G1615.def:
ἐκ-τελέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Deu.32:45 (כָּלָה), 2Ch.4:5, (Da TH Dan.3:40), 2Ma.15:9 * ;]
to bring to an end, finish, complete: Luk.14:29-30.†
(AS)

G2274.def:
ἡττάω, -ῶ
(ἡσσ-, 2Co.12:13, see: ἥσσων) [in LXX for חָתַת, etc. ;]
pass.,
1. to be inferior: before ὑπέρ, 2Co.12:13.
2. to be overcome: absol., 2Pe.2:20; with dative, 2Pe.2:19.†
(AS)
G2274.strong_def: to make worse, i.e. vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower

G5073.derivation: from G5064 (τέσσαρες) and a derivative of the base of G4118 (πλεῖστος);

G2928.def:
Κρύπτω
[in LXX for חָבָא, טָמַן, סָתַר, צָפַן, etc. ;]
to hide, conceal: with accusative, Mat.13:44 25:18; before ἐν, Mat.25:25 (pass., Mat.13:44, Col.3:3); pass., Mat.5:14, Heb.11:23, 1Ti.5:25, Rev.2:17; ἐκρύβη (on the tense and its formation, see M, Pr., 161; Bl., § 19, 3) κ. ἐξῆλθεν Jhn.8:59; before εἰς, Luk.13:21, Rev.6:15; ἀπό (in cl. more frequently dupl. accusative), Rev.6:16; pass., Jhn.12:36, (Bl., § 34, 4). Metaphorical: Mat.11:25 13:35, Luk.11:52, WH, mg., Luk.18:34 19:42, Jhn.19:38 (cf.ἀτο-, ἐν-, περι-κρύπτω).†
(AS)

G1966.def:
ἔπ-ειμι
[in LXX: Exo.8:22 (עָמַד), Sir.42:19, etc. ;]
1. to come upon, approach
2. Of time, to come on or after; mostly as ptcp., ἐπιών, -οῦσα, όν, next, following: τῇ- ἔ. (sc.ἡμέρᾳ, as frequently in late Gk.), Act.16:11 20:15 21:18; ἡμέρᾳ (as usual in cl.), Act.7:26; νυκτί, Act.23:11.†
(AS)
G1966.strong_def: supervening, i.e. (G2250 (ἡμέρα) or G3571 (νύξ) being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night
G1966.derivation: feminine singular participle of a comparative of G1909 (ἐπί) and (to go);

G1716.def:
ἐμ-πτύω
[in LXX: before εἰς, Num.12:14 A, Deu.25:9 (יָרָק)* ;]
= cl., καταπτύω (Ruth., NPhr., 66),
to spit upon: with dative, Mrk.10:34 14:65 15:19; before εἰς, Mat.26:67 27:30. Pass., Luk.18:32.†
(AS)

G4641.derivation: feminine of a compound of G4642 (σκληρός) and G2588 (καρδία);

G0506.def:
ἀνυπότακτος, -ον
(ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω) [in Sm.: 1Ki.2:12 10:27 (for LXX, λοιμός, בֵּן בְּלִיַּעַל)* ;]
of things, not subject to rule: Heb.2:8; of persons, unruly: 1Ti.1:9, Tit.1:6, 10 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0506.strong_def: unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper)
G0506.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5293 (ὑποτάσσω);

G4181.strong_def: in many portions, i.e. variously as to time and agency (piecemeal)
G4181.derivation: adverb from a compound of G4183 (πολύς) and G3313 (μέρος);

G2577.def:
κάμνω
[in LXX: Job.10:1 (קוּט ni.) Job.17:2, Wis.4:16 15:9, 4Ma.3:8 4Mac 7:13 * ;]
1. to work; hence, from the effect of continued work,
2. to be weary: Heb.12:3
3. to be sick: Jas.5:15.†
(AS)
G2577.strong_def: properly, to toil, i.e. (by implication) to tire (figuratively, faint, sicken)

G3634.gloss: so (as), such as, what (manner of), which
G3634.strong_def: such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so
G3634.derivation: probably akin to G3588 (ὁ), G3739 (ὅς), and G3745 (ὅσος);

G0605.def:
ἀπο-κατά-στασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκαθίστημι),
restoration: Act.3:21 (in τ. of repairs and restorations of temples, see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G5125.gloss: such, them, there(-in, -with), these, this, those
G5125.strong_def: to (for, in, with or by) these (persons or things)
G5125.derivation: dative case plural masculine or neuter of G3778 (οὗτος);

G2258.def:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
I. As substantive verb.
1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.
4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.;
(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult.
2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:7, 2Ti.2:19.
4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): Act.1:8, 9:15, Rom.4:12, 1Co.1:18, 2:14, Rev.21:7, al.
5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mat.10:30, Luk.9:32, Jhn.3:24, Act.21:35, 1Co.15:19, al;
(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Luk.4:31, 14:1, Act.1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rom.12:9, 10, Heb.13:5, al.;
(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Luk.23:9.
6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:8, Heb.8:10, al.
7. C. adv.: Mat.19:20, Mrk.4:26, Luk.18:11, al.
8. Ellipses;
(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mat.8:29, 24:32, Jhn.21:22, 23, Heb.6:4, al.;
(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mat.14:27, Mrk.6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Deu.32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mrk.13:6, Jhn.4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)

G2704.def:
κατα-φθείρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi., Gen.6:12, al. ;]
1 1 to destroy entirely.
2. In moral sense (as LXX), to deprave, corrupt: pass. pf. ptcp., before τ. νο ν, 2Ti.3:8.†
(AS)
G2704.strong_def: to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave;

G0424.def:
ἀν-έρχομαι
[in LXX: 3Ki.13:12 (הָלַךְ)* ;]
to go up: Jhn.6:3, Gal.1:17-18 (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G5309.strong_def: to be lofty in mind, i.e. arrogant
G5309.derivation: from a compound of G5308 (ὑψηλός) and G5424 (φρήν);

G1484.def:
ἔθνος, -ους, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for עַם ,גּוֹי ;]
1. a multitude, a company, whether of beasts or men (Hom.).
2. a nation, people: Mat.21:43 24:7, Mrk.13:8, Luk.22:25, Act.10:35, al.; in sing., of the Jewish people, Luk.7:5 23:2, Jhn.11:48, 50-53 18:35, Act.10:22 24:3, 10 26:4 28:19.
3. In pl., as in OT, τὰ ἔ. (like Heb. הַגּוֹיִם), the nations, as distinct from Israel, Gentiles: Mat.4:15 6:32, Act.26:17, Rom.3:29 11:11 15:10, Gal.2:8, al.; of Gentile Christians, Rom.11:13 15:27 16:4, Gal.2:12, 14, Eph.3:1.
SYN.: λαός (see DCG, ii, 229; Cremer, 226). (AS)
G1484.strong_def: a race (as of the same habit), i.e. a tribe; specially, a foreign (non-Jewish) one (usually, by implication, pagan)

G2256.def:
ἡμίωρον (Rec. -ιον), -ου, τό
(ἥμι, half + ὥρα),
half an hour: Rev.8:1.†
(AS)
G2256.derivation: from the base of G2255 (ἥμισυ) and G5610 (ὥρα);

G3691.derivation: probably akin to the base of G188 (ἀκμήν) ("acid");

G1604.def:
ἐκ-πλήρωσις, -εως, ἡ)
[in LXX: 2Ma.6:14 * ;]
a completion, fulfilment: Act.21:26.†
(AS)

G2594.def:
καρτερέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Job.2:9 (חָזַק hi.), Isa.42:14 (פָּאָה), Sir.2:2 12:15, 2 12:1-18, 4Macc 7:1-23 * ;]
to be steadfast, patient: Heb.11:27 (cf. προσ-καρτερέω).†
(AS)

G2660.def:
κατα-νύσσω
[in LXX: Gen.34:7 (עָצַב hith.), Lev.10:3, Psa.4:4, Psa 29:12, al. (דָּמַם), Dan LXX TH Sus 1:10 (רָדַם ni.), Sir.12:12 14:1, al. ;]
1. to strike or prick violently.
2. to stun.
3. Of strong emotion, pass., to be smitten: τὴν καρδίαν, Act.2:37 (see: κατάνυξις).†
(AS)
G2660.strong_def: to pierce thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate violently ("sting to the quick")

G5508.strong_def: Chios, an island in the Mediterranean

G4270.gloss: before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime)
G4270.strong_def: to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe

G3712.strong_def: a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom

G0968.def:
βῆμα, -τος, τό
(βαίνω), [in LXX: Deu.2:5 (מִדְרָךְ), Neh.8:4 (מִגְדָּל), I Est.9:42, Sir.19:30 45:9, 2Ma.13:26 * ;]
1. a step, stride, pace: Act.7:5.
2. a raised place, a platform reached by steps, originally that in the Pnyx at Athens from which orations were made; frequently of the tribune or tribunal of a Roman magistrate or ruler: Mat.27:19, Jhn.19:13, Act.12:21, 18:12, 16, 17 25:6, 10, 17; β. τοῦ θεοῦ, Rom.14:10; τ. Χριστοῦ, 2Co.5:10.
† (AS)
G0968.strong_def: a step, i.e. foot-breath; by implication, a rostrum, i.e. a tribunal

G3546.strong_def: what is reckoned as of value (after the Latin numisma), i.e. current coin

G4237.strong_def: a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement)
G4237.derivation: perhaps from (a leek, and so an onion-patch);

G2583.def:
κανών, -όνος, ὁ
(cf. κάννα, and Heb. קָנֶה, a reed), [in LXX: Mic.7:4, Jdth.13:6, 4Ma.7:21 (and in Aq., Psa.19:5, Job.38:5)* ;]
1. a rod or bar (Jth, l.with).
2. a measuring rule; hence, metaph,
3. a rule or standard: Gal.6:16.
4. a limit (RV, province): 2Co.10:13-16. (For the history of the word and esp. its later meanings, see Westc., Canon, App. A; cf. also MM, Exp., xv; Cremer, 744.)†
(AS)
G2583.strong_def: a rule ("canon"), i.e. (figuratively) a standard (of faith and practice); by implication, a boundary, i.e. (figuratively) a sphere (of activity)

G5134.strong_def: akin to the base of G2352 (θραύω), G5147 (τρίβος), G5149 (τρίζω), etc.); a wound

G1179.def:
Δεκά-πολις, -εως, ὴ
Decapolis, a region east of the Jordan con­taining ten cities: Mat.4:25, Mrk.5:20 7:31.†
(AS)
G1179.strong_def: the ten-city region; the Decapolis, a district in Syria

G0453.def:
ἀ-νόητος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., νοητός; νοέω), [in LXX: Pro.17:28 (אֱוִיל), Sir.42:8, al. ;]
1. not thought on, not understood (Hom., Plat.).
2. not understanding, foolish (Hdt., al., LXX): Luk.24:25, Rom.1:14, Gal.3:1, 3, 1Ti.6:9, Tit.3:3 (Cremer, 438, 790; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀσύνετος (see Tr., Syn., § LXXv) (AS)
G0453.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3539 (νοιέω);

G2949.def:
κῦμα, -τος, τό
(κύω, to be pregnant, to swell) [in LXX chiefly for גַּל ;]
a wave: pl., Mat.8:24 14:24, Mrk.4:37; κ. θαλάσσης, figuratively, Ju 13.†
SYN.: κλύδων, q.v (AS)
G2949.derivation: from (to swell (with young), i.e. bend, curve);

G3782.strong_def: indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty

G0527.def:
ἀπαλός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for רַךְ ;]
tender: Mat.24:32, Mrk.13:28.†
(AS)

G3094.strong_def: a female Magdalene, i.e. inhabitant of Magdala
G3094.derivation: feminine of a derivative of G3093 (Μαγδαλά);

G4831.derivation: from a presumed compound of G4862 (σύν) and G3401 (μιμέομαι);

G3779.gloss: after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what
G3779.strong_def: in this way (referring to what precedes or follows)

G2448.strong_def: Judah (i.e. Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine
G2448.derivation: of Hebrew origin (H03063 or perhaps H03194);

G4209.strong_def: the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it

G5614.strong_def: oh save!; hosanna (i.e. hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration

G4974.strong_def: compare the feminine , a hammer); the ankle (as globular)
G4974.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative probably of the same as (a ball, "sphere";

G0698.def:
Ἀρεοπαγίτης (T, -είτης), -ου, ὁ (see supr.),
a judge of the Court of Areopagus: Act.17:34.†
(AS)
G0698.strong_def: an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill

G4833.strong_def: to render like, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate

G1145.def:
δακρύω
[in LXX for בָּכָה, etc. ;]
to weep, shed tears: Jhn.11:35.†
SYN.: κλαίω, of audible weeping, to cry; ὀδύρομαι, of grief expressed verbally, to lament; θρηνέω, of formal lamentation, to sing a dirge; ἀλαλάζω, to wail in Oriental fashion; στενάζω, of grief expressed by inarticulate sounds, to groan. (AS)

G2018.def:
ἐπι-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַח ;]
1. to bring upon or against: κρίσιν, Ju 9.
2. to impose, inflict: Rom.3:5.†
(AS)
G2018.strong_def: to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce

G3106.strong_def: to beatify, i.e. pronounce (or esteem) fortunate

G2776.def:
κεφαλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX nearly always for רֹאשׁ ;]
the head: Mat.5:35, Mrk.6:24, Rev.1:14 9:7, al. mult.; figuratively, ἄνθρακες ἐπὶ τὴν κ., Rom.12:20 (LXX); αἷμι, Act.18:6; metaphorically, of a husband, with genitive, 1Co.1:13, Eph.5:23; of Christ, 1Co.11:3, Eph.4:15 5:23, Col.1:18 2:10, 19; of things, κ. γωνίας, Mat.21:42 (LXX)
(AS)
G2776.strong_def: the head (as the part most readily taken hold of), literally or figuratively
G2776.derivation: from the primary (in the sense of seizing);

G4438.strong_def: to box (with the fist), i.e. contend (as a boxer) at the games (figuratively)
G4438.derivation: from a derivative of the same as G4435 (πυγμή);

G3699.gloss: in what place, where(-as, -soever), whither (+ soever)
G3699.strong_def: what(-ever) where, i.e. at whichever spot

G0018.def:
ἀγαθός, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
in general, good, in physical and in moral sense, used of persons, things, acts, conditions, etc., applied to that which is regarded as "perfect in its kind, so as to produce pleasure and satisfaction, . . . that which, in itself good, is also at once for the good and the advantage of him who comes in contact with it" (Cremer, 3): γῆ, Luk.8:8; δένδρον, Mat.7:18; καρδία, Luk.8:15; δόσις, Jas.1:17; μέρις, Luk.10:42; ἔργον (frequently in Pl.), Php.1:6; ἐλπίς, 2Th.2:16; θησαυρός, Mat.12:35; μνεία, 1Th.3:6 (cf. 2Ma.7:20); as subst., τὸ ἀ, that which is morally good, beneficial, acceptable to God, Rom.12:2; ἐργάζεσθαι τὸ ἀ, Rom.2:10, Eph.4:28; πράσσειν, Rom.9:11, 2Co.5:10; διώκειν, 1Th.5:15; μιμεῖσθαι, III Jo 11; κολλᾶσθαι τῷ ἀ, Rom.12:9; ερωτᾶν περὶ τοῦ ἀ., Mat.19:17; διάκονος εἰς τὸ ἀ., Rom.13:4; τὸ ἀ. σου, thy favour, benefit, Phm 14; pl., τὰ ἀ., of goods, possessions, Luk.12:18; of spiritual benefits, Rom.10:15, Heb.9:11, 10:1. ἀ is opposite to πονηρός, Mat.5:45, 20:5; κακός, Rom.7:19; φαῦλος, Rom.9:11, 2Co.5:10 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).
SYN.: καλός, δίκαιος. κ. properly refers to goodliness as manifested in form: ἀ. to inner excellence (cf. the cl. καλὸς κἀγαθός and ἐν καρδία κ. καὶ ἀ., Luk.8:15). In Rom.5:7, where it is contrasted with δ., ἀ. implies a kindliness and attractiveness not necessarily possessed by the δίκαιος, who merely measures up to a high standard of rectitude (cf. ἀγαθωσύνη). (AS)

G0457.def:
ἄνοιξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνοίγω),
an opening (in MGr., springtime): ἐν ἀ., as often as I open, Eph.6:19.†
(AS)

G4249.derivation: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw);

G4285.strong_def: to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference

G1324.def:
Δίδυμος, -ου, ὁ
(prop. name from δίδυμος, -η, -ον, double, sc. παῖς, twin)
Didymus, surname of the apostle Thomas: Jhn.11:16 20:24 21:2.†
(AS)
G1324.strong_def: double, i.e. twin; Didymus, a Christian

G3683.derivation: from a derivative of G3685 (ὀνίνημι) and G5411 (φόρος);

G4786.strong_def: to commingle, i.e. (figuratively) to combine or assimilate

G4568.strong_def: a certain measure for things dry

G1533.def:
εἰσ-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא hi. ;]
to bring in, into: with accusative of person(s), Luk.5:18-19; before εἰς, Mat.6:13, Luk.11:4; ἐπί, Luk.12:11; with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς, 1Ti.6:7; pass., Heb.13:11.†
(AS)

G1750.def:
ἐν-ειλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX 1Ki.21:9 לוּט * ;]
to roll in, wind in: with accusative of person(s) and dative of thing(s), Mrk.15:46.†
(AS)
G1750.derivation: from G1772 (ἔννομος) and the base of G1507 (εἱλίσσω);

G2876.def:
κόραξ, -ακος, ὁ
[in LXX for עֹרֵב ;]
a raven: Luk.12:24.†
(AS)

G2779.def:
κῆπος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for גַּן, גַּנָּה, גִּנָּה, Deu.11:10, Sng.4:12, al. ;]
a garden: Luk.13:19, Jhn.18:1, 26 19:41.†
(AS)

G0925.def:
βαρύνω,
to weigh down = βαρέω (which see): Luk.21:34, Rec.†
(AS)

G2817.def:
κληρονομία, -ας, ἡ
(κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for נַחֲלָה, also for יְרֻשָּׁה, etc. ;]
prop., an inherited property, an inheritance: Mat.21:38, Mrk.12:7, Luk.12:13 20:14; in general, a possession, inheritance: Act.7:5, Heb.11:8; of the Messianic Kingdom and its blessings, Act.20:32, Gal.3:18, Col.3:24, Eph.1:14, 18 5:5, Heb.9:15, 1Pe.1:4.†
(AS)
G2817.strong_def: heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession

G2055.def:
ἐρίφιον, -ου, τό
(dim, of ἔριφος, which see) [in LXX: Tob.2:13 * ;]
Mat.25:33, Luk.15:29 (ἔριφον, WH, txt.).†
(AS)
G2055.strong_def: a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person)

G4925.strong_def: to construct, i.e. (passively) to compose (in company with other Christians, figuratively)

G5503.strong_def: a widow (as lacking a husband), literally or figuratively
G5503.derivation: feminine of a presumed derivative apparently from the base of G5490 (χάσμα) through the idea of deficiency;

G2820.def:
κληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Ki.14:41 (לָכַד ni.), Est.4:11 A (קָרָא ni.), Isa.17:11 * ;]
1. to cast lots.
2. to choose by lot.
3. to assign by lot, assign a portion: pass., ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν, Eph.1:11 (on the various interpretations, see ICC; AR; Ellic., in l).†
(AS)
G2820.strong_def: to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege)

G0091.def:
ἀδικέω, -ῶ
(ἄδικος), [in LXX for עשׁק, עוה, etc. ;]
1. intrans., to be ἄδικος, do wrong, act wickedly or criminally: Act.25:11, 1Co.6:8, 2Co.7:12, Col.3:25, Rev.22:11; to do hurt, Rev.9:19.
2. Trans.
(a) to do some wrong: ὃ ἠδίκησεν, Col.3:25; to wrong some one, Mat.20:13, Act.7:26, 27 25:10, 2Co.7:2, Gal.4:12, Phm 18, 2Pe.2:13; pass., Act.7:24, 2Co.7:12; mid., 1Co.6:7 (suffer . . . to be wronged; WM, §38, 3; but see Bl., §54, 5; and cf. ἀποστερέω);
(b) to injure, hurt: Luk.10:19 Rev.2:11 6:6 7:2, 3 9:4,10 11:5.
† (AS)
G0091.strong_def: to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically)

G1077.def:
γενέσια, -ων, τά, neut. pl. of adj. -ιος, -ον, relating to birth (γένεσις);
1. in Attic Gk., a commemoration of the dead.
2. In late Gk., a birthday feast (= cl. γενέθλια; so in π., see MM, Exp., x; cf. also Ῥutherford, NPhr., 184): Mat.14:6, Mrk.6:21.
† (AS)
G1077.derivation: neuter plural of a derivative of G1078 (γένεσις);

G0042.def:
ἁγιωσύνη (cf. ἀγαθωσύνη), -ης, ἡ
(ἅγιος), [in LXX: Psa.29 (30):4 96(97):12 (קֹדֶשׁ), 95(96):6 (עֹז), 144(145):5 (הוֹד), 2Ma.3:12 * ;]
holiness, the state in man resulting from ἁγιασμός, which see: Rom.1:4, 2Co.7:1, 1Th.3:13 (Cremer, 52; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4368.derivation: feminine of a derivative of G4291 (προΐστημι);

G2700.def:
κατα-τοξεύω
[in LXX: Exo.19:13 (יָרָה), al. ;]
to strike down with an arrow, shoot dead: Heb.12:20 (LXX) (Rec.; WH, R, om.).†
(AS)
G2700.strong_def: to shoot down with an arrow or other missile
G2700.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G5115 (τόξον);

G2164.strong_def: to bear well, i.e. be fertile

G5279.gloss: put in mind, remember, bring to (put in) remembrance
G5279.strong_def: to remind quietly, i.e. suggest to the (middle voice, one's own) memory

G1456.def:
ἐγκαίνια, see: ἐνκ-
ἐνκαίνια (Rec. ἐγκ-), -ων, τά (ἐν, καινός),
[in LXX for HSjrj, II Est.6:16, 17, Neh.12:27, Da TH 3:2 (and cf. ἐγκαινισμός, Num.7:10, al., -ισις, Num.7:88) *;]
dedication (anniversary of the cleansing of the Temple from the defilements of Antiochus Epiphanes) : Jhn.10:22.†
(AS)
G1456.strong_def: innovatives, i.e. (specially) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption)
G1456.derivation: neuter plural of a presumed compound from G1722 (ἐν) and G2537 (καινός);

G4693.strong_def: a cavern; by implication, a hiding-place or resort
G4693.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of (a grotto);

G0670.def:
ἀπο-φορτίζομαι
(φορτίζω, to load),
to discharge a cargo (Field, Notes, 134), to unlade: with accusative, τ. γόμον, Act.21:3.†
(AS)
G0670.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the middle voice of G5412 (φορτίζω);

G4133.gloss: but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than
G4133.strong_def: moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather, yet

G4378.derivation: from a comparative of G4314 (πρός) and (to pour);

G4259.derivation: neuter of a presumed compound of G4253 (πρό) and G833 (αὐλή);

G0359.def:
ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναλύω),
a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, 2Ti.4:6.†
(AS)

G5546.strong_def: a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ

G2867.def:
κονιάω, -ῶ
(κονία, dust, lime), [in LXX: Deu.27:2, 4 (שִׂיד), Pro.21:9 * ;]
to plaster or whiten over: of tombs, Mat.23:27; figuratively, of a hypocrite, Act.23:3.†
(AS)

G2743.def:
καυστηριάζω (Rec. καυτηρ-, and so usually in Gk. writers, see Soph., Lex., see word)
to mark by branding, brand (AV, scar, but see CGT, in l): metaphorically, pass. pf. ptcp., 1Ti.4:2 (cf. καυτήριον, 4Ma.15:22 *).†
(AS)
G2743.strong_def: to brand ("cauterize"), i.e. (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively)

G5343.strong_def: to run away (literally or figuratively); by implication, to shun; by analogy, to vanish

G5475.strong_def: copper (the substance, or some implement or coin made of it)
G5475.derivation: perhaps from G5465 (χαλάω) through the idea of hollowing out as a vessel (this metal being chiefly used for that purpose);

G0783.def:
ἀσπασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀσπάζομαι),
a salutation (so always in RV), greeting: oral, Mat.23:7, Mrk.12:38, Luk.1:29, 41 1:44 11:43 20:46; written, 1Co.16:21, Col.4:18, 2Th.3:17.†
(AS)
G0783.strong_def: a greeting (in person or by letter)

G5351.strong_def: properly, to shrivel or wither, i.e. to spoil (by any process) or (generally) to ruin (especially figuratively, by moral influences, to deprave)
G5351.derivation: probably strengthened from (to pine or waste);

G5431.strong_def: to exercise thought, i.e. be anxious

G4856.strong_def: to be harmonious, i.e. (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact)

G1856.def:
ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;]
1. to thrust out: Act.7:45.
2. to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: Act.27:39 (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†
*ἐκ-σώζω,
to preserve from danger, bring safe: Act.27:39 (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).†
ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;]
1. to thrust out: Act.7:45.
2. to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: Act.27:39 (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†
*ἐκ-σώζω,
to preserve from danger, bring safe: Act.27:39 (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).†
(AS)
G1856.strong_def: to expel; by implication, to propel

G0531.def:
ἀ-παρά-βατος, -ον
(παραβαίνω),
inviolable, and so unchangeable: Heb.7:24 (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0531.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3845 (παραβαίνω);

G1887.def:
ἐπ-αύριον,
adv. [in LXX for מָחָר, Gen.30:33, elsewhere, Exo.9:6, al., for מׇחֳרָת ;]
on the morrow: in NT, ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἡμέρα), Mat.27:62, Mrk.11:12, Jhn.1:29, Act.10:9, al
(AS)
G1887.strong_def: occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (G2250 (ἡμέρα) being implied) to-morrow

G1234.def:
δια-γογγύζω
[in LXX chiefly for לין, לון, as Exo.16:2, and cf. Si 34(31):24 ;]
of a number, to murmur or mutter among themselves: Luk.15:2 19:7.†
(AS)

G0100.def:
ἁδρότης, -τος, ἡ
(ἁδρός, thick, well-grown),
1. thickness, vigour.
2. abundance, bounty: 2Co.8:20.
† (AS)

G0899.def:
βάθος, -εος (-ους), τό,
[in LXX for מְצוּלָה ,תַּחְתִּי, etc. ;]
depth: Mat.13:5, Mrk.4:5, Rom.8:39, Eph.3:18; τὸ β., the deep sea: Luk.5:4; metaphorically, β. πλούτου . . . Θεοῦ, Rom.11:33; τὰ β. τ. Θεοῦ (the Divine counsels), 1Co.2:10; ἡ κατὰ βάθους πτωχεία, deep poverty, 2Co.8:2.†
(AS)

G1089.def:
γεύω, γεύομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for טעם ;]
to make to taste. Mid., to taste eat: absol., Act.10:10 20:11, Col.2:21; with genitive, Mat.27:34, Luk.14:24, Act.23:14; with accusative (not cl., but see Westc, Heb., l.with; M, Pr., 66, 245), Jhn.2:9. Metaphorical, Heb.6:4; ῥῆμα θεοῦ, Heb.6:5 (on case, see supr., and cf. Milligan, NTD, 68) θανάτου (cf. Talmudic טַעַם מִיתָה), Mat.16:28, Mrk.9:1, Luk.9:27, Jhn.8:52, Heb.2:9; before ὅτι, 1Pe.2:3 (Cremer, 148).†
(AS)
G1089.strong_def: to taste; by implication, to eat; figuratively, to experience (good or ill)

G4273.derivation: from G4272 (προδίδωμι) (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands);

G2025.def:
ἐπι-χρίω
[in Sm.: Eze.13:10 22:28 * ;]
to spread on, anoint: with accusative, Jhn.9:11; id. before hi-I, with accusative, Jhn.9:6 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G2408.def:
Ἰερεμίας (T, Rec. Ἱερ-; see WH, § 408), -ου, ὁ
Heb. Jeremiah the prophet: Mat.2:17 16:14 27:9 (a ref. to Zec.11:13).†
(AS)

G0784.def:
ἄ-σπιλος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σπῖλος) [in Sm.: Job.15:15 (LXX, καθαρός)* ;]
spotless, unstained: 1Pe.1:19; metaphorically, 1Ti.6:14, Jas.1:27, 2Pe.3:14 (for exx., see MM, see word).†
SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄμωμος (AS)
G0784.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G4695 (σπιλόω);

G4549.strong_def: Saul (i.e. Shaul), the Jewish name of Paul

G4481.derivation: by incorrect transliteration for a word of Hebrew origin (H03594);

G3717.strong_def: right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct
G3717.derivation: probably from the base of G3735 (ὄρος);

G4284.strong_def: to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel
G4284.derivation: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2192 (ἔχω);

G0087.def:
ἀ-διά-κριτος, -ον
(διακρίνω), [in LXX: Pro.25:1 * ;]
1. not to be parted, mixed, undistinguishable (cf. Pr, l.with, and see Lft., Ignat. Eph., §3).
2. without uncertainty (Hort, in l., but see MM, VGT, see word): Jas.3:17.
† (AS)
G0087.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1252 (διακρίνω);

G0343.def:
ἀνα-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ni., pi. ;]
to unveil: metaphorically of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, 2Co.3:14 3:18.†
(AS)
G0343.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G2572 (καλύπτω);

G4648.gloss: consider, take heed, look at (on), mark
G4648.strong_def: to take aim at (spy), i.e. (figuratively) regard

G2778.def:
κῆνσος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. census),
a poll-tax: Mat.17:25 22:17, Mrk.12:14 (WH, mg., ἐπικεφάλαιον); τ. νόμισμα τοῦ κ., Mat.22:19 (see MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)
G2778.strong_def: properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by implication) a tax

G0980.def:
βιόω, -ῶ
(βίος), [in LXX: Pro.7:2 9:6 (חיה), Job.29:18, Wis.4:4 א 1, 12:23, Sir.40:28, 4Ma.5:22 17:18 * ;]
to spend life, to live: τ. χρόνον βιῶσαι (cl., more frequently 2 aor., -ναι), 1Pe.4:2 (cf. Jb, l.with).†
SYN.: ζάω (which see). (AS)

G0820.def:
ἄτιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX: Isa.3:5 (קָלָה ni.), Isa.53:3 (בָּזָה), Job.30:4, 8 (שֵׁם בְּלִי), שֵׁם בְּלִי), Wis.5:1-23, Sir.1:1-30 * ;]
without honour, dishonoured, despised: Mat.13:57, Mrk.6:4, 1Co.4:10; comp., 1Co.12:23.†
(AS)
G0820.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5092 (τιμή);

G1025.def:
βρέφος, -ους, τό,
[in LXX: Sir.19:11, 1Ma.1:61, 2Ma.6:10, 3Ma.5:49, 4Ma.4:25 * ;]
1. an unborn child: Luk.1:41, 44.
2. a newborn child, a babe: Luk.2:12, 16 18:15, Act.7:19, 1Pe.2:2; ἀπὸ βρέφους, from infancy, 2Ti.3:15.
† (AS)
G1025.strong_def: an infant (properly, unborn) literally or figuratively

G0242.def:
ἅλλομαι
[in LXX for צָלַח, דָּלַג pi., etc. ;]
to leap: Act.3:8 14:10; of water, to spring up, Jhn.4:14 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0242.derivation: middle voice of apparently a primary verb;

G1109.def:
γνώστης, -ου, ὁ
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for יִדְּעֹנִי ;]
one who knows, an expert: Act.26:3.†
(AS)

G1318.def:
διδακτός, -ή, -όν
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: Isa.54:13 (לִמּוּד), 1Ma.4:7 * ;]
1. that can be taught.
2. taught; with genitive, of source of teaching (in cl., poët. only);
(a) of persons: δ. θεοῦ, Jhn.6:45 (LXX);
(b) of things, λόγοις δ. πνεύματος, 1Co.2:13.†
(AS)

G2473.def:
ἰσόψυχος -ον
(ἴσος, ψυχή), [in LXX: Psa.55:13 (עֵרֶךְ)* ;]
1. of equal spirit (Æsch., Agam., 1470).
2. like-minded: Php.2:20.†
(AS)

G0938.def:
βασίλισσα, -ης, ἡ (in Attic, βασιλεία, βασιλίς),
[in LXX chiefly for מַלְכָּה ;]
a queen: Mat.12:42, Luk.11:31, Act.8:27, Rev.18:7.†
(AS)

G4986.strong_def: of a safe father; Sopatrus, a Christian
G4986.derivation: from the base of G4982 (σώζω) and G3962 (πατήρ);

G2226.def:
ζῷον (Rec. ζῶον, see LS, see word), -ου, τό
(ζωός, alive), [in LXX for חַי (chiefly) and cognate forms; frequently in Wis ;]
a living creature, an animal: Rev.4:6-9 5:6 ff. Rev.6:1 ff. Rev.7:11 14:3 15:7 19:4; ζῴων τ. αἷμα, Heb.13:11; ἄλογα ζ., 2Pe.2:12, Ju 10.†
SYN.: θηρίον, in which the brutal, bestial element is emphasized, and which is never used of sacrificial animals. On the other hand, ζ. is the more comprehensive, as expressing the vital element common to the whole anima] creation (see Tr., Syn., LXXxi; Cremer, 274). (AS)
G2226.strong_def: a live thing, i.e. an animal
G2226.derivation: neuter of a derivative of G2198 (ζάω);

G5302.gloss: come behind (short), be destitute, fail, lack, suffer need, (be in) want, be the worse
G5302.strong_def: to be later, i.e. (by implication) to be inferior; generally, to fall short (be deficient)

G2264.def:
Ἡρῴδης (Rec. -ώδης), -ου, ὁ
Herod;
1. Herod the Great: Mat.2:1-23, Act.23:35.
2. Herod Antipas (ὁ τετραάρχης, Mat.14:1): Mat.14:1, 3 14:6, Mrk.6:1-56, Mrk.8:15, Luk.1:5 3:1, 19 8:3 9:7, 9 13:31, 23, Act.4:27 13:1.
3. Herod Agrippa I: Act.12:1, 6 12:11, 19 12:21 (cf. Ἀγρίππας (II)).†
(AS)
G2264.strong_def: heroic; Herod, the name of four Jewish kings

G0185.def:
ἀκέραιος, -ον
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: Est.8:13 * ;]
unmixed, pure, hence, metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), guileless, simple: Mat.10:16, Rom.16:19, Php.2:15.†
SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς (cf. Ellic. on Phl., l.with; Tr., Syn., §lvi). (AS)
G0185.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767 (κεράννυμι);

G2892.def:
κουστωδία, -ας, ἡ (Lat. custodia),
a guard: Mat.27:65-66 28:11.†
(AS)

G2935.def:
κτήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(κτάομαι) [in Sm.: Jol.1:11 * ;]
a possessor: Act.4:34.†
(AS)

G4308.strong_def: to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view

G1730.def:
ἔν-δειγμα, -τος
(ἐνδείκνυμι),
a plain token, proof: 2Th.1:5 (cf. ἔνδειξις, which refers rather to the "act of proving"; ἔ., with the passive formation, to the thing proved, see Lft., Notes, 100; M, Th., l.with).†
SYN.: τεκμήριον (AS)

G1085.def:
γένος, -ους, τό
(γίγνομαι), [in LXX for עַם, מִין, זֶרַע, etc. ;]
1. family: Act.4:6 7:13 13:26.
2. offspring: Act.17:28, 29 Rev.22:16.
3. race, nation; Mrk.7:28, Act.4:36 7:19 18:2, 24, 2Co.11:26, Php.3:5, Gal.1:14, 1Pe.2:9.
4. kind, sort, class: Mat.13:47 17:21, Rec., Mrk.9:29, 1Co.12:10, 28 14:10.
† (AS)
G1085.strong_def: "kin" (abstract or concrete, literal or figurative, individual or collective)

G0371.def:
ἀναξίως
(see supr.), adv., [in LXX: 2Ma.14:42 * ;]
in an unworthy manner: 1Co.11:27.†
(AS)

G2544.def:
καίτοιγε
strengthened form of καίτοι, which see (and see: γε): Jhn.4:2.†
(AS)
G2544.strong_def: and yet indeed, i.e. although really

G4165.strong_def: to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser)

G0680.def:
to touch, hold, handle; (act.) to start a fire; "to touch a woman" means "to get married"
primarily to bring in contact, fit, fasten; to light, kindle, Mk. 4:21; Lk. 8:16; to touch, Mt. 8:3; to meddle, venture to partake, Col. 2:21; to have intercourse with, to know carnally, 1Cor. 7:1; by implication to harm, 1Jn. 5:18
G0680.strong_def: properly, to attach oneself to, i.e. to touch (in many implied relations)

G1711.def:
ἐμπορία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX for סָחַר, רָכַל etc. ;]
commerce, business, trade: Mat.22:5.†
(AS)

G2146.def:
εὐ-προσωπέω, -ῶ
(εὐπρόσωπος, fair of face), [in Al.: Psa.141:6, seel. for -ίζω* ;]
to look well, make a fair show: metaphorically (as in 7.; see Deiss., LAE, 96), Gal.6:12.†
(AS)
G2146.strong_def: to be of good countenance, i.e. (figuratively) to make a display
G2146.derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G4383 (πρόσωπον);

G1686.def:
ἐμ-βάπτω
to dip in: τ. χεῖρα ἐν τ. τρυβλίῳ, Mat.26:23; mid., before εἰς, Mrk.14:20.†
(AS)
G1686.strong_def: to whelm on, i.e. wet (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid

G4942.strong_def: to act hypocritically in concert with

G3954.gloss: bold (X -ly, -ness, -ness of speech), confidence, X freely, X openly, X plainly(-ness)
G3954.strong_def: all out-spokenness, i.e. frankness, bluntness, publicity; by implication, assurance
G3954.derivation: from G3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of G4483 (ῥέω);

G4471.strong_def: Rama (i.e. Ramah), a place in Palestine

G1942.def:
ἐπι-κάλυμμα, -τος, τό
(ἐπικαλύπτω), [in LXX: Exo.26:14 39:34, (מְכַסֶּה), 4Ki.17:19 (מָסָךְ), Job.19:29 (aliter in Heb.)* ;]
a cover, veil: metaphorically, τ. κακίας, 1Pe.2:16.†
(AS)

G4485.strong_def: something torn, i.e. a fragment (by implication and abstractly, a fall)

G4775.strong_def: to seat oneself in company with

G1764.strong_def: to place on hand, i.e. (reflexively) impend, (participle) be instant

G0127.def:
αἰδώς (-όος), -οῦς, ἡ,
[in LXX: 3Ma.1:19 4:5 * ;]
a sense of shame, modesty: 1Ti.2:9 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: αἰσχύνη (see Thayer, 14; Tr., Syn., §xix; Cremer, 611 f.; CGT on I Ti, l.with). (AS)
G0127.strong_def: bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe
G0127.derivation: perhaps from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1492 (εἴδω) (through the idea of downcast eyes);

G5610.gloss: day, hour, instant, season, X short, (even-)tide, (high) time

G2299.def:
θεά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(fem. of θεός, which see),
a goddess: Act.19:27.†
(AS)

G2345.def:
θιγγάνω
[in LXX for נָגַע, Exo.19:12 * ;]
1. to touch, handle: Col.2:21, Heb.12:20" (LXX) .
2. to injure (like Heb. נָגַע, and as in Eur., Iph. Aul., 1351): with genitive, Heb.11:28.†
SYN.: see: ἅπτω (AS)
G2345.strong_def: to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure
G2345.derivation: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (to finger);

G0106.def:
ἄζυμος, -ον
(ζύμη), [in LXX for מָצָּה; τὰ ἄ. (sc. λάγανα, cakes) = הַמָצָּה ;]
unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., Mrk.14:1), Luk.22:1; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., Mat.26:17, Mrk.14:12, Luk.22:7; ἡμέραι, Act.12:3 20:6. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: 1Co.5:7; exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), ib. 8 (Cremer, 724).†
(AS)
G0106.strong_def: unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week
G0106.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2219 (ζύμη);

G1169.def:
δειλός, -ή, όν
(δέος), [in LXX for רַךְ, etc. ;]
cowardly, fearful: Mat.8:26, Mrk.4:40, Rev.21:8.†
(AS)

G1370.def:
διχοστασία, -ας, ἡ
(διχοστατέω, to stand apart), [in LXX: 1Ma.3:29 * ;]
standing apart, dissension: Rom.16:17, Gal.5:20.†
(AS)
G1370.derivation: from a derivative of G1364 (δίς) and G4714 (στάσις);

G1147.def:
δάκτυλος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for אֶצְבַּע ;]
a finger: Mat.23:4, Mrk.7:33, Luk.11:46 16:24, Jhn.8:6, 8 20:25, 27; metaphorically, δ. θεοῦ (cf. Exo.8:19), Luk.11:20.†
(AS)

G4862.strong_def: with or together (but much closer than G3326 (μετά) or G3844 (παρά)), i.e. by association, companionship, process, resemblance, possession, instrumentality, addition, etc.

G1704.def:
ἐν-περι-πατέω, -ῶ
(Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: Lev.26:12 Job.1:7, al. (הָלַךְ hithp.), Wis.19:21 ;]
to walk about in or among: before ἐν., dative of person(s), 2Co.6:16 (LXX),†
(AS)
G1704.strong_def: to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to be occupied among persons

G4031.strong_def: strong all around, i.e. a master (manager)

G1578.def:
ἐκ-κλίνω
[in LXX for נָטָה, סוּר, etc. ;]
intrans., to turn aside, turn away: metaphorically, from the right path, absol., Rom.3:12 (LXX); from evil, absol., 1Pe.3:11; before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), Rom.16:17.†
(AS)
G1578.strong_def: to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety)

G0533.def:
ἀπ-αρνέομαι (-οῦμαι) depon.,
[in LXX: Isa.31:7 (מָאַס) * ;]
to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, to ignore: with accusative, of oneself (DCG, ii, 598 f.), Mat.16:24, Mrk.8:34 (MM, VGT, see word), Luk.9:23 (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, Mat.26:34-35, 75, Mrk.14:30-31, 72, Luk.22:34, 61; pass., Luk.12:9 (Cremer, 111).†
(AS)
G0533.strong_def: to deny utterly, i.e. disown, abstain

G1884.def:
ἐπ-αρκέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Ma.8:26 1Mac 11:35 * ;]
1. to be strong enough for.
2. to ward off.
3. to aid, relieve: with dative of person(s), 1Ti.5:10 5:16 (mid., WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G5589.derivation: diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5567 (ψάλλω) (meaning a crumb);

G3424.gloss: having an impediment in his speech

G0652.def:
ἀπόστολος, -ου, ὁ
(ἀοστέλλω), [in LXX; 3Ki.14:6 A (שָׁלַח) * ;]
1. a fleet, an expedition (Dem.).
2. a messenger, one sent on a mission (Hdt., LXX, l.with, and π.; see M, Pr., 37 f.; MM, see word; M, Th., i, 2:7 and reff.): Jhn.13:16, 2Co.8:23 Php.2:25.
3. In NT, an Apostle of Christ
(a) with special ref. to the Twelve: Mat.10:2, Mrk.3:14, Luk.11:49, Eph.3:5, Rev.18:20, al., equality with whom is claimed by St. Paul, Gal.1:1, 11 ff, 1Ti.2:7, a1.;
(b) in a wider sense of prominent Christian teachers, as Barnabas, Act.14:14, apparently also Silvanus and Timothy, 1Th.2:6, and perhaps Andronicus and Junias (Junia?), Rom.16:7 (see ICC, in l); of false teachers, claiming apostleship: 2Co.11:5 11:13, Rev.2:2. (On the different uses of the term in NT, see Lit., Gal., 92-101; Cremer, 530; DB, i, 126; DCG, i, 105; Enc. Br., ii, 196 ff.)
(AS)
G0652.strong_def: a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers)

G3715.strong_def: excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after

G4185.gloss: costly, very precious, of great price

G4281.gloss: go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on
G4281.strong_def: to go onward, precede (in place or time)
G4281.derivation: from G4253 (πρό) and G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (including its alternate);

G1535.def:
εἴτε, see: εἰ.
εἰ,
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
I. Conditional, if;
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20;
(b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20;
(with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.;
(d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al.
2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, if, whether.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12.
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luk.11:18; but even if, 1Co.4:7, 2Co.4:3 11:16.
3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Mrk.2:21, 22 Jhn.14:2, Rev.2:5, al.
4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Mrk.14:29, Luk.11:8, 1Co.7:21, 2Co.4:16, Php.2:17, al.
5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Mat.24:22, Mrk.2:26 6:5, Jhn.9:33, 1Co.7:17 (only), Gal.1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1Co.14:5 15:2, 1Ti.5:19.
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Heb.6:14.
8. εἴ πως, if haply: Act.27:12, Rom.1:10.
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Rom.12:6-8, 1Co.3:22 13:8, al.
(AS)

G2456.derivation: feminine of the same as G2457 (Ἰούλιος);

G1955.def:
ἐπί-λυσις -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιλύω), [in Aq.: Gen.40:8; Sm.: Hos.3:4 * ;]
1. release.
2. solution, interpretation: 2Pe.1:20.†
(AS)

G2994.strong_def: a Laodicean, i.e. inhabitant of Laodicia

G2198.def:
ζάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for חיה (most frequently ptcp., ζῶν, inf., ζῆν, for חַי ;]
1. prop., to live, be alive (see Syn., see word βίος; in cl. usually of animal life, but sometimes of plants, as Arist., Eth. N, i, 7, 12): Act.20:12, Rom.7:1-3, 1Co.7:39, Rev.19:20, al.; ἐν αὐτῷ ζῶμεν, Act.17:28; ἐμοὶ τὸ ζῆν Χριστός, Php.1:21; διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν (M, Pr., 215, 249), Heb.2:15; ὃ δὲ νῦν ζῶ ἐν σαρκί, Gal.2:20; ζῇ ἐν ἐμοὶ Χριστός, Gal.2:20; (ὁ) ζῶν, of God (אֵל חַי and cognate phrases, Jos.3:10, Hos.2:1 (1:10), Isa.37:4, al.; see DCG, ii, 39a), Mat.16:16, Jhn.6:57, Rom.9:26, 1Th.1:9, Heb.3:12, Rev.7:2, al.; in juristic phrase, ζῶ ἐγώ (חַי־אָנִי, Num.14:21, al.), as I live, Rom.14:11; ζῆν ἐπ᾽ ἄρτῳ, Mat.4:4, al.; ἐκ, 1Co.9:14; of coming to life, Mrk.16:[11], Rom.6:10 14:9, 2Co.13:4; opposite to νεκρός, Rev.1:18 2:8; metaphorically, Luk.15:32; ζῆν ἐκ νεκρῶν, Rom.6:13; of the spiritual life of Christians, Luk.10:28, Jhn.5:25, Rom.1:17 8:13; εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, Jhn.6:51, 58; σὺν Χριστῷ, 1Th.5:10; ὄνομα ἔχεις ὅτι ζῇς, Rev.3:1.
2. As sometimes in cl., = βιόω, to live, pass one's life: Luk.2:36, Act.26:5, Rom.7:9, Col.2:20; ἐν πίστει, Gal.2:20; ἐν τ. ἁμαρτίᾳ, Rom.6:2; εὐσεβῶς, 2Ti.3:12; ἀσώτως, Luk.15:13; with dative (cl.), ἑαυτῳ (Field, Notes, 164), Rom.14:7, 2Co.5:15; τ. δικαιοσύνῃ, Luk.20:38, Rom.6:10, 11 Gal.2:19; τ. Χριστῷ, 2Co.5:15; τ. θεῷ, 1Pe.2:24; πνεύματι, Gal.5:25; κατὰ σάρκα, Rom.8:12, 13;
3. Of inanimate things, metaphorically: ὕδωρ ζῶν (i.e. springing water, as opposite to still water), in a spiritual sense, Jhn.4:10, 11 7:38 (DCG, ii, 39f.): ἐλπὶς ζῶσα, 1Pe.1:3; ὁδὸς ζῶσα, Heb.10:20 (cf. ἀνα-, συν-ζάω; Cremer, 270, 721).
(AS)

G1571.def:
ἐκ-καθαίρω
[in LXX for בָּעַר, etc. ;]
1. to cleanse thoroughly, cleanse out: with accusative, ἑαυτόν, 2Ti.2:21; of the impurity removed, ζυμήν, 1Co.5:7.†
(AS)

G3370.strong_def: a Median, or inhabitant of Media

G3542.strong_def: pasture, i.e. (the act) feeding (figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage
G3542.derivation: feminine from the same as G3551 (νόμος);

G5024.derivation: neuter plural of G3588 (ὁ) and G846 (αὐτός) as adverb;

G2141.def:
εὐ-πορέω, -ῶ
(εὔτορος, well provided for) [in LXX: Lev.25:26, 49 נָשַׂג hi.), Lev.25:23 (seel.), Wis.10:10 * ;]
to prosper, be well off: Act.11:29.†
(AS)
G2141.strong_def: (intransitively) to be good for passing through, i.e. (figuratively) have pecuniary means
G2141.derivation: from a compound of G2090 (ἑτοιμάζω) and the base of G4197 (πορεία);

G3982.gloss: agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax) conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield
G3982.strong_def: to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy, to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward certainty)

G2597.def:
κατα-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for יָרַד ;]
to go or come down, descend.
1. Of persons: Mat.3:16 24:17, Luk.2:51 6:17 10:31 17:31 19:5-6, Jhn.4:47, 49 4:51 5:7, Act.7:34 8:15 10:20 20:10 23:10 24:1, 22 Eph.4:10. before ἀπό, Mat.8:1 14:29 27:40, 42 Mrk.3:22 15:30, Luk.10:30, Jhn.6:38, Act.25:7, 1Th.4:16; ἐκ, Mat.17:9; ἐκ τ. οὐρανοῦ, Mat.28:2, Mrk.9:9, Jhn.1:32 3:13 6:33, 41-42 6:50-51, 58 Rev.10:1 18:1 20:1; εἰς, Mrk.1:10, Luk.10:30 18:14, Jhn.2:12, Act.7:15 8:38 14:25 16:8 18:22 25:6, Rom.10:7, Eph.4:9; ἐπί, with accusative loc., Jhn.6:16; with accusative of person(s), Luk.3:22, Jhn.1:33, 51; ἐν, Jhn.5:4; πρός, with accusative of person(s), Act.10:21 14:11, Rev.12:12.
2. Of things: σκεῦος, Act.10:11 11:5; βροχή, Mat.7:25, 27; λαῖλαψ, Luk.8:23; before ἀπό, Luk.9:54, Act.8:26, Jas.1:17; ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Luk.22:44 (WH, R, mg., reject); ἐκ τ. οὐρανοῦ before ἀπό, Rev.3:12 21:2, 10; id. before εἰς, Rev.13:13; ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Rev.16:21. Fig., κ. ἕως ᾄδον, Mat.11:23, Luk.10:15, WH, txt., Tr., mg. (καταβιβασθήση, T, WH, mg., RV), (cf. συν-καταβαίνω).†
(AS)
G2597.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and the base of G939 (βάσις);

G0011.def:
Ἀβραάμ (Heb. אַבְרָהָם), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἄβραμος, -ου; MM, VGT, see word),
Abraham (Gen.17:5 al.): Mat.1:1, 2 al.
(AS)

G2441.def:
ἱματισμός, -ού
(ιματίζω), [in LXX: Gen.24:53, 2Ch.18:29, Eze.16:18, al. (בֶּגֶד); Exo.3:22 12:35, Rut.3:3, al. (שִׂמְלָה), etc. ;]
clothing, apparel (usually of sumptuous attire; see Tr., Syn., § 1): Luk.7:25 9:29, Jhn.19:24 (Psa.22:19, LXX for לְבוּשׁ), Act.20:33, 1Ti.2:9.†
(AS)

G5240.strong_def: to pour out over, i.e. (passively) to overflow
G5240.derivation: from G5228 (ὑπέρ) and the alternate form of G1632 (ἐκχέω);

G4187.strong_def: in many ways, i.e. variously as to method or form
G4187.derivation: adverb from a compound of G4183 (πολύς) and G5158 (τρόπος);

G3975.strong_def: to thicken, i.e. (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous)
G3975.derivation: from a derivative of G4078 (πήγνυμι) (meaning thick);

G1881.def:
ἐπ-αν-ίστημι
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
to raise up against; mid., to rise up against: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Mat.10:21, Mrk.13:12.†
(AS)
G1881.strong_def: to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack
G1881.derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G450 (ἀνίστημι);

G3166.strong_def: akin to G837 (αὐξάνω) and G2744 (καυχάομαι)); to talk big, i.e. be grandiloquent (arrogant, egotistic)
G3166.derivation: from a compound of G3173 (μέγας) and (to boast;

G4728.derivation: probably from the base of G2476 (ἵστημι);

G1132.def:
γυμνότης, -ητος, ἡ
(γυμνός), [in LXX for עֵירֹם, Deu.28:48 * ;]
nakedness: Rom.8:35, 2Co.11:27, Rev.3:18.†
(AS)

G1781.def:
ἐν-τέλλω
[in LXX, as in NT (and mostly in Hdt.), always mid., chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;]
-ομαι, to command, enjoin, instruct: before περί Heb.11:22; with inf., Mat.19:7; with dative of person(s), Act.1:2; οὕτως, Act.13:47; καθώς, Jhn.14:31 (ἐντολὴν ἔδωκεν, WH); before λέγων, Mat.17:9; with inf., Jhn.8:5; ἵνα, Mrk.13:34; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.28:20, Mrk.10:3, Jhn.15:14, 17; before περί, with genitive of person(s), Mat.4:6 and Luk.4:10 (LXX); διαθήκην ἐ. πρός, with accusative of person(s), Heb.9:20 (LXX) (cf. Sir.45:3).†
SYN.:
κελεύω, to command, of verbal orders in general;
παραγγέλλω, to charge, esp. of the transmitted orders of a military com­mander; ἐντέλλω points rather to the contents of the command (see Thayer, see word κελεύω)
(AS)
G1781.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and the base of G5056 (τέλος);

G0376.def:
ἀνά-πηρος (WH, -ειρος; see Field, Notes, 67), -ον (πηρός, maimed)
[in LXX: Tob.14:2 א, 2Ma.8:24 * ;]
maimed, crippled: Luk.14:13, 21.†
(AS)
G0376.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of intensity) and (maimed);

G5190.strong_def: fortuitous, i.e. fortunate; Tychicus, a Christian

G2787.def:
κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ
[in LXX: Gen.6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29 (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as Exo.25:9 (10), for אָרוֹן ;]
a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Mat.24:38, Luk.17:27, Heb.11:7, 1Pe.3:20; of the ark of the covenant, Heb.9:4, Rev.11:19.†
(AS)
G2787.strong_def: a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah

G1431.def:
δωρεά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly (-άν) for חִנָּם, as Gen.29:15 ;]
a gift: Act.11:17, Rom.5:15, Heb.6:4; δ. τ. θεοῦ, Jhn.4:10, Act.8:20; τ. Χριστοῦ, Eph.4:7; τ. πνεύματος, Act.2:38 10:45; τ. δικαιοσύνης, Rom.5:17; τ. χάριτος, Eph.3:7; ἀνεκδιηγήτὶῳ δ., 2Co.9:15. Acc, δωρεάν, adverbially (as frequently in LXX),
(a) freely, as a gift: Mat.10:8, Rom.3:24, 2Co.11:7, 2Th.3:8, Rev.21:6 22:17;
(b) in vain, uselessly: (Jhn.15:25 LXX) Gal.2:21.†
SYN.: see: δόμα (AS)

G1984.def:
ἐπι-σκοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiey for פָּקַד פְּקֻדָּה ;]
1. a visiting, visitation (εἰς ἐ. τοῦ παιδός, Lucian, dial. deor., 20, 6); as in LXX (after Heb.), of God's visitation in mercy, or in judgment (Lev.19:20 Job.10:12, Jer.6:15, Wis.2:20, al.): Luk.19:44, 1Pe.2:12 (see Hort, in l).
2. office, charge, esp. office of an ἐπίσκοιος (which see): Act.1:20 (LXX), 1Ti.3:1 (Cremer, 527 f., 864; DCG, ii, 809b).†
(AS)
G1984.strong_def: inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate"

G1243.def:
δι-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(διαιρέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲלֹקֶת ;]
1. a distinction, diference.
2. a division, distribution: 1Co.12:4-6 (cf. διαιρέω; Cremer, 616).†
(AS)

G0079.def:
ἀδελφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀδελφός), [in LXX for אָהוֹת ;]
a sister: Mat.19:29, al.; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word), of a member of the Christian community: Rom.16:1, 1Co.7:15 Jas.21:15, al.
(AS)

G0256.def:
Ἀλφαῖος (WH, Ἀλ-), -ου, ὁ (Aram. חַלְפַּי)
Alphæus.
1. Father of Levi: Mrk.2:14.
2. Father of James: Mat.10:3, Mrk.3:13, Luk.6:15, Act.1:13.†
(AS)

G5229.gloss: exalt self, be exalted above measure
G5229.strong_def: to raise oneself over, i.e. (figuratively) to become haughty
G5229.derivation: middle voice from G5228 (ὑπέρ) and G142 (αἴρω);

G3846.strong_def: to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken

G0835.def:
αὐλίζομαι
(αὐλή), [in LXX chiefly for לוּן ;]
1. prop., to lodge in a courtyard.
2. to lodge in the open.
3. to pass the night, lodge (LXX; MM, see word): Mat.21:17, Luk.21:37.†
(AS)
G0835.strong_def: to pass the night (properly, in the open air)

G2231.def:
ἡγεμονία, -ας, ἡ
(ἡγεμών), [in LXX: Gen.36:30 (אַלּוּף), Num.1:52 2:17, (דֶּגֶל), Sir.7:4 10:1, 4Ma.6:33 4Mac 13:4 * ;]
rule, sovereignty: Luk.3:1.†
(AS)

G2045.def:
ἐραυνάω, -ῶ late form of ἐρευνάω (Rec., ll. with; cf. Bl., § 6, 1; M, Pr., 46),
[in LXX, ἐρευν- (exc. 1Ch.19:3 A), for חָפַשׂ pi., חָקַר, etc. ;]
to search, examine: Jhn.7:52; with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.5:39, Rom.8:27, 1Co.2:10, Rev.2:23; before orat. obliq., 1Pe.1:11.†
SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω (AS)
G2045.derivation: apparently from G2046 (ἐρέω) (through the idea of inquiry);

G2107.def:
εὐδοκία, -ας, ἡ
(εὐδοκέω, which see), [in LXX: Psa.5:12, al. (רָצוֹן), frequently in Sir; in Inscr. (I.G., 5960), LXX, and NT = εὐδόκησις (Died.) ;]
good pleasure, good-will, satisfaction, approval: Mat.11:26, Luk.10:21, Rom.10:1, Eph.1:5, 9, Php.1:15 2:13; with genitive obj., 2Th.1:11 (see Milligan, in l); ἐν ἀνθρώποις εὐδοκία, Rec., R, mg., WH, mg. (see Field, Notes, 48 f.), Luk.2:14; -ας, Lk, l.with, R, txt., WH, txt. (see ICC, in l; WH, App., in l).†
(AS)
G2107.strong_def: satisfaction, i.e. (subjectively) delight, or (objectively) kindness, wish, purpose
G2107.derivation: from a presumed compound of G2095 (εὖ) and the base of G1380 (δοκέω);

G4894.gloss: consider, know, be privy, be ware of
G4894.strong_def: to see completely; used (like its primary) only in two past tenses, respectively meaning to understand or become aware, and to be conscious or (clandestinely) informed of

G3454.derivation: perhaps from the same as G3453 (μυέω) (through the idea of tuition);

G1467.def:
ἐγκρατεύομαι, depon.,
[in LXX for אפק, Gen.43:31, 1Ki.13:12, Est.5:10 א 3 * ;]
to exercise self-control: 1Co.7:9; with accusative, πάντα (see Bl., 91), 1Co.9:25.†
(AS)
G1467.strong_def: to exercise self-restraint (in diet and chastity)

G0711.def:
Ἀριστόβουλος, -ου, ὁ
(ἄριστος, βουλή, i.e. best-counselling)
Aristobulus, a Christian: Rom.16:10.†
(AS)
G0711.derivation: from the same as G712 (ἄριστον) and G1012 (βουλή);

G0609.def:
ἀπο-κόπτω
[in LXX for קָצַץ, כָּרַת, etc. ;]
to cut off: Mrk.9:43, 45, Jhn.18:10, 26 Act.27:32. Mid., to mutilate oneself, have oneself mutilated: Gal.5:12 (cf. Deu.23:1 LXX; and see Cremer, 751; MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0609.strong_def: to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts)

G2718.def:
κατ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Tob.1:22, א Tob.2:1, Est.3:13, Wis.11:22, 2Ma.11:29 * ;]
to come down, go down: before εἰς, Luk.4:31, Act.8:5 13:4 15:30 19:1, Τ; ἀπό, Luk.9:37, Act.15:1 18:5 21:10; ἀπό and εἰς, Act.11:27 12:10; of coming to port by ship, Act.18:22 21:3 27:5; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Act.9:32; metaphorically, of gifts from God, Jas.3:15.†
(AS)
G2718.strong_def: to come (or go) down (literally or figuratively)
G2718.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (including its alternate);

G4649.strong_def: perhaps akin to G4626 (σκάπτω) through the idea of concealment; compare G4629 (σκέπασμα)); a watch (sentry or scout), i.e. (by implication) a goal

G2335.def:
θεωρία, -ας, ἡ
(see: θεωρέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 5:7, 2Ma.5:26 2Mac 15:12, 3Ma.5:24 * ;]
1. a viewing.
2. = θεώρημα, a spectacle, sight: Luk.23:48 (both senses in cl.).†
(AS)

G2665.def:
κατα-πέτασμα, -τος, τό
(= cl. παραπέτασμα) [in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), Exo.26:31, Lev.21:23, al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), Exo.35:12, Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα) ;]
in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple (or Tabernacle): Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38, Luk.23:45, Heb.6:19 9:3; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ Heb.10:20.†
(AS)
G2665.strong_def: something spread thoroughly, i.e. (specially) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple
G2665.derivation: from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and a congener of G4072 (πέτομαι);

G5544.strong_def: usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor)

G1451.def:
ἐγγύς, adv.,
[in LXX chiefly for קָרוֹב ;]
near;
1. of place: Jhn.19:20, 42; as prep. with genitive (M, Pr., 99), Luk.19:11, Jhn.3:23 6:19, 23 11:18, 54, Act.1:12; with dative, Act.9:38 27:8; superl., ἔγγιστα, Mrk.6:36, WH, mg.; metaphorically, ֹοἱ ἐ., opposite to οἱ μακράν, Eph.2:17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Eph.2:13; ἐ. σου τὸ ῥῆμα, Rom.10:8 (LXX).
2. Of time: Mat.24:32 26:18, Mrk.13:28, 29 Luk.21:30, 31 Jhn.2:13 6:4 7:2 11:55, Rev.1:3 22:10; ὁ κύριος ἐ., Php.4:5; before ἐπὶ θύραις, Mat.24:33; compar., ἐγγύτερον (neut. of adj. -ος, used adverbially), Rom.13:11 (cf. R, txt.); as prep. with genitive, ἐ. κατάρας, Heb.6:8; ἀφανισμοῦ, Heb.8:13 (cf. Cremer, 223).
† (AS)
G1451.strong_def: akin to the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); near (literally or figuratively, of place or time)
G1451.derivation: from a primary verb (to squeeze or throttle;

G4357.gloss: abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with)
G4357.strong_def: to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in

G5587.strong_def: by implication, a slander; probably akin to G5574 (ψεύδομαι)); whispering, i.e. secret detraction

G1991.def:
ἐπι-στηρίζω
[in LXX for סָמַךְ, etc. ;]
to make stronger, confirm: with accusative, Act.14:22 15:32, 41.†
(AS)

G5044.strong_def: to be a childrearer, i.e. fulfil the duties of a female parent
G5044.derivation: from a compound of G5043 (τέκνον) and G5142 (τρέφω);

G4750.strong_def: the mouth (as if a gash in the face); by implication, language (and its relations); figuratively, an opening (in the earth); specially, the front or edge (of a weapon)
G4750.derivation: probably strengthened from a presumed derivative of the base of G5114 (τομώτερος);

G2078.derivation: a superlative probably from G2192 (ἔχω) (in the sense of contiguity);

G2177.def:
ἐφάλλομαι
[in LXX for צָלַח, 1Ki.10:6 11:6 16:13 * ;]
to leap upon: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s) Act.19:16.†
(AS)

G2019.def:
ἐπι-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Est.9:47 AR, 2Ma.1:23, 3Ma.7:13 * ;]
to call out, shout: with accusative of thing(s), Act.21:34; with dative of person(s), Act.22:24; before λέγοντες, Luk.23:21; prat. rect., Act.12:22.†
(AS)
G2019.strong_def: to call at something, i.e. exclaim

G0402.def:
ἀνα-χωρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּרַח, נוּם, etc. ;]
1. to go back.
2. to withdraw: Mat.9:24; frequently in sense of avoiding danger (MM, VGT, see word), Mat.2:12 (but see Thayer), Mat.2:13-14, 22 4:12 12:15 14:13 15:21 27:5, Mrk.3:7, Jhn.6:15, Act.23:19 26:31.†
(AS)

G3498.strong_def: dead (literally or figuratively; also as noun)

G2224.def:
ζώννυμι and ζωννύω
[in LXX chiefly for חָגַר ;]
to gird: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.21:18. Mid., to gird oneself: Act.12:8 (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, περι-, ὑπο-ζώννυμι).†
(AS)
G2224.strong_def: to bind about (especially with a belt)

G5040.strong_def: an infant, i.e. (plural figuratively) darlings (Christian converts)

G0293.def:
ἀμφίβληστρον, -ου, τό
(ἀμφιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for חֵרֶם ;]
something thrown around, as a garment; spec., a casting-net: Mat.4:18.†
(AS)
G0293.strong_def: a (fishing) net (as thrown about the fish)
G0293.derivation: from a compound of the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and G906 (βάλλω);

G0499.def:
ἀντί-τυπος, -ον
(see: τύπος), [in LXX: Est.3:13 A * ;]
1. active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse.
2. Pass. struck back; metaphorically, corres­ponding to (MM, VGT, see word);
(a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, Like in pattern), Heb.9:24;
(b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true likeness), 1Pe.3:21 (Cramer, 357).†
(AS)
G0499.derivation: neuter of a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G5179 (τύπος);

G0599.def:
ἀπο-θνῄσκω,
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;]
to die: of natural death, Mrk.5:35, al.; of violent death (pass. of ἀποκτείνω), esp. of Christ, Mat.26:35, Jhn.12:33, Heb.10:28, al.; of spiritual death, Jhn.6:50, Rom.8:13, al.; with dative ref., Rom.6:2, 10 14:7, 8, Gal.2:19; accusative, ὅ, Rom.6:10; before ἐν, Mat.8:32, Jhn.8:21, 24 1Co.15:22, Heb.11:37, Rev.14:13; before ὑπέρ, περί, Jhn.11:50, 51 18:14, Rom.5:6-8 14:15, 1Co.15:3, 2Co.5:15, 1Th.5:10, 1Pe.3:18; ἀπό, Col.2:20; ἐκ, Rev.8:11; figuratively, 1Co.15:31 (cf. συν-αποθνήσκω, and V. Milligan, NTD, 258f.; DCG, i, 791b; Cremer, 286; MM, see word; on the perfective force of this verb, M, Pr., 112, 114; and on the distinction bet. present and aor., ib. 113 f.).
(AS)

G4205.strong_def: akin to the base of G4097 (πιπράσκω)); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine)

G1274.def:
δι-ανύω
[in LXX: 2Ma.12:17 * ;]
1. to accomplish fully, finish, complete: Act.21:7 (EV).
2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.with (Field, Notes, 134f.).†
(AS)

G0219.def:
ἀλεκτοροφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀλέκτωρ, φωνή),
cock-crowing, i.e. the third watch in the night: Mrk.13:35.†
(AS)

G3455.derivation: from a presumed derivative of ( to "moo");

G0687.def:
ἆρα,
interrog. particle,
implying anxiety or impatience, "quite rare and only in Luke and Paul, therefore a literary word" (Bl., §77, 2).
1. (num igitur) expecting a neg. reply, Luk.18:8; ἆρά γε, Act.8:30.
2. (ergone) in apodosis, expecting an affirm. reply, Gal.2:17 (Bl., l.with; Lft., Ga., in l.; MM, see word).
† (AS)
G0687.derivation: a form of G686 (ἄρα), denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed

G0811.def:
ἀσώτως
adv. (ἄσωτος, prodigal, wasteful), [in LXX for סָרַר, Pro.7:11 * ;]
wastefully: Luk.15:13
(EV, in riotous living; but not necessarily dissolute; cf. MM, ut supr.; Milligan, NTD, 79).† (AS)
G0811.derivation: adverb from the same as G810 (ἀσωτία);

G0444.def:
ἄνθρωπος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ ,אָדָם, also for אֱנוֹשׁ, etc. ;]
man:
1. generically, a human being, male or female (Lat. homo): Jhn.16:21; with art., Mat.4:4 12:35, Mrk.2:27, Jhn.2:25, Rom.7:1, al; disting. from God, Mat.19:6, Jhn.10:33, Col.3:23, al.; from animals, etc., Mat.4:19, Luk.5:10, Rev.9:4, al.; implying human frailty and imperfection, 1Co.3:4; σοφία ἀνθρώπων, 1Co.2:5; ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαι, 1Pe.4:2; κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖν, 1Co.3:3; κατὰ ἄ. λέγειν (λαλεῖν), Rom.3:5, 1Co.9:8; κατὰ ἄ- λέγειν, Gal.3:15 (cf. 1Co.15:32, Gal.1:11); by meton., of man's nature or condition, ὁ ἔσω (ἔξω) ἄ., Rom.7:22, Eph.3:16, 2Co.4:16 (cf. 1Pe.3:4); ὁ παλαιὸς, καινὸς, νέος ἄ., Rom.6:6, Eph.2:15 4:22, 24 Col.3:9, 10; joined with another subst., ἄ. ἔμπορος, a merchant, Mat.13:45 (WH, txt. om. ἄ.); οἰκοδεσπότης, Mat.13:52; βασιλεύς, 18:23; φάγος, 11:19; with name of nation, Κυρηναῖος, Mat.27:32; Ἰουδαῖος, Act.21:39; Ῥωμαῖος, Act.16:37; pl. οἱ ἄ., men, people: Mat.5:13, 16 Mrk.8:24, Jhn.4:28; οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων, Mrk.11:2, 1Ti.6:16.
2. Indef., ἄ. = τις, some one, a man: Mat.17:14, Mrk.12:1, al.; τις ἄ., Mat.18:12, Jhn.5:5, al.; indef. one (Fr. on), Rom.3:28, Gal.2:16, al.; opposite to women, servants, etc., Mat.10:36 19:10, Jhn.7:22, 23.
3. Definitely, with art., of some particular person; Mat.12:13, Mrk.3:5, al.; οὗτος ὁ ἄ., Luk.14:30; ὁ ἄ οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, Mrk.14:71, Mat.12:45; ὁ ἄ. τ. ἀνομίας, 2Th.2:3; ἄ τ. θεοῦ (of Heb. אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים), 1Ti.6:11, 2Ti.3:17, 2Pe.1:21; ὁ υἰὸς τοῦ ἀ., see: υἱός.
SYN.: ἀνήρ, which see (and cf. MM, VGT, 44; Cremer, 103, 635). (AS)
G0444.strong_def: from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)); man-faced, i.e. a human being

G2947.def:
κυλίω late form of κυλίνδω,
[in LXX: Jos.10:18, 1Ki.14:33, al. (גָּלַל), 4Ki.9:33 (שָׁמַט), al. ;]
to roll, roll along. Pass., to be rolled; of persons (in Hom, as sign of grief), to roll or wallow: Mrk.9:20.†
(AS)
G2947.strong_def: compare G2945 (κύκλῳ), G1507 (εἱλίσσω)); to roll about
G2947.derivation: from the base of G2949 (κῦμα) (through the idea of circularity;

G2316.def:
θεός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ (Act.19:37 only; see M, Pr., 60, 244), late voc., θεέ (Mat.27:46; cf. Deu.3:24, al.),
[in LXX chiefly for אֱלֹהִים, also for אֵל and other cognate forms, יהוה, etc. ;]
a god or deity, God.
1. In polytheistic sense, a god or deity: Act.28:6, 1Co.8:4, 2Th.2:4, al.; pl., Ac. 14:11 19:26, Gal.4:8, al.
2. Of the one true God;
(a) anarthrous: Mat.6:24, Luk.20:38, al.; esp. with prep. (Kühner 3, iii, 605), ἀπὸ θ., Jhn.3:2; ἐκ, Act.5:39, 2Co.5:1, Php.3:9; ὑπό, Rom.13:1; παρὰ θεοῦ, Jhn.1:6; παρὰ θεῷ, 2Th.1:6, 1Pe.2:4; κατὰ θεόν, Rom.8:27, 2Co.7:9, 10; also when in genitive dependent on an anarth. noun (Bl., §46, 6), Mat.27:43, Luk.3:2, Rom.1:17, 1Th.2:13; as pred., Lk 20:38, Jhn.1:1, and when the nature and character rather than the person of God is meant, Act.5:29, Gal.2:6, al. (M, Th., 14);
(b) more freq., with art.: Mat.1:23, Mrk.2:7, al. mult.; with prep., ἀπὸ τ. θ., Luk.1:26; ἐκ, Jhn.8:42, al.; παρὰ τοῦ θ., Jhn.8:40; π. τῷ θ., Rom.9:14; ἐν, Col.3:3; ἐπὶ τῷ θ., Luk.1:47; ἐπὶ τὸν θ., Act.15:19; εἰς τ. θ., Act.24:15; πρὸς τ. θ., Jhn.1:2; with genitive of person(s), Mat.22:32, Mrk.12:26, 27, Luk.20:37, Jhn.20:17, al.; ὁ θ. μου, Rom.1:8, Php 1:3, al.; ὁ θ. καὶ πατήρ κ. τ. λ., Rom.15:6, Eph.1:3, Phi 4:20, al.; with genitive of thing(s), Rom.15:5, 13, 33, 2Co.1:3, 1Th.5:23; τὰ τ. θεοῦ, Mat.16:23, Mrk.12:17, 1Co.2:11; τὰ πρὸς τὸν θ., Rom.15:17, Heb.2:17 5:1; τ. θεῷ, as a superl. (LXX, Jos.3:3), Act.7:20, 2Co.10:4; Hebraistically, of judges (Psa.81(82):6), Jhn.10:34" (LXX), 35.
(AS)
G2316.strong_def: figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very
G2316.derivation: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with G3588 (ὁ)) the supreme Divinity;

G1339.def:
δι-ίσπημι
(Rec. διΐσ), [in LXX: Eze.5:1 (חָלַק pi.), Pro.17:9 (פָּרַד hi.), etc. ;]
to set apart, separate; of time (or space), to make an interval, intervene: διαστάσης ὥρας μιᾶς, Luk.22:59; βραχὺ διαστήσαντες, Act.27:28. In pass., mid. and 2 aor., pf. and plpf. act., to part, withdraw: Luk.24:51.†
(AS)
G1339.strong_def: to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene

G5521.strong_def: "gall" or bile, i.e. (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.)
G5521.derivation: feminine of an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as 5514 (from the greenish hue);

G2154.def:
εὔσημος, -ον
(εὖ + οῆμα, a sign) [in LXX for כֶּסֶא, Psa.81:3 (-ως, from LXX 219)* ;]
1. conspicuous (cf. Ps, l.with).
2. clear to the understanding, distinct: 1Co.14:9.†
(AS)
G2154.derivation: from G2095 (εὖ) and the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);

G4238.gloss: commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts
G4238.strong_def: to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from G4160 (ποιέω), which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally)

G4592.strong_def: an indication, especially ceremonially or supernaturally
G4592.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);

G4756.strong_def: from the base of G4766 (στρώννυμι), as encamped); camp-likeness, i.e. an army, i.e. (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries
G4756.derivation: feminine of a derivative of (an army;

G4579.strong_def: to rock (vibrate, properly, sideways or to and fro), i.e. (generally) to agitate (in any direction; cause to tremble); figuratively, to throw into a tremor (of fear or concern)

G0073.def:
ἀγών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(ἄγω), [in LXX: Isa.7:13 (לאה), Est.4:17, Wis.4:2 10:12, II Mac.6, 4Mac .5 * ;]
1. a gathering, esp. for games.
2. a place of assembly.
3. a contest, struggle, trial; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word),
(a) of the Christian life as a contest and struggle: Php.1:30, 1Th.2:2, 1Ti.6:12, 2Ti.4:7 Heb.12:1;
(b) solicitude, anxiety: Col.2:1.
† (AS)
G0073.strong_def: properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety

G2390.def:
ἰάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX for רָפָא (Gen.20:17, al.), exc. Isa.30:26 61:1 (חָבַשׁ) ;]
to heal: with accusative of person(s), Luk.5:17 6:19 9:2, 11 9:42 14:4 22:51, Jhn.4:47, Act.9:34 10:38 28:8; pass., Mat.8:8, 13 15:28, Luk.7:7 8:47 17:15, Jhn.5:13; id. before ἀπό᾽, Mrk.5:29, Luk.6:17; figuratively, of spiritual healing, Mat.13:15, Jhn.12:40, Act.28:27" (LXX) ; pass., Heb.12:13, Jas.5:16, 1Pe.2:24.†
SYN.: θεραπεύω, q.v (AS)
G2390.derivation: middle voice of apparently a primary verb;

G0555.def:
ἀπ-έκ-δυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπεκδύω)
a putting or stripping off: Col.2:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4575.strong_def: venerable (august), i.e. (as noun) a title of the Roman Emperor, or (as adjective) imperial

G2311.def:
θεμελιόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for יָסַד ;]
to lay the foundation of, to found: with accusative, τ. γῆν, Heb.1:10 (LXX); pass., Mat.7:25, Luk.6:48; metaphorically, 1Pe.5:10 (R, mg., settle); pass., Eph.3:18, Col.1:23.†
(AS)
G2311.strong_def: to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate

G0740.def:
ἄρτος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for לֶחֶם ;]

G5202.strong_def: to be a water-drinker, i.e. to abstain from vinous beverages

G1477.def:
ἑδραίωμα, -τος, τό

G5533.derivation: from a derivative of G5531 (χράω) and G3781 (ὀφειλέτης);

G3944.strong_def: to escape along, i.e. be gone

G0936.def:
βασιλεύω, (βασιλεύς),

G0165.def:
αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;]
1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT);
(a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luk.1:70;
(b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Mat.21:19; id., with neg., never, Jhn.4:14; more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., Heb.1:8 (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., Mat.6:13; εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. Isa.45:17, עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), Rom.16:27, LT; cf. also Eph.3:21, 2Pe.3:18, Ju 25, Rev.14:11.
2. οἱ αἰ., the worlds, the universe, "the sum of the periods of time, including all that is manifested in them": He :12 11:3 (cf. 1Ti.1:17, where τῶν αἰ. are prob. "the ages or world-periods which when summed up make eternity".
3. the present age (Heb. הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה): ὁ αἰ., Mat.13:22; ὁ αἰ. οὗτος, Mat.12:32; ὁ νῦν αἰ., 1Ti.6:17; ὁ ἐνεστὼς αἰ., Gal.1:4; similarly, of the time after Christ's second coming (הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא), ὁ αἰ. ἐκεῖνος, Luk.20:35; ὁ αἰ. μέλλων, Mat.12:32; ὁ αἰ. ὁ ἐρχόμενος, Mrk.10:30.
SYN.: κόσμος, the ordered universe, the scheme of material things; οἰκουμένη, the inhabited earth; in contrast with both of which αἰ. is the world under aspects of time (cf. Westc. on Heb.1:2; Tr., Syn., §lix; Thayer, see word, αἰ.; Cremer, 74, 620; MM, VGT). (AS)
G0165.strong_def: properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future)

G4600.strong_def: the jaw-bone, i.e. (by implication) the cheek or side of the face

G2287.def:
θανατη-φόρος, -ον

because: Luk.1:13 2:7 21:28, Act.13:35 18:10 20:26 22:18, Rom.1:19, 21 3:20 8:7, 21, 1Co.15:9, Php.2:26, 1Th.2:8, 18 (Lft., Notes, 37) 1Th.4:6, Heb.11:5, 23, Jas.4:3, 1Pe.1:16 1:24 2:6. G1499.def:
εἰ,
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
I. Conditional, if;
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20;
(b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20;
(with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.;
(d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al.
2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, if, whether.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12.
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luk.11:18; but even if, 1Co.4:7, 2Co.4:3 11:16.
3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Mrk.2:21, 22 Jhn.14:2, Rev.2:5, al.
4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Mrk.14:29, Luk.11:8, 1Co.7:21, 2Co.4:16, Php.2:17, al.
5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Mat.24:22, Mrk.2:26 6:5, Jhn.9:33, 1Co.7:17 (only), Gal.1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1Co.14:5 15:2, 1Ti.5:19.
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Heb.6:14.
8. εἴ πως, if haply: Act.27:12, Rom.1:10.
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Rom.12:6-8, 1Co.3:22 13:8, al.
(AS)

G2197.def:
Ζαχαρίας, -ου, ὁ (Heb. זַכַּי);
1. Zacharias, father of John the Baptist: Luk.1:5, 12-13 1:18, 21 1:40, 59 1:67 3:2.
2. Zechariah, the son of Jehoiada (in txt. wrongly called son of Barachiah; cf. 2Ch.24:19 ff.): Mat.23:35, Luk.11:51.†

G2197.strong_def: Zacharias (i.e. Zechariah), the name of two Israelites

G2548.def:
κἀκεῖνος, -είνη, -εῖνο

But σ. is most frequently taken as = wife; see Thayer, see word; Lft., Notes, 53 ff.; ICC, in l).†

G2932.strong_def: to get, i.e. acquire (by any means; own)

G0471.def:
ἀντ-εῖπον

2 2 aor., without present in use, to speak against, gainsay: Luk.21:15, Act.4:14.†
(AS)

G5458.strong_def: an illuminator, i.e. (concretely) a luminary, or (abstractly) brilliancy

G1123.def:
γραπτός, -ή, -όν

G2680.def:
κατα-σκευάζω

G1723.def:

G0205.def:

G0264.def:
