G2880.strong_def: to cram, i.e. glut or sate

G1687.def:
ἐμβατεύω
[in LXX: with accusative, Jos.19:49 (נָחַל, Jos.19:51 (חָלַק pi.); before εἰς, 1Ma.12:25 1Mac 13:20 1Mac 14:31 1Mac 15:40; metaphorically, 2Ma.2:30 * ;] (ἐμβάτης ἐμβαίνω)
1. to step in or on (Soph.), hence
(a) to frequent, haunt, dwell in (Æsch., Eur.); metaphorically, Col.2:18 (dwelling in, R, txt.; taking, R, mg.);
(b) to invade (1Mac, ll with; metaphorically, Col, Lc.).
2. to enter on, come into possession of (Eur., Dem.; LXX, Jos, H. with); on the difficulties of reading and interpretation in this passage, see Lft, Col., 194 f., 252; ICC, 268 ff.; Field, Notes, 197; Milligan, NTD, 177; and for exx. from π., MM, Exp., xii (cf. κενεμβ.).†
(AS)
G1687.strong_def: equivalent to G1684 (ἐμβαίνω); to intrude on (figuratively)
G1687.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and a presumed derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις);

G0261.def:
ἀμαθής, -ές
(μανθάνω), [in Sm.: Psa.49:11 * ;]
unlearned, ignorant: 2Pe.3:16 (on the rareness of this word, see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0261.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3129 (μανθάνω);

G1918.def:
ἐπι-γαμβρεύω
(γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: Gen.34:9, 1Ki.18:21 ff., 2Ch.18:1, Est.9:14 (חָתַן hithp.), Gen.38:8 R (יָבַם pi.), 1Ma.10:54-56 * ;]
1. to enter into affinity with: with dative (LXX, H. with, exc. Gen.38:8).
2. to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. Gen.38:8): with accusative, Mat.22:24.†
(AS)
G1918.strong_def: to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way
G1918.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G1062 (γάμος);

G0803.def:
ἀσφάλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσφαλής), [in LXX for בָּטַח, etc. ;]
1. firmness.
2. certainty: Luk.1:4.
3. security: Act.5:23, 1Th.5:3.
(In π. it is used as a law-term, proof, security; see MM, see word; M, Th., l.with)†
(AS)

G3016.strong_def: something scaled (light), i.e. a small coin
G3016.derivation: neuter of a derivative of the same as G3013 (λεπίς);

G0758.def:
ἄρχων, -οντος, ὁ
(present ptcp. of ἄρχω), [in LXX for נָשִׂיא., רֹאשׁ, שַׂר, etc. ;]
a ruler, chief: Jesus, Rev.1:5; rulers of nations, Mat.20:25, Act.4:26 7:35; magistrates, Act.23:5, Rom.13:3; judges, Luk.12:58, Act.7:27, 35 16:19; members of the Sanhedrin, Luk.14:1 23:13, 35 24:20, Jhn.3:1 7:26, 48 12:42, Act.3:17 4:5, 8 13:27 14:5; rulers of synagogues, Mat.9:18, 23, Luk.8:41 18:18; οἱ ἄ. τ. αἰῶνος τούτου, 1Co.2:6-8; of the devil: ἄ. τῶν δαιμονίων, Mat.9:34 12:24, Mrk.3:22, Luk.11:15; ὁ ἄ. τοῦ κόσμου, Jhn.12:31 14:30 16:11; ἄ. τ. ἐξουσίας τ. ἀέρος, Eph.2:2 (MM, see word; DB, iii, 838; Ext., 99 f; DCG, ii, 419; DCG, see word Archon).†
(AS)

G3845.strong_def: to go contrary to, i.e. violate a command
G3845.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G939 (βάσις);

G3594.strong_def: to show the way (literally or figuratively (teach))

G0447.def:
ἀν-ίημι
(ἀνά, ἵημι), [in LXX for רָפָה, נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
1. to send up, produce, to send back.
2. to let go, leave without support: Heb.13:5 (cf. Deu.31:6; Hom., Iliad., ii, 71).
3. to relax, loosen (see Field, Notes, 124 f.): Act.16:26 27:40; hence, metaphorically, to give up, desist from: Eph.6:9.†
(AS)
G0447.strong_def: to let up, i.e. (literally) slacken or (figuratively) desert, desist from

G1367.def: two thousand , (Herdotus Historicus):—;singular with collective nouns, δισχιλίη ἵππος 2000 horse, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G0240.def:
ἀλλήλων (genitive pl.), dative -οις, -αις, accusative -ους, -ας, -α (no nom.), recipr. pron.
(ἄλλος),
of one another, mutually: Mat.25:32, Mrk.4:41, Jhn.13:22, al.
(AS)

G0309.def:
ἀνά-βλεψις, -εως, ή
(ἀναβλέπω), [in LXX: Isa.61:1 (פְּקַח־קוֹחַ)* ;]
recovery of sight: Luk.4:18 (Lxx).†
(AS)

G4907.strong_def: a mental putting together, i.e. intelligence or (concretely) the intellect

G1476.def:
ἑδραῖος, -ον (ἕδρα, a seat), [in Sm.: Ps 32 (33):14, al. ;]
1. sitting, seated.
2. steadfast, firm; metaphorically, of moral fixity: 1Co.7:37 15:58, Col.1:23.
† (AS)

G3304.derivation: from G3203 and G3767 (οὖν) and G1065 (γέ);

G0706.def:
ἀριθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מִסְפָּר ;]
number, a number: Luk.22:3, Jhn.6:10, Act.4:4 5:36 6:7 11:21 16:5, Rom.9:27, Rev.5:11 7:4 9:16 13:17-18 15:2 20:8 (for exx. of mystical use in π., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0237.def:
ἀλλαχόθεν
adv. (ἀλλος), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:7 * ;] = ἀλλοθεν (seeMM, VGT, see word)
from another place: Jhn.10:1.†
(AS)

G1083.def:
γέννησις, -εως, ἡ,
[in LXX: 1Ch.4:8 (מִשְׁפָּחָה), Ecc.7:2 (ילד ni.; γένεσις, Aא), Wis.3:13 א 1 (γένεσις, ABא 2), Sir.22:3 * ;]
1. begetting.
2. birth: Mat.1:18, Luk.1:14, Rec.
† (AS)

G1188.def:
δεξιός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for יָמִין ;]
the right: Mat.5:29, Jhn.18:10, al.; ὅπλα δ., weapons carried in the right hand, i.e. for offence, 2Co.6:7 ; ἡ δ. χείρ, Mat.5:30, Luk.6:6, al.; ἡ δ. (sc. χείρ), Mat.6:3, al.; ἐπὶ τὴν δ., in the right hand (R, txt., on R, mg.), Rev.5:1; διδόναι τὴν δ., in friend­ship (Deiss., BS, 251), Gal.2:9; metaphorically of power, τῇ δ. αὐτοῦ, Act.2:33 5:31; τὰ δ., the right side, Mrk.16:5; ἐκ δεξιῶν, on the right hand, with genitive, Mat.25:33, 34, Mrk.15:27, Luk.1:11, al.; of a place of honour in the Messianic Kingdom (cf. 3Ki.2:19, Psa.44(45):10), καθίσαι ἐκ δεξιῶν, Mat.20:21, Mrk.10:37; of the heavenly session of Christ, Mat.26:64, Mrk.14:62, Heb.1:13 (Cremer, 172)
(AS)
G1188.strong_def: the right side or (feminine) hand (as that which usually takes)

G2802.def:
Καῦδα (TR, mg., Κλαῦδα; Rec. Κλαύδή), ἡ,
Cauda, Clauda, an island near Crete: Act.27:16.†
(AS)

G4875.strong_def: to recruit oneself in company with

G3533.strong_def: victorious city; Nicopolis, a place in Macedonia

G1151.def:
δάμαλις, -εως, ἡ
(fem. of δαμάλης, a bullock), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָה, עֶגְלָה ;]
a heifer, Heb.9:13.†
(AS)
G1151.derivation: probably from the base of G1150 (δαμάζω);

G0156.def:
αἰτία, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX: Gen.4:13 (עָוֹן), Pro.28:17 (עָשַׁק), and frequently in Wi, II, III Mac ;]
1. cause, reason, occasion, case: Mat.19:3, Luk.8:47, Act.10:21 22:24 28:20, 2Ti.1:6,12, Tit.1:13, Heb.2:11 ; εἰ οὕτως ἐστιν ἡ αἰ. (cf. Lat. si ita res se habet, and see MM. VGT, see word), Mat.19:10.
2. In forensic sense,
(a) accusation: Act.25:18,27;
(b) cause for punishment, crime: Mat.27:37, Mrk.15:26, Jhn.18:38 19:4,6, Act.13:28 23:28 28:18.
† SYN.: ἔλεγχος, a charge, whether moral or judicial, which has been proven, αἰ. is an accusation simply, false or true. (AS)
G0156.strong_def: a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved)

G4097.strong_def: from the base of G4008 (πέραν)); to traffic (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively)

G1429.def:
δωδεκά-φυλος, -ον
(δώδεκα, φυλή),
of twelve tribes: as subst. neut., τό δ. (cf. λαὸς ὁ δ., Sibyll. Orac.), the twelve tribes, Act.26:7.†
(AS)

G5449.strong_def: growth (by germination or expansion), i.e. (by implication) natural production (lineal descent); by extension, a genus or sort; figuratively, native disposition, constitution or usage

G2443.strong_def: compare G3588 (ὁ)); in order that (denoting the purpose or the result)
G2443.derivation: probably from the same as the former part of G1438 (ἑαυτοῦ) (through the demonstrative idea;

G0880.def:
ἀφωνος, -ον
(φωνή) [in LXX: Isa.53:7 (עָלַם ni.), Wis.4:19, 2Ma.3:29 * ;]
dumb, speechless: Act.8:32 (LXX); of idols (MM, see word), 1Co.12:2; of beasts, 2Pe.2:19; τοσαῦτα γένη φωνῶν καὶ οὐδὲν ἄ.—so many kinds of voices and none voiceless, i.e. without signification, unintelligible: 1Co.14:10.†
(AS)
G0880.strong_def: voiceless, i.e. mute (by nature or choice); figuratively, unmeaning
G0880.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5456 (φωνή);

G0917.def:
βαρέως, adv.
(βαρύς), [in LXX: β. φέρειν, Gen.31:35 (חרה בעיני); β. ἀκούειν, Isa.6:10 (כּבד hi.)* ;]
heavily, with difficulty: Mat.13:15, Act.28:27" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G0524.def:
ἀπ-αλγέω, -ῶ
1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61).
2. In late Gk.
(a) to despair (Polyb., i, 35, 5);
(b) to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): Eph.4:19.†
(AS)
G0524.strong_def: to grieve out, i.e. become apathetic

G5129.gloss: here(-by, -in), him, one, the same, there(-in), this
G5129.strong_def: to (in, with or by) this (person or thing)
G5129.derivation: dative case singular masculine or neuter of G3778 (οὗτος);

G1249.def:
διάκονος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
(derivation unknown), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: Est.6:3, 5, א B Est.1:10 2:2, Pro.10:4, 4Ma.9:17 * ;]
1. in general, a servant, attendant, minister: Mat.20:26 22:13 23:11, Mrk.9:35 10:43, Jhn.2:5, 9, 1Co.3:5, Gal.2:17, Eph.6:21, Col.4:7; δ. θεοῦ, Rom.13:4, 2Co.6:4, 1Th.3:2; δ. Χριστοῦ, 2Co.11:23, Col.1:7, 1Ti.4:6; cf. ὁ δ. ὁ ἐμός, Jhn.12:26; δ. περιτομῆς, Rom.15:8; δ. καινῆς διαθήκης, 2Co.3:6; δ. δικαιοσύνης, 2Co.11:15; δ. [εὐαγγελίου], Eph.3:7, Col.1:23; δ. [ἐκκλησίας], Col.1:25.
2. As technical term for Church officer (so in pre-Christian times, see M, Th., I, 32), a deacon: Php.1:1, 1Ti.3:8, 12; fem. (cf. Eccl. διακονίσσα), Rom.16:1 (cf. 1Ti.3:11, and CGT, in l., also M, Th., l.with).†
SYN.: δοῦλος, bondman; θεράπων, servant acting voluntarily; ὑπηρέτης, servant, attendant, by etymol. suggesting subordination. All these imply relation to a person, in distinction from which δ. represents rather the servant in relation to his work. Cf. also λειτουργός, a public servant, in which the idea of service to the community is prominent; οἰκέτης, a house servant. (AS)
G1249.strong_def: an attendant, i.e. (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a Christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon or deaconess)
G1249.derivation: probably from an obsolete (to run on errands; compare G1377 (διώκω));

G0055.def:
ἁγνῶς
(ἁγνός),
adv.,
purely, with pure motives: Php.1:17.†
(AS)

G4400.strong_def: to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose
G4400.derivation: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G5495 (χείρ);

G4866.strong_def: to wrestle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to seek jointly

G3791.strong_def: to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass

G0897.def:
Βαβυλών, -ῶνος, ἡ (בָּבֶל, Heb. form of Assyr. Bab-ili, Gate of God),
Babylon: Mat.1:11, 12 17, Act.7:43" (LXX) ; symbolically, of Rome: Rev.14:8 16:19 17:5 18:2, 10, 21, and prob. also 1Pe.5:13.†
(AS)
G0897.strong_def: Babylon, the capitol of Chaldæa (literally or figuratively (as a type of tyranny))

G1331.def:
δι-ερωτάω, -ῶ
to find by inquiry: with accusative, Act.10:17.†
(AS)
G1331.strong_def: to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation

G3738.strong_def: to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion)
G3738.derivation: middle voice from (a row or ring);

G1389.def:
δολόω, -ῶ
(δόλος) [in LXX: Psa.15:3 (רָגַל), Psa.36:2 (חָלַק hi.) * ;]
1. to ensnare.
2. As of wine, to adulterate, corrupt: τ. λόγον τ. θεοῦ, 2Co.4:2.†
SYN.: καπηλεύω which see (AS)

G3992.strong_def: to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas (as a stronger form of ) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and G4724 (στέλλω) denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield

G3923.strong_def: to bear in alongside, i.e. introduce simultaneously

G2400.def:
ἰδού,
[in LXX chiefly for הִנֵּה,]
prop. imperat. 2 aor. mid. of ὁράω, used as a demonstrative particle, with frequency much greater in LXX and NT than in cl. (see M, Pr., 11),
lo, behold, see: Mat.10:16 11:8 13:3, Mrk.3:32, Luk.2:48, 1Co.15:51, Jas.5:9, Ju 14, Rev.1:7, al.; after genitive absol., Mat.1:20 2:1, 13 12:46, al.; καὶ ἰδού, Mat.2:9 (and freq.), Luk.1:20 10:25, Act.12:7, al.; in elliptical sentences, taking the place of copula or predicate (like הִנֵּה in Heb.), Mat.3:17, Luk.5:12 22:31, 47 Act.8:27, 36 al.
(AS)
G2400.derivation: second person singular imperative middle voice of G1492 (εἴδω);

G4369.gloss: add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more
G4369.strong_def: to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat

G1159.def:
δαπανάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Tob.1:7, 1Ma.14:32, al. ;]
1. to spend, expend: with accusative, Mrk.5:26; before ἐπί, with dative of person(s), Act.21:24; ὑπέρ, 2Co.12:15.
2. to consume, squander: Luk.15:14; ἐν τ. ἡδσναῖς (on the constr. with ἐν, see Hort, Mayor, in l.), Jas.4:3 (cf. ἐκ-, προσ- δ.).†
(AS)
G1159.strong_def: to expend, i.e. (in a good sense) to incur cost, or (in a bad one) to waste

G4320.strong_def: to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat)

G0331.strong_def: a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person)

G3603.gloss: called, which is (make), that is (to say)
G3603.derivation: from the neuter of G3739 (ὅς) and the third person singular present indicative of G1510 (εἰμί);

G0081.def:
ἀδελφότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ἀδελφός), [in LXX: 1Ma.12:10,17, 4Mac .5 * ;]
1. abstract, brotherhood, brotherly affection (LXX).
2. Concrete, the brotherhood, the Christian community: 1Pe.2:17 5:9 (MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0081.strong_def: brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity

G4874.strong_def: to mix up together, i.e. (figurative) associate with
G4874.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a compound of G303 (ἀνά) and G3396 (μίγνυμι);

G4841.strong_def: to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specially, persecution; to "sympathize")
G4841.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and G3958 (πάσχω) (including its alternate);

G3180.derivation: from a compound of G3326 (μετά) and G3593 (ὁδεύω) (compare "method");

G4636.strong_def: a hut or temporary residence, i.e. (figuratively) the human body (as the abode of the spirit)

G1483.def:
ἐθνικῶς,
adv.,
in Gentile fashion: Gal.2:14.†
(AS)

G2842.def:
κοινωνία, -ας, ἡ
(κοινωνός), [in LXX: Lev.6:2 (יָד תְּשׂוּמֶת), Wis.8:18, 3Ma.4:6 * ;]
1. fellowship, communion: Act.2:42, 2Co.6:14, Php.1:5; τ. υἱοῦ, 1Co.1:9; τ. αἵματος, σώματος Χρ., 1Co.10:10 : παθημάτων αὐτσῦ, Php.3:10; τ. πνεύματος, 2Co.13:13, Php.2:1; δεξιὰς κοινωνίας, Gal.2:9; τ. πίστεώς σου, Phm 6; before μετὰ: τ. πατρός, 1Jn.1:3 Jn 1:6; ἡμῶν, ἀλλήλων, 1Jn.1:3 Jn 1:7.
2. contribution (as outcome of fellowship): Rom.15:26, 2Co.8:4 9:13, Heb.13:6 (cf. Art. Communion, DB, i, 460 ff.; MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)
G2842.strong_def: partnership, i.e. (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction

G1548.def:
ἐκ-γαμίσκω
Rec. for γαμίσκω, which see: Luk.20:34-35. Not elsewhere.†
γαμίζω
(γάμος),
to give in marriage, a daughter: 1Co.7:38. Pass., Mat.22:30 24:38, Mrk.12:25, Luk.17:27 20:35 (WH, mg., γαμίσκονται; cf. γαμίζω).†
(AS)

G0979.def:
βίος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for יָמִים ;]
1. period or course of life, life: Luk.8:14, 1Ti.2:2, 2Ti.2:4, 1Jn.2:16.
2. living, livelihood, means (in Pro.31:14 for לֶחֶם; see DCG, ii, 39a): Mrk.12:44, Luk.8:43 15:12, 30 21:4, 1Jn.3:17.†
SYN.: ζωή, is life intensive, "vita quâ, vivimus," the vital principle; βίος, life extensive, "vita quam vivimus," (1) the period of life, (2) the means by which it is sustained. Hence, in cl., ζ., being confined to the physical life common to men and animals, is the inferior word (cf. zoology, biography). In NT, ζωή is elevated into the ethical and spiritual sphere (cf. Tr., Syn., §xxvii). (AS)
G0979.strong_def: life, i.e. (literally) the present state of existence; by implication, the means of livelihood

G2990.gloss: be hid, be ignorant of, unawares
G2990.strong_def: to lie hid (literally or figuratively); often used adverbially, unwittingly
G2990.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is used only as an alternate in certain tenses;

G4906.strong_def: to take food in company with
G4906.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and G2068 (ἐσθίω) (including its alternate);

G5410.strong_def: a forum or market-place; only in comparative with G675 (Ἄππιος); a station on the Appian road

G1504.def:
εἰκών, -όνος (cf. ἔοικα),
[in LXX chiefly for צֶלֶם ;]
an image, likeness: Mat.22:20, Mrk.12:16, Luk.20:24, Rom.1:23, 1Co.15:49, Rev.13:14, 15 14:9, 11 15:2 16:2 19:20 20:4; opposite to σκιά, Heb.10:1; of man, εἰ. θεοῦ, 1 Co 11:7; of the regenerate, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ Col.3:10 (see Lft., in l.); εἰ. τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, Rom.8:29, 2Co.3:18; of Christ, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ, 2Co.4:4, Col.1:15.† SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, denoting resemblance, which may however be merely accidental. εἰ. is a derived likeness and like the head on a coin or the parental likeness in a child, implies an archetype. Cf. also εἶδος, appearance, not necessarily based on reality; σκιά, a shadowed resemblance; χαρακτήρ, the impress of a stamp; μόρφη (which see), the form as indicative of the inner being.
(AS)
G1504.strong_def: a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance

G1762.def:
ἔνι Ionic form of ἐν (ἐνί), with strengthened accent;
[in LXX: Sir.37:2, 4Ma.4:22 * ;]
= ἔνεστι,
is in, has place, can be: 1Co.6:5, Gal.3:28 (tris) Col.3:11, Jas.1:17 (cf. Lft., Ga.; Hort and Mayor, Ja., ll. with).†
(AS)
G1762.strong_def: impersonally, there is in or among
G1762.derivation: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of G1751 (ἔνειμι);

G0275.def:
ἀμέριμνος, -ον
(μέριμνα), [in LXX: Wis.6:15 7:23 * ;]
free from anxiety or care: Mat.28:14, 1Co.7:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0275.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3308 (μέριμνα);

G2517.def:
καθ-εξῆς
(= cl. ἑξῆς, ἐφεξῆς)
adv.,
1. successively, in order: Luk.1:3, Act.11:4 18:23; τῶν κ.. (those that succeeded him), Act.3:24.
2. after­wards: ἐν τῷ κ. (sc. χρόνῳ), Luk.8:1.†
(AS)
G2517.strong_def: thereafter, i.e. consecutively; as a noun (by ellipsis of noun) a subsequent person or time

G0105.def:
ἀετός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX for נֶשֶׁר ;]
an eagle: Rev.4:7 8:13 (Rec. ἀγγέλου) 12:14. Where carrion is referred to, ἀ. is probably a vulture (cf. Job.39:30, Pro.30:17): Mat.24:28, Luk.17:37 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G1954.def:
ἐπί-λοιπος, -ον
(λοιπός), [in LXX for יָתַר, שָׁאַר ;]
still left, remaining: χρόνος, 1Pe.4:2.†
(AS)

G4118.strong_def: the largest number or very large

G0507.def:
ἄνω
adv (ἀνά),
(a) up, upwards: Jhn.11:41, Heb.12:15;
(b) above (opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, Gal.4:26, Php.3:14; τά, Jhn.8:23, Col.3:1-2; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), Jhn.2:7 (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0612.def:
ἀπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκρίνομαι), [in LXX for דָּבָר, etc. ;]
an answering, an answer: Luk.2:47 20:26, Jhn.1:22 19:9.†
(AS)

G2272.def:
ἡσύχιος, -α, -ον
(= the more frequently ἥσυχος; cf. Wis.18:14, Sir.25:20), [in LXX: Isa.66:2 (רוּחַ נָכֶה)* ;]
quiet, tranquil: 1Ti.2:2, 1Pe.3:4.†
SYN.: ἤρεμος, of tranquillity arising from without; ἡ., from within (see Ellic. on 1Ti, l.with; but also see CGT, ib.).† (AS)
G2272.strong_def: properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e. (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing)
G2272.derivation: a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος) and perhaps G2192 (ἔχω);

G1938.def:
ἐπιθυμητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπιθυμέω) [in LXX: Num.11:34 (אָוָה hithp.); εἶναι ἐ., Pro.1:22 (חָמַד)* ;]
one longing for, lustful after: κακῶν, 1Co.10:6.†
(AS)

G2661.def:
κατ-αξιόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.13:12, 3Ma.3:21 3Mac 4:11, 4Ma.18:3 * ;]
to deem worthy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), 2Th.1:5; pass. before inf., Luk.20:35, Act.5:41.†
(AS)

G1772.def:
ἔν-νομος, -ον
[in LXX: Sir, Pro.1:1-33 ogue 12* ;]
1. lawful, legal (MM, Exp., xiii): Act.19:39.
2. Of persons,
(a) law-abiding;
(b) under law: ἔ. Χριστοῦ, in relation to Christ, 1Co.9:21 (Cremer. 435).†
(AS)

G5225.strong_def: to begin under (quietly), i.e. come into existence (be present or at hand); expletively, to exist (as copula or subordinate to an adjective, participle, adverb or preposition, or as an auxiliary to a principal (verb)

G0455.def:
ἀν-οίγω
(ἀνά, οἴγω = οἴγνυμι) [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַח ;]
to open;
1. trans., with accusative; a door or gate, Act.5:19 12:14, Rev.4:1; pass., Act.12:10 16:26-27; metaphorically of opportunity or welcome, Act.14:27, Col.4:3, Rev.3:20; pass., 1Co.16:9, 2Co.2:12, Rev.3:8; absol. (sc. θύραν), Act.5:23 12:16; with dative of person(s), Luk.12:36, Jhn.10:3; metaphorically, Mat.7:7-8 25:11, Luk.11:9-10 13:25, Rev.3:7; θησαυρούς (Sir.43:14), Mat.2:11; τ. μνημεῖα, Mat.27:52; τάφος, Rom.3:13; τ. φρέαρ, Rev.9:2; of heaven, Mat.3:16, Luk.3:21, Act.10:11, Rev.11:19 15:5 19:11; σφραγῖδα, Rev.5:9 6:1 ff. Rev.8:1; βιβλίον, βιβλαρίδιον, Luk.4:17, Rev.5:2-5 10:2, 8 20:12; τ. στόμα, Mat.17:27; id. Hebraistically (Num.22:28, Job.3:1, Isa.50:5, al.), of beginning to speak, Mat.5:2, Act.8:32, 35 10:34 18:14; before εἰς βλαιφημίας, Rev.13:6; ἐν παραβολαῖς (Psa.78:2), Mat.13:35; of recovering speech, Luk.1:64; of the earth opening, Rev.12:16; τ. ὀφθαλμoύς, Act.9:8, 40; id. with genitive of person(s), of restoring sight, Mat.9:30 20:33, Jhn.9:1ff; 10.21, 11:37ff ; metaphorically, Act.26:18; ἀκοάς, with genitive of person(s), of restoring hearing, Mrk.7:35.
2. Intrans. in 2 pf., ἀνέῳγα (M, Pr., 154); heaven, Jhn.1:51; τ. στόμα, before πρός, of speaking freely, 2Co.6:11 (cf. δι-ανοίγω and see MM, VGT, 45).†
(AS)
G0455.strong_def: to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications)

G5288.strong_def: to withhold under (out of sight), i.e. (reflexively) to cower or shrink, (figuratively) to conceal (reserve)

G2394.def:
Ἰάσων, -ονος, ὁ
Jason: Act.17:5-7, 9; perhaps the same, Rom.16:21.†
(AS)
G2394.strong_def: about to cure; Jason, a Christian
G2394.derivation: future active participle masculine of G2390 (ἰάομαι);

G5494.strong_def: akin to the base of 5490 through the idea of a channel), meaning a storm (as pouring rain); by implication, the rainy season, i.e. winter

G4160.gloss: abide, + agree, appoint, X avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth), cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have, hold, X journeying, keep, + lay wait, + lighten the ship, make, X mean, + none of these things move me, observe, ordain, perform, provide, + have purged, purpose, put, + raising up, X secure, shew, X shoot out, spend, take, tarry, + transgress the law, work, yield
G4160.strong_def: to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct)
G4160.derivation: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary;

G2907.def:
κρέας, -έως, pl., κρέα
[in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.) ;]
flesh, meat: Rom.14:21, 1Co.8:13.†
(AS)

G2205.def:
ζῆλος, -ου, ὁ and in late Gk., also -εος, τό (2Co.9:2, Php.3:6),
[in LXX for קִנְאָה, Num.25:11, al. ;]
1. zeal: 2Co.7:11 9:2; κατά ζῆλος, Php.3:6; with genitive obj., Jhn.2:17 (LXX), Rom.10:2; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.7:7; with genitive subj., θεοῦ, 2Co.11:2; πυρός, Heb.10:27 (cf. Isa.26:11, Wis.5:18, and cf. Westc., in l).
2. jealousy: Rom.13:13, 1Co.3:3 3:2 2Co.12:20, Gal.5:20 (WH, txt, RV), Jas.3:14, 16; πλησθῆναι ζήλου Act.5:17 13:45; pl., ζῆλοι (see B1., § 32, 6), Gal.5:20, WH, mg.†
(AS)
G2205.strong_def: properly, heat, i.e. (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of God), or an enemy, malice)

G3516.strong_def: not speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature Christian
G3516.derivation: from an obsolete particle (implying negation) and G2031 (ἔπος);

G1218.def:
δῆμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
1. a district, country.
2. the common people, the people generally; esp. the people assembled: Act.12:22 17:5 19:30 33.
† SYN.: λαός, the people at large: δ., the people as a body politic; opposite to δ. is ὄχλος, the unorganized multitude. ἔθνος, in sing., means in NT as in Gk. writers generally, a nation, but in pl. denotes the rest of mankind apart from the Jews: Gentiles. λ. also, rare in cl. (Att... λεώς), is frequently in LXX and NT, and usually limited to the chosen people, Israel (cf. Cl. Rev., i, 42 f.; Cremer, 689). (AS)

G3687.strong_def: to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess

G0154.def:
αἰτέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁאל ;]
to ask, request: absol., Mat.7:7, Jas.1:6; with accusative of person(s), Mat.5:42, Luk.6:30; with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Mat.20:20, 1Jn.5:15; id. before παρά, Act.3:2, Jas.1:5; with dupl. accusative Mat.7:9, Mrk.6:22, Jhn.16:23. Mid. (on the distinction bet. mid. and act., see M, Pr., 160): absol., Mrk.15:8, Jhn.16:26, Jas.4:3; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.14:7, Mrk.6:24, al.; with accusative of person(s), Mat.27:20, Luk.23:25; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, Act.9:2; with accusative and inf., Luk.23:23. with inf. Act.7:46, Eph.3:13 (cf. ἀπ-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, παρ-, προσ- αιτέω).
SYN.: ἐρωτάω, which see, πυνθάνομαι. On the proper distinction between these words, see Tr., Syn., § xl, Thayer, see word αἰ. In late Gk., however, αἰ. and ἐ. seem to have become practically synonymous (cf. Act.3:2,3; see Field, Notes, 101 f.; M, Th., I, 4:1; M, Pr., 66.n; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

G2750.def:
κειρία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Pro.7:16 (מַרְבַד)* ;]
a vernacular word,
1 1, a bed-cord (Aristoph., AV., 816; Pr, l.with).
2. In pl., swathings (cf. Field, Notes, 96 f.): Jhn.11:44.†
(AS)

G2808.def:
κλείω
[in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;]
to shut: θύραν, Mat.6:6; τ. ἄβυσσον, Rev.20:3; pass., θύρα, Mat.25:10, Luk.11:7 (pl.), Jhn.20:19, 26, Act.21:30; δεσμωτήριον, Act.5:23; πυλῶνες, Rev.21:25. Metaphorical, τ. οὐρανόν, Luk.4:25, Rom.11:6; τ. σπλάγχνα, 1Jn.3:17; τ. βασιλείαν, Mat.23:14; id. absol., Rev.3:7; τ. θύραν, Rev.3:8. (cf. ἀπο-, ἐκ-, κατα-, συν-κλείω.) †
(AS)

G0222.def:
Ἀλεξανδρινός (Rec. -δρῖνο; see Kühner3, II, 296), -ή, -όν,
Alexan­drian: Act.27:6 28:11.†
(AS)

G1802.def:
Ἐνώχ (Heb. חֲנוֹךְ), ὁ,
Enoch (Gen.5:18): Luk.3:37, Heb.11:5, Ju 14.†
(AS)

G4880.strong_def: to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to

G4417.strong_def: to trip, i.e. (figuratively) to err, sin, fail (of salvation)

G1213.def:
δηλόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for ידע ;]
to make plain, declare: with accusative, 1Co.3:13, Col.1:8, Heb.9:8 12:27; with dative of person(s), 2Pe.1:14; with dative of person(s), before περί (pass.), 1Co.1:11; before εἰς, 1Pe.1:11.†
SYN.: ἐμφανίζω, to make manifest, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind. (AS)

G1935.def:
ἐπιθανάτιος, -ον
[in LXX: From Bel 1:31 ;]
condemned to death: 1Co.4:9.†
(AS)

G3860.gloss: betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend
G3860.strong_def: to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit

G2356.def:
θρησκεία (-κία, T), -ας, ἡ
(θρῆσκος), [in LXX: Wis.14:18, 27, Sir.22:5 A, 4Ma.5:6 4Mac 5:13 * ;]
religion in its external aspect (MM, Exp., xv), worship: Act.26:5, Jas.1:26-27; θ. τῶν ἀγγέλων, Col.2:18.†
SYN.: see: θρῆσκος (AS)

G4801.strong_def: to yoke together, i.e. (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage)
G4801.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G2201 (ζεῦγος);

G1343.def:
δικαιοσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(δίκαιος), [in LXX chiefly for צֶדֶק, and cognates, Gen.15:6, al., rarely for חֶסֶד, Gen.19:19 ;]
the character of ὁ δίκαιος (which see)
1. in broad sense, righteousness, conformity to the Divine will in purpose, thought and action: Mat.5:6, Jhn.16:8, Act.13:10, Rom.4:3; λόγος δικαιοσύνης, teaching of r., Heb.5:13; βασιλεὺς δ. (cf. FlJ, BJ, vi, 10, β. δίκαιος), Heb.7:2; ὅπλα δ., Rom.6:13; ὁδὸς δ., Mat.21:32; θώραξ τῆς δ., Eph.6:14; διὰκονοι δ., 2Co.11:15; ὁσιότης καὶ δ., Luk.1:75, cf. Eph.4:24; ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δ., Eph.5:9; δ. κ. εἰρήνη κ. χαρά, Rom.14:17; δ. κ. ἁγιασμός, 1Co.1:30; opposite to ἁμαρτία, Rom.8:10; ἀνομία, 2Co.6:14; άδικία, Rom.3:5; ποιεῖν τὴν δ., 1Jn.2:29 Jn 3:7; id. as an inclusive term for the active duties of the religious life (ICC, in l; Abbott, Essays, 73 ff), Mat.6:1; ἐργάζεσθαι δ., Act.10:35; διώκειν δ., 1Ti.6:11; πληροῦν πᾶσαν δ., Mat.3:15; ζῆν τῇ δ., 1Pe.2:24; δ. θεοῦ, a righteousness divine in its character and origin, Mat.6:33, Jas.1:20, (where it also includes the idea of God's personal r.; see ICC, on Rom.1:17) Rom.1:17 3:5, 21-26 10:3, 2Co.5:21, Php.3:9; ἡ δ. τ. πίσιεως, Rom.4:11; ἡ ἐκ π. δ., Rom.9:30; ἡ κατὰ π. δ., Heb.11:7; opposite to this is ἡ ἐκ νόμου δ., Rom.10:5; ἡ δ. ἐν ν., Php.3:6; ἡ ἰδία δ., Rom.10:3, cf. Php.3:9
2. In narrower sense (cf. δίκαιος), justice: Act.17:31, 2Pe.1:1, Rev.19:11 (DCG, ii, 529 ff.; Cremer, 190, 690).
(AS)
G1343.strong_def: equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification

G2507.def:
καθ-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָתַץ, פָּרַץ, יָרַד, etc. ;]
1. to take down: with accusative of person(s) (the technical term for removal after crucifixion, Field, Notes, 44), Mrk.15:36, 46, Luk.23:53, Act.13:29.
2. to put down by force, pull down, destroy: ἀποθήκας, Luk.12:18 (opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν); δυνάστας, Luk.1:52; ἔθνη, Act.13:19; pass., Act.19:27 (diminished, Field, Notes, 129 f.); figuratively, to refute: λογισμούς, 2Co.10:5.†
(AS)
G2507.strong_def: to lower (or with violence) demolish (literally or figuratively)
G2507.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and G138 (αἱρέομαι) (including its alternate);

G4904.gloss: companion in labour, (fellow-)helper(-labourer, -worker), labourer together with, workfellow
G4904.derivation: from a presumed compound of G4862 (σύν) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);

G0565.def:
ἀπέρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;]
1. to go away, depart (also, in late writers, with "perfective" force, to arrive at a destination, the thought being carried on to the goal; M, Pr., 111f., 247; MM, see word);
(a) absol.: Mat.13:25, al.; ptcp., ἀπελθών, used pleonastically with other verbs as in Heb. (Dalman, Words, 21), Mat.13:28, al.;
(b) with mention of place or person: εἰς, Mat.14:15; ἐπί, Luk.24:24; πρός, Rev.10:9; ἀπό, Luk.1:38; ἐξω, Act.4:15; ἐκεῖ, Mat.2:22.
2. As in LXX, before ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), to go after, follow: Mrk.1:20, Jhn.12:19; metaphorically, Mrk.1:42, Rev.21:1.
(AS)
G0565.strong_def: to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively

G1448.def:
ἐγγίζω (ἐγγύς).
[in LXX for נגשׁ, קרב, etc. ;]
1. trans., to bring near: Gen.48:10, Isa.5:8.
2. Intrans., to come near: absol., Mat.26:46, Mrk.14:42, Luk.18:40 19:41 21:20, 28 24:15, Act.21:33 23:15; with adv., ὅπου, Luk.12:33; with dative, Luk.7:12 15:1, Luke.15.25 22:47, Act.9:3 10:9 22:6; τ. θεῷ, Heb.7:19, Jas.4:8; before εἰς, Mat.21:1, Mrk.11:1, Luk.18:35 19:29 24:28; πρός, with dative, Luk.19:37; μέχρι θανάτου, Php.2:30; of time, ὥρα, Mat.26:45; ἡμέρα, Rom.13:12, Heb.10:25; καιρός, Mat.21:34, Luk.21:8; χρόνος, Act.7:17; ἑορτή, Luk.22:1; παρουσία, Jas.5:8; τέλος, 1Pe.4:7; ἐρήμωσις, Luk.21:20; ἀπολύτρωσις, Luk.21:28; ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία (for similar expressions in Targ., see Dalman, 106), Mat.3:2 4:17 10:7 Mrk.1:15, Luk.10:9 (ἐφ ̓ ὑμᾶς) 10:11 (cf. προσ-εγγίζω), and see Cremer, 224).
† (AS)

G0926.def:
βαρύς, -εῖα, ύ,
[in LXX chiefly for כָּבֵד ;]
heavy: Mat.23:4. Metaphorical, burdensome: ἐντολή, 1Jn.5:3; severe (perh. impressive): ἐπιστολή, 2Co.10:10; weighty: τὰ βαρύτερα τ. νόμου, Mat.23:23; αἰτιώματα, Act.25:7; violent, cruel (EV, grievous): λύκος, Act.20:29.†
(AS)

G4476.strong_def: perhaps rather akin to the base of G4474 (ῥαπίζω) through the idea of puncturing); a needle

G1661.def:
ἐλεφάντινος, -η, -ον
(ἐλέφας, ivory), [in LXX for שֵׁן ;]
of ivory: Rev.18:12.†
(AS)
G1661.strong_def: elephantine, i.e. (by implication) composed of ivory

G0521.def:
ἀ-παίδευτος, -ον
(παιδεύω), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, etc., chiefly in Wis. lit. ;]
uninstructed, ignorant: 2Ti.2:23.†
(AS)
G0521.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3811 (παιδεύω);

G3447.strong_def: to fabricate the image of a bullock

G1822.def:
ἐξ-αρτίζω
(ἄρτιος), [in LXX. Exo.28:7 (חָבַר pu.) * ;]
1. to com­plete, finish: τ. ἡμέρας, Act.21:5.
2. to furnish, supply: pass., 2Ti.3:17 (for exx., see MM, Exp., xiii; Cremer, 651).†
(AS)
G1822.strong_def: to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher)
G1822.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G739 (ἄρτιος);

G2084.def:
ἑτερό-γλωσσος
(Att.. -ττος), -ον, [in Aq.: Psa.114:1, Isa.33:19 * ;]
of alien speech, of another tongue (see Cremer, 681): 1Co.14:21 (aliter in LXX).†
(AS)

G4200.derivation: from a derivative of (a way, i.e. means);

G5595.strong_def: to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish

G1672.def:
Ἕλλην, -ηνος, ὁ
[in LXX: Jol.3:6, Zec.9:13 (יָוָן), etc.; 1Ma.1:19, al. * ;]
a Greek; opposite to βάρβαρος, Rom.1:14; usually in ΝΤ of Greek Gentiles, opposite to Ἰουδαῖοι: Jhn.7:35, Act.11:29 14:1 16:1, 3 18:4 19:19, 17 20:21 21:28 Rom.1:16 2:9-10 3:9 10:12, 1Co.1:22 1:24 10:32 12:13, Gal.2:3 3:28, Col.3:11; of proselytes, Jhn.12:29, Act.17:4.†
(AS)
G1672.strong_def: a Hellen (Grecian) or inhabitant of Hellas; by extension a Greek-speaking person, especially a non-Jew

G5104.gloss: (used only with other particles in the comparative, as G2544 (καίτοιγε), G3305 (μέντοι), G5105 (τοιγαροῦν), G5106 (τοίνυν), etc
G5104.strong_def: an enclitic particle of asseveration by way of contrast; in sooth
G5104.derivation: probably for the dative case of G3588 (ὁ);

G0310.def:
ἀνα-βοάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for צָעַק, זָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;]
to cry out: Mat.27:46 (WH, ἐβόησεν; see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0070.def:
ἀγρυπνία, -ας, ἡ (see supr.),
[in LXX: Si .9, 2Ma.2:26 * ;]
sleeplessness, watching: 2Co.6:5 11:27. (Plat., Hdt.; for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word) †
(AS)

G2358.def:
θριαμβεύω
(θρίαμβος, 1. a festal hymn to Bacchus. 2. The Roman triumphus),
1. to triumph (and rarely, with accusative, to triumph over; so perh. Col.2:15, but see infr.).
2. to lead in triumph: with accusative of person(s), 2Co.2:14; hence, generally, to make a spectacle or show of: Col.2:15 (but see supr.; cf. MM, Exp., xv; and esp. Field, Notes, 181).†
(AS)
G2358.strong_def: and a derivative of G680 (ἅπτομαι) (meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer or (by Hebraism) to give victory
G2358.derivation: from a prolonged compound of the base of G2360 (θροέω);

G0878.def:
ἄφρων, -ον genitive -ονος
(φρήν), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, נָבָל, etc. ;]
without reason, senseless, foolish, expressing "want of mental sanity and sobriety, a reckless and inconsiderate habit of mind" (Hort; cf. MM, see word): Luk.11:40 12:20, Rom.2:20, 1Co.15:36, 2Co.11:16 12:6 12:11, 1Pe.2:15; opposite to φρόνιμος, 2Co.11:19; to συνιέντες, Eph.2:17.†
(AS)
G0878.strong_def: properly, mindless, i.e. stupid, (by implication) ignorant, (specially) egotistic, (practically) rash, or (morally) unbelieving
G0878.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5424 (φρήν);

G2255.def:
ἥμισυς, -εια, -υ genitive, -ους (late, as in π., for cl., -εος Bl., § 8, 4; Mayser, 294), n. p1., ἡμίσια (Rec., cl., -εια),
[in LXX for חֵצִי, מַחֲצִית ;] half;
1. as adj., agreeing in gender and number with the substantive following, τὰ ἡμίσια τ. ὑταρχόντων, Luk.19:8.
2. As neut. subst., τὸ ἥμισυ, the half; ἥ. (anarth.), a half: with genitive, ἥ. καιροῦ, Rev.12:14; ἕως ἡμίσους τ. βασιλείας μου, Mrk.6:23; after a cardinal number, ἡμέρας τρεῖς κ. ἥμισυ, Rev.11:9, 11.†
(AS)
G2255.derivation: neuter of a derivative from an inseparable prefix akin to G260 (ἅμα) (through the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-;

G0691.def:
ἀργέω, -ῶ
(ἀργός), [in LXX: Est.4:24, Ecc.12:3 (בָּטֵל), I Est.2:30, Sir.33:27), 2Ma.5:25 * ;]
to be idle; τὸ κρίμα . . . ἀ., lingers (cf. MGr. ἀργά, late: MM, see word): 2Pe.2:3.†
(AS)
G0691.strong_def: to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay

G1635.def:
ἑκών, -οῦσα, -όν
[in LXX: Exo.21:13, Job.36:19 * ;]
willing, of one's own free will: Rom.8:20, 1Co.9:17 (Cremer, 246).†
(AS)

G1628.def:
ἐκ-φεύγω
[in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;]
to flee away, escape: absol., Act.16:27, 1Th.5:3, Heb.2:3; before ἐκ, Act.19:10; with accusative of person(s), Heb.12:25; with accusative of thing(s), Luk.21:36, Rom.2:3; τ. χεῖρας αὐτοῦ, 2Co.11:33.†
(AS)

G1354.def:
Διονύσιος, -ου, ὁ
Dionysius, an Athenian: Act.17:34.†
(AS)

G4091.strong_def: close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman

G4455.gloss: at any time, + never (…to any man), + yet, never man
G4455.strong_def: at any time, i.e. (with negative particle) at no time

G1744.def:
ἐν-δύνω, see: ἐνδύω.
ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2Ti.3:6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;]
1. with accusative of person(s), Mat.27:28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Mat.27:31, Mrk.15:20, Luk.15:22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.6:25, Mrk.6:9, Luk.8:27 12:22, Act.12:21; ptcp., Mat.22:11, Mrk.1:6, 2Co.5:3, Rev.1:13 15:6 19:14; of armour (figuratively): Rom.13:12, Eph.6:11, 14, 1Th.5:8; metaphorically, δύναμιν, Luk.24:49; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, 1Co.15:53-54; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, Eph 4:24, Col.3:10; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, Col.3:12; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, Rom.13:14, Gal.3:27,
2. to enter, press into: 2Ti.3:6 (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†
(AS)
G1744.strong_def: to sink (by implication, wrap (compare G1746 (ἐνδύω)) on, i.e. (figuratively) sneak

G1580.def:
ἐκ-κομίζω
to carry out: as freq., a corpse for burial, Luk.7:12.†
(AS)

G1078.def:
γένεσις, -εως, ἡ
(γίγνομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹלֵדֹת ;]
1. origin, lineage: βίβλος γενέσεως (as in Gen.2:4a 5:1), Mat.1:1.
2. birth: Mat.1:18, Luk.1:14 (Rec. γέννησις); πρόσωπον τῆς γ., face of his birth ("what God made him to be," Hort., in l.), Jas.1:23; ὁ τροχὸς τῆς γ., the wheel (course) of birth or creation ("the wheel of man's nature according to its original Divine purpose," Hort), Jas.3:6.
† (AS)

G0450.def:
ἀνίστημι (ἀνά, ἵστημι),
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1. causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., with accusative, to raise up: Act.9:41; from death, Jhn.6:39, Act.2:32; to raise up, cause to be born or appear: Mat.22:24, Act.3:22, 26.
2. Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.;
(a) to rise: from lying, Mrk.1:35; from sitting, Luk.4:16; to leave a place, Mat.9:9; pleonastically, as Heb. קוּם, before verbs of going, Mrk.10:1, al. (see Dalman, Words, 23; M, Pr., 14); of the dead, Mat.17:23, Mrk.8:31; before ἐκ νεκρῶν, Mat.17:9, Mrk.9:9;
(b) to arise, appear: Act.5:36, Rom.15:12 (cf. ἐπ-, ἐξ- ἀνίστημι, and see Cremer, 306, 738; MM, VGT, see word).
SYN.: ἐγείρω.
(AS)
G0450.strong_def: to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)

G2493.def:
Ἰωήλ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. יוֹאֵל,),
Joel: Act.2:16.†
(AS)

G0232.def:
ἁλιεύω
(ἁλιεύς), [in LXX: Jer.16:16 (דִּיג)* ;]
to fish: Jhn.21:3 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0232.strong_def: to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish

G1956.def:
ἐπι-λύω
[in Aq.: Gen.40:8 41:8, 12; Th.: Hos.3:4 * ;]
1. to loose, release.
2. to solve, settle, explain: Mrk.4:34, Act.19:39.†
(AS)
G1956.strong_def: to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide

G4377.strong_def: to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon

G3196.strong_def: a limb or part of the body

G2254.def:
ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς,
of person(s) pron.
I.
(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in Mat.3:11, Mrk.1:8, Luk.3:16, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as Mat.10:16, Jhn.10:17; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. 1Ki.3:8), Act.9:10; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, Jhn.1:23 (LXX), Act.7:32 (LXX).
(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, Jhn.14:20; μου τ. λόγους, Mat.7:24; ὀπίσω μου, Mat.3:11; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, Rev.5:5; also with the prep. πρός, as Mrk.9:19, al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as Luk.10:16, Jhn.7:23, Mrk.14:7, al.
(with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, Mat.2:6; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, Mrk.9:24.
(d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, Jdg.11:12, al.), i.e. what have we in common: Mat.8:29, Mrk.1:24, 5:7, Luk.8:28, Jhn.2:4; τί γάρ μοι, 1Co.5:2.
(e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).
(f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: Mat.2:8, Luk.2:48, Jhn.6:56, Rom.3:7, 1Co.7:40, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, Jhn.7:28.
(AS)

G0358.def:
ἄναλος, -ον
(ἅλς), [in Aq.: Eze.13:10-11, 15 22:28 * ;]
saltless, insipid: Mrk.9:50.†
(AS)
G0358.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G251 (ἅλς);

G1222.def:
δή-που (WH, δή που),
indef. adv.,
mostly in sense of surely, of course, we know: Heb.2:16 T (WH, δή που).†
(AS)
G1222.strong_def: a particle of asseveration; indeed doubtless

G4372.derivation: from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G4969 (σφάζω);

G1840.def:
ἐξ-ισχύω
[in LXX: Sir.7:6 * ;]
to have strength enough, to be quite able: with inf., Eph.3:18.†
(AS)
G1840.strong_def: to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent

G1427.def:
δώδεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl.
numeral, twelve: Mat.9:20 10:1, al.; οἱ δ., the apostles, Mat.10:5, Mrk.4:10, al.; in Act.19:7 24:11, for Rec. δεκαδύο.
(AS)
G1427.strong_def: two and ten, i.e. a dozen

G0554.def:
ἀπ-εκ-δύω
to strip off clothes or arms; mid., to strip off from oneself: Col.3:9; to strip, despoil (mid, for act., ICC, in l; but cf. Lft., Ellic.), Col.2:15.†
(AS)
G0554.strong_def: to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil
G0554.derivation: middle voice from G575 (ἀπό) and G1562 (ἐκδύω);

G2986.gloss: bright, clear, gay, goodly, gorgeous, white
G2986.strong_def: radiant; by analogy, limpid; figuratively, magnificent or sumptuous (in appearance)

G5172.derivation: from (to break up or (figuratively) enfeeble, especially the mind and body by indulgence);

G3158.strong_def: Matthat (i.e. Mattithjah), the name of two Israelites
G3158.derivation: probably a shortened form of G3161 (Ματταθίας);

G4718.strong_def: a cluster of grapes (as if intertwined)
G4718.derivation: probably from the base of G4735 (στέφανος);

G2433.def:
ἱλάσκομαι
(ἵλαος = ἵλεως) [in LXX (cf. Westc., Epp. Jo., 85 f.) for סָלַח, 4Ki.5:18 24:4, Psa.25:11, La 3:42, Da TH Dan.9:19; כָּפַר pi., Psa.65:3 78:38 79:9; נָחַם ni., Exo.32:14, Est.4:17 * ;]
1. in cl., with accusative of person(s), to conciliate, appease, propitiate (= ἐξιλάσκομαι, Gen.32:20, Pro.16:14, Mal.1:9, al.).
2. In LXX (Thackeray, Gr., 270, 1.), Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 224 f.), and NT, to be propitious, merciful (with dative of thing(s), Psa.79:9, al.): with dative of person(s) (4Ki.5:18), Luk.18:13.
3. As in Philo (= ἐξιλάσκ-, in LXX: Eze.43:22, al.), to expiate, make propitiation for: τ. ἁμαρτίας, Heb.2:17 (Cremer, 301 ff., 735).†
(AS)
G2433.strong_def: to conciliate, i.e. (transitively) to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious
G2433.derivation: middle voice from the same as G2436 (ἵλεως);

G5574.strong_def: to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood
G5574.derivation: middle voice of an apparently primary verb;

G5324.strong_def: to make apparent, i.e. (passively) to appear (neuter participle as noun, a spectacle)

G3918.gloss: come, X have, be here, + lack, (be here) present
G3918.strong_def: to be near, i.e. at hand; neuter present participle (singular) time being, or (plural) property
G3918.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and G1510 (εἰμί) (including its various forms);

G2617.def:
κατ-αισχύνω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;]
to disgrace, dishonour, put to shame: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.11:4-5; with accusative of person(s), 1Co.1:27 11:22; pass., to be ashamed: Luk.13:17, 2Co.7:14 9:4, 1Pe.3:16; as in LXX (Psa.22:6 25:2-3, al.), of unfulfilled hopes: Rom.5:5; pass., Rom.9:33 10:11, 1Pe.2:6" (LXX) .†
(AS)
G2617.strong_def: to shame down, i.e. disgrace or (by implication) put to the blush

G4057.gloss: exceedingly, out of measure, the more

G0244.def:
ἀλλοτρι-επίσκοπος (Rec. ἀλλοτριοεπ-), -ου, ὁ
one who meddles in things alien to his calling: 1Pe.4:15 (see ICC, in l; Deiss., BS, 224-4; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0244.strong_def: overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler (specially, in Gentile customs)

G2650.def:
κατα-μένω
[in LXX for יָשַׁב (Num.20:1, al.), etc. ;]
to remain permanently, abide: Act.1:13, 1Co.16:6, WH (παραμ-, T, EV).†
(AS)

G5578.strong_def: a spurious prophet, i.e. pretended foreteller or religious impostor

G3703.strong_def: properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit
G3703.derivation: apparently from the base of G3796 (ὀψέ) and G5610 (ὥρα);

G0989.def:
βλάσφημος, -ον
(βλασ-, of uncertain deriv., see Thayer, Boisacq; + φήμη, speech), [in LXX: Isa.66:3 (מְבָרֵךְ אָוֶן), Wis.1:6, Sir.3:16, 2Ma.9:28 10:4, 36 * ;]
(a) evil-speaking, slanderous, blasphemous: Act.6:11, 2Ti.3:2, 2Pe.2:11 (cf. Ju 9);
(b) as subst. a blasphemer: 1Ti.1:13 (Cremer, 570).
† (AS)
G0989.strong_def: scurrilious, i.e. calumnious (against men), or (specially) impious (against God)
G0989.derivation: from a derivative of G984 (βλάπτω) and G5345 (φήμη);

G2260.strong_def: than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed)

G1834.def:
ἐξ-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to lead, show the way; metaphorically, to unfold, narrate, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.24:35 Act.21:19; with dative of person(s), Act.10:8; θεόν (understood), Jhn.1:18; before ὅσα, Act.15:12; καθώς, Act.15:14.†
(AS)
G1834.strong_def: to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold

G0749.def:
ἀρχιερεύς, -έως, ὁ,
[in LXX for כּ'' הָרֹאשׁ,כּ'' הַגָּדוֹל ,כּהֵן ;]
1. high-priest: Mrk.2:26 14:47, al.; of Christ: Heb.2:17 3:1, al.
2. In pl., chief priests, including ex-high-priests and members of high-priestly families: Mat.2:4, Mrk.8:31, al. (Cremer, 294; DCG, i, 297f.; MM, see word).
(AS)
G0749.strong_def: the high-priest (literally, of the Jews, typically, Christ); by extension a chief priest

G0178.def:
ἀ-κατά-κριτος, -ον
(κατακρίνω),
1. uncondemned (EV): Act.16:37, 22:25.
2. = cl. ἄκριτος, without trial, not yet tried (MM, VGT, see word) Ac, ll. cc.
† (AS)
G0178.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2632 (κατακρίνω);

G4747.strong_def: something orderly in arrangement, i.e. (by implication) a serial (basal, fundamental, initial) constituent (literally), proposition (figuratively)
G4747.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of G4748 (στοιχέω);

G5517.strong_def: dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e. (by implication) terrene

G2123.def:
εὔ-κοπος, -ον
[in LXX: Sir.22:15, 1Ma.3:18 * ;]
with easy labour, easy: compar., -ώτερόν ἐστι, with inf., Mat.9:5, Mrk.2:9, Luk.5:23; with accusative and inf., Mat.19:24, Mrk.10:25, Luk.16:17 18:25 (Polyb.; the adv. -ως occurs in Aristoph., Fr., 615).†
(AS)
G2123.strong_def: better for toil, i.e. more facile
G2123.derivation: comparative of a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G2873 (κόπος);

G1745.def:
ἔν-δυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνδύω), [in LXX: Job.41:13 (לְבוּשׁ), Est.5:1 * ;]
a putting on: ίματίων, 1Pe.3:3.†
(AS)

G3133.strong_def: to extinguish (as fire), i.e. (figuratively and passively) to pass away

G1625.def:
ἐκ-τρέφω
[in LXX for גָּדַל, etc. ;]
1. prop., of children, to nurture, bring up: Eph.6:4.
2. to nourish: Eph.5:29.†
(AS)
G1625.strong_def: to rear up to maturity, i.e. (genitive case) to cherish or train

G0072.def:
ἀγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἄγω), [in LXX: Est.2:20 10:3, 2Ma.4:16 6:8 11:24, 3Ma.4:10 * ;]
1. a carrying away.
2. a leading, guiding; metaphorically, training; hence, from the expression ἀ. τοῦ βίου, absol., conduct, way of life: 2Ti.3:10 (Cremer, 61; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0072.strong_def: a bringing up, i.e. mode of living

G4916.strong_def: to inter in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate spiritually (to Christ by a sepulture as to sin)

G3983.strong_def: "pine"); to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave
G3983.derivation: from the same as G3993 (πένης) (through the idea of pinching toil;

G4307.strong_def: forethought, i.e. provident care or supply

G1993.def:
ἐπι-στομίζω
(στόμα),
to bridle; metaphorically, to stop the mouth, to silence: Tit.1:11.†
(AS)
G1993.strong_def: to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence

G4014.strong_def: to remove all around, i.e. unveil, cast off (anchor); figuratively, to expiate
G4014.derivation: from G4012 (περί) and G138 (αἱρέομαι) (including its alternate);

G4220.strong_def: interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. is it this or that
G4220.derivation: neuter of a comparative of the base of G4226 (ποῦ);

G3909.strong_def: to chance near, i.e. fall in with

G1645.def:
ἐλαφρός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for קַל, קָלָל ;]
light in weight easy to bear: Mat.11:30; θλίψρις (EV, our light affliction), 2Co.4:17.†
(AS)
G1645.derivation: probably akin to G1643 (ἐλαύνω) and the base of G1640 (ἐλάσσων);

G1037.def:
βυθός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX: Exo.15:5, Neh.9:11 (מְצוֹלָה), Psa.67 (68):22 68 (69):2, 15 106 (107):24 (מְצוּלָה)* ;]
1. the bottom.
2. the depth of the sea, the deep sea: 2Co.11:25.
† (AS)

G0573.def:
ἁπλοῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν
(contr. fr. -όος; ἁ.- cop., πλόος), [in LXX: Pro.11:25 * ;]
simple, single: in a moral sense (DCG, ii, 628 f.), ἀφθαλμός, Mat.6:22, Luk.11:34. (In π. of a marriage dowry, see MM, see word).†
ἁπλόος, see: ἁπλοῦς
SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἀκέραιος (Tr., Syn., § lvi; Cremer, 107, 639) (AS)
G0573.strong_def: properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear)
G0573.derivation: probably from G1 (Α) (as a particle of union) and the base of G4120 (πλέκω);

G5011.gloss: base, cast down, humble, of low degree (estate), lowly
G5011.strong_def: depressed, i.e. (figuratively) humiliated (in circumstances or disposition)

G1219.strong_def: public; (feminine singular dative case as adverb) in public

G4555.strong_def: sardine (G3037 (λίθος) being implied), i.e. a gem, so called

G0433.def:
ἀν-ήκω
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: Jos.23:14 (בּוֹא), 1Ki.27:8, Sir. prol.10, 1, 2 Mac6* ;]
prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, see word), Eph.5:4, Col.3:18; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.†
(AS)
G0433.strong_def: to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper

G0128.def:
.*Αἰθίοψ, -οπος, ὁ
(αἴθω, to burn, ὤψ, face; i.e. swarthy), [in LXX for כּוּשׁ ;]
Ethiopian: Act.8:27.†
(AS)
G0128.derivation: from (to scorch) and (the face, from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι));

G3895.strong_def: to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize

G2223.def:
ζώνη, -ης, ἡ
(ζώννυμι) [in LXX for אַבְנֵט, חֲגוֹר, etc. ;]
a belt, girdle: Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6, Act.21:11, Rev.1:13 15:6; as a receptacle for money, Mat.10:9, Mrk.6:8.†
(AS)
G2223.strong_def: a belt; by implication, a pocket
G2223.derivation: probably akin to the base of G2218 (ζυγός);

G2059.def:
ἑρμηνεύω
[in LXX: Est.4:7 (תִּרְגַּם), Est.10:3 Job.42:17β* ;]
1. to explain.
2. to interpret: Luk.24:27 (WH, mg.), Jhn.1:39, 43 9:7, Heb.7:2.†
(AS)
G2059.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G2060 (Ἑρμῆς) (as the god of language);

G1547.def:
ἐκ-γαμίζω
Rec. for γαμίζω, which see: Mat.22:30 24:38, Luk.17:27, 1Co.7:38. Not elsewhere.†
(AS)
G1547.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a form of G1061 (γαμίσκω) (compare G1548 (ἐκγαμίσκω));

G1471.def:
ἔγκυος, see: ἐνκ-.
ἔνκυoς (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν), -ον
(κύω, to conceive), [in LXX: Sir.42:10 * ;]
pregnant, big with child : Luk.2:5.†
(AS)
G1471.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and the base of G2949 (κῦμα);

G5424.strong_def: the midrif (as a partition of the body), i.e. (figuratively and by implication, of sympathy) the feelings (or sensitive nature; by extension (also in the plural) the mind or cognitive faculties)
G5424.derivation: probably from an obsolete (to rein in or curb; compare G5420 (φράσσω));

G1939.def:
ἐπιθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(έπιθυμέω), [in LXX chiefly for תַּאֲוָה, אָוָה; also for חֶמֶד, etc. ;]
desire, longing: Luk.22:15 (see: ἐπιθυμέω), Php.1:23, 1Th.2:17, Rev.18:14; p1., Mrk.4:19; esp. with ref. to forbidden things, desire, lust (Vg., concupiscentia): Rom.7:7-8, Jas.1:14-15, 2Pe.1:4; pl., Gal.5:24, 1Ti.6:9, 2Ti.2:22 4:3, 1Pe.1:14 4:2; πάθος ἐπιθυμίας, 1Th.4:5; ἐ. κακή, Col.3:5; with genitive, μιασμοῦ, 2Pe.2:10 (see Mayor, in l); τ. καρδιῶν, Rom.1:24; τ. κόσμου (aroused by the world), 1Jn.2:17; τ. σώματος, Rom.6:12; τ. ἀπάτης, Eph.4:22 (see ICC, in l); τ. σαρκός, 1Jn.2:16, 2Pe.2:18 (without art.), Gal.5:16; τ. ὀφθαλμῶν, 1Jn.2:16; σαρκικαὶ ἐ., 1Pe.2:11 (cf. 4Ma.1:32); κοσμικαί, Tit.2:12; εἰς ἐπιθυμίας, Rom.13:14; ποιεῖν τὰς ἐ., Jhn.8:44; ὑπακούειν ταῖς ἐ., Rom.6:12; δουλεύειν, ἄγεσθαι, ἐπιθυμίαις, Tit.3:3, 2Ti.3:6; πορεύειθαι ἐν ἐ., 1Pe.4:3; κατά, Ju 16 18, 2Pe.3:3; ἀναστρέφεσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐ., Eph.2:3.†
SYN.: πάθος (which see), ὄρεξις (AS)
G1939.strong_def: a longing (especially for what is forbidden)

G4314.gloss: about, according to , against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in)
G4314.strong_def: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated)

G0379.def:
ἀναπολόγητος, -ον
(ἀπολογεόμαι),
without excuse, inexcusable (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; see Lft., Notes, 252): Rom.1:20 2:1.†
(AS)
G0379.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G626 (ἀπολογέομαι);

G0791.def:
ἀστεῖος, -ον
(ἄστυ, a city), [in LXX: Exo.2:2 (טוֹב), Num.22:32 (οὐκ ἀ. יָרַט), Jdg.3:17 (בָּרִיא), Jdth.11:23, Dan LXX, Sus 1:7, 2Ma.6:23 * ;]
1. of the town.
2. (Like Lat. urbanus),
(a) courteous,
(b) elegant (in π., of clothing, MM, see word), comely, fair (as in Ex, l.with), Heb.11:23, Act.7:20.†
(AS)

G3755.strong_def: during which same time, i.e. whilst
G3755.derivation: for the genitive case of G3748 (ὅστις) (as adverb);

G0290.def:
ἀμπελών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(ἄμπελος), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם ;]
a vineyard: Mat.20:1 ff. Mat.21:28 ff, Luk.13:6 20:9 ff., 1Co.9:7. Æschin., 49, 13; Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word; LS, see word ἀμπελουργεῖον.)
(AS)

G1636.def:
ἐλαία
(Attic, ἐλάα), -ας, ἡ [in LXX for זַיִת ;]
1. an olive tree: Rom.11:17, 24, Rev.11:4; τ. ὄρος τῶν ἐ. (זַיִת הַר, Zec.14:4), the Mount of Olives: Mat.21:1 24:3 26:30, Mrk.11:1 13:3 14:26, Luk.19:37 22:39; τὸ καλούμενον ἐ. (T, ἐλαιών, which see), Luk.19:29 21:37.
2. an olive (Aristoph.): Jas.3:12.†
(AS)
G1636.strong_def: an olive (the tree or the fruit)
G1636.derivation: feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary;

G4977.gloss: break, divide, open, rend, make a rent
G4977.strong_def: to split or sever (literally or figuratively)

G2315.derivation: from G2316 (θεός) and a presumed derivative of G4154 (πνέω);

G2357.def:
θρῆσκος
(-κός, WH), -ον, ό
religious, careful of the outward forms of divine service (see previous word)): Jas.1:26.†
SYN.: εὐσεβής, θεοσεβής, δεισιδαίμων (see Tr., Syn., § xlviii) (AS)
G2357.strong_def: ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious
G2357.derivation: probably from the base of G2360 (θροέω);

G2455.def:
Ἰούδας, -α
dative -ᾳ,
accusative -αν
(so in LXX, and also rarely, Ἰουδά, indecl.; cf. Thack., Gr., 163) (Heb. יְהוּדָה)
1. Judah, son of Jacob: Mat.1:2-3, Luk.3:33; φυλή Ἰ., Rev.5:5 7:5; by meton., of the tribe, Heb.7:14; of its confines, γῆ Ἰ., Mat.2:6;πόλις Ἰ., Luk.1:39.
2. Judah (unknown): Luk.3:30.
3. Judas Iscariot (see: Ἰσκαριώτης): Mat.10:4, Mrk.3:19, Luk.6:16, Jhn.6:71 13:2, al.
4. Judas, the Lord's brother (see: ἀδελφός): Mat.13:55, Mrk.6:3 (prob.), Ju 1.
5. Judas the Apostle, son of James (see: Θαδδαῖος): Luk.6:16, Jhn.14:22, Act.1:13.
6. Judas, of Damascus: Act.9:11.
7. Judas, surnamed Βαρσαββᾶς (which see): Act.15:22, 27 15:32.
8. Judas the Galilean: Act.5:37
Ἰωδά
(Rec. Ἰούδα)
Joda: Luk.3:26.†
(AS)
G2455.strong_def: Judas (i.e. Jehudah), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region

G2837.def:
κοιμάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב ;]
to lull to sleep, put to sleep. Mid and pass., to fall asleep (M, Pr., 162; M, Th., 1, 4, 13): Mat.28:13, Luk.22:45, Jhn.11:12, Act.12:6. Metaph, of death: Mat.27:52, Jhn.11:11 Act.7:60 13:36, 1Co.7:39 11:30 15:6 15:18 15:20 15:51, 1Th.4:13-15, 2Pe.3:4 (cf. Isa.14:8 43:17, 2Ma.12:45).†
SYN.: καθεύδω (AS)
G2837.strong_def: to put to sleep, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease

G5561.gloss: coast, county, fields, ground, land, region
G5561.strong_def: room, i.e. a space of territory (more or less extensive; often including its inhabitants)
G5561.derivation: feminine of a derivative of the base of G5490 (χάσμα) through the idea of empty expanse;

G0828.def:
Αὔγουστος, -ου, ὁ
(Lat.), Augustus, the Roman Emperor: Luk.2:1 (cf. Σεβαστός; and see MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0828.strong_def: Augustus, a title of the Roman emperor

G1603.def:
ἐκ-πληρόω
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:10, 3Ma.1:2 3Mac 1:22 * ;]
1. to fill full, make up a number.
2. to fulfil (MM, Exp., xii; Cremer, 839), Act.13:32.†
(AS)

G3551.strong_def: law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case (regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a principle)
G3551.derivation: from a primary (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to animals);

G2407.def:
ἱερατεύω
(cl. = ἱεράομαι) [in LXX chiefly for כָּהַן pi. ;]
to be a priest, officiate as a priest: Luk.1:8 (the word is frequently in Inscr.; see LS, see word; Deiss., BS, 215; LAE, 70; Cremer, 734).†
(AS)
G2407.strong_def: to be a priest, i.e. perform his functions

G3784.gloss: behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should
G3784.strong_def: to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty
G3784.derivation: probably from the base of G3786 (ὄφελος) (through the idea of accruing);

G3042.derivation: probably from G3007 (λείπω) (through the idea of destitution);

G3639.strong_def: a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. death, punishment

G3155.derivation: accusative case of a derivative of the base of G3145 (μασσάομαι) (through the idea of tentative manipulation, i.e. unsuccessful search, or else of punishment);

G0721.def:
ἀρνίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of ἀρήν; see MM, see word), [in LXX: Psa.114:4, 6 (pl., צֹאן בֵּן), Jer.11:19 (כֶּבֶשׂ), Jer.50:45 (צָעִיר)* ;]
a little lamb, a lamb: Jhn.21:15, Rev.2:7.†
(AS)

G2800.def:
κλάσις, -εως, ἡ
(κλάω),
a breaking: Luk.24:35, Act.2:42.†
(AS)

G2105.def:
εὐδία, -ας, ἡ
(εὔδιος, calm) [in LXX: Sir.3:15 * ;]
fair weather: Mat.16:2 (Rec., R, txt.).†
(AS)
G2105.strong_def: a clear sky, i.e. fine weather
G2105.derivation: feminine from G2095 (εὖ) and the alternate of G2203 (Ζεύς) (as the god of the weather);

G4062.strong_def: to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to craze
G4062.derivation: from G4012 (περί) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);

G5399.strong_def: to frighten, i.e. (passively) to be alarmed; by analogy, to be in awe of, i.e. revere

G2021.def:
ἐπιχειρέω, -ῶ
(χεῖρ), [in LXX for חָשַׁב, Exo.9:25; גָּמַל, 2Ch.20:11, al. ;]
1. to pat one's hand to.
2. to take in hand, attempt: with inf., Luk.1:1, Act.9:29 19:13.†
(AS)
G2021.strong_def: to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake

G4766.strong_def: to "strew," i.e. spread (as a carpet or couch)
G4766.derivation: prolongation from a still simpler , (used only as an alternate in certain tenses) (probably akin to G4731 (στερεός) through the idea of positing);

G4881.strong_def: to destroy (middle voice or passively, be slain) in company with

G2686.def:
κατα-σοφίζομαι
[in LXX: Exo.1:10 (חָכָם hith.), Jdth.5:11 10:19 * ;]
to deal craftily with, outwit: Act.7:19 (LXX) †
(AS)
G2686.strong_def: to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent
G2686.derivation: middle voice from G2596 (κατά) and G4679 (σοφίζω);

G1340.def:
δι-ισχυρίζομαι (T, Rec. διϊσ-), depon.;
1. to lean upon.
2. to affirm confidently: with ptcp., Luk.22:59; with accusative and inf. (Bl., § 70, 3), Act.12:15.†
(AS)
G1340.strong_def: to stout it through, i.e. asservate
G1340.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and a derivative of G2478 (ἰσχυρός);

G4008.strong_def: through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across
G4008.derivation: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of (to "pierce");

G2992.strong_def: a people (in general; thus differing from G1218 (δῆμος), which denotes one's own populace)

G1779.def:
ἐνταφιάζω
[in LXX: Gen.50:2 (חָנַט; cf. ἐνταφιαστής, Gen.50:2 for רָפָא; see Deiss., BS, 120 f.; MM, Exp., xiii)* ;]
a κοινή word (Deiss., LAE, 723),
to prepare for burial: Mat.26:12, Jhn.19:40.†
(AS)
G1779.strong_def: to inswathe with cerements for interment
G1779.derivation: from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G5028 (τάφος);

G2245.def:
ἡλίκος, -η, -ον
1. prop., as big as, as old as.
2. As indirect interrog., what sized, what, how great, how small (the sense to be determined by the context): Col.2:1, Jas.3:5, Gal.6:11 (WH, mg.; πηλ-, WH, txt., RV).†
(AS)
G2245.strong_def: as big as, i.e. (interjectively) how much
G2245.derivation: from (a comrade, i.e. one of the same age);

G5168.strong_def: akin to the base of G5134 (τραῦμα), G5147 (τρίβος) and G5176 (τρώγω)); an orifice, i.e. needle's eye
G5168.derivation: from a derivative of (to wear away;

G1016.def:
βοῦς, βοός, ὁ, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for בָּקָר ;]
an ox, a cow: Luk.13:15 14:5, 19 Jhn.2:14, 15 1Co.9:9" (LXX), 1Ti.5:18.†
(AS)
G1016.strong_def: an ox (as grazing), i.e. an animal of that species ("beef")
G1016.derivation: probably from the base of G1006 (βόσκω);

G4383.gloss: (outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence
G4383.strong_def: the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person
G4383.derivation: from G4314 (πρός) and (the visage, from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι));

G1575.def:
ἐκ-κλάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Lev.1:17 (שָׁסַע pi.)* ;]
to break off: pass., Rom.11:17-20.†
(AS)

G2085.def:
ἑτεροδιδασκαλέω, -ῶ
to teach other or different doctrine: 1Ti.1:3 6:3 (cf. CGT, in l; Milligan, NTD, 102).†
(AS)

G0340.def:
ἀνα-καινίζω
(καινός), [in LXX: 2Ch.15:8, Psa.103:5 104:30, La 5:21 (חָדַשׁ pi., hith)., Psa.39:2 (עָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:9 * ;]
to renew: Heb.6:6 (Isocr., Plut.).†
(AS)
G0340.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of G2537 (καινός);

G1072.def:
γεμίζω
(γέμω), [in LXX: Gen.45:17 (טען), 3Ma.5:47, 4Ma.3:14 * ;]
to fill;
1. properly, of a ship (Thuc, al.): Mrk.4:37 (pass.).
2. In late writers, generally (MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), with accusative, before genitive, Mrk.15:36, Jhn.2:7 6:13, Rev.15:8; ἀπό, Luk.15:16, Rec. WH, mg.; ἐκ, Luk.15:16, WH, Rev.8:5. Pass., absol.: Luk.14:23.
† (AS)

G2278.def:
ἠχέω, -ῶ
(ἦχος), [in LXX for הָמָה, etc. ;]
to sound: 1Co.13:1 (cf. ἐξ-, κατ-ηχέω).†
(AS)
G2278.strong_def: to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate

G3795.strong_def: a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment)
G3795.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of G3702 (ὀπτός);

G0432.def: anise, dill , (Aristophanes Comicus); ionic ἄννησον or ἄνησον (Herdotus Historicus); aeolic ἄννητον, or ἄνητον, (Sapho). (ML)

G0996.def:
βοήθεια, -ας, ἡ (see: βοηθέω),
[in LXX for עֵזֶר, etc. ;]
help: Heb.4:16; pl., helps, "frapping," a technical nautical term (MM, Exp., x; DB, ext., 367): Act.27:17.†
(AS)
G0996.strong_def: aid; specially, a rope or chain for frapping a vessel

G5290.gloss: come again, return (again, back again), turn back (again)
G5290.strong_def: to turn under (behind), i.e. to return (literally or figuratively)

G0720.def:
ἀρνέομαι -οῦμαι, depon.,
[in LXX: Gen.18:15 (כָּחַשׁ pi.), Wis.12:27 16:16 17:10, 4Ma.8:7 4Mac 10:15 * ;]
1. to deny, say no, opposite to είπεῖν: absol., Mat.26:70, Luk.8:45; before ἅτι, 1Jn.2:22; with inf., Heb.11:24
2. In late Gk. (MM, see word), with accusative of person(s), to deny, refuse to acknowledge, disown: Act.3:14 7:35; Ἰησοῦν, Mat.10:33, 2Ti.2:12, 1Jn.2:22, Ju 4; ἑαυτόν, Luk.9:23, 2Ti.2:13 (prove false to)
3. C. accusative of thing(s) (in cl. to refuse), to deny, abjure: 1Ti.5:8, Tit.2:12, 2Ti.3:5 (cf. ἀπαρνέομαι)
(AS)
G0720.strong_def: to contradict, i.e. disavow, reject, abnegate

G3529.strong_def: conquest (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) the means of success

G0459.def:
ἄ-νομος, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νόμος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]

G0459.strong_def: lawless, i.e. (negatively) not subject to (the Jewish) law; (by implication, a Gentile), or (positively) wicked
G0459.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3551 (νόμος);

G2269.def:
Ἠσαῦ, ὁ
indecl. (Heb. עֵשָׂו, Gen.25:25),
Esau: Rom.9:13 (LXX) Heb.11:20 12:16.†

G1021.def:
βραδύς, -εῖα, -ύ,

G1911.def:
ἐπι-βάλλω
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית, etc. ;]
1. trans., to cast, lay or put upon: with accusative and dative, Mrk.11:7, 1Co.7:35; with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, Rev.18:10, WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, Mat.26:50, Luk.20:19 21:12, Jhn.7:30, Act.5:18 21:27; with dative (Polyb.), Mrk.14:46 Act.4:3; with inf., Act.12:1; τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, Luk.9:62; ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, Luk.5:36; ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ, Mat.9:16.
2. Intrans.,
(a) to throw oneself or rush upon: τ. κύματα εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Mrk.4:37; metaphorically, to put one's mind upon (but see Field, Notes, 41 ff.), ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, when he thought thereon (sc. τ. ῥήματι), he wept (EV, txt.; R, mg., he began to weep; cf. M, Pr., 131): Mrk.14:72 (see also Swete, in l);
(b) to fall to one's share: τὸ ἐπιβάλλον (sc. dative; Hdt., a1., a technical formula frequently in π.; Deiss., BS, 230, LAE, 152), Luk.15:12.†
(AS)
G1911.strong_def: to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with G1438 (ἑαυτοῦ) implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to

G4044.derivation: from G4012 (περί) and the base of G4008 (πέραν);

G3592.strong_def: the same, i.e. this or that one (plural these or those); often used as a personal pronoun

G0236.def:
ἀλλάσσω
(ἄλλος), [in LXX chiefly for חָלַף, מוּר hi., etc. ;]

2. to transform: 1Co.15:51-52, Heb.1:12.
3. to exchange: with accusative, before ἐν (= בְּ, Psa.106:20) instead of simple genitive (Bl., § 36, 8), Rom.1:23
(cf. ἀπ-, δι-, κατ-, ἀπο-κατ-, μετ-, συν-αλλάσσω; see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G2112.def:
εὐθέως

straightway, at once, directly: Gal.1:16, Jas.1:24, 3Jn.14 (cf. Dalman, Words, 28 f.), Rev.4:2, and frequently in Mt, Lk, Jo, Ac (in Mk, εὐθύς), which see)
(AS)
G2112.strong_def: directly, i.e. at once or soon

G3960.strong_def: to knock (gently or with a weapon or fatally)

G0367.def:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה),
Ananias;
1. of Jerusalem: Act.5:1, 3 5:5.
2. Of Damascus: Act.9:10-13, 17 22:12.
3. High Priest: Act.23:2 24:1.†
(AS)
G0367.strong_def: Ananias, the name of three Israelites

G2691.def:
κατα-στρηνιάω, -ῶ
to wax wanton against: with genitive, 1Ti.5:11
(AS)

G2355.def:
θρῆνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for קִינָה ;]
a lamentation: Mat.2:18, Rec.†
(AS)

G2083.def:
ἑταῖρος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ and cognate forms, also Sir.11:6 37:2 ff., al. ;]
a companion, comrade: Mat.11:16 (WH, ἑτέροις); voc., as term of address, my friend: Mat.20:13 22:12 26:50.†
(AS)

G3937.derivation: probably by contraction for (a derivative of a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G3306 (μένω));

G3765.gloss: after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not)

G5130.gloss: such, their, these (things), they, this sort, those
G5130.strong_def: of (from or concerning) these (persons or things)
G5130.derivation: genitive case plural masculine or neuter of G3778 (οὗτος);

G0681.def:
ἅπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַע ;]
prop., to fasten to; hence, of fire, to kindle, light: Luk.8:16 11:33 15:8, Act.28:2. Mid., with genitive, to fasten oneself to, cling to, lay hold of (so in π.; MM, see word): Mat.8:3, 15, Jhn.20:17, al.; of carnal intercourse, 1Co.7:1; with reference to levitical and ceremonial prohibitions, 2Co.6:17, Col.2:21; of hostile action, 1Jn.5:18 (cf. ἀν-, καθ-, περι- άπτω)
SYN.: θιγγάνω, ψηλαφάω. ἅ. is the stronger, θ., to touch, the lighter term. ψ. is to feel, as in search of something (Tr., Syn., § xvii; Lft., Col., 201 f.) (AS)
G0681.strong_def: properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire

G3988.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G3982 (πείθω);

G0623.def:
Ἀπολλύων, -οντος, ὁ
(present ptcp. of ἀπολλύω),
Apollyon, i.e. the Destroyer: Rev.9:11 (cf. Ἀβάδδων). (Cremer, 453; DB, i, 125, 172.) †
(AS)

G0088.def:
ἀδιάλειπτος, -ον
(διαλείπω),
unremitting, incessant: Rom.9:2, 2Ti.1:3. (For exx., see MM, VGT, see word) †
(AS)
G0088.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G1223 (διά) and G3007 (λείπω);

G1749.def:
ἔνεδρον, -ου, τό, see: ἐνέδρα.
ἐν-έδρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἕδρα, a seat), [in LXX: Jos.8:7-9, Psa.10:8 (אָרַב)* ;]
a lying in wait, an ambush: Act.23:16 (Rec. ἔνεδρον, a form frequently in LXX), Act.25:8.†
(AS)
G1749.derivation: neuter of the same as G1747 (ἐνέδρα);

G5167.strong_def: akin to G5149 (τρίζω), but denoting a duller sound); a turtle-dove (as cooing)

G0180.def:
ἀκατάπαυστος, -ον
(καταπαύω),
that cannot cease, not to be restrained: with genitive of thing(s), 2Pe.2:14, T, Tr. txt.†
(AS)
G0180.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2664 (καταπαύω);

G3474.strong_def: dull or stupid (as if shut up), i.e. heedless, (morally) blockhead, (apparently) absurd
G3474.derivation: probably from the base of G3466 (μυστήριον);

G1187.def:
δεξιολάβος, -ου, ὁ
(δεξιός, λαμβάνω),
a kind of soldier, prob. a spearman (Vg., lancearius) or slinger: Act.23:23.†
δεξιο-βόλος, -ου, ὁ
(δεξιός, βάλλω),
one who throws with the right hand: L for δεξιολάβος, Act.23:23.†
(AS)
G1187.strong_def: a guardsman (as if taking the right) or light-armed soldier

G2578.def:
κάμπτω
[in LXX chiefly for כָּרַע, 4Ki.1:13, 2Ch.29:29, Isa.45:24 (23), al. ;]
to bend, bow: with accusative of thing(s), γόνυ, τὰ γ.; with dative of person(s), τῇ Βάαλ, Rom.11:4 (LXX); πρὸς τ. πατέρα, Eph.3:14; by meton., πᾶν γόνυ for πᾶς, Rom.14:11 (LXX) Php.2:10 (cf. ἀνα-, συν-κάμπτω).†
(AS)

G0725.def:
ἁρπαγμός, οῦ, ὁ
(ἁρπάζω);
1. prop., accusative, to the rule of its formation (Bl., § 27, 2), actively, the act of seizing, robbery (Plut., Deu Puer. Educ., p. 12A), Php.2:6, AV (Waterland, Works, II, 108; Cremer, 649 f.; Meyer, in l; cf. also JThS, July, 1909, April, 1911; MM, see word).
2. Passively = ἅρπαγμα (Eze.22:25, of a lion's prey, ), a thing seized, hence, a prize: Phi, l.with, RV (Lft., Ellic., ICC, in l; Donaldson, NCrat., 450 ff.; and esp. Gifford, The Incarnation, 59-71, and reff. in DB, ii, 835 B). The lexical data favour the active meaning, but as they also admit the possibility of the alternative, most modern expositors have accepted the latter as seeming to suit the logic of the passage better. The lexical difficulty, however, remains (MM, see word, esp. the last ref.). As to the usage of St. Paul, he seems inclined to adopt the -μα form where it is appropriate (e.g. Rom.11:9, where cf. LXX; 1Co.13:9, 2 Co 19), and there is certainly a presumption in favour of the active meaning here from the fact that he does not use the LXX ἅρπαγμα. Suggestions looking to a fresh exegesis are given in JThS, ll with†
(AS)

G3412.strong_def: Mitylene (or Mytilene), a town on the island of Lesbos

G5463.gloss: farewell, be glad, God speed, greeting, hall, joy(- fully), rejoice
G5463.strong_def: to be "cheer"ful, i.e. calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well

G2645.def:
κατά-λοιπος, -ον
[in LXX for שָׁאַר, שְׁאֵרִית, יָתַר, etc. ;]
left remaining: ἱο κ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, Act.15:17 (LXX).†
(AS)
G2645.strong_def: left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the rest)

G5220.strong_def: in subjection under a man, i.e. a married woman

G0484.def:
ἀντί-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις; see MM, VGT see word; M, Pr., 56), -εως, ἡ
(ἀντιλαμβάνομαι) [in LXX for עֹז, זְרוֹעַ, etc., frequently in Psa.2:1-12,3Mac.; frequently also in π. in petitions to the Ptolemies in sense of βοήθεια (see Deiss., LAE, 107; BS, 92, 223) ;]
1. cl. a laying hold of, an exchange.
2. Hellenistic (LXX, π.) help: pl. of ministrations of deacons; 1Co.12:28 (DB, ii, 347 f.; Cremer, 386).†
(AS)

G1612.def:
ἐκ-στρέφω
[in LXX: Deu.32:20, Amo.6:13 Eze.16:34 A (הָפַךְ), Za 11:16 (פָּרַק pi.), Eze.13:20 (צוּד pi.)* ;]
1. to turn out of (Hom.).
2. to turn inside out; metaphorically, to change entirely, pervert (Aristoph.): Tit.3:11.†
(AS)

G0492.def:
ἀντι-παρ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Wis.16:10 * ;]
to pass by opposite to: Luk.10:31-32 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4578.strong_def: a commotion, i.e. (of the air) a gale, (of the ground) an earthquake

G2451.def:
Ἰουδαϊκός, ή, -όν
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:11 V, 2Ma.13:21 * ;]
Jewish: Tit.1:14.†
(AS)

G3727.strong_def: perhaps akin to G3725 (ὅριον)); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath)

G1375.def:
διωγμός, -oῦ, ὁ
(διώκω), [in LXX: Pro.11:19 (רָדַף pi.), La 3:19 (מָרוּד), 2Ma.12:23 * ;]
persecution: Mat.13:21, Mrk.4:17 10:30 Act.8:1 13:50, Rom.8:35, 2Co.12:10, 2Th.1:4, 2Ti.3:11.†
(AS)

G2447.def:
ἰός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX: Eze.24:6, 11-12 (חֶלְאָה), Psa.140:3 (חֵמָה), al. ;]
1. an arrow.
2. rust (Ez, l.with): Jas.5:3 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).
3. poison: figuratively, Rom.3:13 (Ps. l.with), Jas.3:8.†
(AS)
G2447.strong_def: rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents)

G0208.def:
ἀκυρόω, -ῶ
(κῦρος, authority), [in LXX: 1Es.6:32 Est.6:1-34, 2Ma.6:1-31 * ;]
to revoke, invalidate (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.15:6, Mrk.7:13, Gal.3:17 (Plut.).†
(AS)
G0208.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2964 (κυρόω);

G1793.def:
ἐν-τυγχάνω
[in LXX: Da TH Dan.6:12-13 (קֶרֶב) Wis.8:20 16:28, 2Ma.2:25 2Mac 4:36 2Mac 6:12 2Mac 15:39, 3Ma.6:37; before κατά, 1Ma.8:32 1Mac 10:61-64 1Mac 11:25 * ;]
1. to fall in with.
2. to meet with in order to converse.
3. to petition, make petition: with dative of person(s), before ὑπέρ with genitive of person(s), Act.25:24 (cf. Field, Notes, 140), Heb.7:25, Rom.8:27, 34 (θεῷ, not expressed); before κατά, against: Rom.11:2 (cf. ἔντευξις, ὑπερ-εντυγχάνω).†
(AS)
G1793.strong_def: to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against)

G5600.gloss: + appear, are, (may, might, should) be, X have, is, + pass the flower of her age, should stand, were
G5600.strong_def: (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with G1487 (εἰ) and its comparative, as well as with other particles) be

G4263.strong_def: something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively)
G4263.derivation: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of G4260 (προβαίνω);

G0788.def:
ἆσσον (Rec., after Vg., Ἄσσον),
adv. (compar. of ἄγχι, near),
nearer: Act.27:13 (RV, close in shore; see B1., § 11, 3; 44, 3; poets, Ion, and late prose).†
(AS)
G0788.derivation: neuter comparative of the base of G1451 (ἐγγύς);

G4391.strong_def: to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously

G2723.def:
κατηγορέω, -ῶ
(κατά, ἀγορεύω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:5, (9), 1Ma.7:6 1Mac 7:25, 2Ma.4:47 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:21, 4Ma.9:14 * ;]
to make accusation, accuse,
(a) in general: absol., Rom.2:15; with genitive of person(s) (cl., WM, 254), Jhn.5:45; irreg. with accusative of person(s), Rev.12:10;
(b) before a judge: absol., Act.24:2, 19; with genitive of person(s), Mat.12:10, Mrk.3:2, Luk.6:7 11:54 (WH, txt., R, om.), Luk.23:2, 10, Jhn.8:6 Act.25:5 28:19; id. with accusative of thing(s) (cl., but see WM, l.with), Mrk.15:3-4; with genitive of thing(s) (Dem.), Act.24:8 25:11; before περί, with genitive of thing(s) (Thuc., viii, 85), Act.24:13; with accusative of thing(s), before κατά with genitive of person(s) (WM, § 28, 1), Luk.23:14. Pass. (B1., § 54, 3), before ὑπό with genitive, Mat.27:12, Act.22:30; ὁ κατηγορούμενος, Act.25:16.†

G2161.def:
Εὔτυχος, -ου, ὁ
(εὖ, τυχή),
Butychus, a young man: Act.20:9.†
(AS)
G2161.strong_def: well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man
G2161.derivation: from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G5177 (τυγχάνω);

G2374.def:
θύρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for פֶּתַח, also for דַּל, דֶּלֶת, etc. ;]
a door: κλείειν (ἀποκ-) τὴν θ., Mat.6:6, Luk.13:25; pass., Mat.25:10, Luk.11:7, Jhn.20:19, 26, Act.21:30; ἀνοίγειν, Act.5:19; pass., Act.16:26-27; κρούειν, Act.12:13; διὰ τῆς θ., Jhn.10:1-2; πρὸς τὴν θ., Mrk.1:33 11:4 (WH om. τήν), Act.3:2; τὰ πρὸς τὴν θ., the space by the door, Mrk.2:2; πρὸς τῇ θ., Jhn.18:16; ἐπὶ τῇ θ, Act.5:9; πρὸ τῆς θ., Act.12:6; ἐπὶ τῶν θ., Act.5:23; ἡ θ. τ. μνημείου, Mat.27:60, Mrk.15:46 16:3. Metaphorical, of Christ, ἡ θ. τ. προβάτων, Jhn.10:7, 9; of the Kingdom of Heaven, Luk.13:24; of opportunities, θ. πίστεως, Act.14:27; θ. μεγάλη, 1Co.16:9; θ. τ. λόγου, Col.4:3; θ. ἀνεῳγμένη (ἠνεῳγ-), 2Co.2:12, Rev.3:8 4:1; of Christ, ἑστηκὼς ἐπὶ τὴν θ. καὶ κρούων, Rev.3:20; of his second coming, ἐπὶ θύραις εἶναι, Mat.24:33, Mrk.13:29; πρὸ θυρῶν ἑστηκέναι, Jas.5:9.†
(AS)
G2374.strong_def: a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively)

G3961.derivation: from a derivative probably of G3817 (παίω) (meaning a "path");

G0677.def:
ἀπρόσκοπος, -ον
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.32:21, 3Ma.3:8 * ;]
1. act., not causing to stumble: metaphorically, of not leading others into sin, 1Co.10:32.
2. Pass., not stumbling, without offence, blameless: Act.24:16, Php.1:10 (for exx., see MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0677.strong_def: actively, inoffensive, i.e. not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. not led into sin
G0677.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4350 (προσκόπτω);

G0321.def:
ἀν-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi. ;]
to lead or bring up: before είς, with accusative loc., Mat.4:1, Luk.2:22 4:5 (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), Act.9:39 16:34; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, Rom.10:7, Heb.13:20; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, Act.12:4 (MM, VGT, see word); in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν, Act.7:41. Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), to put to sea: Luk.8:22, Act.13:13 16:11 18:21 20:3, 13 21:1-2 27:2, 4 27:12, 21 28:10-11 (cf.ἐπ-ανάγω).†
(AS)
G0321.strong_def: to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away

G1316.def:
δια-χωρίζω
[in LXX: Gen.1:4 ff (בָּדַל hi.), Gen.13:9 ff. (פָּרַד ni.), etc. ;]
to separate entirely. Mid., to separate oneself, depart: before ἀπό Luk.9:33.†
(AS)
G1316.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the middle voice of G5563 (χωρίζω);

G4537.strong_def: to trumpet, i.e. sound a blast (literally or figuratively)

G0836.def:
αὐλός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἄω, to blow), [in LXX chiefly for חָלִיל ;]
a pipe: 1Co.14:7.†
(AS)

G3674.strong_def: akin to G260 (ἅμα)) as adverb; at the same place or time

G2889.def:
κόσμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Gen.2:1, Deu.4:19 17:3, Isa.24:21 40:26 (צבא), Exo.33:5, 6 Jer.2:32 4:30, Eze.7:20 16:11 23:40 (עֲדִי), Isa.61:10 (כְּלִי), al., Wis.2:24 and freq., Sir.6:30, al ;]
1. order (Hom., Plat., al.).
2. ornament, adornment, esp. of women (Hom., al.): 1Pe.3:3.
3. Later, the world or universe, as an ordered system (Plat., al.): Act.17:24, Rom.4:13, 1Co.3:22, Php.2:15, Heb.4:3, al.
4. In late writers only, the world, i.e. the earth (= ἡ οἰκουμένη, cf. Mat.4:8 with Luk.4:5): Mat.4:8, Mrk.16:[15], Col.2:20, 1Ti.6:7, al.; hence by meton.,
(a) of the human inhabitants of the world: Mat.5:14 15:38, Mrk.14:9, Jhn.1:10 4:42 12:47, Rom.3:6, 1Co.4:13, 2Co.5:19, 2Pe.2:5, al.;
(b) of worldly affairs or possessions: Mat.16:26, Mrk.8:36, Luk.9:25, 1Co.7:31, 1Jn.2:16, al.;
(with) in ethical sense, of the ungodly: Jhn.7:7 14:17, 27 1Co.1:21, Jas.1:27, 1Jn.4:4, al.;
(d) metaphorically: ὁ κ. τῆς ἀδικίας, Jas.3:6.
SYN.: αἰών, which see (cf . also Dalman, Words, 162ff.; Tr., Syn., §lix; Westc., additional note on Jhn.1:10; DB, iv, 938ff.). (AS)
G2889.strong_def: orderly arrangement, i.e. decoration; by implication, the world (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally))
G2889.derivation: probably from the base of G2865 (κομίζω);
