G5535.strong_def: to make (i.e. have) necessity, i.e. be in want of

G5321.strong_def: exhibition, i.e. (figuratively) expression, (by extension) a bestowment

G2193.strong_def: a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place)

G0113.def:
ἄθεσμος, -ον
(θεσμός, law, custom), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:12 6:26 * ;]
lawless, esp. of those who violate the law of nature and conscience (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 2Pe.2:7 3:17.†
SYN.: ἀθέμιτος, ἄνομος, κακός, πονηρός, φαῦλος (see Tr., Syn., §lxxiv; DCG, ii, 821b). (AS)
G0113.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι) (in the sense of enacting);

G5110.strong_def: interest on money loaned (as a produce)

G0921.def:
Βαρναβᾶς, -α, ὁ (Aram. בַּר, son, as prefix to another word interpreted in Act.4:36, τῆς παρακλήσεως, perh. נְבוּאָה, wh., however, should be rendered by προφητεία as in II Est.6:14, LXX. Deiss., BS, 309f., thinks Β. may be a variant of the name Βαρνεβοῦς, son of Nebo, found in a Syrian Inscr., altered with a view to disguising its origin; see also Milligan, NTD, iii; Dalman, Gr., 142),
Barnabas: Act.4:36 9:27 11:22, 30 12:25 13-15, 1Co.9:6, Gal.2:1, 9 13, Col.4:10.†
(AS)
G0921.strong_def: son of Nabas (i.e. prophecy); Barnabas, an Israelite

G1491.def:
εἶδος, -ους, τό,
[in LXX for מַרְאֶה,, etc. ;]
1. that which is seen, appearance, external form: Luk.3:22 9:29, Jhn.5:37, 2Co.5:7 (ICC in l.).
2. form, sort, kind: 1Th.5:22.
† (AS)
G1491.strong_def: a view, i.e. form (literally or figuratively)

G2403.def:
Ἰεζάβελ (L, Ἰεζ-; Tr. -βέλ; Rec. -βήλ) ἡ, indecl. (Heb. אִיזֶבֶל; LXX as txt.; FlJ, Ἰεζαβέλη),
Jezebel (3Ki.16:31, al.): symbolically, Rev.2:20 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)
G2403.strong_def: Jezabel (i.e. Jezebel), a Tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher)

G3444.derivation: perhaps from the base of G3313 (μέρος) (through the idea of adjustment of parts);

G0187.def:
ἀκμάζω
(ἀκμήν), [in LXX: 4Ma.2:3 * ;]
to be at the prime; of produce of the ground, to be ripe (Thuc.): Rev.14:18 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0187.strong_def: to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature

G2057.def:
Ἑρμᾶς, -ᾶ, accusative, -ᾶν (Doric form of Ἑρμῆς),
Hermas, a Christian: Rom.16:14.†
(AS)

G2148.def:
Εὐρ-ακύλων (Rec. εὐροκλύδων, which see), -ωνος
(Εὖρος, the East wind, and Lat. Aquilo; Vg., Euroaquilo),
the Euraquilo, a N.E. wind (i.e. between Eurus and Aquilo): Act.27:14.†
εὐρο-κλύδων (G, εὐροκλ-), -ωνος, ὁ
(Εὖρος (seel. εὐρύς, broad), κλύδων),
Euroclydon (prob. a sailor's corruption of Εὐρακύλων, which see): Act.17:14, Rec,†
(AS)
G2148.strong_def: a storm from the East (or southeast), i.e. (in modern phrase) a Levanter

G5338.derivation: probably akin to the base of G5457 (φῶς) (compare G5350 (φθέγγομαι));

G1058.def:
Γαλλίων, -ωνος, ὁ,
Gallio, proconsul of Achaia: Act.18:12, 14 17.†
(AS)

G1309.def:
δια-φεύγω
[in LXX: Jos.8:22 (פָּלִיט), Jos.10:28 (שָׂרִיד), etc. ;]
to flee through, escape: Act.27:42.†
(AS)

G2859.def:
κόλπος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חֵיק ;]
1. prop., the bosom: Jhn.13:23; fig., of close association, ἐν (εἰς τὸν) τοῖς κ. Ἀβραάμ, Luk.16:22-23 (cf. 4Ma.13:16); ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κ. τ. πατρός, Jhn.1:18
2. The bosom or fold of a loose garment falling over a girdle, used as a pocket, hence figuratively, εἰς τὸν κ. Isa.65:6, Jer.32:18 : Luk.6:38
3. A bosom-like hollow, as a bay or gulf: Act.27:39.†
(AS)
G2859.strong_def: the bosom; by analogy, a bay

G1702.def:
ἐμ-παίζω
[in LXX for עָלַל hithp., שָׂחַק, etc. ;]
= Attic προσ-, καταπαίζω,
to mock at, mock (Hdt.): with dative, Mat.27:29, 31, Mrk.15:20, Luk.14:29 22:63 23:36; pass., Mat.2:16, Luk.18:32; absol., Mat.20:19 27:41, Mrk.10:34 15:31, Luk.23:11.†
(AS)

G4797.gloss: confound, confuse, stir up, be in an uproar
G4797.strong_def: to commingle promiscuously, i.e. (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind)
G4797.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and (to pour) or its alternate;

G3194.strong_def: Melita, an island in the Mediterranean

G3996.strong_def: to grieve (the feeling or the act)

G4127.strong_def: a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a calamity

G2742.def:
καύσων, -ωνος, ὁ
(καίω), [in LXX: Gen.31:40 א (חֹרֶב), Isa.49:10 (שָׁרָב), Job.27:21, Hos.12:1, (2), Hos.13:15, Jon.4.8, Jer.18:17, Eze.17:10 19:12 (קָדִים); Jer.51:1, From Theodotion Dan.3:67) Jdth.8:3, Sir.18:16 34:16 43:22 * ;]
1. burning heat (Ge, Isa (?), Jth, ll.with, Sir.18:16): Mat.20:12, Luk.12:55 (Jas.1:11, AV).
2. a hot wind from the east (Heb. קָדִים, see LXX, ll.with), the modern sirocco (see CGT on Amo.4:9): Jas.1:11 (RV, the scorching wind; cf. R, mg., the hot wind, Mt, Lk, ll.with).†
(AS)

G1680.def:
ἐλπίς
(ἑλ-, Rom.8:20, WH, see Bl., § 4, 3; M, Pr., 44), -ίδος, ἡ [in LXX for בָּטַח and its derivatives, תִּקְוָה (frequently in Jb), etc. ;]
expectation (in cl., rarely of evil, mostly of good, and so always in NT), hope;
1. of hope in general: 2Co.1:6; with genitive obj., Act.16:19; art. inf., Act.27:20, 1Co.9:10; παρ᾽ ἐλπίδα, Rom.4:18; ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, 1Co.9:10.
2. Of religious hope: ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, Act.2:26 26:6, Rom.4:18 8:20, Tit.1:2; τῇ ἐ. ἐσώθημεν, Rom.8:24; κατ᾽ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου, Tit.3:7; of the Messianic hope of Israel, Act.23:6 26:6-7 28:20; of Christian hope, Rom.5:2-5 12:12 15:4, 13, 1Co.13:13, 2Th.2:16, Heb.3:6 6:11 7:19 10:23, 1Pe.1:3 1:21 3:15; with genitive obj., Rom.5:2, Col.1:27, 1Th.1:3 5:8, Tit.1:2; with genitive of that on which the hope is based, Act.26:6, Eph.1:18 4:4, Col.1:23; ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἐ., Rom.15:13; ἔχειν ἐ. (= cl. ἐλπίζειν), Act.24:15, Rom.15:4, 2Co.3:12 10:15, Eph.2:12, 1Th.4:13; before ἐπί, with dative, 1Jn.3:3; εἰς, Act.24:15; ὅτι, Rom.8:20, Php.1:20-21. Meton.,
(a) of the author or ground of hope (cl.): 1Th.2:19, 1Ti.1:1; with genitive obj., Col.1:27;
(b) of the thing hoped for: Gal.5:5, Col.1:5, Tit.2:13, Heb.6:18 (Cremer, 252, 712).†
(AS)
G1680.derivation: from a primary (to anticipate, usually with pleasure);

G4362.strong_def: to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross)

G1751.def:
ἔν-ειμι
1. to be in, within (Job.27:3, al.): ptcp. pl., τὰ ἐνόντα, Luk.11:41 (R, txt., cf. MM, Exp., xii).
2. to be possible: Luk.11:41 (R, mg.).†
(AS)

G1968.def:
ἐπι-πίπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
to fall upon (Field, Notes, 25): with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:10 (see Swete, in l), Act.20:10; before ἐπὶ τ. τράχηλον (as Gen.46:29, Tob.11:8, 3Ma.5:49, al.), Luk.15:20, Act.20:37. Metaphorical, φόβος, Luk.1:12, Act.19:17, Rev.11:11; ὀνειδισμοί, Rom.15:3 (LXX); of the Holy Spirit: before ἐπί, with dative, Act.8:16; ἐπί, with accusative, Act.10:44 11:15; absol., Act.23:7.†
(AS)
G1968.strong_def: to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively)

G0336.def:
ἀν-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναιρέω), [in LXX: Num.11:15 (הָרַג), Jdg.15:17 (רָמָה), Jdth.15:4, 2Ma.5:13 * ;]
1. a taking up or away (Thuc.).
2. a destroying, slaying, murder (Field, Notes, 116; MM, VGT, see word): Act.8:1.†
(AS)

G3723.strong_def: in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally)

G2450.def:
Ἰουδαΐζω
(Ἰουδαῖος), [in LXX: Est.8:17 (יָהַד hith.)* ;]
to can-form to Jewish practice, to Judaize: Gal.2:14.†
(AS)

G1106.strong_def: cognition, i.e. (subjectively) opinion, or (objectively) resolve (counsel, consent, etc.)

G0126.def:
ἀΐδιος, -ον
(ἀεί), [in LXX: Wis.7:26, 4Ma.10:15 * ;]
everlasting (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word): Rom.1:20, Ju 6.†
SYN.: αἰώνιος, also frequently in Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 363 J. The etymological distinction between the meanings of the two words seems not to be retained in late Greek (see Thayer, see word, αἰώνιος; cf. Cremer, 79, 611). (AS)
G0126.strong_def: everduring (forward and backward, or forward only)

G3377.strong_def: to disclose (through the idea of mental effort and thus calling to mind), i.e. report, declare, intimate
G3377.derivation: probably from the same base as G3145 (μασσάομαι) and G3415 (μνάομαι) (i.e. , to strive);

G4921.strong_def: to set together, i.e. (by implication) to introduce (favorably), or (figuratively) to exhibit; intransitively, to stand near, or (figuratively) to constitute
G4921.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and G2476 (ἵστημι) (including its collateral forms);

G3656.strong_def: to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to converse

G2620.def:
κατα-καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX: Zec.10:12 (הָלַךְ hith.), Jer.50:11 (עָלַז), Jer.50:38 (הָלַל)* ;]
1. to boast against, exult over: with genitive, Rom.11:18, Jas.2:13; before κατά, with genitive, Jas.3:14 (T, om. κατά).
2. before ἐν, to glory in (Za., l.with, Jer.27:38).†
(AS)

G0529.def:
ἀπάντησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπαντάω), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, to meet: Mat.25:6 27:32 (WH, txt., omits), Act.28:15, 1Th.4:17 (see M, Th., in l; M, Pr., 14, 242; MM, VGT, see word; Lft., Notes, 69).†
(AS)

G2365.def:
θυγάτριον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of θυγάτηρ),
a little daughter, a term of endearment used in late Gk. (cf. B1., § 27, 4): Mrk.5:23 7:25.†
(AS)

G2402.def:
ἱδρώς
(Tr. -ῶς), -ῶτος, ὁ [in LXX: Gen.3:19 (זֵעָה), 2Ma.2:29, 4Ma.7:8 * ;]
sweat: Luk.22:44 (WH, omit).†
(AS)
G2402.derivation: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat);

G1240.def:
διά-δοχος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
(διαδέχομαι), [in LXX: 1Ch.18:17 (לְיַד), 2Ch.26:11 (שַׂר) 28:7 (מִשְׁנֶה), Sir.46:1 48:8, 2Ma.4:29 14:26 * ;]
a successor: Act.24:27 (for usage in LXX and π. in sense of court official, see Deiss., BS, 115).†
(AS)

G0661.def:
ἀπο-τίνω (or -τίω)
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם pi. ;]
to pay off, repay: Phm 19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0730.def:
ἄρσην (ἄρρην, T, in Rom.1:27; Rec. in Rev.12:5, 13) -ενος, ὁ, ἡ, ἄρσεν, τό
(old Attic for ἄρρην, see supr.; both forms are found in π.; MM, see word), [in LXX chiefly for זָכָר ;]
male: Mat.19:4, Mrk.10:6, Luk.2:23, Rom.1:27, Gal.3:28, Rev.12:5, 13.†
(AS)

G4798.strong_def: to use jointly, i.e. (by implication) to hold intercourse in common

G3308.derivation: from G3307 (μερίζω) (through the idea of distraction);

G0870.def:
ἀφόβως
adv. (φόβος), [in LXX: Pro.1:33 (פַּחַד), Wis.17:4 * ;]
without fear: Luk.1:74, Php.1:14, 1Co.16:10, Ju 12.†
(AS)
G0870.derivation: adverb from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5401 (φόβος);

G2300.def:
θεάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX; 2Ch.22:6 (רָאָה), Tob.2:2 13:6, 14, Jdth.15:8, 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 3:36, 3Ma.5:47 * ;]
to behold, look upon, contemplate, view (in early writers with a sense of wondering), in NT apparently always in literal, physical sense of "careful and deliberate vision which interprets . . . its object": with accusative of thing(s), Mat.11:7, Luk.7:24 23:55, Jhn.1:14, 32 4:35 11:45, Act.22:9, 1Jn.1:1; with accusative of person(s), Mat.22:11, Act.21:27, Rom.15:24, 1Jn.4:12; with ptcp., Mrk.16:14, Luk.5:27, Jhn.1:38, Act.1:11; before ὅτι, Jhn.6:5, 1Jn.4:14; pass., Mat.6:1 23:5, Mrk.16:11.†
SYN.: see: θεωρέω (AS)
G2300.strong_def: to look closely at, i.e. (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit
G2300.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb;

G3586.strong_def: timber (as fuel or material); by implication, a stick, club or tree or other wooden article or substance
G3586.derivation: from another form of the base of G3582 (ξέστης);

G2175.def:
εὐωδία, -ας, ἡ
(εὐώδης, fragrant; ὄζω) [in LXX for נִיחוֹחַ, Gen.8:21, al. (ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας); Sir.20:9 24:15, al. ;]
fragrance: metaphorically, Χριστοῦ εὐ,., 2Co.2:15; ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας (a metaphor of sacrifice, most frequently in Pent. and Ez.), Eph.5:2, Php.4:18.†
(AS)
G2175.derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G3605 (ὄζω);

G0617.def:
ἀπο-κυλίω
(see: κυλίω), [in LXX: Gen.29:3, 8 29:10 (גָּלַל) Jdth.13:9 * ;]
to roll away: Mat.28:2, Mrk.16:3, Luk.24:2.†
(AS)

G4521.strong_def: the Sabbath (i.e. Shabbath), or day of weekly repose from secular avocations (also the observance or institution itself); by extension, a se'nnight, i.e. the interval between two Sabbaths; likewise the plural in all the above applications

G4530.derivation: probably from the same as G4531 (σαλεύω);

G3998.derivation: prolongation from the base of G3993 (πένης);

G1049.def:
γαζο-φυλάκιον, -ου, τό
(γάζα, φυλακή), [in LXX chiefly for לִשְׁכָּה, נִשְׁכָּה (4Ki.23:11, al.), once for גְּנָזִים (Est.3:9); το͂ γ., τᾶ γ., of a temple treasury, Neh.10:37, 2Ma.3:6, al. ;]
treasury: also, apparently, the trumpet-shaped chests into which the peoples' temple-offerings were thrown (DB, iv, 96; DCG, ii, 748): Mrk.12:41, 43 Luk.21:1, Jhn.8:20.†
(AS)
G1049.strong_def: a treasure-house, i.e. a court in the temple for the collection-boxes

G1995.def:
ἐπι-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιστρέφω) [in LXX: Eze.47:7 (שׁוּב), Sir.18:21 49:2, etc. ;]
a turning about; metaphorically, conversion (Field, Notes, 246): Act.15:3.†
(AS)

G4407.strong_def: pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal

G1211.def:
δή
consecutive co-ordinating particle with no exact equiv. in Eng., giving greater exactness and emphasis to the word or words to which it is attached; sometimes translatable as now therefore, then, verily, certainly.
1. With verbs: imperat., Act.6:3 (WH, mg.) 13:2, 1Co.6:20; hort. subjc., Luk.2:15, Act.15:36; indic., δή που (Τ, δήπου, which see), Heb.2:16.
2. With pronouns: ὃ δή, now this is he who, Mat.13:23.†
(AS)
G1211.strong_def: a particle of emphasis or explicitness; now, then, etc.

G2831.def:
κλυδωνίζομαι
(κλύδων), [in LXX: Isa.57:20 (גָּרַשׁ)* ;]
to be tossed by waves; metaphorically, to be tossed like waves (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 11, 3): Eph.4:14.†
(AS)

G4272.strong_def: to give before the other party has given

G5138.derivation: perhaps strengthened from the base of G4486 (ῥήγνυμι) (as if jagged by rents);

G3879.strong_def: to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within)

G0188.def:
ἀκμήν, accusative of ἀκμή,
a point, used as adv., at the present point of time, even now, even yet: Mat.15:16.†
(AS)
G0188.derivation: accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to (a point) and meaning the same;

G0821.def:
ἀτιμόω, -ῶ
(ἄτιμος), [in LXX chiefly for בָּזָה ;]
= ἀτιμάζω, to dishonour, treat with indignity: Mrk.12:4, Rec.†
(AS)

G0951.def:
βεβαίωσις, -εως, ἡ
(βεβαιόω, which see), [in LXX: Lev.25:23 (צְמִיתֻת), Wis.6:19 * ;]
confirmation: τ. εὐαγγελίου, Php.1:7; εἰς β., Heb.6:16, a phrase frequently in π. of guarantee in a business transaction (Deiss., BS, 104ff.; Cremer, 140).†
(AS)

G3829.strong_def: all-receptive, i.e. a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan)
G3829.derivation: neuter of a presumed compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of G1209 (δέχομαι);

G2067.def:
ἔσθησις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: pl., 2Ma.3:33, 3Ma.1:16 * ;]
clothing: pl., Act.1:10.†
(AS)

G1003.def:
Βοός and Βοές (RV, Βοάζ, Rec. Βοόζ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֹּעַז),
Boaz (Rut.2:1): Mat.1:5, Luk.3:32.†
(AS)

G2034.def:
ἐπτάκις
adv.,
seven times: Mat.18:21-22, Luk.17:4.†
(AS)

G0198.def:
ἀκριβόω, -ῶ
(ἀκριβής), [in Aq.: Isa.30:8 49:16 * ;]
to enquire with exactness, learn carefully: Mat.2:7, 16 (for similar ex., see MM, VGT, sv.).†
(AS)

G2312.def:
θεο-δίδακτος, -ον
taught of God (cf. διδακτοὶ θεοῦ, Jhn.6:45): 1Th.4:9.†
(AS)

G5295.strong_def: to run under, i.e. (specially), to sail past
G5295.derivation: from G5259 (ὑπό) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);

G5058.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G5057 (τελώνης);

G5035.strong_def: shortly, i.e. without delay, soon, or (by surprise) suddenly, or (by implication, of ease) readily

G0077.def:
ἀδάπανος, -ον
(δαπάνη),
without expense, free of charge: 1Co.9:18.†
(AS)

G0137.def:
Αἰνών, ἡ, indecl. (cf. Heb.עַיִן, a spring),
Aenon: Jhn.3:23.†
(AS)
G0137.derivation: of Hebrew origin (a derivative of G5869, place of springs);

G2846.def:
κοιτών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(κοίτη = Att.., δωμότιον, see Kennedy, Sources, 40), [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר, 2Ki.4:7, Jol.2:16; I Est.3:3, al. ;]
a bed-chamber; ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ κ., a chamberlain: Act.12:20.†
(AS)

G4539.derivation: probably of Hebrew origin (feminine from H07965);

G2746.def:
καύχησις, -εως, ἡ
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX for תִּפְאָרָה (1Ch.29:13, Eze.16:12, al) ;]
a boasting, glorying: Rom.3:27, 2Co.11:10 11:17, Jas.4:16; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.7:4 8:24; ἐτί, with genitive, 2Co.7:14; ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., Rom.15:17; στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), 1Th.2:19; of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), 2Co.1:12.†
(AS)
G2746.strong_def: boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense

G0662.def:
ἀπο-τολμάω, -ῶ
to be quite bold, make a bold venture: Rom.10:20.†
(AS)

G0654.def:
ἀπο-στρέφω
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
trans., with accusative,
(a) to turn away, remove: Rom.11:26, 2Ti.4:4; metaphorically, to turn away from allegiance, pervert: Luk.23:14;
(b) to turn back, return: μάχαιραν, Mat.26:52. Pass., reflex., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, Mat.5:42, 2Ti.1:15, Tit.1:14, Heb.12:25; so act., absol., Act.3:26 (cf. Sir.8:5; Bl., § 53, 1; Cremer, 880).†
(AS)
G0654.strong_def: to turn away or back (literally or figuratively)

G0940.def:
βασκαίνω,
[in LXX: Deu.28:54, 56 (רעע), Sir.14:6, 8*.]
1. to slander (Dem.).
2. to blight by the evil eye, to fascinate, bewitch: Gal.3:1.
† (AS)
G0940.strong_def: to malign, i.e. (by extension) to fascinate (by false representations)

G0633.def:
ἀπο-νίπτω
[in LXX for שָׁטַף, רָחַץ, מָחָה ;]
to wash off: mid. (reflex.), τ. χεῖρας, Mat.27:24.†
(AS)
G0633.strong_def: to wash off (reflexively, one's own hands symbolically)

G4077.strong_def: a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring)
G4077.derivation: probably from G4078 (πήγνυμι) (through the idea of gushing plumply);

G5487.strong_def: to grace, i.e. indue with special honor

G1976.def:
ἐπι-ράπτω (Rec. -ρράπτω),
to sew upon: before ἐπί, with accusative, Mrk.2:21.†
(AS)
G1976.strong_def: to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle
G1976.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G4476 (ῥαφίς);

G3761.gloss: neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as
G3761.strong_def: not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even

G2781.def:
κηρίον, -ου, τό
(κηρός, wax), [in LXX for נֹפֶת, צוּף, Psa.19:10 118:12, Pro.16:24, al. ;]
honeycomb: κ. μελίσσιον, Luk.24:42 (Rec.; WH, txt., R, txt., omit).†
(AS)
G2781.strong_def: a cell for honey, i.e. (collectively) the comb

G2598.def:
κατα-βάλλω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל hi. ;]
1. to cast down, prostrate: metaphorically, pass., 2Co.4:9.
2. to put down, lay down: metaphorically, mid., with accusative, θεμέλιον, Heb.6:1.†
(AS)

G3686.derivation: from a presumed derivative of the base of G1097 (γινώσκω) (compare G3685 (ὀνίνημι));

G3707.strong_def: gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen

G0218.def:
ἀλείφω
(cf. λίπος, oil), [in LXX: Gen.31:13, Exo.40:15, Num.3:3 (מָשַׁח), Eze.13:10 ff. (טוּחַ), Rut.3:3, 2Ki.12:20 14:2, 4Ki.4:2, 2Ch.28:15, Mic.6:15, Dan LXX TH Dan.10:3 (סוּךְ), Est.2:12, Jdth.16:8 * ;]
to anoint, festally or in homage: with accusative of thing(s) or of person(s), Mat.6:17, Jhn.12:3, Mrk.16:1; before dative, ἐλαίῳ, Mrk.6:13, Jas.5:14; μύρῳ, Luk.7:38, 46, Jhn.11:2.†
SYN.: χρίω, μυρίζω (against the distinction made bet. ἀ. and χ. in Tr., Syn., § 38, see MM, VGT, see word, ἀ.) (AS)
G0218.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as particle of union) and the base of G3045 (λιπαρός);

G1138.def:
Δαυείδ (Rec. Δαβίδ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. דָּוִד),
David, King of Israel: Mat.1:6; 12:3, and al.; σκηνὴ Δ., Act.15:16; κλεὶς Δ., Rev.3:7; θρόνος Δ., Luk.1:32; ῥίζα Δ., Rev.5:5; βασιλεία Δ., Mrk.11:10; υἱὸς Δ., the Messiah (Ps. Sol., 17:23; for other reff. in Jewish lit., see Dalman, Words, 317), Mat.1:1 9:27, and al.; ἐν Δ., i.e. the Psalter, Heb.4:7
(AS)

G4919.strong_def: to crush together, i.e. (figuratively) to dispirit

G5010.strong_def: regular arrangement, i.e. (in time) fixed succession (of rank or character), official dignity

G3877.gloss: attain, follow, fully know, have understanding
G3877.strong_def: to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to

G2214.def:
ζήτησις, -εως, ἡ
(ζητέω).
1. a seeking, search.
2. a questioning, inquiry, debate: Act.15:2, 7, 2Ti.2:23, Tit.3:9; before περί, Jhn.3:26, Act.25:20, 1Ti.6:4.†
(AS)
G2214.strong_def: a searching (properly, the act), i.e. a dispute or its theme

G1090.def:
γεωργέω, -ῶ
(γεωργός), [in LXX: 1Ch.27:26 (עָשָׂה מְלֶאכֶת הַשָּׂדֶה), I Est.4:6, 1Ma.14:8 * ;]
to till the ground: pass., Heb.6:7.
(AS)

G0408.strong_def: man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite

G1690.def:
ἐμ-βριμάομαι (T, -έομαι; Bl., § 22, 1), -ῶμαι
(βρίμη, strength, bulk, whence βριμάομαι, to snort with anger),
depon., with aor. mid. and pass.,
[in LXX (Hatch, Essays, 25): Dan LXX 11:30 (also Aq., Psa.7:12; Sm., Isa.17:13) * ;]
to snort in (of horses, Æsch.), hence, to speak or act with deep feeling (DCG, i, 62b);
(a) to be moved with anger (cf. ἐμβρίμημα, La 2:6): with dative, Mrk.14:5, Jhn.11:33; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Jhn.11:38;
(b) to admonish sternly: with dative, Mat.9:30, Mrk.1:43.†
(AS)
G1690.strong_def: to have indignation on, i.e. (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin, (specially) to sternly enjoin
G1690.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and (to snort with anger);

G4280.strong_def: used as alternate of G4277 (προέπω); to say already, predict

G3763.gloss: neither at any time, never, nothing at any time
G3763.strong_def: not even at any time, i.e. never at all

G4741.strong_def: to set fast, i.e. (literally) to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or (figuratively) to confirm
G4741.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G2476 (ἵστημι) (like G4731 (στερεός));

G1648.def:
Ἐλεάζαρ(Heb. אֶלְעָזָר), ὁ, indecl.,
Eleazar: Mat.1:15.†
(AS)

G1904.def:
ἐπ-έρχομαι,
[in LXX for בּוֹא, עָבַר, etc. ;]
1. to come to, arrive, come on: before ἀπό, with genitive loc., Act.14:19 (ἐπῆλθαν; cf. M, Pr., 65; Deiss., BS, 191); of time, Eph.2:7.
2. to come upon (as in Hom.): of calamities, Luk.21:26, Act.8:24 13:40, Jas.5:1; of an enemy, Luk.11:22; of the Holy Spirit, Luk.1:35, Act.1:8, [in LXX: γίγνομαι ἐπί, Jdg.14:6, 3Ki.11:6, al.].†
(AS)
G1904.strong_def: to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence

G0049.def:
ἁγνισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (> ἁγνίζω),
[in LXX: Num.6:5 (נֵזֶר) 8:7 19:17 (חַטָּאָה), etc. ;]
purification: in ceremonial sense, Act.21:26 (LXX).†
(AS)

G3726.strong_def: to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin

G3049.gloss: conclude, (ac-)count (of), + despise, esteem, impute, lay, number, reason, reckon, suppose, think (on)
G3049.strong_def: to take an inventory, i.e. estimate (literally or figuratively)

G0461.def:
ἀν-ορθόω, -ῶ
(ἀνά, ὀρθόω, to set straight, set up), [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן hi. ;]
to set upright or straight again, restore: of persons, Luk.13:13, Heb.12:12; of things, σκηνήν, Act.15:16 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 807).†
(AS)
G0461.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of the base of G3717 (ὀρθός);

G4265.strong_def: to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance

G3364.gloss: any more, at all, by any (no) means, neither, never, no (at all), in no case (wise), nor ever, not (at all, in any wise)
G3364.strong_def: a double negative strengthening the denial; not at all

G2966.strong_def: a limb of the body (as if lopped)

G2186.strong_def: to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal);

G0116.def:
Ἀθῆναι, -ῶν, αἱ (plural because consisting of several parts),
Athens: Act.17:15,16 18:1, 1Th.3:1.†
(AS)
G0116.derivation: plural of (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city);

G5327.strong_def: a gap or chasm, i.e. ravine (winter-torrent)
G5327.derivation: properly, strengthened from the base of G4008 (πέραν) or rather of G4486 (ῥήγνυμι);

G4348.strong_def: a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy

G0667.def:
ἀπο-φέρω
[in LXX for הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
to carry off, bear, or lead away: with accusative, Mrk.15:1, 1Co.16:3, Rev.17:3 21:10. Pass., Luk.16:22, Act.19:12.†
(AS)

G2187.def:
Ἐφραίμ, (-ΐμ, Tr.)
Ephraim, a town near Jerusalem: Jhn.11:54.†
(AS)
G2187.derivation: of Hebrew origin (H0669 or better H06085);

G0546.def:
ἀπειλέω, -ῶ (ἀπειλή)
[in LXX: Nam.1:4 (גָּעַר), Isa.66:14 (זָעַם), Sir.19:17, al. ;]
to threaten: 1Pe.2:23; mid., Act.4:17 (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. προσαπειλέω).†
(AS)
G0546.strong_def: to menace; by implication, to forbid

G1445.def:
Ἑβραῖος (WH, Ἐβ-), -α, -ον (Aram, עִבְרַי), as subst., ὁ Ἑ.,
[in LXX for עֵבֶר, עִבְרִי ;]
a Hebrew.
1. In OT, of Israelites in contrast with those of another race (Gen.14:13, Exo.1:15, Deu.15:12, al.).
2. In NT as the correlative of Ἑλληνιστής, a Jew who had adopted, in greater or less degree, Greek culture and Greek language. The distinction was not merely linguistic (DB, ii, 325); as far as it was so, Συριστής would be a more correct Greek term for the Jew of Semitic speech (see: Ἑβραΐς, and cf. Dalman, Words, 7): Act.6:1, 2Co.11:22, Php.3:5.
† (AS)

G0268.def:
ἁμαρτωλός, -όν
(ἁμαρτάνω), [in LXX chiefly for רָשָׁע ;]
sinful, a sinner: of all men, 1Ti.1:15; of those especially wicked, 1Ti.1:9, 1Pe.4:18; p1., Mat.9:10-13 11:19 26:45, al. (see MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 102, 634)
(AS)

G3187.strong_def: larger (literally or figuratively, specially, in age)

G0642.def:
ἀπ-ορφανίζω
(ἀπό, ὀρφανός),
to be bereaved (prop., of a parent, Lft., Notes, 36); metaphorically, 1Th.2:17 (where Field thinks it = χωρισθέντες, Notes, 199).†
(AS)
G0642.strong_def: to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse)
G0642.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and a derivative of G3737 (ὀρφανός);

G0927.def:
βαρύτιμος, -ον
(βαρύς, τιμή),
of great value, very costly: Mat.26:7 (T, πολυτίμου) .†
(AS)

G2220.def:
ζυμόω, -ῶ
(ζύμη), [in LXX for חָמֵץ, Exo.12:34, 39 Lev.6:17 23:17, Hos.7:4 * ;]
to leaven: Mat.13:33, Luk.13:21, 1Co.5:6, Gal.5:9.†
(AS)

G3732.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G3733 (ὄρνις);

G2827.def:
κλίνω
[in LXX chiefly for נָטָה ;]
1. to make to bend, to bow: τ. κεφαλήν (of one dying), Jhn.19:30; τ. πρόσωτον (of terrified persons), Luk.24:5.
2. to make to lean, to rest: τ. κεφαλήν (in sleep), Mat.8:20, Luk.9:58.
3. As in Hom., of soldiers, to turn (to flight), παρεμβολάς, Heb.11:34.
4. In late Gk. (as mid, in cl.), to decline: intrans., ἡ ἡμέρα, Luk.9:12 24:29.†
(AS)
G2827.strong_def: to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively)

G4998.strong_def: safe (sound) in mind, i.e. self-controlled (moderate as to opinion or passion)
G4998.derivation: from the base of G4982 (σώζω) and that of G5424 (φρήν);

G3607.strong_def: a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail

G3786.derivation: from (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit);

G0036.def:
ἀγενής, -ές
(γένος),
1. unborn (Plat.);
2. of no family, ignoble, base (opposite to ἀγαθός, Soph., Fr., 105): opposite to εὐγενής, 1Co.1:28 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0036.strong_def: properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble
G0036.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1085 (γένος);

G4683.strong_def: from a derivative of the base of G4682 (σπαράσσω) meaning to strap or wrap with strips); to swathe (an infant after the Oriental custom)

G1181.def:
δεκάτη, -ης, ἡ prop. fem. (sc. μέρος) of δέκατος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX for מַעֲשֵׂר: Gen.14:20, Neh.12:44, and al. ;]
a tenth part, a tithe: Heb.7:2, 4; 8, 9 (for a curious inversion of the Biblical use, see MM, see word).†
(AS)
G1181.strong_def: a tenth, i.e. as a percentage or (technically) tithe

G1515.def:
εἰρήνη, -ης, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלוֹם ;]
peace;
1. of public peace, freedom from war: Luk.14:32, Act.12:20 24:2; of the church, Ac 9:31.
2. Of peace between persons, concord, agreement : Mat.10:34, Luk.12:51, Rom.14:17, 1Co.7:15, Gal.5:22, Jas.3:18; ζητεῖν εἰ., 1Pe.3:11; διώκειν, 2Ti.2:22; ib. before μετὰ πάντων, Heb.12:14; by meton., of him who brings peace, Eph.2:14.
3. As in LXX (= Heb. שָׁלוֹם, Aram. שְׁלָם), of a state of security and safety: Jhn.16:33, Rom.2:10, 1Th.5:3,́ whence the formulae, ὕπαγε (πορεύου) εἰς εἰ, Mrk.5:34, Luk.7:50 (cf. 1Ki.1:17, al.; לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם); εἰ. ὑμῖν (שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם), Jhn.20:19, 21, 26; ἀπολύειν ἐν εἰ., Luk.2:29, cf. 1Co.16:11; ἡ εἰ. ὑμῶν, Mat.10:13, Luk.10:6; υἱὸς εἰρήνης, ib.
4. Of spiritual peace, the peace of Christ's kingdom (DCG, ii, 330f.): Luk.1:79 2:14 Jhn.16:33, Rom.2:10 5:1 8:6, al.; ὁ κύριος τῆς εἰ., 2Th.3:16; ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰ., Rom.15:33 16:20, 2Co.13:11, al.; in epistolary salutations, Rom.1:7, 1Co.1:3, Gal.1:3, 1Th.1:1, 1Pe.1:2, 2Jo.3, Rev.1:4, al. (see Cremer, 244).
(AS)
G1515.strong_def: peace (literally or figuratively); by implication, prosperity
G1515.derivation: probably from a primary verb (to join);

G2295.def:
θαῦμα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Job.17:8 18:20 20:8 21:5 (שַׂעַר, etc.)* ;]
1. a wonder: 2Co.11:14.
2. wonder: Rev.17:6.†
(AS)
G2295.strong_def: wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract)
G2295.derivation: apparently from a form of G2300 (θεάομαι);

G0988.def:
βλασφημία, -ας, ἡ
(βλάσφημος), [in LXX: Eze.35:12 (נֶאָצָה), Da TH 3:29 (96) (שׁלה), Tob.1:18, 1Ma.2:6, 2Ma.8:4 10:35 15:24 * ;]
(a) railing slander: Mat.12:31 15:19, Mrk.3:28 7:22, Eph.4:31, Col.3:8, 1Ti.6:4, Ju 9, Rev.2:9
(b) spec., impious speech against God, blasphemy: Mat.26:65, Mrk.14:64, Luk.5:21, Jhn.10:33, Rev.13:5; ὄνομα βλασφημίας, Rev.13:1 17:3; with genitive obj. Mat.12:31; πρὸς τ. θεόν, Rev.13:6 (Cremer, 570; DB, i, 305; DCG ii, 423).†
(AS)

G0425.def:
ἄνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνίημι), [in LXX: 2Es.4.22 (שָׁלוּ), 2Ch.23:15, I Est.4:62, Wis.13:13, Sir.15:20 26:10 * ;]
a loosening, relaxation: Act.24:23 (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, VGT, see word); by St. Paul, opposite to θλίψις, expressed or understood, relief: 2Co.2:12 7:5 8:13, 2Th.1:7.†
SYN.: ἀνάπαυσις (which see).† (AS)

G0407.def:
ἀνδρίζω
[in LXX for חָזַק אָמַץ (Jos.1:6 ff., 1Ch.22:19, al.; in 2Ki.10:12, Psa.27:14 31:24 combined with κρατιοῦσθαι, as in 1Co, l.with) ;]
to make a man of. Mid., to play the man (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 1Co.16:13.†
(AS)

G4650.strong_def: to dissipate, i.e. (figuratively) put to flight, waste, be liberal
G4650.derivation: apparently from the same as G4651 (σκορπίος) (through the idea of penetrating);

G0999.def:
βόθυνος, -ου, ὁ (= βόθρος, more frequently in cl.),
[in LXX chiefly for פַּחַת ;]
a pit: Mat.12:11 15:14, Luk.6:39 (cf. DB, iii, 885; DCG, ii, 367).†
(AS)
G0999.strong_def: a hole (in the ground); specially, a cistern

G2794.def:
κίνδυνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Psa.116:3 (מֵצַר), Sir.3:26, al. ;]
danger, peril: Rom.8:35; pl., 2Co.11:26.†
(AS)

G0337.def:
ἀν-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for הָרַג hi., מוּת hi., נָכָה hi., etc. ;]
1. to take up: mid., Act.7:21.
2. to take away, make an end of, destroy (for late exx. of various senses, see MM, VGT, see word);
(a) of things (as frequently in cl. of laws, etc.): Heb.10:9;
(b) of persons, to kill: Mat.2:16, Luk.22:2 23:32, Act.2:23 5:33, 36 7:28 9:23-24, 29 10:39 12:2 13:28 16:27 22:20 23:15, 21 23:27 25:3 26:10, 2Th.2:8, WH, txt., R, txt.†
(AS)
G0337.strong_def: to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder
G0337.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and (the active of) G138 (αἱρέομαι);

G2049.def:
ἐρημόω, -ῶ
(ἔρημος), [in LXX for חָרַב hi., שָׁמֵם ni., etc. ;]
to desolate, lay waste: Mat.12:25, Luk.11:17, Rev.17:16 18:16, 19.†
(AS)

G2366.def:
θύελλα, -ης, ἡ
(θύω), [in LXX Deu.4:11 5:22 (עֲרָפֶל), Exo.10:22 * ;] (poët. in cl.),
a hurricane, cyclone, whirlwind: Heb.12:18.†
SYN.: λαίλαψ (which see) (AS)
G2366.derivation: from G2380 (θύω) (in the sense of blowing) a storm

G0095.def:
ἀδίκως, adv.
(ἄδικος), [in LXX for שׁקר, עול, etc. ;]
unjustly, undeservedly: 1Pe.2:19.†
(AS)

G2121.def:
εὔ-καιρος, -ον
[in LXX: Psa.104:27 (עֵת), 2Ma.14:29 2Mac 15:20-21, 3Ma.4:11 3Mac 5:44 * ;]
timely, seasonable, suitable (Cremer, 740): ἡμέρα, Mrk.6:21 (or empty, as in Byz. and MGr.; see MM, Exp., xiv); βοήθεια, Heb.4:16.†
(AS)

G2950.def:
κύμβαλον, -ου, τό
(κύμβη, a cup), [in LXX chiefly for מְצִלָּה ;]
a cymbal: 1Co.13:1.†
(AS)
G2950.derivation: from a derivative of the base of G2949 (κῦμα);

G2739.def:
καυματίζω
(καῦμα),
to burn or scorch up: with accusative before ἐν πυρί, Rev.16:8. Pass., Mat.13:14, Mrk.4:6; before καῦμα μέγα, Rev.16:9.†
(AS)

G2798.def:
κλάδος, -ου, ὁ
(κλάω), [in LXX for דָּלִיָּה, כַּף, etc. ;]
a young tender shoot broken off for grafting; then, a branch: Mat.13:32 21:8 24:32, Mrk.4:32 13:28, Luk.13:19; metaphorically, of descendants (cf. Sir.40:15), Rom.11:16-19, 21.†
(AS)
G2798.strong_def: a twig or bough (as if broken off)

G0330.def:
ἀνα-θάλλω
(θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: Psa.28:7 (עָלַז), Eze.17:24 (פָּרַח hi.), Hos.8:9, Wis.4:4, Sir.5:1-15 * ;]
to revive: Php.4:10 (of MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G5258.derivation: from an obsolete primary (perhaps akin to G5259 (ὑπό) through the idea of subsilience);

G5416.strong_def: a whip, i.e. Roman lash as a public punishment
G5416.derivation: neuter of a derivative from the base of G5417 (φραγελλόω);

G1894.def:
ἐπει-δή
conj.;
1. of time, when now, after that: Luk.7:1 (WH, txt.).
2. Of cause, seeing that, forasmuch as: Luk.11:6, Act.13:46 (WH, txt., RV) Act.14:12 15:24, 1Co.1:21-22 14:16 15:21, Php.2:26.†
(AS)
G1894.strong_def: since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas

G1576.def:
ἐκ-κλείω
[in LXX: ἐ. κρίσιν, for נָטָה hi., Exo.23:2 (also as seel., Job.34:20, Psa.67:1-7 (Psa.68:30) * ;]
to shut out: Gal.4:17. Pass., Rom.3:27.†
(AS)

G0900.def:
βαθύνω
(βαθύς), [in LXX for עמד: Psa.91 (92):5, Jer.29 (49):8 30(49)30 * ;]
to deepen: Luk.6:48.†
(AS)

G5222.strong_def: an encounter or concurrence (with G1519 (εἰς) for infinitive, in order to fall in with)

G1101.def:
γλωσσόκομον, -ου, τό, vernac. form of cl. γλωσσοκομεῖον
(γλῶσσα, κομέω), [in LXX for אָרוֹן, 2Ki.6:11, 2Ch.24:8, 10 11 * ;]
1. = cl. -εῖον (see supr.), a case for holding the reeds or tongues of musical instruments.
2. As in LXX, π. (MM, see word), a box, chest: Jhn.12:6 13:29.
† (AS)
G1101.strong_def: properly, a case (to keep mouthpieces of wind-instruments in) i.e. (by extension) a casket or (specially) purse
G1101.derivation: from G1100 (γλῶσσα) and the base of G2889 (κόσμος);

G1442.def:
ἕβδομος, -η, -ον
(ἑπτὰ), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִיעִי ;]
seventh: Jhn.4:52, Heb.4:4" (LXX), Ju 14, Rev.8:1 10:7 11:15 16:17 21:20.†
(AS)

G4828.strong_def: to testify jointly, i.e. corroborate by (concurrent) evidence

G3515.strong_def: to act as a babe, i.e. (figuratively) innocently

G2659.def:
κατά-νυξις, -εως, ἡ
(κατανύσσω, which see), [in LXX: Psa.60:3 (תַּרְעֵלָה), Isa.29:10 (תַּרְדֵּמָה)* ;]
1. a pricking.
2. (Perhaps through resembl. of κατανύσσω to -νυστάζω), torpor of mind, stupefaction: Rom.11:8 (LXX) (see ICC, in l; Field, Notes, 157).†
(AS)
G2659.strong_def: a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), i.e. (by implication, (perhaps by some confusion with G3506 (νεύω) or even with G3571 (νύξ))) stupor (lethargy)

G4456.strong_def: to petrify, i.e. (figuratively) to indurate (render stupid or callous)

G2813.def:
κλέπτω
[in LXX for גָּנַב ;]
to steal: absol., Mat.6:19-20 19:18, Mrk.10:19, Luk.18:20, Jhn.10:10, Rom.2:21 13:9, Eph.4:28; with accusative, Mat.27:64 28:13.†
(AS)

G4781.strong_def: to bend together, i.e. (figuratively) to afflict

G2653.def:
κατα-θεματίζω
to curse vehemently: Mat.26:74 (cf. ἀναθεμ-).†
(AS)

G4006.derivation: from the perfect of the alternate of G3958 (πάσχω);

G0904.def:
Βαλάκ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בָּלָק),
Balak; (Num.22:2): Rev.2:14.†
(AS)

G2576.def:
καμμύω
(syncopated form of καταμύω, used by Ep. and κοινή writers; Rutherford, NPhr., 426 f.) [in LXX: Isa.6:10 (שָׁעַע hi.) Isa.29:10 33:15 (עָצַם), La 3:44 AR* ;]
to shut the eyes: τ. ὀφθαλμούς, Mat.13:15, Act.28:27 (Isa, l.with).†
(AS)
G2576.strong_def: to shut down, i.e. close the eyes
G2576.derivation: from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and the base of G3466 (μυστήριον);

G1114.def:
γόης, -ητος, ὁ (γοάω, to wail),
1. a wailer.
2. a wizard.
3. an impostor (cf. γοητεία, trickery, 2Ma.12:24): 2Ti.3:13.
† (AS)
G1114.strong_def: properly, a wizard (as muttering spells), i.e. (by implication) an imposter

G4923.strong_def: companionship on a journey, i.e. (by implication), a caravan
G4923.derivation: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G3598 (ὁδός) ("synod");

G3822.strong_def: to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete

G1598.def:
ἐκ-πειράζω
[in LXX: Deu.6:16 8:2, 16 Psa.78:18 (נָסָה pi.) * ;]
= cl. ἐκπειράομαι,
to put to the proof or test, make trial of, tempt: with accusative, of God, Mat.4:7 (LXX), Luk.4:12 (ib.), 1Co.10:9; of Christ, Luk.10:25 (Cremer, 497).†
(AS)

G4388.strong_def: to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine)
G4388.derivation: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G5087 (τίθημι);

G3466.strong_def: a secret or "mystery" (through the idea of silence imposed by initiation into religious rites)
G3466.derivation: from a derivative of (to shut the mouth);

G2877.def:
κοράσιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of κόρη), [in LXX chiefly for נַעֲרָה, Rut.2:8, al.; in Joel 4:3, Zec.8:5 for יַלְדָּה ;]
a colloquial word which survives in MGr. (Kennedy, Sourcs, e154), girl, maiden: Mat.9:24-25 14:11, Mrk.5:41-42 6:22, 28.†
(AS)
G2877.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of (a maiden);

G5311.strong_def: elevation, i.e. (abstractly) altitude, (specially), the sky, or (figuratively) dignity

G3152.strong_def: empty, i.e. (literally) profitless, or (specially), an idol

G3850.strong_def: a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage

G2126.def:
εὐλαβής, -ές
(εὖ, λαβεῖν), [in LXX: Mic.7:2 AB2 (חָסִיד); εὐ. ποιεῖν, Lev.15:31 (נָזַר hi.), Sir.11:7 א2* ;]
1. cautious, circumspect.
2. devout, religious, reverent: Act.2:5 8:2 22:12; δίκαιος καὶ εὐ., Luk.2:25.†
(AS)

G1401.def:
δοῦλος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX, ὁ δ. nearly always for עֶבֶד; ὁ δ. chiefly for שִׁפְחָה ,אָמָה ;]
1. in bondage to, subject to: Rom.6:19.
2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ δ., a slave;
(a) fem., ἡ δ., a female slave, bondmaid (Cremer, 702; DB, iii, 215): Luk.1:38, 48 Act.2:18" (LXX) ;
(b) masc., ὁ δ., a slave, bond-man: Mat.8:9 18:23, al.; opposite to ἐλεύθερος, 1Co.7:22 12:13, Gal.3:28, Eph.6:8, Col.3:11, Rev.6:15 13:16 19:18; opposite to κύριος, δεσπότης, οἰκοδεσπότης, Mat.10:24 13:27, 28 Luk.12:46, Jhn.15:15, Eph.6:5, Col.3:22 4:1, al.; metaphorically, δ. Χριστοῦ, τοῦ Χρ., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Rom.1:1, 1Co.7:22, Gal.1:10, Eph.6:6, Php.1:1, Col.4:12, Jas.1:1, 2Pe.1:1, Ju 1; δ. τ. θεοῦ, τ. κυρίου, Act.16:17, 2Ti.2:24, Tit.1:1, 1Pe.2:16, Rev.7:3 15:3; δ. πονηρός, ἀχρεῖος, κακός, Mat.18:32 24:48 25:26, 30, Luk.17:10 19:22; δ. ἁμαρτίας, Jhn.8:34, Rom.6:17, 20; τ. φθορᾶς, 2Pe.2:19.
SYN.: διάκονος (q.V.), θεράπων, ὐπηρέτης (see DB, iii, 377; iv, 461, 469; DCG, i, 221; ii, 613; Cremer, 215, 702). (AS)
G1401.strong_def: a slave (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary; frequently, therefore in a qualified sense of subjection or subserviency)

G2852.def:
κολαφίζω
(κόλαφος = Att.., κόνδυλοι, the knuckles, the closed fist)
to strike with the fist, to buffet: Mat.26:67, Mrk.14:65, 2Co.12:7; pass., 1Co.4:11, 1Pe.2:20.†
(AS)
G2852.derivation: from a derivative of the base of G2849 (κολάζω);

G3549.strong_def: to legislate, i.e. (passively) to have (the Mosaic) enactments injoined, be sanctioned (by them)

G0965.def:
Βηθλέεμ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בֵּית לֶחֶם, house of bread),
Bethlehem, a town 6 m. S. of Jerusalem: Mat.2:1, 5 6, 8, 16, Luk.2:4, 15 Jhn.7:42.†
(AS)
G0965.strong_def: Bethleem (i.e. Beth-lechem), a place in Palestine

G0860.def:
ἁφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), [in LXX for נֶגַע, frequently in Le ;]
a joint (MM, see word): Eph.4:16, Col.2:19 (Lft., in l).†
(AS)

G1780.def:
ἐνταφιασμός, -οῦ
(ἐνταφιάζω),
preparation for burial: Mrk.14:8, Jhn.12:7.†
(AS)

G0142.def:
αἴρω,
[in LXX chiefly for נשׂא, also for לקח, etc. ;]
1. to raise, take up, lift or draw up: Jhn.8:59 11:41, Act.27:17, al.
2. to bear, carry: Mat.4:6 16:24, al.
3. to bear or take away, carry off, remove: Mat.21:21, Jhn.19:31, 1Co.5:12 6:15 (see Lft., Notes, 216), al.; of the taking away sin by Christ, Jhn.1:29, 1Jn.3:5. (Cf. ἀπ᾽, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, μετ-, συν-, ὑπερ-αίρω). For exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0142.strong_def: to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare H05375) to expiate sin

G4066.gloss: country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about
G4066.strong_def: around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun, with G1093 (γῆ) implied vicinity)

G2731.def:
κατ-οίκησις, -εως, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX for יָשַׁב, Gen.10:30, al. ;]
dwelling: Mrk.5:3.†
(AS)
G2731.strong_def: residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion)

G2292.def:
θαρρέω, -ῶ
(later form of θαρσέω), [in LXX: Pro.1:21, Bar.4:21, 27, from LXX Bar.6:16, (17), 4Ma.13:11 4Mac 17:4 * ;]
to be of good cheer or courage, to be confident: 2Co.5:6 5:8, Heb.13:6; τ. πεποιθήσει, 2Co.10:2; before εἰς, 2Co.10:1; ἐν, 2Co.7:16.†
SYN.: τολμάω. "θ. has reference more to the character, τ. to its manifestation " (Thayer, see word τολμάω) (AS)

G5522.strong_def: a heap (as poured out), i.e. rubbish; loose dirt

G5262.strong_def: an exhibit for imitation or warning (figuratively, specimen, adumbration)

G0465.def:
ἀντ-άλλαγμα, -τος, τό
(ἀντί, ἄλλαγμα; ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מְחִיר ;]
an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce: Mat.16:26, Mrk.8:37 (cf. Sir.26:14; and see Swete, Mk., l.with; Cremer, 90).†
(AS)
G0465.derivation: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G236 (ἀλλάσσω);

G1677.def:
ἐλλογάω, -ῶ
(a κοινή word, elsewhere usually -έω; cf. Bl., § 22, 2),
to charge to one's account, impute: Phm 18 (on parallels, cf. Deiss., LAE, 79 f., 335 f.; Milligan, NTD, 73; MM, Exp., xii); of sin, Rom.5:13 (Cremer, 400).†
(AS)
G1677.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and G3056 (λόγος) (in the sense of account);

G2420.def:
ἱερωσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(ἱερός), [in LXX: 1Ch.29:22 (כָּהַן), I Est.5:38, Sir.45:24, 1Ma.2:54 1Mac 3:49 1Mac 7:9 1Mac 7:21, 4Ma.5:35 4Mac 7:6 * ;]
priesthood: Heb.7:11-12, 24.†
(AS)
G2420.strong_def: sacredness, i.e. (by implication) the priestly office

G1879.def:
ἐπ-ανα-παύω
[in LXX, mid., for נוּחַ, שָׁעַן ni ;]
to refresh, cause to rest (upon); mid., to rest upon: metaphorically, with dative, Rom.2:17; before ἐπί, with accusative, Luk.10:6 (Cremer, 827).†
(AS)
G1879.strong_def: to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely)
G1879.derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G373 (ἀναπαύω);

G1489.def:
εἰ,
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
I. Conditional, if;
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20;
(b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20;
(with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.;
(d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al.
2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, if, whether.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12.
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luk.11:18; but even if, 1Co.4:7, 2Co.4:3 11:16.
3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Mrk.2:21, 22 Jhn.14:2, Rev.2:5, al.
4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Mrk.14:29, Luk.11:8, 1Co.7:21, 2Co.4:16, Php.2:17, al.
5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Mat.24:22, Mrk.2:26 6:5, Jhn.9:33, 1Co.7:17 (only), Gal.1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1Co.14:5 15:2, 1Ti.5:19.
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Heb.6:14.
8. εἴ πως, if haply: Act.27:12, Rom.1:10.
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Rom.12:6-8, 1Co.3:22 13:8, al.
(AS)
G1489.strong_def: if indeed, seeing that, unless, (with negative) otherwise

G5149.strong_def: to creak (squeak), i.e. (by analogy) to grate the teeth (in frenzy)

G3789.strong_def: a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially Satan
G3789.derivation: probably from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (through the idea of sharpness of vision);

G0203.def:
ἀκροβυστία, -ας, ή
(perh. an Alexandrian form of cl. ἀκροποσθία; cf. MM, VGT, see word) [in LXX for עׇרְלָה ;]
the prepuce, foreskin (LXX), hence abstr., uncircumcision: Act.11:3, Rom.2:25-27 3:30 4:10-12, 1Co.7:18-19, Gal.5:6 6:15, Col.2:13 3:11 By meton., the uncircumcised: Rom.4:9, Gal.2:7, Eph.2:11.†
(AS)
G0203.strong_def: the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e. gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person
G0203.derivation: from G206 (ἄκρον) and probably a modified form of (the penis or male sexual organ);

G2516.def:
καθ-έζομαι
[in LXX: Lev.12:5, al. (יָשַׁב), Job.39:28 (שָׁכַן) ;]
to sit down, sit: Jhn.20:12; before ἐν, Mat.26:55, Luk.2:46, Jhn.11:20, Act.6:15; before ἐπί, with genitive, Act.20:9; id. with dative, Jhn.4:6 (cf. παρα-καθέζ-, κάθημαι).†
καθ ̓ εἷς, see: (εἷς.)
(AS)
G2516.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος);

G4493.strong_def: a jerk (of the eye, i.e. (by analogy) an instant)

G3713.strong_def: to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long for)
G3713.derivation: middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare G3735 (ὄρος));

G0029.def:
ἀγγαρεύω (from the Persian; cf. Vg. angiare, and the Heb. אִגֶרֶת; on the orthogr., see Bl., §6, 1; M, Pr., 46),
to impress into public service, employ a courier; hence, to compel to perform a service (prob. common in the vernac.; cf. Deiss., BS, 86f., MM, Exp., iv; VGT, see word): Mat.5:41, 27:32, Mrk.15:21.†
(AS)
G0029.strong_def: properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service

G0985.def:
βλαστάνω,
[in LXX for צמח, etc. ;]
1. to sprout: Mat.13:26, Mrk.4:27, Heb.9:4.
2. In late Gk., causal, to make to grow, produce: with accusative, Jas.5:18.
† (AS)
G0985.strong_def: to germinate; by implication, to yield fruit

G2061.strong_def: born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian

G2769.def:
κεράτιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of κέρας),
1. a little horn (Arist.).
2. In pl. (the fruit of the κερατέα), carob-pods: Luk.15:16.†
(AS)
G2769.strong_def: something horned, i.e. (specially) the pod of the carob-tree
G2769.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2768 (κέρας);

G4963.strong_def: a twisting together, i.e. (figuratively) a secret coalition, riotous crowd

G3322.strong_def: to form the middle, i.e. (in point of time), to be half-way over

G0316.def:
ἀναγκαῖος, -αῖα, -αῖον
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Est.8:13, Wis.16:3, Sir prol.22, 2Ma.4:23 2Mac 9:21, 4Ma.1:2 * ;]
1. necessary: Act.13:46, 1Co.12:22, 2Co.9:5, Php.2:25, Tit.3:14, Heb.8:3; comp. -αιότερον, Php.1:24.
2. Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate (Field, Notes, 118; ΜΜ, VGT, see word): ἀ. φίλοι, Act.10:24.†
(AS)

G0329.def:
ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ
(ζωός, πῦρ), [in LXX: 1Ma.13:7 * ;]
to kindle afresh: metaphorically, 2Ti.1:6 (for vernac. exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0329.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and a compound of the base of G2226 (ζῶον) and G4442 (πῦρ);

G0512.def:
ἀν-ωφελής, -ές
(ἀ- neg., ὄφελος), [in LXX: Isa.44:10 (יָעַל בִּלְתִּי) Jer.2:8 (יָעַל לֹא), Pro.28:3, Wis.1:11 * ;]
unprofitable: Tit.3:9; neut. as subst., unprofitableness: Heb.7:18.†
(AS)
G0512.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G5624 (ὠφέλιμος);

G2393.def:
ἴασπις, -ιδος, ἡ
[in LXX: Exo.28:18 36:38 (Exo.39:11) (יַהֲלֹם), Isa.54:12 (כַּדְכֹּד), Eze.28:13 (יָשְׁפֵה, see BDB, Lex., see word)* ;]
jasper, apparently not the modern stone of that name, but a translucent stone (DB, see word): Rev.4:3 21:11, 18-19.†
(AS)

G5440.strong_def: a guard-case, i.e. "phylactery" for wearing slips of Scripture texts
G5440.derivation: neuter of a derivative of G5442 (φυλάσσω);

G0515.def:
ἀξιόω, -ῶ
(ἄξιος), [in LXX chiefly for בְּעָא, בָּקַשׁ; frequently in Wis.1:1-16, 2 Mac ;]
(a) to deem worthy: with accusative and inf. (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), Luk.7:7; id. and genitive of thing(s), 2Th.1:11; pass. with genitive of thing(s), 1Ti.5:17, Heb.3:3 10:29
(b) to think fit: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205), Act.15:38 28:22.†
(AS)

G2734.def:
κατοπτρίζω
(κάτοπτρον, a mirror),
to show as in a mirror. Mid., to see oneself mirrored (see MM, Exp., xv); with accusative of thing(s) (R, txt., but see mg.), to reflect as a mirror: 2Co.3:18 (cf. Abbott, Essays, 94).†
(AS)
G2734.strong_def: to mirror oneself, i.e. to see reflected (figuratively)
G2734.derivation: middle voice from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (compare G2072 (ἔσοπτρον));

G1349.def:
δίκη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for נָקָם, רִיב, etc. ;]
1. custom.
2. right.
3. a judicial hearing; hence its result, the execution of a sentence, punishment: δ. τίνειν, 2Th.1:9; δ. υπεχειν, Ju 7.
4. Personified (cf. Lat. Justitia), justice, vengeance: Act.28:4.†
(AS)
G1349.strong_def: right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution)

G1967.def:
ἐπιούσιος, -ον
(cf. περιούσιος, [in LXX for סְגֻלָּה, etc.]),
found only in the phrase ἄρτος ἐ., EV, daily; R, mg., for the coming day: Mat.6:11, Luk.11:3. (Several derivations find support, each pointing to a different meaning.
1. ἐπιοῦσα (sc. ἡμέρα) (or, ἐπὶ τὴν ἰοῦσαν (sc. ήμέραν), Zorell, see word), hence, for the morrow or for the coming day (R, mg.).
2. (a) ἐπί + οὐσία, hence, for subsistence, needful (Am. R, mg.);
(b) ἐπί + εἶναι in fern. ptcp. form, hence, pertaining to (the day). For renderings of versions and views of various writers, see reff. in DB, ext., 36 f.; DCG, ii, 58 f., 62a; ICC on Lk, l.with The EV, daily, is based on the Vg. (Lk; OL, Mt, Lk, quotidianus). "It is difficult not to think that τὸν ἐ. rests upon misunderstanding of an original Aramaic phrase, or upon a Greek corruption" (ICC on Mt, l.with; cf. also Cremer, 239).†
(AS)
G1967.strong_def: tomorrow's; but more probably from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of the present participle feminine of G1510 (εἰμί); for subsistence, i.e. needful
G1967.derivation: perhaps from the same as G1966 (ἐπιοῦσα);

G4095.derivation: a prolonged form of ; which (together with another form) ; occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses;

G0353.def:
ἀνα-λαμβάνω
[in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא, also for לָקַח, etc. ;]
1. to take up, raise: Mrk.16:19, Act.1:2, 11 1:22 10:16, 1Ti.3:16.
2. to take up, take to oneself: Act.7:43 20:13-14 23:31, Eph.6:13, 16, 2Ti.4:11 (for late exx., v MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G2007.def:
ἐπι-τίθημι
[in LXX for נָתַן, שָׁוָה, etc. ;]
1. to lay, set or place upon: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), Mat.23:4, Luk.15:5, Jhn.9:6 (WH, txt. Jhn.9:15), Act.15:10 28:3; ἐπί, with genitive of thing(s), Mat.27:29; ἐν, ib.; with dative of person(s), σταυρόν, Luk.23:26; στέφανον, Jhn.19:2; ὄνομα, Mrk.3:16-17; πληγάς, Luk.10:30, Act.16:23; ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Rev.22:18; of the laying on of hands, τ. χεῖρα (-ας), before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Mat.9:18, Mrk.16:13, Act.8:17 9:17; with dative of person(s), Mat.19:13, 15, Mrk.5:23 6:5 7:32 8:23, Luk.4:40 13:13, Act.6:6 8:19 9:12 13:3 19:6 28:8, 1Ti.5:22. Mid.,
(a) to provide: Act.28:10 (RV, put on board; cf. Field, Notes, 149);
(b) to throw oneself upon, attack: with dative of person(s), Act.18:10.
2. to add to: Rev.22:18 (see supr., and cf. Swete, in l).†
(AS)
G2007.strong_def: to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense)

G2372.def:
θυμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(θύω), [in LXX most frequently for אַף, also for חֱמָא, חָרוֹן, etc., 30 words in all ;]
passion, hot anger, wrath: Heb.11:27; ὀργὴ καὶ θ., Rom.2:8, cf. Col.3:8; πικρία κ. θ., Eph.4:31; πλησθῆναι, πλήρης θυμοῦ, Luk.4:28, Act.19:28; θ. ἔχειν, Rev.12:12; οἶνος τ. θυμοῦ τ. πορνείας (cf. Jer.51:7), Rev.14:8 18:3 (cf. Rev.17:2); οἶνος τ. θ. τ. θεοῦ, Rev.14:10; τ. ὀργῆς τ. θεοῦ, Rev.16:19 19:15; ὁ θ. τ. θεοῦ, Rev.14:19 15:1, 7 16:1; pl., impulses or outbursts of anger: ἔρις, ζῆλος, θυμοὶ, ἐριθίαι, 2Co.12:20, Gal.5:20 (Cremer, 287, 733).†
SYN.: ὀργή, παροργισμός (AS)

G2611.def:
κατα-δέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for חָבַשׁ, etc. ;]
to bind up: τ. τραύματα (cf. Sir.27:21), Luk.10:34.†
(AS)
G2611.strong_def: to tie down, i.e. bandage (a wound)

G2572.def:
καλύπτω
[in LXX almost always for כָּסָה pi. ;]
in cl., rare in prose,
to cover: with accusative of person(s), Luk.23:30; with accusative of thing(s) and dative, Luk.8:16; pass., Mat.8:24; metaphorically, to veil, conceal: pf. ptcp. pass., Mat.10:26, 2Co.4:3; of the forgiveness of sins (cf. Psa.32:5 85:2; DB, ii, 56b): 1Pe.4:8, Jas.5:20; (seel. for καιομένη, WH, mg., Luk.24:32).†
(AS)

G5218.strong_def: attentive hearkening, i.e. (by implication) compliance or submission

G5500.strong_def: to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint
G5500.derivation: from a comparative of G5495 (χείρ) and (to stretch);

G1728.def:
ἐν-άρχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for חָלַל hi. ;]
to begin, make a beginning: Gal.3:3, Php.1:6.†
(AS)

G1619.def:
ἐκτενῶς
adv., [in LXX: Jon.3.8 (חׇזְקָה), Jol.1:14, Jdth.4:12, 3Ma.5:9 * ;]
fervently, earnestly: Act.12:5, 1Pe.1:22; compar., Luk.22:44 (WH br., R, mg., omits).†
(AS)

G2866.def:
κομψός, -ή, -όν
(κομέω, to take care of),
well-dressed, elegant, fine; compar. neut., κομψότερον ἔχειν (cf. κόμψως ἔχειν, Epict., and colloq. Eng., "to be doing finely"): Jhn.4:52.†
(AS)
G2866.derivation: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of 2865 (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice);

G3856.gloss: make a public example, put to an open shame
G3856.strong_def: to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy

G2310.def:
θεμέλιος, -ον
(τίθημι), [in LXX for אַרְמוֹן, מוֹסָד, etc. ;]
of or for a foundation; as subst., ὁ θ. (sc. λίθος), a foundation stone, foundation: Luk.6:48-49 14:29 (but see Deiss., BS, 123); pl., οἰ θ. (cl.), Heb.11:10 Rev.21:14, 19; neut., τὸ θ. (Arist., Phys., vi, 6, 10, LXX and later writers), Act.16:26; metaphorically, Rom.15:20, 1Co.3:10-12 Eph.2:20, 1Ti.6:19, 2Ti.2:19, Heb.6:1.†
(AS)
G2310.strong_def: something put down, i.e. a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively)

G5124.gloss: here (-unto), it, partly, self(-same), so, that (intent), the same, there(-fore, -unto), this, thus, where(-fore)
G5124.derivation: neuter singular nominative or accusative case of G3778 (οὗτος);

G2943.def:
κυκλόθεν
adv., (κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב ;]
from all sides, round about: Rev.4:3-4, 8,†
(AS)
G2943.strong_def: from the circle, i.e. all around
G2943.derivation: adverb from the same as G2945 (κύκλῳ);

G0937.def:
βασιλικός, -ή, -όν (βασιλεύς),
[in LXX for מֶלֶךְ and its cognates ;]
royal, belonging to a king: χώρα, Act 12:20; ἐσθής, Act.12:21; νόμος β., a supreme law, "a law which governs other laws and so has a specially regal character" (Hort), or because made by a king (LAE, p. 3673), Jas.2:8; τις, one in the service of a king, a courtier, Jhn.4:46, 49 (WH, mg., βασιλίσκος).†
(AS)
G0937.strong_def: regal (in relation), i.e. (literally) belonging to (or befitting) the sovereign (as land, dress, or a courtier), or (figuratively) preeminent

G0905.def:
βαλλάντιον (Rec. βαλά-), -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: Job.14:17 (צְרוֹר), Pro.1:14 (כִּיס), Tob.1:14 8:2, Sir.18:33 א 2 * ;]
a purse: Luk.10:4 12:33 22:35, 36.†
(AS)
G0905.derivation: probably remotely from G906 (βάλλω) (as a depository);

G2462.def:
ἵππος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for סוּס, sometimes for פָּרָשׁ, רֶכֶב ;]
a horse: Jas.3:3, Rev.6:2 ff. Rev.9:7 ff. Rev.14:20 18:13 19:11 ff,†
(AS)

G3986.strong_def: a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication, adversity

G4293.strong_def: to anounce beforehand, i.e. predict, promise

G4380.strong_def: to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality

G2325.def:
θερίζω
(θέρος), [in LXX chiefly for קָצַר ;]
to reap: Mat.6:26, Luk.12:24, Jas.5:4; figuratively, Mat.25:24, 26, Luk.19:21-22, Jhn.4:36-38, 2Co.9:6, Gal.6:7, 9, Rev.14:15; with accusative, τ. σαρκικά, 1Co.9:11; φθοράν, ζωὴν αἰώνιον, Gal.6:8; τ. γῆν, Rev.14:16.†
(AS)
G2325.derivation: from G2330 (θέρος) (in the sense of the crop);

G1221.def:
δή-ποτε
indef. adv. (also written δή ποτε), with generalizing force;
1. absol., sometime.
2. With adv. or relat., -soever: ᾦ δ., Jhn.5:4 (L, οἱῳδηποτοῦν).†
(AS)
G1221.strong_def: a particle of generalization; indeed, at any time

G5604.strong_def: a pang or throe, especially of childbirth

G0493.def:
Ἀντίπας (T, Ἀντείπας), -α (in some MSS. it appears to be indecl.; but see M, Pro.12:1-28; it is abbrev. from Ἀντίπατρος), ὁ,
Antipas: Rev.2:13.†
(AS)
G0493.derivation: contracted for a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and a derivative of G3962 (πατήρ);

G4364.strong_def: to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing)
G4364.derivation: middle voice from G4314 (πρός) and G4160 (ποιέω);

G3718.derivation: from a compound of G3717 (ὀρθός) and the base of G5114 (τομώτερος), to make a straight cut, i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine message)

G3008.strong_def: to be a public servant, i.e. (by analogy) to perform religious or charitable functions (worship, obey, relieve)

G1502.def:
εἴκω,
[in LXX: 2Ki.12:7 (ענה), Wis.18:25, 4Ma.1:6 * ;]
to yield: Gal.2:5 (cf. ὑπ-είκω).†
(AS)
G1502.strong_def: properly, to be weak, i.e. yield

G0735.def:
Ἄρτεμις, -ιδος, ἡ
Artemis, an Asiatic goddess, to be disting. from the Gk. goddess of the same name: Act.19:24, 27-28
(AS)
G0735.strong_def: prompt; Artemis, the name of a Grecian goddess borrowed by the Asiatics for one of their deities
G0735.derivation: probably from the same as G736 (ἀρτέμων);

G3511.strong_def: a temple-servant, i.e. (by implication) a votary
G3511.derivation: from a form of G3485 (ναός) and (to sweep);

G1050.def:
Γαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Γάϊος, Rec.),
Gaius, the name of a Christian;
1. of Macedonia: Act.19:29.
2. Of Derbe: Act.20:4.
3. Of Corinth: Rom.16:23, 1Co.1:14.
4. The one to whom in Ep. Jo is addressed: III Jo 1.
† (AS)

G2182.def:
ἐφ-ευρετής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐφευρίσκω, to find out)
an inventor, contriver: κακῶν (cf. κακίας εὑρετής, 2Ma.7:31), Rom.1:30.†
(AS)
G2182.derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G2147 (εὑρίσκω);

G1602.def:
ἐκ-πλέω, -ῶ
to sail away: Act.20:6; before εἰς, Act.15:39 18:18.†
(AS)

G1808.def:
ἐξ-αίρω
[in LXX for נָסַע, יָרַשׁ hi., כָּרַת ni., מוּת, בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
to lift up, lift off the earth, remove: 1Co.5:13 (LXX)†
(AS)

G3701.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

G4876.strong_def: to meet with; figuratively, to occur
G4876.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G473 (ἀντί);

G1923.def:
ἐπι-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιγράφω),
an inscription: Mat.22:20, Mrk.12:16 15:26, Luk.20:24 23:33.†
(AS)

G1314.def:
δια-φυλάσσω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁמַר (as Psa.91:11) ;]
to guard carefully (M, Pr., 116), defend: with accusative, Luk.4:10 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4815.strong_def: to clasp, i.e. seize (arrest, capture); specially, to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication, to aid

G4892.strong_def: a joint session, i.e. (specially), the Jewish Sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal
G4892.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4862 (σύν) and the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος);

G2957.def:
Κυρήνη, -ης, ἡ
Cyrene, a city in Libya: Act.2:10.†
(AS)

G2690.def:
κατα-στρέφω
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, etc., Gen.19:21, Jer.20:16, al. ;]
1. to turn down, turn over; as, the soil.
2. to overturn, overthrow: Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15; pass. pf. ptcp., Act.15:16 (LXX).†
(AS)
G2690.strong_def: to turn upside down, i.e. upset

G2829.def:
κλοπή, -ῆν, ἡ
(κλέπτω), [in LXX for גָּנַב ;]
theft: pl., Mat.15:19, Mrk.7:22.†
(AS)

G3123.gloss: + better, X far, (the) more (and more), (so) much (the more), rather
G3123.strong_def: (adverbially) more (in a greater degree)) or rather
G3123.derivation: neuter of the comparative of the same as G3122 (μάλιστα);

G3562.strong_def: in a mind-having way, i.e. prudently
G3562.derivation: adverb from a comparative of the accusative case of G3563 (νοῦς) and G2192 (ἔχω);

G0640.def:
ἀπορία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπορέω), [in LXX for בֶּהָלָה, etc. ;]
perplexity: Luk.21:25 (MM, see word; on the construction, see Field, Notes, 74 f.).†
(AS)

G2624.def:
κατα-κληρονομέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָחַל, יָרַשׁ, etc. ;]
1. to distribute by lot or as an inheritance (Num.34:18, Jos.14:1, al.): Act.13:19.
2. to receive by inheritance (Deu.1:38, al.).†
κατα-κληροδοτέω, ῶ,
[in LXX: Deu.1:38 21:16 A (-νομέω, B), (נָחַל), 1Ma.3:36 א R (-νομέω, A)* ;]
Act.13:19, Rec., = -νομέω, which see†
(AS)
G2624.strong_def: to be a giver of lots to each, i.e. (by implication) to apportion an estate
G2624.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of a compound of G2819 (κλῆρος) and G1325 (δίδωμι);

G1460.def:
ἐγκατοικέω, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-κατοικέω, -ῶ (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν),
to dwell among: before ἐν, 2Pe.2:8.†
(AS)
G1460.strong_def: to settle down in a place, i.e. reside

G0641.def:
ἀπο-ρίπτω
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, c1.), [in LXX for שָׁלַךְ hi., etc. ;]
to throw away, cast forth: reflexively, Act.27:43 (BV, cast themselves overboard; see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G3963.strong_def: Patmus, an islet in the Mediterranean

G0807.def:
ἀσχημονέω, -ῶ
(ἀσχήμαων), [in LXX: Eze.16:7, 22 16:39 23:29 (עֶרְיָה); Deu.25:3 (קָלָה ni.)* ;]
to act unbecomingly, behave dishonourably: 1Co.13:5; before ἐπί, ib. 1Co.7:36 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G1282.def:
δια-πρίω
[in LXX: 1Ch.20:3 (סוּר) * ;]
to saw asunder. Pass., metaphorically (vernacular?), EV, cut to the heart: Act.5:33; before τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, Act.7:54.†
(AS)
G1282.strong_def: to saw asunder, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate
G1282.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the base of G4249 (πρίζω);

G0772.def:
ἀσθενής -ές
(ἀ- neg., σθένος, strength), [in LXX for עָנִי, etc. ;]
without strength, weak, feeble: 1Co.1:27 4:10 12:22, 2Co.10:10, Gal.4:9, 1Th.5:14, Heb.7:18, 1Pe.3:7. Rhetorically, τό ἀ. τ. θεοῦ, God's action of apparent weakness: 1Co.1:25; of bodily debility, sick, sickly: Mat.25:39 (Rec.) Mat.25:43-44, Luk.9:2 (Rec.) Luk.10:9, Act.4:9 5:15-16 In moral and spiritual sense (MM, see word; Cremer, 526), Mat.26:41, Mrk.14:38, Rom.5:6, 1Co.8:7 8:9-10 9:22 11:30.†
(AS)
G0772.strong_def: strengthless (in various applications, literal, figurative and moral)
G0772.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G4599 (σθενόω);

G2270.strong_def: to keep still (intransitively), i.e. refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech

G0842.def:
αὐτάρκης, -ες
(αὐτός, ἀρκέω), [in LXX: Pro.30:8 (חֹק), Sir.5:1 11:24 31:28 40:18, 4Ma.9:9 * ;]
as in cl., in philosophical sense, self-­sufficient, independent; subjectively, contented: Php.4:11 (in non-lit. π., the word means simply enough, sufficient; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G1919.def:
ἐπί-γειος, -ον
(ἐπί, γῆ),
of the earth, earthly: τὰ ἐ., Jhn.3:12 Php.2:10 3:19 (anarth.); σώματα, 1Co.15:40; οἰκία, 2Co.5:1; σοφία, Jas.3:15 (Cremer, 153).†
(AS)

G1951.def:
ἐπι-λέγω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;]
1. to say in addition (Hdt.).
2. to call by name, to call: Jhn.5:2.
3. to choose; mid., to choose for oneself: Act.15:40.†
(AS)
G1951.derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G3004 (λέγω);

G3740.strong_def: how (i.e. with G302 (ἄν), so) many times as

G4211.strong_def: a female trader in purple cloth
G4211.derivation: feminine of a compound of G4209 (πορφύρα) and G4453 (πωλέω);

G4839.strong_def: to remain in company, i.e. still live

G3716.strong_def: to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward
G3716.derivation: from a compound of G3717 (ὀρθός) and G4228 (πούς);

G1424.def:
δυσμή, -ῆς, ἡ
(= δύσις, δύνω), [in LXX for בּוֹא, עֲרָבָה, etc. ;]
mostly in pl., opposite to ἀνατολαί;
1. a setting, as of the sun (accusative to Thayer, see word, so perhaps in Luk.12:54).
2. the quarter of sunset, the west: anarth., Mat.8:11 24:27, Luk.12:54 13:29, Rev.21:13.†
(AS)
G1424.strong_def: the sun-set, i.e. (by implication) the western region

G2068.def:
ἐσθίω, and (poet, and late prose) ἔσθω,
[in LXX chiefly for אכל ;]
to eat;
(a) absol.: Mat.14:20, 21 Mrk.6:31, Jhn.4:31, al.; ἐν τ. φαγεῖν (on this aor. form, see M, Pr., 111), 1Co.11:21; διδόναι φαγεῖν, with dative of person(s), Mrk.5:43, al.; ἐ. καὶ πίνειν, Mat.6:25, 31 Luk.10:7, al.; of ordinary use of food and drink, 1Co.9:4 11:22; of partaking of food at table, Mrk.2:16, Luk.5:30, al.; opposite to fasting, Mat.11:18, Luk.5:33, al.; of revelling, Mat.24:49, Luk.12:45 .
(b) with accusative of thing(s): Mat.6:25, Mrk.1:6, Jhn.6:31, Rom.14:2, al.; ἄρτον (Heb. אָכַל לֶחֶם), Mat.15:2, Mrk.3:20, al.; τὸν ἑαυτοῦ ἄ., 2Th.3:12; ἄ. before παρά, genitive of person(s), 2Th.3:8; τά before id., Luk.10:7; τ. πάσχα, Mat.26:17, Mrk.14:12 al; τ. κυριακὸν δεῖπνον, 1Co.11:20; τ. θυσίας, 1Co.10:18; before ἐκ (= cl. part. genitive), Jhn.6:26, 5o, 51, 1Co.11:28; ἀπό (cf. Heb. אָכַל מִן), Mat.15:27, Mrk.7:28; metaphorically, to devour, consume: Heb.10:27, Jas.5:3, Rev.17:16 (cf. κατ-, συν-εσθίω) .
(AS)
G2068.strong_def: used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by G5315 (φάγω); to eat (usually literal)

G3496.strong_def: new town; Neapolis, a place in Macedonia

G4785.strong_def: to count down in company with, i.e. enroll among
G4785.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a compound of G2596 (κατά) and G5585 (ψηφίζω);

G1885.def:
ἐπαρχεία (Rec. -χία, see Bl., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ
(ἔπαρχος, a prefect), [in LXX: Est.4:11 (מְדִינָה), Jdth.3:6 A* ;]
the jurisdiction of a prefect, a province: Act.23:3, 34 25:1.†
*†ἐπάρχεισς, -ον,
of a prefect: ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἐξουσία) = ἐπαρχεια, which see, Act.25:1 (WH, mg.).†
(AS)
G1885.strong_def: a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture
G1885.derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G757 (ἄρχω) (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch");

G0679.def:
ἄ-πταιστος, -ον
(πταίω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:39 * ;]
without stumbling, sure-footed: metaphorically (MM, see word), Ju 24.†
(AS)
G0679.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4417 (πταίω);

G4147.gloss: be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich
G4147.strong_def: to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively)

G5199.strong_def: healthy, i.e. well (in body); figuratively, true (in doctrine)

G0615.def:
ἀπο-κτείνω
(also in late forms -κτέννω, Mat.10:28, a1., LTTr., -κτεννύω, Mrk.12:5, WH), [in LXX for הָרַג, מוּת ;]
to kill: Mat.14:5, al.; before instr. ἐν (which see), Eph.2:16, Rev.2:23, al. Metaphorical: Rom.7:11; τ. ἔχθραν, Eph.2:16; τὸ γράμμα ἀποκτείνει 2Co.3:6 (on the perfective force of this verb, see M, Pr., 114)
(AS)
G0615.strong_def: to kill outright; figuratively, to destroy

G0207.def:
Ἀκύλας, -ου (and -α; MM, VGT, see word), ὁ (Lat.),
Aquila: Act.18:2, 18 18:26, Rom.16:3, 1Co.16:19, 2Ti.4:19.†
(AS)

G3900.strong_def: a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e. (unintentional) error or (wilful) transgression

G0445.def:
ἀνθ-υπατεύω
(see next word),
to be proconsul: Act.18:12 Rec. (see: ἀνθύπατος).†
(AS)

G4123.strong_def: holding (desiring) more, i.e. eager for gain (avaricious, hence a defrauder)

G5393.derivation: active participle of the base of G5395 (φλόξ);

G1901.def:
ἐπ-εκ-τείνω
to extend: mid., to stretch forward: with dative, Php.3:13.†
(AS)
G1901.derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1614 (ἐκτείνω);

G5400.strong_def: a frightening thing, i.e. terrific portent
G5400.derivation: neuter of a derivative of G5399 (φοβέω);

G0021.def:
ἀγαλλιάω, -ῶ, Hellenistic form of cl. ἀγάλλω, to glorify, mid. -ομαι, to exult in;
[in LXX (most frequently in Pss.) chiefly for גיל, רנן pi. ;]
to exult, rejoice greatly: before ἐπί, with dative, Luk.1:47; with dative mod., 1Pe.1:8, Rev.19:7. Mid., with same sense: Mat.5:12, Luk.10:21, Act.2:26, 16:34, 1Pe.4:13; before ἵνα, Jhn.8:56; ἐν, Jhn.5:35 (1 aor. pass. perh. as mid.; but see Mozley, Psalter, 5), 1Pe.1:6 (Cremer, 590).†
(AS)
G0021.strong_def: properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult

G3570.derivation: a prolonged form of G3568 (νῦν) for emphasis;

G3798.strong_def: late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve)

G2916.def:
κρίθινος, -η, -ον
(κριθή), [in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה ;]
of barley: Jhn.6:9, 13
(AS)

G0392.def:
ἀνα-τάσσομαι
[in LXX only as seel. (Ald.) in Ecc.2:20 ;]
to arrange in order, bring together from memory (Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, VGT, see word): Luk.1:1.†
(AS)
G0392.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and the middle voice of G5021 (τάσσω);

G3378.strong_def: as interrogative and negative, is it not that?

G5401.derivation: from a primary (to be put in fear);

G0854.def:
ἀφανισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀφανίζω), [in LXX chiefly for שַׁמָּה, שְׁמָמָה ;]
vanishing: Heb.8:13.†
(AS)

G2247.def:
ἧλος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Isa.41:7 מַסְמֵר etc. ;]
a nail: Jhn.20:25.†
(AS)

G0789.def:
Ἄσσος, -ου
(also Ἀσσός, -οῦ), ή
Assos, a city on the E. coast of Asia Minor: Act.20:13-14 (see: ἆσσον).†
(AS)
G0789.strong_def: Assus, a city of Asia MInor

G0923.def:
Βαρσαββᾶς (Rec. -αβᾶς), -ᾶ (Aram., son of Sabba),
Barsabbas:
1. the surname of one Joseph: Act.1:23.
2. The surname of one Judas: Act.15:22.
† (AS)
G0923.strong_def: son of Sabas (or Tsaba); Bar-sabas, the name of two Israelites
G0923.derivation: of Chaldee origin (H01247 and probably H06634);

G2101.def:
εὐ-άρεστος, -ον
[in LXX: Wis.4:10 9:10 * ;]
well-pleasing, acceptable: Rom.12:2; with dative of person(s), Rom.12:1 14:16, 2Co.5:9, Eph.5:10, Php.4:18; id. before ἐν, Tit.2:9 (κυρίῳ), Col.3:20; ἐνώπιον, Heb.13:21 (for ex. in Inser., see Deiss., BS, 215).†
(AS)

G0034.def:
ἀγέλη, -ης, ἡ
(ἄγω), [in LXX chiefly for עֵ֫דֶר ;]
a herd: Mat.8:30-32, Mrk.5:11, 13, Luk.8:32,33.†
(AS)

G2834.def:
Κνίδος, -ου, ἡ
Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: Act.27:7.†
(AS)
G2834.strong_def: Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor

G1962.def:
ἐπι-νεύω
[in LXX: Pro.26:24 (נָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:57, 2Ma.4:10 2Mac 11:15 2Mac 14:20 * ;]
to nod in command or approval, to nod approval, consent: Act.18:20.†
(AS)
G1962.strong_def: to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to assent

G0755.def:
ἀρχι-τρίκλινος, -ου, ὁ
(τρί-κλινος or -ον, a room with three couches)
the superintendent of a banquet, whose duty it was to arrange the tables and food (DB, ii, 253): Jhn.2:8-9.†
(AS)
G0755.derivation: from G746 (ἀρχή) and a compound of G5140 (τρεῖς) and G2827 (κλίνω) (a dinner-bed, because composed of three couches);

G2733.def:
κατ-οικία, -ας, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹשָׁב, Exo.35:3, al. ;]
1. a dwelling: Act.17:26.
2. a settlement (Polyb.).†
(AS)
G2733.strong_def: residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself)

G1008.def:
βοτάνη, -ῆς, ἡ
(βόσκω), [in LXX for עֵשֶׂב, דֶשֶׁא, חָצִיר ;]
1. grass, fodder.
2. green herb: Heb.6:7.†
SYN.: λάχανον, a garden herb, a vegetable. (AS)

G0249.def:
ἄ-λογος, -ον
[in LXX: Exo.6:12 (שָׂפָה עָרֵל), Num.6:12 (נָפַל), Job.11:12, Wis.11:15-16, 4Ma.3:1-21 * ;]
1. without reason, irrational: ζῷα, 2Pe.2:12, Ju 10.
2. contrary to reason: Act.25:27 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0249.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3056 (λόγος);

G4419.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4420 (πτέρυξ);

G0583.def:
ἀπο-γράφω
[in LXX: Jdg.8:14, Pro.22:20 (כָּתַב), I Est.8:30, 3Ma.2:29 3Mac 4:14 3Mac 6:34 3Mac 6:38 * ;]
1. to write out, copy.
2. to enrol; mid., to enrol oneself: Luk.2:1 (M, Pr., 162; but. see ICC, in l), Luk.2:3, 5; pass., Heb.12:23 (see reff, see word ἀπογραφή ).†
(AS)
G0583.strong_def: to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol

G2807.def:
κλείς, -δός Att.. accusative, κλεῖν, later -εῖδα, pl., κλεῖδες, -ας, contr., -εῖς, ἡ,
[in LXX for מַפְתֵּחַ, Isa.22:22, al. ;]
a key. Fig., τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν, Mat.16:19; τ. γνώσεως, Luk.11:52; of David (cf. LXX, l.with), Rev.3:7; τ. θανάτου κ. τ. ᾅδου, Rev.1:18; τ. ἀβύσσαυ, Rev.20:1; τ. φρέατος τῆς ἀ., Rev.9:1.†
(AS)
G2807.strong_def: a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively

G3344.strong_def: to turn across, i.e. transmute or (figuratively) corrupt

G2670.def:
κατα-πονίζω
[in LXX for טָבַע pu., Exo.15:4 A, בָּלַע pi., שָׁטַף, Psa.55:9 69:2, al. ;]
to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein: Mat.14:30; pass., Mat.18:6.†
(AS)
G2670.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of the same as G4195 (Πόντος);

G3867.strong_def: to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course)

G0959.def:
Βερνίκη (elsewhere Βερενίκη), Macedonian form of Φερενίκη, cf. Veronica, Victoria), -ης, ἡ,
Bernice, Berenice, dau. of Herod Agrippa I: Act.25:13, 23 26:3o.†
(AS)
G0959.strong_def: victorious; Bernice, a member of the Herodian family
G0959.derivation: from a provincial form of G5342 (φέρω) and G3529 (νίκη);

G2522.def:
καθημερινός, -ή, -όν
(καθ ̓ ἡμέραν), [in LXX: Jdth.12:15 * ;]
daily (MGr. καθημερνός): Act.6:1.†
(AS)

G1096.def:
γίνομαι, Ion. and κοινή for Att. γίγν- (M. Pr., 47; Bl., §6, 8 Mayser, 166 f.),
[in LXX chiefly for היה ;]
1. of persons, things occurrences, to come into being, be born, arise, come on: Jhn.1:15 8:58, 1Co.15:37; a first appearance in public, Mrk.1:4, Jhn.1:6, al.; before ἐκ (of birth), Rom.1:3, Gal.4:4; διά, Jhn.1:3; βροντή, Jhn.12:29; σεισμός, Rev.6:12; γογγυσμός, Act.6:1; χαρά, Act.8:8, many other similar exx.; ἡμέρα, Luk.22:66, al.; ὀψέ, Mrk.11:19; πρωΐα, Mat.27:1; νύξ, Act.27:27.
2. Of events, to come to pass, take place, happen: Mat.5:18, Mrk.5:14, Luk.1:20 2:15, Act.4:21, 2Ti.2:18, al.; μὴ γένοιτο [LXX for חָלִילָה, Jhn.22:29, al.], far be it, God forbid: Rom.3:4 (ICC, in l.), 1Co.6:15 and frequently in Pl.; καὶ ἐγένετο, ἐγένετο δέ ([in LXX for וַיְהִי ;] see Burton, 142 f.; M, Pr., 16f.; Dalman, Words, 32 f.; Robertson, Gr., 1042 f.), with indic, Mat.7:28, Luk.1:8, al.; before καί and indic., Luk.8:1, Act.5:7, al.; with accusative and inf., Mrk.2:23, Luk.3:21, al.; ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο, before τοῦ with inf., Act.10:25; with dative of person(s), to befall one: with inf., Act.20:16; with accusative and inf., Act.22:6; with adv., εὖ, Eph.6:3; τ́ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ (Field, Notes, 115), Act.7:40 (LXX); before εἰς, Act.28:6.
3. to be made, done, performed, observed, enacted, ordained, etc.: Mat.6:10 19:8, Mrk.2:27 11:23, Act.19:26, al.; before διά with genitive, Mrk.6:2, Act.2:43; ὑπό, Luk.13:17; ἐκ, Luk.4:23; ἐν, 1Co.9:15; ἀπογραφή, Luk.2:2; ἀνάκρισις Act.25:26; ἄφεσις, Heb.9:22; ὁ νόμος, Gal.3:17; τὸ πάσχα, Mat.26:2.
4. to become, be made, come to be: with pred., Mat.4:3, Luk.4:3, Jhn.2:9, 1Co.13:11, al.; before ὡς, ὡσεί, Mat.10:25, Mrk.9:26; εἰς (M, Pr., 71f.), Mrk.12:1o, al.; with genitive Rev.11:15; id., of age, Luk.2:42; with dative, γ. ἀνδρί ([LXX for הָיָה לְאִישׁ, Rut.1:12, al. ;] see Field, Notes, 156), Rom.7:3, 4; before ἐν, Act.22:17, Rev.1:10, al.; ἐπάνω, Luk.19:19; μετά, with genitive, Mrk.16:[10], Act.9:19; before εἰς, ἐπί (Field, Notes, 135), κατά (ib., 62), with accusative of place, Act.20:16 21:35 27:7, al.; before ἐκ, Mrk.9:7, Luk.3:22, 2Th.2:7, al. Aoristic pf. γέγονα (M, Pr., 52, 145f.; Field, Notes, 1f.), Mat.25:6, Luk.10:36, al. Aor. ἐγενήθη (for ἐγένετο, M, Pr., 139f.; Mayser, 379), Mat.11:23, al. (Cf. απο-, δια-, επι-, παρα-, συμ-, παρα-, προ-.)
(AS)
G1096.strong_def: to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e. (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.)
G1096.derivation: a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb;

G5456.strong_def: a tone (articulate, bestial or artificial); by implication, an address (for any purpose), saying or language
G5456.derivation: probably akin to G5316 (φαίνω) through the idea of disclosure;

G0646.def:
άποστασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀφίστημι), [in LXX for מַעַל, etc. ;]
defection, apostasy, revolt; in late Gk. (MM, Exp., viii; Lft., Notes, 111; Cremer, 308) for cl. ἀπόστασις, frequently in sense of political revolt, in LXX (e.g. Jos.22:22, 2Ch.29:19, Jer.2:19) and NT always of religious apostasy: Act.21:21, 2Th.2:3.†
(AS)
G0646.derivation: feminine of the same as G647 (ἀποστάσιον);

G2429.def:
ἰκμάς, -άδος, ἡ
[in LXX. Jer.17:8 (יוּבַל), Job.26:14 (שֶׁמֶץ)* ;]
moisture: Luk.8:6.†
(AS)

G0657.def:
ἀπο-τάσσω
[in LXX: Ecc.2:20 (יָאַשׁ pi.), I Est.6:27, Jer.20:2, 1-18; 1Ma.4:1-61 * ;]
to set apart. Mid., in late Gk. (El., § 37, 1; Swete, Mk., 136 f.; MM, e. dative,
(a) to take leave of: Mrk.6:46, Luk.9:61, Act.18:18, 21, 2Co.2:13;
(b) to forsake: Luk.14:33.†
(AS)
G0657.strong_def: literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce
G0657.derivation: middle voice from G575 (ἀπό) and G5021 (τάσσω);

G4708.strong_def: more speedily, i.e. sooner than otherwise

G4458.strong_def: an enclitic particle of indefiniteness of manner; somehow or anyhow; used only in composition
G4458.derivation: adverb from the base of G4225 (πού);

G4783.strong_def: a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) accord with

G2474.def:
Ἰσραήλ (FlJ, Ἰσράηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. יִשְׂרָאֵל, Gen.32:28),
Israel: ὁ οἶκος Ἰ., Act.7:42 (LXX), al.; λαός, Act.4:10; υὁοί, Act.5:21, al.; αἱ φυλαὶ τοῦ Ἰ., Mat.19:28, al. By meton., for the Israelites, Mat.2:6, Luk.1:54, Rom.11:2, al.; ὁ λαὸς Ἰ., Act.4:10; γῆ Ἰ., Mat.2:20-21; βασιλεὺς Ἰ., Mat.27:42, Jhn.1:50; ἡ ἐλπὶς τοῦ Ἰ., Act.28:20; ὁ Ἰ. τοῦ θεοῦ (of Christians), Gal.6:16; ὁ Ἰ. κατὰ σάρκα, 1Co.10:18
(AS)
G2474.strong_def: Israel (i.e. Jisrael), the adopted name of Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively)

G1933.def:
ἐπιεικής, -ές
(εἰκός, likely), [in LXX: Psa.86:5 (סַלָּח), Est.8:13 * ;]
1. seemly, fitting (Hom.).
2. equitable, fair, moderate: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.3:2, 1Pe.2:18, Jas.3:17; τὸ ἐ. (Thuc., i, 76), Php.4:5 (cf. Mayor, Ja, l.with, and see: ἐπιεικία).†
ἐπιείκεια see: ἐπιεικία
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2:19 12:18 Bar.2:27, from LXX Bar.4:24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2:22 2Mac 10:4, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 7:6 * ;]
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): Act.24:4; with πραΰτης, 2Co.10:1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii) (AS)

G1770.def:
ἐν-νεύω
[in LXX: Pro.6:13 10:10 (קָרַץ), Sir.27:22 A * ;]
to nod to, make a sign to: with dative of person(s), Luk.1:62.†
(AS)
G1770.strong_def: to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture

G0002.def:
Ἀαρών (Heb. אַהֲרוֹן), indecl. (in FlJ, -ῶνος),
Aaron (Exo.4:14, al.): Luk.1:5, Act.7:40, Heb.5:4, 7:11, 9:4.†
(AS)

G0385.def:
ἀνα-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for לָקַח, עָלָה hi. ;]
to draw up: Luk.14:5, Act.11:10 (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G1116.def:
Γόμορρα, -ας, ἡ, and -ων, τά (Heb. עֲמֹרָה),
Gomorrah, one of the cities of the plain (Gen.19): Mat.10:15, Rom.9:29" (LXX), 2Pe.2:6, Ju 7.†
(AS)
G1116.strong_def: Gomorrha (i.e. Amorah), a place near the Dead Sea

G0171.def:
ἀκαίρως, adv.
(ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), [in LXX: Si 35 (32):4 * ;]
out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), 2Ti.4:2 (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0171.derivation: adverb from the same as G170 (ἀκαιρέομαι);

G2894.def:
κόφινος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Jdg.6:19 (סַל), Psa.81:6 (דּוּד)* ;]
