a murderer, manslayer (Eur.; see MM, VGT, see word): Jhn.8:44, 1Jn.3:16.†
SYN.: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (see Tr., Syn, § 83) (AS)

G4451.strong_def: ignition, i.e. (specially), smelting (figuratively, conflagration, calamity as a test)

G0278.def:
ἀ-μεταμέλητος, -ον
(μεταμέλομαι),
not repented of, unregretted: Rom.11:29, 2Co.7:10.†
(AS)
G0278.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3338 (μεταμέλλομαι);

G0648.def:
ἀπο-στεγάζω
(στέγη), [in Sm.: Jer.29:11 * ;]
to unroof: Mrk.2:4.†
(AS)
G0648.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and a derivative of G4721 (στέγη);

G4822.gloss: compact, assuredly gather, intrust, knit together, prove
G4822.strong_def: causative (by reduplication) of the base of G939 (βάσις)); to drive together, i.e. unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach

G1647.def:
ἐλαχιστότερος
(for corresp. superl., see LS; see also Bl., § 44, 3);
less than the least: Eph.3:8.†
(AS)

G3076.gloss: cause grief, grieve, be in heaviness, (be) sorrow(-ful), be (make) sorry
G3076.strong_def: to distress; reflexively or passively, to be sad

G0404.def:
ἀνα-ψύχω
[in LXX for נָפַשׁ ni., חָיָה, etc. (frequently in sense of revive, refresh oneself) ;]
to refresh: with accusative of person(s), 2Ti.1:16 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 588).†
(AS)
G0404.strong_def: properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve

G2886.def:
κοσμικός, -ή, -όν
(κόσμος)
1. pertaining to the world or universe.
2. of this world, earthly. Heb.9:1.
3. In ethical sense, worldly: ἐπιθυμίαι, Tit.2:12.†
(AS)

G1952.def:
ἐπι-λείπω
[in LXX: Ob 5 א1 R (שָׁאַר hi.) * ;]
to fail: with accusative of person(s), Heb.11:32.†
(AS)
G1952.strong_def: to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for

G3579.strong_def: to be a host (passively, a guest); by implication, be (make, appear) strange

G4572.derivation: genitive case from G4571 (σέ) and G846 (αὐτός), also dative case of the same, , and accusative case , likewise contracted , , and , respectively;

G2953.strong_def: a Cyprian (Cypriot), i.e. inhabitant of Cyprus

G4059.strong_def: to cut around, i.e. (specially) to circumcise
G4059.derivation: from G4012 (περί) and the base of G5114 (τομώτερος);

G3814.strong_def: a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant

G0792.def:
ἀστήρ, -έρος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כּוֹכָב ;]
a star: Mat.2:2, 7-10 :, Mrk.13:25, 1Co.15:41, Rev.6:13 8:10-12 9:1 12:1, 4; metaphorically, ὁ ἀ. ὁ πρωϊνός Rev.2:28 22:16; ἀ. πλαῆται, Ju 13; ἀ. ἑπτά, symbolizing the angels of the seven churches, Rev.1:16, 20 2:1 3:1 (cf. ἄστρον, and see DCG, ii, 674 f.; MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0792.strong_def: a star (as strown over the sky), literally or figuratively
G0792.derivation: probably from the base of G4766 (στρώννυμι);

G2318.def:
θεοσεβής, -ές
(θεός, σέβομαι), [in LXX for אֱלֹהִים יָרֵא, Exo.18:21, al. ;]
God-fearing, godly: Jhn.9:31.†
SYN.: εὐσεβής (which see), θρῆσκος (AS)

G2729.def:
κατ-ισχύω
[in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
to overpower, prevail against, prevail: absol., Luk.23:23; with inf., Luk.21:36; with genitive, Mat.16:18.†
(AS)

G4941.strong_def: an accident; Syntyche, a Christian female

G3625.strong_def: land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire
G3625.derivation: feminine participle present passive of G3611 (οἰκέω) (as noun, by implication, of G1093 (γῆ));

G1597.def:
ἔκ-παλαι
adv. (of a class of compound adverbs common in late Gk.; see Mayor on 2 Pe, l.with),
for a long time, from of old: 2Pe.2:3 3:5.†
(AS)
G1597.strong_def: long ago, for a long while

G1040.def:
βύσσος, -οῦ, ἡ (cf. Heb. בּוּץ),
[in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ ;]
byssus, a fine species of flax, also the linen made from it: Luk.16:19.†
(AS)

G3356.strong_def: to be moderate in passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently)
G3356.derivation: from a compound of the base of G3357 (μετρίως) and G3806 (πάθος);

G1200.def:
δεσμο-φύλαξ, -κος, ὁ
(δεσμός, φύλαξ),
a prison-keeper, gaoler: Act.16:23, 27, 36 (cf. ἀρχιδ-, Gen.39:21).†
(AS)

G2416.def:
ἱερο-συλέω, -ῶ
(ἱερόσυλος, which see), [in LXX: 2Ma.9:2 * ;]
to rob a temple (commit sacrilege, R, mg.): Rom.2:22.†
(AS)

G2273.def:
1. = ἦ τοι, now surely, truly, verily , (Iliad by Homer); after ἀλλ᾽ εἰ . ., nevertheless , (Iliad by Homer)
2. = ἤτοι, either in truth , followed by ἤ, or , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G1521.def:
εἰσ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא, hi. ;]
to bring in: with accusative, Luk.2:27, Jhn.18:16, Act.7:45; before εἰς, Luk.22:54, Act.9:8 21:28-29, 37 22:24, Heb.1:6; ὧδε, Luk.14:21.†
(AS)

G0600.def:
ἀπο-καθ-ίστημι (ἀποκαθιστάω, Mrk.9:12, Rec., -ιστάνω, LTTr.; cf. Act.1:6; -κατιστάνω, WH),
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
1. to restore, i.e. to a former condition: of health, Mat.12:13, Mrk.3:5 8:25, Luk.6:10; of social or political affairs, Mat.17:11, Mrk.9:12, Act.1:6.
2. to give back, bring back: Heb.13:19 (so in π., MM, see word; cf. also Cremer, 312).†
(AS)
G0600.strong_def: to reconstitute (in health, home or organization)

G1247.def:
διακονέω, ῶ
(δίακονος);
1. generally, to minister, serre, wait upon, especially at table, to do one a service, cure for one's needs: absol., Mat.20:28, Mrk.10:45, Luk.10:40 22:26, 27, Jhn.12:2, 1Pe.4:11; ὅσα διηκόνησεν, 2Ti.1:18; with dative of person(s), Mat.4:11 8:15 25:44 27:55, Mrk.1:13, 31 15:41, Luk.4:39 8:3 12:37 17:8, Jhn.12:26, Act.6:2 19:22, Rom.15:25, Phm 13, Heb.6:10.
2. to serve as deacon: 1Ti.3:10, 3:13.
3. C. accusative of thing(s), to minister, supply, supply by ministration: 1Pe.1:12 4:10; pass., 2Co.3:3 8:19, 20.†
SYN.: λειτουργέω, which see (Cremer, 179). (AS)
G1247.strong_def: to be an attendant, i.e. wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a Christian deacon

G2379.def:
θυσιαστήριον, -ου, τό
(θυσιάζω, to sacrifice), [in LXX (where the word first appears) very freq., nearly always for מַדְבַּח ;]
an altar:
(a) generally, Jas.2:21; pl., Rom.11:3 (LXX); metaphorically, Heb.13:10 (see Westc., in l, and esp. his add, note on the history of the word, 455 ff.);
(b) of the altar of burnt-offering in the Temple, Mat.5:23-24 23:18-20, 35, Luk.11:51, 1Co.9:13 10:18, Heb.7:13, Rev.11:1;
(with) of the altar of incense in the sanctuary (Exo.30:1, al.), Luk.1:11; symbolically in Heaven, Rev.6:9 8:3 9:13 14:18 16:7 (Cremer, 292).†
(AS)
G2379.strong_def: a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative)

G4519.strong_def: armies; sabaoth (i.e. tsebaoth), a military epithet of God
G4519.derivation: of Hebrew origin (H06635 in feminine plural);

G0634.def:
ἀπο-πίπτω
[in LXX for מָלַל, נָפַל, etc. ;]
to fall off: Act.9:18.†
(AS)

G2505.def:
καθά
adv. (for καθ᾽ ἅ), [in LXX: Gen.7:9 19:8, al. (אֲשֶׁר, כְּ), Isa.58:11, Wis.3:10, al. ;]
just as, according as: Mat.27:10 (LXX), Luk.1:2, D (cf. BL, § 78, 1; Phil. Gosp., 8 f.).†
(AS)
G2505.strong_def: according to which things, i.e. just as
G2505.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and the neuter plural of G3739 (ὅς);

G0319.def:
ἀνα-γνωρίζω
[in LXX: Gen.45:1 (יָדַע hith.)* ;]
to recognize: Act.7:13 (WH, txt., ἐγνωρίσθη).†
(AS)
G0319.derivation: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G1107 (γνωρίζω);

G0998.def:
βοηθός, -ον (see: βοηθέω),
[in LXX chiefly for עזר ;]
1. (poët. -όος), hasting to the war-cry (Hom.).
2. helping, auxiliary; as subst. (Hdt.), a helper: Heb.13:6 (LXX).
† (AS)

G1046.def:
Γαδαρηνός, -ή, -όν
(Γαδαρά, Gadara, the capital of Peræa),
Gadarene, of Gadara: Mat.8:28 (Rec. Γεργεσηνῶν), Mrk.5:1, Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν), Luk.8:26, 37 Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν).†
(AS)
G1046.strong_def: a Gadarene or inhabitant of Gadara
G1046.derivation: from (a town east of the Jordan);

G2353.def:
θρέμμα, -τος, τό
(τρέφω)
1. a nurseling, esp. of animals (Eur., Plat., al.).
2. cattle: Jhn.4:12.†
(AS)

G4844.strong_def: to partake a beverage in company

G0853.def:
ἀφανίζω
(ἀφανής), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם ni., שָׁמַד hi., etc. ;]
1. to make unseen, hide from sight (Xen., a1.).
2. Later (MM, see word)
(a) to destroy: Mat.6:19-20;
(b) to disfigure: Mat.6:16. Pass., to vanish: Jas.4:14; to perish: Act.13:41(LXX).†
(AS)
G0853.strong_def: to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed)

G1950.def:
ἐπι-λανθάνομαι
(alternative mid, form of ἐπιλήθω, to cause to forget) [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַח ;]
to forget, neglect: with inf., Mat.16:5, Mrk.8:14; with genitive, Heb.6:10 13:2, 16; with accusative (as occasionally in cl.; MM, Exp., xiv), Php.3:13; ὁποῖος ἦν, Jas.1:24; pass. ptcp. (cf. Isa.23:16, Sir.3:14 23:14, Wis.2:4), Luk.12:6.†
(AS)
G1950.strong_def: to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect
G1950.derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2990 (λανθάνω);

G4688.strong_def: a speculator, i.e. military scout (spy or (by extension) life-guardsman)

G0263.def:
ἀμάραντος, -ον
(μαραίνομαι), [in LXX: Wis.6:12 (σοφία)* ;]
un­fading (whence ὁ ἀ., the amaranth, an unfading flower): 1Pe.1:4 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0263.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3133 (μαραίνω);

G1900.def:
ἐπ-έκεινα
adv. (= ἐπ᾽ ἐκεῖνα), [in LXX: Lev.22:27, Num.32:19, al. (הָלְאָה), etc. ;]
beyond; with genitive, Act.7:43 (LXX) †
(AS)
G1900.strong_def: upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of
G1900.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and (the accusative case plural neuter of) G1565 (ἐκεῖνος);

G5491.strong_def: a lip (as a pouring place); figuratively, a margin (of water)
G5491.derivation: from a form of the same as G5490 (χάσμα);

G2564.def:
καλέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for קרא ;]
1. to call, summon: with accusative of person(s), Mat.20:8 25:14, Mrk.3:31, Luk.19:13, Act.4:18; before ἐκ, Mat.2:15 (LXX); metaphorically, 1Pe.2:9.
2. to call to one's house, invite: Luk.14:16, 1Co.10:27, Rev.19:9; εἰς τ. γάμους, Mat.22:3, 9 Luk.14:8, 9 Jhn.2:2; ὁ καλέσας, Luk.7:39; οἱ κεκλημένοι, Mat.22:8; metaphorically, of inviting to partake of the blessings of the kingdom of God (Dalman, Words, 118f.): Rom.8:30 9:24, 25 1Co.7:17, 18; before εἰς, 1Co.1:9, 1Th.2:12, 1Ti.6:12; ὁ καλῶν (καλέσας), of God, Gal.1:6 5:8, 1Th.5:24, 1Pe.1:15, 2Pe.1:3; οἱ κεκλκλημένοι, Heb.9:15; before ἐν (ἐπί), 1Co.7:15, Gal.5:13, Eph.4:4, 1Th.4:7; κλήσει, Eph.4:1, 2Ti.1:9.
3. to call, name call by name: pass., Mat.2:23, Luk.1:32, al.; καλούμενος, Luk.7:11, Act.7:58, al.; ὁ κ. (Deiss., BS, 210), Luk.6:15 22:3 23:33, Act.10:1, Rev.12:9, al.; with pred nom., Mat.5:9, Luk.1:35, Rom.9:26, Jas.2:23, 1Jn.3:1. (Cf. ἀντι-, ἐν-, εἰσ- (-μαι), ἐπι-, μετα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, προ-, προσ-, συν-καλέω.)
(AS)
G2564.strong_def: to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise)
G2564.derivation: akin to the base of G2753 (κελεύω);

G0147.def:
αἰσχροκερδῶς, adv.,
from eagerness for base gain: 1Pe.5:2 (here only).†
(AS)

G0396.def:
ἀνα-τρέπω
[in LXX for דָּחָה, הָדַף, etc. ;]
to overturn, destroy: Jhn.2:15 WH, txt.; metaphorically, to subvert (MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.2:18, Tit.1:11.†
(AS)
G0396.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);

G2540.def:
καιρός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עֵת, also for מוֹעֵד, etc. ;]
1. due measure, fitness, proportion (Eur., Xen., al.).
2. Of Time (cl. also) in the sense of a fixed and definite period, time, season (Kennedy, Sources, 153): Mat.11:25, Mrk.1:15, Luk.21:8, Rom.13:11, Eph.6:18, Heb.11:15, 1Pe.1:5 1:11 Rev.1:3, al.; with genitive, πειρασμοῦ Luk.8:13; τ. καρπῶν, Mat.21:34; σύκων, Mrk.11:13; pl., Mat.21:41; χρόνοι ἢ (καὶ) κ., Act.1:7, 1Th.5:1; ἐθνῶν, Luk.21:24; of opportune or seasonable time, Act.24:25, Gal.6:10, Eph.5:16, Col.4:5; with inf., Heb.11:15; ὁ κ. οὗτος, Mrk.10:30, Luk.18:30; ὁ νῦν κ. (Dalman, Words, 148), Rom.8:18; ὁ κ. ὁ ἐμός, Jhn.7:6; κ. δεκτῲ, 2Co.6:2 (LXX); δουλεύειν τῷ κ., Rom.12:11, R, mg.; τ. σημεῖα τῶν κ., Mat.16:3; adverbial usages: ἐν κ., Mat.24:45, 1Pe.5:6 (cf. καιρῷ, Luk.20:10; τῷ κ., Mrk.12:2); ἄχρι καιροῦ, Luk.4:13; πρὸς καιρόν, Luk.8:13, 1Co.7:5; κατὰ καιρόν, Rom.5:6; πρὸ καιροῦ, Mat.8:29
SYN.: (χρόνος) time in the sense of duration (AS)
G2540.strong_def: an occasion, i.e. set or proper time

G4910.strong_def: to entertain sumptuously in company with, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to revel together
G4910.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of a presumed compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G2192 (ἔχω) (meaning to be in good condition, i.e. (by implication) to fare well, or feast);

G1254.def:
δια-κωλεύω
[in LXX: Jdth.4:7 12:7 * ;]
to hinder, prevent: with accusative, Mat.3:14.†
(AS)
G1254.strong_def: to hinder altogether, i.e. utterly prohibit

G3310.strong_def: a portion, i.e. province, share or (abstractly) participation

G5271.strong_def: to decide (speak or act) under a false part, i.e. (figuratively) dissemble (pretend)
G5271.derivation: middle voice from G5259 (ὑπό) and G2919 (κρίνω);

G0415.def:
ἀν-ελεήμων, -ον
(-ἀ, ἐλεήμων), [in LXX for אַכְזָר ;]
without mercy: Rom.1:13.†
(AS)
G0415.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1655 (ἐλεήμων);

G2124.def:
εὐλάβεια, -ας, ἡ
(εὐλαβής), [in LXX: Jer.22:24 (דְּאָגָה), Pro.28:14, Wis.17:8 * ;]
1. caution, discretion (Soph., Plat., al.).
2. In later Gk. (Diod., Plut., al.), also reverence, godly fear: Heb.5:7 12:28.†
(AS)
G2124.strong_def: properly, caution, i.e. (religiously) reverence (piety); by implication, dread (concretely)

G0413.def:
ἀνέκλειπτος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐκλείπω),
unfailing: Luk.12:33 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0413.strong_def: not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible
G0413.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1587 (ἐκλείπω);

G1825.def:
ἐξ-εγείρω
[in LXX for עוּר ni., hi., etc. ;]
to raise up: Rom.9:17 (cf. ICC, in l); from the dead, 1Co.6:14.†
(AS)
G1825.strong_def: to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction)

G0248.def:
ἀλοάω, -ῶ
(ἅλως, see: ἅλων; and cf. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for דּוּשׁ ;]
to thresh: 1Co.9:9 9:13; 1Ti.5:18.†
(AS)

G2805.def:
κλαυθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κλαίω), [in LXX chiefly for בְּכִי ;]
crying, weeping, Act.20:37; κ. καὶ ὀδυρμός, Mat.2:18 (LXX); ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ βρυγμός, Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30, Luk.13:28.†
(AS)

G1828.def:
ἐξ-έλκω
[in LXX: Gen.37:28 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;]
to draw out or away: metaphorically, ὑπὸ τ. ἐπιθυμίας, Jas.1:14 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)
G1828.strong_def: to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin)

G0753.def:
ἀρχι-τέκτων, -ονος, ὁ
(τέκτων), [in LXX: Isa.3:3 (חָרָשׁ) Sir.38:27. 2Ma.2:29 * ;]
a master-builder, architect: 1Co.3:10 (in π. of building contractors, MM, see word).†
(AS)

G4560.strong_def: similar to flesh, i.e. (by analogy) soft

G1031.def:
βρύχω (Attic, βρύκω),
[in LXX: Job.16:10(9), Psa.34 (35):16 36 (37):12 111 (112):10, La 2:16 (חרק)* ;]
1. to bite or eat greedily.
2. to gnash, grind, with the teeth: Act.7:54.
† (AS)
G1031.strong_def: to grate the teeth (in pain or rage)

G3764.gloss: as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet

G0865.def:
ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος, -ον
without love of good: 2Ti.3:3 (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but see MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0865.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5358 (φιλάγαθος);

G2754.def:
κενοδοξία, -ας, ἡ
(κενόδοξος), [in LXX: Wis.14:14, 2Ma.2:15 2Mac 8:10 * ;]
1. foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with).
2. vain­glory, groundless conceit: Php.2:3.†
(AS)

G2196.def:
Ζαρά, ὁ indecl. (Heb. זֶרַח, Gen.38:30),
Zerah, an ancestor of Jesus: Mat.1:3.†
(AS)

G4753.strong_def: an armament, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops (more or less extensive or systematic)

G0211.def:
ἀλάβαστρον, -ου, τό (also -ος, ὁ, ἡ; colloq. and κοινή for ἀλάβαστος),
[in LXX: 4Ki.21:13 (צַלַּחַת)* ;]
a box of alabaster (ἀλαβαστίτης) for ointment: Mat.26:7, Mrk.14:3, Luk.7:37 (see DCG, i, 41b; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0211.strong_def: properly, an "alabaster" box, i.e. (by extension) a perfume vase (of any material)
G0211.derivation: neuter of (of uncertain derivation), the name of a stone;

G4805.strong_def: co-yoked, i.e. (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as a proper name; Syzygus, a Christian

G1062.def:
γάμος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX for מִשְׁתֶּה ;]
1. a wedding, esp. a wedding-feast: Mat.22:8, 10 11, 12, Jhn.2:1-3, Rev.19:7, 9; pl. (Field, Notes, 16), Mat.22:2-4, 9 25:10, Luk.12:36 14:8.
2. marriage: Heb.13:4 (Cremer, 666).
† (AS)

G1655.def:
ἐλεήμων, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for חַנּוּן ;]
merciful: Mat.5:7, Heb.2:17.†
(AS)

G3803.strong_def: a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation)

G1245.def:
δια-καθαρίζω
= θαίρω: Mat.3:12.†
δια-καθαίρω,
to cleanse thoroughly: Luk.3:17.†
(AS)

G3100.strong_def: intransitively, to become a pupil; transitively, to disciple, i.e. enrol as scholar

G0816.def:
ἀτενίζω
(ἀτενής, strained, intent; τείνω), [in LXX: I Est.6:28, 3Ma.2:26 * ;]
to look fixedly, gaze (MM, see word): with dative of person(s), gaze upon: Luk.4:20 22:56, Act.3:12 10:4 14:9 23:1; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), Act.3:4 6:15 13:9; metaphorically, Act.1:10 7:55 11:6, 2Co.3:7 3:13.†
(AS)
G0816.derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a particle of union) and (to stretch);

G0689.def:
Ἀράμ indec. (Heb. רָם),
Aram: Mat.1:3-4, Luk.3:33 (R, txt., WH, Ἀρνεί).†
(AS)

G0217.def:
ἅλας (T, ἅλα), -ατος, τό, late form of cl. ἅλς, -ος, ὁ (MM, VGT, see word),
[in LXX chiefly for מְלַח ;]
salt, lit, and figuratively: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:50 Luk.14:34; like cl. ἅλες, wit, of wisdom and grace in speech: Col.4:6.†
(AS)

G4895.strong_def: to be in company with, i.e. present at the time
G4895.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and G1510 (εἰμί) (including its various inflections);

G1279.def:
δια-πορεύω
[in LXX for עָבַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
to carry over. Pass., to pass across, journey through: absol., Luk.18:36, Rom.15:24; before κατὰ πόλεις κ. κώμας, Luk.13:22; διά, with genitive, Mrk.2:23, Luk.6:1 (cf. Pro.9:12 with, Wis.3:1); with accusative, Act.16:4.†
(AS)

G4328.gloss: (be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for
G4328.strong_def: to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await

G1561.def:
ἐκ-δοχή ῆς, ἡ
(ἐκδέχομαι);
1. in cl.,
(a) a receiving from, succession;
(b) an interpretation.
2. In NT, = προσδοκία, expectation: Heb.10:27 (cf. Field, Notes, 231; Cremer, 688).†
(AS)

G1199.def:
δεσμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(δέω), [in LXX chiefly for אסר ;]
a band, bond: metaphorically, Luk.13:16; ὁ δεσμὸς τ. γλώσσης, Mrk.7:35 (for this expression in π., see Deiss., LAE, 306 ff.; of actual bonds, see Ruth., Gr., 9). Pl., δεσμοί, Php.1:13; δεσμά (as also in cl.), Luk.8:29, Act.16:26 20:23; genitive, dative, Act.23:29 26:29, 31, Php.1:7, 14, 17, Col.4:18, 2Ti.2:9, Phm 10, Heb.11:36, Ju 6; ἐν τοῖς δ. τοῦ εὐαγγελίου Phm 13.†
(AS)
G1199.strong_def: a band, i.e. ligament (of the body) or shackle (of a prisoner); figuratively, an impediment or disability
G1199.derivation: neuter and masculine respectively from G1210 (δέω);

G2346.def:
θλίβω
[in LXX chiefly (ὁ θλίβων, ) for צוּר ;]
to press: with accusative of person(s), Mrk.3:9; ὁδὸς τεθλιμμένη, a narrow (compressed) way, Mat.7:14. Metaphorical (as frequently in LXX), to oppress, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s), 2Th.1:6; pass. (Vg., tribulor, tribulation em patior), 2Co.1:6 4:8 7:5, 1Th.3:4, 2Th.1:7, 1Ti.5:10, Heb.11:37 (cf. ἀπο-, συν-θλίβω).†
(AS)
G2346.derivation: akin to the base of G5147 (τρίβος);

G1978.def:
ἐπίσημος, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: Gen.30:42 (קָשַׁר), Est.5:4 8:13, 1Ma.11:37 1Mac 14:48, 2Ma.15:36, 3Ma.6:1 * ;]
1. bearing a mark; of money, stamped, coined.
2. Metaphorical,
(a) in good sense, notable, illustrious: Rom.16:7;
(b) in bad sense, notorious: Mat.27:16.†
(AS)
G1978.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and some form of the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);

G2218.def:
ζυγός (in cl. more frequently τὸ ζυγόν), -οῦ, ὁ
(ζεύγνυμι), [in LXX for עֹל, מֹאזֵן, etc. ;]
1. a yoke; metaphorically, of bondage or submission to authority: Mat.11:29-30, Act.15:10, Gal.5:1, 1Ti.6:1.
2. a balance: Rev.6:5 (of. Isa.40:12, al.).†
(AS)
G2218.strong_def: a coupling, i.e. (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales)
G2218.derivation: from the root of (to join, especially by a "yoke");

G4975.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of the alternate of G2192 (ἔχω) as adverb;

G4529.derivation: probably from G4535 (σάλος) (from the surge on the shore);

G1061.def:
γαμίζω
(γάμος),
to give in marriage, a daughter: 1Co.7:38. Pass., Mat.22:30 24:38, Mrk.12:25, Luk.17:27 20:35 (WH, mg., γαμίσκονται; cf. γαμίζω).†
(AS)
G1061.strong_def: to espouse (a daughter to a husband)

G0645.def:
ἀπο-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָתַק: ni., hi., etc. ;]
to draw off or away, tear away (MM, see word): Act.20:30; μάχαιραν, draw a sword, Mat.26:51; pass., to be parted or withdrawn (Field, Notes, 134; but see Thayer, see word), Luk.22:41, Act.21:1.†
(AS)
G0645.strong_def: to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously)

G2277.def:
1. as Substantive Verb, to be, to exist , οὐκ ἔσθ᾽ οὗτος ἀνήρ, οὐδ᾽ ἔσσεται (Odyssey by Homer); τεθνηῶτος, μηδ᾽ ἔτ᾽ ἐόντος (Odyssey by Homer); οὐκέτ᾽ ἔστι he is no more , (Euripides); θεοὶ αἰὲν ἐόντες (Iliad by Homer); ἐσσόμενοι posterity, (Iliad by Homer); ζώντων καὶ ὄντων Ἀθηναίων (Demosthenes Orator):—;so of cities, etc., ὄλωλεν, οὐδ᾽ ἔτ᾽ ἔστι Τροία (compare Troja fuit) , (Euripides)
2. of things, to be, exist , εἰ ἔστιν ἀληθέως [ ἡ τράπεζα] (Herdotus Historicus); ἕως ἂν ὁ πόλεμος ἦι so long as it last , (Thucydides)
3. to be , opposite to appearing to be , as esse to videri , τὸν ἐόντα λόγον the true story, (Herdotus Historicus); τὰ ὄντα ἀπαγγέλλειν (Thucydides); τῶι ὄντι, Lat. revera, in reality, in fact, (Plato Philosophus)
4. followed by the Relative, οὐκ ἔστιν ὅς, no one , (Iliad by Homer), etc.; εἰσὶν οἵ, Lat. sunt qui, (Thucydides), etc.; ἐστὶν ἅ some things , (Thucydides); also ἔστιν οἵ, for εἰσὶν οἵ, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—;so withrelat. Particles, ἔστιν ἔνθα, Lat. est ubi, (Xenophon Historicus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅπη, ἔσθ᾽ ὅπου, somewhere , or somehow , (Plato Philosophus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅπως in some manner , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅτε, ἔσθ᾽ ὅτε, sometimes , (Sophocles Tragicus), etc.
5. ἔστι impersonal, with infinitive, like πάρεστι, it is possible , (Homer), attic
6. to be , Copula connecting predicate with subject, both being in the same case, (Homer), etc.
7. sometimes εἶναι with Part. represents finite Verb, ἦν τεθνηκώς, for ἐτεθνήκει, (Aeschulus Tragicus); πεφυκός ἐστι = πέφυκε, (Aristophanes Comicus)
8. the Inf. is redundant in some phrases, ἑκὼν εἶναι (see. ἑκών II); τὸ ἐπ᾽ ἐκείνοις εἶναι quantum in illis esset , (Thucydides); τὸ σύμπαν εἶναι (Herdotus Historicus); τὸ νῦν εἶναι (Plato Philosophus), etc. (ML)
G2277.derivation: third person singular imperative of G1510 (εἰμί);

G5263.strong_def: to exhibit under the eyes, i.e. (figuratively) to exemplify (instruct, admonish)

G4770.strong_def: a "Stoic" (as occupying a particular porch in Athens), i.e. adherent of a certin philosophy

G1863.def:
ἐπ-άγω
[in LXX for בּוֹא hi., etc. (29 words in all) ;]
to bring upon: with dative and accusative, 2Pe.2:5; ἑαυτοῖς ἐ. (for cl. mid., see Mayor, in l), 2Pe.2:1; ἐ. τὸ αἷμα (cf. Ge 209), Act.5:28.†
(AS)
G1863.strong_def: to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a crime)

G0019.def:
ἀγαθωσύνη (on the termination, see: ἁγιότης, and cf . WH, App., 152; MM, VGT, see word), -ης, ἡ
(ἀγαθός), [in LXX for טוֹבָה, טוֹב, טוּב, only in Heb. bks. ;]
goodness (representing "the kindlier, as δικαιοσύνη, the sterner element in the ideal character," AE, Eph., 5:9; on its relation to χρηστότης, see Tr., Syn., §lxiii): Rom.15:14, Gal.5:22, 2Th.1:11.†
(AS)

G3574.strong_def: a day-and-night, i.e. full day of twenty-four hours

G2334.def:
θεωρέω, -ῶ
(θεωρός, a spectator, θεάομαι) [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה, חָזָה ;] (present and imperfect only, exc. Jhn.7:3 (fut.), Mat.28:1, Luk.23:48, Jhn.8:51, Rev.11:12 (aor.); El., § 24);
1. (cl.), to look at, gaze, behold: absol., Mat.27:55, Mrk.15:40, Luk.23:35; before πῶς, Mrk.12:41; ποῦ, Mrk.15:47; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.6:40, 62 12:45 16:10-19, Act.3:16 20:38 25:24, Rev.11:11-12; id. with ptcp., Mrk.5:15, Luk.10:18, Jhn.6:19 10:12 20:12, 14, 1Jn.3:17; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.28:1, Luk.14:29 21:6 23:48, Jhn.2:23 6:2 7:3, Act.4:13 8:13; id. with ptcp., Jhn.20:6, Act.7:56 10:11; before ὅτι, Act.19:26.
2. In popular lang. (Kennedy, Sources, 155; EL, § 24, see word ὁρᾶν), in present and imperfect = ὁράω, to see, perceive, discern: before ὅτι, Mrk.16:4, Jhn.4:19 12:19, Act.19:26 27:10; πόσαι, Act.21:20; πηλίκος, Heb.7:4; with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.5:38; id. with ptcp., Act.17:16 28:6; with accusative of person(s), Mrk.3:11, Jhn.14:19, Act.9:7 17:22; πνεῦμα, Luk.24:37; τὸ π., Jhn.14:17; before ὅτι, Jhn.9:8; with ptcp., Luk.24:39.
3. Hebraistically, to experience, partake of: τ. θάνατον, Jhn.8:51 (cf. Psa.89:49); τ. δόξαν, Jhn.17:24 (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-θερρέω).†
(AS)
G2334.strong_def: to be a spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge))
G2334.derivation: from a derivative of G2300 (θεάομαι) (perhaps by addition of G3708 (ὁράω));

G0639.def:
ἀπορέω, -ῶ
(ἄπορος, ἀ- neg., πόρος, a way, resource), [in LXX for צָרַר, מוּךְ, etc. ;]
to be at a loss, be perplexed: absol., Mrk.6:20 (ἐποίει, R, mg.); mid., be in doubt: absol., 2Co.4:8; with accusative, Act.25:20; before περί, Luk.24:4; ἐν, Gal.4:20; περὶ τίνος λέγει, Jhn.13:22.†
SYN.: διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, διστάζω, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491) (AS)
G0639.strong_def: to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally)
G0639.derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G4198 (πορεύομαι);

G0200.def:
ἀκρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אַרְבֶּה, also for חָגָב, etc. ;]
a locust: Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6, Rev.9:3, 7.†
(AS)
G0200.strong_def: a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation)
G0200.derivation: apparently from the same as G206 (ἄκρον);

G2071.def:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
I. As substantive verb.
1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.
4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.;
(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult.
2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:7, 2Ti.2:19.
4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): Act.1:8, 9:15, Rom.4:12, 1Co.1:18, 2:14, Rev.21:7, al.
5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mat.10:30, Luk.9:32, Jhn.3:24, Act.21:35, 1Co.15:19, al;
(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Luk.4:31, 14:1, Act.1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rom.12:9, 10, Heb.13:5, al.;
(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Luk.23:9.
6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:8, Heb.8:10, al.
7. C. adv.: Mat.19:20, Mrk.4:26, Luk.18:11, al.
8. Ellipses;
(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mat.8:29, 24:32, Jhn.21:22, 23, Heb.6:4, al.;
(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mat.14:27, Mrk.6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Deu.32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mrk.13:6, Jhn.4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)

G2367.def:
θύινος (usually θύϊνος, as Rec.), -η, -ον
(θυία, θύα, an African aromatic tree, with ornamentally veined wood of varying colour, = Lat. citrinus), [in Sm.: 3Ki.10:11 (אַלְמֻגִּים)* ;]
thyme: ξύλον, Rev.18:12 (Diosc.).†
(AS)
G2367.strong_def: denoting a certain fragrant tree); made of citron-wood
G2367.derivation: from a derivative of G2380 (θύω) (in the sense of blowing;

G0823.def:
ἄ-τομος, -ον
(τέμνω), [in Sm.: Isa.54:8 (MM, see word) * ;]
indivisible; of time, ἄτομον, a moment: ἐν ἄ., 1Co.15:52.†
(AS)
G0823.strong_def: uncut, i.e. (by implication) indivisible (an "atom" of time)
G0823.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G5114 (τομώτερος);

G1523.def:
εἰσ-δέχομαι
[in LXX for קָבַץ ;]
to admit, receive: 2Co.6:17 (LXX) (Cremer, 687).†
(AS)

G2445.def:
Ἰόππη (FlJ, id., and also Ἰόπη), -ης, ἡ, (Heb. יָפוֹ),
Joppa: Act.9:1-43 10:1-48 11:1-30.†
(AS)
G2445.strong_def: Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in Palestine

G1398.def:
δουλεύω
(δοῦλος), [in LXX for עָבַד, as Gen.14:4, exc. Da TH Dan.7:14, 27 (פְּלַח), Isa.56:6 (שָׁרַת pi.)* ;]
to be a slave, be subject to, serve: absol., Rom.7:6, Gal.4:25, 1Ti.6:2; with dative of person(s), Mat.6:24, Luk.15:29 16:13, Rom.9:12" (LXX) ; of nations, Jhn.8:33, Act.7:7" (LXX) ; θεῷ, τ. κυρίῳ, Mat.6:24, Luk.16:13, Act.20:19, Rom.12:11 (R, mg., καιρῷ) Rom.16:18, Eph.6:7, Col.3:24, 1Th.1:9; τ. Χριστῷ, Rom.14:18, Col.3:24; νόμῳ θεοῦ, Rom.7:25; τ. θεοῖς, Gal.4:8; τ. καιρῷ, Rom.12:11 (R, mg. for κυρίῳ); ἀλλήλοις, Gal.5:13; σὺν ἐμοί Php.2:22; τ. ἁμαρτίᾳ, Rom.6:6; νόμῳ ἁμαρτίας, Rom.7:25;
ἐπιθυμίαις κ. ἡδοναις, Tit.3:3; τ. κοιλία, Rom.16:18; μαμωνᾷ, Mat.6:24, Luk.16:13; τ. στοιχείοις τ, κόσμου, Gal.4:9 (Cremer, 217).†
(AS)
G1398.strong_def: to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary)

G4084.gloss: apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take
G4084.strong_def: to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting (capture))

G4070.strong_def: the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year

G3772.strong_def: the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity)
G3772.derivation: perhaps from the same as G3735 (ὄρος) (through the idea of elevation);

G2955.def:
κύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for קָדַד ;]
to bow the head, stoop down: Mrk.1:7; before κάτω, Jhn.8:6, 8 (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-, συν-κύπτω).†
κατα-κύπτω,
[in LXX: 4Ki.9:32 (שָׁקַף hi.)* ;]
to bend down, stoop: Jhn.8:8 (κάτω κύψας, Rec., WH, mg.).†
(AS)
G2955.derivation: probably from the base of G2949 (κῦμα);

G2406.def:
ἱεράτευμα, -τος, τό
(ἱερατεύω), [in LXX: βασίλειον ἱ., Exo.19:1-25 6:1-30 (כֹּהֵן מַמְלָכָה) Exo.23:22, 2Ma.2:17 * ;]
a priesthood, body of priests: ἱ ἅγιον, 1Pe.2:5; βασ. ἱ, 1Pe.2:9 (LXX, Ex, l.with).†
(AS)
G2406.strong_def: the priestly fraternity, i.e. sacerdotal order (figuratively)

G0041.def:
ἁγιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ἅγιος), [in LXX: 2Ma.15:2 * ;]
sanctity, holiness, regarded, properly, as an abstract quality (see next word, and cf. Lft. Notes, 49; MM, VGT, see word): 2Co.1:12, Heb.12:10.†
(AS)

G4350.strong_def: to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively)

G1433.def:
δωρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Gen.30:20 (זָבַד), Est.8:1, Pro.4:2 (נָתַן), Lev.7:15 (קׇרְבָּן), 1Es.1:7 Est.8:14 Est.8:55, Sir.7:25 * ;]
to present, bestow. As depon. (with same sense), -Ιομαι,.-οίμαι: Mrk.15:45, 2Pe.1:3-4.†
SYN.: δίδωμι, q.v (AS)

G0572.def:
ἀπλότης, -ητος, ή
(ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: 4Ki.15:11 (תֹּם), 1Ch.29:17 (לֵבָב יֹשֶׁר, ἁ. τῆς καρδίας, cf. Col.3:22, where see Lft.), Wis.1:1, al. ;]
simplicity, sincerity: Rom.12:8, 2Co.11:3, Eph.6:5, Col.3:22; as manifested in generous, unselfish giving, liberality, graciousness: 2Co.8:2 9:11 9:13 (see ICC, Rom.12:8; Hort, Jas.1:5, and see: ἁπλῶς).†
(AS)
G0572.strong_def: singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal)

G4345.strong_def: to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with

G1679.def:
ἐλπίζω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח, also for חָסָה, יָחַל pi., hi., etc. ;]
to look for, expect, hope (for): with accusative of thing(s), Rom.8:24-25, 1Co.13:7, Heb.11:1; with dative of thing(s) (τ. τύχῃ, Thuc., iii, 97, 2), Mat.12:21; before καθώς, 2Co.8:5; with inf., Luk.6:34 23:8, Act.26:7, Rom.15:24, 1Co.16:7, 2Co.5:11, Php.2:19, 23, 1Ti.3:14, II Jn 12, 3Jn.14; before ὅτι, with pres., Luk.24:21; with fut., Act.24:26, 2Co.1:13 13:6, Phm 22. As in LXX (WM, § xxxiii, d; and esp. in the pf., Ellic. on 1Ti.4:10; Bl., § 59, 2), with prep.; εἰς, Jhn.5:45 (see Ellis., l.with), 1Pe.3:5; before ὅτι, 2Co.1:10; ἐπί, with dative, Rom.15:12 (LXX 1Ti.4:10 6:17; ἐν, 1Co.15:19; with accusative, 1Pe.1:13 (aor. imper. see Bl., § 58, 2); τ. θεόν, 1Ti.5:5 (of. ἀπ-, προ-ελπίζω, see Cremer, 255).†
(AS)

G0651.def:
ἀπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποστέλλω), [in LXX: Deu.22:7, 3Ki.4:34 9:16 Psa.78:49, Ecc.8:8, Sng.4:13 (for שָׁלַח and its cognates), 1Es.9:51 Est.9:54, Jer.32:36, Bar.2:25, 1Ma.2:18, 2Ma.3:2 *.]
1. In cl., a sending away (MM, see word), as, an expedition (Hdt.).
2. In LXX
(a) discharge, dis­missal (Ecc.8:8);
(b) a gift (3Ki.9:16, 1Ma.2:13).
3. In NT, the office of an Apostle of Christ, apostleship: Act.1:25, Rom.1:5, 1Co.9:2, Gal.2:8 (Cremer, 530).†
(AS)

G3942.strong_def: apparently a state alongside of supposition, i.e. (concretely) an adage; specially, an enigmatical or fictitious illustration
G3942.derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and perhaps a derivative of G3633 (οἴομαι);

G3345.strong_def: to transfigure or disguise; figuratively, to apply (by accommodation)
G3345.derivation: from G3326 (μετά) and a derivative of G4976 (σχῆμα);

G0738.strong_def: just born, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert

G1585.def:
ἐκ-λανθάνω
[in Sm.: Psa.13:2 * ;]
to escape notice utterly; mid., to forget utterly: Heb.12:5.†
(AS)
G1585.derivation: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G2990 (λανθάνω);

G4836.strong_def: to be present together, i.e. to convene; by implication, to appear in aid

G0517.def:
ἀόρατος, -ον
(ὁράω), [in LXX: Gen.1:2 (תֹּהוּ), Isa.45:3 (מִסְתָּר), 2Ma.9:5 * ;]
unseen, invisible: Rom.1:20, Col.1:15-16, 1Ti.1:17, Heb.11:27.†
(AS)
G0517.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3707 (ὁρατός);

G5376.strong_def: fond of horses; Philippus, the name of four Israelites

G3165.derivation: a shorter (and probably original) form of G1691 (ἐμέ);

G4746.strong_def: a spread (as if tramped flat) of loose materials for a couch, i.e. (by implication) a bough of a tree so employed

G1173.def:
δεῖπνον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for פַּת־בַּג (Da) ;]
the chief meal of the day, dinner, supper: Mat.23:6, Mrk.12:39, Luk.14:17, 24 20:46, Jhn.13:2, 4 21:20, 1Co.11:21; δ. ποιεῖν, Mrk.6:21, Luk.14:12, 16, Jhn.12:2; κυριακὸν (which see) δ., 1Co.11:20; metaphorically (Dalman, Words, 118), δ. τ. γάμου τ. ἀρνίου, Rev.19:9; δ. τ. μέγα τ. Θεοῦ, Rev.19:17.†
(AS)
G1173.strong_def: dinner, i.e. the chief meal (usually in the evening)

G4410.strong_def: a sitting first (in the front row), i.e. preeminence in council

G1563.def:
ἐκεῖ
adv., [in LXX chiefly for שָׁם ;]
1. properly, of place, there: Mat.2:13 5:24, al.; οἱ ἐ., Mat.26:71; οὗ . . . ἐ., Mat.6:21 18:20 24:28, Mrk.6:10, Luk.12:34; pleonastic, ὅπου . . . ἐ. (= שָׁם אֲשֶׁר, Deu.4:5, al.), Rev.12:6, 14 (cf. Bl., § 50, 4).
2. As often in cl. (Hdt., Thuc., al.), with verbs of motion, for ἐκεῖσε, thither: Mat.2:22 17:20 24:28 26:36, Mrk.6:33, Luk.12:18 17:37 21:2, Jhn.11:8 18:2-3, Rom.15:24
(AS)

G4033.strong_def: to encircle all around, i.e. blockade completely

G4475.gloss: (+ strike with the) palm of the hand, smite with the hand

G2810.derivation: probably contracted from (compound of G2811 (κλέος) and G3962 (πατήρ));

G0124.strong_def: an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus

G5417.strong_def: to whip, i.e. lash as a public punishment
G5417.derivation: from a presumed equivalent of the Latin flagellum;

G4416.strong_def: first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively)
G4416.derivation: from G4413 (πρῶτος) and the alternate of G5088 (τίκτω);

G2945.def:
κύκλος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב ;]
a ring, circle. Dat., κύκλῳ, as adverb., round about, around: Mrk.3:34 6:6, 36, Luk.9:12, Rom.15:19; with genitive, Rev.4:6 5:11 7:11†
(AS)
G2945.strong_def: akin to G2947 (κυλιόω)); i.e. in a circle (by implication, of G1722 (ἐν)), i.e. (adverbially) all around
G2945.derivation: as if dative case of (a ring, "cycle";

G5224.gloss: goods, that which one has, things which (one) possesseth, substance, that hast
G5224.strong_def: things extant or in hand, i.e. property or possessions
G5224.derivation: neuter plural of present participle active of G5225 (ὑπάρχω) as noun;

G0067.def:
Ἀγρίππας, -α (Bl., §7, 2), ὁ
Agrippa (II): Act.25:13, 22, 23, 24, 26 26:1, 2, 19, 27, 28, 32. (For Agrippa I, see: Ἡρῴδης, 3.) †
(AS)
G0067.strong_def: wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods

G2404.def:
Ἱεράπολις (WH, Ἱερὰ Πόλις), -εως, ἡ
Hierapolis: a city in the Lyons valley in the Province of Asia: Col.4:13.†
(AS)
G2404.strong_def: holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor

G2241.def:
ἡλεί (Rec. ἠλί L, ἠλί; Heb. אֵל),
Eli, my God: Mat.27:46 (cf. ἐλωΐ).†
(AS)
G2241.derivation: of Hebrew origin (H0410 with pronominal suffix);

G1710.def:
ἐμ-πορεύομαι depon.
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר ;]
1. to travel, esp. for business.
2. to traffc, trade: Jas.4:13.
3. C. accusative of thing(s)
(a) to traffic in;
(b) to import: (Hos.12:1, for יָבַל hoph.).
4. C. accusative of person(s), to make a gain of: 2Pe.2:3.†
(AS)
G1710.strong_def: to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade

G3017.strong_def: Levi, the name of three Israelites

G0167.def:
ἀκαθαρσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀκάθαρτος), [in LXX chiefly for טֻמְאָה, טָמֵא ;]
uncleanness, impurity,
(a) physical (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.23:27;
(b) moral: Rom.1:24 6:19, 2Co.12:21, Gal.5:19, Eph.4:19 5:3, Col.3:5, 1Th.2:3 4:7.
† (AS)

G1215.def:
δημηγορέω, -ῶ
(δῆμος, ἀγορεύω, to speak in the assembly), [in LXX: Pro.24:66 (30:31), 4Ma.5:15 * ;]
to deliver an oration: Act.12:21.†
(AS)
G1215.strong_def: to be a people-gatherer, i.e. to address a public assembly
G1215.derivation: from a compound of G1218 (δῆμος) and G58 (ἀγορά);

G0857.def:
ἀφειδία (L, -εία), -ας, ἡ
(ἀφειδής, unsparing);
1. extravagance.
2. unsparing treatment, severity: Col.2:23.†
(AS)
G0857.derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5339 (φείδομαι);

G4853.strong_def: a co-tribesman, i.e. native of the same country
G4853.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G5443 (φυλή);

G1642.def:
ἐλαττόω, -ῶ
(ἐλάιττων), [in LXX (where also -σσῶ) chiefly for חָסֵר, and very frequently in Sir ;]
to make less: Heb.2:7 (LXX); pass., Jhn.3:30, Heb.2:9.†
(AS)

G4632.strong_def: a vessel, implement, equipment or apparatus (literally or figuratively [specially, a wife as contributing to the usefulness of the husband])

G4242.strong_def: seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors)

G1549.def:
ἔκ-γονος, -ον
(ἐκγίγνομαι, to be born of), [in LXX for פְּרִי (neut.), בֵּן, etc. ;]
1. with genitive, born of.
2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ ἔ., a child, son or daughter; in pl., descendants: τέκνα ἢ ἔ., children or grand-children, 1Ti.5:4.†
(AS)
G1549.derivation: neuter of a derivative of a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and G1096 (γίνομαι);

G1818.def:
ἐξ -απατάω, -ῶ strengthened form of ἀπατάω,
[in LXX: Exo.8:29 (הָתַל hi.), Da TH Sus 5:6* ;]
to deceive: with accusative, Rom.7:11 Rom.16:18, 1Co.3:18, 2Co.11:3, 2Th.2:3; pass., 1Ti.2:14.†
(AS)

G2744.def:
καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX for הָלַל hith., etc. ;]
to boast or glory (in LXX, of joyous exultation, and so in the NT quotations, infr.; cf. DB, ii, 790b; Hort on Jas.1:9): absol., 1Co.1:31 (LXX) 1Co.4:7 13:3, 2Co.10:13 10:17" (LXX) 2Co.11:16 11:18 12:1 12:6, Eph.2:9, Jas.4:16; with accusative of thing(s), 2Co.9:2 11:30; before ἐν (LXX), Rom.2:23 5:3, 1Co.3:21, 2Co.5:12 10:15 11:12 12:5 12:9, Gal.6:13-14 Jas.1:9; ἐν (τ.) θεῷ, Rom.2:17 5:11; ἐν κυρίῳ, 1Co.1:31 (LXX) 2Co.10:17 (LXX); ἐν Χ. Ἰησοῦ, Php.3:3; before ἐπί with dative, Rom.5:2; περί, with genitive, 2Co.10:8; εἰς, 2Co.10:16; ὑπέρ, with genitive of person(s), 2Co.7:14 12:5; ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, 1Co.1:29 (cf. ἐν, κατα-καυχάομαι).†
(AS)
G2744.strong_def: to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense)
G2744.derivation: from some (obsolete) base akin to that of (to boast) and G2172 (εὔχομαι);

G0161.def:
αἰχμαλωσία -ας, ἡ
(αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִי, גּוֹלָה ;]
captivity (Diod., al.): Rev.13:10; pl., abstr. for concr., = αἰχμάλωτοι, Eph.4:8 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2467.def:
- to know, see, understand
Occurs as Perfect with Present meaning
G2467.derivation: assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of G1492 (εἴδω);

G3965.strong_def: paternal descent, i.e. (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation)
G3965.derivation: as if feminine of a derivative of G3962 (πατήρ);

G2290.def:
θάπτω
[in LXX chiefly for קָבַר ;]
to bury: with accusative, Mat.8:21-22 14:12, Luk.9:59-60, Act.5:6, 9-10; pass., Luk.16:22, Act.2:29, 1Co.15:4.†
(AS)
G2290.strong_def: to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter

G0209.def:
ἀκωλύτως
adv. (κωλύω), [in Sm.: Job.34:31 * ;]
without hindrance (so frequently in legal documents; MM, VGT, see word): Act.28:31.†
(AS)
G0209.strong_def: in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely
G0209.derivation: adverb from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2967 (κωλύω);

G1875.def:
ἐπ-άν
conj. (ἐπεί, which see, ἄν)
later form of ἐπήν,
after, when: with subjc. Pres., Luk.11:34; with subjc. aor., Mat.2:8, Luk.11:22.†
(AS)
G1875.strong_def: a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as

G1659.def:
ἐλευθερόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Pro.25:10. 2Ma.1:27 2Mac 2:22 * ;]
to make free from sin, Jhn.8:32, 36; before ἀπό, Rom.6:18, 22 8:2, 21; τ. ἐλευθερία (dative commodi), Gal.5:1 (on the "punctiliar" force of this verb, see M, Pr. 149; cf. also Cremer, 251).†
(AS)
G1659.strong_def: to liberate, i.e. (figuratively) to exempt (from moral, ceremonial or mortal liability)

G2097.def:
εὐαγγελίζω
[in LXX for בָּשַׂר pi., hith.; for good news in general: 1Ki.31:9, al.; of God's loving kindness, Psa.40:10 96:2, and esp. of Messianic blessings, Isa.40:9 60:6, al. ;]
to bring or announce glad tidings;
1. act. (only in late writers): with accusative of person(s), Rev.10:7; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Rev.14:6; pass., of things, to be proclaimed as glad tidings: Luk.16:16, Gal.1:11, 1Pe.1:25; impers., 1Pe.4:6; of persons, to have glad tidings proclaimed to one: Mat.11:5, Luk.7:22, Heb.4:2, 6
2. Depon. mid. (cl.), to proclaim glad tidings, in NT esp. of the Christian message of salvation: absol., Luk.9:6, Rom.15:20, al.; with dative of person(s), Luk.4:18 (LXX), Rom.1:15, al.; in same sense with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Luk.3:18, Act.16:10, Gal.1:9, 1Pe.1:12; with accusative of thing(s), εἰρήνην, Act.10:36, Rom.10:15" (LXX) ; τ, βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, Luk.8:1; with dative of person(s), Luk.1:19 4:43, Eph.2:17 3:8; αὐτῷ τ. Ἰησοῦν, Act.8:35 17:18; with dupl. accusative, Act.13:32; with accusative of person(s) and inf., Act.14:15; τ. κώμας (πολεῖς), Act.8:25, 40 14:21 (cf. προ-ευαγγελίζομαι)
(AS)
G2097.strong_def: to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the gospel

G2550.def:
κακοήθεια (WH, -θία), -ας, ἡ
(κακός, ἦθος), [in LXX: Est.8:13, 3Ma.3:22 3Mac 7:3 A, 4Ma.1:4 4Mac 3:4 * ;]
malignity, malevolence: Rom.1:29 (Cremer, 329).†
(AS)
G2550.derivation: from a compound of G2556 (κακός) and G2239 (ἦθος);

G3641.gloss: + almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while
G3641.strong_def: puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat

G0159.def:
αἴτιος, -α, ὁ
(αἰτία), [in LXX: 1Ki.22:22 (סבב) Dan LXX Bel 41, TH ib. 42, Su 53, 2Ma.4:47 13:4, 4Ma.1:11 * ;]
1. causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: Heb.5:9; τὸ αἰ., the cause, Act.19:40.
2. blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, Luk.23:4,14,22.
† (AS)

G0981.def:
βίωσις, -εως, ἡ
(βιόω), [in LXX: Si prol. 12 * ;]
manner of life: Act.26:4.†
(AS)
G0981.strong_def: living (properly, the act, by implication, the mode)

G1815.def:
ἐξ-ανάστασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐξανίστημι),
a rising again: ἐκ τ. νεκρῶν, Php.3:11 (Cremer, 308).†
(AS)

G2471.def:
ἰσότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ἴσος), [in LXX: Job.36:30, Zec.4:7 * ;]
1. equality: 2Co.8:13-14.
2. equity, fairness: τὸ δίκαιον κ. τὴν ἰ., Col.4:1 (for dis­tinction bet. τὸ δ. and ἡ ἰ, see ICC, in l).†
(AS)
G2471.strong_def: likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication, equity

G0590.def:
ἀπό-δημος, -ον
gone abroad (RV, sojourning in another country): Mrk.13:34.†
(AS)
G0590.strong_def: absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller

G2952.def:
κυνάριον, -ου, τό
(in Att.. also κυνίδιον, diminutive of κύων)
a little dog: Mat.15:26-27 Mrk.7:27-28 †
(AS)
G2952.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2965 (κύων);

G1435.def:
δῶρον, -ου, τό
(δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly for קׇרְבָּן, also for מִנְחָה, etc. ;]
a gift, present: Mat.2:11, Rev.11:10; of gifts and sacrifices to God, Mat.5:23-24 8:4 15:5 23:18-19, Mrk.7:11, Luk.21:1, 4, Heb.5:1 8:3-4 9:9 11:4; δ. θεοῦ, Eph.2:8.†
SYN.: see word δόμα (AS)

G5383.strong_def: to be fond of being first, i.e. ambitious of distinction
G5383.derivation: from a compound of G5384 (φίλος) and G4413 (πρῶτος);

G0822.def:
ἀτμίς, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX for עָנַן, תִּמֹּר, etc. ;]
vapour: Jas.4:14; ἀ. καπνοῦ, Act.2:19 (LXX).†
(AS)

G5536.strong_def: something useful or needed, i.e. wealth, price

G5214.strong_def: to hymn, i.e. sing a religious ode; by implication, to celebrate (God) in song

G2967.gloss: forbid, hinder, keep from, let, not suffer, withstand
G2967.strong_def: to estop, i.e. prevent (by word or act)

G1322.def:
διδαχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: Psa.60:1-12 title. (לָמַד pi.); Sm.: Deu.33:8 * ;]
1. objectively, teaching, doctrine, that which is taught: Mrk.1:27, Jhn.7:16, Act.17:19, Rom.6:7 16:17, 2Jn.10, Rev.2:24; with genitive poss., Mat.7:28 16:12 22:33, Mrk.1:22 11:18, Luk.4:32, Jhn.18:19, Act.5:28, Rev.2:14-15; ἡ δ., of Christ, Jhn.7:17, Act.13:12, 2Jn.9; of. τὴν δ., Tit.1:9; with genitive obj., βαπτισμῶν δ., Heb.6:2; pl., Heb.13:9.
2. Actively, teaching: Act.2:42, 2Ti.4:2; ἐν τ. δ., in the course of his teaching: Mrk.4:2 12:38; λαλεῖν ἐν δ., 1Co.14:6; ἔχειν δ., 1Co.14:26 (DCG, i, 485; Cremer, 181).†
SYN.: διδασκαλία (AS)

G2960.def:
κυριακός, -ή, -όν
(κύριος), [in LXX: κ. φωνη (Συριακή φ., R), 2Ma.15:36 A * ;]
1. as frequently in Inscr. (LS, see word; Deiss., BS, 217 f.), of the lord or master, imperial.
2. of the Lord (i.e. Christ): δεῖπνον, 1Co.11:20; ἡμέρα, Rev.1:10. (cf. λόγια κ., Papias, Eus., HE, iii, 39, 1; γραφαὶ κ., Clem. Alex., etc; for eccl. usage, cf. Soph., Lex., see word)†
(AS)
G2960.strong_def: belonging to the Lord (Jehovah or Jesus)

G1468.def:
ἐγκρατής, -ές
(κράτος), [in LXX: Wis.8:20, Sir.6:27 15:1 26:15 27:30, al. ;]
1. strong, powerful.
2. C. genitive of thing(s), master of, hence,
3. (sc. ἑαυτοῦ), self -controlled, exercising self-control: Tit.1:8.
† SYN.: σώφρων (see reff. s. ἐγκράτεια). (AS)
G1468.strong_def: strong in a thing (masterful), i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) self-controlled (in appetite, etc.)

G0754.def:
ἀρχι-τελώνης, -ου, ὁ
a chief tax-collector, chief publican: Luk.19:2.†
(AS)

G0164.def:
αἰχμάλωτος, -ον
(αἰχμή, a spear, ἁλίσκομαι, to be taken), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁבָה, גּוֹלָה ;]
captive: Luk.4:18 (LXX).†
(AS)
G0164.strong_def: properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive
G0164.derivation: from (a spear) and a derivative of the same as G259 (ἅλωσις);

G0778.def:
ἀσκέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.15:4 * ;]
1. to adorn (poët.).
2. to practise, exercise (Hdt., Xen.).
3. to endeavour (Xen., al.): with inf., Act.24:16.†
(AS)
G0778.strong_def: to elaborate, i.e. (figuratively) train (by implication, strive)
G0778.derivation: probably from the same as G4632 (σκεῦος);

G2701.def:
κατα-τρέχω
[in LXX: Lev.26:37, Jdg.1:6 (רָדַף), al. ;]
to run down: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Act.21:32.†
(AS)
G2701.strong_def: to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower

G3321.derivation: from a presumed compound of G3319 (μέσος) and G3772 (οὐρανός);

G4819.strong_def: to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e. concur (take place)
G4819.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G939 (βάσις);

G4311.gloss: accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth
G4311.strong_def: to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel

G3673.derivation: from the base of G3674 (ὁμοῦ) and G5078 (τέχνη);

G1305.def:
δια-τροφή, ῆς, ἡ
(διατρέφω, to support, sustain), [in LXX: 1Ma.6:49 * ;]
food, nourishment: 1Ti.6:8.†
(AS)
G1305.derivation: from a compound of G1223 (διά) and G5142 (τρέφω);

G0824.def:
ἄ-τοπος, -ον
(τόπος), [in LXX: Job.4:8 11:11, Pro.30:20, al., for אָוֶן, etc. ;]
1. out of place, not befitting.
2. marvellous, strange (of symptoms, Hipp.): Act.28:6; hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense,
3. improper, unrighteous (so in LXX, and for exx. from π., see M, Th., l.with; MM, see word): Luk.23:41, Act.25:5, 2Th.3:2.†
(AS)
G0824.strong_def: out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked
G0824.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5117 (τόπος);

G4108.strong_def: roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader;

G2138.def:
εὐ-πειθής, ές,
(εὖ, πείθομαι), [in LXX: 4Ma.12:6 AR* ;]
ready to obey, compliant: Jas.3:17.†
(AS)

G5575.strong_def: a spurious witness, i.e. bearer of untrue testimony
G5575.derivation: from G5571 (ψευδής) and a kindred form of G3144 (μάρτυς);

G0994.def:
βοάω, -ῶ
(βοή), [in LXX chiefly for זעק, צעק, קרא ;]
1. absol., to cry, call out: Mat.3:3, 27:46, Mrk.1:3 15:34, Luk.3:4 9:38 18:38, Jhn.1:23, Act.8:7 17:6 25:24, Gal.4:27.
2. C. dative, to call on for help (Heb. זעק על, Hos.7:14, al.), Luk.18:7.†
SYN.: καλέω, to call, invite, summon; κράζω, to cry, harshly or inarticulately, as animals; κραυγάζω, intensive of κράζω. βοάω expresses emotion, whether joy, fear, etc. (AS)
G0994.strong_def: to halloo, i.e. shout (for help or in a tumultuous way)
G0994.derivation: apparently a prolonged form of a primary verb;

G1771.def:
ἔννοια, -ας, ἡ
(νοῦς), [in LXX: Pro.1:4 2:11 3:21 4:1 5:2 8:12 16:22 18:15 19:7 23:4, 19 24:7 (מְזִמָּה, etc.), Wis.2:14, Da TH Sus 1:28* ;]
1. thinking, consideration.
2. a thought, purpose, design: Heb.4:12, 1Pe.4:1.†
SYN.: ἐνθῦμησις, which see (Cremer, 439) (AS)
G1771.derivation: from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G3563 (νοῦς);

G0399.def:
ἀνα-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for קָטַר hi., etc. ;]
1. to carry or lead up: with accusative of person(s), Mat.17:1, Mrk.9:2; pass., Luk.24:51 (WH, rejects, R, mg. omits); ἀ. τ. ἁμαρτίας ἐπί τ. ξύλον (see Deiss., 135, 88 f.; ICC, in l; MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe.2:24.
2. In LXX and NT, to bring to the altar, to offer (see Hort on 1Pe, l.with): θυσίας, etc., Heb.7:27 13:15, 1Pe.2:5; ἐπί τ. θυσιαστήριον, Jas.2:21 (see Mayor, in l).
3. to bear, sustain (cf. Num.14:33, Isa.53:12): Heb.9:28.†
(AS)

G0277.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3334 (μετακινέω);

G2643.def:
κατ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: Isa.9:5(4), 2Ma.5:20 * ;]
1. exchange.
2. reconciliation: Rom.5:11; κ. κόσμου, Rom.11:15; διακονία τῆς κ., 2Co.5:18; λόγος τῆς κ., 2Co.5:19.†
(AS)
G2643.strong_def: exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e. restoration to (the divine) favor

G4625.gloss: occasion to fall (of stumbling), offence, thing that offends, stumblingblock
G4625.strong_def: a trap-stick (bent sapling), i.e. snare (figuratively, cause of displeasure or sin)
G4625.derivation: ("scandal"); probably from a derivative of G2578 (κάμπτω);

G5394.strong_def: to cause a blaze, i.e. ignite (figuratively, to inflame with passion)

G2580.def:
Κανά (Rec. -νᾶ), ἡ,
indecl.,
Cana, of Galilee: Jhn.2:1, 11 4:46 21:2.†
(AS)

G2667.def:
κατα-πίπτω
[in LXX: Psa.145:14 (נָפַל), etc. ;]
to fall down: Act.28:6; before εἰς, Act.26:14; ἐπί with accusative, Luk.8:6.†
(AS)

G0276.def:
ἀ-μετάθετος, -ον
(μετατίθημι), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:1 3Mac 5:12 * ;]
immutable: Heb.6:18; as subat., τὸ ἀ., immutability, Heb.6:17 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0276.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3346 (μετατίθημι);

G2563.strong_def: a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a similar plant); by implication, a pen

G2000.def:
ἐπισφαλής, -ές
(σφάλλω, to cause to full), [in LXX: Wis.9:14 (cf. -ῶς, Wis.4:4) * ;]
1. prone to fall (Plat.).
2. dangerous (Hipp., Plut., al.): Act.27:9.†
(AS)
G2000.derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and (to trip);

G2253.def:
ἡμιθανής, -ές
(ἥμι, half + θνήσκω) [in LXX: 4Ma.4:11 * ;]
half-dead: Luk.10:30.†
(AS)
G2253.derivation: from a presumed compound of the base of G2255 (ἥμισυ) and G2348 (θνήσκω);

G3933.strong_def: a maiden; by implication, an unmarried daughter

G1250.def:
διακόσιοι, -αι, -α
two hundred: Mrk.6:37, and al.
(AS)

G3385.gloss: not (the particle usually not expressed, except by the form of the question)
G3385.derivation: from G3361 (μή) and the neuter of G5100 (τὶς);

G0686.def:
ἄρα,
illative particle, expressing a more subjective or informal inference than οὖν,
then: prop. (as in cl.), the second word in the sentence, Rom.7:21 8:1, Gal.3:7; ἐπεὶ ἄρα, 1Co.7:14 (with another word between) 5:10; as the first word, Luk.11:48, Act.11:18, Rom.10:17, 1Co.15:18, 2Co.5:15 7:12, Heb.4:9; so prop. in apodosis after protasis with εἰ, Mat.12:28, Luk.11:20, Gal.2:21 3:29 5:11, Heb.12:8 (κενὸν ἄρα), 1Co.15:14; often in interrogations, direct and indirect, τίς (τί) ἄρα, Mat.18:1 19:25, 27 24:45, Mrk.4:41, Luk.1:66 8:25 12:42 22:23, Act.12:18; εἰ ἄρα, Mrk.11:13, Act.8:22; εἴπερ ἄρα, 1Co.15:15; οὐκ ἄρα, Act.21:38; μήτι ἄρα, 2Co.1:17; in strengthened forms, ἄρα γε, ἄραγε, Mat.7:20 17:26, Act.17:27, and more frequently ἄρα οὖν (Epp. Paul.), so then, Rom.5:18 7:3, 25 8:12 9:16, 18 14:19, Gal.6:10, Eph.2:19, 1Th.5:6, 2Th.2:15 (Bl., §77, 2; 78, 5; MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0686.strong_def: a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows)
G0686.derivation: probably from G142 (αἴρω) (through the idea of drawing a conclusion);

G0141.def:
αἱρετικός, -ή, όν
(αἱρέομαι),
1. capable of choosing (Plat.).
2. causing division, heretical, factious (Cremer, 614): as subst., Tit.3:10.
† (AS)

G4762.gloss: convert, turn (again, back again, self, self about)
G4762.strong_def: to twist, i.e. turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively)
G4762.derivation: strengthened from the base of G5157 (τροπή);

G5501.strong_def: from an obsolete equivalent (of uncertain derivation); more evil or aggravated (physically, mentally or morally)

G5306.derivation: comparative from G5259 (ὑπό) (in the sense of behind);

G1226.def:
δια-βεβαιόομαι, -οῦμαι
to affirm confidently: Tit.3:8; before περί, 1Ti.1:7 (Cremer, 140).†
(AS)
G1226.strong_def: to confirm thoroughly (by words), i.e. asseverate
G1226.derivation: middle voice of a compound of G1223 (διά) and G950 (βεβαιόω);

G0827.def:
αὐγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Isa.59:9 (נְגֹהָה), 2Ma.12:9 * ;]
1. brightness
2. Later (as in MGr.; MM, see word), daylight, dawn: Act.20:11 (Cremer, 118).†
SYN.: φέγγος (see Thayer, s. φ.; DB, iii, 44a; Tr., Syn., § xlvi). (AS)
G0827.strong_def: a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn

G0655.def:
ἀπο-στυγέω, -ῶ
(στυγέω, to hate),
to abhor: Rom.12:9.†
(AS)
G0655.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G4767 (στυγνητός);

G3173.gloss: (+ fear) exceedingly, great(-est), high, large, loud, mighty, + (be) sore (afraid), strong, X to years
G3173.strong_def: big (literally or figuratively, in a very wide application)
G3173.derivation: (including the prolonged forms, feminine , plural , etc.; compare also G3176 (μέγιστος), G3187 (μείζων));

G3392.strong_def: to sully or taint, i.e. contaminate (ceremonially or morally)

G0470.def:
ἀντ-απο-κρίνομαι
(ἀντί, ἀποκρίνω), [in LXX: Jdg.5:29, Job.16:9 (8) Job.32:12 (עָנָה)* ;]
to answer again, reply against: before πρός, with accusative of thing(s), Luk.14:6; with dative of person(s), Rom.9:20.†
(AS)

G2554.def:
κακο-ποιέω, ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for רָעַע hi. ;]
to do harm, to do evil: Mrk.3:4, Luk.6:9, 1Pe.3:17, 3Jn.11 (Cremer, 329).†
(AS)
G2554.strong_def: to be a bad-doer, i.e. (objectively) to injure, or (genitive) to sin

G3801.lemma: ὁ ὢν καί ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
G3801.translit: ho ṑn kaí ho ēn kaí ho erchómenos
G3801.gloss: which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be)
G3801.strong_def: the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e. the Eternal, as a divine epithet of Christ
G3801.derivation: a phrase combining G3588 (ὁ) with the present participle and imperfect of G1510 (εἰμί) and the present participle of G2064 (ἔρχομαι) by means of G2532 (καί);

G5562.gloss: come, contain, go, have place, (can, be room to) receive
G5562.strong_def: to be in (give) space, i.e. (intransitively) to pass, enter, or (transitively) to hold, admit (literally or figuratively)

G1756.def:
ἐνεργής, -ές
(late form of ἐνεργός, on WH. cf. AR, Eph., 241),
at work, active, effective: 1Co.16:9, Phm 6, Heb.4:12 (Cremer, 261).†
(AS)

G1621.def:
ἐκ-τινάσσω
[in LXX for נָעַר ni., pi., etc. ;]
to shake off: κονιορτόν, Mat.10:14; χοῦν, Mrk.6:11. Mid.: κονιορτόν, Act.13:51; ἱμάτια, Act.18:6 (cf. MM, Exp., iii).†
(AS)

G1631.def:
ἐκ-φύω
[in OT (Sm.) Psa.104:14; (Al.) Isa.61:11 * ;]
to cause to grow out, put forth (leaves): Mat.24:32, Mrk.13:28.†
(AS)

G1982.def:
ἐπι-σκιάζω
[in LXX: Exo.40:35 (שָׁכַן), Psa.91:4 140:7 (סָכַךְ), Pro.18:11 * ;]
to throw a shadow upon, overshadow: with dative, Act.5:15; of a shining (Mt, l.with, and cf. Exo.40:29, 35, 2Ma.2:8) cloud, with dative, Mrk.9:7; with accusative, Mat.17:5, Luk.9:34; metaphorically (cf. Pss, Pr, ll.with), of the Holy Spirit, Luk.1:35.†
(AS)
G1982.strong_def: to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence
G1982.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G4639 (σκιά);

G1387.def:
δολιόω
(δόλιος), [in LXX: Num.25:18, Psa.105:25 (נָכַל), Psa.5:6 (חָלַק hi.) * ;]
to deceive: ἐδολιοῦσαν (-σαν, frequently in κοινή Gk. for imperfect 3rd of person(s) pl.), Rom.3:13 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2722.def:
κατ-έχω
[in LXX for אָחַז, חָזַק hi., etc. ;]
1. perfective of ἔχω (M, Pr., 116; M, Th., 155),
(a) to possess, hold fast: Luk.8:15, Jhn.5:4, Rom.1:18 (Lft., Notes, 251), 1Co.7:30 11:2, 2Co.6:10, 1Th.5:21, Heb.3:6, 14 10:23;
(b) to lay hold of, get possession of: Luk.14:9.
2. to hold back, detain, restrain (M, Th., 156 f.): with accusative before τοῦ μή with inf., Luk.4:42; before πρός, with accusative, Phm 13; absol., τὸ κατέχον (ὁ κ.), 2Th.2:6-7.
3. Intrans., as nautical term, to put in, make for (LS, see word): Act.27:40.†
(AS)
G2722.strong_def: to hold down (fast), in various applications (literally or figuratively)

G4965.strong_def: Sychar (i.e. Shekar), a place in Palestine

G1198.def:
δέσμιος, -ον (also -α, -ον;
δεσμός), [in LXX for אסר;]
1. binding.
2. bound, captive; ὁ δ., as subst., a prisoner: Mat.27:15, 16, Mrk.15:6, Act.16:25, 27 23:18 25:14, 27 28:16 (Rec.) 17, Heb.10:34 13:3; ὁ δ. τοῦ Χριστοῦ, Eph.3:1, 2Ti.1:8, Phm 1, 9; ὁ δ. ἐν κυρίῳ, Eph.4:1.†
(AS)

G1899.def:
ἐπειτα, adv. of sequence
[in LXX: Num.19:10 A, Isa.16:2, 4Ma.6:3 * ;]
thereupon, thereafter, then: Luk.16:7, Gal.1:21, Jas.4:14; before μετὰ τοῦτο, Jhn.11:7; μετὰ ἔτη τρία, Gal.1:18; διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν, Gal.2:1; πρῶτον . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:46, 1Th.4:17, Heb.7:2; πρότεφον . . . ἔ, Heb.7:27; ἀπαρχὴ . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:23; εἶτα . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:5-6 (WH, txt.); . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:5-7 (WH, mg.); τρίτον . . . ἔ. (his), 1Co.12:28.†
(AS)

G4599.strong_def: probably akin to the base of G2476 (ἵστημι)); to strengthen, i.e. (figuratively) confirm (in spiritual knowledge and power)

G2500.def:
Ἰωσῆς, -ῆ (Rec. -ή Luk.3:29; AV, Jose; see: Ἰησοῦς, 3), and -ῆτος (Mk, ll with), ὁ,
Joses;
1. brother of our Lord: Mrk.6:3, Mat.13:55 (Rec., see: Ἰωσήφ).
2. Son of Mary: Mat.27:56 (-σήφ), WH, txt), Mrk.15:40, 47
3. see: Βαρνάβας.†
(AS)
G2500.strong_def: Joses, the name of two Israelites

G1203.def:
δεσπότης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for אָדוֹן, אֲדֹנָי; in Jdth.9:17, δ. τ. οὐρανῶν κ. τ. γῆς];
a master, lord, correlative of δοῦλος, οἰκέτης: 1Ti.6:1, 2, 2Ti.2:21, Tit.2:9, 1Pe.2:18; as title of God, voc., δέσποτα (so usually in LXX), Luk.2:29, Act.4:24; ὁ δ. = voc. δέσποτα (cf. B1., § 33, 4), Rev.6:10; of Christ, 2Pe.2:1, Ju 4, R, txt. (but cf. mg.).†
SYN.: κύριος (which see), implying limitation of authority and a more general relation than δ., which "denoted absolute ownership and uncontrolled power" (Thayer). (AS)

G0438.def:
ἄνθος, -εος, τό
[in LXX for צִיץ, etc. ;]
a flower: Jas.1:10-11. 1Pe.1:24" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5143.strong_def: compare G2359 (θρίξ)); which uses (the base of G1408 (δρόμος)) as alternate in certain tenses; to run or walk hastily (literally or figuratively)

G0797.def:
ἀστράπτω
[in LXX for בָּרָק ;]
to lighten, flash forth: Luk.17:24 24:4 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G1364.def:
δίς
adv.,
twice: Mrk.14:30, 72; δ. τ. σαββάτου, Luk.18:12; καὶ ἅπαξ κ. δ., Php.4:16, 1Th.2:18; δ. ἀποθανόντα, Ju 12 (see Mayor, ICC, in l); δ. μυριάδες, Rev.9:16.†
(AS)

G5087.gloss: + advise, appoint, bow, commit, conceive, give, X kneel down, lay (aside, down, up), make, ordain, purpose, put, set (forth), settle, sink down
G5087.strong_def: to place (in the widest application, literally and figuratively; properly, in a passive or horizontal posture, and thus different from G2476 (ἵστημι), which properly denotes an upright and active position, while G2749 (κεῖμαι) is properly reflexive and utterly prostrate)
G5087.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses);

G0570.def:
ἀπιστία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.14:25, 4Ma.12:4 * ;]
want of faith, unbelief: Mat.13:58, Mrk.6:6 9:24 16:14, Rom.3:3 (but see: ἀπιστέω) Rom.4:20 11:20, 23, 1Ti.1:13, Heb.3:12, 19 (DCG, ii, 775a; Cremer, 492).†
(AS)
G0570.strong_def: faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience)

G3697.gloss: what manner (sort) of, such as whatsoever
G3697.strong_def: of what kind that, i.e. how (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent G5108 (τοιοῦτος) of quality)

G4737.strong_def: to adorn with an honorary wreath (literally or figuratively)

G0066.def:
ἄγριος, -α, -ον
(ἀγρός), [in LXX for שָׂדֶה, etc. ;]
1. living in fields, wild: μέλι. Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6.
2. savage, fierce: Ju 13. (Cf. usage in π. of a malignant wound; MM, VGT, see word)
† (AS)
G0066.strong_def: wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce)

G1912.def:
ἐπι-βαρέω, -ῶ
to put a burden on, be burdensome: figuratively, absol., 2Co.2:6; with accusative of person(s), 1Th.2:9, 2Th.3:8 (cf. M, Th., I, 29).†
(AS)
G1912.strong_def: to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards

G2242.def:
Ἡλεί (Rec. Ἡλί; RV, Ἡλί), ὁ, indecl.,
Heli, Joseph's father: Luk.3:23.†
(AS)

G2047.def:
ἐρημία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔρημος), [in LXX: Isa.60:20, Eze.35:4 (חָרַב, חׇרְבָּה), Eze.35:9 (שְׁמָמָה), Wis.17:17, Sir.47:17, Bar.4:33, 4Ma.18:8 * ;]
a solitude, wilderness: Mat.15:33, Mrk.8:4, 2Co.11:26, Heb.11:38.†
(AS)

G4469.strong_def: O empty one, i.e. thou worthless (as a term of utter vilification)

G3327.derivation: from G3326 (μετά) and the base of G939 (βάσις);

G0871.def:
ἀφ-ομοιόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Wis.13:14, Ep. Jer 1:5, 63, 71* ;]
to make like: pass., Heb.7:3.†
(AS)

G0439.def:
ἀνθρακιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: Sir.11:32, 4Ma.9:20 * ;]
a heap of burning coals: Jhn.18:18 21:9.†
(AS)

G1197.def:
δέσμη (Rec. δεσμή), -ης, ἡ
(δέω), [in LXX for אֲגֻדָּה, Exo.12:22 * ;]
a bundle: δήσατε αὐτὰ εἰς δέσμας (D, Orig., omit εἰς, and Blass thinks original reading, δέσμας δέσμας; see Deiss., LAE, 125.4), Mat.13:30.†
(AS)

G1787.def:
ἐντός
(ἐν),
adv., [in LXX: Job.18:20, Psa.39:3 109:22, Sng.3:10; ὁ, τὸ, τὰ ἐ., Psa.103:1, Isa.16:11, Da TH Dan.10:16, Sir.19:26, 1Ma.4:48 * ;]
within: with genitive, ἐ. ὑμῶν, within you (i.e. in your hearts, R, txt.), or among you (R, mg.), Luk.17:21 (cf. Field, Notes, 71; Thayer, see word; ICC, Lk, l.with; Dalman, Words, 145 ff.); τὸ ἐ., Mat.23:26.†
(AS)

G1494.def:
εἰδωλόθυτος, -ον,
(εἴδωλον, θύω), [in LXX: 4Ma.5:2 * ;]
sacrificed to idols: τὸ, τὰ εἰ, Act.15:29 21:25, 1Co.8:1, 4 7, 10 10:19, Rev.2:14, 2o.†
(AS)
G1494.strong_def: an image-sacrifice, i.e. part of an idolatrous offering
G1494.derivation: neuter of a compound of G1497 (εἴδωλον) and a presumed derivative of G2380 (θύω);

G0624.def:
Ἀπολλωνία, -ας, ἡ
Apollonia, a city of Macedonia: Act.17:1.†
(AS)
G0624.strong_def: from G622 (ἀπόλλυμι)); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia
G0624.derivation: from the pagan deity (i.e. the sun;

G0890.def:
ά-χρηατος, -ον
[in LXX: Hos.8:8 (חֵפֶץ אַיִן), Wis.2:11, Sir.16:1, al. ;]
useless; unserviceable: opposite to εὔχρηστος, Phm 11.†
(AS)
G0890.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5543 (χρηστός);

G3733.strong_def: a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl)
G3733.derivation: probably from a prolonged form of the base of G3735 (ὄρος);

G0338.def:
ἀν-αίτιος, -ον
(αἰτία), [in LXX: Deu.19:10, 13 21:8-9 (נָקִי), Dan LXX TH Sus1:62, always of αἷμα (of. MM, VGT, see word)* ;]
guiltless, innocent: Mat.12:5, 7.†
(AS)

Ἱεροσόλυμα (WH, Ἰερ-, see Intr., § 408), -ων, τά (on πᾶσα Ἱ., Mat.2:3, see WM, 794; M, Pr., 48, 244; Thayer, see word), and Ἱερουσαλήμ (WH, Ἰερ-), ἡ., indecl., as always in LXX exc. some parts of Apocr.. (Heb. יְרוּשָׁלִַם), the former always in FlJ, Mk, Jo EV. and Mt (except. Mat.27:37), and most frequently in Lk, the latter always in He, Re, and by St. Paul (except. Gal.1:17-18 2:1),
Jerusalem: Mat.2:1, Mrk.3:8, Jhn.1:19, al.; its inhabitants, Mat.2:3 3:5 23:37, Luk.13:34, Symbolically, ἡ- ἄνω Ἱ., Gal.4:26, contrasted with ἡ νῦν Ἱ., Gal.4:25; Ἱ. ἐπουράνιος, Heb.12:22; ἡ καινὴ Ἱ., Rev.3:12 21:2, 10

G2749.def:

(cf. ἀνά-, συν-ανά-, ἀντί-, ἀπό-, ἐπί-, κατά-, παρά-, περί-, πρό-κειμαι).†

G2749.derivation: middle voice of a primary verb;

G4358.strong_def: to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at

G0826.def:
αὐγάζω
(αὐγή), [in LXX: Lev.13:24-28, 38 14:56 (בֹּהֶרֶת) Lev.13:39 (כֵּהֶה)* ;]

G2431.def:

G5620.gloss: (insomuch) as, so that (then), (insomuch) that, therefore, to, wherefore

G0017.def:
ἀγαθοποιός, -όν = cl. ἀγαθουργός,
[in LXX, of a woman who deals pleasantly in order to corrupt, Sir.42:14 * ;]
doing well, acting rightly (Plut.): 1Pe.2:14 (Cremer, 8; MM, VGT, see word).†

G1722.def:
ἐν,
prep, (the most frequently of all in NT), with dative (= Heb. בְּ, Lat. in, with abl.).
I. Of place, with dative of thing(s), of person(s), in, within, on, at, by, among: ἐν τ. πόλει, Luk.7:37; τ. οφθαλμῷ, Mat.7:3; τ. κοιλίᾳ, Mat.12:40; τ. ὄρει, 2Pe.1:18; τ. θρόνῳ, Rev.3:21; τ. δεξιᾷ τ. θεοῦ, Rom.8:34; ἐν ἡμῖν Abbott-Smith has ὑμῖν., Luk.1:1; of books, ἐν τ. βιβλίῳ, Gal.3:10; τ. νόμῳ, Mat.12:5, al.; ἐν τοῖς τ. Πατρός, in my Father's house (RV; cf. M, Pr., 103), Luk.2:49; trop., of the region of thought or feeling, ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ (-αις), Mat.5:28, 2Co.4:6, al.; τ. συνειδήσεσιν, 2Co.5:11; after verbs of motion, instead of εἰς (constructio praegnans, a usage extended in late Gk. beyond the limits observed in cl.; cf. Bl., §41, 1; M, Th., 12), ἀποστέλλω . . . ἐν, Mat.10:16. δέδωκεν ἐν τ. χειρί (cf. τιθέναι ἐν χερσί, Hom., Il., i, 441, al.), Jhn.3:35; id. after verbs of coming and going (not in cl.), εἰσῆλθε, Luk.9:46; ἐξῆλθεν, Luk.7:17.
II. Of state, condition, form, occupation, etc.: ἐν ζωῇ, Rom.5:10; ἐν τ. θανάτῳ, 1Jn.3:14; ἐν πειρασμοῖς, 1Pe.1:6; ἐν εἰρήνῃ, Mrk.5:25; ἐν δόξῃ, Php.4:19; ἐν πραΰτητι, Jas.3:13; ἐν μυστηρίῳ, 1Co.2:7; ἐν τ. διδαχῇ, Mrk.4:2; of a part as contained in a whole, ἐν τ. ἀμπέλῳ, Jhn.15:4; ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι, Rom.12:4; of accompanying objects or persons (simple dative in cl.), with, ἐν αἵματι, Heb.9:25; ἐν δέκα χιλιάσιν, Luk.14:31 (cf. Ju 14, Act.7:14); similarly (cl.), of clothing, armour, arms, ἐν στολαῖς, Mrk.12:38; ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ, Jas.2:2; ἐν μαξαίρῃ, Luk.22:49; ἐν ῥάβδῳ, 1Co.4:21 (cf. ἐν τόξοις, Xen., Mem., 3, 9, 2); of manner (cl.), ἐν τάχει (= ταχέως), Luk.18:8 (cf. Bl., §41, 1); of spiritual influence, ἐν πνεύματι, Rom.8:9; ἐν π. ἀκαθάρτῳ, Mrk.1:23; of the mystical relation of the Christian life and the believer himself, to God and Christ (cf. ICC, Ro., 160f.; Mayor on Ju 1; M, Pr., 103): ἐν Χριστῷ, Rom.3:24, 6:11, 1Co.3:1, 4:10, 2Co.12:2, Gal.2:17, Eph.6:21, Col.4:7, 1Th.4:16, al.
III. Of the agent, instrument or means (an extension of cl. ἐν of instr.—see LS, see word Ill—corresponding to similar use of Heb. בְּ), by, with: ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος (= cl. παρά, C. dative), 1Co.6:2; ἐν τ. ἄρχοντι τ. δαιμονίων, Mat.9:34; ἐν αἵματι, Heb.9:22; ἐν ὕδατι, Mat.3:11, al.; ἐν μαχαίρᾳ ἀποκτενεῖ (cf. the absol. ἐν μ., ἐν ῥάβδῳ, supr., II, which some would classify here), Rev.13:10 (cf. 6:8). Allied to this usage and distinctly Semitic are the following: ἠγόρασας . . . ἐν τ. αἵματι σου (cf. BDB, see word בְּ, III, 3), Rev.5:9; ὁμολογεῖν ἐν (= Aram. אודי בּ; cf. McNeile on Mt, I.with; M, Pr., 104), Mat.10:32, Luk.12:8; ὀμνύναι ἐν (= cl. accusative, so Jas.5:12), Mat.5:34, al.; also at the rate of, amounting to, Mrk.4:8 (WH; vv. ll., εἰς, ἒν), Act.7:14 (LXX).
IV. Of time,
(a) in or during a period: ἐν τ. ἡμέρᾳ (νυκτί), Jhn.11:9, al.; ἐν σαββάτῳ, Mat.12:2, al.; ἐν τῷ μεταξύ, meanwhile, Jhn.4:31;
(b) at the time of an event: ἐν τ. παρουσίᾳ, 1Co.15:23; ἐν τ. ἀναστάσει, Mat.22:28;
(with) with art. inf.,
(α) present (so sometimes in cl., but not as in NT = ἕως; V. M, Pr., 215), while: Mat.13:4, Mrk.6:48, Gal.4:18, al.;
(β) aor., when, after: Luk.9:36, al.;
(d) within (cl.): Mat.27:40,
V. In composition: (1) meaning: (a) with adjectives, it signifies usually the possession of a quality, as ἐνάλιος, ἐν́δοξος; (b) with verbs, continuance in (before ἐν) or motion into (before εἰς), as ἐμμένω, ἐμβαίνω. (ii) Assimilation: ἐν becomes ἐμ- before β, μ, π, φ, ψ; ἐγ- before γ, κ, ξ, χ; ἐλ- before λ. But in the older MSS of NT, followed by modern editions, assimilation is sometimes neglected, as in ἐνγράφω, ἐγκαινίζω, etc.
(AS)
G1722.derivation: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between G1519 (εἰς) and G1537 (ἐκ));

G2070.def:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
I. As substantive verb.
1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.
4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.;
(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult.
2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:7, 2Ti.2:19.
4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): Act.1:8, 9:15, Rom.4:12, 1Co.1:18, 2:14, Rev.21:7, al.
5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mat.10:30, Luk.9:32, Jhn.3:24, Act.21:35, 1Co.15:19, al;
(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Luk.4:31, 14:1, Act.1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rom.12:9, 10, Heb.13:5, al.;
(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Luk.23:9.
6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:8, Heb.8:10, al.
7. C. adv.: Mat.19:20, Mrk.4:26, Luk.18:11, al.
8. Ellipses;
(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mat.8:29, 24:32, Jhn.21:22, 23, Heb.6:4, al.;
(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mat.14:27, Mrk.6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Deu.32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mrk.13:6, Jhn.4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)
G2070.derivation: first person plural indicative of G1510 (εἰμί);

G3808.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G3816 (παῖς);

G4333.strong_def: to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides

G2189.def:
ἔχθρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἐχθρός), [in LXX for אֵיבָה, שִׂנְאָה, etc. ;]
enmity: Luk.23:12, Rom.8:7, Gal.5:20, Eph.2:15-16, Jas.4:4.†
ἀηδία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀ- neg., ἦδος, pleasure), [in LXX: Pro.23:29 (שִׂיחַ)* ;]

2. dislike (Plat.). disagreement (MM, VGT, see word): Luk.23:12 D.†

G2189.strong_def: hostility; by implication, a reason for opposition

G2621.def:
κατά-κειμαι
[in LXX: Pro.6:9 23:34 (שָׁכַב), Jdth.13:15, Wis.17:7 * ;]

2. to lie sick: Mrk.1:30 2:4, Jhn.5:6, Act.28:8; before ἐπί with genitive, Act.9:33; id. with accusative, Luk.5:25; ἐν, Jhn.5:3.
3. to recline at meals (cf. ἀνάιειμαι): Mrk.14:3, Luk.5:29; before ἐν, Mrk.2:15, Luk.7:37, 1Co.8:10.†
