G3936.strong_def: to stand beside, i.e. (transitively) to exhibit, proffer, (specially), recommend, (figuratively) substantiate; or (intransitively) to be at hand (or ready), aid

G5330.strong_def: a separatist, i.e. exclusively religious; a Pharisean, i.e. Jewish sectary

G2439.def:
ἱματίζω
(ἱμάτιον),
to clothe: Mrk.5:15, Luk.8:35 (elsewhere only in π.; cf. MM, Exp., xv; Deiss., LAE, 78 f.).†
(AS)

G2649.def:
κατα-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Job.15:6, Pro.25:18 (עָנָה), al. ;]
to bear witness againt: with accusative of thing(s) and genitive of person(s), Mat.26:62 27:13, Mrk.14:60.†
(AS)

G2301.def:
θεατρίζω
(θέατρον),
to make a spectacle of, expose to contempt (eccl.; ἐκθ-, Polyb.): pass., Heb.10:33.†
(AS)

G2222.def:
ζωή, -ῆς, ἡ (ζάω),
[in LXX chiefly for חַיִּים ;]
life (in Hom., Hdt., = βίος, which see; later, existence, vita quâ vivimus, as distinct from βίος, vita quam vivimus; opposite to θάνατος);
1. of natural life: Luk.16:25, Act.8:33, 1Co.15:19, 1Ti.4:8, Heb.7:3, Jas.4:14; πνεῦμα ζωῆς, Rev.11:11; ψυχὴ ζωῆς ( Gen.1:30), Rev.16:3; of the life of one risen from the dead, Rom.5:10, Heb.7:16.
2. Of the life of the kingdom of God, the present life of grace and the life of glory which is to follow (Dalman, Words, 156ff.; Westc, Epp. Jo., 214ff.; Cremer, 272ff.): Jhn.6:51, 53 Rom.7:10 8:6, 10 Php.2:16, Col.3:4, 2Pe.1:3; αἰώνος (reff. supr.; DCG, i, 538a, ii, 30f.), Jhn.4:36 12:50 17:3, 1Jn.1:2, al.; τ. φῶς τῆς ζ., Jhn.8:12; ὁ Λόγος τ. ζ., 1Jn.1:1; ὁ ἄρτος τ. ζ., Jo 6:35, 48; δικαίωσις ζωῆς, Rom.5:18; μετάνοια εἰς ζ., Act.11:18; ἐν αὐτῷ ζ. ἦν, Jhn.1:4; ζ. ἡ ἐν. Χ. Ἰ., 2Ti.1:1; τὰ πρὸς ζωήν, 2Pe.1:3, al.; στέφανος τῆς ζ., Jas.1:12, Rev.2:10; χάρις ζωῆς (genitive expl.), 1Pe.3:7; ζ. καὶ εἰρήνη, Rom.8:6; ζ. καὶ ἀφθαρσία, 2Ti.1:10; ἀνάστασις ζωῆς, Jhn.5:29; βίβλος ζωῆς, Php.4:3, Rev.3:5; ξύλον ζωῆς, Rev.2:7; ὕδωρ ζωῆς, Rev.22:17; meton., of that which has life: τ. πνεῦμα, Rom.8:10; ῥήματα, Jhn.6:63; of one who gives life, Jhn.11:25 14:6, 1Jn.1:2; ἡ ἐντολή, Jhn.12:50.
SYN.: see: βίος. (AS)

G4845.strong_def: to implenish completely, i.e. (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passive, be complete)

G5174.strong_def: the Troad (or plain of Troy), i.e. Troas, a place in Asia Minor

G1746.def:
ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2Ti.3:6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;]
1. with accusative of person(s), Mat.27:28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Mat.27:31, Mrk.15:20, Luk.15:22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.6:25, Mrk.6:9, Luk.8:27 12:22, Act.12:21; ptcp., Mat.22:11, Mrk.1:6, 2Co.5:3, Rev.1:13 15:6 19:14; of armour (figuratively): Rom.13:12, Eph.6:11, 14, 1Th.5:8; metaphorically, δύναμιν, Luk.24:49; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, 1Co.15:53-54; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, Eph 4:24, Col.3:10; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, Col.3:12; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, Rom.13:14, Gal.3:27,
2. to enter, press into: 2Ti.3:6 (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†
(AS)
G1746.strong_def: to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively)
G1746.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and G1416 (δύνω) (in the sense of sinking into a garment);

G0844.def:
αὐτόματος -ον, and -η, -ον
(etym. doubtful; see Boisacq, Prellwitz, see word), [in LXX, Lev.25:5, 11, 4Ki.19:29 (סָפִיחַ), Jos.6:5, Job.24:24, Wis.17:6 * ;]
1. of persons, acting of one's own will.
2. Of inanimate things and natural agencies, of itself, of its own accord: γῆ Mrk.4:28 (MM, see word); πύλη, Act.12:10.†
(AS)
G0844.derivation: from G846 (αὐτός) and the same as G3155 (μάτην);

G0026.def:
ἀγάπη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for אַהֲבָה, which is also rendered by ἀγάπησις and φιλία ;]
love, goodwill, esteem. Outside of bibl. and eccl. books, there is no clear instance (with Deiss., LAE, 18:4, 70:2, cf. the same writer in Constr. Quar., ii, 4; and with MM, VGT, see word, cf. Dr. Moulton in Exp. Times, xxvi, 3, 139). In NT, like ἀγαπάω, -ῶ,
1. Of men's love:
(a) to one another, Jhn.13:35;
(b) to God, 1Jn.2:5.
2. Of divine love;
(a) God's love: to men, Rom.5:8; to Christ, Jhn.17:26;
(b) Christ's love to men: Rom.8:35.
3. In pl., love feasts: Ju 12 (DB, iii, 157).
SYN.: φιλία. ἀ., signifying properly (see: ἀγαπάω) love which chooses its object, is taken over from LXX, where its connotation is more general, into NT, and there used exclusively to express that spiritual bond of love between God and man and between man and man, in Christ, which is characteristic of Christianity. It is thusdistinct from φιλία, friendship (Jas.4:4 only), στοργή, natural affection (in NT only in compounds, see: ἄστοργος) and ἔρως, sexual love, which is not used in NT, its place being taken by ἐπιθυμία. (Cf. ἀγαπάω; and see Abbott, Essays, 70f.; DB, vol. i., 555; Cremer, 13, 593; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0026.strong_def: love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast

G1630.def:
ἔκφοβος, -ον
[in LXX: ἔ. εἶναι for יָגֹר, Deu.9:19; also 1Ma.13:2 * ;]
affrighted, terrified: Mrk.9:16, Heb.12:21.†
(AS)

G2654.def:
κατ-αν-αλίσκω
[in LXX chiefly forאָכַל ;]
1. to use up, spend.
2. to consume: of fire, ptcp., Heb.12:29 (LXX).†
(AS)

G5420.strong_def: to fence or inclose, i.e. (specially), to block up (figuratively, to silence)
G5420.derivation: apparently a strengthening form of the base of G5424 (φρήν);

G1964.def:
ἐπιορκέω, -ῶ
(ἐπίορκος), [in LXX: I Est.1:48, Wis.14:28 * ;]
to swear falsely, forswear oneself: Mat.5:33.†
(AS)

G4959.strong_def: to moan jointly, i.e. (figuratively) experience a common calamity

G1088.def:
γέρων, -οντος, ὁ,
[in LXX for זָקֵן ;]
an old man: Jhn.3:4.†
(AS)

G5356.strong_def: decay, i.e. ruin (spontaneous or inflicted, literally or figuratively)

G3349.strong_def: to raise in mid-air, i.e. (figuratively) suspend (passively, fluctuate or be anxious)
G3349.derivation: from a compound of G3326 (μετά) and a collateral form of G142 (αἴρω) or perhaps rather G109 (ἀήρ) (compare "meteor");

G1154.def:
Δαμασκός, -οῦ, ἡ (Heb. דַּמֶּשֶׂק),
Damascus: Act.9.2ff. 22:5ff.26.12,20, 2Co.11:32, Gal.1:17.†
(AS)

G1408.def:
δρόμος, -ου, ὁ
(δραμεῖν, see: τρέχω) [in LXX chiefly for מְרוּצָה ;]
a course: figuratively, of life or ministry, Act.13:25 20:24, 2Ti.4:7.†
(AS)

G3824.strong_def: (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration

G2737.def:
κατώτερος, -έρα, -ερον
(κάτω), [in LXX for תַּחְתּוֹן, תַּחְתִּי ;]
lower; τὰ. κ. τῆς γῆς (see AR, Eph., l.with; for rendering this lower earth, see ICC, Eph, l.with), the lower parts of the earth (cf. Psa.139:15; cf. also MGr., ἡ κάτου γῆ, the underworld, Thumb, MGV, 334): Eph.4:9.†
(AS)

G0943.def:
βάτος, -ου, ὁ (Heb. בַּת),
[in LXX (also βαίθ, βάδος): II Est.7:22 * ;]
bath, a Jewish liquid measure, = μετρητής (which see), or about 8 3/4 gals.: Luk.16:6.†
(AS)
G0943.strong_def: a bath, or measure for liquids

G0939.def:
βάσις, ־εως, ἡ
(βαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for אֶדֶן ;]
1. a step (Æsch., al.).
2. Hence, a foot (Plat.; Wis.13:18): Act.3:7.
† (AS)
G0939.strong_def: a pace ("base"), i.e. (by implication) the foot

G1743.def:
ἐν-δυναμόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jdg.6:34, 1Ch.12:18 A (לָבַשׁ), Psa.52:7 (עָזַז)* ;]
to make strong, strengthen: with accusative, of person(s), Php.4:13, 1Ti.1:12, 2Ti.4:17. Pass., Act.9:22; C. dative, Rom.4:20; before ἐν, 2Ti.2:1 (ἐν Κυρίῳ), Eph.6:10 (Cremer, 221).†
(AS)

G1361.def:
Διοτρέφης (Rec. -τρεψής), -ες
(Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + τρέφω: cherished by Zeus),
as proper name, Diotrephes: III Jn 9.†
(AS)
G1361.strong_def: Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity
G1361.derivation: from the alternate of G2203 (Ζεύς) and G5142 (τρέφω);

G2149.def:
εὐρύ-χωρος, -ον
(εὐρύς, broad + χώρα), [in LXX for רָחַב ni., and cognate forms (Isa.30:23, al.), exc. 2Ch.18:9 (גֹּרֶן ;)
spacious, broad: Mat.7:13.†
(AS)

G0230.def:
ἀληθῶς
adv. (ἀληθής). [in LXX (Jer.28:6, Psa.58:1, al.) chiefly for אָמֵן and cogn. forms ;]
truly, surely: Mat.14:33 26:73 Mrk.14:70 15:39, Luk.9:27 12:44 21:3, Jhn.1:48 4:42 6:14 7:26, 40 8:31 17:8 Act.12:11, 1Th.2:13, 1Jn.2:5.†
(AS)

G4953.strong_def: a sign in common, i.e. preconcerted signal
G4953.derivation: neuter of a compound of G4862 (σύν) and the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);

G0061.def:
ἄγρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἄγω),
1. the chase, a hunting or catching: Luk.5:4.
2. that which is taken, a catch: of fish, Luk.5:9.
† (AS)
G0061.strong_def: (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish)

G4829.strong_def: to share jointly, i.e. participate in
G4829.derivation: middle voice from G4862 (σύν) and G3307 (μερίζω);

G0954.def:
Βεελζεβούλ (WH, App., 159, Rec., βεελζεβούλ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, lord, and the Talmudic זִבּוּל, from זֶבֶל, dung (Dalman, Gr., 137.n), or perh. זִבֻל, habitation, but, see DB, iv, 409f.; DCG, i, 181). The AV, RV, Beelzebub, comes through Vg. from 4Ki.1:2, בַּעַל זִבוּב, lord of flies (LXX, βάαλ μυῖα, Sm., βεελζεβούβ),
Beelzebul, Beelzebub, a name of Satan: Mat.10:25 12:24, 27 Mrk.3:22, Luk.11:15, 18 19.†
(AS)
G0954.strong_def: dung-god; Beelzebul, a name of Satan
G0954.derivation: of Chaldee origin (by parody on H01176);

G2946.def:
κύλισμα, -τος, τό
(κυλίω), [in Sm.: Eze.10:13 * ;]
1. a roll.
2. = κυλισμός (which see), a rolling, wallowing (or, as κυλίστρα, Xen., Eq., see 3, a rolling place): 2Pe.2:22 (Rec.).†
(AS)
G2946.strong_def: a wallow (the effect of rolling), i.e. filth

G5146.strong_def: properly, a crow-foot (three-pronged obstruction in war), i.e. (by analogy) a thorny plant (caltrop)

G4288.gloss: forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind

G1589.def:
ἐκλογή, ῆς ἡ
(ἐκλέγω), [in Aq.: Isa.22:7; Sm., Th.: Isa.37:24 * ;]
a choice, selection; in NT, always of the Divine choice (EV, election): σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς, genitive qual., a chosen vessel; κατ ἐ., Rom.9:11 11:5, 28; with genitive of person(s), 1Th.1:4, 2Pe.1:10; by meton., ἡ ἐ. = οἱ ἐκλεκτοί, Rom.11:7.†
(AS)

G0710.def:
ἀριστερός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for שְׂמֹאול ;]
left, on the left: ὅπλα, 2Co.6:7; ἡ ἀ.. (sc. χείρ), Mat.6:3; ἐξ ἀριστερῶν, on the left (MM, see word ): Mrk.10:37, Luk.23:33.†
(AS)
G0710.derivation: apparently a comparative of the same as G712 (ἄριστον);

G4909.gloss: allow, assent, be pleased, have pleasure
G4909.strong_def: to think well of in common, i.e. assent to, feel gratified with

G4376.strong_def: presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice

G2180.strong_def: an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus

G2136.def:
Εὐοδία (Rec. -ωδία), -ας, ἡ
Euodia (not as AV, Euodias), a Christian woman: Php.4:2.†
(AS)
G2136.strong_def: fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian woman

G4512.strong_def: a fold (as drawing together), i.e. a wrinkle (especially on the face)

G1566.def:
ἐκεῖσε
adv., [in LXX: Job.39:29 שָׁם * ;]
thither: Act.21:3; constr. pregn. (MM, Exp., xii; Field, Notes, 134), τοὺς ἐ. ὄντας, Act.22:5.†
(AS)

G0401.def:
ἀνά-χυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναχέω, to pour out),
a pouring out, overflowing, excess: metaphorically, 1Pe.4:4 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0401.derivation: from a comparative of G303 (ἀνά) and (to pour);

G5274.strong_def: to take from below, i.e. carry upward; figuratively, to take up, i.e. continue a discourse or topic; mentally, to assume (presume)

G2518.def:
καθεύδω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב, Gen.28:13, Psa.88:5, al.; also for יָשֵׁן, Sng.5:2, Dan LXX TH Dan.12:2, al.; for יָשַׁב, 1Ki.19:9 ;]
to sleep: Mat.8:24 9:24 13:25 25:5 26:46, 43 26:45, Mrk.4:27, 38 5:39 14:37, 40-41, Luk.8:52 22:46, 1Th.5:7. Metaphorical,
(a) of death (as Ps, Da, ll. with): 1Th.5:10 (cf. Mat.9:24, Mrk.5:39, Luk.8:52, and see Swete, Mk., l.with);
(b) of moral and spiritual insensibility: Mrk.13:36, Eph.5:14, 1Th.5:6.†
SYN.: (κοιμάω.) (AS)
G2518.strong_def: to lie down to rest, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep (literally or figuratively)

G2861.def:
κολυμβήθρα, -ας, ἡ
(κολνμβάω), [in LXX for בְּרֵכָה, 4Ki.18:27, al. ;]
a swimming pool, pool: Jhn.5:2, 4 5:7 9:7.†
(AS)
G2861.strong_def: a diving-place, i.e. pond for bathing (or swimming)

G1152.def:
Δάμαρις, -ιδος, ἡ
(δάμαρ, poët., a wife),
Damaris: Act.17:34.†
(AS)
G1152.strong_def: perhaps gentle; Damaris, an Athenian woman
G1152.derivation: probably from the base of G1150 (δαμάζω);

G0291.def:
Ἀμπλιᾶτος (T, -ίατος; Rec. Ἀμπλιᾶς; see MM, VGT, 5.see), -ου, ὁ
Ampliatus: Rom.1:6 8:8.†
(AS)

G4696.strong_def: a stain or blemish, i.e. (figuratively) defect, disgrace

G3488.derivation: a flower of the same name, from (stupefaction, as a "narcotic");

G2409.def:
ἱερεύς, -έως, ὁ
(ἱερός), [in LXX for כָּהֵן ;]
a priest: ἱ. τ. Διός, Act.14:13; of Jewish priests, Mat.8:4 12:4-5, Mrk.1:44 2:26, Luk.1:5 5:14, Jhn.1:19, Heb.8:4, al.; of Christ, Heb.5:6 (LXX) Heb.10:21; of Christians, Rev.1:6 5:10 20:6 (Cremer, 293; on the accusative pl., ἱερεῖς, see Thack., Gr., 147 f.; Bl., § 8, 2)
(AS)

G4695.strong_def: to stain or soil (literally or figuratively)

G3573.strong_def: to nod, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep; figuratively, to delay
G3573.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G3506 (νεύω);

G1895.def:
ἐπει-δή-περ
conj.,
forasmuch as ("a stately compound," frequently in cl. and suitable for the formal introduction of Lk): Luk.1:1.†
(AS)

G1009.def:
βότρυς, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX for אֶשְׁכֹּל ;]
a cluster of grapes: Rev.14:18 (cf. στραφυλή) .†
(AS)

G1325.def:
δίδωμι,
[in LXX chiefly for נָתַן (53 words in all) ;]
to give—in various senses, accusative to context—bestow, grant, supply, deliver, commit, yield: absol., Act.20:35; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mat.4:9 5:31, Jhn.1:12, al. mult.; with dative of person(s), before ἐκ, Mat.25:8; id. with genitive part.. Rev.2:17; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.3:16, Rev.20:13, al.; δεξιάς, Gal.2:9; φίλημα, Luk.7:45; γνῶσιν, Luk.1:77; κρίσιν, Jhn.5:22; of seed yielding fruit, Mrk.4:7, 8; ἐργασίαν (Deiss., LAE, 117f.), Luk.12:58; with inf. fin., Mat.27:34, Mrk.5:43, Luk.8:55, Jhn.6:52, al.; with dative of person(s) and inf., Luk.1:74, al.; with accusative and inf., Act.2:27, Rev.3:9; with dupl. accusative, Mat.20:28, Mrk.10:45, Eph.1:22 4:11, 2Th.3:9, 1Ti.2:6, al.; ἑαυτὸν δ. εἰς (Polyb., al.), Act.19:31; with dative of person(s), before κατά (MM, Exp., xi), Rev.2:28 (LXX); δ. ἵνα, Rev.3:9; δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἀνεῳγμένην, Rev.3:8.
SYN.: δωρέομαι. (AS)
G1325.strong_def: to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection)
G1325.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses);

G4363.strong_def: to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm)

G4937.gloss: break (in pieces), broken to shivers (+ -hearted), bruise
G4937.strong_def: to crush completely, i.e. to shatter (literally or figuratively)
G4937.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G5147 (τρίβος);

G0045.def:
ἄγκυρα, -ας, ἡ (ἄγκος, a bend), [in Sm.: Jer.52:18 * ;]
an anchor: Act.27:29, 30 40 ; figuratively (MM, VGT, see word), Heb.6:19.†
(AS)

G2338.def:
θῆλυς, -εια, -υ
[in LXX chiefly for נְקֵבָה ;]
female: as subst., ἡ θ., a female, a woman: Rom.1:26-27; τὸ θ.., Mat.19:4, Mrk.10:6, Gal.3:28.†
(AS)

G4929.strong_def: to arrange jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to direct

G3878.strong_def: to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey

G2207.def:
ζηλωτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ζηλόω), [in LXX for קַנָּא (θεὸς ζ.), Exo.20:5 34:14, Deu.4:24 5:9 6:15; קַנּוֹא, Nam.1:2 (θεός); pl., I Est.8:72; ζ. τῶν νόμων, 2Ma.4:2;τὸν ζ. Φινεές, 4Ma.18:12 (cf. Num.25:11)* ;]
1. in cl. an emulator, zealous admirer (Plat., al.).
2. eagerly desirous, zealous;
(a) absol., as in OT, ll. with;
(b) with genitive obj.: (zealous to acquire or to defend), 1Co.14:12, Tit.2:14, 1Pe.3:13; τ. νόμου (2Mac, l.with), Act.21:20; παραδόσεων, Gal.1:14; with genitive of person(s), θεοῦ, Act.22:3.
3. In FlJ, NT, a Zealot, member of the Jewish party so called: as surname of the Apostle Simon, Luk.6:15, Act.1:13.†
(AS)

G2944.def:
κυκλόω, -ῶ
(κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;]
1. to move in a circle, revolve.
2. to surround, encircle: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.10:24 (WH, txt., cf. -εύω), Act.14:20; pass., Luk.21:20, Heb.11:30 (cf. περι-κυκλόω).†
(AS)

G4126.derivation: probably a form of G4150 (πλύνω) (through the idea of plunging through the water);

G1104.def:
γνησίως, adv.,
[in LXX: 2Ma.14:8, 3Ma.3:23 * ;]
sincerely, honourably: Phi 2:20 (for a parallel in π., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G4508.strong_def: dirty, i.e. (relatively) cheap or shabby; morally, wicked

G1036.def:
βυθίζω
(βυθός), [in LXX: 2Ma.12:4 * ;]
trans., to cause to sink, to sink: metaphorically, εἰς ὄλεθρον, 1Ti.6:9; pass., to sink, intrans.: Luk.5:7.†
(AS)
G1036.strong_def: to sink; by implication, to drown

G1262.def:
δια-λύω
[in LXX for אבה, חבל, etc. ;]
to part asunder, dissolve; of an assembly, pass., to disperse: Act.5:36.†
(AS)

G1871.def:
ἐπ-αιτέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: Psa_109:10 (H7592) Sir_40:28 * ;]
1. to ask besides.
2. to beg (as a mendicant; cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Luk.16:3 18:35 (Cremer, 74).†
(AS)

G0974.def:
βιβλαρίδιον, -ου, τό (diminutive of βιβλάριον, diminutive of βίβλος),
a little book: Rev.10:2, 8 (WH, βιβλιόν, T2, 7 βιβλιδάριον) 9, 10. Not hitherto found elsewhere.†
(AS)

G5534.derivation: third person singular of the same as G5530 (χράομαι) or G5531 (χράω) used impersonally;

G4964.gloss: conform to, fashion self according to
G4964.strong_def: to fashion alike, i.e. conform to the same pattern (figuratively)
G4964.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G4976 (σχῆμα);

G5480.strong_def: a scratch or etching, i.e. stamp (as a badge of servitude), or scupltured figure (statue)

G4656.strong_def: to obscure or blind (literally or figuratively)

G1611.def:
ἔκ-στασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐξίστημι) [in LXX: Gen.27:33, 1Ki.14:15, Eze.26:16, al. (חֲרָדָה); 2Ch.14:14 17:10 20:29 (פַּחַד), al. ;]
1. a displacement (Arist.).
2. An abnormal condition of the mind, in which the subject passes out of his usual self-control (Hippocr.); in NT (Kennedy, Sources, 121 f.);
(a) a trance: Act.10:10 11:5 22:17;
(b) amazement: Mrk.5:42 16:8, Luk.5:26, Act.3:19.†
(AS)
G1611.strong_def: a displacement of the mind, i.e. bewilderment, "ecstasy"

G0975.def:
βιβλίον, -ου, τό (diminutive of βίβλος, which see),
[in LXX also in the alternat. form βυβ-, chiefly for סֶפֶר and the most frequently of the cognate forms ;]
1. a paper, letter, written document: β. ἀποστασίου, bill of divorce, Mat.19:7, Mrk.10:4.
2. a book, a roll: Luk.4:17, 20 Jhn.20:30 21:25, Gal.3:10, 2Ti.4:13, Heb.9:19 10:7, Rev.1:11 5:1-9 6:14 10:8 20:12 22:7-19; β. τ. ζωῆς, Rev.13:8 17:8 20:12 21:27.
† (AS)

G0238.def:
ἀλληγορέω, -ῶ
(ἄλλος, ἀγορεύω)
to speak allegorically (Cremer, 96 ff.): Gal.4:24.†
(AS)

G1921.strong_def: to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge

G4913.strong_def: to rejoice in with oneself, i.e. feel satisfaction concerning
G4913.derivation: middle voice from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G2237 (ἡδονή);

G2543.def:
καίτοι
(= καί τοι, and so also written in cl.)
concessive particle, [in LXX: 4Ma.2:6 * ;]
and yet, although: Act.14:17; with ptcp., Heb.4:3.†
(AS)

G1283.def:
δι-αρπάζω
[in LXX for בָּזַז, גָּזַל, שָׁסַס, etc. ;]
to plunder: Mat.12:29, Mrk.3:27.†
(AS)

G4532.strong_def: Salem (i.e. Shalem), a place in Palestine

G0561.def:
ἀπ-έναντι
adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX);
1. over against (MM, see word): Mat.27:61, Mrk.12:41, WH, mg.
2. before, in the presence of: Mat.27:24 (WH, mg.), Act.3:16, Rom.3:18.
3. against: Act.17:7.†
(AS)
G0561.strong_def: from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against

G0831.def:
αὐθεντέω, -ῶ
(αὐθέντης, i.e. αὐτο- ἕντης, one who acts on his own authority, in π., an autocrat; cf. Wis.12:6; cf. -ία, 3Ma.2:29; -ικος is frequently in vernacular, MM, see word)
to govern, exercise authority over: 1Ti.2:12.†
(AS)
G0831.strong_def: to act of oneself, i.e. (figuratively) dominate
G0831.derivation: from a compound of G846 (αὐτός) and an obsolete (a worker);

G3870.gloss: beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray
G3870.strong_def: to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation)

G2111.def:
εὔ-θετος, -ον
(τίθημι), [in LXX: Psa.32:6 (מָצָא), From Th Sus 1:15* ;]
ready for use, fit: of things, with dative, Heb.6:7; before εἰς, Luk.14:35; of persons, with dative, Luk.9:62 (for rabbinic parallels, see Dalman, Words, 119 f.).†
(AS)
G2111.derivation: from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G3741.strong_def: and from G40 (ἅγιος), which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure)
G3741.derivation: of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from 1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from G2413 (ἱερός), which denotes formal consecration;

G1156.def:
δάνιον, -ου, τό
(late form of δάνειον, Rec.; see: δανίζω), [in LXX: Deu.24:11 (נָשָׁה) 15:8, 10 (עָבַט hi.), 4Ma.2:8 * ;]
a loan: Mat.18:27.†
(AS)
G1156.strong_def: probably akin to the base of G1325 (δίδωμι); a loan

G1275.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the genitive case of G3956 (πᾶς);

G1210.def:
δέω (I),
[in LXX chiefly for אסר ;]
to tie, bind, fasten;
(1) with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς δεσμάς, Mat.13:30; of an ass, Mat.21:2, Mrk.11:2, 4 Luk.19:30.
(2) with accusative of person(s), of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, Jhn.19:40; δεδομένος τ. πόδας . . . κειρίαις (Bl., §34, 6; Kühner 3, iii, 125), Jhn.11:44; of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, Rev.9:14; a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, Mrk.5:3, 4; captives, Mat.12:29 14:3 22:13 27:2, Mrk.3:27 6:17 15:1, 7, Jhn.18:12, 24, Act.9:2, 14, 21, 21:11, 13 22:5, 29 24:27, Col.4:3, Rev.20:2; ἁλύσεσι, Act.12:6 21:33. Metaphorical, ὁ λόγος τ. Θεοῦ, 2Ti.2:9; of Satan binding by disease (MM, see word), Luk.13:16; of constraint or obligation, Act.20:22; of the marriage bond, 1Co.7:39; id. with dative of person(s), ἀνδρί, Rom.7:2; γυναικί, 1Co.7:27; in Rabbinic lang. (Dalman, Words, 213f.), to forbid, declare forbidden, Mat.16:19 18:18 (cf. κατα-, περι-, συν-, ὐπο-δέω; Cremer, 82).
† (AS)
G1210.strong_def: to bind (in various applications, literally or figuratively)

G1139.def:
δαιμονίζομαι
(in cl. also δαιμονάω; δαίμων), [in Aq.: Ps 90(91):6 * ;]
to be under the power of a δαίμων (δαιμόνιον, which see), to be possessed: Mat.15:22; elsewhere always ptcp., -ιζόμενος, -ισθείς: Mat.4:24; 8:16, 28, 33 9:32 12:22, Mrk.1:32 15 16 18, Luk.8:36, Jhn.10:21 (Cremer, 171).†
(AS)
G1139.strong_def: to be exercised by a dæmon

G2695.def:
κατα-σφάζω
[in LXX: Zec.11:5 (הָרַג), Eze.16:40 (בָּתַק pi.), 2Ma.8:1-36 ;]
to kill off, slay: with accusative, Luk.19:27.†
(AS)

G2259.def:
ἡνίκα
rel. adv. of time,
at which time, when; before αν, with subjc., whensoever: 2Co.3:15-16.†
(AS)

G2799.strong_def: to sob, i.e. wail aloud (whereas 1145 is rather to cry silently)

G2658.def:
κατ-αντάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ki.3:29 (חוּל), 2Ma.4:21 2Mac 4:24 2Mac 4:44 2Mac 6:14 * ;]
to come to, arrive at: before εἰς, with accusative loc., Act.16:1 18:19, 24 21:7 25:13 (see M, Pr., 132) Act.27:12 28:13; before ἀντικρύ, with genitive, Act.20:15. Metaphorical, before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), 1Co.10:11 14:36; id. with accusative of thing(s), to attain to: Act.26:7, Eph.4:13, Php.3:11.†
(AS)
G2658.strong_def: to meet against, i.e. arrive at (literally or figuratively)
G2658.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G473 (ἀντί);

G0333.def:
ἀνα-θεωρέω, -ῶ
to observe carefully, consider well: Act.17:23, Heb.13:7 (Diod., al.).†
(AS)
G0333.strong_def: to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively)

G2644.def:
κατ-αλλάσσω
(Att.. -ττω; cf. ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX: Jer.48:39 (חָתַת), 2Ma.1:5 2Mac 7:33 2Mac 8:29 * ;]
prop., to change, exchange (esp. of money); hence, of persons, to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile (for exx. in cl., see Thayer„ LS): of the reconciliation of man to God (Lft., Notes, 288; ICC on Ro, l.with; DCG, ii, 474, 797), 2Co.5:18-19; pass Rom.5:10, 2Co.5:20; of a woman returning to her husband, 1Co.7:11 (cf. ἀπο-καταλλάσσω).†
(AS)
G2644.strong_def: to change mutually, i.e. (figuratively) to compound a difference

G2481.def:
ἴσως
(ἴσσς),
adv., [in LXX for אוּלַי, אַךְ, הֵן, Gen.32:20, Jer.5:4, al. ;]
1. equally.
2. perhaps: Luk.20:13.†
(AS)

G2009.def:
ἐπιτιμία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιτιμάω), [in LXX: Wis_3:10 * ;]
1. citizenship, franchise.
2. As in Inscr. (LS, see word), LXX, l.with (= cl. τὸ ἐπιτίμιον), punishment, penalty: 2Co.2:6.†
(AS)
G2009.strong_def: properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of G2008 (ἐπιτιμάω)) of a penalty
G2009.derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G5092 (τιμή);

G4858.strong_def: unison of sound ("symphony"), i.e. a concert of instruments (harmonious note)

G5572.strong_def: a spurious teacher, i.e. propagator of erroneous Christian doctrine

G3521.strong_def: abstinence (from lack of food, or voluntary and religious); specially, the fast of the Day of Atonement

G2453.def:
Ἰουδαῖος, -αία, -αῖον
(Ἰούδας),
Jewish: ἀνήρ, Act.10:28 22:3; ἄνθρωπος, Act.21:39; ψευδοπροφήτης, 13:6; ἀσχιερεύς, 19:14; γυνή, 16:1 24:24; γῆ, Jhn.3:22; χώρα, Mrk.1:5. Substantively,
(a) Ἰουδαῖος, ὁ, a Jew: Jhn.4:9, Act.18:24, Rom.2:28; pl., Rev.2:9 3:9; οἱ Ἰ., Mat.2:2, Mrk.7:3, Jhn.2:6, al.; Ἰ. τε καὶ Ἕλληνες, Act.14:1, al.; κ. προσήλυτοι, Act.2:10; ἔθνη τε κ. Ἰ., Act.14:5; οἱ κατὰ τὰ ἔθνη, Act.21:21; of Jewish Christians, Gal.2:13; of the ruling class who opposed Jesus, Jhn.1:19 2:18 5:10 11:8 13:33, al.;
(b) Ἰουδαία, -ας, ἡ (sc. γῆ, χώρα, cf. Jhn.3:22, Mrk.1:5), (Heb. יְהוּדָה), Judæa: Mat.2:1, Luk.1:5, Jhn.4:3, al.
(AS)
G2453.derivation: from G2448 (Ἰουδά) (in the sense of G2455 (Ἰούδας) as a country);

G2129.def:
εὐλογία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for בְּרָכָה ;]
1. fair speaking, flattering speech: χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐ., Rom.16:18.
2. praise: of God (as in late Inscr.; LS, see word) and Christ, Rev.5:12-13 7:12
3. In LXX and NT: blessing, benediction;
(a) the act of blessing: 1Co.10:16, Heb.12:17, Jas.3:10;
(b) concrete, a blessing: Rom.15:29, 2Co.9:5-6, Gal.3:14, Eph.1:3, Heb.6:7, 1Pe.3:9 (cf. Deu.11:26, Sir.7:32, al.).†
(AS)
G2129.strong_def: fine speaking, i.e. elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), i.e. (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or largess

G0250.def:
ἀλόη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Sng.4:14 א (אֲהָלִים)* ;]
the aloe, aloes (the powder of a fragrant wood): Jhn.19:39.†
(AS)

G0526.def:
ἀπ-αλλοτριόω, -ῶ
[in LXX for זוּר, H5110 etc. ;]
to alienate, estrange; pass.: Eph.2:12 4:18, Col.1:21 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 95, 633).†
(AS)
G0526.strong_def: to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant
G0526.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and a derivative of G245 (ἀλλότριος);

G4658.strong_def: a Scythene or Scythian, i.e. (by implication) a savage

G0023.def:
ἀγανακτέω, -ῶ (ἄγαν, much, ἄχομαι, to grieve),
[in LXX: Wis.5:22, 12:27, Da TH Bel 28, 4Ma.4:21 * ;]
to be indignant: Mat.21:15, 26:8, Mrk.10:14, 14:4; before περί, Mat.20:24, Mrk.10:41; before ὅτι, Luk.13:14 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0023.strong_def: akin to the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant

G3771.derivation: from G3772 (οὐρανός) and the enclitic of source;

G0092.def:
ἀδίκημα, -τος, τό
(ἀδικέω), [in LXX for עָוֹן, פֶּשַׁע, etc. ;]
a wrong, injury, misdeed (MM, VGT, see word): Act.18:14 24:20, Rev.18:5.†
(AS)

G5206.strong_def: the placing as a son, i.e. adoption (figuratively, Christian sonship in respect to God)
G5206.derivation: from a presumed compound of G5207 (υἱός) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G0071.def:
ἄγω,
[in LXX for בּוא hi., לקח, נהג, etc. ;]
1. to lead, bring, carry: with ace, before ἐπί, εἰς, ἕως, πρός and simple dative; metaphorically, to lead, guide, impel: Jhn.10:16 Rom.2:4, Heb.2:10, 2Ti.3:6, al.
2. to spend or keep a day: Luk.24:21, Act.19:38
3. Intrans., to go: subjunc., ἄγωμεν, Mat.2:46, al. (Cramer, 61; MM, VGT, see word).
(AS)
G0071.strong_def: properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce

G1717.def:
ἐμφανής, -ές
(ἐμφαίνω, to show in, exhibit), [in LXX: Mic.4:1, Isa.2:2 (כּוּן ni.), Wis.6:22 7:21 14:17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Exo.2:14 (יָדַע ni.), Isa.65:1 (דָּרַשׁ ni.)* ;]
manifest: Act.10:40; metaphorically, Rom.10:20 (LXX) (see: ἐπιφανής).†
(AS)
G1717.derivation: from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G5316 (φαίνω);

G4800.strong_def: to continue to live in common with, i.e. co-survive (literally or figuratively)

G1437.strong_def: a conditional particle; in case that, provided, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote indefiniteness or uncertainty

G1148.def:
Δαλμανουθά, ἡ
indecl.,
Dalmanutha, an unidentified place near the Sea of Galilee: Mrk.8:10 (cf. Μαγαδάν).†
(AS)

G0118.def:
ἀθλέω, -ῶ (in cl. also ἀθλεύω, ἆθλος, a contest, in war or in sport),
to contend in games, wrestle, combat: 2Ti.2:5.†
(AS)
G0118.strong_def: to contend in the competitive games
G0118.derivation: from (a contest in the public lists);

G0265.def:
ἁμάρτημα, -τος, τό
(ἁμαρτεῖν, see supr.), [in LXX for חַטָּאָה, עָוֺן etc. ;]
an act of disobedience to divine law (Lft., Notes, 273), a sinful deed, a sin: Mrk.3:28-29, Rom.3:25, 1Co.6:18, 2Pe.1:9, WH, mg.; αἰώνιωv ἀ. (DCG, i, 788a), Mrk.3:29 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀγνόημα, ἁμαρτία, ἀνομία, ἀσέβεια, ἥττημα, παράβασις, παρακοή, παρανομία, παράπτωμα (ν. Cremer, 100; Tr., Syn., § lxvi; DB, iv, 532; DCG, l.with; Westc, Eph., 165 f.) (AS)

G5092.strong_def: a value, i.e. money paid, or (concretely and collectively) valuables; by analogy, esteem (especially of the highest degree), or the dignity itself

G4651.derivation: probably from an obsolete (perhaps strengthened from the base of G4649 (σκοπός) and meaning to pierce);

G5476.derivation: adverb perhaps from the base of G5490 (χάσμα) through the idea of a fissure in the soil;

G5117.gloss: coast, licence, place, X plain, quarter, + rock, room, where
G5117.strong_def: a spot (general in space, but limited by occupancy; whereas G5561 (χώρα) is a large but participle locality), i.e. location (as a position, home, tract, etc.); figuratively, condition, opportunity; specially, a scabbard

G2951.def:
κύμινον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Isa.28:25, 27 (כַּמֹּן)* ;]
cumin: Mat.23:23.†
(AS)

G2640.def:
κατά-λειμμα, -τος, τό
(καταλείπω), [in LXX far שָׁאַר (Isa.10:22 14:22), שְׁאֵרִית, etc. ;]
a remnant: Rom.9:27, Rec. (for ὑπόλειμμα, which see).†
(AS)
G2640.strong_def: a remainder, i.e. (by implication) a few

G0235.def:
ἀλλά (ἀλλ᾽ usually bef. α and υ, often bef. ε and η, rarely bef. ο and ω, never bef. ι; Tdf., Pr., 93 f.; WH, App., 146),
adversative particle,
stronger than δέ; prop. neuter pl. of ἄλλος, used adverbially, with changed accent; hence prop. otherwise, on the other hand (cf. Rom.3:31);
1. opposing a previous negation, but: οὐ (μὴ) . . . ἀ., Mat.5:15, 17 Mrk.5:39, Jhn.7:16, al.; rhetorically subordinating but not entirely negativing what precedes, οὐ . . . ἀ., not so much . . . as, Mrk.9:37, Mat.10:20, Jhn.12:44, al.; with ellipse of the negation, Mat.11:7-9, Act.19:2, 1Co.3:6 6:11 7:7, 2Co.7:1, Gal.2:3, al.; in opposition to a foregoing pos. sentence, ἀ. οὐ, Mat.24:6, 1Co.10:23; οὐ μόνον . . . ἀ. καί, Jhn.5:18, Rom.1:32, al.; elliptically, after a negation, ἀ. ἵνα, Mrk.14:49, Jhn.1:8 9:3, al.; = εἰ μή (Bl., §77, 13; M, Pr., 241; but cf. WM, §iii, 10), Mat.20:23, Mrk.4:22.
2. Without previous negation, to express opposition, interruption, transition, etc., but: Jhn.16:20 12:27, Gal.2:14; before commands or requests, Act.10:20 26:16, Mat.9:18, Mrk.9:22, al.; to introduce an accessory idea, 2Co.7:11; in the apodosis after a condition or concession with εἰ, ἐάν, εἴπερ, yet, still, at least, Mrk.14:29, 1Co.9:2, 2Co.4:16, Col.2:5, al.; after μέν, Act.4:17, Rom.14:20, 1Co.14:17; giving emphasis to the following clause, ἀλλ᾽ ἔρχεται ὥρα, yea, etc., Jhn.16:2; so with neg., ἀλλ᾽ οὐδέ, nay, nor yet, Luk.23:15.
3. Joined with other particles (a practice which increases in late writers; Simcox, LNT, 166), ἀ. γε, yet at least, Luk.24:21, 1Co.9:2; ἄ ἤ., save only, except, Luk.12:51, 2Co.1:13; ἀ. μὲν οὖν, Php.3:8 (on this usage, see MM, VGT, see word).
(AS)
G0235.strong_def: properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations)

G3031.strong_def: frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it

G5504.strong_def: "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto

G2266.def:
Ἡρῳδιάς (Rec. Ἡρω-), -άδος, ἡ
Herodias, granddaughter of Herod the Great: Mat.14:3, 6, Mrk.6:17, 19 6:22, Luk.3:19.†
(AS)
G2266.strong_def: Herodias, a woman of the Heodian family

G2158.def:
εὐσχήμωι, -ον
(εὖ, σχῆμα), [in LXX: Pro.11:25 * ;]
1. elegant, graceful, comely (Eur., Plat., al.): τὰ εὐ. ἡμῶν (opposite to τὰ ἀσχ- ἡμ-), 1Co.12:24; in moral sense, seemly, becoming, 1Co.7:35.
2. Also in late Gk. (see Swete, Mk., l.with; MM, Exp., xiv), wealthy, influential (RV, of honourable estate): Mrk.15:43, Act.13:50 17:12.†
(AS)

G2814.def:
κλῆμα, -τος, τό
(κλάω), [in LXX chiefly for זְמוֹרָה, דָּלִיָּה, Eze.15:2 17:6-7, al. ;]
a vine-twig, vine-branch: Jhn.15:2, 4-6.†
(AS)
G2814.strong_def: a limb or shoot (as if broken off)

G4276.strong_def: to hope in advance of other confirmation

G1855.def:
ἔξωθεν
adv. (ἔξω opposite to ἔσωθεν), [in LXX for חוּץ ;]
1. prop. (in answer to the question, Whence ?), from without: Mrk.7:18
2. More often (= ἔξω; cf. Bl., § 25, 3), without: Mat.23:27-28 Mrk.7:18, 2Co.7:5; τὸ ἔ., Mat.23:25, Luk.11:39-40; οἱ ἔ., 1Ti.3:7, Mrk.4:11 (WH, mg.); ὁ ἔ. κόσμος, 1Pe.3:3; ἐκβάλλειν ἔ., Rev.11:2. As prep. with genitive: Mrk.7:15, Rev.11:1-19 4Ki.14:20 (cf. Robertson, Gr., 548).†
(AS)

G4624.strong_def: to entrap, i.e. trip up (figuratively, stumble (transitively) or entice to sin, apostasy or displeasure)

G2824.def:
κλίμα, -τος, τό
(κλίνω) [in LXX: Jdg.20:2 A (פִּנָּה)* ;]
1. an inclination, slope, esp. the slope from the equator to the pole (Arist).
2. a region (Polyb., al.): pl., Rom.15:23, 2Co.11:10, Gal.1:21.†
(AS)
G2824.strong_def: a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country

G1194.def:
δέρω
[in LXX: Lev.1:6, 2Ch.29:34; 35:11 (פָּשַׁט hi.)* ;]
1. to skin, flay.
2. (of. Eng. slang, hide) to beat, thrash: with accusative, Mat.21:35, Mrk.12:3, 5, Luk.20:10, 11 22:63, Jhn.18:23, Act.5:40 16:37 22:19; ὡς ἀέρα δέρων, 1Co.9:26; εἰς πρόσωπου δ., 2Co.11:20. Pass., Mrk.13:9, Luk.12:47, 48 (δαρήσεται πολλάς, ὀλίγας, Sc. πληγάς).†
(AS)
G1194.strong_def: properly, to flay, i.e. (by implication) to scourge, or (by analogy) to thrash

G4399.strong_def: to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate

G1934.def:
ἐπι-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, 4Ki.8:8, Isa.62:12, al.; also for בָּקַשׁ, 3Ki.20:1, Ecc.7:28), Hos.3:5; פָּקַד, 4Ki.3:8 ;]
"directive" of ζητέω (MM, Exp., xiv),
to inquire for, seek after, wish for: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.6:32 12:39 16:4, Luk.12:30, Act.19:39, Rom.11:7, Php.4:17, Heb.11:14 13:14; with accusative of person(s), Luk.4:42, Act.12:19; with inf., Act.13:7.†
(AS)
G1934.strong_def: to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave

G3919.strong_def: to lead in aside, i.e. introduce surreptitiously

G5541.strong_def: to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently

G0704.def:
ἀρήν, ἀρνός, ὁ
(nom, not in use, exc. in early times: see MM, see word), [in LXX for מְרִיא, כֶּבֶשׂ, etc. ;]
a lamb: Luk.10:3.†
(AS)

G2592.def:
καρπο-φορέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Hab.3:17 (פָּרַח), Wis.10:7 * ;]
to bear fruit: χόρτον, Mrk.4:28 (cf. Wis, l.with). Metaphorical, of conduct: Mat.13:23, Mrk.4:20, Luk.8:15, Rom.7:4-5, Col.1:10; mid., Col.1:6.†
(AS)

G2337.def:
θηλάζω
(θηλή, a breast), [in LXX chiefly for יָנַק hi. ;]
1. of the mother, to suckle: Mat.24:19, Mrk.13:17, Luk.21:23.
2. Of the young, to suck: Mat.21:16; μαστούς, Luk.11:27 (cf. Job.3:12, Sng.8:1, al.).†
(AS)

G2423.def:
Ἰεχονίας, -ον, ό (Heb. יְכׇנְיָה, Jehoiakin),
Jechoniah: Mat.1:11-12.†
(AS)

G1276.def:
δια-περάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Deu.30:13, Isa.23:2 (עבר), עבר), 1Ma.6:1-63 * ;]
to pass over, cross over: Mat.9:1; before ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Mat.14:34, Mrk.6:53; εἰς, Mrk.5:21, Act.21:2; πρὸς ἡμᾶς, Luk.16:28.†
(AS)
G1276.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and a derivative of the base of G4008 (πέραν);

G2796.def:
κίνησις, -εως, ἡ
(κινέω), [in LXX: Job.16:6 (5), (נִיד), al. ;]
a moving: Jhn.5:3.†
(AS)

G1292.def:
διάστημα, -τος, τό
(διίστημι), [in LXX for רֶוַח, etc. ;]
an interval, space: of time (Sir, prol. 24), Act.5:7.†
(AS)

G0416.def:
ἀνεμίζω = Attic ἀνεμόω
(ἄνεμος);
pass.,
to be driven by the wind: Jas.1:6.†
(AS)

G2694.def:
κατα-σύρω
[in LXX: Jer.49:10 (חָשַׂף), Dan LXX, Dan.11:10, 26 (שָׁטַף) * ;]
1. to pull down.
2. to drag away: with accusative of person(s), Luk.12:58.†
(AS)
G2694.strong_def: to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially

G0593.def:
ἀπο-δοκιμάζω
[in LXX: Psa.118:22, al. (מָאַס) ;]
to reject: Mat.21:42 (LXX), Mrk.8:31 12:10" (LXX) Luk.9:22 17:25 20:17" (LXX), Heb.12:17, 1Pe.2:4 2:7" (LXX) (Cremer, 701; MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0593.strong_def: to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate

G5164.strong_def: a wheel (as a runner), i.e. (figuratively) a circuit of physical effects

G0644.def:
ἀπο-σκίασμα, -τος, τό
(ἀποσκιάζω, to cast a shadow; v,s. σκία)
a shadow: Jas.1:17 (MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0644.derivation: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and a derivative of G4639 (σκιά);

G4245.strong_def: older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter"

G1287.def:
δια-σκορπίζω
[in LXX for פּוּץ, זָרָה, etc. ;]
to scatter abroad, disperse: of sheep, Mat.26:31 = Mrk.14:27" (LXX) ; of persons, Luk.1:51, Act.5:37, opposite to συνάγω, Jhn.11:52; of winnowing grain, Mat.25:24, 26; metaphorically, of property, to squander, waste: Luk.15:13 16:1.†
(AS)
G1287.strong_def: to dissipate, i.e. (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander

G5341.derivation: by transposition for a derivative probably of G5316 (φαίνω) (as showing outside the other garments);

G3735.strong_def: perhaps akin to G142 (αἴρω); compare G3733 (ὄρνις)); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain)
G3735.derivation: probably from an obsolete (to rise or "rear";

G1725.def:
ἔν-αντι
adv.,
a κοινή word (MM, Exp., xii),
before; as prep., with genitive: Luk.1:8, Act.7:10 (WH, ἐναντίον), Act.8:21.†
(AS)

G0671.def:
ἀπό-χρησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποχράομαι, to use to the full, abuse)
abuse, misuse: Col.2:22 (MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0671.strong_def: the act of using up, i.e. consumption
G0671.derivation: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G5530 (χράομαι);

G0133.def:
αἴνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(αἰνέω), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹדָה, תְּהִלָּה ;]
praise (Eccl.): θυσία αἰνέσεως (Lev.7:12, זֶבַח תּוֹדָה), Heb.13:15.†
(AS)
G0133.strong_def: a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a thank(-offering)

G2764.def:
κεραμικός, -ή, -όν
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:41 (פֶּחָר)* ;]
1. (cl.) of a potter (e.g. γῆ).
2. In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), earthen: Rev.2:27.†
(AS)

G3423.strong_def: to give a souvenir (engagement present), i.e. betroth

G0196.def:
ἀκριβής, -ές
[in LXX: Dan LXX 2:45 6:12 (יַצִּיב) Dan.4:25, Est.4:5, Sir.18:29 19:25 31:24 32:3 * ;]
exact, precise, careful, of things and persons: superl., Act.26:5.†
(AS)
G0196.derivation: superlative of (a derivative of the same as G206 (ἄκρον));

G3956.gloss: all (manner of, means), alway(-s), any (one), X daily, + ever, every (one, way), as many as, + no(-thing), X thoroughly, whatsoever, whole, whosoever
G3956.derivation: including all the forms of declension; apparently a primary word;

G5596.strong_def: a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful
G5596.derivation: diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5597 (ψώχω);

G0328.def:
ἀνα-ζώννυμι
[in LXX: Jdg.18:16, Pro.31:17 (חָגַר)* ;]
to gird up: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, 1Pe.1:13.†
(AS)

G1377.def:
διώκω
[in LXX chiefly for רָדַף ;]
1. to put to flight, drive away: Mat.23:34.
2. to pursue;
(a) of persons; with accusative, without hostility, to follow after: Luk.17:23; with hostile purpose: Act.26:11, Rev.12:13. Hence, to persecute: Mat.5:10-12, 44 10:23, Luk.11:49 21:12, Jhn.5:16 15:20, Act.7:52 9:4-5 22:4, 7-8 26:14-15 Rom.12:14, 1Co.4:12 15:9, 2Co.4:9, Gal.1:13, 23 4:29 5:11 6:12, Php.3:6, 2Ti.3:12;
(b) metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), of seeking eagerly after: Rom.9:30, 1Ti.6:11, 2Ti.2:22; νόμον δικαιοσύνης, Rom.9:31; τ. φιλοξενίαν, Rom.12:13; εἰρήνην, Heb.12:14, 1Pe.3:11; τὰ τῆς εἰ., Rom.14:19; τ. ἀγάπην, 1Co.14:1; τὸ ἀγαθόν, 1Th.5:15; absol., to follow on, drive, or speed on (Æsch.), Php.3:12, 14.†
(AS)
G1377.strong_def: compare the base of G1169 (δειλός) and G1249 (διάκονος)); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute
G1377.derivation: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb (to flee;

G2288.def:
θάνατος, -ου, ὁ (θνήσκω),
[in LXX chiefly for מָוֶת ,מוּת, sometimes דֶּבֶר ;]
death;
1. of the death of the body, whether natural or violent: Jhn.11:13, Php.2:27, Heb.7:23, al; opposite to ζωή, Rom.8:38, Php.1:20; of the death of Christ, Rom.5:10, Php.3:10, Heb.2:9; ῥυέσθαι (σώζειν) ἐκ θ., 2Co.1:10, Heb.5:7; περίλυπος ἕως θανάτου, Mat.26:38, Mrk.14:34; μέχρι (ἄχρι), Php.2:8, Rev.2:10; πληγὴ θανάτου, a deadly wound. Rev.13:3; ἰδεῖν θάνατον, Luk.2:26, Heb.11:5; γεύεσθαι θανάτου, Mrk.9:1; ἔνοχος θανάτου, Mrk.14:64; θανάτῳ τελευτᾶν ( Exo.21:17, מוּת יוּמָת), Mrk.7:10; death personified, Rom.6:9, 1Co.15:26, Rev.21:4; pl., of deadly perils, 2Co.11:23.
2. Of spiritual death: Jhn.5:24 8:51, Rom.7:10, Jas.1:15, 5:20, 1Jn.3:14 5:16, al.; of eternal death, Rom.1:32 7:5, al.; ὁ θ. ὁ δεύτερος, Rev.2:11 21:8 (cf. Cremer, 283ff.; DB, iii, 114ff.; DCG, i, 791f.).
(AS)
G2288.strong_def: (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively)

G5590.gloss: heart (+ -ily), life, mind, soul, + us, + you
G5590.strong_def: breath, i.e. (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from G4151 (πνεῦμα), which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from G2222 (ζωή), which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the Hebrew H05315, H07307 and H02416)

G2343.def:
θησαυρίζω
[in LXX for צָפַן, etc. ;]
to lay up, store up: of riches, Jas.5:3; id. with dative of person(s), Luk.12:21, 2Co.12:14; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.16:2; θησαυροὺς ἑαυτῷ, Mat.6:19-20; pass., 2Pe.3:7; metaphorically, ὀργὴν ἑαντῷ, Rom.2:5 (cf. Pro.1:18, Pss. Pss.Sol 9:9).†
(AS)
G2343.strong_def: to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively)

G3144.strong_def: a witness (literally (judicially) or figuratively (genitive case)); by analogy, a "martyr"

G5157.derivation: from an apparently primary to turn;

G3624.strong_def: a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively)

G4622.strong_def: Sion (i.e. Tsijon), a hill of Jerusalem; figuratively, the Church (militant or triumphant)

G0174.def:
ἀκάνθινος, -ον
(ἄκανθα), [in LXX: Isa.34:13 (סיר) * ;]
1. of thorns: Mrk.15:17, Jhn.19:5.
2. of acantha-wood (Hdt.; π. ap. MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)

G3315.strong_def: to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify (as surety)

G4266.strong_def: to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired

G2765.def:
κεράμιον, -ου, τό
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Jer.35:5 (גְּבִיעַ), etc. ;]
an earthen vessel, a jar or jug: ὕδατος, Mrk.14:13, Luk.22:10.†
(AS)
G2765.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2766 (κέραμος);

G5384.strong_def: actively, fond, i.e. friendly (still as a noun, an associate, neighbor, etc.)

G4032.strong_def: to conceal all around, i.e. entirely

G2641.def:
κατα-λείπω
[in LXX chiefly far שָׁאַר, ni., hi., also for עָזַב, יָתַר, etc. ;]
1 1, to leave behind, leave: with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), Mat.4:13, Mrk.12:19, 21, Luk.20:31, Act.24:27 25:14, Heb.11:27; of sailing by a place, Act.21:3; ptcp., καταλιπών, redundant (Dalman, Words, 21 f.), Mat.16:4 21:17; pass., Jhn.8:9, 1Th.3:1; metaphorically, εὐθεῖαν ὁδόν, 2Pe.2:15.
2. to forsake, abandon: Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:7" (LXX) Mrk.14:52, Luk.5:28 15:4, Act.6:2, Eph.5:31" (LXX) .
3. to leave remaining, reserve: with accusative and inf., Luk.10:40; ἐμαυτῷ, Rom.11:4 (LXX); pass., Heb.4:1 (cf. ἐν-κατα-λείπω).†
(AS)
G2641.strong_def: to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining

G1848.def:
ἐξ-ουθενέω, -ῶ
(οὐθείς, which see), [in LXX (see: ἐξουθενέω): 1Ki.2:30, al., and as seel. for -δενέω, -όω, -θενόω* ;]
to set at nought, despise utterly, treat with contempt: with accusative of person(s), Luk.18:9 23:11, Rom.14:3, 10, 1Co.16:11; with accusative of thing(s), Gal.4:14, 1Th.5:20; pass., of persons: Mrk.9:12 (T, -όω), 1Co.6:4; of things λίθος, Act.4:11 (LXX ἀπεδοκίμασαν); λόγος, 2Co.10:10; τὰ ἐξουθενημένα, 1Co.1:28.†
SYN.: ἀθετέω, καταφρονέω (see DCG, i, 453b) (AS)
G1848.derivation: a variation of G1847 (ἐξουδενόω) and meaning the same

G5406.strong_def: a murderer (always of criminal (or at least intentional) homicide; which G443 (ἀνθρωποκτόνος) does not necessarily imply; while G4607 (σικάριος) is a special term for a public bandit)

G4879.strong_def: to take off together, i.e. transport with (seduce, passively, yield)

G4534.derivation: perhaps of similar origin to G4529 (Σαλαμίς);

G0462.def:
ἀν-όσιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὅσιος), [in LXX: Eze.22:9 (זִמָּה, Wis.12:4, 2Ma.7:34 2Mac 8:32, 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 5:7, 4Ma.12:11 * ;]
unholy, profane (Cremer, 464): 1Ti.1:9, 2Ti.3:2 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0462.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3741 (ὅσιος);

G4168.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4167 (ποίμνη);

G4968.derivation: neuter of a derivative of G4967 (σφαγή);

G5364.derivation: adverb from a compound of G5384 (φίλος) and G444 (ἄνθρωπος);

G1039.def:
βύσσινος, -η, -ον
(βύσσος), [in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ, etc. ;]
made of βύσσος, fine linen: Rev.18:12, 16 19:8, 14.†
(AS)
G1039.strong_def: made of linen (neuter a linen cloth)

G4823.strong_def: to give (or take) advice jointly, i.e. recommend, deliberate or determine

G5209.strong_def: you (as the objective of a verb or preposition)

G4150.derivation: a prolonged form of an obsolete (to "flow");

G4042.strong_def: a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed)

G4776.strong_def: to give (or take) a seat in company with

G5121.derivation: contraction for the neuter of G3588 (ὁ) and G1726 (ἐναντίον);

G5233.derivation: from G5228 (ὑπέρ) and the base of G939 (βάσις);

G2856.def:
κολοβόω, -ῶ
(κολοβός, docked), [in LXX: 2Ki.4:12 (קָצַץ pi.) * ;]
to cut off, amputate (LXX), hence, to curtail, shorten: Mat.24:22, Mrk.13:20.†
(AS)
G2856.derivation: from a derivative of the base of G2849 (κολάζω);

G3887.strong_def: to stay near, i.e. remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere)

G5482.strong_def: akin to G1125 (γράφω) through the idea of scratching); a stake, i.e. (by implication) a palisade or rampart (military mound for circumvallation in a siege)

G1438.strong_def: him- (her-, it-, them-, also (in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons) my-, thy-, our-, your-) self (selves), etc.
G1438.derivation: from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of G846 (αὐτός);

G1103.def:
γνήσιος, -α, -ον
(γίγνομαι), [in LXX: Sir.7:18, 3Ma.3:19 * ;]
1. prop., lawfully begotten, born in wedlock (in π., γυνὴ γ., a lawful wife; MM, see word).
2. true, genuine, sincere: Php.4:3, 1Ti.1:2, Tit.1:4; as subst., τὸ γ. = ἡ γνησιότης, sincerity, 2Co.8:8.
† (AS)

G5490.derivation: from a form of an obsolete primary (to "gape" or "yawn");

G2557.def:
κακοῦργος, -ον
(contr. from epic κακόεργος), [in LXX. Pro.21:15 (אָוֶן, פָּעַל), Est.8:13, Sir.11:33 33:26 (Sir.33:26)* ;]
a malefactor, criminal: Luk.23:32-33, 39, 2Ti.2:9.†
(AS)
G2557.derivation: from G2556 (κακός) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);

G0960.def:
Βέροια, -ας, ἡ,
Berœa, a city of Macedonia: Act.17:10, 13.†
(AS)
G0960.derivation: perhaps a provincial from a derivative of G4008 (πέραν) (Perœa, i.e. the region beyond the coast-line);

G5242.strong_def: to hold oneself above, i.e. (figuratively) to excel; participle (as adjective, or neuter as noun) superior, superiority

G0748.derivation: from G746 (ἀρχή) and a derivative of G2413 (ἱερός);

G4973.strong_def: a signet (as fencing in or protecting from misappropriation); by implication, the stamp impressed (as a mark of privacy, or genuineness), literally or figuratively

G2514.def:
καθαρότης, -ητος, ἡ
(καθαρός), [in LXX: Exo.24:10 (טֹהַר), Wis.7:24 * ;]
purity, cleanness: with genitive, Heb.9:13.†
(AS)

G0202.def:
ἀκροατής, οῦ, ὁ (see supr.)
[in LXX: Isa.3:3 (לַחַשׁ), Sir.3:29 ;]
a hearer: Rom.2:13, Jas.1:22, 23, 25.†
(AS)
G0202.strong_def: apparently an intensive of G191 (ἀκούω)); a hearer (merely)

G3800.strong_def: rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay
G3800.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as G3795 (ὀψάριον);

G2411.def:
ἱερός, -ά, όν
[in LXX: Eze.28:18 (מִקְדָּשׁ); τό ἱ, 1Ch.29:4 (בַּיִת), Eze.45:19 (עֲזָרָה); very frequently in I Est.1:1-58 -4 Mac ;]
1. in Hom., marvellous, mighty, divine.
2. (Also in Hom, and later cl.) consecrated to the deity, sacred: pl., ἱ. γράμματα, 2Ti.3:15.
3. As subst.,
(a) (so in Hom.), τὰ ἱ., sacrifices, sacred rites, sacred things: 1Co.9:13;
(b) later, τὸ ἱ.,., a consecrated or sacred place, a temple: τ. Ἀρτέμιδος, Act.19:27; of the temple at Jerusalem, i.e. the entire precincts or some part thereof (as distinct from ὁ ναός, which see, the Sanctuary proper): 1Co.9:13, and frequently in Gosp. and esp. in Ac, Mat.12:6, Mrk.13:3, Act.4:1, al. (on the use of ἱ. in Imperial Iuser., see Deiss., LAE, 380 f.)
(AS)
G2411.strong_def: a sacred place, i.e. the entire precincts (whereas G3485 (ναός) denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem or elsewhere)

G0005.def:
Ἀββά (T, -ᾶ), indecl. (Aram, אַבָּא, emphatic form of אַב = Heb. אָב, father),
used in the phrase Ἀ. ὁ παήρ, Abba, Father (see Swete on Mk, I.with): Mrk.14:36, Rom.8:15, Gal.4:6.†
(AS)

G4051.gloss: abundance, that was left, over and above

G1835.def:
ἑξήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
sixty: Mat.13:8, 23, Mrk.4:8, 20, Luk.24:13, 1Ti.5:9, Rev.11:3 Rev.12:6 Rev.13:18.†
(AS)

G2399.def:
ἰδιώτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἴδιος), [in LXX: Pro.6:8 (no Heb.)* ;]
1. a pri­vate person, as opposite to the State or an official (βασιλεῖς κ. ἰδιῶται, Pr, l.with; and cf. MM, Exp., xv).
2. one without professional knowledge, unskilled, uneducated, unlearned: 1Co.14:16 14:23-24 (R, mg., without gifts); ἀγράμματοι κ. ἰ., Act.4:13; with dative (= cl. with genitive of thing(s)), λόγῳ, 2Co.11:6.†
(AS)
G2399.strong_def: a private person, i.e. (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot")

G0775.def:
Ἀσιάρχης, -ου, ὁ
an Asiarch, one of ten officers elected by the various cities in the province of Asia whose duty it was to celebrate at their own charges the public games and festivals: Act.19:31 (Strab., Inscr.; DB, see word).†
(AS)
G0775.strong_def: an Asiarch or president of the public festivities in a city of Asia Minor

G5085.strong_def: Tiberias, the name of a town and a lake in Palestine

G0614.def:
ἀπόκρυφος, -ον
(ἀποκρύπτω), [in LXX Chiefly for סֵתֶר ;]
hidden: Mrk.4:22, Luk.8:17, Col.2:3 (see Lft., in l; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G2566.def:
καλλίων, -ον
compar. of καλός, see: καλῶς
καλῶς
adv. (καλός), [in LXX for parts and derivatives of יָטַב ;]
finely, rightly, well: Luk.6:48, 1Co.14:17, Gal.4:17 5:7, Jas.2:3; λέγειν, λαλεῖν, etc., Mat.15:7, Mrk.7:6 12:28, Luk.6:26 20:39, Jhn.4:17 8:48 13:13 18:23, Act.28:25; as exclamation of approval, Mrk.12:32, Rom.11:20; κ. ποιεῖν, Mat.12:12, 1Co.7:37-38 Jas.2:8, 19; with dative of person(s) (cl. accusative; WM, § 32, 1 β), Luk.6:27; with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.7:37; with ptcp., Act.10:33 (M, Pr., 131), Php.4:14, 2Pe.1:19, 3Jn.6; προϊστάναι (-ασθαι), 1Ti.3:4 3:12 5:17; διακονεῖν, 1Ti.3:13; ἀνατρέφεσθαι, Heb.13:18; ironically, Mrk.7:9, 2Co.11:4 (but see CGT, in l); κ. ἔχειν, to be well: Mrk.16:18. Compar., κάλλιον (for superl., B1., § 44, 3), very well: Act.25:10.†
(AS)
G2566.derivation: neuter of the (irregular) comparative of G2570 (καλός);

G5286.strong_def: something under the feet, i.e. a foot-rest (figuratively)
G5286.derivation: neuter of a compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and G4228 (πούς);

G3510.strong_def: a kidney (plural), i.e. (figuratively) the inmost mind

G2043.def:
ἐρείδω
(chiefly in poets and late prose for ἐρυγγάνω), [in LXX for תָּמַךְ (Pro.4:4 5:5 11:16, al.), etc. ;]
to prop, fix firmly: act., as mid., ἐρείσασα, of a ship driving ashore (RV, struck), Act.27:41.†
(AS)

G0548.def:
ἄπ-ειμι
(εἰμί, sum) [in LXX for כָּחַד ni., נָדַח ni. ;]
to be absent: 1Co.5:3, 2Co.10:1 10:11 13:2 13:10 Php.1:27, Col.2:5.†
(AS)

G1233.def:
διά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(διαγιγνώσκω), [in LXX: Wis.3:18 * ;]
1. a distinguishing, also as medical term.
2. As law-term (Lat. cognitio), determination, decision: Act.25:21 (Cremer, 674).†
(AS)

G2669.def:
κατα-πονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:2 (A), 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 2:13 * ;]
to wear down, oppress, treat hardly: pass., Act.7:24, 2Pe.2:7.†
(AS)
G2669.strong_def: to labor down, i.e. wear with toil (figuratively, harass)
G2669.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G4192 (πόνος);

G1238.def:
διάδημα, -τος, τό
(διαδέω, to bind round), [in LXX for כֶּתֶר (as Est.1:11), etc. ;]
the band round the τιάρα of a Persian king; a diadem, the badge of royalty: Rev.12:3 13:1 19:12.†
SYN.: στέφανος, the badge of "victory, of valour, of nuptial joy, of festal gladness " (but see M, Th., i, 219; cf. DB, i, 530, 604). (AS)
G1238.derivation: from a compound of G1223 (διά) and G1210 (δέω);

G4256.strong_def: to accuse already, i.e. previously charge
G4256.derivation: from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G156 (αἰτία);

G1696.def:
ἐμμένω
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1. to abide in: Act.28:30.
2. to abide by, be true to: before ἐν; τ. πίστει, Act.14:22; τ. διαθήκῃ, Heb.8:9 (LXX); with dative, τ. γεγραμμένοις (dative ptcp. as in legal formula; cf. Deiss., BS, 248; MM, Exp., xii): Gal.3:10 (LXX).†
(AS)
G1696.strong_def: to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively) persevere

G2881.def:
κορίνθιος, -α, -ον
Corinthian; as subst., ὁ Κ., a Corinthian: Act.18:8 27:1-44 (WH, txt., R, omit), 2Co.6:11; 1Co, 2Co, tit.†
(AS)
G2881.strong_def: a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth

G1144.def:
δάκρυον (poët. form δάκρυ), -ου, τό,
[in LXX for דִּמְעָה ;]
a tear: Mrk.9:24 (WH, txt., R, txt. omit), Act.20:19, 31, 2Co.2:4, 2Ti.1:4, Heb.5:7 12:17, Rev.7:17 21:4; metaphorically, dative pl., δάκρυσι (La 2:11, Thuc., vii, 75; Bl., § 9, 3), Luk.7:38, 44.†
(AS)

G0383.def:
ἀνα-σείω
[in Aq.: 1Ki.26:19, Job.2:3; Aq., Sm.: Isa.36:18 * ;]
1. to shake out, shake back, move to and fro (Thuc., a1.).
2. In late writers (Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word), to stir up; metaphorically, to excite: τ. ὄχλον, Mrk.15:11; τ. λαόν, Luk.23:5.†
(AS)

G1646.def:
ἐλάχιστος, -η, -ον
(see: ἐλάσσων),
smallest, least: as proper superlat., 1Co.15:9; elsewhere, as usually in late Gk., intensive (B1., § 11, 3); Mat.2:6 (LXX) Mat.25:40, 45 Luk.12:26 16:10 19:17, 1Co.4:3 6:2, Jas.3:4; ἐ. ἐν τ. βασιλείᾳ τ. οὐρανῶν, Mat.5:19 (see Dalman, Words, 113). Compar., ἐλαχιστότερος (for corresp. superl., see LS; see also Bl., § 44, 3); less than the least: Eph.3:8.†
(AS)
G1646.strong_def: used as equivalent to G3398 (μικρός); least (in size, amount, dignity, etc.)

G2635.def:
κατα-λαλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָבַר ni., pi. ;]
to speak evil of, rail at: in cl., with accusative; in LXX,
(a) with genitive,
(b) before κατά, with genitive; in NT, with genitive (M, Pr., 65): Jas.4:11, 1Pe.2:12; pass., 1Pe.3:16,†
(AS)
G2635.strong_def: to be a traducer, i.e. to slander

G3318.strong_def: Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare 0763), a region of Asia

G1799.def:
ἐνώπιος, -ον
(ὤψ), [in LXX for פָּנִים, etc. ;]
face to face, in sight (Theocr.; ἄρτοι ἐ., Exo.25:29): neut., ἐνώπιον, in vernacular, with force of prep. with genitive [in LXX for פָּנִים, עַיִן, etc., cf. G2229.def:
ἦ (μήν), see: εἰ, iii, 7.
εἰ,
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
I. Conditional, if;
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20;
(b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20;
(with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.;
(d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al.
2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, if, whether.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12.
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luk.11:18; but even if, 1Co.4:7, 2Co.4:3 11:16.
3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Mrk.2:21, 22 Jhn.14:2, Rev.2:5, al.
4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Mrk.14:29, Luk.11:8, 1Co.7:21, 2Co.4:16, Php.2:17, al.
5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Mat.24:22, Mrk.2:26 6:5, Jhn.9:33, 1Co.7:17 (only), Gal.1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1Co.14:5 15:2, 1Ti.5:19.
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Heb.6:14.
8. εἴ πως, if haply: Act.27:12, Rom.1:10.
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Rom.12:6-8, 1Co.3:22 13:8, al.
(AS)
G2229.derivation: an adverb of confirmation; perhaps intensive of G2228 (ἤ); used only (in the New Testament) before G3303 (μέν);

βάρβαρος, -ον (prob. onomatop., descriptive of unintelligible sounds),
[in LXX: Ps 113 (114):1 (לעז), Eze.21:31 (36) (בּער), 2Ma.2:21 4:25 10:4, 3Ma.3:24 * ;]
barbarous, barbarian, strange to Greek language and culture (and also, after the Persian war, with the added sense of brutal, rude): Act.28:2, 4 Rom.1:14, 1Co.14:11, Col.3:11 (see Lft., in l., and Notes, 249).†
(AS)

G0591.def:
ἀπο-δίδωμι
[in LXX for מָכַר, שׁוּב hi., נָתַן, שָׁלֵם pi., etc. ;]
to give up or back, restore, return: Mat.27:58, Luk.4:20 9:42 19:8; esp. of wages, debts, oaths, etc. (MM, see word), to render what is due, to pay (Deiss., LAE, 334 f.): absol., Mat.18:25, 28, Luk.7:42. with accusative, Mat.5:26 18:29-30, 34 20:8 21:41 22:21, Mrk.12:17, Luk.10:35 12:59 20:25, Rom.13:7, Heb.12:11, Rev.22:2; ὅρκους, Mat.5:33 (cf. Num.30:3, Deu.23:21 al.); of conjugal duty, τ. ὀφειλήν, 1Co.7:3; ἀμοιβάς, 1Ti.5:4; μαρτύριον, to give (as in duty bound) testimony, Act.4:33; λόγον, to render account, Mat.12:36, Luk.16:2, Act.19:40, Heb.13:17, 1Pe.4:5; hence of requital, recompense, both in good and bad sense, Mat.6:4, 6 6:18 16:27, Rom.2:6, 2Ti.4:8 4:14 Rev.18:6 22:12; κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ, Rom.12:17, 1Th.5:15, 1Pe.3:9. Mid., to give up of one's own, hence to sell (fr. Hdt. on): with accusative of thing(s), Act.5:8, Heb.12:16; with accusative of person(s), Act.7:9 (cf. ἀνταποδίδωμι) .†
(AS)
G0591.strong_def: to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications)

G3783.strong_def: something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault

G2761.def:
κενῶς
adv., [in LXX: Isa.49:4 (רִיק)* ;]
in vain, to no purpose: Jas.4:5.†
(AS)

G1246.derivation: middle voice from G1223 (διά) and a compound of G2596 (κατά) and G1651 (ἐλέγχω);

G1741.def:
ἔνδοξος, -ον
(δόξα [in LXX for כָּבַד, etc. ;]
1. held in honour, of high repute: 1Co.4:10.
2. glorious, splendid: of deeds, τά ἔ., Luk.13:17; of clothing, Luk.7:25. Metaphorical, ἐκκλησία, Eph.5:27 (cf. παράδοξος).†
(AS)

G1724.def:
ἐν-άλιος, -ον
(also -α, -ον; ἅλς, the sea),
of the sea: τὰ ἐ., marine creatures, Jas.3:7.†
(AS)

G1519.strong_def: to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases

G4972.gloss: (set a, set to) seal up, stop
G4972.strong_def: to stamp (with a signet or private mark) for security or preservation (literally or figuratively); by implication, to keep secret, to attest

G3404.strong_def: to detest (especially to persecute); by extension, to love less

G3468.strong_def: probably akin to the base of G3433 (μόλις)) and probably (the face; from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark

G0881.def:
Ἄχαζ (WH, Ἄχας), ὁ (Heb. אָחָז),
Ahaz: Mat.1:9.†
(AS)

G1790.def:
ἔν-τρομος, -ον
[in LXX: Da TH Dan.10:11 (רָעַד hi.); ἔ. γίγνεσθαι, Psa.18:7 77:18 (רַעַשׁ), Wis.17:10, 1Ma.13:2 * ;]
trembling with fear (Pint.): Act.7:32 16:29, Heb.12:21 (ἔκτρ-, WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G4901.strong_def: to testify further jointly, i.e. unite in adding evidence

G2206.def:
ζηλόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָנָא pi. ;]
1. to burn with envy or jealousy, to be jealousy: absol., Act.7:9 17:5, 1Co.13:4, Jas.4:2 (R, mg., cf. Mayor, in l).
2. to seek or desire eagerly: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.12:31 14:1 14:39 (cf. Sir.50:18, Wis.1:12); with accusative of person(s), 2Co.11:2, Gal.4:17; pass., Gal.4:18.†
(AS)
G2206.strong_def: to have warmth of feeling for or against

G0714.def:
ἀρκέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for הוֹן, etc. ;]
1. to keep off; with dative, to assist.
2. to suffice: with dative of person(s), Jo 67, 2Co.12:9; impers., Mat.25:9, Jhn.14:8 (MM, see word). Pass., to be satisfied: with dative of thing(s), Luk.3:14, 1Ti.6:8, Heb.13:5; before ἐπί, III Jn 10.†
(AS)
G0714.strong_def: properly, to ward off, i.e. (by implication) to avail (figuratively, be satisfactory)
G0714.derivation: apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to G142 (αἴρω) through the idea of raising a barrier);

G2415.def:
Ἱεροσολυμεῖτης (WH, Ἰερ-; Rec. -μίτης), -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: Sir.50:27 (28) 2Ma.4:22 2Mac 4:39 (V* -μήτης) 2Ma 18:5* ;]
an inhabitant of Jerusalem: Mrk.1:5, Jhn.7:25.†
(AS)
G2415.strong_def: a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma

G2069.def:
Ἐσλεί (Rec. 'Ἐσλί, see WH, Notes, 155), ὁ,
Esli, an ancestor of Jesus: Luk.3:25.†
(AS)

G0434.def:
ἀν-ήμερος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἥμερο ),
not tame, savage (MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.3:3.†
(AS)
G0434.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and (lame);

G0090.derivation: from a derivative of a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1311 (διαφθείρω);

G4854.strong_def: grown along with (connate), i.e. (figuratively) closely united to
G4854.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G5453 (φύω);

G1715.strong_def: in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time)

G1066.def:
Γεδεών, ὁ, indecl. in LXX and NT, in FlJ, Ant., see 6, 3 and 4 -ῶνος (Heb. גִּדְעוֹן),
Gideon (Jdg.6-8): Heb.11:32.†
(AS)

G1270.def:
δια-νόημα, -τος, τό
(διανοέομαι, to think), [in LXX for מַחֲשָׁבָה, etc., Isa.55:9, al., frequently in Sir ;]
a thought: Luk.11:17.†
(AS)
G1270.strong_def: something thought through, i.e. a sentiment
G1270.derivation: from a compound of G1223 (διά) and G3539 (νοιέω);

G3578.strong_def: hospitality, i.e. (by implication) a place of entertainment

G0799.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4793 (συγκρίνω);

G5531.derivation: probably the same as the base of G5530 (χράομαι);

G1185.def:
δελεάζω
(δέλεαρ, a bait),
to allure by a bait: metaphorically, to allure, entice: with accusative, 2Pe.2:14, 18; pass., Jas.1:14.†
(AS)

G5148.derivation: from a compound of G5140 (τρεῖς) and G2094 (ἔτος);

G4824.strong_def: advisement; specially, a deliberative body, i.e. the provincial assessors or lay-court
G4824.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4825 (σύμβουλος);

G1999.def:
ἐπι-σύστασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπισυνίστημι) [in LXX: Num.16:40 (עֵדָה) Num.26:9 (נָצָה hi.), I Est.5:73 A* ;]
a gathering, a riotous throng: Rec. (for ἐπίστασις, which see), Act.24:12, 2Co.11:28.†
(AS)
G1999.strong_def: a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly)
G1999.derivation: from the middle voice of a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G4921 (συνιστάω);

G0963.def:
Βηθανία, -ας (also -ιά, indecl., Luk.19:29 and in B*, Mrk.11:1), ἡ, (Heb. בֵּית עֲנִיָּה, house of affliction, accusative to Jerome, or perh., house of dates, cf. Bethphage),
Bethany;
1. a village fifteen furlongs from Jerusalem, the modern El Azerîyeh: Mat.21:17 26:6, Mrk.8:22 (WH, mg.) 11:1, 11, 12 14:3 Luk.19:29 24:50, Jhn.11:1, 18 12:1.
2. A place on E. bank of Jordan: Jhn.1:28 (R, mg., Βηθαβαρά, which see).
† (AS)
G0963.strong_def: date-house; Beth-any, a place in Palestine

G1932.def:
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2:19 12:18 Bar.2:27, from LXX Bar.4:24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2:22 2Mac 10:4, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 7:6 * ;]
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): Act.24:4; with πραΰτης, 2Co.10:1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii) (AS)

G2239.def:
ἦθος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX: Sir.20:26, 4Ma.1:29 4Mac 2:7 4Mac 2:21 4Mac 5:24 4Mac 13:27 * ;]
1 1, a haunt, abode.
2. = ἔθος, custom, manner: pl., 1Co.15:33.†
(AS)

G4083.strong_def: the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit

G0419.def:
ἀνεξεραύνητος
(Rec. -εύνητος, as in Attic; M, Pr., 46), -ον (ερευνάω), [in Sm. (-ευ-): Pr., 25:3 * ;]
unsearchable: Rom.11:33.†
(AS)
G0419.strong_def: not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable
G0419.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1830 (ἐξερευνάω);

G1794.def:
ἐν-τυλίσσω
to wrap up (LS), roll or coil about (DCG, ii, 227, 507a): with accusative and dative, Mat.27:59 (iv, Tr. [WH], cf. similar sentence in π.; MM, Exp., xiii), Luk.23:53; pass., Jhn.20:7.†
(AS)
G1794.strong_def: probably akin to G1507 (εἱλίσσω)); to entwine, i.e. wind up in

G0119.def:
ἄθλησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀθλέω),
a contest, combat, esp. of athletes; figuratively, a struggle: Heb.10:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4215.strong_def: a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water
G4215.derivation: probably from a derivative of the alternate of G4095 (πίνω) (compare G4224 (πότος));

G3064.derivation: genitive case singular of the same as G3062 (λοιποί);

G0722.def:
ἀροτριάω, -ῶ
(ἄροτρον), [in LXX: Deu.22:10, al. (חָרַשׁ), Isa.7:25 (עֲדַר) ;]
later form of ἀρόω, to plough (MM, see word): Luk.17:7, 1Co.9:10.†
(AS)

G1691.def:
ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς,
of person(s) pron.
I.
(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in Mat.3:11, Mrk.1:8, Luk.3:16, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as Mat.10:16, Jhn.10:17; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. 1Ki.3:8), Act.9:10; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, Jhn.1:23 (LXX), Act.7:32 (LXX).
(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, Jhn.14:20; μου τ. λόγους, Mat.7:24; ὀπίσω μου, Mat.3:11; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, Rev.5:5; also with the prep. πρός, as Mrk.9:19, al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as Luk.10:16, Jhn.7:23, Mrk.14:7, al.
(with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, Mat.2:6; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, Mrk.9:24.
(d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, Jdg.11:12, al.), i.e. what have we in common: Mat.8:29, Mrk.1:24, 5:7, Luk.8:28, Jhn.2:4; τί γάρ μοι, 1Co.5:2.
(e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).
(f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: Mat.2:8, Luk.2:48, Jhn.6:56, Rom.3:7, 1Co.7:40, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, Jhn.7:28.
(AS)

G1534.def:
εἶτα
adv.,
denoting sequence;
1. of time; then, next: Mrk.8:25, Luk.8:12, Jhn.13:5 19:27 20:27, 1Ti.3:10, Jas.1:15; before genitive abs., Mrk.4:17; in enumerations, 1Co.15:5 15:7 15:24, 1Ti.2:13.
2. In argument;
(a) therefore, then,
(b) furthermore: Heb.12:9 (cf. εἶτεν).†
(AS)
G1534.strong_def: a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover

G2630.def:
κατα-κρημνίζω
(κρημνός), [in LXX: 2Ch.25:12 (שָׁלַךְ hi.), 2Ma.12:15 2Mac 14:43, 4Ma.4:25*.]
to throw over a precipice, cast down head­long: Luk.4:29.†
(AS)
G2630.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G2911 (κρημνός);

G5076.strong_def: the ruler of a fourth part of a country ("tetrarch")

G3195.gloss: about, after that, be (almost), (that which is, things, + which was for) to come, intend, was to (be), mean, mind, be at the point, (be) ready, + return, shall (begin), (which, that) should (after, afterwards, hereafter) tarry, which was for, will, would, be yet
G3195.strong_def: to intend, i.e. be about to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or things, especially events; in the sense of purpose, duty, necessity, probability, possibility, or hesitation)
G3195.derivation: a strengthened form of G3199 (μέλω) (through the idea of expectation);

G1128.def:
γυμνάζω
(γυμνός), [in LXX: 2Ma.10:15 * ;]
1. properly, to exercise naked.
2. Generally, to exercise, train the body or mind: 1Ti.4:7, Heb.5:14 12:11, 2Pe.2:14.
† (AS)
G1128.strong_def: to practise naked (in the games), i.e. train (figuratively)

G1167.def:
δειλία, -ας, ἡ
(δειλός), [in LXX for אֵימָה, מְחִתָּה, etc. ;]
cowardice, timidity (never in good sense): 2Ti.1:7.†
SYN.: φόβος, fear, in general, good or bad; εὐλάβεια (which see), apprehension generally, but chiefly pious fear, "that careful and watchful reverence which pays regard to every circumstance in that with which it has to deal" (cf. Tr., Syn., § x).† (AS)

G2437.def:
Ἰλλυρικόν, -οῦ, τό
Illyricum, a region bordering on the Adriatic Sea: Rom.15:19.†
(AS)
G2437.strong_def: (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe
G2437.derivation: neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation;

G5142.strong_def: but perhaps strengthened from the base of G5157 (τροπή) through the idea of convolution); properly, to stiffen, i.e. fatten (by implication, to cherish (with food, etc.), pamper, rear)

G2930.def:
κρύσταλλος, -ου, ὁ
(κρύος, frost), [in LXX: Job.38:29, Psa.147:17, Eze.1:22 (קֶרַח), etc. ;]
crystal: Rev.4:6 22:1.†
(AS)

G5613.gloss: about, after (that), (according) as (it had been, it were), as soon (as), even as (like), for, how (greatly), like (as, unto), since, so (that), that, to wit, unto, when(-soever), while, X with all speed
G5613.strong_def: which how, i.e. in that manner (very variously used, as follows)
G5613.derivation: probably adverb of comparative from G3739 (ὅς);

G2671.def:
κατ-άρα, -ας, -ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for קְלָלָה ;]
a curse: Gal.3:10, 13 Heb.6:8, 2Pe.2:14; opposite to εὐλογία, Jas.3:10; concrete, of Christ, Gal.3:13 (see Lft. in l).†
(AS)

G4463.strong_def: to strike with a stick, i.e. bastinado

G5387.strong_def: fond of natural relatives, i.e. fraternal towards fellow Christian
G5387.derivation: from G5384 (φίλος) and (cherishing one's kindred, especially parents or children);

G1368.def:
δι-υλίζω
(δια, ὑλίζω, to strain) [in LXX: Amo.6:6 * ;]
1. to strain thoroughly (Archytas; Am., l.with).
2. Later, to strain out: figuratively, Mat.23:24.†
(AS)

G1010.def:
βουλευτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(βουλεύω), [in LXX: Job.3:14 12:17 (יעץ)* ;]
a councillor, a senator; of a member of the Sanhedrin: Mrk.15:34, Luk.23:50.†
(AS)
G1010.strong_def: an adviser, i.e. (specially) a councillor or member of the Jewish Sanhedrin

G1379.def:
δογματίζω
[in LXX: Est.3:9 (כָּתַב ni.), Dan LXX 2:13, 15 (דָּת), I Est.6:34, 2Ma.10:3 2Mac 15:36, 3Ma.4:11 * ;]
to decree. Mid., to subject oneself to an ordinance: Col.2:20.†
(AS)
G1379.strong_def: to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule

G1374.def:
δίψυχος, -ον
(δίς, ψυχή),
of two minds, wavering: Jas.1:8 4:8 (Cremer, 588; DB, iv, 528).†
(AS)
G1374.strong_def: two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose)

G1698.def:
ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς,
of person(s) pron.
I.
(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in Mat.3:11, Mrk.1:8, Luk.3:16, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as Mat.10:16, Jhn.10:17; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. 1Ki.3:8), Act.9:10; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, Jhn.1:23 (LXX), Act.7:32 (LXX).
(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, Jhn.14:20; μου τ. λόγους, Mat.7:24; ὀπίσω μου, Mat.3:11; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, Rev.5:5; also with the prep. πρός, as Mrk.9:19, al. (f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: Mat.2:8, Luk.2:48, Jhn.6:56, Rom.3:7, 1Co.7:40, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, Jhn.7:28.
(AS)

G0190.def:
ἀκολουθέω, -ῶ
(ἀκόλουθος, following; ἀ- cop., κέλευθος, poët., away), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;]
to accompany, follow: Mat.4:25, al. Metaphorical, of discipleship: Mat.9:9, Mrk.9:38, Jhn.12:26, al.
