(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20;
(b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20;
(with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.;
(d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al.
2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, if, whether.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12.
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luk.11:18; but even if, 1Co.4:7, 2Co.4:3 11:16.
3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Mrk.2:21, 22 Jhn.14:2, Rev.2:5, al.
4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Mrk.14:29, Luk.11:8, 1Co.7:21, 2Co.4:16, Php.2:17, al.
5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Mat.24:22, Mrk.2:26 6:5, Jhn.9:33, 1Co.7:17 (only), Gal.1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1Co.14:5 15:2, 1Ti.5:19.
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Heb.6:14.
8. εἴ πως, if haply: Act.27:12, Rom.1:10.
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Rom.12:6-8, 1Co.3:22 13:8, al.
(AS)

G0327.def:
ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Job.3:4 (דָּרַשׁ), Job.10:6 (בָּקַשׁ pi.), 2Ma.13:21 * ;]
to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, see word): Luk.2:44-45 Act.11:25.†
(AS)

G0134.def:
αἰνέω, -ῶ (αἶνος), poët., Ion. and late prose (MM, VGT, see word) for cl. ἐπαινέω,
[in LXX chiefly for הלל, ידה ;]
to praise: with accusative, τ. θεόν, Luk.2:13,20 19:37 24:53, Act.2:47 3:8,9, Rom.15:11; with dative, τ. Θεῷ (Jer.20:13, al. for הִלֵּל לְ; see Field, Notes, 245), Rev.19:5.†
SYN.: ἐξομολογέω, εὐλογέω, εὐχαριστέω, μακαρίζω (see DCG, i, 211). (AS)

G3419.strong_def: a remembrance, i.e. cenotaph (place of interment)

G5181.derivation: a provincial form of the derivative of the base of G2962 (κύριος);

G4607.strong_def: a dagger-man or assassin; a freebooter (Jewish fanatic outlawed by the Romans)

G5088.gloss: bear, be born, bring forth, be delivered, be in travail
G5088.strong_def: to produce (from seed, as a mother, a plant, the earth, etc.), literally or figuratively
G5088.derivation: a strengthened form of a primary (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses);

G0501.def:
ἀντλέω, -ῶ
(ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for שָׁאַב, etc. ;]
1. prop., to bale out.
2. Generally, to draw water: absol., Jhn.2:8 4:15; ὕδωρ, Jhn.2:9 4:7 (on its use of the water made wine, see DCG, ii, 815a; MM, VGT, see word; Field, Notes, 84 f.).†
(AS)
G0501.strong_def: to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.)

G4113.strong_def: a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square

G0571.def:
ἄ-πιστος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., πιστός) [in LXX: Pro.17:6 28:25, Isa.17:10 * ;]
(a) of things, incredible: Act.26:8;
(b) of persons, without faith or trust, unbelieving: Mat.17:17, Mrk.9:19, Luk.9:41 12:46, Jhn.20:27, Tit.1:15, Rev.21:8; specif., of unbelievers as opposite to Christians: 1Co.6:6 7:12-15 10:27 14:22-24, 2Co.4:4 6:14-15, 1Ti.5:8 (cf. Lft., Notes, 265; Cremer, 491).†
(AS)
G0571.strong_def: (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing)
G0571.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G4103 (πιστός);

G2165.def:
εὐφραίνω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂמַח, qal, pi. ;]
to cheer, gladden: with accusative of person(s), opposite to λυπεῖν, 2Co.2:2. Pass., to be happy, rejoice, make merry: Luk.15:32, Act.2:26" (LXX) Rom.15:10 (LXX), Gal.4:27 (LXX), Rev.11:10 12:12; before ἐν, Act.7:41; ἐπί with dative, Rev.18:20; of merry-making at a feast (3Ki.4:20; of. Kennedy, Sources, 155; Field, Notes, 69 f.), Luk.12:19 15:23-24, 29" (LXX) (λαμπρῶς) Luk.16:19.†
(AS)
G2165.strong_def: to put (middle voice or passively, be) in a good frame of mind, i.e. rejoice

G1165.def:
δειγματίζω
(δεῖγμα),
a rare word (ICC, ll. with), to make a show of, to expose: Mat.1:19 (Rec. παραδ-, which see), Col.2:15.†
(AS)

G1056.def:
Γαλιλαία, -ας, ἡ (Heb. הַגָּלִיל, the circle, district),
Galilee, the name of the northern region of Palestine in NT times: Γ. τῶν ἐθνῶν, Mat.4:15 (LXX); θάλασσα τῆς Γ., Mat.15:29 (cf. Jhn.6:1).
(AS)
G1056.strong_def: Galilæa (i.e. the heathen circle), a region of Palestine

G3458.derivation: probably ultimately from the base of G3433 (μόλις) (through the idea of hardship);

G2100.def:
εὐαρεστέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ hith., Gen.5:22, 24, Psa.26:2 56:13, al., Sir.44:16 ;]
to be well pleasing: τ. θεῷ (LXX, ll. with), Heb.11:5-6. Pass., to be well pleased: with dative, Heb.13:16.†
(AS)

G1268.def:
δια-νέμω
[in LXX for חלק, Deu.29:25 * ;]
to distribute, divide: pass., to be spread about, Act.4:17.†
(AS)
G1268.strong_def: to distribute, i.e. (of information) to disseminate
G1268.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the base of G3551 (νόμος);

G4931.strong_def: to complete entirely; generally, to execute (literally or figuratively)

G1190.strong_def: a Derbæan or inhabitant of Derbe

G1891.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) (in the sense of devoted to) and (Venus);

G5273.strong_def: an actor under an assumed character (stage-player), i.e. (figuratively) a dissembler ("hypocrite"

G0683.def:
ἀπ-ωθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for זָנַח, מָאַס, etc. ;]
to thrust away. Mid., to thrust away from oneself, refuse, reject: with accusative of person(s) (MM, see word), Act.7:27, 39 13:46, Rom.11:1-2, 1Ti.1:19.†
(AS)
G0683.strong_def: to push off, figuratively, to reject
G0683.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the middle voice of or (to shove);

G5276.strong_def: vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e. lower wine-vat
G5276.derivation: neuter of a presumed compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and G3025 (ληνός);

G1170.def:
δεῖνα, ὁ, ἡ, τό (genitive -νος, dative -νι, accusative -να),
[in Aq.: Rut.4:1, 1Ki.21:2 (3) (Sm. also), 4Ki.6:8 * ;]
such an one, a certain one, whom one cannot or will not name: Mat.26:18.†
(AS)
G1170.strong_def: so and so (when the person is not specified)
G1170.derivation: probably from the same as G1171 (δεινῶς) (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful, i.e. strange);

G5203.derivation: from a compound of G5204 (ὕδωρ) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (as if looking watery);

G4395.strong_def: to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office

G0769.def:
ἀσθένεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσθενής), [in LXX for כָּשַׁל, etc. ;]
weakness, frailty, sickness: Luk.13:11-12, Jhn.11:4, Act.28:9, Rom.6:19 8:26, 2Co.11:30 13:4, Gal.4:13 (MM, see word), Heb.5:2 7:28 11:34; ἐν ἀ., Jhn.5:5, 1Co.2:3 15:43, 2Co.12:9; pl., Mat.8:17, Luk.5:15 8:2, 2Co.12:5 12:9-10, 1Ti.5:23, Heb.4:15.†
SYN.: μαλακία, νόσος (see DB, iii, 323a) (AS)
G0769.strong_def: feebleness (of mind or body); by implication, malady; morally, frailty

G0378.def:
ἀνα-πληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, Lev.12:6, al.; also שָׁלַם (Gen.15:16, 3Ki.7:51, Isa.60:20), etc. ;]
1. to fill up, make full (in π. of com­pleting contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, VGT, see word): τόπον, take one's place (cf. Heb. מָקוֹם שָׁלַם), 1Co.14:16; άμαρτίας, complete the number, 1Th.2:16; τ. νόμον, observe perfectly, Gal.6:2; pass., προφητεία, fulfilled, Mat.13:14.
2. to supply: τό ὑστέρημα, 1Co.16:17, Php.2:30 (Cremer, 838).†
(AS)
G0378.strong_def: to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience)

G2558.def:
κακουχέω, -ῶ
(κακόν, ἔχω), [in LXX: 3Ki.2:26 11:39 (עָנָה pi., hith.)* ;]
to ill-treat, hurt, torment: pass. ptcp., Heb.11:37 13:3.†
(AS)
G2558.derivation: from a presumed compound of G2556 (κακός) and G2192 (ἔχω);

G2362.def:
θρόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כִּסֵּא, Exo.11:5, al. ;]
in Hom., a seat, chair. Later, a throne, chair of state, seat of authority; of kings: metaphorically, of God, Mat.5:34, Act.7:49" (LXX), Rev.1:4, al.; by meton., for kingly power, sovereignty, Luk.1:32, 52, Act.2:30; for an angelic hierarchy, Col.1:16; of Christ, Mat.19:28, Rev.3:21, al.; of Satan, Rev.2:13; τ. θηρίου, Rev.16:10; of the Apostles, Mat.19:28, Luk.22:30, cf. Rev.20:4; of πρεσβύτεροι, Rev.4:4 11:16 (on θ. τῆς χάριτος, Heb.4:16, see Westc., in l; Deiss., BS, 135)
(AS)
G2362.strong_def: a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate

G1358.def:
δι-ορύσσω
[in LXX: Job.24:16, Exo.12:5, 7 12:12, (חָתַר) * ;]
to dig through: with accusative, of house-breaking (as in π.; MM, Exp., xi), Mat.24:43, Luk.12:39; absol., Mat.6:19-20.†
(AS)

G1663.def:
Ἐλιέζερ(Heb. אֱלִיעֶזֶר), ὁ, indecl.,
Eliezer, an ancestor of Jesus: Luk.3:29.†
(AS)

G2898.def:
κρανίον, -ου, τό
(κάρα, the head), [in LXX: Jdg.9:53, 4Ki.9:35 (גֻּלְגֹּלֶת)* ;]
a skull: Mat.27:33, Mrk.15:22, Luk.23:33, Jhn.19:17.†
(AS)
G2898.derivation: diminutive of a derivative of the base of G2768 (κέρας);

G0659.def:
ἀπο-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ hi. ;]
to put off or aside; in NT always mid.,
(a) to put of from oneself as a garment: τ. ἱμάτια, Act.7:58; metaphorically, in ethical sense, to put of, lay aside: Rom.13:12, Eph.4:22, 25, Col.3:8, Heb.12:1, Jas.1:21, 1Pe.2:1;
(b) to stow away, put: ἐν τ. φυλακῇ (MM, see word), Mat.14:3.†
(AS)

G1333.def:
διετία, -ας, ἡ
(διετής), [in LXX (Græc. Ven.): Gen.41:1 45:5 * ;]
the space of two years: Act.24:27 28:30.†
(AS)

G0756.def:
ἄρχω
[in LXX for חָלַל, מָשַׁל, etc. ;]
1. to begin.
2. to rule (see DCG, ii, 538b.): with genitive, Mrk.10:42, Rom.15:12. Mid., to begin: before ἀπό, Mat.16:21 20:8, Luk.14:18 23:5 24:27, 47, Jhn.8:9, Act.1:22 8:35 10:37, 1Pe.4:17; with inf., an Aramaic pleonasm, Mrk.1:45 2:23 5:17, Luk.3:8, al. (see M, Pro.14:1-35 f.; Dalman, Words, 27; MM, see word)
(AS)
G0756.derivation: middle voice of G757 (ἄρχω) (through the implication, of precedence);

G0103.def:
ᾄδω (Attic form of Ion. and poët. ἀείδω),
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;]
to sing,
(a) intrans., with dative (MM, VGT, see word), of praise to God: Eph.5:19, Col.3:16 ;
(b) trans., with cogn. accusative: ᾠδὴν, Rev.5:9 14:3 15:3.
† (AS)

G5179.gloss: en-(ex-)ample, fashion, figure, form, manner, pattern, print
G5179.strong_def: a die (as struck), i.e. (by implication) a stamp or scar; by analogy, a shape, i.e. a statue, (figuratively) style or resemblance; specially, a sampler ("type"), i.e. a model (for imitation) or instance (for warning)

G2855.def:
κολλυβιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόλλυβος, a small coin, a rate of exchange),
a money-changer: Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15, Jhn.2:15 (of. κερματιοτής).†
(AS)
G2855.strong_def: probably akin to G2854 (κολλούριον)); a coin-dealer
G2855.derivation: from a presumed derivative of (a small coin;

G4078.strong_def: to fix ("peg"), i.e. (specially) to set up (a tent)
G4078.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses);

G3470.strong_def: a flaw or blot, i.e. (figuratively) disgraceful person

G0643.def:
ἀπο-σκευάζω
[in LXX: Lev.14:36 (פָּנָה pi.) * ;]
to pack and carry off; mid., to pack and remove one's goods: Act.21:15, Rec. (see ἐπισ-).†
ἐπι-σκευάζω,
[in LXX for pm pi., etc. ;]
to equip, make ready; mid., to make one's preparations: Act.21:15.†
(AS)
G0643.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and a derivative of G4632 (σκεῦος);

G0210.def:
ἀκων (Attic contr. for ἀέκων), -ουα, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἅκων, willing), [in LXX: Job.14:17, 2Ma.11:12 * ;]
unwilling: 1Co.9:17.†
(AS)
G0210.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1635 (ἑκών);

G2382.def:
θώραξ, -ακσς, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁרְיוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
a breastplate: Rev.9:9, 17; θ. τ. δικαιοσύνης, Eph.6:14 (cf. Isa.59:17, Wis.5:18-19); θ. πίστεως, 1Th.5:8.†
(AS)
G2382.strong_def: the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet

G0737.def:
ἄρτι
adv., [in LXX: Dan LXX 9:22 10:11 (עַתָּה), al. ;]
adv.,
of coincidence, denoting strictly present time, as contrasted with past or future, just, just now, this moment: Mat.3:15 9:18 26:53, Jhn.13:7, Gal.4:20, 1Th.3:6 (see Lft., Notes, 44; Milligan, in l), Rev.12:10; opposite to past time, Jhn.9:19, 25 13:33, 1Co.16:7, Gal.1:9-10; to future, Jhn.13:37 16:12, 31, 1Co.13:12, 2Th.2:7, 1Pe.1:6 1:8; ἄχρι τῆς ἅ. ὥρας, 1Co.4:11; ἕως ἄ., Mat.11:12, Jhn.2:10 5:17 16:24, 1Co.4:13 8:7 15:6, 1Jn.2:9; ἀπ᾽ ἄ., see: ἀπάρτι (see Rutherford, NPhr., 70 f; MM, see word).†
SYN.: νῦν, now, "the objective, immediate present; ἤδη, now, already, " the subjective present, with a suggested reference to some other time or to some expectation". (Thayer, 75.) (AS)
G0737.derivation: adverb from a derivative of G142 (αἴρω) (compare G740 (ἄρτος)) through the idea of suspension;

G2308.def:
θέλησις, -εως, ἡ
(θέλω) [in LXX: 2Ch.15:15, Pro.8:35 (רָצוֹן), Eze.18:23 (חֵפֶץ), LXX Dan.11:45 (צְבִי), Tob.12:18, Wis.16:25, 2Ma.12:16, 3Ma.2:26 * ;]
in colloq. and MGr. = τὸ θέλειν,
will: Heb.2:4.†
(AS)

G1207.def:
δευτερό-πρωτος, -ον
second first (in what sense, there is no satisfactory explanation. The reading is prob. not original, see ICC, in l.; DCG, i, 411; ii, 541, 724): Luk.6:1, WH, mg., R, mg.†
(AS)
G1207.strong_def: second-first, i.e. (specially) a designation of the Sabbath immediately after the Paschal week (being the second after Passover day, and the first of the seven Sabbaths intervening before Pentecost)

G1804.def:
ἐξ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to tell out, proclaim: 1Pe.2:9 [Mrk.16:1-20, "shorter conclusion"] (Cremer, 29).†
(AS)
G1804.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);

G0993.def:
Βοανηργές, indecl. (on the derivation, see Dalman, Gr., 144; Words, 42; Swete, Mk., l.with; DCG, i, 216),
Boanerges: Mrk.3:17.†
(AS)
G0993.strong_def: sons of commotion; Boanerges, an epithet of two of the apostles

G0950.def:
βεβαιόω, -ῶ
(βέβαιος), [in LXX: Ps 40 (41)12 (נצב hi.), 118 (119)28 (קוּם pi.), 3Ma.5:42 * ;]
to confirm, establish, secure, of things (cl.): λόγον, Mk 16:[20]; ἐπαγγελίας, Rom.15:8; of persons (DCG, ii, 605): 1Co.1:8, 2Co.1:21. Pass., 1Co.1:6, Col.2:7, Heb.2:3 13:9 (as an Attic legal term, to guarantee the validity of a purchase, establish or confirm a title; see next word, Cremer, 139; cf. δια-β.).†
(AS)

G2923.def:
κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַט ;]
a judge: Mat.5:25, Luk.12:14, 58 18:2; τ. ἀδικίας, Luk.18:6; with gem of thing(s) (obj.), Act.18:15, Jas.4:11; (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, Jas.2:4; of a Roman procurator, Act.24:10; of God, Heb.12:23, Jas.4:12; Christ, Act.10:42, 2Ti.4:8, Jas.5:9; of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, Mat.12:27, Luk.11:19; in the OT sense (Jdg.2:16, Rut.1:1, al), of a ruler in Israel, Act.13:20.†
SYN.: δικάστης, q.v (AS)

G0969.def:
βήρυλλος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ,
[in LXX: Tob.13:17 (-ύλλιον in Exo.28:20, שֹׁהַם * ;])
beryl, a jewel of sea-green colour: Rev.21:20.†
(AS)

G2632.def:
κατα-κρίνω
[in LXX: Est.2:1 (גָּזַר ni.), Wis.4:16, Dan LXX TH Sus 1:53, 4:34, TH Sus 1:41,48,53* ;]
to give judgment against, condemn: Rom.8:34; with accusative of person(s), Mrk.14:64, Jhn.8:10-11; disting. fr. κρίνειν, Rom.2:1, 1Co.11:32; before θανάτῳ (cl. -ου or -ον), Mat.20:18, Mrk.10:33; pass., Mat.27:3, Mrk.16:16, Rom.14:23, 1Co.11:32, 2Pe.2:6. Metaphorical, of condemning through a good example: Mat.12:41-42, Luk.11:31-32, Rom.8:3, Heb.11:7 †
(AS)

G3794.derivation: from a remote derivative of G2192 (ἔχω) (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely);

G0020.def:
ἀγαλλίασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀγαλλιάω), [in LXX (most frequently in Pss. and often coupled with εὐφροσύνη, as Ps 44(45):15) chiefly for גִּיל ;]
exultation, exuberant joy: Luk.1:44, Act.2:46, Heb.1:9, Ju 24; χαρὰ καὶ ἀ., Luk.1:14 (Cremer, 592).†
(AS)

G1120.def:
γονυπετέω, -ῶ) (γόνυ, πίπτω);
1. to fall on the knees: before ἔμπροσθεν, Mat.27:29.
2. to fall down before one: with accusative, Mat.17:14, Mrk.1:40, R, txt., 10:17.
† (AS)
G1120.derivation: from a compound of G1119 (γόνυ) and the alternate of G4098 (πίπτω);

G4040.strong_def: housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically as a noun)

G5389.strong_def: to be fond of honor, i.e. emulous (eager or earnest to do something)
G5389.derivation: middle voice from a compound of G5384 (φίλος) and G5092 (τιμή);

G2762.def:
κεραία (WH, κερέα, see App., 151), -ας, ἠ
(κέρας),
a little horn: of the point or extremity which distinguishes some Heb. letters from others (e.g. ד from ר; DCG, ii, 733), Mat.5:18, Luk.16:17.†
(AS)
G2762.strong_def: something horn-like, i.e. (specially) the apex of a Hebrew letter (figuratively, the least particle)
G2762.derivation: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of G2768 (κέρας);

G2730.def:
κατ-οικέω, -ῶ
[in LXX very frequently and nearly always for יָשַׁב ;]
1. trans., to inhabit, dwell in: with accusative, Luk.13:4, Act.1:10 2:9, 14 4:16 9:32, 35 19:10, 17. Rev.17:2; of God, Mat.23:21.
2. Intrans., to settle, dwell: Act.22:12; before ἐν (cl.), Act.1:20 (LXX) Act.2:5 7:2, 4 7:48 9:22 11:29 13:27 17:24, Heb.11:9, Rev.13:12; before εἰς (B1., § 39, 3; M, Pr., 62 f., 234 f.), Mat.2:23 4:13, Act.7:4; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς (Num.13:33, al.), Rev.3:10 6:10 8:13 11:10 13:8, 14 17:8; ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τ. γ., Act.17:26; ὅπου, Rev.2:13; ἐκεῖ (of demons), Mat.12:45, Luk.11:26. Metaphorical, of divine indwelling: ὁ Χριστός, Eph.3:17; τ. πνεῦμα, Jas.4:5 (κατῴκισεν, T, WH, R, txt.); τ. πλήωρμα (τ. θεότητος), Col.1:19 2:9; δικαιοσύνη (cf. Wis.1:4), 2Pe.3:13 (cf. ἐν-κατοικέω).†
κατοικίζω,
[in LXX for יָשַׁב hi., etc. ;]
to cause to dwell: metaphorically, with accusative, τὸ πνεῦμα, Jas.4:5 (Rec., R, mg., κατῴκησεν).†
(AS)
G2730.strong_def: to house permanently, i.e. reside (literally or figuratively)

G3661.derivation: adverb from a compound of the base of G3674 (ὁμοῦ) and G2372 (θυμός);

G0028.def:
Ἅγαρ (Rec. Ἄ-), ἡ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀγάρα, -ης, Heb. הָגָר),
Hagar (Gen.16): Gal.4:24,25.†
(AS)

G1736.def:
ἐνδημέω, -ῶ
(ἔνδημος, living in a place),
to live in a place, be at home: ἐν τ. σώματι, 2Co.5:6 5:9; πρὸς τ. Kύριον, 2Co.5:8.†
(AS)
G1736.strong_def: to be in one's own country, i.e. home (figuratively)
G1736.derivation: from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G1218 (δῆμος);

G1791.def:
ἐν-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Job.20:3, Psa.35:26 44:15 69:7, 19 71:13 109:29 (כְּלִמָּה)* ;]
1. with genitive of person(s), respect, reverence (Soph., Polyb., al.).
2. Absol., shame (Hipp.): 1Co.6:5 15:34.†
(AS)

G1426.def:
δυσφημία, -ας, ἡ
(δύσφημος, slanderous), [in LXX: 1Ma.7:38, 3Ma.2:20 * ;]
evil-speaking, defamation: opposite to εὐφημία, 2Co.6:8.†
(AS)
G1426.derivation: from a compound of G1418 (δυσ-) and G5345 (φήμη);

G0833.def:
αὐλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חָצֵר ;]
1. in Hom., an open courtyard before a house, hence, an enclosure in the open, a sheepfold: Jhn.10:1, 16
2. the court, courtyard, round which a house is built: Mat.26:3, 58 26:69, Mrk.14:54, 66 15:16 Luk.11:21 22:55, Jhn.18:15; τ. ναοῦ, Rev.11:2. a dwelling, a palace (so, accusative to Grimm-Th., see word): Mat.26:3, 58, Mrk.14:54 15:16, Luk.11:21, Jhn.18:15 (but see MM, see word; cf. also DB, ii, 25, 287).†
(AS)
G0833.strong_def: a yard (as open to the wind); by implication, a mansion

G4997.strong_def: soundness of mind, i.e. (literally) sanity or (figuratively) self-control

G0201.def:
ἀκροατήριον, -ου, τό
(ἀκροάομαι, to listen)
a place of audience: Act.25:23 (Plut.).†
(AS)

G3908.gloss: allege, commend, commit (the keeping of), put forth, set before
G3908.strong_def: to place alongside, i.e. present (food, truth); by implication, to deposit (as a trust or for protection)

G1336.def:
δι-ηνεκής, -ές
(διήνεγκα, aorist of διαφέρω) [in Sm.: Psa.48:15, 89:30 ;]
unbroken, continuous: adverbially, εἰς τὸ δ., continually (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 251), Heb.7:3 10:1, 12 10:14†
(AS)
G1336.strong_def: carried through, i.e. (adverbially with G1519 (εἰς) and G3588 (ὁ) prefixed) perpetually
G1336.derivation: neuter of a compound of G1223 (διά) and a derivative of an alternate of G5342 (φέρω);

G4436.strong_def: a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying)
G4436.derivation: from (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located);

G5565.strong_def: at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition)

G0757.def:
ἄρχω
[in LXX for חָלַל, מָשַׁל, etc. ;]
1. to begin.
2. to rule (see DCG, ii, 538b.): with genitive, Mrk.10:42, Rom.15:12. Mid., to begin: before ἀπό, Mat.16:21 20:8, Luk.14:18 23:5 24:27, 47, Jhn.8:9, Act.1:22 8:35 10:37, 1Pe.4:17; with inf., an Aramaic pleonasm, Mrk.1:45 2:23 5:17, Luk.3:8, al. (see M, Pro.14:1-35 f.; Dalman, Words, 27; MM, see word)
(AS)
G0757.strong_def: to be first (in political rank or power)

G2844.def:
κοινωνός, -ή, -όν
(κοινός), [in LXX: Pro.28:24, Isa.1:23 (חָבֵר), Mal.2:14 (חֲבֶרֶת), Est.8:13, al. ;]
1. as adj., = κοινός.
2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ κ.,
(a) a partner, associate, companion: 2Co.8:23, Phm 17; with dative of person(s), Luk.5:10; with genitive of person(s), Heb.10:33; id. before ἐν, Mat.23:30;
(b) a partaker, sharer: with genitive of thing(s), 1Co.10:18 10:20, 2Co.1:7, 1Pe.5:1, 2Pe.1:4 (see Deiss., BS, 368 n2).†
(AS)

G3816.gloss: child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man
G3816.strong_def: a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God)

G0038.def:
ἁγιασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἁγιάζω), [in LXX: Eze.45:4 (מִקְדָּשׁ), Sir.7:31, etc. ;]
as an active verbal noun in -μός, it signifies properly the process τὸ ἁγιάζειν, rather than the resultant state, ἁγιωσύνη, hence,
1. consecration;
2. sanctification: so strictly in Rom.6:19,22 (but see Meyer), 1Co.1:30, 1Th.4:3,7, 2Th.2:13, Heb.12:14, 1Pe.1:2. Elsewhere it perhaps (Ellic.; but see Milligan, Th., 48) inclines to the resultant state: 1Th.4:4, 1Ti.2:15 (Cremer, 55, 602).
† (AS)
G0038.strong_def: properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier

G2865.def:
κομίζω
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
1. to take care of.
2. to carry off safe.
3. to carry off as booty.
4. to bear or carry: Luk.7:37. Mid., to bear for oneself, hence,
(a) to receive: Heb.10:36 11:13, 39, 1Pe.1:9 5:4, 2Pe.2:13;
(b) to receive back, recover (in cl. so also act.): Mat.25:27, Heb.11:19; metaphorically, of requital, 2Co.5:10, Col.3:25; παρὰ Κυρίου, Eph.6:8 (cf. ἐκ-, συν-κομίζω).†
(AS)
G2865.strong_def: properly, to provide for, i.e. (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain)
G2865.derivation: from a primary (to tend, i.e. take care of);

G2142.def:
εὐ-πορία, -ας, ἡ
(εὔπορος), [in LXX for חַיִל, 4Ki.25:10 A (frequently in Aq.)* ;]
1. facility.
2. plenty, wealth: Act.19:25.†
(AS)

G3072.strong_def: Lycaonistically, i.e. in the language of the Lycaonians
G3072.derivation: adverb from a derivative of G3071 (Λυκαονία);

G4816.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and G3004 (λέγω) in its original sense;

G0815.def:
ἄτεκνος, -ον
(τέκνον), [in LXX: Gen.15:2, Lev.20:20-21 (עֲרִירִי), Isa.49:21, Jer.18:21 (שָׁכֹל), Sir.16:3 * ;]
childless: Luk.20:28-29.†
(AS)
G0815.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5043 (τέκνον);

G2688.def:
κατά-στημα, -τος, τό
(καθίστημι), in LXX: 3Ma.5:45 (-εμα, A) * ;]
1. condition, of health, etc.
2. demeanour: Tit.2:3 (for exx. see Field, Notes, 220).†
(AS)
G2688.strong_def: properly, a position or condition, i.e. (subjectively) demeanor

G0097.def:
ἄδολος, -ον,
1. guileless (Pind., Thuc).
2. Of liquids (Æsch., Eur., and late prose writers), genuine, pure (in π. and in MGr. of wine, also of corn: MM, VGT, see word; Milligan, NTD, 77): of milk, metaphorically, 1Pe.2:2.
† SYN.: ἀκέραιος (which see), ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς. (AS)

G1925.def:
ἐπι-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Pro.12:17 (פּוּחַ hi.), Isa.37:26 (בּוֹא hi.), Esp. Jer.59, 2Ma.15:32, al ;]
1. to show, exhibit, display: with accusative and dative, Mat.16:1 22:19 24:1, Luk.17:14. Mid., to display for oneself or as one's own (but cf. El., § 55, 1): Act.9:39.
2. to show, point out, prove: with accusative, Heb.6:17; with accusative and inf., Act.18:28 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G3584.strong_def: arid; by implication, shrunken, earth (as opposed to water)
G3584.derivation: from the base of G3582 (ξέστης) (through the idea of scorching);

G3000.strong_def: to minister (to God), i.e. render religious homage

G3129.derivation: prolongation from a primary verb, another form of which, , is used as an alternate in certain tenses;

G2791.def:
Κιλικία, -ας, ἡ
Cilicia, a province of Asia Minor: Act.6:9 15:23, 41 21:39 22:3 23:34 27:5, Gal.1:21.†
(AS)
G2791.strong_def: Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor

G3348.gloss: be partaker, pertain, take part, use
G3348.strong_def: to share or participate; by implication, belong to, eat (or drink)

G1303.def:
δια-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for כָּרַת, frequently δ. διαθήκην (כָּרַת) ;]
to place separately, arrange, dispose. Mid, only in NT;
1. (a) in general, to dispose of; with dative of person(s), to assign to one, Luk.22:29;
(b) to dispose of by a will, make a testament (in cl., δ. διαθήκην also in this sense): Heb.9:16-17 (but cf. R, mg., and see: διαθήκη).
2. δ. διαθήκην, to make a covenant (Aristoph.): with dative of person(s), Heb.8:10 (LXX); before πρ, with accusative of person(s), Act.3:25, Heb.10:16" (LXX) (cf. ἀντι-διατίθημι).†
(AS)
G1303.strong_def: to put apart, i.e. (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest)
G1303.derivation: middle voice from G1223 (διά) and G5087 (τίθημι);

G2648.def:
κατα-μανθάνω
[in LXX: Gen.34:1 (רָאָה), Job.35:4 (5) (שׁוּר), Sir.9:5, 8, al. ;]
to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully (on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, Pr., 117): Mat.6:28.†
(AS)
G2648.strong_def: to learn thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to note carefully

G1416.def:
δύνω Ion, and trag. form of δύω,
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
to enter, sink into; of the sun (sc. όντον), set: Mrk.1:32, Luk.4:40
(cf. ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-εν-, παρ-εισ-, ἐπι-δύνω).†
δύω, see: δύνω
δύνω Ion, and trag. form of δύω,
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
to enter, sink into; of the sun (sc. όντον), set: Mrk.1:32, Luk.4:40
(cf. ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-εν-, παρ-εισ-, ἐπι-δύνω).†
δύω, see: δύνω
(AS)
G1416.derivation: prolonged forms of an obsolete primary (to sink);

G0495.def:
ἀντί-περα (Rec. ἀντιπέραν, LTr. ἀντιπέρα) adv., = cl. ἀντιπέρας (MM, VGT, 49),
on the opposite side: with genitive, Luk.8:26.†
(AS)

G1712.def:
ἐμπόριον, -ον, τό
(ἔμπορος) [in LXX: Deu.33:19 (סָפַן), Eze.27:3 (רָכַל); ἐ. εἶναι, Isa.23:17 (זָנָה)* ;]
a trading place, exchange: οἶκος ἐμπορίου, Jhn.2:16.†
(AS)

G1255.def:
δια-λαλέω, -ῶ
[in Sm.: Ps 50(51):16, and al. ;]
1. to talk with: πρός, Luk.6:11.
2. to talk over: pass., Luk.1:65.†
(AS)
G1255.strong_def: to talk throughout a company, i.e. converse or (genitive case) publish

G0194.def:
ἄκρατος, -ον
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: Psa.75:8 (חֲמַר), Jer.25:15 (חֵמָה), 3Ma.5:2 * ;]
unmixed, pure: οἶνος, Rev.14:10.†
(AS)
G0194.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767 (κεράννυμι);

G2962.strong_def: supreme in authority, i.e. (as noun) controller; by implication, Master (as a respectful title)

G4563.strong_def: akin to G4951 (σύρω)); meaning a broom; to sweep
G4563.derivation: from a derivative of (to brush off;

G1528.def:
εἰσ-καλέω, -ῶ,
to call in: mid., with accusative of person(s), Act.10:23.†
(AS)

G5048.strong_def: to complete, i.e. (literally) accomplish, or (figuratively) consummate (in character)

G4980.strong_def: to take a holiday, i.e. be at leisure for (by implication, devote oneself wholly to); figuratively, to be vacant (of a house)

G1643.def:
ἐλαύνω
[in LXX: Isa.41:7 (הָלַם) Isa.33:21 (שַׁיִט), etc. ;]
to drive: of the wind, Jas.3:4, 2Pe.2:17; of sailors rowing or sailing a boat, Mrk.6:48, Jhn.6:19; of demons, Luk.8:29 (cf. ἀπ-, συν-ελαύνω).†
(AS)
G1643.strong_def: to push (as wind, oars or dæmonical power)
G1643.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an alternative of this) of uncertain affinity;

G3811.strong_def: to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment)

G2168.def:
εὐχαριστέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jdth.8:25 Wis.18:2, 2Ma.1:11 2Mac 10:7 A 2Ma.12:31 R, 3Ma.7:16 * ;]
to be thankful, give thanks (chiefly in late writers and Inscr.; cf. Milligan, Th., 5; Ellic. on Col.1:12; Lft., Notes, 9): Rom.1:21, 1Co.14:17, 1Th.5:18; of giving thanks before meat, Mat.15:36 26:27, Mrk.8:6 14:23, Luk.22:17, 19, Jhn.6:11, 23, 1Co.11:24; with dative pens., τ. θεῷ, Luk.17:16, Act.27:35 28:15, Rom.14:6 16:4, 1Co.14:18, Php.1:3, Col.1:3, 12, Phm 4; before διὰ Ἰ. Χριστοῦ, Rom.1:8 7:25 R, WH, mg., Col.3:17; ἐν ὀνόματι Χρ., Eph.5:20; before περί, 1Th.1:2, 2Th.1:3; ὅτι, Rom.1:8, 2Th.2:13; ἐπι, with dative of thing(s), 1Co.1:4; ὐπέρ, 1Co.10:30, Eph.1:16 5:20; ὅτι, Luk.18:11, Jhn.11:41, 1Co.1:14, 1Th.2:13, Rev.11:17; pass. (Deiss., BS, 122 f.), 2Co.1:11.†
SYN.: see: αἰνέω; and cf. Cremer, 903 f (AS)
G2168.strong_def: to be grateful, i.e. (actively) to express gratitude (towards); specially, to say grace at a meal

G3583.gloss: dry up, pine away, be ripe, wither (away)
G3583.strong_def: to desiccate; by implication, to shrivel, to mature

G3471.gloss: become fool, make foolish, lose savour
G3471.strong_def: to become insipid; figuratively, to make (passively, act) as a simpleton

G1013.def:
βούλημα, -τος, τό
(βούλομαι), [in LXX: Pro.9:10 (דַּעַת), 2Ma.15:5, 4Ma.8:18 * ;]
purpose, will: Act.27:43, Rom.9:19, 1Pe.4:3.†
SYN.: θέλημα. (AS)

G1231.def:
δια-γινώσκω
(see previous word), [in LXX chiefly for ידע, and cf. 2Ma.9:15 ;]
1. to distinguish, ascertain exactly: Act.23:15
2. As Athen. law-term, to determine: τὰ καθ᾽ ὑμᾶς, your case, Act.24:22 (Cremer, 673).†
(AS)
G1231.strong_def: to know thoroughly, i.e. ascertain exactly

G2163.def:
εὔφημος, -ον
(εὖ, φήμη), [in Sm.: Psa.63:6 ;]
primarily, utter­ing words or sounds of good omen, hence,
1. avoiding ill-omened words, religiously silent.
2. fair-sounding, auspicious (R, mg., gracious): Php.4:8.†
(AS)

G1657.def:
ἐλευθερία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Lev.19:20 (חֻפְשָׁה), 1Es.4:49 Est.4:53, Sir.7:21, Sir.33:25, 1Ma.14:27, 3Ma.3:28 * ;]
liberty: with reference to the religious life, 1Co.10:29, 2Co.3:17, Gal.2:4 5:1, 1Pe.2:16, 2Pe.2:19; ὁ νόμος τῆς ἐ., Jas.1:25 2:12; ἡ ἐ. τῆς δόξης, Rom.8:21; ἐπ᾽ ἐ., Gal.5:13 (on which formula, cf. Deiss., LAE, 327 ff.; Cremer, 251).†
(AS)
G1657.strong_def: freedom (legitimate or licentious, chiefly moral or ceremonial)

G0076.def:
Ἀδάμ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָדָם),
Adam: Luk.3:38, Rom.5:14, 1Co.15:22,45, 1Ti.2:13,14 Ju 14. Christ ὁ ἔσχατος Ἀ., 1Co.15:45.†
(AS)
G0076.strong_def: Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative)

G0946.def:
βδέλυγμα, -τος, τό
(βδελύσσω), [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶץ ,תּוֹעֵבָה ;]
an abomination, a detestable thing: Luk.16:15, Rev.17:4, 5 21:27; τὸ β. τ. ἐρημώσεως (Dan LXX 12:11, cf . 1Ma.1:54; DB, i, 12f.; DCG, i, 6f.), Mrk.13:14, Mat.24:15 (Cremer, 138).†
(AS)

G3181.strong_def: bounded alongside, i.e. contiguous (neuter plural as noun, frontier)

G1149.def:
Δαλματία (L, Δελ-), -ας, ἡ
Dalmatia, a part of Illyria on E. coast of the Adriatic: 2Ti.4:10.†
(AS)

G1017.def:
βραβεῖον, -ου, τό
(βραβεύς, an umpire),
a prize in the games: 1Co.9:24; metaphorically, of the Christian's reward, Php.3:14.†
(AS)
G1017.strong_def: an award (of arbitration), i.e. (specially) a prize in the public games

G2609.def:
κατ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for יָרַד hi. ;]
to bring down: with accusative of person(s), Act.22:30, Rom.10:6; id. before εἰς, Act.9:30 23:15, 20 23:28; as nautical term, to bring to land: τ. πλοῖον ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Luk.5:11; pass., before εἰς, Act.27:3 2:12.†
(AS)
G2609.strong_def: to lead down; specially, to moor a vessel

G4557.strong_def: hence the "onyx" stone); a "sardonyx", i.e. the gem so called
G4557.derivation: from the base of G4556 (σάρδιος) and (the nail of a finger;

G4569.strong_def: Saulus (i.e. Shaul), the Jewish name of Paul
G4569.derivation: of Hebrew origin, the same as G4549 (Σαούλ);

G0476.def:
ἀντίδικος, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX for רִיב ;]
as subst., an opponent in a lawsuit, adversary: Mat.5:25, Luk.12:58 18:3, 1Pe.5:8 (Cremer, 696; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0476.strong_def: an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy)

G1752.def:
ἕνεκα (so Mat.19:5, Luk.6:22, Act.19:32 26:21; elsewhere, prop, only before a vowel, ἕνεκεν; εἵνεκεν, originally Ionic: Luk.4:18 18:29, Act.28:20, 2Co.3:10),
prep. with genitive,
on account of, because of: Mat.5:10-11 16:25 19:29, Mrk.8:35, Luk.6:22, Act.28:20, Rom.8:36, 2Co.3:10; ἕ. τούτου, Mat.19:5; υούτων, Act.26:21; τίνος ἕ., Act.19:32; before τοῦ, with inf., 2Co.7:12; οὗ ἕν., Luk.4:18
(AS)

G1289.def:
δια-σπείρω
[frequently in LXX for פּוּץ, etc. ;]
to scatter abroad, disperse: Act.8:1, 4 11:19.†
(AS)
G1289.strong_def: to sow throughout, i.e. (figuratively) distribute in foreign lands

G0006.def:
Ἄβελ, (WH, Ἅ-), ὁ, indecl.
(הֶבֶל),
Abel (Gen.4:2-10): Heb.11:4, 12:24; αἵμα Ἄ., Mat.23:35, Luk.11:51.†
(AS)

G1317.def:
διδακτικός, -ή, -όν
(= cl. διδασκαλικός)
apt at teaching: 1Ti.3:2, 2Ti.2:24.†
(AS)

G2502.def:
Ἰωσείας (-σίας, Rec.), -ου, ὁ (Heb. יֹאשִׁיָּה),
Josiah: Mat.1:10-11 †
(AS)

G2052.def:
ἐριθία
(T, cl., -εία), -ας, ἡ, [in Sm.: Eze.23:11 * ;] (on the origin and history of the word, see Hort, Ja., 81 fly.; Ellic. on Gal.5:20; Cremer, 262)
ambition, self-seeking, rivalry: Jas.3:14, 16; κατ᾽ ἐριθίαν, Php.2:3; οἱ ἐξ ἐ., Rom.2:8, Php.1:17; pl. (Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153), 2Co.12:20, Gal.5:20.†
(AS)
G2052.derivation: perhaps as the same as G2042 (ἐρεθίζω);

G4713.derivation: from the base of G2476 (ἵστημι) (as stationary);

G5050.strong_def: (the act) completion, i.e. (of prophecy) verification, or (of expiation) absolution

G4848.strong_def: to journey together; by implication, to assemble

G1479.def:
ἐθελο-θρησκία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ,
self-imposed worship: Col.2:23 (eccl.; cf. DB, iv, 923a; Cremer, 733).†
(AS)
G1479.strong_def: voluntary (arbitrary and unwarranted) piety, i.e. sanctimony

G2395.def:
ἰατρός, -οὔ, ὁ
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX for רָפָא ;]
a physician: Mat.9:12, Mrk.2:17 5:26, Luk.4:23 5:31 8:43 (om. WH, R, mg.), Col.4:14 (on the status of physicians, see MM, Exp., xv.).†
(AS)

G1041.def:
βωμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(βαίνω), [in LXX (Hex.) for מִזְבֵּחַ, in Proph., chiefly for בָּמָה ;]
1. any raised place, a platform.
2. an altar: Act.17:23 (cf. θυσιαστήριον and see DB, i, 75).
† (AS)
G1041.strong_def: properly, a stand, i.e. (specially) an altar

G1261.def:
δια-λογισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(διαλογίζομαι) [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲשָׁבָה ;]
a thought, reasoning, inward questioning: Mat.15:19, Mrk.7:21, Luk.2:35 5:22 6:8 9:46, 47 24:38, Rom.1:21 14:1, 1Co.3:20" (LXX), Php.2:14; κριταὶ δ. πονηρῶν, genitive of qual. (cf. Pro.12:5), Jas.2:4; χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ δ. (where perh. δ., like מְזִמָּה, in Ps 138(139):20, al., implies evil intention), 1Ti.2:8 (see Hort, in l.; cf. Cremer, 400).†
(AS)
G1261.strong_def: discussion, i.e. (internal) consideration (by implication, purpose), or (external) debate

G1873.def:
ἐπ-ακούω
[in LXX for שָׁמַע, עָנָה, etc. ;]
1. to listen to.
2. to hearken to, hear with favour (one's prayer): with genitive of person(s), 2Co.6:2 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1865.def:
ἐπ-αθροίζω
to assemble besides (Plut.): pass., Luk.11:29.†
(AS)

G0516.def:
ἀξίως,
adv. [in LXX: Wis.7:15 16:1, Sir.14:11 * ;]
worthily: Rom.16:2, Eph.4:1, Php.1:27; with genitive (frequently in Inscr.; Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, 51), ἀ. τ. Κυρίου, Col.1:10; τ. θεοῦ 1Th.2:12, 3Jn.6.†
(AS)

G5346.strong_def: to show or make known one's thoughts, i.e. speak or say
G5346.derivation: properly, the same as the base of G5457 (φῶς) and G5316 (φαίνω);

G4107.strong_def: a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher

G4396.strong_def: a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet
G4396.derivation: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G5346 (φημί);

G5429.strong_def: thoughtful, i.e. sagacious or discreet (implying a cautious character; while G4680 (σοφός) denotes practical skill or acumen; and G4908 (συνετός) indicates rather intelligence or mental acquirement); in a bad sense conceited (also in the comparative)

G5619.strong_def: just as if, i.e. as it were

G2663.def:
κατά-παυσις, -εως, ἡ
(καταπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, Psa.95:11, Isa.66:1, al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., 2Ma.15:1]
1. in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease.
2. In LXX and NT, rest, repose: Act.7:49 (LXX), Heb.3:11, 18 4:1, 3 4:5, 10-11†
(AS)

G4675.gloss: X home, thee, thine (own), thou, thy

G4003.derivation: from G4002 (πέντε) and G2532 (καί) and G1182 (δέκατος);

G4038.strong_def: all around, i.e. (as an adjective) circumjacent

G0685.def:
ἀρά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אָלָה ];
1. a prayer (MM, see word).
2. (as in Homer) a curse, malediction: Rom.3:14 (LXX),†
(AS)
G0685.strong_def: properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation

G0296.def:
ἄμφοδον, -ου, το
(ἀμφί ὁδός), [in LXX for אַרְמוֹן (Jer.17:27 30:10 49:27)* ;]
prop., a road around anything (RV, the open street): Mrk.11:4, Act.19:28, WH, mg.†
(AS)
G0296.derivation: from the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and G3598 (ὁδός);

G0149.def:
αἰσχρός, -ά, όν
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX: Gen.41:3 ff. (רַע, רֹעַ), Jdth.12:12, al. ;]
base, shameful: 1Co.11:6 14:35, Eph.5:12, Tit.1:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4777.strong_def: to suffer hardship in company with

G1726.def:
ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;]
over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, Mat.14:24, Mrk.6:48, Act.27:4; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, Psa.42:1-11), with genitive, Mrk.15:39. Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: 1Th.2:15, Act.26:9 28:17; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., Tit.2:8. Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: Luk.1:6 20:26 24:19 Act.7:10 (ἔναντι, T), Act.8:32 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1065.def:
γε, enclitic postpositive particle, rarer in κοινή than in cl., giving special prominence to the word to which it is attached, distinguishing it as the least or the most important (Thayer, see word),
indeed, at least, even (but not always translatable into English);
1. used alone: Luk.11:8 18:5 Rom.8:32.
2. More frequently with other particles: αλλά γε, Luk.24:21, 1Co.9:2; ἄρα γε, Mat.7:20 17:26, Act.17:27; ἆρά γε, Act.8:30; εἴ γε (Rec. εἴγε), 2Co.5:3, Gal.3:4, Eph.3:2 4:21, Col.1:23 (see Meyer, Ellic., on Ga, Eph, ll. with; Lft., on Ga, Col, ll. with); εἰ δὲ μήγε, following an affirmation, Mat.6:1, Luk.10:6 13:9; a negation, Mat.9:17, Luk.5:36, 37 14:32, 2Co.11:16; καί γε (Rec. καίγε, cl. καὶ . . . γε), Luk.19:42 (WH om.), Act.2:18 17:27; καίτοιγε (L καίτοι γε, Tr. καί τοι γε), Jhn.4:2; μενοῦνγε (see see word); μήτι γε, see: μήτι; ὄφελόν, 1Co.4:8.
† (AS)
G1065.derivation: a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed)

G1544.def:
ἐκ-βάλλω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּרַשׁ pi., also for שָׁלַךְ hi., יָצָא hi., יָרַשׁ hi., etc. ;]
1. to drive, cast or send out, to expel: with accusative of thing(s), mid. (σῖτον), before εἰς, Act.27:38; pass., Mat.15:17; with accusative of person(s), Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15, al.; δαιμόνια, Mat.7:22, Mrk.1:34, al.; id. before ἐκ, Mrk.7:26; παρά, Mrk.16:9; ἐν, Mrk.3:22; (ἐν) τ. ὀνόματι, Mat.7:22, Mrk.9:38; λόγῳ, Mat.8:16; before ἔξω, Jhn.6:37; id. with genitive, Mrk.12:8, al.; of expulsion from home, Gal.4:30; from the Church, III Jn 10.
2. In LXX and NT (like Heb. יָצָא and Aram. הַנְפֵּק), to command or cause to depart: Mat.9:38, Mrk.1:12 (see Swete, in l.), ib. Mrk.1:43 5:40, Luk.10:2, Jas.2:25; τ. κρίσιν εἰς νῖκος (to cause to proceed to its goal), Mat.12:20 (LXX).
3. to reject (cl.): τ. ὄνομα ὑμῶς ὡς πονηρόν (cf. Deu.25:14), Luk.6:22; to leave out, Rev.11:2.
4. to take, draw or pluck out;
(a) with violence: Mat.7:5, Mrk.9:47, Luk.6:42;
(b) to bring forth or out of: Mat.12:35, Luk.10:35.
(AS)

G3637.strong_def: an eight-day old person or act

G0984.def:
βλάπτω,
[in LXX: Pro.25:20, Tob.12:2, Wis.10:8 18:2, 2Ma.12:22, 4Ma.9:7 * ;]
to hurt, injure: with accusative, Mrk.16:[18], Luk.4:35.†
(AS)
G0984.strong_def: properly, to hinder, i.e. (by implication) to injure

G1550.def:
εκ-δαπανάω, -ῶ
strengthened form of δαπανάω, to spend wholly; pass., with reflexive force, to spend oneself wholly: before ὑπέρ, 2Co.12:15.†
(AS)

G1758.def:
ἐν-έχω
[in LXX: Gen.49:23 (סָתַם), Eze.14:4, 7, 3Ma.6:10 * ;]
1. to hold in; pass., to be held, entangled: with dative of thing(s); jig., ζυγῷ δουλείας, Gal.5:1 (cf. MM, Exp., xii); θλίψρεσιν, 2Th.1:4 (cf. ἀσεβείσιν, 3Mac, l.with).
2. to set oneself against, be urgent against (as Ge, l.with; for con­struction, see Swete, Mk., l.with): Mrk.6:19, Luk.11:53.†
(AS)
G1758.strong_def: to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication, to keep a grudge

G4074.strong_def: a (piece of) rock (larger than G3037 (λίθος)); as a name, Petrus, an apostle

G5496.strong_def: to be a hand-leader, i.e. to guide (a blind person)

G2114.def:
εὐθυμέω, -ῶ
(ὔθυμος), [in Sm.: Psa.32:11, Pro.15:15 * ;]
1. trans., to make cheerful (Æsch.).
2. Intrans. (Eur., Plut.; so mid. in Xen., Plat.), to be of good cheer: Act.27:22, 25, Jas.5:13.†
(AS)
G2114.strong_def: to cheer up, i.e. (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully

G1441.def:
ἑβδομηκοντάκις, adv.,
[in LXX for שִׁבְעִים, Gen.4:24 * ;]
seventy times: ἑ. ἑπτά, seventy times seven, Mat.18:22 (R, txt., ICC, in l.), or seventy-seven times (R, mg.; cf. M, Pr., 98; WM, 314; Meyer, in l.).†
(AS)

G0726.def:
ἁρπάζω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּזַל, טָרַף ;]
to seize, catch up, snatch away, carry off by force: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.12:29 13:19, Jhn.10:12, 28-29; τ. βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, Mat.11:12; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.6:15, Act.8:39 23:10, Ju 23; pass., before ἕως, 2Co.12:2; εἰς, 2Co.12:4, 1Th.4:17; πρός, Rev.12:5 (cf. δι-, συν-αρπάζω, and see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G3820.strong_def: antique, i.e. not recent, worn out

G3508.strong_def: Nephthaleim (i.e. Naphthali), a tribe in Palestine

G4843.strong_def: to take by enclosing altogether, i.e. earnestly throw the arms about one
G4843.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a compound of G4012 (περί) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);

G2636.def:
κατα-λαλιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(κατάλαλος), [in LXX: Wis.1:11 * ;]
evil-speaking, railing: p1., 2Co.12:20, 1Pe.2:1.†
(AS)

G1767.def:
ἐννέα, οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl.,
nine: Luk.17:17; ἐνενήκοντα ἐ., Mat.18:12-13, Luk.15:4, 7.†
(AS)

G2672.def:
κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon.
(κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;]
to curse: with accusative, Mrk.11:21; opposite to εὐλογέω, Luk.6:26, Rom.12:14, Jas.3:9; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): Mat.25:41.†
(AS)
G2672.strong_def: to execrate; by analogy, to doom

G3107.strong_def: supremely blest; by extension, fortunate, well off
G3107.derivation: a prolonged form of the poetical (meaning the same);

G1026.def:
βρέχω,
[in LXX chiefly for מטר ;]
1. to wet: Luk.7:38, 44.
2. In late Gk. writers and vernac. = ὕειν, to send rain, to rain (Kennedy, Sources, 39, 155): Mat.5:45; trop., β. πῦρ κ. θεῖον, Luk.17:29; impers., βρέχει, it rains: Jas.5:17; with ὐετός as subj., Rev.11:6.
† (AS)

G0632.def:
ἀπο-νέμω
(νέμω, to distribute), [in LXX: Deu.4:19 (חָלַק), 3Ma.1:7 3Mac 3:16 * ;]
to assign, apportion: 1Pe.3:7. (In π. of a Prefect who renders to all their dues; see MM, see word)†
(AS)
G0632.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G3551 (νόμος);

G0115.def:
ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀθετέω), [in LXX, usually of unfaithful, rebellious action: 1Ki.24:12 (פֶּשַׁע), Jer.12:1 (בֶּגֶד), Da TH 9:7 (מַעַל), 2Ma.14:28 * ;]
a disannulling, setting aside: Heb.7:18 9:26 (for similar usage in π., see Deiss., BS, 228 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G1446.def:
Ἑβραΐς (WH, Ἐβ-), -ίδος (Aram. עִבְרַי), peculiar form of Ἑβραϊκός,
[in LXX, ἡ Ἑ. φωνή, 4Ma.12:7 16:15 * ;]
in NT, ἡ Ἑ. διάλεκτος, Hebrew, i.e. the Aramaic vernacular of Palestine: Act.21:40 22:2 26:14.†
(AS)

G3646.derivation: from a derivative of a compound of G3650 (ὅλος) and a derivative of G2545 (καίω);

G2903.def:
κράτιστος, -η, -ον
superl, of κρατύς (Hom.),
1. strongest, mightiest (Hom.).
2. noblest, best (cf. κρείσσων), most excellent (find., Soph., al.): voc., κρατίστε, as title of honour and respect (DCG, ii, 727a), Luk.1:3, Act.23:26 24:3 26:25.†
(AS)
G2903.derivation: superlative of a derivative of G2904 (κράτος);

G1486.def:
ἔθω, pf. with present sense εἴωθα,
[in LXX: Num.24:1 (כְּפַעַם־בְּפַעַם), Dan LXX Su 13, Sir.37:14, 4Ma.1:12 * ;]
to be accustomed, wont: Mat.27:15, Mrk.10:1; ptcp., τὸ εἰθός, custom: κατὰ τὸ εἰ. (Nu, l.with), Luk.4:16, Act.17:2.†
(AS)
G1486.strong_def: to be used (by habit or conventionality); neuter perfect participle usage

G3631.derivation: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin (H03196));

G1853.def:
ἔξ-υπνος, -ον
(ὕπνος), [in LXX: I Est.3:3 * ;]
roused out of sleep: Act.16:27.†
(AS)

G2526.def:
καθό
(= καθ᾽ ὅ),
adv., [in LXX: Lev.9:5, 15 (אֲשֶׁר), I Est.1:50, Sir.16:20 Bar.1:6, 2Ma.4:16 * ;]
as, according as: Rom.8:26, 2Co.8:12, 1Pe.4:13.†
(AS)
G2526.strong_def: according to which thing, i.e. precisely as, in proportion as

G2579.def:
κἄν
by crasis for καὶ ἄν (= ἐάν; WH, App., 145b; Thayer, see word), with subjunc.,
1. and if: Mrk.16:18 Luk.12:38, Jhn.8:55, 1Co.13:2-3, Jas.5:15; with ellips., Luk.13:9.
2. Concessive, even if: Mat.21:21 26:35, Jhn.8:14 10:38 11:25, Heb.12:20.
3. As intensive of simple καί (M, Pr., 167; WM, 730; Jannaris, Gr., 598), even, at least: Mrk.5:28 6:56, Act.5:15, 2Co.11:16.†
(AS)

G0746.def:
ἀρχή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for קֶדֶם, רֹאשׁ, רֹאשׁ, etc. ;]
1. beginning, origin;
(a) absol., of the beginning of all things: of God as the Eternal, the First Cause, Rev.21:6 (cf. 18); similarly, of Christ, Rev.22:13; of Christ as the uncreated principle, the active cause of creation, Rev.3:14; in his relation to the Church, Col.1:18; ἐν ἀ., Jhn.1:1-2; ἀπ᾽ ἀ. (and ἀπ᾽ ἀ. κτισεως), Mat.19:4, 8 24:21, Mrk.10:6 13:19, Jhn.8:44, 2Th.2:13, 2Pe.3:4, 1Jn.1:1 Jn 2:13-14 Jn 2:24; κατ ἀρχἀς, Heb.1:10;
(b) relatively: Heb.7:3; ἀ. ὠδίνων, Mat.24:8, Mrk.13:9; τ. σημείων, Jhn.2:11; τ. ὑποστάσεως, Heb.3:14; τ. λογίων, Heb.5:12; ὁ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγος, the account of the beginning, the elementary view of Christ, Heb.6:1; ἀρχὴν λαμβάνειν, to begin, Heb.2:3; ἐξ ἀ., Jhn.6:64 16:4; ἀπ᾽ ἀ., Luk.1:2, Jhn.15:27, 1Jn.2:7 Jn 2:24 Jn 3:11, 2Jn.5-6; ἐν ἀ., Act.11:15 26:4, Php.4:15; τὴν ἀρχήν, adverbially, at all (Hdt., al.; v MM, see word): Jhn.8:25.
2. an extremity, a corner: Act.10:11 11:5.
3. sovereignty, principality, rule (cf. DB, i, 616 f.): Luk.12:11 20:20, Rom.8:38, 1Co.15:24, Eph.1:21 3:10 6:12, Col.1:16 2:10, 15 Tit.3:1, Ju 6 (Cremer, 113).†
(AS)
G0746.strong_def: (properly abstract) a commencement, or (concretely) chief (in various applications of order, time, place, or rank)

G1095.def:
γηράσκω (also γηράω; γῆρας),
[in LXX chiefly for זקן ;]
to grow old: Jhn.21:18, Heb.8:13.†
SYN.: παλαιοῦμαι. (AS)

G3676.strong_def: at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still
G3676.derivation: adverb from the base of G3674 (ὁμοῦ);

G3132.strong_def: to divine, i.e. utter spells (under pretense of foretelling
G3132.derivation: from a derivative of G3105 (μαίνομαι) (meaning a prophet, as supposed to rave through inspiration);

G2735.def:
κατόρθωμα, -τος, τό
Rec, for διόρθωμα (which see), Act.24:3.†
(AS)
G2735.strong_def: something made fully upright, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (specially, good public administration)
G2735.derivation: from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G3717 (ὀρθός) (compare G1357 (διόρθωσις));

G0169.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2508 (καθαίρω) (meaning cleansed);

G1813.def:
ἐξ-αλείφω
[in LXX for טוּחַ, Lev.14:42, al.; metaphorically, מָחָה, שָׁחַת, etc. ;]
1. to plaster, wash over (LXX).
2. to wipe off, wipe out: δάκρυον, Rev.7:17 21:4; metaphorically, χειρόγραφον, Col.2:14; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐκ, Rev.3:5 (MM, Exp., xiii); pass., ἀμαρτίαι (ἐξαλιφθῆναι, WH), Act.3:19 (cf. Psa.51:11 Psa.109:13, Isa.43:25, Sir.46:20 (ἁμ. ἀπαλ-), 3Ma.2:19).†
(AS)
G1813.strong_def: to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears, figuratively, pardon sin)

G1862.strong_def: a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good)

G0944.def:
βάτραχος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: Ex 8, Psa.77 (78):45 104 (105):30 (צְכַרִדֵּעַ), Wis.19:10 * ;]
a frog: Rev.16:13.†
(AS)

G0157.def:
αἰτίωμα (Rec. αἰτίαμα, the usual form; see MM, VGT, see word), -τος, τό
(αἰτιάομαι, αἰτία),
a charge, accusation: Act.25:7.†
(AS)

G0790.def:
ἀστατέω, -ῶ
(ἄστατος, unstable), [in Aq.: Isa.58:7 (LXX, ἄστεγος)* ;]
to be unsettled, be homeless, lead a vagabond life (Cremer, 738 MM, see word): 1Co.4:11 †
(AS)
G0790.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2476 (ἵστημι);

G0616.def:
ἀπο-κυέω
(Rec. -κύω), -ῶ (ἀπό, κυέω or κύω, to be pregnant), [in LXX: 4Ma.15:17 * ;]
prop., "the medical word for birth as the close of pregnancy" (Hort, Ja., 26 f.). In κοιν, "an ordinary syn. of τίκτω, but definitely 'perfectivised' (M, Pr., 111 ff.; MM, see word) by the
ἀπό, and so implying safe delivery," to bring forth, give birth to: Jas.1:15, 18.†
(AS)
G0616.strong_def: to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively)
G0616.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G2949 (κῦμα);

G0957.def:
βελτίων, -ον (genitive -ονος), comp. of ἀγαθός,
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
neut. as adv., better, very well: 2Ti.1:18 (also Act.10:28 D). On elative use in these passages, see M, Pr., 78, 236.†
(AS)
G0957.derivation: neuter of a compound of a derivative of G906 (βάλλω) (used for the comparative of G18 (ἀγαθός));

G0621.def:
ἀπο-λείχω
(for ἐπιλ-, which see),
to lick up: Luk.16:21, Rec.†
(AS)

G1609.def:
ἐκ-πτύω
1. to spit out.
2. to spit at in disgust, to abominate, loathe (= cl. ἀποπτ-, καταπτ-): Gal.4:14.†
(AS)

G2565.def:
καλλιέλαιος, ου, ἡ
the garden olive (opposite to ἀγριέλ-): Rom.11:24.†
(AS)
G2565.strong_def: a cultivated olive tree, i.e. a domesticated or improved one
G2565.derivation: from the base of G2566 (καλλίον) and G1636 (ἐλαία);

G0375.def:
ἀνα-πέμπω
1. to send up,
(a) to a higher place (Æsch., Plat., al.);
(b) to a higher authority (Deiss., BS, 229; MM, VGT, see word; cf. also Field, Notes, 140): Luk.23:7, 15, Act.25:21.
2. to send back (Pind.): Luk.23:11, Phm 11.†
(AS)

G1823.def:
ἐξ-αστράπτω
[in LXX: Num.3:3 (בָּרָק), Eze.1:4 (לָקַח hithp.) 17 Dan LXX 106 (קָלַל)* ;]
to flash like lightning, gleam, be radiant: ἱματισμός, Luk.9:29.†
(AS)
G1823.strong_def: to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments)

G2417.def:
ἱερόσυλος, -ον
(ἱερόν, συλάω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:42 (cf. -λημα, 2Ma.4:39; -λία, 2Ma.13:6)* ;]
robbing temples: Act.19:37.†
(AS)

G1766.def:
ἐνατος, (Rec. ἔνν-), -η, -ον
ninth: Rev.21:20; of the ninth hour (3 o'clock, p.m.), Mat.20:5 27:45-46, Mrk.15:33-34, Luk.23:44, Act.3:1 10:3, 30.†
(AS)

G1320.def:
διδάσκαλος, -ου, ὁ
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: Est.6:1, 2Ma.1:10 * ;]
given as rendering of Heb. רַבִּי ,רַבּוֺן (NT, Ῥαββεί, Ῥαββουνεί which see);
a teacher: Jhn.1:39 20:16; of Jewish teachers, Luk.2:46, Jhn.3:10, cf. Rom.2:20-21; of John Baptist, Luk.3:12; of Jesus, Jhn.3:2, 10 8:4 11:28 13:13-14, and often in Syn., most frequently in voc., as title of address, as Mat.8:19, Mrk.4:38; of Jesus by himself, Mat.23:8; of an apostle, 1Ti.2:7, 2Ti.1:11; of Christians, 1Co.12:28-29, Eph.4:11, Act.13:1, Jas.3:1; of false teachers, 2Ti.4:3 (Cremer, 181; DB, i, 609, iii, 294, iv, 691)
SYN.: παιδευτής, q.v (AS)

G5443.strong_def: an offshoot, i.e. race or clan

G2622.def:
κατα-κλάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Eze.19:12 (נָתַשׁ hoph.)* ;]
to break up, break in pieces: Mrk.6:41, Luk.9:16.†
(AS)

G3659.strong_def: a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye

G1220.def:
δηνάριον, -ου, τό
the Lat. denarius, a Roman coin, nearly equal to the δραχμή, which see: Mat.18:28 20:2, 9, 13 22:19, Mrk.6:37 12:15 14:5, Luk.7:41 10:35 20:24, Jhn.6:7 12:5, Rev.6:6; τὸ ἀνὰ δ., Mat.20:10.†
(AS)

G0326.def:
ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ
[in Al.: Gen.45:27 * ;]
to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, Luk.15:24 (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, Rom.7:9.†
(AS)

G5069.strong_def: from G5064 (τέσσαρες)); a quaternion or squad (picket) of four Roman soldiers
G5069.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of (a tetrad;

G1892.def:
ἐπ-εγείρω
[in LXX for עוּר hi., קוּם hi., etc. ;]
to rouse up, excite: C. accusative of thing(s), διωγμόν, Act.13:50; ψυχάς, Act.14:2.†
(AS)
G1892.strong_def: to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against

G3817.strong_def: to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than G5180 (τύπτω)); specially, to sting (as a scorpion)

G1757.def:
ἐν-ευλογέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ ;]
to bless: pass., before ἐν, Act.3:25 (LXX), Gal.3:8 (LXX) (Cremer, 770).†
(AS)

G3914.strong_def: to winter near, i.e. stay with over the rainy season

G0653.def:
ἀποστοματίζω
(στόμα),
1. In cl., to speak from memory, to dic­tate to a pupil (Plat.).
2. In late Gk., to catechize, question: Luk.11:53 (MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0653.strong_def: to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. to catechize (in an invidious manner)
G0653.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and a (presumed) derivative of G4750 (στόμα);

G0285.def:
ἄμμος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹל ;]
sand, sandy ground: Mat.7:26, Rom.9:27, Heb.11:12, Rev.18:1, Rev.20:8.†
(AS)

G1584.def:
ἐκ-λάμπω
[in LXX for אוֹר hi., etc. ;]
to shine forth: Mat.13:43.†
(AS)

G0004.def:
αβαρής, -ές
(βαρός),
without weight; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word) not burdensome: 2Co.11:9.†
(AS)
G0004.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G922 (βάρος);

G2504.def:
κἀγώ see: ἐγώ.
ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς,
of person(s) pron.
I.
(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in Mat.3:11, Mrk.1:8, Luk.3:16, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as Mat.10:16, Jhn.10:17; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. 1Ki.3:8), Act.9:10; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, Jhn.1:23 (LXX), Act.7:32 (LXX).
(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, Jhn.14:20; μου τ. λόγους, Mat.7:24; ὀπίσω μου, Mat.3:11; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, Rev.5:5; also with the prep. πρός, as Mrk.9:19, al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as Luk.10:16, Jhn.7:23, Mrk.14:7, al.
(with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, Mat.2:6; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, Mrk.9:24.
(d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, Jdg.11:12, al.), i.e. what have we in common: Mat.8:29, Mrk.1:24, 5:7, Luk.8:28, Jhn.2:4; τί γάρ μοι, 1Co.5:2.
(e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).
(f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: Mat.2:8, Luk.2:48, Jhn.6:56, Rom.3:7, 1Co.7:40, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, Jhn.7:28.
(AS)
G2504.strong_def: so also the dative case , and accusative case and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me

G1637.def:
ἔλαιον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁמֶן ;]
olive-oil: Luk.16:6, Rev.6:6 18:13; for lamps, Mat.25:3-4, 8; for healing, Mrk.6:13, Luk.10:34, Jhn.5:14; for anointing at feasts, Luk.7:46, Heb.1:9" (LXX) .†
SYN.: μύρον, ointment, see Tr., Syn., 135 (AS)
G1637.derivation: neuter of the same as G1636 (ἐλαία);

G3039.strong_def: to winnow, i.e. (by analogy), to triturate
G3039.derivation: from , the equivalent of (a winnowing fan or basket);

G4030.strong_def: encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet
G4030.derivation: feminine of a compound of G4012 (περί) and G2776 (κεφαλή);

G1665.def:
Ἐλεισάβετ (T, Rec. Ἐλισ-; see WH, App., 155), ἡ indecl. (Heb. אֱלִישֶׁבַע)
Elizabeth: Luk.1:5 ff.†
(AS)

G1699.def:
ἐμός, -ή, -όν
poss. prop. of first of person(s), representing the em­phasized genitive ἐμοῦ,
mine, subjectively and objectively, i.e. belonging to, proceeding from or related to me: Mat.18:20, Mrk.8:38, Jhn.3:29 (most frequently in this gospel), al.; absol., τὸ ἐμόν, τὰ ἐμά, Mat.20:15 25:27, Luk.15:31, Jhn.10:14 16:14-15 17:10; = genitive obj. (cl.), εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀvάμνησιν, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24-25; with genitive expl., τ. ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου, 1Co.16:21, Col.4:18, 2Th.3:17
(AS)
G1699.derivation: from the oblique cases of G1473 (ἐγώ) (G1698 (ἐμοί), G1700 (ἐμοῦ), G1691 (ἐμέ));

G3880.strong_def: to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn

G0102.def:
ἀ-δύνατος, -ον,
[in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, דַּל, etc. ;]
1. of persons, unable, powerless: Act.14:8; figuratively Rom.15:1 (MM, VGT, see word).
2. Of things, impossible: Mat.19:26, Mrk.10:27, Luk.18:27, Rom.8:3, Heb.6:4,18 10:4 11:6.
† (AS)
G0102.strong_def: unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible
G0102.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1415 (δυνατός);

G0062.def:
ἀγραυλέω, -ῶ
(ἀγραυλος, dwelling in the field; ἀγρός, αὐλή),
to live in the fields: Luk.2:8.†
(AS)
G0062.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1121 (γράμμα);

G0117.def: Athenian, of or from Athens , (Iliad by Homer), etc (ML)
G0117.strong_def: an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ

G0763.def:
ἀσέβεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσεβής), [in LXX for פֶּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
ungodliness, impiety: Rom.1:18 11:26, 2Ti.2:16, Tit.2:12; ἔργα ἀσεβείας, ungodly deeds, Ju 15; ἐπιθυηίαι τ. ἀσεβειῶν, desires for ungodly things or deeds, Ju 18 (DB, iv, 532; Cremer, 523; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G1880.def:
ἐπ-αν-έρχομαι
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;]
to return: Luk.10:35 19:15.†
(AS)
G1880.strong_def: to come up on, i.e. return

G0129.def:
αἷμα, ατος, τό,
[in LXX for דָּם ;]
blood.
1. In the ordinary sense: Mrk.5:25, Luk.8:43,44 22:44, Jhn.19:34, Act.15:20,29 21:25, Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13.
2. In special senses:
(a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jhn.1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word);
(b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Mat.16:17, 1Co.15:50, Gal.1:16, Eph.6:12, Heb.2:14;
(with) of things in colour resembling blood: Act.2:19,20, Rev.6:12 14:18-20.
(d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): Mat.23:30,35 27:4,6,8,24,25, Luk.11:50,51 13:1, Act.1:19 5:28 18:6 20:26 22:20, Heb.12:4, Rev.6:10 17:6 18:24 19:2 ; αἷ. ἐκχέειν (Deiss., LAE, 428; MM, VGT, see word, αἷ.), Rom.3:15, Rev.16:6;
(e) of sacrificial blood, as an expiation: Heb.9:7,12,13,18-22,25 10:4 11:28 13:11; of the blood of Christ, Mat.26:28, Mrk.14:24, Luk.22:20, Jhn.6:53,54,56, Act.20:28, Rom.3:25 5:9, 1Co.10:16 11:25,27, Eph.1:7 2:13, Col.1:20, Heb.9:12,14 10:19,29 12:24 13:20, 1Pe.1:2,19, 1Jn.1:7 (cf. 5:6,8), Rev.1:5 5:9 7:14 12:11. (Cremer, 69 f., 612 f.)
† (AS)
G0129.strong_def: blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred

G5055.gloss: accomplish, make an end, expire, fill up, finish, go over, pay, perform
G5055.strong_def: to end, i.e. complete, execute, conclude, discharge (a debt)

G3397.strong_def: a small space of time or degree
G3397.derivation: masculine or neuter singular of G3398 (μικρός) (as noun);

G0098.def:
Ἁδραμυντηνός (T, Rec. Ἀδραμυττηνός), -ή,-όν,
of Adramyttium, a seaport of Mysia: Act.27:2.†
(AS)

G1186.def:
δένδρον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for עֵץ, etc. ;]
a tree: Mat.3:10, al.; δ. ἀγαθόν, Mat.7:17, 18; δ. καλόν, Mat.12:33, Luk.6:43; δ. σαπρόν, Mat.7:17, 18 12:33, Luk.6:43; γίνεσθαι δ., Mat.13:32; γ. εἰς δ., Luk.13:19.
(AS)

G3809.strong_def: tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction

G3700.strong_def: to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from G991 (βλέπω), which denotes simply voluntary observation; and from G1492 (εἴδω), which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while G2300 (θεάομαι), and still more emphatically its intensive G2334 (θεωρέω), signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and G4648 (σκοπέω) a watching from a distance)
G3700.derivation: a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice) ; which is used for it in certain tenses; and both as alternate of G3708 (ὁράω);

G0085.def:
ἀδημονέω, -ῶ (on the derivation, see MM, VGT, see word), [in Aq.: Job.18:20; Sm.: Psa.60 (61):3 115:2 (116:11), Ecc.7:17(16), Eze.3:15 * ;]
to be troubled, distressed (MM, l.with): Mat.26:37, Mrk.14:33, Php.2:26.†
(AS)

G4516.strong_def: strength; Roma, the capital of Italy

G2956.def:
Κυρηναῖος, -α, -ον
(Κυρήνη),
of Cyrene, a Cyrenæan: Mat.27:32, Mrk.15:21, Luk.23:2, Act.6:9 11:20 13:1.†
(AS)
G2956.strong_def: i.e. Cyrenæan, i.e. inhabitant of Cyrene

G3644.strong_def: a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent

G1176.def:
δέκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά,
ten: Mat.20:24, al.; θλίψις ἡμερῶν δ., i.e. of brief duration: Rev.2:10.†
δεκα-οκτώ, T for δέκα ὀκτώ,
eighteen: Luk.13:4.†

G1595.def:
ἐκούσιος, -ον

usually of actions, voluntary: κατὰ ἑ., of free will (Lft., in l), Phm 14.†
(AS)

G2328.def:
θερμαίνω
(θερμός), [in LXX chiefly for חָמַם ;]
to warm, heat; mid., to warm oneself: Mrk.14:54, 67, Jhn.18:18, 25 Jas.2:16.†
(AS)

G4719.strong_def: a head of grain (as standing out from the stalk)

G0345.def:
ἀνά-κειμαι
[in LXX: I Est.4:10, Tob.9:6 א * ;]
1. in cl., as pass. of ἀνατίθημ, to be laid up, laid: Mrk.5:40 Rec.
2. In late writers (cf. MM, VGT, see word) = κεῖσθαι, κατακεῖσθαι, to recline at table: Mat.26:20; part. ἀνακείμενος, Mat.9:10 22:10-11 26:7, Mrk.6:26 14:18 16:14, Luk.22:27, Jhn.6:11 12:2 13:23, 28.†
SYN.: ἀνακλίνω, ἀναπίπτω, the latter denoting an act rather than a state and thus in Jhn.13:25 differing from ἀνάκειμαι (see. Jhn.13:23) by indicating a change of position. (AS)
G0345.strong_def: to recline (as a corpse or at a meal)

G4169.strong_def: individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one
G4169.derivation: from the base of G4226 (ποῦ) and G3634 (οἷος);

G2896.def:
κράζω
[in LXX for זָעַק, צָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;]
in cl. chiefly poët.,
1. prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, to scream, cry out (Æsch., al.): Mrk.5:5 9:26 15:39 (Rec., R, mg.), Luk.9:39, al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. Gen.4:10), Jas.5:4.
2. to cry, call out with a loud voice: with accusative of thing(s), Act.19:32; before orat. dir., Mrk.10:48, Luk.18:39, al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Mrk.5:7, Rev.14:15, al.; λέγων, Mat.8:29, al.; of public teaching, Jhn.1:15, Rom.9:27, al.; of importunate prayer (cf. Job.35:12, Psa.3:5, al.), Rom.8:15, Gal.4:6; pf. with Pres. sense (vernac.; M, Pr., 147), Jhn.1:15
SYN.: see: βοάω (AS)
G2896.strong_def: properly, to "croak" (as a raven) or scream, i.e. (genitive case) to call aloud (shriek, exclaim, intreat)

G0669.def:
ἀπο-φθέγγομαι
[in LXX for נָבָא, etc. ;]
to speak forth, give utterance: Act.2:4, 14 26:25 (MM, s. see).†
(AS)

G2771.def:
κέρδος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in Aq.: Eze.27:24; Sm.: Psa.30:10, al. ;]
gain: Php.1:21 3:7, Tit.1:11.†
(AS)

G1946.def:
Ἐπικούριος (Rec. -ειος), -ου, ὁ
an Epicurean, a follower of Epicurus: Act.17:18.†
(AS)
G1946.strong_def: an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus

G0150.def:
αἰσχρός, -ά, όν
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX: Gen.41:3 ff. (רַע, רֹעַ), Jdth.12:12, al. ;]
base, shameful: 1Co.11:6 14:35, Eph.5:12, Tit.1:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0422.def:
ἀν-επ-αίσχυντος, -ον
(ἐπαισχύνομαι)
not to be put to shame: 2Ti.2:15.†
(AS)
G0422.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G153 (αἰσχύνομαι);

G1961.def:
ἐπι-μένω
[in LXX: Exo.12:39 (מָהַהּ hith.)* ;]
to stay on, tarry or abide still: before έν, 1Co.16:8; αὐτοῦ, there, Act.15:34 (WH, txt., RV, txt., omit) Act.21:4; with dative, τ. σαρκί, Php.1:24; before παρά, with dative of person(s), Act.28:14; πρός, with accusative of person(s), 1Co.16:7, Gal.1:18; with accusative temp., Act.10:48 21:4, 10 28:12, 14, 1Co.16:7. Metaphorical, to continue in a pursuit or state: with dative, τ. ἀμαρτίᾳ, Rom.6:1; τ. ὰπιστίᾳ, Rom.11:23; τ. πίστει, Col.1:23; αὐτοῖς (see CGT, in l), 1Ti.4:16; τ. χρηστότητι, Rom.11:22; with ptcp. (cf. Bl., § 73, 4; 76, 2), Jhn.8:7, Act.12:16.†
(AS)
G1961.strong_def: to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively, persevere)

G2368.def:
θυμίαμα, -τος, τό
(θυμιάω), [in LXX chiefly for קְטֹרֶת ;]
fragrant stuff for burning, incense: ἡ ὥρα τοῦ θ., Luk.1:10; θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θ. (Exo.30:27, al.), Luk.1:11; pl., Rev.5:8 8:3-4 18:13.†
(AS)
G2368.strong_def: an aroma, i.e. fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself

G1969.def:
ἐπι-πλήσσω
1. to strike at, to punish.
2. to rebuke, reprove: 1Ti.5:1.†
(AS)
G1969.strong_def: to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid

G0780.def:
ἀσμένως
adv. (ἥδομαι, to be glad), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:12 2Mac 10:33, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 5:21 * ;]
gladly: Act.21:17.†
(AS)
G0780.derivation: adverb from a derivative of the base of G2237 (ἡδονή);

G4479.strong_def: Rebecca (i.e. Ribkah), the wife of Isaac

G4225.strong_def: as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly
G4225.derivation: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun (some) otherwise obsolete (compare G4214 (πόσος));

G0059.def:
ἀγοράζω
(ἀγορά), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבר, קנה ;]
1. to frequent the ἀγορά (Hdt., al.).
2. to buy in the market, purchase (Xen., al.; LXX; in π. very common in deeds of sale, see MM, VGT, see word): absol., Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:44, 46, al.; before παρά, with genitive of person(s), Rev.3:18 (LXX, Polyb.); ἐκ, Mat.27:7; with genitive pret., Mrk.6:37, al.; metaphorically, 1Co.6:20 7:23, 2Pe.2:1, Rev.5:9 14:3, 4.
(AS)
G0059.strong_def: properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem

G2756.def:
κενός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for רִיק and cognate forms ;]
empty (Gen.37:24, Jdg.7:16). Metaphorical,
(a) empty, vain: λόγοι, Eph.5:6; ἀπάτη, Col.2:8; κήρυγμα, πίστις, 1Co.15:14;
(b) vain, fruitless: ἡ χάρις, 1Co.15:10; κόπος, 1Co.15:50; ἡ εἴσοδος, 1Th.2:1; κενά, Act.4:25 (LXX); εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose (Diod., LXX; cl. διὰ κενῆς), 2Co.6:1, Gal.2:2, Php.2:16, 1Th.3:5;
(with) of persons, empty-handed: Mrk.12:3, Luk.1:53 20:10-11; vain, Jas.2:20.†
SYN.: μάταιος, of the aim or effect of an action, κ. of its quality (Lft. on Cl. Rom., 1Co., § 7; Tr., Syn., xlix) (AS)

G1257.def:
δια-λείπω
[in LXX for יחל (as 1Ki.10:8), etc. ;]
to intermit, leave off for a time: Luk.7:45.†
(AS)
G1257.strong_def: to leave off in the middle, i.e. intermit

G3097.strong_def: a Magian, i.e. Oriental scientist; by implication, a magician

G1410.def:
δύναμαι, depon.,
[in LXX chiefly for יָכֹל ;]
to be able, have power, whether by personal ability, permission, or opportunity: with inf. (M, Pr., 205; WM, §44, 3) pres., Mat.6:24, Mrk.2:7, Jhn.3:2, 1Co.10:21, al.; with inf. aor., Mat.3:9, Mrk.1:45, Jhn.3:3, 4 Rom.8:39, al.; with accusative, to be able to do something: Mrk.9:22, Luk.12:26; 2Co.13:8; absol., to be able, capable, powerful: 1Co.3:2 10:13.
(AS)

G1419.def:
δυσ-βάστακτος, -ον
(βαστάζω), [in LXX for נֵטֶל, Pro.27:3 * ;]
hard to be borne: Mat.23:4 (om. WH, txt., R, mg.), Luk.11:46.†
(AS)
G1419.derivation: from G1418 (δυσ-) and a derivative of G941 (βαστάζω);

G0391.def:
ἀνα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀναστρέφομαι) [in LXX: Tob.4:14, 2Ma.5:8 2Mac 6:23 * ;]
1. a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.).
2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; see: ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on Jas.3:13; MM, VGT, see word), manner of life, behaviour, conduct: Gal.1:13, Eph.4:22, 1Ti.4:12, Heb.13:7, Jas.3:13, 1Pe.1:15 1:18 2:12 3:1-2 3:16, 2Pe.2:7 3:11.†
(AS)

G2228.derivation: a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms;

G3041.derivation: probably from G3040 (λιμήν) (through the idea of nearness of shore);

G4255.strong_def: to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend)

G5198.gloss: be in health, (be safe and) sound, (be) whole(-some)
G5198.strong_def: to have sound health, i.e. be well (in body); figuratively, to be uncorrupt (true in doctrine)

G2418.def:
ἱερουργέω, -ῶ
(ἱερουργός, a sacrificing priest) [in LXX: 4Ma.7:3 R (of. -γία, 4Mac 3:30 א R)* ;]
to perform sacred rites; with accusative, to minister in priestly service (minister in sacrifice, R, mg.), τὸ εὐαγγέλιον, Rom.15:16.†
(AS)
G2418.strong_def: to be a temple-worker, i.e. officiate as a priest (figuratively)
G2418.derivation: from a compound of G2411 (ἱερόν) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);

G1304.def:
δια-τρίβω
[in LXX Lev.14:8 (יָשַׁב), Jer.35:7 (גּוּר), Tob.11:8, 12, Jdth.10:2, 2Ma.14:23 * ;]
to rub hard, rub away, consume; δ. χρόνον, ἡμέρας, to spend time: Act.14:3, 28 16:12 20:6 25:6, 14. Intransitively with ellipse of object (El., § 81, 1), to spend time, stay: Jhn.3:22 11:54, Act.15:35, Act.12:19.†
(AS)
G1304.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the base of G5147 (τρίβος);

G3799.strong_def: properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show

G0637.def:
ἀπο-πλύνω
[in LXX chiefly for כָּבַס pi. ;]
to wash off: seel. for πλύνω, Luk.5:2, Rec.†
(AS)

G2079.def:
ἐσχάτως
adv.,
extremely, utterly; ἐ. ἔχειν (= Lat. in extremis esse), only in late writers (cf. ἐν ἐσχάτοις εἶναι, FlJ, Ant., ix, 8, 6), to be at the point of death: Mrk.5:28.†
(AS)
G2079.strong_def: finally, i.e. (with G2192 (ἔχω)) at the extremity of life

G1299.def:
δια-τάσσω
[in LXX for שׂוּם, שָׁמַר, etc. ;]
to charge, give orders to, appoint, arrange, ordain: with dative, Mat.11:1, 1Co.9:14 16:1; before inf., Luk.8:55, Act.18:2. Mid., 1Co.7:17, Act.20:13; with accusative, 1Co.11:34; with dative, Tit.1:5; before inf., Act.7:44 24:23. Pass., τὸ διατεταγμένον, Luk.3:13, Act.23:31; τὰ διαταχθέντα, Luk.17:9-10; διαταγείς, Gal.3:19.†
(AS)
G1299.strong_def: to arrange thoroughly, i.e. (specially) institute, prescribe, etc.

G1178.def:
δεκα-πέντε
[in LXX: Exo.27:15, 1Ma.10:40, al. ;]
late form of πεντεκαίδεκα, fifteen: Jhn.11:18, Act.27:5, WH, mg., ib. 28, Gal.1:18.†
(AS)

G4140.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G4130 (πλήθω);

G2838.def:
κοίμησις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Sir.46:19 48:13 * ;]
a reclining, resting: Jhn.11:13.†
(AS)

G1832.def:
ἔξ-εστι
(εἰμί),
impers. verb.,
it is permitted, lawful: Mrk.2:24, Act.8:37 (R, mg.), 1Co.10:23; with inf., Mat.12:2, 10 12 14:4 15:26 19:3 22:17 27:6, Mrk.3:4 12:14, Luk.6:2, 9 14:3, Jhn.5:10; before accusative, Mrk.2:26, Luk.6:4 20:22; with dative of person(s) and inf., Mat.20:15, Mrk.6:18 10:2, Jhn.18:31, Act.16:21 21:37 22:25 (inf. understood), 1Co.6:12; ἐξόν (sc. ἐστί), Act.2:29, 2Co.12:4; ἐξὸν ἦν, Mat.12:4.†
(AS)
G1832.strong_def: so also neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of G1510 (εἰμί) expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public)
G1832.derivation: third person singular present indicative of a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and G1510 (εἰμί);

G3916.strong_def: at the thing itself, i.e. instantly
G3916.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and G5536 (χρῆμα) (in its original sense);

G5236.gloss: abundance, (far more) exceeding, excellency, more excellent, beyond (out of) measure
G5236.strong_def: a throwing beyond others, i.e. (figuratively) supereminence; adverbially (with G1519 (εἰς) or G2596 (κατά)) pre- eminently

G5516.derivation: the 22nd, 14th and an obsolete letter (G4742 (στίγμα) as a cross) of the Greek alphabet (intermediate between the 5th and 6th), used as numbers; denoting respectively 600, 60 and 6;

G3684.strong_def: belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a ass)

G1570.def:
ἔκ-θετος, -ον
(ἐκτίθημι), [in Al.: Eze.42:3 * ;]
cast out: ποιεῖν ἔ. = ἐκτιθέναι, Act.7:19.†
(AS)
G1570.strong_def: put out, i.e. exposed to perish
G1570.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G1638.def:
ἐλαιών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(ἐλαία), [in LXX for זַיִת ;]
olive-grove, olive-garden (so in FlJ and in π.; Deiss., BS, 209 ff.; MM, Exp., iii; M, Pr., 49, 69, 235): Luk.19:29 21:37 (WH, -ῶν; see their App., 158; Field, Notes, 73; El., § 10, 5; 33, 1; Thayer, see word), Act.1:12 (where EL, ll with, proposes the conjectural emendation ἐλαιῶν for -ῶνος).†
(AS)
G1638.strong_def: an olive-orchard, i.e. (specially) the Mount of Olives

G5114.strong_def: more comprehensive or decisive than G2875 (κόπτω), as if by a single stroke; whereas that implies repeated blows, like hacking); more keen
G5114.derivation: comparative of a derivative of the primary (to cut;

G0879.def:
ἀφ-υπιόω, -ῶ
(ὑπνόω, to put to sleep), [in Al.: Gen.28:11 * ;]
1. to awake from sleep (Anth.).
2. = cl. καθυπνόω (MM, see word), to fall asleep: Luk.8:23.†
(AS)
G0879.strong_def: properly, to become awake, i.e. (by implication) to drop (off) in slumber
G0879.derivation: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G5258 (ὕπνος);

G5013.strong_def: to depress; figuratively, to humiliate (in condition or heart)

G1656.def:
ἔλεος, -ους, τό
(cl. -ου, ὁ, and so Rec., Mat.9:13 12:7 23:23, Tit.3:5, Heb.4:16; on the Hellenistic form τό ἔ., see WH, App., 158; M, Pr., 60; Mayser, 277; Kühner, i, 515), [in LXX chiefly for חֶסֶד ;]
mercy, pity, compassion;
1. of men: Mat.9:13 (LXX) Mat.12:7 23:23; ποιεῖν ἔ. (and id. before μετά, with genitive; cf. Heb. עִם חֶסֶד עָשָׂה, Gen.21:23, al.), Luk.10:37, Jas.2:13 3:17.
2. Of God: Luk.1:50, 54 1:58, Rom.15:9, Eph.2:4, 2Ti.1:16 1:18, Tit.3:5, Heb.4:16, 1Pe.1:3; esp. in benedictions, Gal.6:16, 1Ti.1:2, 2Ti.1:2, 2Jn.3, Ju 2; σκευὴ ἐλέους, Rom.9:23; σπλάγχνα ἐλέους, Luk.1:78; ποιεῖν ἔ. (see supr.), Luk.1:72; τ. ὑμετέρῳ ἐλέει, Rom.11:31.
3. Of Christ: Ju 21.†
SYN.: οἰκτιρμός (see: ἐλεέω) (AS)

G0123.def:
αἰγιαλός, -οῦ, ὁ (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word),
[in LXX: Jdg.5:17 (חוֹף), Sir.24:14 * ;]
the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Mat.13:2,48 Jhn.21:4, Act.21:5 27:39,40.†
(AS)
G0123.strong_def: a beach (on which the waves dash)
G0123.derivation: from (to rush) and G251 (ἅλς) (in the sense of the sea;

G2571.def:
κάλυμμα, -τος, τό
(καλύπτω), [in LXX: Num.3:25 4:8 ff. (מְכַסֶּה), Exo_34:33 ff. (מַסְוֶה), etc. ;]
a covering, veil: 2Co.3:13-16 †
(AS)

G2786.strong_def: the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a surname of Peter

G2122.def:
εὐκαίρως
adv., [in LXX: Sir.18:22 * ;]
seasonably, in season: Mrk.14:11; opposite to ἀκ- (Kühner3, iv, 346 d), 2Ti.4:2.†
(AS)

G4807.derivation: of Hebrew origin (H08256) in imitation of G4809 (συκομωραία);

G4375.derivation: from a presumed compound of G4314 (πρός) and G5368 (φιλέω);

G1985.def:
ἐπί-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ
(σκοπός, a watcher), [in LXX for פָּקַד, its parts and derivatives, Num.4:16 31:14, Jdg.9:28, 4Ki.11:15 11:18, 2Ch.34:12 34:17, Neh.11:9, 14 11:22; אֵל, Job.20:29; נָגַשׂ:, Isa.60:17; Wis.1:6, 1Ma.1:51 * ;]
a superintendent, guardian, overseer (cl.; for exx. see LS, see word): Act.20:28, 1Pe.2:25 (ICC, in l); as technical term for a religious office (Deiss., BS, 230 f.), in later Paul. epp. of the head of a church (Vg. episcopus), a bishop: Php.1:1, 1Ti.3:2, Tit.1:7 (see reff. see word ἐπισκοπή).†
(AS)
G1985.strong_def: a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively)
G1985.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4649 (σκοπός) (in the sense of G1983 (ἐπισκοπέω));

G0466.def:
ἀντ-ανα-πληρόω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ἀναπληρόω),
to fill up in turn: Col.1:24 (see Lft., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G3591.strong_def: a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. burden (hindrance)
G3591.derivation: probably from the same as G43 (ἀγκάλη);

G0311.def:
ἀναβολή, - ῆς, ἡ
(ά αβάλλω), [in LXX for בּנף, etc. ;]
delay: Act.25:17 (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G1998.def:
ἐπι-συν-τρέχω
to run together again: Mrk.9:25 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)
G1998.strong_def: to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion)

G1807.def:
ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi. ;]
to take out: with accusative, ὀφθαλμόν, Mat.5:29 18:9; mid.
(a) to take out for oneself, choose: Act.26:17 (Thayer, see word; Page, Ac., l.with, but see infr.);
(b) to deliver: Act.7:10, 34" (LXX) Act.12:11 Act.23:27 Act.26:17 (EV, but see supr.), Gal.1:4.†
(AS)
G1807.strong_def: actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select; figuratively, to release

G1789.def:
ἐν-τρέφω
to train up, nurture; pass., metaphorically, τοῖς λόγοις τ. πίστεως, 1Ti.4:6.†
(AS)

G0355.def:
ἀν-αλίσκω
(on the etymology, see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל also for כָּלָה, etc. ;]
1. to expend.
2. to consume, destroy: Luk.9:54, Gal.5:15, 2Th.2:8, Rec. WH, mg.†
(AS)
G0355.strong_def: properly, to use up, i.e. destroy
G0355.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and a form of the alternate of G138 (αἱρέομαι);

G1414.def:
δυνατέω, -ῶ
(δυνατός),
to be able, be powerful, mighty: with inf., Rom.14:4, 2Co.9:8; absol., opposite to ἀσθενῶ 2Co.13:3.†
(AS)

G3384.strong_def: a "mother" (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote)

G5419.strong_def: to indicate (by word or act), i.e. (specially), to expound
G5419.derivation: probably akin to G5420 (φράσσω) through the idea of defining;

G5247.strong_def: prominence, i.e. (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character)

G0145.def:
αἰσθητήριον, -ου, τό
(αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX: Jer.4:19 (קִיר), 4Ma.2:22 * ;]
sense, organ of perception: Heb.5:14 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0145.strong_def: properly, an organ of perception, i.e. (figuratively) judgment

G5558.strong_def: to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments

G5310.strong_def: highest, i.e. (masculine singular) the Supreme (God), or (neuter plural) the heavens
G5310.derivation: superlative from the base of G5311 (ὕψος);

G5542.derivation: from a compound of G5543 (χρηστός) and G3004 (λέγω);

G0688.def: Arabia , (Herdotus Historicus), poetry Ἀρραβία, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) (ML)

G4522.derivation: from a derivative of (to equip) meaning furniture, especially a pack-saddle (which in the East is merely a bag of netted rope);

G0577.def:
ἀπο-βάλλω
[in LXX: Isa.1:30 (נָבֵל) and elsew. without Heb. equiv. ;]
to throw off: Mrk.10:50; metaphorically, to lose, let go (Field, Notes, 231 f.; MM, see word): Heb.10:35.†
(AS)
G0577.strong_def: to throw off; figuratively, to lose

G5201.strong_def: a water-jar, i.e. receptacle for family supply

G0497.def:
ἀντι-στρατεύομαι
to make war against: with dative, Rom.7:23.†
(AS)

G0588.def:
ἀπο-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Tob.7:17, Jdth.13:13; Jdt.13.1, 4Mac.10:1-21 * ;]
to accept gladly, welcome, receive: Luk.8:40 9:11, Act.18:27 21:17 28:30; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), Act.2:41 24:3 (MM, see word; Cremer, 688).†
(AS)
G0588.strong_def: to take fully, i.e. welcome (persons), approve (things)

G4694.strong_def: a ledge or reef of rock in the sea

G0906.def:
βάλλω,
[in LXX for נפל, שׂום, ידד, etc. ;]
