prop., of a weapon or missile; then generally, of things and persons, lit. and metaphorically, to throw, cast, put, place: with accusative, before εἰς, Mat.4:18, and frequently ἐπί, Mat.10:34; κάτω, Mat.4:6; ἔξω, Mat.5:13; ἀπό, Mat.5:29; ἐκ, Mrk.12:44; δρέπανον, Rev.14:19; μάχαιραν, Mat.10:34; κλῆρον, Mat.27:35; of fluids, to pour: Mat.9:17, Jhn.13:5; pass., to be laid, to lie ill: Mat.9:2; ἐβλήθη (timeless aor., M, Pr., 134), Jhn.15:6; intrans., to rush (Bl., §53, 1): Act.27:14. Metaphorical, β. εἰς τ. καρδίαν, Jhn.13:2 (cf. usage in π., without idea of violence; also of liquids; MM, Exp., x; see also Cremer, 120, 657; cf. ἀμφι-, ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐμ-, παρ-εμ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, συμ-, ὑπερ-, ὑπο-βάλλω).
(AS)
G0906.strong_def: to throw (in various applications, more or less violent or intense)

G4048.strong_def: to tear all around, i.e. completely away

G2915.def:
κριθή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה ;]
barley: pl. (as usually in cl.), Rev.6:6.†
(AS)

G1786.def:
ἐντόπιος, -ον
(τόπος),
of a place, resident: Act.21:12.†
(AS)

G1242.def:
διαθήκη, -ης, ἡ
(διατίθημι), [frequently in LXX, and nearly always for בְּרִית ;]
1. as usually in cl., a disposition, testament, will (Plat., al.): Gal.3:15 (R, mg., but see Lft., in l.), Heb.9:16, 17 (R, txt.; MM, Exp., xi; Milligan, NTD, 75; Abbott, Essays, 107; Deiss., LAE, 341; but see infr.).
2. As in LXX (for בְּרִית) = cl. συνθήκη, a convention, arrangement, covenant (exc. in the disputed cases mentioned above, always between God and man, "perhaps with the feeling that the δια- compound was more suitable than the συν- for a covenant with God---συνθ. might suggest equal terms," MM, Exp., l.with): Gal.3:15 (R, txt., but see supr., and cf. Thayer, see word), Heb.9:16, 17 (R, mg., Westc., in l.; Hatch, Essays, 47; but see supr.), Mat.26:28, Mrk.14:24, Luk.1:72, Act.3:25 7:8, Rom.11:27" (LXX), 2Co.3:14, Gal.3:17, Heb.7:22 8:6, ib. 9, 10" (LXX) 9:4, 15-17 20" (LXX) 10:16 (LXX), 29 12:24 13:20, Rev.11:19; καινὴ δ., Mat.26:28, and Mrk.14:24 (R, mg.), Luk.22:20, 1Co.11:25, 2Co.3:6, Heb.8:8" (LXX) 9:15; pl. Rom.9:4, Gal.4:24, Eph.2:12.†
(AS)
G1242.strong_def: properly, a disposition, i.e. (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will)

G3598.strong_def: a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means

G4264.strong_def: to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate
G4264.derivation: from G4253 (πρό) and a reduplicated form of G971 (βιάζω);

G1366.def:
δίστομος, -ον
(δίς, στόμα), [in LXX: Jdg.3:16, Psa.149:6, Pro.5:4 (פֶּה), Sir.21:3 * ;]
1. of rivers and roads, double-mouthed, double branching.
2. Of swords (Eur.; LXX, ll with), two-edged: Heb.4:12, Rev.1:16 2:12.†
(AS)

G3137.strong_def: Maria or Mariam (i.e. Mirjam), the name of six Christian females

G2159.def:
εὐτόνως
adv. (εὖ, τείνω), [in LXX forשׁוֹפָר Jos.6:8 * ;]
vigorously, vehemently: Luk.23:10, Act.18:28.†
(AS)
G2159.strong_def: in a well-strung manner, i.e. (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely)
G2159.derivation: adverb from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of (to stretch);

G1596.def:
ἑκουσίως
adv., [in LXX: Psa.54:6 (נְדָבָה) 2Ma.14:3, al. ;]
voluntarily, willingly: Heb.10:26, 1Pe.5:2.†
(AS)
G1596.derivation: adverb from the same as G1595 (ἑκούσιον);

G2285.def:
θάμβος, -ους, τό
[in LXX for פַּחַד, etc. ;]
amazement: Luk.4:36 5:9, Act.3:10.†
(AS)

G0348.def:
1. to drive back , (Odyssey by Homer)
2. to beat back an assailant, (Thucydides)
3. to stop:—; Pass. to be stopped, stop short , τινός from a thing, (Lucian) (ML)

G1616.def:
ἐκ-τένεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐκτενής), [in LXX: Jdth.4:9, 2Ma.14:38, 3Ma.6:41 * ;]
zeal, intentness, earnestness (cf. Deiss., BS, 262): Act.26:7.†
(AS)

G0596.def:
ἀπο-θήκη, -ης, ἡ
(ἀποτίθημι), [in LXX for אוֹצָר, טֶנֶא, etc. ;]
a storehouse, granary: Mat.3:12 6:26 13:30, Luk.3:17 12:18, 24.†
(AS)

G4180.derivation: from a compound of G4183 (πολύς) and G3056 (λόγος);

G1423.def:
δυσκόλως
adv.,
with difficulty: Mat.19:23, Mrk.10:23, Luk.18:24.†
(AS)

G2864.def:
κόμη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Num.6:5, Eze.44:20 (פֶּרַע), al. ;]
the hair: 1Co.11:15.†
(AS)
G2864.strong_def: the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from G2359 (θρίξ); which properly denotes merely the scalp)
G2864.derivation: apparently from the same as G2865 (κομίζω);

G2297.def:
θαυμάσιος, -α, -ον
(θαῦμα), [in LXX chiefly for פָּלָא ni. (n. pl. = פָּלָא Jos.3:5 ;)
wonderful; n. pl., wonders: Mat.21:15.†
(AS)
G2297.strong_def: wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle

G4043.strong_def: to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary)

G1830.def:
ἐξ-εραυνάω
(Rec. ἐξερευνάω), -ῶ, [in LXX for חָקַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
to search out, search carefully: before περί, 1Pe.1:10.†
(AS)

G2347.def:
θλίψις (LTr., θλῖψις), -εως, ἡ
(θλίβω), [in LXX for צָרָה, etc. ;]
pressure (Arist.). In LXX and NT metaphorically, tribulation, affliction, distress: Mat.24:9, 21 24:29, Mrk.13:19, 24, Jhn.16:21, Act.7:11 11:19, Rom.12:12, 2Co.1:4 1:8 4:17 6:4 7:4 8:2 8:13, Php.4:14, 2Th.1:6, Jas.1:27, Rev.1:9 2:9, 22 7:14; with ἀνάγκη (which see), 1Th.3:7; στενοχωρία (which from the order of the words would appear to be the stronger term), Rom.2:9 8:35; διωγμός, Mat.13:21, Mrk.4:17, 2Th.1:4; θ. ἔχω, Jhn.16:33, 1Co.7:23, Rev.2:10; ἔρχεσθαι ἐπί, Act.7:11; ἐν θλίψει 1Th.1:6; pl., Act.7:10 14:22 20:28, Rom.5:3, Eph.3:13, 1Th.3:3, Heb.10:33; τ. Χριστοῦ, Col.1:24; θ. τῆς καρδίας, 2Co.2:4; θ. ἐγείρειν, Php.1:17.†
SYN.: ἀνάγκη, διωγμός, στενοχωρία (see supr., and cf. Tr., Syn, iv; Lft., Notes, 45) (AS)

G1944.def:
ἐπι-κατ-άρατος, -ον
(ἐπικαταράομαι, to imprecate curses on), [in LXX for אָרַר, also Wis.3:12 14:8, 4Ma.2:19 ;]
accursed: Gal.3:10 (LXX) Gal.3:13 (LXX κεκαταραμένος) (Cremer, 109).†
(AS)
G1944.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G2672 (καταράομαι);

G4715.strong_def: a stander (standard of value), i.e. (specially), a stater or certain coin

G2244.def:
ἡλικία, -ας, ἡ
(ἧλιξ, of the same age, mature), [in LXX: Eze.13:18 (קוֹמָה), Job.29:18, Wis.4:9, Sir.26:17, frequently in 2-4 Mac ;]
always of age or maturity; "a stage of growth whether measured by age or stature";
1. (a) age: Mat.6:27, Luk.12:25 (R, mg.), Heb.11:11;
(b) full age, maturity: Jhn.9:21, 23, Eph.4:13.
2. stature: Luk.19:3 (Mat.6:27, Luk.12:25, AV, R, txt.; but the prevailing usage in LXX and π. favours the former meaning in these doubtful passages; cf., Ellic., ICC, AR, on Eph, l.with; Milligan, NTD, 74 f., and esp., MM, Exp., xv; e contra, Field, Notes, 6).†
(AS)

G3790.strong_def: the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the brink of a precipice
G3790.derivation: perhaps from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision);

G0373.def:
ἀνα-παύω,
[in LXX for fourteen different words, chiefly נוּחַ, also רָבַץ, שָׁאַן, etc. ;]
to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh: Mat.11:28, 1Co.16:18, Phm 20; pass., Phm 7, 2Co.7:13. Mid., to take rest, enjoy rest: Mat.26:45, Mrk.6:31 14:41, Luk.12:19, Rev.6:11 14:13; as in Heb. ofIs 11:2 (עַל נוּחַ), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ᾽ ὑᾶμς ἀ., 1Pe.4:14. (In π. this word is used as a technical agricultural term; see MM, VGT, see word; and cf. Le 2634 f.; Cremer, 826.)†
(AS)
G0373.strong_def: (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh

G2340.def:
θηρεύω
(θήρα), [in LXX for צוּד, etc. ;]
to hunt, ensnare, catch: metaphorically, Luk.11:54.†
(AS)
G2340.strong_def: to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp at

G5001.strong_def: something orderly in arrangement (a troop), i.e. (figuratively) a series or succession

G4217.strong_def: interrogatively, whatever, i.e. of what possible sort
G4217.derivation: apparently from G4219 (πότε) and the base of G4226 (ποῦ);

G2361.def:
θρόμβος, -ου, ὁ
(τρέφω, in primary sense to thicken),
a lump, a clot of blood (DCG, ii, 685b): αἵματος, Luk.22:44 (WH, R, mg. omit the passage, see WH, App., 64 ff.).†
(AS)
G2361.derivation: perhaps from G5142 (τρέφω) (in the sense of thickening);

G2562.def:
καλάμη, -ης, ἡ
(cf. κάλαμος), [in LXX chiefly for קַשׁ, Exo.5:12, Isa.5:24, al. ;]
a stalk of corn, stubble: 1Co.3:12.†
(AS)
G2562.strong_def: a stalk of grain, i.e. (collectively) stubble

G4523.strong_def: a Sadducæan (i.e. Tsadokian), or follower of a certain heretical Israelite

G4379.strong_def: to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve)

G2942.def:
κυβερνήτης, -ου, ὁ
(see: κυβέρνησις), [in LXX for חֹבֵל, Eze.27:8, 27-28, Pro.23:24, 4Ma.7:1 * ;]
1. a steersman, pilot: Act.27:11, Rev.18:17.
2. Metaphorical, a guide, governor (Eur., Plat.).†
(AS)

G3980.strong_def: to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice
G3980.derivation: from a compound of G3982 (πείθω) and G757 (ἄρχω);

G2702.def:
κατα-φέρω
[in LXX for יָרַד hi., etc. ;]
to bring down: αἰτιώματα, Act.25:7; ψῆφον, to cast a ballot, Act.26:10; pass., to be borne down: ὕπνῳ, ἀπὸ τ. ὕ., Act.20:9.†
(AS)
G2702.strong_def: to bear down, i.e. (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a vote
G2702.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate);

G4760.strong_def: a camping-ground, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops
G4760.derivation: from the base of G4756 (στρατιά) and the same as G3977 (πεδινός);

G4389.strong_def: to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage
G4389.derivation: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);

G2555.def:
κακοποιός, -όν
(κακόν, ποιέω), [in LXX: Pro.12:4 (בּוּשׁ hi.) Pro.24:19 (רָעַע hi.)* ;]
doing evil; as susbt., an evil-doer: 1Pe.2:12 2:14 4:15.†
(AS)

G0074.def:
ἀγωνία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀγών), [in LXX: 2Ma.3:14,16 15:19 * ;]
1. a contest, wrestling (Eur., Xen.).
2. Of the mind, great fear, agony, anguish (Dem., Arist.): Luk.22:44 (cf . Field, Notes, 77 f. ; Abbott, Essays, 101 f. ; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0074.strong_def: a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish

G1436.def:
ἔα,
interj.,
expressing surprise, indignation, fear (in cl. chiefly in poët.), ah! ha!: Luk.4:34.†
(AS)
G1436.strong_def: properly, let it be, i.e. (as interjection) aha!

G1269.def:
δια-νεύω
[in LXX: Ps 34(35):19 (קרץ), Sir.27:22 * ;]
to wink at, nod to, beckon to: Luk.1:22.†
(AS)
G1269.strong_def: to nod (or express by signs) across an intervening space

G2104.def:
εὐγενής, -ές
(εὖ, γένος), [in LXX: Job.1:3 (גָּדוֹל), 2Ma.10:13 R, 4Ma.6:5 4Mac 9:13 4Mac 9:23 4Mac 9:27 4Mac 10:3 4Mac 10:15 * ;]
1. well born, of noble race: Luk.19:12, 1Co.1:26.
2. noble-minded: compar., -έστερος, Act.17:11.†
(AS)
G2104.strong_def: well born, i.e. (literally) high in rank, or (figuratively) generous

G4852.strong_def: to say jointly, i.e. assent to

G3973.strong_def: to stop (transitively or intransitively), i.e. restrain, quit, desist, come to an end

G0536.def:
ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית ;]
1. the beginning of a sacrifice.
2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. Num.15:20), Rom.11:16. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: Rom.8:23; of Christians: Rom.16:5, 1, 1Co.16:15, 2Th.2:13 (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., Notes, 119 f.), Jas.1:18, Rev.14:4; of Christ: 1Co.15:20 15:23 (Cremer, 117; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0536.strong_def: a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. the (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively)
G0536.derivation: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G756 (ἄρχομαι);

G1929.def:
ἐπι-δίδωμι
[in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;]
1. to give over, to hand: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mat.7:9, 19, Luk.11:11-12 24:30, 42, Act.15:30; pass. with dative of person(s), Luk.4:17.
2. to give in, give way: absol., Act.27:15.†
(AS)
G1929.strong_def: to give over (by hand or surrender)

G2191.def:
ἔχιδνα, -ης, ἡ
[in OT (Aq.), Isa.59:5 * ;]
a viper: Act.28:3; metaphorically, γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, Mat.3:7 12:34 23:33, Luk.3:7.†
(AS)
G2191.strong_def: an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively)

G3142.strong_def: something evidential, i.e. (genitive case) evidence given or (specially), the Decalogue (in the sacred Tabernacle)
G3142.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G3144 (μάρτυς);

G2588.def:
καρδία, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for לֵבָב ,לֵב ;]
the heart,
1. the bodily organ which is regarded as the seat of life ( 2Ki.18:14, 4Ki.9:24, al.).
2. In a psychological sense, the seat of man's collective energies, the focus of personal life, the seat of the rational as well as the emotional and volitional elements in human life, hence that wherein lies the moral and religious condition of the man (DB, ii, 317f.; DGG, ii, 344a);
(a) of the seat of physical life ( Jdg.19:5, Psa.101 (102):5 103 (104):15): Act.14:17, Jas.5:5;
(b) of the seat of spiritual life: Mat.5:8, Mrk.7:19, Luk.1:51, Act.5:3, Rom.10:9, 10 Eph.6:5, al.; pl., Mat.9:4, Mrk.2:6, al.; opposite to στόμα, χείλεα, πρόσωπον, Mat.15:8, Mrk.7:6, Rom.10:8, 9 2Co.5:12; περιτομὴ καρδίας, Rom.2:29; ἐκ κ., Rom.6:17, 1Pe.1:22; ἀπὸ τῶν κ., Mat.18:35; ἐν ὅλῃ (ἐξ ὅλης), Mat.22:37, Mrk.12:30" (LXX) ; γινώσκειν (ἐρευνᾶν, δοκιμάζειν) τὰς κ., Luk.16:15, Rom.8:27, 1Th.2:4; to think, etc., ἐν τ. κ., Mat.9:4, Mrk.2:6, Luk.12:45, Rom.10:6; συνιέναι (νοεῖν) τῇ κ., Mat.13:15, Jhn.12:40; ἐπαχύνθη ἡ κ., Mat.13:15 (LXX); πωροῦν τὴν κ., Jhn.12:40; κ. εὐθεῖα, Act.8:21; πονηρά, Heb.3:12; ἀμετανόητος, Rom.2:5; εἶναι (ἔχειν) ἐν τῇ κ., 2Co.7:3, Php.1:7; ὀδύνη τῇ κ., Rom.9:2.
3. Of the central or innermost part of anything (of the pith of wood, Arist.): τ. γῆς, Mat.12:40 (Cremer, 343ff.).
(AS)
G2588.strong_def: the heart, i.e. (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle

G4614.strong_def: Sina (i.e. Sinai), a mountain in Arabia

G2020.def:
ἐπι-φώσκω
[in LXX for הָלַל hi., Job.41:18 A (Βא, ἐπιφαύσκ-) * ;]
1. to let shine.
2. to dawn (cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Luk.23:54; before εἰς, Mat_28:1.†
(AS)

G4018.strong_def: something thrown around one, i.e. a mantle, veil
G4018.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4016 (περιβάλλω);

G5559.strong_def: the body (properly, its surface or skin)
G5559.derivation: probably akin to the base of G5530 (χράομαι) through the idea of handling;

G0082.def:
ἄ-δηλος, -ον
(δῆλος), [in LXX: Ps 50 (51):6 (בַּטֻחוֹת) ;]
1. unseen, unobserved, not manifest (Ps, l.with): Luk.11:44.
2. uncertain, indistinct: 1Co.14:8.
† (AS)
G0082.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1212 (δῆλος);

G1735.def:
έν-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Psa.119:122 (עָרַב), 2Ma.11:18 * ;]
1. to admit, approve.
2. to be possible; impers., ἑνδέχεται, it is possible: with accusative and inf., Luk.13:33 (Cremer, 687).†
(AS)
G1735.strong_def: (impersonally) it is accepted in, i.e. admitted (possible)
G1735.derivation: third person singular present of a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G1209 (δέχομαι);

G1232.def:
δια-γνωρίζω
to publish abroad:
Luk.2:17, Rec. (ἐγνώρισεν, Edd.).†
(AS)

G1586.def:
ἐκ-λέγω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;]
to pick out, choose. In NT always mid. (exc. Luk.9:35, ἐκλελεγμένος, WH, ἀγαπητός, R, mg.), to pick out for oneself, choose (cf. M, Pr., 157 f.): with accusative of thing(s), Luk.10:42 14:7; with accusative of person(s), Act.6:5 15:22, 25; of Christ (see supr.), Luk.9:35; of Christ's choice of disciples, Luk.6:13, Jhn.6:70 13:18 15:16, 19 Act.1:2; of the Divine choice: of persons, Mrk.13:20, Act.1:24 13:17 15:7, Eph.1:4, Jas.2:5; of things, 1Co.1:27-28 (Cremer, 402, 773).†
(AS)
G1586.derivation: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G3004 (λέγω) (in its primary sense);

G0382.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G705 (ἀριθμέω);

G5451.strong_def: trans-planting, i.e. (concretely) a shrub or vegetable

G3901.strong_def: to flow by, i.e. (figuratively) carelessly pass (miss)
G3901.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the alternate of G4482 (ῥέω);

G1474.def:
ἐδαφίζω (ἔδαφος)
[in LXX chiefly for רטשׁ pu. ;]
1. to beat level like a threshing floor (Theophr.).
2. to dash to the ground (Field, Notes, 74): Luk.19:44 (cf. Psa.136(137):9, Hos.14:1).
† (AS)

G5623.strong_def: to be useful, i.e. to benefit

G1184.def:
δεκτός, -ή, -όν
verbal adj. of δέχομαι, [in LXX chiefly for רָצוֹן: Pro.11:1, al. ;]
acceptable: Luk.4:19 (LXX) 24, Act.10:35, 2Co.6:2" (LXX), Php.4:18 (cf. εὐπροσδ-).†
(AS)

G2183.def:
ἐφ-ημερία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐφήμερος), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת, מַחֲלֹקֶת ;]
1. a course of daily services (Neh.13:30, 1Ch.25:8, al.).
2. a class or course of priests detailed for service in the temple (1Ch.23:6, al.): Luk.1:5, 8 (cf. MGr., ἐφημέριος, priest).†
(AS)
G2183.strong_def: diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families

G3494.strong_def: a youth (up to about forty years)

G0050.def:
ἀγνοέω, -ῶ (> ἁγνίζω),
[in LXX for שָׁגָה, שָׁגַג, אָשַׁם, etc. ;]
1. to be ignorant, not to know: absol., Ι Ti 1:13, Heb.5:2; with accusative, Act.13:27 17:23, Rom.10:3, 2Co.2:11; ἐν οἷς, 2Pe.2:12; before ὅτι, Rom.2:4 6:3 7:1, 1Co.14:38; οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, a Pauline phrase: with accusative, Rom.11:25; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.1:8; περί, 1Co.12:1, 1Th.4:13. ὅτι, Rom.1:13, 1Co.10:1 (for similar usage in π., V. MM, VGT, see word). Pass.: 1Co.14:38, 2Co.6:9, Gal.1:22.
2. not to understand: with accusative, Mrk.9:32, Luk.9:45.
† (AS)
G0050.strong_def: not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination)
G0050.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3539 (νοιέω);

G0288.def:
ἄμπελος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX for גֶּפֶן ;]
vine: Mat.26:29, Mrk.14:25, Luk.22:18 Jas.3:12; figuratively, of Christ, Jhn.15:1, 4-5; of his enemies (on the usage here, see MM, VGT, see word): Rev.14:18-19.†
(AS)
G0288.strong_def: a vine (as coiling about a support)
G0288.derivation: probably from the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and that of G257 (ἅλων);

G2891.def:
κούμ (Tr., txt., κοῦμ, Rec. κοῦμι) (Heb. imperat. masc., used as an interjection, קוּם),
koum (arise): Mrk.5:41.†
(AS)

G1559.def:
ἐκ-διώκω
[in LXX for בָּרַח hi., צָמַת, הָדַף, etc. ;]
to chase away, drive out: 1Th.2:15 (cf. Deu.6:19, Jol.2:20).†
(AS)
G1559.strong_def: to pursue out, i.e. expel or persecute implacably

G1545.def:
ἔκ-βασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐκβαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.2:17 8:8 11:14 * ;]
1. a way out (Hom., Xen.): 1Co.10:13.
2. the issue (Menand.) Heb.13:7.†
(AS)
G1545.derivation: from a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G939 (βάσις) (meaning to go out);

G1564.def:
ἐκεῖθεν
adv., [in LXX chiefly for שָׁם ;]
1. of place, thence: Mat.4:21, Mrk.6:1, al.
2. Of time, thereafter (see: κἀκεῖθεν).
(AS)

G4543.strong_def: Samo-thrace (Samos of Thrace), an island in the Mediterranean

G1529.def:
εἴσ-οδος, -ου, ὁ
(ὁδός) [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
1. a means of entering, place of entrance: Heb.10:19, 2Pe.1:11 (cf. Westc., He., l.with; MM, Exp., xii; but see infr.).
2. a going in, entrance: Act.13:24; with genitive loc., Heb.10:19 (Thayer, see word; but see supr.); before εἰς, 2Pe.1:11 (Mayor, in l.; Thayer; but see supr.); πρός, 2Th.1:9 2:1.†
(AS)

G0251.def:
ἅλς, ἁλός, ὁ
variant for ἅλας (which see): Mrk.9:49, Rec. WH, mg., R, mg.†
(AS)

G1313.def:
διά-φορος, -ον
(διαφέρω), [in LXX for שְׁנָא (Dan.7:7, 19); also as in Polyb., iv, 188, al., Τὸ δ., τὰ δ., money: Sir.27:1 42:5, 2Ma.3:6 ;]
1. different: Rom.12:6, Heb.9:10.
2. excellent: compar., -ώτερος, Heb.1:4 8:6.†
(AS)

G3525.strong_def: to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e. (figuratively) be discreet

G5266.strong_def: something bound under the feet, i.e. a shoe or sandal

G3550.derivation: from G3551 (νόμος) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G1032.def:
βρύω, poët., late prose and vernac.,
to be full to bursting;
1. of the earth producing vegetation.
2. Of plants putting forth buds.
3. Of springs, to gush with water: Jas.3:11.
† (AS)
G1032.strong_def: to swell out, i.e. (by implication) to gush

G0037.def:
ἁγιάζω, Hellenistic form of ἁγίζω
(ἅγιος),
to make holy, consecrate, sanctify; [in LXX chiefly for קדשׁ pi., hi. ;]
1. to dedicate, separate, set apart for God; of things: Mat.23:17,19, 2Ti.2:21; of persons: Christ, Jhn.10:36, 17:19.
2. to purify, make conformable in character to such dedication: forensically, to free from guilt, 1Co.6:11, Eph.5:26, Heb.2:11, 10:10, 14, 29, 13:12; internally, by actual sanctification of life, Jhn.17:17, 19, Act.20:32, 26:18, Rom.15:16, 1Co.1:2, 7:14, 1Th.5:23, Rev.22:11; of a nonbeliever influenced by marriage with a Christian, 1Co.7:14.
3. In the intermediate sense of ceremonial or levitical purification:
(a) of things, 2Ti.2:21;
(b) of persons, Heb.9:13.
4. to treat as holy: Mat.6:9, Luk.11:2, 1Pe.3:16 (Cremer, 53, 602; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0037.strong_def: to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate

G2570.def:
καλός, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹבָה ,טוֹב, also for יָפֶה, etc. ;]
1. primarily, of outward form ("related to . . . ἀγαθός as the appearance to the essence," Cremer, 339), fair, beautiful: λίθοι (BV, goodly), Luk.21:5.
2. In reference to use, of that which is well adapted to its ends, good, excellent: of fish, τ. καλά (opposite to σαπρά), Mat.13:48; σπέρμα, Mat.13:24, 27, 37, 38; καρπός, Mat.3:10 7:17-19 12:33, Luk.3:9 [WH] 6:43; δένδρον (opposite to σαρπόν), Mat.12:33, Luk.6:43; γῆ, Mat.13:8, 23 Mrk.4:8, 20 Luk.8:15; τ. ἅλας, Mrk.9:50, Luk.14:34; ὁ νόμος, Rom.7:16, 1Ti.1:8; διδασκαλία, 1Ti.4:6; καρδία κ. καὶ ἀγαθή, Luk.8:15; παραθήκη, 2Ti.1:14; μέτρον, Luk.6:38; βαθμός, 1Ti.3:13; θεμέλιος, 1Ti.6:19; τὸ κ., 1Th.5:21; μαργαρίται, Mat.13:45; οἶνος, Jhn.2:10; ποιμήν, Jhn.10:11, 14; διάκονος, 1Ti.4:6; οἰκονόμος, 1Pe.4:10; στρατιώτης, 2Ti.2:3; στρατεία, 1Ti.1:18; ἀγών, 1Ti.6:12, 2Ti.4:7; ὁμολογία, 1Ti.6:12, 13; ἔργον, Mat.26:10, Mrk.14:6, Jhn.10:33, 1Ti.3:1; pl., Jhn.10:32; καλόν, with inf. and dative, Mat.18:8, 9 1Co.7:1, 26 9:15; id. with accusative and inf., Mat.17:4, Mrk.9:5, 43, 45, 47, Luk.9:33, Heb.13:9; before εἰ, Mat.26:24, Mrk.9:42 14:21; ἐάν, 1Co.7:8.
3. Ethically, good, in the sense of right, fair, noble, honourable: Gal.4:18, Heb.5:14; ἔργα, Mat.5:16, 1Ti.5:10, 25 6:18, Tit.2:7, 14 3:8, 14 (Field, Notes, 223f.), Heb.10:24, 1Pe.2:12; ἀναστροφή, Jas.3:13, 1Pe.2:12; συνείδησις, Heb.13:18; before ἐνώπιον, Rom.12:17, 2Co.8:21, 1Ti.2:3; το] κ. ποιεῖν (κατεργάζεσθαι), Rom.7:18, 21 2Co.13:7, Gal.6:9, Jas.4:17; καλόν ἐστιν, with inf., Mat.15:26 (T, ἔξεστιν), Mrk.7:27, Rom.14:21, Gal.4:18; μαρτυρία, 1Ti.3:7; ὄνομα, Jas.2:7; καύχημα, 1Co.5:6 (neg.); θεοῦ ῥῆμα, Heb.6:5. κ. does not occur in Re.†
SYN.: see: ἀγαθός. (AS)
G2570.derivation: of uncertain affinity; properly, beautiful, but chiefly (figuratively) good (literally or morally), i.e. valuable or virtuous (for appearance or use, and thus distinguished from G18 (ἀγαθός), which is properly intrinsic)

G1252.def:
δια-κρίνω
[in LXX for שׁפט, דִּין, etc. ;]
1. to separate, hence, to distinguish, discriminate, discern: μηδὲν δ., Act.11:12; οὐδὲν δ. μεταξύ, Act.15:9; σε, 1Co.4:7; τὸ σῶμα, 1Co.11:29.
2. to settle, decide, judge, arbitrate: Mat.16:3, 1Co.6:5 11:29 (ICC, in l.), ib. 31 14:29. Mid, and pass.;
1. to get a decision, contend, dispute: before πρός, Act.11:2; with dative (but see ICC, in l.), Ju 9; absol., Ju 22 (R,mg.).
2. Hellenistic (NT and Eccl., but not LXX), to be divided in one's mind, to hesitate, doubt: Mat.21:21 Rom.14:23, Jas.1:6; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, Jas.2:4; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Mrk.11:23; μηδὲν δ., Act.10:20; δ. τ. ἀπιστίᾳ, Rom.4:20, Ju 22 (R, txt.).†
(AS)
G1252.strong_def: to separate thoroughly, i.e. (literally and reflexively) to withdraw from, or (by implication) oppose; figuratively, to discriminate (by implication, decide), or (reflexively) hesitate

G2745.def:
καύχημα, -τος, τό
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּהִלָּה, תִּפְאָרָה ;]
1. a boast (Pind.): 2Co.5:12 9:3 (Thayer, see word; e. contra, 2, Ellic., Lft., on Gal.6:4; Lft., Notes, 204, 277).
2. ground or matter of glorying: Rom.4:2, 1Co.5:6 9:15-16, 2Co.1:14, Gal.6:4, Php.1:26 2:16, Heb.3:6 (cf. καύχησις).†
(AS)
G2745.strong_def: a boast (properly, the object; by implication, the act) in a good or a bad sense

G0592.def:
ἀπο-δι-ορίζω
(διορίζω, ἅρος, a limit),
to mark off, hence metaphorically to make separations: Ju 19 (Cremer, 806).†
(AS)
G0592.strong_def: to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party)
G0592.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and a compound of G223 (Ἀλέξανδρος) and G3724 (ὁρίζω);

G4197.strong_def: travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. career

G1405.def:
δράσσομαι
[in LXX for נָשַׁק pi., Psa.2:12; elsewhere קָמַץ, as Lev.2:2 ;]
to grasp with the hand, to lay hold of: metaphorically, with accusative (M, Pr., 65), 1Co.3:19 (LXX).†
(AS)
G1405.derivation: perhaps akin to the base of G1404 (δράκων) (through the idea of capturing);

G0339.def:
ἀνα-καθ-ίζω
(see: καθίζω);
1. trans., to set up.
2. Intrans., to sit up: Luk.7:15 (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), Act.9:40 (frequently in medical writings: MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0339.strong_def: properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up

G1997.def:
ἐπι-συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπισυνάγω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:7 * ;]
a gathering together, assembly: Heb.10:25; before ἐπί, 2Th.2:1 (cf. 2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)
G1997.strong_def: a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship)

G2495.def:
Ἰωνᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Heb. יוֹנָה),
Jonah, the prophet: Mat.12:39-41 16:4, Luk.11:29-30, 32.†
(AS)
G2495.strong_def: Jonas (i.e. Jonah), the name of two Israelites

G4673.strong_def: a funereal receptacle (urn, coffin), i.e. (by analogy) a bier
G4673.derivation: probably akin to the base of G4987 (σωρεύω);

G1500.def:
εἰκῇ (-ῆ, Rec., as in cl.), adv.,
[in LXX: Pro.28:25 (εἰκῇ)* ;]
1. without cause or reason: Mat.5:22 (E, mg.), Col.2:18 (ICC).
2. vainly, fruitlessly, to no purpose: Rom.13:4, 1Co.15:2, Gal.3:4 4:11, Col.2:18.
† (AS)
G1500.derivation: probably from G1502 (εἴκω) (through the idea of failure);

G2133.def:
εὔνοια, -ας, ἡ
(εὔνοος), [in LXX: Est.2:23, al. ;]
goodwill: Eph.6:7 (of slaves; cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G3857.strong_def: a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise")

G2118.def:
εὐθύτης, -ητος, ἡ
(εὐθύς), [in LXX chiefly for יֹשֶׁר, מִישׁוֹר and cognate forms ;]
uprightness: Heb.1:8 (LXX).†
(AS)

G3151.strong_def: an idle (i.e. senseless or mischievous) talker, i.e. a wrangler

G2237.def:
ἡδονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἥδομαι, to be glad) [in LXX: Num.11:8 (טַעַם), Pro.17:1, Wis.7:2 16:20, and frequently in 4Mac ;]
pleasure: 2Pe.2:13; pl., Luk.8:14, Tit.3:3, Jas.4:1, †
(AS)

G0914.def:
Βαραχίας, -ου, ὁ (Heb. בֶּרֶכְיָה),
Barachiah: Mat.23:35, see: Ζαχαρίας.†
(AS)

G4691.strong_def: a seed-picker (as the crow), i.e. (figuratively) a sponger, loafer (specially, a gossip or trifler in talk)

G2352.def:
θραύω
[in LXX for 1,21 (Deu.28:33, Isa.42:4 58:6), etc. ;]
to break in pieces, shatter; metaphorically, to break down: Luk.4:18 (LXX).†
(AS)

G0364.def:
ἀνάμνησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναμιμνήσκω), [in LXX: Psa.38:1-22 70:1-5 title. (זָכַר hi.), Lev.24:7 (אַזְכָּרָה), Num.10:10 (זִכְרוֹן), Wis.16:6 * ;]
remembrance: εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀ., Luk.22:19 (WH om.), 1Co.11:24-25; ἀ. ἁμαρτιῶν, Heb.10:3 (see Abbott, Essays, 122 ff.; DCG, ii, 74a).†
SYN.: ὑπόμνησις (see Tr., Syn., § cvii). (AS)

G2115.def:
εὔ-θυμος, -ον
[in LXX: 2Ma.11:26 * ;]
1. kind (Hom.).
2. of good cheer (Æsch., al.): Act.27:36.†
(AS)

G4732.strong_def: to solidify, i.e. confirm (literally or figuratively)

G3030.strong_def: the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself

G4966.strong_def: Sychem (i.e. Shekem), the name of a Canaanite and of a place in Palestine

G0611.def:
ἀποκρίνω, ἀποκρίνομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for ענה ;]
in cl.,
1. to separate, distinguish.
2. to choose.
Mid., to answer: Mat.27:12, Mrk.14:61, Luk.3:16 23:9, Jhn.5:17, 19 Act.3:12. In late Gk. the pass, also is used in this sense, and pass. forms are the more frequently in NT (M, Pr., 39, 161; MM, see word);
(a) in general sense: absol., Mrk.12:34; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.22:46; with dative of person(s), Mat.12:38; before πρός, Act.25:16;
(b) Hebraistically
(i) like ענה, to begin to speak, take up the conversation (Kennedy, Sources, 124f.): Mat.11:25, al.,
(ii) redundant, as in the Heb. phrase וַיַּעַן וַיּאֹמֶר (Dalman, Words, 24f., 38; M, Pr., 14; Bl., §58, 4; 74, 2; Cremer, 374): ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπε, Mat.4:4; ἔφη, 8:8; λέγει, Mrk.3:33; in Jo most frequently (ἀπεκ. κ. εἶπε, 1:49. )
(AS)
G0611.strong_def: to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare H06030) to begin to speak (where an address is expected)

G2029.def:
ἐπ-οπτεύω
[in Sm.: Psa.10:14 33:13 * ;]
to watch (in Hom., as an overseer; cf Ps, ll. with), look upon: 1Pe.2:12 3:2.†
(AS)
G2029.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

G5120.strong_def: sometimes used for G5127 (τούτου); of this person
G5120.derivation: properly, the genitive case of G3588 (ὁ);

G4010.strong_def: fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor

G4948.strong_def: a Syran (i.e. probably Tyrian), a native of Syria

G1205.def:
δεῦτε
adv., as pl. of δεῦρο, 1. (b), which see, [in LXX chiefly for לְכוּ ;]
come on! come here! come!: with imperat., Mat.25:34 28:6, Jhn.4:29 21:12, Rev.19:17; with subjc., Mat.21:38, Mrk.12:7; before ὀπίσω, Mat.4:19, Mrk.1:17; πρός, Mat.11:28; εἰς, Mat.22:4, Mrk.6:31.†
(AS)
G1205.derivation: from G1204 (δεῦρο) and an imperative form of (to go);

G4729.strong_def: to hem in closely, i.e. (figuratively) cramp

G2461.def:
ἱππικός, -ή, -όν
(ἵππος), [in LXX: 1Ma.15:33, 3Ma.1:1 * ;]
of a horse or of horsemen, equestrian; as subst., τὸ ἱ (sc. στράτευμα), cavalry: Heb.9:16.†
(AS)
G2461.derivation: neuter of a derivative of G2462 (ἵππος);

G0575.strong_def: "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative)

G0907.strong_def: to immerse, submerge; to make whelmed (i.e. fully wet); used only (in the New Testament) of ceremonial ablution, especially (technically) of the ordinance of Christian baptism

G1569.def:
ἔκ-θαμβος, -ον
(θάμβος), [in LXX: Wis.10:19, Da TH Dan.7:7 (dreadful, terrible: אֵמְתָּנִי) * ;]
amazed (cf. Polyb., xx, 10, 9): Act.3:11.†
(AS)

G3475.strong_def: Moseus, Moses, or Mouses (i.e. Mosheh), the Hebrew lawgiver

G4487.strong_def: an utterance (individually, collectively or specially),; by implication, a matter or topic (especially of narration, command or dispute); with a negative naught whatever

G3143.strong_def: to be adduced as a witness, i.e. (figuratively) to obtest (in affirmation or exhortation)

G0356.def:
ἀναλογία, -ας, ἡ
(λόγος), [in Al.: Lev.27:1-34"18 * ;]
proportion (MM, VGT, see word): Rom.12:6 (cf. Cremer, 397).†
(AS)
G0356.derivation: from a compound of G303 (ἀνά) and G3056 (λόγος);

G1075.def:
γενεαλογέω, -ῶ
(γενεά, λέγω), [in LXX: 1Ch.5:1 (יחשׁ)* ;]
to trace ancestry, reckon genealogy; pass., before ἐκ: Heb.7:6.†
(AS)
G1075.strong_def: to reckon by generations, i.e. trace in genealogy

G1760.def:
ἐνθυμέομαι, -οῦμαι
(θυμός), [in LXX for דָּמָה pi., etc. ;]
to reflect on, ponder: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.1:20 9:4.†
(AS)
G1760.derivation: from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G2372 (θυμός);

G3020.strong_def: Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites

G3078.strong_def: grief-dispelling; Lysanias, a governor of Abilene

G3903.strong_def: to furnish aside, i.e. get ready
G3903.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and a derivative of G4632 (σκεῦος);

G2851.def:
κόλασις, -εως, ἡ
(κολάζω), [in LXX: Eze.14:3-7 18:30 44:12, (מִכְשׁוֹל) Eze.43:11, λαμβάνειν τὴν κ. (כָּלַם ni.); Wis.11:13 16:2, 24 19:4, Jer.18:20, 2-4 Mac.5 * ;]
correction, penalty, punishment: Mat.25:46, 1Jn.4:18.†
SYN.: τιμωρία, requital. Arist. distinguishes between κ . as that which, being disciplinary, has reference to the sufferer, and τ. as that which, being penal, has reference to the satisfaction of him who inflicts (see Thayer, see word κ., and cf. Tr., Syn., § vii). But in late Gk. especially, the distinction is not always maintained (see reff. in Thayer) (AS)

G1607.def:
ἐκ-πορεύω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;]
to make to go out; pass. and mid., to go forth: Luk.3:7, Act.25:4; of demons leaving one possessed, Mat.17:21 (WH om.), Act.19:12; of excrement, Mk 719; before ἀπό, Mat.20:29, Mrk.10:46; ἐκ, Mrk.13:1 (of the dead rising, Jhn.5:29); ἐκεῖθεν, Mrk.6:11; ἔξω, Mrk.11:19; είς, Mrk.10:17, Jhn.5:29; ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Rev.16:14; πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mat.3:5, Mrk.1:5; εἰσπορ- (which see) καὶ ἐ., Act.9:28; metaphorically, to come forth, proceed: of feelings, etc., Mrk.7:23; before ἐκ, Mat.15:11, 18 Mrk.7:15, 20-21, Luk.4:22, Eph.4:29; ῥῆμα, before διά, Mat.4:4 (LXX); of lightning and flame, Rev.4:5 9:17-18 11:5; a river, Rev.22:1; a sword, Rev.1:16 19:15; a rumour, before εἰς, Luk.4:37; of the Holy Spirit, before παρά, Jhn.15:26.†
(AS)
G1607.strong_def: to depart, be discharged, proceed, project

G5287.strong_def: a setting under (support), i.e. (figuratively) concretely, essence, or abstractly, assurance (objectively or subjectively)
G5287.derivation: from a compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and G2476 (ἵστημι);

G1740.def:
ἐν-δοξάζω
[in LXX for כָּבַד ni., Exo.14:4, 17-18, Eze.28:22, etc.; for עָרַץ, Psa.89:7; Sir.38:6, al. ;]
to glorify: pass., 2Th.1:10-12.†
(AS)

G1599.def:
ἐκ-πέμπω
[in LXX for שָׁלַח ;]
to send forth: Act.13:4 17:10.†
(AS)

G3375.strong_def: a particle of affirmation (only with G2229 (ἦ)); assuredly

G3563.strong_def: the intellect, i.e. mind (divine or human; in thought, feeling, or will); by implication, meaning
G3563.derivation: probably from the base of G1097 (γινώσκω);

G3461.strong_def: a ten-thousand; by extension, a "myriad" or indefinite number

G1673.def:
Ἑλληνικκός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: Jer.46:6 50:16 (יָנָה: aliter in Heb.), 2Ma.4:10 2Mac 4:15 2Mac 6:9 2Mac 11:24 2Mac 13:2, 4Ma.8:8 * ;]
Greek: τ. Ἑλληνικῇ (sc. γλωσσῇ), Rev.9:11.†
(AS)

G2096.def:
Εὔα (WH, Εὔα, § 408; Rec. Εὖα; S (in I Ti), Εὖα), -ας, ἡ (Heb. חַוָּה, Gen.3:20),
Eve, wife of Adam: 2Co.11:3, 1Ti.2:13.†
(AS)
G2096.strong_def: Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman

G3071.strong_def: Lycaonia, a region of Asia Minor

G1720.def:
ἐμ-φυσάω, -ῶ
(φυσάω, to blow), [in LXX for נָפַח, etc. ;]
to breathe into (cf. Gen.2:7, Wis.15:11, a1.), breathe upon: Jhn.20:22.†
(AS)

G5272.strong_def: acting under a feigned part, i.e. (figuratively) deceit ("hypocrisy")

G0707.def:
Ἁριμαθεία
(WH, Ἁρ.), -ας, ἡ [in LXX: Ἁριμαθάιμ, 1Ki.1:1, al. (רָמָה) ;]
Arimathæa: Mat.27:57, Mrk.15:43, Luk.23:51, Jhn.19:38.†
(AS)
G0707.strong_def: Arimathæa (or Ramah), a place in Palestine

G2535.def:
Καίν
(Τ, Κάϊν), ὁ,
indecl.
(in FlJ, Κάϊς, -ιος), (Heb. קַיִן; Gen.4:1),
Cain: Heb.11:4, 1Jn.3:12, Ju 11.†
(AS)
G2535.strong_def: Cain, (i.e. Cajin), the son of Adam

G2065.def:
ἐρωτάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל ;]
1. to ask, question (cl.): absol., Luk.19:31 22:68, Jhn.8:7 with accusative of person(s), Jhn.9:21 16:19, 30 8:21; before λέγων, Mat.16:13, Luk.23:3, Jhn.1:19, 21 5:12 9:19 16:5; with dupl. accusative (WM, § 32, 4a), Mat.21:24, Mrk.4:10, Luk.20:3, Jhn.16:23 (M, Pr., 66„); with accusative of person(s), before περί, Luk.9:45, Jhn.18:19.
2. In late Gk. (Milligan, NTD, 51; not, as Cremer, 716, Thayer, see word, a "Hebraism"), = αἰτέω (which see), to ask, request: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.14:16; before imperat., Luk.14:18-19 Php.4:3; λέγων, Mat.15:23, Jhn.12:21; before ἵνα (M, Pr., 208), Mrk.7:26, Luk.7:36 16:27, Jhn.4:47 17:15 19:31, 38, 1Th.4:1, 2Jn.5; ὅπως, Luk.7:3 11:37, Act.23:20; with inf., Luk.5:3 8:37, Jhn.4:40, Act.3:3 10:48 23:18, 1Th.5:12; with accusative of person(s), before περί, Luk.4:38 Jhn.17:9, 20, 1Jn.5:16; ὑπέρ, 2Th.2:1-2; τὰ (WH, txt., om. τὰ) πρὸς εἰρήνην, Luk.14:32 (cf. δι-, ἐπ-ερωτάω)
SYN.: see: αἰτέω (AS)
G2065.strong_def: to interrogate; by implication, to request

G4282.strong_def: to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively)

G0394.def:
ἀνα-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for חָרַם (Cremer, 546) ;]
to lay upon, set up, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; see also MM, VGT, see word), to set forth, declare: Act.25:14, Gal.2:2.†
(AS)
G0394.strong_def: to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound
G0394.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and the middle voice of G5087 (τίθημι);

G4789.strong_def: a co-heir, i.e. (by analogy) participant in common

G1393.def:
Δορκάς, -άδος, ἡ
(δορκάς, a gazelle),
Dorcas, also called Ταβειθά, which see: Act.9:36, 39.†
(AS)

G1137.def:
γωνία, -ας, ἡ
(γόνυ), [in LXX chiefly for פִּנָּה ;]
an angle, a corner: Mat.6:5, Act.26:26; τ. τέσσαρας γ. τ. γῆς, Rev.7:1, 20:8; κεφαλὴ γνωνίας (רֹאשׁ פִּנָּה, Ps 117(118):22, LXX), Mat.21:42, Mrk.12:10, Luk.20:17, Act.4:11, 1Pe.2:7.†
(AS)

G2375.def:
θυρεός, -οῦ, ὁ
(θύρα), [in LXX for מָגֵן, צִנָּה ;]
1. in Hom., a door-stone.
2. In late Gk. (Polyb., Plut.), the scutum, a large oblong shield: θ. τ. πίστεως, Eph.6:16 (cf. Wis.5:20, where ὁσιότης is likened to the ἀσπίς, the clypeus or small round shield of the light-armed soldier).†
(AS)

G2982.derivation: of Hebrew origin (H04100 with prepositional prefix);

G2041.def:
ἔργον, -ου, τό (originally Ϝέργον, work), [very frequently in LXX, chiefly for מַשֶׂה, מְלָאכָה, also for עֲבֹדָה, פֹּעַל, etc. ;]
1. work, task, employment: Mrk.13:34, Jhn.4:34 17:4, Act.13:2, Php.1:22 2:30, 1Th.5:13, al.; of an enterprise or undertaking (Deu.15:10, Wis.2:12), Act.5:38.
2. a deed, action: Tit.1:16, Jas.1:25 . listing, from λόγος, Luk.24:19, Rom.15:18, 2Th.2:17, 1Jn.3:18; ἐν λόγοις κ. ἔ., Act.7:22; of acts of God, Jhn.9:3, Act.13:41" (LXX), Heb.4:10, Rev.15:3; of Christ, Mat.11:2; esp. in Jo, e.g. 5:20, 36 7:3 10:38 14:11, 12 15:24; in ethical sense, of human actions (AR, Eph., 190), bad or good, Mat.23:3, Luk.11:48, Jhn.3:20, 21 Jas.2:14ff. 3:13, Rev.2:5 3:8; τὸ ἔ., collectively, Gal.6:4, Jas.1:4, 1Pe.1:17, Rev.22:12; τὸ ἔ. τ. νόμου, Rom.2:15; ἔ. ἀγαθόν, Rom.2:7, Col.1:10, 2Th.2:17, Tit.1:16, al.; καλόν, Mat.26:10, Mrk.14:6; pl. (as frequently in cl.), Mat.5:16, 1Ti.5:10, 25 Heb.10:24; ἔ. πίστεως, 1Th.1:3, 2Th.1:11; ἔ. πονηρά, Col.1:21, 2Jo.11; νέκρα, Heb.6:1 9:14; ἄκαρπα, Eph.5:11; ἔ. ἀσεβείας, Ju 15; τ. σκότους, Rom.13:12, Eph.5:11; ἔ. νόμου, Rom.3:20, 28 Gal.2:16 3:2, 5 10.
3. that which is wrought or made, a work: 1Co.3:13-15; τ. χειρῶν, Act.7:41; of the works of God, Heb.1:10; γῆ κ. τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔ., 2Pe.3:10; τὸ ἔ. τ. θεοῦ, Rom.14:20.
(AS)
G2041.strong_def: toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act

G2925.def:
Κρούω
[in LXX: before ἐπί Jdg.19:22, Sng.5:2 (דָּפַק) ;]
with, accusative, τ. αὐλαίαν, Jdth.14:14 * ;]
to strike, knock: at a door (Κόπτειν, in Att..), Mat.7:7-8, Luk.11:9-10 12:36, Act.12:16, Rev.3:20; with accusative, τ. θύραν, Luk.13:25, Act.12:13.†
(AS)

G1164.def:
δεῖγμα, -τος, τό
(δείκνυμι);
1. (cl.) a thing shown, a specimen.
2. = cl. παράδ- (cf. ὑπόδ-, 2Pe.2:6), an example (a warning): Ju 7.†
(AS)

G2469.def:
ἰσκαριώθ, ὁ indecl.
(Mrk.3:19 14:10, Luk.6:16, elsewhere -ιώτης; V. infr.) and Ἰσκαριώτης, -ου (Heb. prob. קִרְיָא אִישׁ; see Swete, Mk., 319),
Iscariot: surname of Judas, ll. with supr., also Mat.10:4 26:14, Mrk.14:43 (WH, R, omit), Luk.22:3, Jhn.12:4 13:2 14:22; of his father Simon, Jhn.6:71 13:26.†
(AS)
G2469.strong_def: inhabitant of Kerioth; Iscariotes (i.e. Keriothite), an epithet of Judas the traitor
G2469.derivation: of Hebrew origin (probably H0377 and H07149);

G2806.def:
κλάω
[in LXX: Jer.16:7 (פַּרְנַךְ), al. ;]
to break, break in pieces: of bread, Mat.14:19 15:36 26:26, Mrk.8:6 14:22, Luk.22:19 24:30, Act.2:46 20:7, 11 27:35, 1Co.10:16 11:24; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), Mrk.8:19 (cf. ἐκ-, κατα-κλάω).†
(AS)

G4152.strong_def: non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (dæmoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious

G5421.strong_def: a hole in the ground (dug for obtaining or holding water or other purposes), i.e. a cistern or well; figuratively, an abyss (as a prison)

G5126.strong_def: this (person, as objective of verb or preposition)
G5126.derivation: accusative case singular masculine of G3778 (οὗτος);

G1373.def:
δίψος, -εος (-ους), τό
(late form of δίψα), [in LXX chiefly for and cognates ;]
thirst: 2Co.11:27.†
(AS)

G4452.strong_def: an enclitic particle of indefiniteness; yet, even; used only in the comparative. See G3369 (μηδέπω), G3380 (μήπω), G3764 (οὐδέπω), G3768 (οὔπω), G4455 (πώποτε).
G4452.derivation: another form of the base of G4458 (-πώς);

G2139.def:
εὐ-περί-στατος, -ον
(εὖ, περιΐστημι),
of sins, readily besetting: Heb.12:1 (on form and sense of the word, see Westc., in l).†
(AS)
G2139.strong_def: well standing around, i.e. (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case)
G2139.derivation: from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of a presumed compound of G4012 (περί) and G2476 (ἵστημι);

G2668.def:
κατα-πλέω, -ῶ
to sail down, sail to land, put in: εἰς τ. χώραν, Luk.8:26.†
(AS)
G2668.strong_def: to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land at

G1639.def:
Ἐλαμείτης (Rec. -αμίτης), -ου, ὁ
(Heb. אֵילָם) [in LXX (cl.) Ἐλυμαίος, Ἔλαμος: Jdth.1:6; Ἀιλαμείτης (vv.ll. Ἐλ-, -αμίτης; Bl., § 3, 7): Isa.11:11 21:2 22:6) ;]
an Elamite: Act.2:9.†
(AS)

G3621.strong_def: to manage (a house, i.e. an estate)

G0144.def:
αἴσθησις, -εως, ἡ
(αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX chiefly for דַּעַת ;]
perception (MM, VGT, see word): Php.1:9.†
SYN.: ἐπίγνωσις, which see (cf. Cremer, 620). (AS)

G0787.def:
ἀσσάριον, -ον, τό
(diminutive of Lat. as),
an assarion, a farthing, one-tenth of a drachma: Mat.10:29, Luk.12:6 (MM, see word; DB, iii, 428; DCG, ii, 200).†
(AS)
G0787.strong_def: an assarius or as, a Roman coin

G1155.def:
δανίζω
(late form of cl. -είζω, Rec., Bl., § 3; Thackeray, Gr., 85f.) [in LXX chiefly for לוה (Pro.19:17) ;]
to lend money on interest: Luk.6:34, 35; mid., to borrow: Mat.5:42.†
SYN.: κίχρημι (see: χράω), to lend in a friendly way. (AS)
G1155.strong_def: to loan on interest; reflexively, to borrow

G1959.def:
ἐπι-μελεομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: Gen.44:21 (עַיִן שׂוּם) I Est.6:27, Pro.27:25, Sir.30:25, 1Ma.11:37 * ;]
to take care of: with genitive, Luk.10:34-35, 1Ti.3:5.†
(AS)
G1959.derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and the same as G3199 (μέλω);

G0257.def:
ἅλων, -ωνος
(for Attic ἅλως, -ω, see MM, VGT, see word), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for גֹּרֶן ;]
a threshing floor: Mat.3:12, Luk.3:17 (here prob. by meton. = the grain on the threshing floor).†
(AS)
G0257.strong_def: a threshing-floor (as rolled hard), i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed)
G0257.derivation: probably from the base of G1507 (εἱλίσσω);

G2536.def:
Καινάμ (T, Καϊ-; Rec. Καϊνάν), ό, indecl. (Heb. קֵינָן),
Cainam, Cainan;
1. son of Enos (Gen.5:9): Luk.3:37.
2. Son of Arphaxad (Gen.10:24 (LXX): Luk.3:36.†
(AS)
G2536.strong_def: Cainan (i.e. Kenan), the name of two patriarchs

G0585.def:
ἀπό-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποδείκνυμι) [in LXX: 3Ma.4:20, 4Ma.3:19 4Mac 13:10 * ;]
1. a showing off.
2. As used by Gk. philosophers, demonstration, certain proof: 1Co.2:4 (see ICC, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes, 173).†
(AS)

G0728.def:
ἀρραβών
(T, ἀραβ-: 2Co, ll. with), -ώνος, ὁ, [in LXX: Gen.38:17-20 (עֲרָבוֹן)* ;]
an earnest, part payment in advance for security, a first instalment: 2Co.1:22 5:5, Eph.1:14. (The word is found in cl. and was prob. brought to Greece by the Phænicians (AR, Eph., l.with). It is found in π. with both spellings (see Milligan, NTD, 73). In MGr. ἀρραβῶνα is an engagement ring; see MM, see word)†
(AS)
G0728.strong_def: a pledge, i.e. part of the purchase-money or property given in advance as security for the rest

G4598.derivation: from G4597 (σής) and a derivative of G977 (βιβρώσκω);

G4024.strong_def: to gird all around, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to fasten on one's belt (literally or figuratively)

G0260.def:
ἅμα
adv.,
at once (Lat. simul): Act.24:26 27:40, Rom.3:12 (one and all = יַחַד, Psa.14:3), Col.4:3, 1Ti.5:13, Phm 22; before σύν, 1Th.4:17 5:10; as prep. with dative, together with: Mat.13:29 (see MM, VGT, see word); also, with adv., ἅ. πρωΐ (cl., ἅ. ἕω, etc.), early in the morning: Mat.20:1.†
(AS)
G0260.strong_def: properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association

G2959.def:
κυρία
(Κυρία, T, WH, mg.), -ας, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for גְּבֶרֶת ;]
a lady: 2Jn.1 Jn 5 (on the interpretation, see ICC, 167 ff.).†
(AS)

G1641.def:
ἐλαττονέω, -ῶ
(ἔλαττον), [in LXX (with -όω) chiefly for חָסֵר ;]
to be less (RV, had no lack): 2Co.8:15 (LXX) (a rare word; cf. MM, Exp., xii).†
(AS)

G2350.def:
θορυβέω, -ῶ
(θόρυβος), [in LXX: Nam.2:3 (רָעַל ho.), Dan LXX 8:17 (בָּעַת ni.), Jdg.3:26, Wis.18:19, Sir.40:6 * ;]
1. to make a noise or uproar: mid., of loud and ostentatious lamentation, Mat.9:23, Mrk.5:39, Act.20:10.
2. Trans., to trouble, throw into confusion: τ. πόλιν, Act.17:5.†
(AS)
G2350.strong_def: to be in tumult, i.e. disturb, clamor

G3623.strong_def: a house-distributor (i.e. manager), or overseer, i.e. an employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the Gospel)
G3623.derivation: from G3624 (οἶκος) and the base of G3551 (νόμος);

G1553.def:
ἐκ-δημέω, -ῶ
(ἔκδημος, from home; cf. -ία, 3Ma.4:11)*;
to be from home, absent: 2Co.5:6; before ἀπό, 2Co.5:8; before ἐκ, 2Co.5:9 (cf. ἀπο-, ἐνδημέω).†
(AS)
G1553.strong_def: to emigrate, i.e. (figuratively) vacate or quit
G1553.derivation: from a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and G1218 (δῆμος);

G2574.def:
κάμηλος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX for גָּמַל ;]
camel: Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6; in proverbs, Mat.19:24 23:24, Mrk.10:25, Luk.18:25 (on the seel. κάμιλος, see WH, Notes, 151).†
κάμιλος, see: κάμηλος, and cf. Thayer; LS, s.v
(AS)

G2647.def:
κατα-λύω
[in LXX for לוּן, שָׁבַת, etc. ;]
1. to destroy, cast down: Mat.24:2, Mrk.13:2, Luk.21:6; τ. ναόν, Mat.26:61 27:40, Mrk.14:58 15:29, Act.6:14; οἰκίαν, 2Co.5:1; opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν, Gal.2:18. Metaphorical, to overthrow, annul, abrogate: Act.5:38-39; τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, Rom.14:20; τ. νόμον, Mat.5:17 (2Ma.2:22).
2. to unloose, unyoke (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), to take up one's quarters, lodge (cl., Gen.19:2, al.): Luk.9:12 19:7.†
(AS)
G2647.strong_def: to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e. (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially (compare G2646 (κατάλυμα)) to halt for the night

G0001.def:
Α, α, ἄλφα (which see), τό, indecl.,
alpha, the first letter of the Greek alphabet. As a numeral, ά = 1, α = 1000. As a prefix, it appears to have at least two and perhaps three distinct senses:
1. ἀ- (before a vowel, ἀν-) negative, as in ἄ-γνωστος, ἄ-δικος.
2. ἀ-, ἁ- copulative, indicating community and fellowship, as in ἁ-πλοῦς, ἀ-κολουθέω, ἀ-δελφός.
3. An intensive force (LS, s. α), as in ἀ-τενίζω is sometimes assumed (but see Boisacq, see word).
(AS)
G0001.strong_def: the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first:

G4722.strong_def: to roof over, i.e. (figuratively) to cover with silence (endure patiently)

G1082.def:
Γεννησαρέτ (Rec. Γενησ-, Mk, l.with; Targ. גְּנֵיסַר),
[in LXX: Γεννησάρ (as in some MSS. Mt, Mk), 1Ma.11:67 * ;]
Gennesaret, a fertile plain on W. shore of the Sea of Galilee; ἡ γῆ, Mat.14:34, Mrk.6:53; ἡ λίμνη (יָם כִּנֶּרֶת, Num.34:11, elsewhere ἡ θάλασσα τ. Γαλιλαίας, Mrk.1:16; ἡ θ. τ. Τιβεριάδος, Jhn.6:1), Luk.5:1.†
(AS)
G1082.strong_def: Gennesaret (i.e. Kinnereth), a lake and plain in Palestine

G5512.strong_def: to throw out the lip, i.e. jeer at
G5512.derivation: from a derivative probably of G5491 (χεῖλος);

G4757.strong_def: a camper-out, i.e. a (common) warrior (literally or figuratively)
G4757.derivation: from a presumed derivative of the same as G4756 (στρατιά);

G2560.def:
κακῶς
(κακός),
adv., [in LXX: Wis.18:19, 4Ma.6:17.al.; κ. εἰπεῖν, ἐρεῖν (אָרַר, קָלַל pi.), Exo.22:28 (27), Lev.19:14, Isa.8:21; κ. ἔχειν (חָלָה, Eze.34:4, al. ;]
badly, ill;
(a) in physical sense: κ. ἔχειν, to be ill, Mat.4:24 8:16 9:12 14:35 17:15, Mrk.1:32, 34 2:17 6:55 5:31 7:2; πάσχειν, Mat.17:15 (WH, mg.); δαιμονίζεσθαι, Mat.15:22; κακοὺς κ. ἀπολέσει (as frequently in cl., see LS, see word; MM, Exp., xv), evil that they are, he will evilly, etc., Mat.21:41;
(b) in moral sense, wrongly (1Ma.7:42, 4Mac, l.with, al.): κ. λαλεῖν, Jhn.18:23; είπεῖν, with accusative of person(s), Act.23:5; αἰτεῖσθαι, Jas.4:8,†
(AS)

G1614.def:
ἐκ-τείνω
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, נָטָה, etc. ;]
to stretch out or forth: τ. χεῖρα (as often in LXX), Mat.8:3 12:13 14:31 26:51, Mrk.1:41 3:5, Luk.5:13 6:10 Jhn.21:18, Act.26:1; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), towards, Mat.12:49; against, Luk.22:53; εἰς ἴασιν, Act.4:30; of anchors, to cast, Act.27:30.†
(AS)

G1236.def:
δι-άγω
[in LXX for עבר hi., etc. ;]
1. to carry over.
2. Of time, to pass: βίον, 1Ti.2:2; absol., to live, before ἐν, Tit.3:3.†
(AS)

G2062.def:
ἑρπετόν, -οῦ, τό
(ἕρπω, to crawl), [in LXX chiefly for רֶמֶשׂ, שֶׁרֶץ ;]
a creeping thing, reptile: Act.10:12 11:6, Rom.1:23, Jas.3:7.†
(AS)
G2062.strong_def: a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare H07431)) a small animal
G2062.derivation: neuter of a derivative of (to creep);

G0552.def:
ἄπειρος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., πεῖρα, trial), [in LXX: Num.14:23, Zec.11:15 (אֱוִלִי) Jer.2:6 (עֲרָבָה) * ;]
without experience of: with genitive of thing(s), Heb.5:13 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0552.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3984 (πεῖρα);

G0804.def:
ἀσφαλής, -ές
(ἀ- neg., σφάλλω, to trip up), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pu., etc. ;]
certain, secure, safe: Act.21:34 22:30 25:26, Php.3:1, Heb.6:19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0804.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail");

G3408.strong_def: pay for service (literally or figuratively), good or bad

G2116.def:
εὐθύνω
(εὐθύς), [in LXX: Num.22:23, Jos.24:23 (נָטָה hi.), Jdg.14:7, 1Ki.18:20 18:26 (יָשַׁר) Pro.20:24, Sir.2:2, 6, al. ;]
1. to direct: Jas.3:4.
2. to make straight: Jhn.1:23 (LXX, ἑτοιμάσατε).†
(AS)

G2095.def:
εὖ
adv. (prop. neuter of old Epic ἐΰς, good, noble) [in LXX, εὖ γίγνεσθαι, εὖ ποιεῖν (יָטַב) ;]
well: εὖ γιν., Eph.6:3 (LXX); εὖ ποιεῖν, with dative (cf. Sir.12:1-2), to do good, Mrk.14:7 (where Nestle suggests εὐποιεῖν, which see); εὖ πράσστειν, to fare well, Act.15:29; in replies (= εὖγε), good! well done! Mat.25:21, 23 Luk.19:17 (εὖγε, WH, txt.).†
εὖ-γε,
adv.,
in replies, well! good! well done!: Luk.19:17 (WH for Rec. εὖ, which see).†
(AS)

G4787.strong_def: to move together, i.e. (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition)

G0388.def:
ἀνα-σταυρόω
1. to impale (Hdt.).
2. to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.).
3. to crucify again: Heb.6:6 (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G0852.def:
ἀφανής, -ές
(φαίνω), [in LXX: Neh.4:8(2), Job.24:20, Sir.20:30 41:14, 2Ma.3:34 * ;]
unseen, hidden: Heb.4:13.†
(AS)
G0852.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5316 (φαίνω);

G2063.def:
ἐρυθρός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for אֱדֹם, Isa.63:2; ἐ. θάλασσα for סוּף -יָם Exo.10:19, al. ;]
red: ἡ ἐ. θάλασσα, the Red Sea, Act.7:36, Heb.11:29.†
(AS)
G2063.derivation: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with G2281 (θάλασσα)) the Red Sea

G1703.def:
ἐμ-παίκτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐμπαίζω, which see), [in LXX: Isa.3:4 (תַּעֲלוּל) * ;]
a mocker: 2Pe.3:3, Ju 18.†
(AS)
G1703.strong_def: a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher

G4500.derivation: adverb from a derivative of (a whir);

G0647.def:
ἀποστάσιον, -ου, τό
(ἀφίστημι), [in LXX; Deu.24:1, 3, Jer.3:8, Isa.50:1 (כְּרִיתוּת) * ;]
1. in cl., only in phrase ἀποστασίου δίκη, an action against a freedman for forsaking his προστάτης (Dem.).
2. In LXX, βιβλίον ἀποστασίου, a bill of divorce: Mat.19:7, Mrk.10:4; in same sense ἀ. alone (MM, see word), Mat.5:31 (for other late exx., see MM, l.with; Kennedy, Sources, 121).†
(AS)
G0647.derivation: neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of G868 (ἀφίστημι);

G5245.strong_def: to vanquish beyond, i.e. gain a decisive victory

G2289.def:
θανατόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת hi., ho., also for הָרַג, etc. ;]
to put to death: with accusative, Mat.10:21 26:59 27:1, Mrk.13:12 14:55, Luk.21:16, 2Co.6:9, 1Pe.3:18; pass., Rom.8:36. Metaphorical: Rom.8:13; pass., with dative, (in relation to), Rom.7:4.†
(AS)
G2289.derivation: from G2288 (θάνατος) to kill (literally or figuratively)

G1371.def:
διχοτομέω, -ῶ
(διχοτόμος, δίχα, τέμνω), [in LXX: Exo.29:17 (נָתַח pi.) ;]
to cut in two, cut asunder: perh. metaphorically of severe scourging (but see Meyer on Mt, l.with, and cf. 1Ki.15:33, 2Ki.12:31, Heb.11:37), Mat.24:51, Luk.12:46.†
(AS)
G1371.strong_def: to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely
G1371.derivation: from a compound of a derivative of G1364 (δίς) and a derivative of (to cut);

G1054.def:
Γαλατικός, -ή, -όν (see previous word),
Galatian, belonging to Galatia: Act.16:6 18:23.†
(AS)

G3463.strong_def: ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many
G3463.derivation: plural of an apparently primary word (properly, meaning very many);

G0800.def:
ἀ-σύμφωνος, -ον
[in LXX: Wis.18:10, Da, LXX, Bel 1:15 * ;]
dissonant, discordant; metaphorically, at variance: πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Act.28:25.†
(AS)
G0800.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G4859 (σύμφωνος);

G3453.strong_def: to initiate, i.e. (by implication) to teach

G3089.gloss: break (up), destroy, dissolve, (un-)loose, melt, put off

G3921.strong_def: to settle in alongside, i.e. lodge stealthily
G3921.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and a compound of G1519 (εἰς) and G1416 (δύνω);

G5492.strong_def: to storm, i.e. (passively) to labor under a gale

G1409.def:
Δρούσιλλα (Rec. Δρουσίλλα), ης, ἡ
Drusilla, wife of Felix: Act.24:24.†
(AS)
G1409.strong_def: Drusilla, a member of the Herodian family
G1409.derivation: a feminine diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name);

G2026.def:
ἐπ-οικοδομέω, -ῶ
in NT, always metaphorically, of the spiritual life regarded as a building (Cremer, 449);
1. to build upon: 1Co.3:10 3:12 3:14; pass., Eph.2:20.
2. to build up: Col.2:7, 1Pe.2:5 (T, οἰκοδ- WH, Rec.), Ju 20.†
(AS)
G2026.strong_def: to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up

G3828.strong_def: every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous (G5561 (χώρα) being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor
G3828.derivation: from a compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and G4443 (πυρά);

G2172.def:
εὔχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for נָדַד, also for עָתַר hi., etc. ;]
to pray: with accusative of thing(s), 2Co.13:9; with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, Act.26:29; before πρὸς τ. θεόν, 2Co.13:7; with accusative and inf., Act.27:29, 3Jn.2; before ὑπέρ, Jas.5:16; ηὐχόμην εἶναι (On imperfect here, see ICC, in l, Lft., Phm 13), Rom.9:3 (Cremer, 718).†
(AS)
G2172.strong_def: to wish; by implication, to pray to God
G2172.derivation: middle voice of a primary verb;

G1271.def:
διάνοια, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב ;]
the understanding, mind: Luk.1:51, Eph.4:18, Col.1:21, 1Pe.1:13, 2Pe.3:1, 1Jn.5:20; pl., Eph.2:3; in quotations from LXX, Mat.22:37, Mrk.12:30, Luk.10:27, Heb.8:10 10:16 (Cremer, 79, 438).†
(AS)
G1271.strong_def: deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise

G0075.def:
ἀγωνίζομαι
(ἀγών), [in LXX: Da TH 6:14 (שׂוּם בָּל), Sir.4:28, I, II, 4Mac .5 * ;]
1. to contend for a prize: 1Co.9:25,
2. to fight, struggle, strive: Jhn.18:36; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word). Col.1:29 4:12, 1Ti.4:10 6:12, 2Ti.4:7; with inf. (Field, Notes, 66), Luk.13:24 (Cremer, 609)
† (AS)
G0075.strong_def: to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something)

G3633.strong_def: to make like (oneself), i.e. imagine (be of the opinion)

G2740.def:
καῦσις, -εως, ἡ
(καίω), [in LXX for בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
burning: Heb.6:8.†
(AS)

G5154.strong_def: third; neuter (as noun) a third part, or (as adverb) a (or the) third time, thirdly

G5532.gloss: business, lack, necessary(-ity), need(-ful), use, want
G5532.strong_def: employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution
G5532.derivation: from the base of G5530 (χράομαι) or G5534 (χρή);

G1516.def:
είρηνικός, -ή, -όν
(εἰρήνη), [in LXX for שָׁלוֹם and cognates ;]
peaceful: Heb.12:11, Jas.3:17.†
(AS)

G5253.strong_def: a higher part of the house, i.e. apartment in the third story
G5253.derivation: neuter of a derivative of G5228 (ὑπέρ);

G2384.def:
Ἰακώβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. יַעֲקֹב),
Jacob;
1. The patriarch: Mat.1:2 8:11, Jhn.4:5-6, Act.7:8, al; as in Heb. (cf. Num.23:7, Isa.41:8, Sir.23:12, al.), of his descendants, Rom.11:26 (LXX).
2. The father-in-law of Mary: Mat.1:15-16 (on the form as distinct from that of the next word, see Deiss., BS, 3161)
(AS)
G2384.strong_def: Jacob (i.e. Ja`akob), the progenitor of the Israelites

G1153.strong_def: a Damascene or inhabitant of Damascus

G1122.def:
γραμματεύς, -έως (accusative pl., -εῖς, see Bl., §8, 2), ὁ
(γράμμα), [in LXX always for שׁטר in Hex., elsewhere chiefly for ספר ;]
1. a secretary; γ. τ. πόλεως, a state-clerk: Act.19:35.
2. In π., of a military officer (Deiss., BS, 110f.). So Jdg.5:14, 4Ki.25:19 (ספר), al.
3. a scribe, a biblical scholar, teacher of the law (so first in I Est.8:3, II Est.7:6; in Luk.5:17, νομοδιδάσκαλος; in Luk.10:25, νομικός): Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, and frequently in Gosp. γ. καὶ ἀρχιερεῖς, Mat.2:4, and al.; γ. κ. Φαρισαῖοι, Mat.5:20, and al.; γ. μαθητευθεὶς τῇ βασιλείᾳ τ. οὐρ., Mat.13:52; ποῦ σοφός; ποῦ γ., 1Co.1:20 (Cremer, 167; DB, iv, 420, 800).
(AS)
G1122.derivation: from G1121 (γράμμα). a writer, i.e. (professionally) scribe or secretary

G5390.strong_def: with friendliness of mind, i.e. kindly

G1593.def:
ἐκ-νεύω
[in LXX: Jdg.4:18 (סוּר) Jdg.18:26, 4Ki.2:24 23:16 (פָּנָה), Mic.6:14 (סוּג hi.), 3Ma.3:22 * ;]
1. to bend the head aside (Xen.).
2.
(a) to shun, avoid (Diod.);
(b) to withdraw: Jhn.5:13†
(AS)
G1593.strong_def: (by analogy) to slip off, i.e. quietly withdraw

G0112.def:
ἄ-θεος, -ον,
1. in cl.
(a) slighting or denyiyig the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, see word);
(b) godless, ungodly (Pind.);
(with) abandoned by the gods (Soph.)
2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): Eph.2:12.
† (AS)
G0112.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2316 (θεός);

G1742.def:
ἔνδυμα, -τος, τό
(ἐνω), [in LXX chiefly for לְבוּשׁ ;]
raiment, clothing, a garment: Mat.3:4 6:25, 28 7:15 22:11-12 28:3, Luk.12:23.†
(AS)

G1347.def:
δικαίωσις, -εως, ἡ
(δικαιόω), [in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, Lev.24:22 * ;]
the act of pronouncing righteous, justification, acquittal: Rom.4:25 5:18 (Cremer, 199).†
(AS)

G0304.def:
ἀνα-βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX for מַעֲלָה: מַעֲלָה: 3Ki.10:19-20, 4Ki.9:13 20:9 ff, 2Ch.9:18-19, Isa.38:8, Eze.40:6, 49; ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀ., tit. Psa.120:1-7 121:1-8 122:1-9 123:1-4 124:1-8 125:1-5 126:1-6 127:1-5 128:1-6 129:1-8 130:1-8 131:1-3 132:1-18 133:1-3 134:1-3)* ;]
1. a going up, an ascent (Pss, ll. with ?).
2. a step (LXX); p1., a flight of stairs: Act.21:35, 40. (On the formation -θμός, see MM, VGT, see word)†
(AS)

G2906.def:
κραυγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for צְוָחָה, תְּרוּעָה, שַׁוְעָה, etc. ;]
crying, outcry, clamour: Mat.25:6, Luk.1:42, Act.23:9, Eph.4:31, Heb.5:7, Rev.21:4.†
(AS)
G2906.strong_def: an outcry (in notification, tumult or grief)

G1094.def:
γῆρας, Attic, genitive (-αος) -ως, dative ᾳ; Ion. and κοινή, -εος (-ους), dative -ει, τό,
[in LXX for שֵׂיבָה, etc. ;]
old age: ἐν γήρει, Luk.1:36.†
(AS)

G1386.def:
δόλιος, -α, -ον
(δόλος), [in LXX—chiefly in Pss, Pr, Sir—for etc. ;]
deceitful: 2Co.11:13.†
(AS)

G0931.def:
βάσανος, -ου, ὁ (of Oriental origin),
[in LXX chiefly for כְּלִמָּה ,אָשָׁם, and frequently in 4Mac ;]
1. prop., touchstone, a dark stone used in testing metals.
2. examination by torture.
3. torment, torture: Mat.4:24, Luk.15:23, 28.
† (AS)
G0931.derivation: perhaps remotely from the same as G939 (βάσις) (through the notion of going to the bottom);

G0177.def:
ἀ-κατα-κάλυπτος, -ον
(κατακαλύπτω), [in LXX: Lev.13:45 A (פָּרוּע) * ;]
uncovered, unveiled: 1Co.11:5, 13.†
(AS)
G0177.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G2596 (κατά) and G2572 (καλύπτω);

G4526.strong_def: "sack"-cloth, i.e. mohair (the material or garments made of it, worn as a sign of grief)

G2919.def:
κρίνω,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for ריב ,דּין, etc. ;]
1. to separate, select, choose (cl.; in LXX: 2Ma.13:15).
2. to approve, esteem: Rom.14:5.
3. to be of opinion, judge, think: Luk.7:43, 1Co.11:13; before τοῦτο ὅτι, 2Co.5:14; with accusative and inf., Act.16:15; with accusative and pred., Act.13:46 26:8.
4. to decide, determine, decree: with accusative, Act.16:4, Rom.14:13, 1Co.7:37, 2Co.2:1; with inf. (Field, Notes, 167), Act.20:16 25:25, 1Co.2:2 5:3, Tit.3:12 (cf. 1Ma.11:33, Wis.8:9, al.); with accusative and inf., Act.21:25 27:1.
5. to judge, adjudge, pronounce judgment: absol., Jhn.8:16, 26; before κατά, with accusative, Jhn.7:24 8:15; κρίσιν κ., Jhn.7:24; τ. δίκαιον, Luk.12:57 (Deiss., LAE, 118); in forensic sense, Jhn.18:31, Act.23:3, al.; pass., Rom.3:4 (LXX); of God's judgment, Jhn.5:30 8:50, Rom.2:16 3:6, 2Ti.4:1, 1Pe.4:5, al.
6. = κατακρίνω, to condemn (cl.): Act.13:27; of God's judgment, Jhn.3:18 5:22 12:47, 48, Act.7:7, Rom.2:12, 1Co.11:32, Heb.10:30" (LXX), Jas.5:9, Rev.19:2, al.
7. As in LXX (for שׁפט), to rule, govern ( 4Ki.15:5, Psa.2:10, al.): Mat.19:28, Luk.22:30, 1Co.6:3.
8. to bring to trial (cl.); mid., to go to law: with dative of person(s), Mat.5:40; before μετά, with genitive of person(s) (of the opponent), ἐπί, with genitive (of the judge), 1Co.6:1, 6 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἀντ-απο- (-μαι), δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συν-, ὑπο- (-μαι), συν-υπο- (-μαι)).
SYN.: see: δικάστης. (AS)
G2919.strong_def: by implication, to try, condemn, punish
G2919.derivation: properly, to distinguish, i.e. decide (mentally or judicially);

G2060.strong_def: Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian

G2066.def:
ἐσθής, -ῆτος, ἡ
(ἕννυμι, to clothe; hence, ἐσθής, Lk, ll with, Elz.) [in LXX: 1Es.8:71 Est.8:73, 2Ma.8:35 2Mac 11:8 * ;]
clothing, raiment: Luk.23:11 24:4, Act.10:30 12:21, Jas.2:2-3.†
(AS)

G4826.strong_def: Symeon (i.e. Shimon), the name of five Israelites

G3398.strong_def: small (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity)

G2528.def:
καθ-οπλίζω
[in LXX: Jer.46:9 (תָּפַשׂ), Mac.9* ;]
to arm fully: pass., Luk.11:21.†
(AS)
G2528.strong_def: and G3695 (ὁπλίζω); to equip fully with armor

G3428.derivation: a prolonged form of the feminine of G3432 (μοιχός);

G1826.def:
ἔξ-ειμι
(εἶμι),
to go forth: Act.13:42 Act.17:15 Act.20:7; before ἐπί, with accusative, Act.27:43.†
(AS)
G1826.strong_def: to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to the shore)

G4920.strong_def: to put together, i.e. (mentally) to comprehend; by implication, to act piously

G5045.strong_def: an artificer (as producer of fabrics), i.e. (specially), a craftsman in wood

G2332.def:
θεσσαλονίκη, -ης, ἡ
Thessalonica, a city of Macedonia: Act.17:1, 11 17:13, Php.4:16, 2Ti.4:10.†
(AS)
G2332.strong_def: Thessalonice, a place in Asia Minor

G0155.def:
αἴτημα, -ατος, τό
(αἰτέω), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁאֵלָה ;]
that which has been asked for, a petition, request: Luk.23:24, Php.4:6, Jhn.5:15.†
SYN.: see: δέησις. (AS)
G0155.strong_def: a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking

G2613.def:
κατα-δικάζω
[in LXX: Psa.94:21 (רָשַׁע hi.), La 3:36 (עָוַת pi.), Wis.2:20, al. ;]
to pass sentence upon, condemn; in cl., with genitive of person(s) (accusative of thing(s)); in late writers (so LXX), with accusative of person(s) (θανάτῳ, Wis, l.with): Mat.12:7, Jas.5:6; absol. (as Plat., Legg., 958c), Luk.6:37; pass., Mat.12:37, Luk.6:37.†
δικάζω,
to judge: Luk.6:37 (Tr., mg.; see: καταδ-; Cremer, 199).†
(AS)
G2613.strong_def: to adjudge against, i.e. pronounce guilty
G2613.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G1349 (δίκη);

G1773.def:
ἔννυχος, -ον
(νύξ), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:5 * ;] (in cl. poët.; prose in late Gk. only)
nightly. Neut., adverbially, ἔννυχα (Rec. -χον), by night: Mrk.1:35.†
(AS)
G1773.derivation: neuter of a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G3571 (νύξ);

G5474.strong_def: burnished copper, an alloy of copper (or gold) and silver having a brilliant lustre
G5474.derivation: neuter of a compound of G5475 (χαλκός) and G3030 (λίβανος) (in the implied mean of whiteness or brilliancy);

G2707.def:
κατα-φρονητής, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for בָּגַד, בֹּגְדוֹת, Hab.1:5 2:5, Zep.3:4 * ;]
a despiser: Act.13:41.†
(AS)

G3855.strong_def: to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away

G1845.def:
ἐξ-ορκιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐξορκίζω),
1. one who administers an oath.
2. an exorcist: Act.19:13.†
(AS)
G1845.strong_def: one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer)

G4069.strong_def: a Persian woman; Persis, a Christian female

G0031.def:
ἀγγελία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄγγελος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁמוּעָה ;]
a message: 1Jo.1:5, 3:11 (Cremer, 18; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G1605.def:
ἐκ-πλήσσω
(Attic -ττω, Act.13:12), [in LXX: (pass.) Ecc.7:16, (שָׁמֵם hithp.), Wis.13:4, 2Ma.7:12, 4Ma.8:4 4Mac 17:16 * ;]
1. prop., to strike out, drive away.
2. to strike with panic or shock, to amaze, astonish: pass., Mat.13:54 19:25, Mrk.6:2 7:37 10:26, Luk.2:48; before ἐπί, with dative of thing(s), Mat.7:28 22:33, Mrk.1:22 11:18, Luk.4:32 9:43, Act.13:12.†
SYN.: " πτωεῖν G?, to terrify, agitate with fear;
τρεμεῖν, to tremble, predominantly physical;
φοβεῖν, to fear, "the general term," Thayer;
cf. also φρίσσω, to shudder, and see: δειλία
δειλία, -ας, ἡ
(δειλός), [in LXX for אֵימָה, מְחִתָּה, etc. ;]
cowardice, timidity (never in good sense): 2Ti.1:7.†
SYN.: φόβος, fear, in general, good or bad; εὐλάβεια (which see), apprehension generally, but chiefly pious fear, "that careful and watchful reverence which pays regard to every circumstance in that with which it has to deal" (cf. Tr., Syn., § x).† (AS)

G4241.strong_def: to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right)

G0409.def:
ἀνδρο-φόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: 2Ma.9:28 * ;]
a man-slayer: 1Ti.1:9 (cf. φονεύς, and see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G3307.gloss: deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give participle
G3307.strong_def: to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to disunite, differ

G4365.strong_def: to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as G4313 (προπορεύομαι))

G4915.strong_def: a co-aged person, i.e. alike in years
G4915.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G2244 (ἡλικία);

G1020.def:
βραδυπλοέω, -ῶ
(βραδύς, πλοῦς),
to sail slowly: Act.27:7.†
(AS)
G1020.derivation: from G1021 (βραδύς) and a prolonged form of G4126 (πλέω);

G3467.strong_def: from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)); to shut the eyes, i.e. blink (see indistinctly)
G3467.derivation: from a compound of the base of G3466 (μυστήριον) and (the face;

G2948.def:
κυλλός, -ή, -όν
1. crooked, crippled: Mat.15:30-31 (WH, txt. om.);
2. maimed: Mat.18:8, Mrk.9:43.†
(AS)
G2948.strong_def: rocking about, i.e. crippled (maimed, in feet or hands)

G2227.def:
ζωο-ποιέω, ῶ
[in LXX for חָיָה pi., hi., Jdg.21:14, 4Ki.5:7, Neh.9:6, Job.36:6, Psa.70:20, Ecc.7:12 * ;]
1. in cl. (= ζωογονέω), to produce alive.
2. In LXX and NT, to make alive, cause to live, quicken (DCG, ii, 606a; Cremer, 275): Jhn.5:21 6:53, Rom.4:17 8:11, 1Co.15:45, 2Co.3:6, Gal.3:21. Pass., 1Co.15:22 15:36, 1Pe.3:18.†
(AS)
G2227.derivation: from the same as G2226 (ζῶον) and G4160 (ποιέω);

G3606.strong_def: from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction)
G3606.derivation: from G3739 (ὅς) with the directive enclitic of source;

G1024.strong_def: short (of time, place, quantity, or number)

G1081.def:
γέννημα, -τος, τό
(γεννάω), [in LXX chiefly for תְּבוּאָה ;]
offspring of men or animals: ἐχιδνῶν, Mat.3:7 12:34 23:33, Luk.3:7 (and elsewhere in Rec. for γένημα, which see).†
(AS)
G1081.strong_def: offspring; by analogy, produce (literally or figuratively)

G5350.strong_def: to utter a clear sound, i.e. (generally) to proclaim
G5350.derivation: probably akin to G5338 (φέγγος) and thus to G5346 (φημί);

G3340.strong_def: to think differently or afterwards, i.e. reconsider (morally, feel compunction)

G3047.strong_def: the south(- west) wind (as bringing rain, i.e. (by extension) the south quarter)

G2484.def:
Ἰτουραῖος, -αία, -αῖον
[in LXX: 1Ch.5:19 A (יְטוּר) * ;]
Ituræan (in cl. always ὁι Ἰ., the Ituræans) χώρα (ἡ Ἰτουραίων ὀρεινή, τὰ τῶν Ἰ. μέρη, Strabo, XVI, ii, 16, 20), Luk.3:1 (cf. Exp. (1894), ix, 51 ff., 143 ff., 288 ff.).†
(AS)
G2484.strong_def: Ituræa (i.e. Jetur), a region of Palestine

G0837.def:
αὐξάνω
(and the earlier form αὔξω, Eph.2:21, Col.2:19; MM, see word), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָה ;]
1. trans., to make to grow: 1Co.3:6-7, 2Co.9:10. Pass., to grow, increase, become greater: Mat.13:32, Mrk.4:8, 2Co.10:15, Col.1:6; τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τ. θεοῦ, Col.1:10; εἰς σωτηρίαν, 1Pe.2:2.
2. In later Gk. (but nowhere in LXX), intrans., to grow, increase: of plants, Mat.6:28, Luk.12:27 13:19; of infants, Luk.1:80 2:40; of a multitude, Act.7:17; of the increase of the Gospel: ὁ λόγος ηὔξανε, Act.6:7 12:24 19:20; of Christ as a leader, Jhn.3:30; of Christian character: εἰς Χριοτόν, Eph.4:15; εἰς ναόν, Eph.2:21; ἐν χάριτι, 2Pe.3:18; τὴν αὔξησιν τ. θεσῦ, Col.2:19 (cf. συν, ὑπερ-αυξάνω).†
(AS)
G0837.strong_def: to grow ("wax"), i.e. enlarge (literal or figurative, active or passive)
G0837.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb;

G2234.def:
ἡδέως
adv. (ἡδύς, sweet), [in LXX: Pro.3:24 (עָרַב), etc. ;]
gladly, with pleasure: Mrk.6:20 12:37, 2Co.11:19; superlat., ἥδιστα, very gladly (B1., § 11, 3), 2Co.12:9 12:15.†
(AS)
G2234.derivation: adverb from a derivative of the base of G2237 (ἡδονή);

G0840.def:
αὐστηρός, -ά, -όν
(αἄω, to dry up) [in LXX: 2Ma.14:30 * ;]
prop., stringent, harsh to the taste. Metaphorical, in Inscr., of a rough country; of disposition and manners, strict, severe (as in π., of an inspector; MM, s v): Luk.19:21-22.†
SYN.: σκληρός (Tr., § xiv) (AS)
G0840.strong_def: rough (properly as a gale), i.e. (figuratively) severe
G0840.derivation: from a (presumed) derivative of the same as G109 (ἀήρ) (meaning blown);

G0047.def:
ἁγνεία (WH, ἁγνία),
[in LXX for טָהֳרָה, נָזִיר, נֶזֶר, etc. ;]
purity: 1Ti.4:12, 5:2 (Cremer, 58. For exx. of ceremonial use in π., see MM, Exp., iv).†
(AS)

G5411.strong_def: a load (as borne), i.e. (figuratively) a tax (properly, an individual assessment on persons or property; whereas G5056 (τέλος) is usually a general toll on goods or travel)

G0547.def:
ἀπειλή, -ῆ, ἡ
[in LXX for גְּעָרָה, etc. ;]
threatening, threat: Act.4:29 9:1, Eph.6:9.†
(AS)

G2305.def:
θειότης, -ητος, ἡ
(θεῖος) [in LXX: Wis.18:9 * ;]
divine nature, divinity: Rom.1:20 (for ex. from π., see MM, Exp., xv).†
SYN.: θεότης, deity, godhead, divine personality. θει. = divine nature and properties, a summary term for the attributes of deity, differing from θεότης as quality or attribute from essence (AS)

G0270.def:
ἀμάω, -ῶ
(in cl. chiefly poët.),
to reap: Jas.5:4.†
(AS)
G0270.strong_def: properly, to collect, i.e. (by implication) reap

G5183.strong_def: a Tyrian, i.e. inhabitant of Tyrus

G0322.def:
ἀνα-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Hab.3:2 (יָדַע), Dan LXX 1:11 (מָנָה), Dan.1:20 (מָצָא), 1Esdra.6.2, 3Mac.9 * ;]
1. to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. 2Ma.2:8, see MM, VGT, see word): Act.1:24.
2. to consecrate, set apart, (Strab., Plut., Anth.): Luk.10:1.†
(AS)
G0322.strong_def: to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint

G4339.strong_def: an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte")

G5231.strong_def: above upward, i.e. greatly higher (in place or rank)

G5378.strong_def: fond of words, i.e. talkative (argumentative, learned, "philological"); Philologus, a Christian

G1706.def:
ἐμ-πίπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
to fall into: before εἰς, Mat.12:11, Luk.6:39 10:36; metaphorically, εἰς κρίμα, 1Ti.3:6; ὀνειδισμόν 1Ti.3:7; πειρασμόν, 1Ti.6:9; εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ (cf. 2Ki.24:14, 1Ch.21:13, Sir.2:18), Heb.10:31.†
(AS)
G1706.strong_def: to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with

G4897.gloss: go in with, go with into

G2108.def:
εὐεργεσία, -ας, ἡ
(εὐεργέτης), [in LXX: Psa.78:11 (עֲלִילָה), Wis.16:11, 24, 2Ma.6:13 2Mac 9:26, 4Ma.8:17 * ;]
a good deed, kindness, benefit: 1Ti.6:2; with genitive of person(s) (εὐ. πόλεως, Plat., leg., 805b), Act.4:9,†
(AS)

G1811.def:
ἐξ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX Amo.2:4, Jer.2:2 (אַחַר הָלַךְ), Isa.56:11 (פָּנָה), Job.31:9 (פָּתָה ni.), Sir.5:2, Dan LXX TH Dan.3:1-30 :(41) * ;]
to follow, follow up (in various senses): metaphorically, 2Pe.1:16 2:2 2:15 †
(AS)
G1811.strong_def: to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to

G2719.def:
κατ-εσθίω
("perfective" comp. of ἐσθίω, which see, and cf. M, Pr., 111) [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל ;]
to eat up, devour: with accusative, of seed, Mat.13:4, Mrk.4:4, Luk.8:5; τέκνον, Rev.12:4; βιβλαρίδιον, Rev.10:9-10; metaphorically, οἰκίας, Mat.23:13, Mrk.12:40, Luk.20:47; τ. βίον, Luk.15:30; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.2:17 (LXX), 2Co.11:20, Gal.5:15, Rev.11:5 20:9.†
(AS)
G2719.strong_def: to eat down, i.e. devour (literally or figuratively)
G2719.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and G2068 (ἐσθίω) (including its alternate);

G3851.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G1011 (βουλεύω);

G0752.def:
ἀρχισυνάγωγος, -ου, ὁ
(συναγωγή),
ruler of a synagogue, an administrative officer, supervising the worship (הַכְּנֵםֶת רֹאשׁ): Mrk.5:22, 35-36 5:38 Luk.8:49 13:14, Act.13:15 18:8, 17 (Inscr., see MM, see word; cf. also DB, ext., 101).†
(AS)

G2132.def:
εὐ-νοέω, -ῶ
(εὔνοος, friendly), [in LXX: Est.8:13 Bא1, Dan LXX 2:43, 3Ma.7:11 * ;]
to be favourable, kindly disposed: with dative, Mat.5:25.†
(AS)
G2132.strong_def: to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile
G2132.derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G3563 (νοῦς);

G1872.def:
ἐπ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX (chiefly metaphorically) for אָחַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
to follow after; in NT metaphorically; absol.: Mrk.16:20 (illustrated by use in verifying accounts; see MM, Exp., xiv; Milligan; NTD, 78); with dative of person(s), of sins, 1Ti.5:24 (cf. Ellic. and CGT, in l); τ. ἴχνεσιν, 1Pe.2:21; ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ, 1Ti.5:10.†
(AS)

G3581.strong_def: foreign (literally, alien, or figuratively, novel); by implication, a guest or (vice-versa) entertainer

G0903.strong_def: Balaam, a Mesopotamian (symbolic of a false teacher)

G4041.strong_def: being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own)
G4041.derivation: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and G1510 (εἰμί);

G3038.strong_def: stone-strewed, i.e. a tessellated mosaic on which the Roman tribunal was placed
G3038.derivation: from G3037 (λίθος) and a derivative of G4766 (στρώννυμι);

G4739.strong_def: to be stationary, i.e. (figuratively) to persevere
G4739.derivation: from the perfect tense of G2476 (ἵστημι);

G3464.derivation: probably of foreign origin (compare H04753, G4666 (σμύρνα));

G1070.def:
γελάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for צחק, שׂחק ;]
to laugh: Luk.6:25; fut., γελάσω) (M, Pr., 154), ib. 21 (cf. κατα-γελάω).†
(AS)
G1070.strong_def: to laugh (as a sign of joy or satisfaction)

G4134.strong_def: replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete

G1876.def:
ἐπανάγκης, -ες
(ἀνάγκη), only in neut.;
1. ἐπάναγκες (sc. ἐστί), it is compulsory, necessary.
2. As adv., of necessity: Act.15:28.†
(AS)
G1876.derivation: neuter of a presumed compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G318 (ἀνάγκη);

G0496.def:
ἀντι-πίπτω
[in LXX: Exo.26:5 (קָבַל), Exo.26:17 (שׁוּב), Num.27:14 (מְרִיבָה) Job.23:13 (שָׁלַב hi.) * ;]
1. to fall against or upon (Arist., Polyb.).
2. to strive against, resist (Arist.): with dative, Act.7:51
(AS)
G0496.derivation: from G473 (ἀντί) and G4098 (πίπτω) (including its alternate);

G0390.def:
ἀνα-στρέφω
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
1. to overturn: Jhn.2:15.
2. to turn back, return: Act.5:22 15:16.
3. to turn hither and thither; pass., to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell: Mat.17:22 Rec.; metaphorically (like Heb. הָלַךְ, in κοινή writers and in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, VGT, see word), to conduct oneself, behave, live: 2Co.1:12, Eph.2:3, 1Ti.3:15, Heb.10:33 13:18, 1Pe.1:17, 2Pe.2:18.
† SYN.: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω (AS)
G0390.strong_def: to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live

G1206.def:
δευτεραῖος, -α, -ον
(δεύτερος),
adj. with adverbial sense;
on the second day: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, Act.28:13.†
(AS)
G1206.strong_def: secondary, i.e. (specially) on the second day

G3734.derivation: from a compound of the base of G3725 (ὅριον) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G1391.def:
δόξα, -ης, ἡ
(δοκέω), [in LXX very frequently for כָּבוֹד, also for הוֹד ,פִּפְאֶרֶת, etc., 25 words in all ;]
in cl.,
1. expectation, judgment, opinion (4Ma.5:18).
2. opinion, estimation in which one is held, repute; in NT, always good opinion, hence reputation, praise, honour, glory: Luk.14:10, Jhn.12:43, Heb.3:3; opposite to αἰσχύνη, Php.3:19; to ἀτιμία, 2Co.6:8; δ. κ. τιμή, Rom.2:7, 10 1Pe.1:7, 2Pe.1:17; ζητεῖν, Jhn.5:44 7:18 8:50, 1Th.2:6; λαμβάνειν, Jhn.5:41, 2Pe.1:17, Rev.5:12; διδόναι δ. τ. θεῷ (cf. נָתַן כָּבוֹד לַיהוָֹה, Jer.13:16, al.), Luk.17:18, Jhn.9:24, Act.12:23, Rom.4:20, Rev.4:9; εἰς (τ.) δ. θεοῦ, Rom.3:7 15:7, Php.1:11, al.; in doxologies, τ. θεῷ (ᾧ) ἡ δ., Luk.2:14, Rom.11:36 16:27, Gal.1:5, Eph.3:21, al.
3. Later also (not cl.) as in LXX (= הוֹד, Job.39:20, 1Ch.29:25; כָּבוֹד, Job.19:9, Est.5:11, al.), visible brightness, splendour, glory: of light, Act.22:11; of heavenly bodies, 1Co.15:40ff.; esp. that wh. radiates from God's presence, as manifested in the pillar of cloud and in the Holy of Holies (= כָּבוֹד, Exo.16:10 25:22 40:34, al.; and new Heb. שְׁכִינָה, 2Ma.2:8; see DB, iv, 489b), Rom.9:4, Jas.2:1 (see Hort, Mayor, in l.); hence of the manifested glory of God, Rom.1:23, Col.1:11 Eph.1:6, 12 17 3:16; of the same as communicated to man through Christ, 2Co.3:18 4:6; and of the glorious condition into which Christians shall enter hereafter, Rom.8:18, 21 9:23, 2Ti.2:10, al.
SYN.: ἔπαινος τιμή (see Hort on 1Pe.1:7). (AS)
G1391.strong_def: glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective)

G4501.strong_def: a sabre, i.e. a long and broad cutlass (any weapon of the kind, literally or figuratively)

G5136.strong_def: to seize by the throat or neck, i.e. to expose the gullet of a victim for killing (generally, to lay bare)

G0535.def:
ἀπαρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπαρτίζω, to finish),
completion: Luk.14:28 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G2726.def:
κατήφεια, -ας, ἡ
(κατηφής, downcast, Wis.17:4 *),
dejection: Jas.4:9.†
(AS)
G2726.derivation: from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and perhaps a derivative of the base of G5316 (φαίνω) (meaning downcast in look);

G5484.gloss: be-(for) cause of, for sake of, +…fore, X reproachfully
G5484.strong_def: through favor of, i.e. on account of
G5484.derivation: accusative case of G5485 (χάρις) as preposition;

G5234.derivation: adverb from present participle active of G5235 (ὑπερβάλλω);

G0898.def:
βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ, Ion. form of βασμός
(βαίνω, to step), [in LXX 1Ki.5:5 (מִפְתָּן), 4Ki.20:9, 10 11 (מַעֲלָה), Sir.6:36 * ;]
a step (4Ki, l.with, of degrees of a dial); metaphorically, a degree, standing: 1Ti.3:13.†
(AS)

G1055.def:
γαλήνη, -ης, ἡ,
a calm: Mat.8:26, Mrk.4:39, Luk.8:24.†
(AS)

G2782.def:
κήρυγμα, -τος, τό
(κηρύσσω), [in LXX: 2Ch.30:5 (קוֹל), Jon.3.2 (קְרִיאָה), Pro.9:3, I Est.9:3 * ;]
in cl.,
that which is cried by a herald, a proclamation. In NT (see Lft., Notes, 161), of God's heralds, proclamation, message, preaching (i.e. the substance as distinct from the act which would be expressed by † κήρυξις): Mat.12:41, Luk.11:32, 1Co.1:21, 2Ti.4:17, Tit.1:3; with genitive cubic., τὸ κ. μου, 1Co.2:4; ἡμῶν, 1Co.15:14; with genitive obj., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Rom.16:25.†
(AS)
G2782.strong_def: a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself)
