G4863.gloss: + accompany, assemble (selves, together), bestow, come together, gather (selves together, up, together), lead into, resort, take in
G4863.strong_def: to lead together, i.e. collect or convene; specially, to entertain (hospitably)

G2023.def:
ἐπι-χορηγέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir.25:22, 2Ma.4:9 A * ;]
to supply, provide: with accusative of thing(s), 2Pe.1:5; id. with dative of person(s), 2Co.9:10, Gal.3:5; pass., Col.2:19, 2Pe.1:11 (cf. χορηγέω, and see MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)
G2023.strong_def: to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute

G2050.def:
ἐρήμωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐρημόω), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם, שָׁמֵם, Lev.26:34-35, Psa.73:10, Dan.9:27 11:31 12:11, al.; חׇרְבָּה, Jer.7:34 22:5, al. ;]
a making desolate, laying waste: Luk.21:20; βδέλυγμα ἐρημώσεως (Da, ll. with, 1Ma.1:54), Mat.24:15" (LXX), Mrk.13:14.†
(AS)

G2822.strong_def: invited, i.e. appointed, or (specially), a saint

G1930.def:
ἐπι-δι-ορθόω
to set in order further: Tit.1:5 (Inscr.; Cremer, 8O8).†
(AS)
G1930.strong_def: to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally
G1930.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3717 (ὀρθός);

G1121.strong_def: a writing, i.e. a letter, note, epistle, book, etc.; plural learning

G3599.derivation: perhaps from the base of G2068 (ἐσθίω);

G2849.def:
κολάζω
(κόλος, docked), [in LXX: Dan.6:12 (13) (no Heb.), I Est.8:24, Wis.3:4 (and freq.), 1Ma.7:7, al. ;]
1. to curtail, dock, prune.
2. to check, restrain.
3. to chastise, correct, punish: pass., 2Pe.2:9; mid., cause to be punished (3Ma.7:3): Act.4:21.†
(AS)
G2849.strong_def: properly, to curtail, i.e. (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction)

G4099.strong_def: Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor

G1839.def:
ἐξ-ίστημι (also in Hellenistic -ιστάνω, Act 8:9),
[in LXX for H2730, etc. (29 words in all) ;],
1. causal in Pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put out of its place; metaphorically, ἐ. τινά φρενῶν (Eur.), to drive one out of his senses, hence, absol., to confound, amaze: with accusative of person(s), Luk.24:22, Act.8:9, 11.
2. Intr. in pass. and mid., also in 2 aor., pf., plpf. act., before ἐκ or with genitive, to stand aside from, retire from; esp. τ. φρενῶν, to lose one's senses (Eur.), hence, absol.;
(a) to be beside oneself, be mad: Mrk.3:21, 2Co.5:13 (opposite to σωφρονεῖν);
(b) to be amazed, confounded: Mat.12:23, Mrk.2:12 Mrk.5:42 Mrk.6:51, Luk.2:47 Luk.8:56, Act.2:7, 12 Act.8:13 Act.9:21 Act.10:45 Act.12:16 (Cremer, 309).†
(AS)
G1839.strong_def: to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane

G4898.strong_def: a co-absentee from home, i.e. fellow-traveller
G4898.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G1553 (ἐκδημέω);

G4414.strong_def: one standing first in the ranks, i.e. a captain (champion)

G0212.def:
ἀλαζονία(Rec. -εία, the earlier form), -ας, ἡ
(ἀλαζών), [in LXX: Wis.5:8 17:7, 2; 4Ma.5:1-38 * ;]
the character of an ἀλαζών, boastfulness, vainglory, vaunting: Jas.4:16 (Mayor, in l), 1Jn.2:16.†
(AS)

G0481.def:
ἄντικρυς
(Tr. -ύς, Rec. ἀντικρύ), adv. (ἀντί) [in LXX: Neh.12:8 (נֶגֶד), 3Ma.5:16 * ;]
in cl., outright; in κοινή (= cl. καταντικρύ), over against: Act.20:15 (see Bl., § 5, 4; 40, 7; Rutherford, NPhr., 500 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G2586.def:
καπνός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for עָשָׁן ;]
smoke: Rev.8:4 9:2-3, 17-18 14:11 15:8 18:9, 18 19:3; ἀτμὶς καπνοῦ, Act.2:19 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2072.def:
ἔσ-οπτρον, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Wis.7:26, Sir.12:11 * ;]
a mirror: 1Co.13:12, Jas.1:23.†
(AS)
G2072.derivation: from G1519 (εἰς) and a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

G4408.strong_def: the prow, i.e. forward part of a vessel
G4408.derivation: feminine of a presumed derivative of G4253 (πρό) as noun;

G5252.strong_def: to esteem oneself overmuch, i.e. be vain or arrogant

G4730.derivation: from a compound of G4728 (στενός) and G5561 (χώρα);

G3389.derivation: from G3384 (μήτηρ) and the base of G257 (ἅλων);

G1877.def:
ἐπ-αν-άγω
[in LXX: Zec.4:12 (רוּק hi.), Sir.17:26 26:28, 2Ma.9:21 2Mac 12:4 * ;]
to bring up or back (sc. ναῦς); to put out to sea (DB, iii, 63b): Luk.5:3-4; intrans., to return: Mat.21:18.†
(AS)
G1877.strong_def: to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return

G5042.strong_def: childbirth (parentage), i.e. (by implication) maternity (the performance of maternal duties)

G0400.def:
ἀνα-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַע hi., זָכַר hi. ;]
to cry out, exclaim: Luk.1:42 (Arist., al.).†
(AS)

G5037.gloss: also, and, both, even, then, whether
G5037.strong_def: both or also (properly, as correlation of G2532 (καί))
G5037.derivation: a primary particle (enclitic) of connection or addition;

G2440.def:
ἱμάτιον, -ου, τό
(dim, of εἷμα, a garment), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּגֶד also for שִׂמְלָה, שַׂלְמָה, etc. ;]
a garment, but in usage always (exc. in p1., see infr.) of an outer garment, a mantle, cloak (thrown over the χιτών; see Rutherford, NPhr., 22; DCG, i, 499a): Mat.9:16, 20-21 Mrk.2:21 5:27-28, 30 Jhn.19:2, Act.12:8, al.; opposite to χιτών, Mat.5:40, Luk.6:29, Act.9:39; pl., garments, clothes (i.e. the cloak and the tunic), Mat.17:2 26:65 27:31, 35, Mrk.5:30 15:20, 24, Jhn.19:23-24, Jas.5:2, al
(AS)
G2440.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on);

G0395.def:
ἀνατολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνατέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָח קָדִים ;]
1. a rising: of light, Luk.1:78.
2. the sun-rising, the east (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.2:2, 9, Rev.21:13; ἀ. ἡλίου, Rev.7:2 16:12 (WΗ, p1.); pl., Mat.2:1 8:11 24:27, Luk.13:29.†
(AS)
G0395.strong_def: a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural)

G3748.gloss: X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever)
G3748.strong_def: which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same

G4994.strong_def: to make of sound mind, i.e. (figuratively) to discipline or correct

G0569.def:
ἀπιστέω, -ῶ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.1:2 10:7 12:17 18:13, Sir.1:27, 2Ma.8:13 * ;]
1. to disbelieve, be faithless: Mrk.16:11, 16, Luk.24:11, 41, Act.28:24, 1Pe.2:7; so prob. also Rom.3:3, 2Ti.2:13 (ICC, CGT, in ll; MM, see word).
2. = ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., Notes, 265; Thayer, see word).†
(AS)
G0569.strong_def: to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey

G4112.strong_def: moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false)

G1714.def:
ἐμ-πίπρημι,
ἐμπρήθω (for the form, see: ἐμπίπλημι, and cf. Veitch, see word πίμπρημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף ;]
to set on fire: πόλιν, Mat.22:7; pass., of the body, to become inflamed: Act.28:6 (T; πίμπρημι WH, which see).†
(AS)
G1714.strong_def: to enkindle, i.e. set on fire
G1714.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and (to blow a flame);

G2633.def:
κατά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
(κατακρίνω),
condemnation: 2Co.3:9 7:3 (cf. Deiss., LAE, 91 f.).†
(AS)

G2602.def:
κατα-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταβάλλω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:29 * ;]
1. a laying down: εἰς κ. σπέρματος, Heb.11:11 (EV, to conceive seed).
2. a foundation (of a house, ii Mac, l.with): metaphorically, ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, Mat.13:35 (LXX) (om. ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, WH, R, mg.), Mat.25:34, Luk.11:50, Heb.4:3 9:26, Rev.13:8 17:8; πρὸ κ. κόσμου, Jhn.17:24, Eph.1:4, 1Pe.1:20.†
(AS)
G2602.strong_def: a deposition, i.e. founding; figuratively, conception

G3770.strong_def: celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the sky

G0806.def:
ἀσφαλῶς
adv., [in LXX: Gen.34:25 (בֶּטַח), Tob.6:4, Wis.18:6, Bar.5:7, 1Ma.6:40, 3Ma.7:6 * ;]
(a) safely: Mrk.14:44, Act.16:23;
(b) assuredly: Act.2:36.†
(AS)

G2470.def:
ἴσος
(epic ἶσος, so sometimes Rec.), -η, -ον, [in LXX for כְּ֜, Jb 5:14; Job.10:10, al.; אֶחָד, Eze.40:5 ff.; 2Ma.9:15, 4Ma.13:20-21, al. ;]
equal, the same in size, number, quality, etc.: δωρεά, Act.11:17; μαρτυρίαι, Mrk.14:56, 59; ἴ. ποιεῖν, with accusative and dative, Mat.20:12; ἑαυτὸν τ. θεῷ, Jhn.5:18; τὰ ἴ. ἀπολαβεῖν, Luk.6:34, n. pl., ἴσα, adverbially, Rev.21:16; τ. θεῷ, Php.2:6.†
(AS)
G2470.derivation: probably from G1492 (εἴδω) (through the idea of seeming);

G1689.def:
ἐμ-βλέπω
[in LXX for רָאָה, 3Ki.8:8, al.), פָּנָה (Job.6:28 A, al.); metaphorically, Isa.51:1 (נָבַט hi.), Sir.2:10, etc. ;]
to look at: with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.8:25; with dative of person(s) (part., before λέγει, εἶπεν, cf. Xen., Cyr., i, 3, 2), Mat.19:26, Mrk.10:21, 27 14:67, Luk.20:17 22:61 (ἐνέβλεψεν), Jhn.1:36, 43; absol., to look, Act.22:11; metaphorically, to consider: Mat.6:26.†
(AS)
G1689.strong_def: to look on, i.e. (relatively) to observe fixedly, or (absolutely) to discern clearly

G1329.strong_def: to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate

G0750.def:
ἀρχι-ποίμην, -ενος, ὁ
[in Sm.: 4Ki.3:4 * ;]
found on an Egyptian mummy label (Deiss., LAE, 97 ff.; cf. MM, see word); used by modem Greeks of tribal chiefs; chief shepherd. of Christ, 1Pe.5:4.†
(AS)

G4582.strong_def: probably akin to the alternate of G138 (αἱρέομαι), through the idea of attractiveness); the moon

G5445.strong_def: perhaps akin to G5453 (φύω) through the idea of swelling in bulk), mean to knead; a mass of dough
G5445.derivation: from a prolonged form of (to mix a liquid with a solid;

G0874.def:
ἀφ-ορμή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Eze.5:7 (הָמוֹן), Pro.9:9, 3Ma.3:2 * ;]
prop., a starting point; in war, a base of operations; metaphorically, an occasion, incentive, opportunity (MM, see word): 2Co.11:12, Gal.5:13; ἀφ. λαμβάνειν, Luk.11:24, WH, mg., Rom.7:8, 11; ἀφ. διδόναι, 2Co.5:12, 1Ti.5:14.*
(AS)
G0874.derivation: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G3729 (ὁρμάω);

G0033.def:
ἄγε, prop. imperat. of ἄγω,
come! used as adv. and addressed, like φέρε, to one or more persons: Jas.4:13, 5:1.†
(AS)

G0114.def:
ἀθετέω, -ῶ (τίθημι), [in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, etc., often meaning, as 1Ki.13:3 (Heb., al.), to revolt; properly, to make ἄθετον , or do away with what has been laid down (see DCG, i, 453 f.)].
1. to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην , Gal.3:16; ἐντολήν , Mrk.7:9; νόμον . Heb.10:28; πίστιν , 1Ti.5:12.
2. to nullify, make void: Luk.7:30 (see Field, Notes, 59), 1Co.1:19, Gal.2:21.
3. to reject: Mrk.6:26 (Field, op. cit., 30), Lk 10:16, Jhn.12:48, I Th 48, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0114.strong_def: to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate
G0114.derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G3162.strong_def: a knife, i.e. dirk; figuratively, war, judicial punishment
G3162.derivation: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of G3163 (μάχη);

G3778.gloss: he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who
G3778.strong_def: the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated)
G3778.derivation: from the article G3588 (ὁ) and G846 (αὐτός);

G1108.def:
γνῶσις, -εως, ἡ
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for דַּעַת ;]
1. a seeking to know, inquiry, investigation.
2. knowledge, in NT, specially of the kn. of spiritual truth: absol., Luk.11:52, Rom.2:20 15:14, 1Co.1:5 (Lft., Notes, 147) 8:1, 7, 10, 11, 13:2, 8 14:6, 2Co.6:6 8:7 11:6, Eph.3:19, Col.2:3, 1Pe.3:7, 2Pe.1:5, 6; with genitive obj., σωτηρίας, Luk.1:77; τ. δόξης τ. θεοῦ, 2Co.4:6; τ. θεοῦ, 2Co.2:14 10:5; Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, Php.3:8 (see Deiss., LAE, 383.8), 2Pe.3:18; with genitive subjc., θεοῦ, Rom.11:33; λόγος γνώσεως, 1Co.12:8; ψευδωνύμου γνώσεως, 1Ti.6:20.
† SYN.: σοφία, φρόνησις (cf. ἐπί-γνωσις and see Lft. on Col.2:3; Cremer, 156). (AS)

G1590.def:
ἐκ-λύω
[in LXX for רָפָה, etc. ;]
1. to loose, release.
2. to unloose, as a bow-string, to relax, enfeeble; pass., to be faint, grow weary: Mat.15:32, Mrk.8:3; of mental weariness, Gal.6:9, Heb.12:3, 5" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G2606.def:
κατα-γελάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂחַק, Job.5:22, Pro.29:9, al. ;]
to deride, laugh scornfully at: with genitive of person(s), Mat.9:24, Mrk.5:40, Luk.8:53.†
(AS)

G4888.strong_def: to exalt to dignity in company (i.e. similarly) with

G0626.def:
ἀπολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἀπό, λόγος), [in LXX: Jer.12:1 (רִיב) Jer.31:6, 2Ma.13:26 * ;]
1. to defend: with accusative, Rom.2:15.
2. to defend one's self: absol., Luk.21:14, Act.26:1; before ὅτι, Act.25:8; τί, to adduce something in one's defence, Luk.12:11, Act.26:24 (ταῦτα) Act.24:10 (τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ); περί, with genitive of thing(s), and ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), Act.26:2; with dative of person(s), Act.19:33, 2Co.12:19.†
(AS)
G0626.strong_def: to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. exculpate (self)
G0626.derivation: middle voice from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G3056 (λόγος);

G2830.def:
κλύδων, -ωνος, ὁ
(κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over), [in LXX: Jon.1.4; Jon.1.12 (סַעַר), al. ;]
a billow, surge: Luk.8:24, Jas.1:6.†
SYN.: κῦμα, a wave (AS)
G2830.strong_def: a surge of the sea (literally or figuratively)

G0477.derivation: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G5087 (τίθημι);

G4976.strong_def: a figure (as a mode or circumstance), i.e. (by implication) external condition

G1858.def:
ἑορτάζω
(ἑορτή), [in LXX for חָגַג ;]
to keep festival: 1Co.5:8.†
(AS)

G5553.strong_def: a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin

G4234.strong_def: practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function

G0795.def:
ἀστοχέω, -ῶ
(στόχος, a mark), [in LXX: Sir.7:19 8:9 * ;]
to miss the mark, fail: with genitive, 1Ti.1:6 (so in π., MM, see word); before περί, 1Ti.6:21, 2Ti.2:18.†
(AS)
G0795.strong_def: to miss the mark, i.e. (figuratively) deviate from truth
G0795.derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and (an aim);

G4202.strong_def: harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry

G4724.strong_def: properly, to set fast ("stall"), i.e. (figuratively) to repress (reflexively, abstain from associating with)
G4724.derivation: probably strengthened from the base of G2476 (ἵστημι);

G1034.def:
βρώσιμος, -ον
(βρῶσις), [in LXX: Lev.19:23, Neh.9:25, Eze.47:12 (מַאֲכָל)* ;]
eatable: Luk.24:41.†
(AS)

G1057.def:
Γαλιλαῖος, -αία, -αῖον,
Galilæan: Mat.26:69, Mrk.14:70, Luk.13:1, 2 22:59, 23:6, Jhn.4:45, Act.1:11 2:7 5:37.†
(AS)

G0919.def:
Βαρι-ησοῦς, -οῦ, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־יֵשׁוּעַ, son of Joshua),
Bar-Jesus: Act.13:6 (see: Ἐλύμας).†
(AS)
G0919.strong_def: son of Jesus (or Joshua); Bar-jesus, an Israelite

G1532.def:
εἰσ-τρέχω
[in LXX: 2Ma.5:26 * ;]
to run in: Act.12:14.†
(AS)

G1337.def:
διθάλασσος, -ον
(δις, θύλασσα);
1. divided into two seas (as the Euxine, Strab., ii, 522).
2. dividing the sea: τόπον δ., a tongue of land, or reef, running out into the sea: Act.27:41.†
(AS)
G1337.strong_def: having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet

G0713.def:
ἀρκετός, -ή, -όν
(ἀρκέω), [in Aq.: Deu.25:2 * ;]
sufficient: Mat.6:34 (on the neut., see B1., § 31, 2); before ἵνα (M, Pr., 210), Mat.10:25; with inf., 1Pe.4:3 (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G2789.def:
κιθαρίζω
[in LXX: Isa.23:16 (נָגַן pi.)* ;]
to play upon the lyre or harp: 1Co.14:7, Rev.14:2.†
(AS)

G1465.def:
ἐγκόπτω, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-κόπτω (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν; and in I Pe, l.with, ἐκκ-);
1. to cut into (as in breaking up a road), hence, 2. to hinder: with accusative Act.24:4, 1Th.2:18, . inf., Gal.5:7; before τοῦ, with inf., Rom.15:22; εἰς τό, with inf, 1Pe.3:7.†
(AS)
G1465.strong_def: to cut into, i.e. (figuratively) impede, detain

G3338.derivation: from G3326 (μετά) and the middle voice of G3199 (μέλω);

G1237.def:
δια-δέχομαι
[in LXX for מִשְׁנֶה (Deiss., BS, 115), פַּרְבָּר ;]
to receive through another, receive in turn: Act.7:45 (RV, in their turn; see Field, Notes, 116).†
(AS)
G1237.strong_def: to receive in turn, i.e. (figuratively) succeed to

G4302.strong_def: to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn

G5188.strong_def: to make a smoke, i.e. slowly consume without flame

G0166.strong_def: perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well)

G2549.def:
κακία, -ας, ἡ
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;]
1. badness in quality (opposite to ἀρετή, excellence).
2. wickedness, depravity, malignity: Act.8:22, Rom.1:29, 1Co.5:8 14:20, Eph.4:31, Col.3:8, Tit.3:3, Jas.1:21, 1Pe.2:1 2:16.
3. In late Gk., evil, trouble, affliction (Amo.3:6, 1Ki.6:9, Ecc.7:15, Sir.19:6, al.): Mat.6:34 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).†
SYN.: (πονηρία) (AS)
G2549.strong_def: badness, i.e. (subjectively) depravity, or (actively) malignity, or (passively) trouble

G2567.def:
καλο-διδάσκαλος, -ου, ὁ
a teacher of that which is good: Tit.2:3.†
(AS)

G0397.def:
ἀνα-τρέφω
[in LXX: Wis.7:4 B, 4Ma.10:2 4Mac 11:15 א* ;]
to nurse up, nourish, educate, bring up: Luk.4:16, WΗ, mg., Act.7:20-21 22:3.†
(AS)

G4156.strong_def: throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled)

G1417.def:
δύο, numeral, indecl. exc. in dative, δυσί, δυσίν (Attic δυοῖν),
two: Mat.19:6, Mrk.10:8, Jhn.2:6, al.; with pl. noun, Mat.9:27 10:10, al.; οἱ, τῶν, τοὺς δ., Mat.19:5 20:24, Mrk.10:8, Eph.2:15, al.; δ. ἐξ, Luk.24:13; distrib., ἀνὰ, κατὰ δ., two and two, two apiece: Luk.10:1 (WH, ἀνὰ δ. [δύο]), Jhn.2:6, 1Co.14:27; δύο δύο (= ἀνὰ δ., as LXX, Gen.6:19 for שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם, but not merely "Hebraism," cf. μυρία μυρία, Æsch., Pers., 981, and for usage in π. and MGr., see M, Pr., 21, 97), Mrk.6:7; εἰς δ. (two and two, Xen., Cyr., 7, 5, 17), into two parts, Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38.
(AS)

G2816.def:
κληρονομέω, -ῶ
(κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for יָרַשׁ, also for נָחַל, etc. ;]
1. to receive by lot.
2. to inherit (in cl., usually with genitive of thing(s)): absol., Gal.4:30 (LXX); in general, to possess oneself of, receive as one's own, obtain (as Deu.4:5, al., cf. Psa.25:3, Isa.61:7): with accusative of thing(s) (as generally in late Gk., see M, Pr., 65), of the Messianic Kingdom (cf. Psa.37:11, Sir.4:13 37:26, and see Dalman, Words, 125 ff.) and its bless­ings and privileges, τ. γῆν, Mat.5:5 (cf. LXX); τ. βασιλείαν, β. θεοῦ, Mat.25:34, 1Co.6:9-10 15:50, Gal.5:21; ζωὴν αἰώνιον, Mat.19:29, Mrk.10:17, Luk.10:25 18:18; σωτηρίαν, Heb.1:14; τ. ἐπαγγελίας, Heb.6:12; ἀφθαρσίαν, 1Co.15:50; ὄνομα, Heb.1:4; τ. εὐλογίαν, Heb.12:17, 1Pe.3:9; ταῦτα, Rev.21:7 (cf. κατα-κληρονομέω).†
(AS)
G2816.strong_def: to be an heir to (literally or figuratively)

G4958.strong_def: to send (draw) together, i.e. enwrap (enshroud a corpse for burial), contract (an interval)

G1352.def:
διό
conjunct. for δι᾽ ὅ,
wherefore, on which account: Mat.27:8, Luk.7:7, Act.15:19, Rom.1:24, al.; δ. καί, Luk.1:35, Act.10:29 24:26, Rom.4:22 15:22, 2Co.1:20 4:13 5:9, Php.2:9, Heb.11:12 13:12 (see Ellic. on Gal.4:31).
(AS)

G3074.derivation: perhaps akin to the base of G3022 (λευκός) (from the whitish hair);

G2030.def:
ἐπόπτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX (of God): Est.5:1, 2Ma.3:39 2Mac 7:35, 3Ma.2:21 * ;]
1. an overseer (LXX, ll. with).
2. a spectator: 2Pe.1:16 (of ἐ. as applied to God, see parallels in Inscr., MM, Exp., xiv; of the use of this term in the mysteries, see Mayor on 2Pe, l.with; Thayer, see word).†
(AS)
G2030.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

G3473.derivation: from a compound of G3474 (μωρός) and G3004 (λέγω);

G5132.strong_def: a table or stool (as being four-legged), usually for food (figuratively, a meal); also a counter for money (figuratively, a broker's office for loans at interest)
G5132.derivation: probably contracted from G5064 (τέσσαρες) and G3979 (πεζῇ);

G0582.def:
ἀπο-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπογράφω)
[in LXX: Dan.10:21 (כָּתָב), I Est.8:30, AB, 2Ma.2:1, 3Ma.2:32 3Mac 4:15 3Mac 4:17 3Mac 7:22 * ;]
1. a written copy.
2. As law term, a deposition (Demos.).
3. In late writers, a register, enrolment, census (MM, see word; Deiss., LAE, 160, 268 f.): Luk.2:2, Act.5:37.†
(AS)
G0582.strong_def: an enrollment; by implication, an assessment

G1627.def:
ἐκ-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;]
1. to carry out, bring out: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.15:22, 1Ti.6:7; with accusative of person(s), Mrk.8:23, Act.5:15; of the dead for burial (cf. κομίζω), Act.5:6, 9-10.
2. to bring forth;
(a) of women (Hipp., Arist., al.);
(b) of the ground (Hdt.): Heb.6:8.†
(AS)

G2747.def:
Κενχρεαί (Rec. Κεχγ-; ν. WH, App., 150), -ῶν, αἱ,
Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth: Act.18:18, Rom.16:1.†
(AS)

G1475.def:
ἔδαφος, -εος (-ους), τό,
[in LXX for עָפָר, קַרְקע, etc. ;]
bottom, pavement, ground: Act.22:7.†
(AS)

G3391.gloss: a (certain), + agree, first, one, X other

G5530.strong_def: to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e. (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner
G5530.derivation: middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from G5495 (χείρ), to handle);

G0014.def:
ἀγαθοεργέω, -ῶ,
to do good, show kindness: 1 Ti 6:18 (Cremer, 8).†
ἀγαθουργέω, -ῶ, contracted form (rare, see WH, App., 145) of ἀγαθοερ- (which see),
to do good: Act.14:17.†
(AS)

G1874.def:
ἐπ-ακροάομαι, -ῶμαι
to listen attentively: Act.16:25 (cf. Page, in l).†
(AS)
G1874.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G202 (ἀκροατής);

G1979.def:
ἐπισιτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπισιτίζομαι, to supply with provisions), [in LXX: Gen.42:25, al. (צֵידָה), Jdth.2:18 4:5 ;]
1. a foraging.
2. provisions, food: Luk.9:12.†
(AS)
G1979.derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G4621 (σῖτος);

G4583.derivation: middle voice or passive from a presumed derivative of G4582 (σελήνη);

G0990.def:
βλέμμα, -τος, τό
(βλέπω),
a look, a glance: βλέμματι καὶ ἀκοῇ, 2Pe.2:8, sight and hearing, a sense not found for β. in Gk. lit., but perh. recognized in the vernacular (ICC, in l.)†
(AS)

G2503.def:
ἰῶτα, τό ,
iota (Heb. י, i.e. the smallest letter): Mat.5:18.†
(AS)
G2503.strong_def: "iota", the name of the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, put (figuratively) for a very small part of anything
G2503.derivation: of Hebrew origin (the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet);

G4490.derivation: adverb from a derivative of G4483 (ῥέω);

G0387.strong_def: properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively)
G0387.derivation: from a derivative of G450 (ἀνίστημι) (in the sense of removal);

G5550.gloss: + years old, season, space, (X often-)time(-s), (a) while
G5550.strong_def: a space of time (in general, and thus properly distinguished from G2540 (καιρός), which designates a fixed or special occasion; and from G165 (αἰών), which denotes a particular period) or interval; by extension, an individual opportunity; by implication, delay

G3751.strong_def: the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power

G0594.def:
ἀπο-δοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποδέχομαι),
acceptance, approbation (Field, Notes, 203): 1Ti.1:15 4:9 (Cremer, 686; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G3630.derivation: from G3631 (οἶνος) and a derivative of the alternate of G4095 (πίνω);

G1127.def:
γρηγορέω, -ῶ, = Attic ἐργήγορα, pf. of ἐγείρω, which see,
[in LXX (later bks. only) chiefly for שׁקד ;]
1. to be awake; metaphorically, of being alive, 1Th.5:10.
2. to watch: Mat.24:43 26:38, 40 Mrk.13:34 14:34, 37 Luk.12:37, 39; metaphorically, Mat.24:42 25:13 26:41, Mrk.13:35, 37 14:38, Act.20:31, 1Co.16:13, 1Th.5:6, 1Pe.5:8, Rev.3:2, 3 16:15; before ἐν, Col.4:2. (Cf. δια-γρηγορέω).†
SYN.: see: ἀγρθπνέω. (AS)
G1127.strong_def: to keep awake, i.e. watch (literally or figuratively)

G4743.strong_def: a point of time, i.e. an instant

G2715.def:
κατ-εξουσιάζω
to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), Mat.20:25, Mrk.10:42.†
SYN: (κατακυριεύω) (see Swete, Mk., l.with)
(AS)

G4795.strong_def: from the base of G2962 (κύριος)); concurrence, i.e. accident
G4795.derivation: from a comparative of G4862 (σύν) and (to light or happen;

G3745.gloss: all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who(-soever)

G0551.def:
απείραστος, -ον
(πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω),
untempted, untried, without experience: Jas.1:13 (see Hort, in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0551.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3987 (πειράω);

G5497.gloss: some to lead by the hand
G5497.strong_def: a hand-leader, i.e. personal conductor (of a blind person)
G5497.derivation: from G5495 (χείρ) and a reduplicated form of G71 (ἄγω);

G3371.gloss: any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more

G3905.strong_def: to extend along, i.e. prolong (in point of time)

G2199.def:
Ζεβεδαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Heb. זְבַדְיָה; LXX: Ζαβδειά, Est.8:8 10:20; Ζαβαδαῖας, I Est.9:35; Ζαβαδαῖος, I Est.9:21)
Zebedee, father of James and John the Apostles: Mat.4:21 10:2 20:20 26:37 27:56, Mrk.1:19-20 3:17 10:35, Luk.5:10, Jhn.21:2.†
(AS)

G2344.strong_def: a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively)

G1682.def:
ἐλωί
(-ΐ Rec.; ἑλωΐ LT; Aram. אֱלָהּ),
Eloi: Mat.27:46, Mrk.15:34" (LXX) .†
(AS)
G1682.derivation: of Chaldean origin (H0426 with pronominal suffix) my God

G2541.def:
Καῖσαρ, -αρος, ὁ
Cæsar: Mat.22:17, Luk.2:1, Jhn.19:12, Act.25:8 ff., al
(AS)
G2541.strong_def: Cæsar, a title of the Roman emperor

G3861.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and G1391 (δόξα) (in the sense of seeming);

G0700.def:
ἀρέσκω
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
1. to please (Hom., Hdt., al.): with dative of person(s), Mat.14:6, Mrk.6:22, Rom.8:8 15:2, 1Th.2:15 4:1, 1Co.7:32-34 Gal.1:10, 2Ti.2:4; before ἐνώπισν (= Heb. בּעֵנֵי, Bl., § 37, 1; 40, 7), Ac 65.
2. In late Gk., esp. in Inscr., to render service to (see M, Th., ICC, 1 Co., ll with; Cremer, 640 f.); Rom.15:1, 3, 1Co.10:33, 1Th.2:4.†
(AS)
G0700.strong_def: to be agreeable (or by implication, to seek to be so)
G0700.derivation: probably from G142 (αἴρω) (through the idea of exciting emotion);

G3568.gloss: henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this (time)
G3568.strong_def: "now" (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or immediate
G3568.derivation: a primary particle of present time;

G2336.def:
Θήκη, -ης, ἡ
(τίθημι), [in LXX: Exo.25:27 (בַּיִת), Isa.6:13 3:26 * ;]
a receptacle, chest, case: of the sheath of a sword, Jhn.18:11.†
(AS)

G1005.def:
βορρᾶς, -ᾶ (Attic contr. of Βορέας, the North wind personified),
[in LXX for צָפוֹן ;]
1. Boreas, the North wind.
2. the north: Luk.13:29, Rev.21:13.
† (AS)

G1565.def:
ἐκεῖνος, -η, -ο
(ἐκεῖ), [in LXX chiefly for הַהוּא ,הוּא, and cogn. forms ;]
demonstr. pron.,
that person or thing (ille), implying remoteness as compared with οὗτος (hic);
1. absol., emphatic he, she, it: opposite to οὗτος, Luk.18:14, Jas.4:15; ἡμεῖς, Heb.12:25; ὑμεῖς, Mrk.4:11; ἄλλοι, Jhn.9:9; ἐγώ, Jhn.3:30; to persons named, Mk 16:[10, 13, 20], Jhn.2:21; of one (absent) who is not named, contemptuously (Abbott, JG, §§2385, 2732), Jhn.7:11 9:28; with respect, of Christ, 1Jo.2:6 3:3, al.; referring to a preceding noun, Mrk.16:[10], Jhn.7:45; resumption of a participial subject, Jhn.1:33 9:37 10:1, Rom.14:14, al. (on its reference in Jhn.19:35, see Westc, in l.; Moffatt, Intr., 568; Sanday, Fourth Gospel, 77ff.).
2. As adj., joined, like οὗτος, to a noun with the article: Mat.7:25, Mrk.3:24, Jhn.18:15, al.; esp. of time, past or future: ἐν τ. ἡμέραις ἐ., Mat.3:1, Mrk.1:9, Act.2:18" (LXX), al.; ἐν ἐ. τ. ἡμέρᾳ, esp of the Parousia, Mat.7:22, Luk.6:23, 2Th.1:10, 2Ti.1:12; adverbially, ἐκεινής (sc. ὁδοῦ) = cl. ἐκεινῇ (Bl., §36, 13), that way, Luk.19:4.
(AS)
G1565.strong_def: that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the article prefixed

G4899.strong_def: chosen in company with, i.e. co-elect (fellow Christian)
G4899.derivation: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G1586 (ἐκλέγομαι);

G4052.gloss: (make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above)
G4052.strong_def: to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel

G1396.def:
δουλαγωγέω, -ῶ
(δοῦλος, ἄγω),
to make a slave, bring into bondage: 1Co.9:27 (Cremer, 703).†
(AS)
G1396.strong_def: to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue)
G1396.derivation: from a presumed compound of G1401 (δοῦλος) and G71 (ἄγω);

G1654.def:
ἐλεημοσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(ἐλεέω), [in LXX chiefly for חֶסֶד, צְדָקָה ;]
1. mercy, pity.
2. almsgiving, alms (like the German Almosen, a corruption of the Greek word ἐ): Mat.6:4; ποιεῖν ἐ., Mat.6:2-3, Act.9:36 10:2 24:17; ἐ. διδόναι, Luk.11:41 (cf. Mat.23:36; Dalman, Words, 62 f.) 12:33; αἰτεῖν, Act.3:2; λαβεῖν, Act.3:3; πρὸς (in order to ask) ἐ., Act.3:10; pl., Act.10:4, 31 (Cremer, 711).†
(AS)
G1654.strong_def: compassionateness, i.e. (as exercised towards the poor) beneficence, or (concretely) a benefaction

G2553.def:
κακοπαθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jon.4.10 (עָמָל)* ;]
to suffer evil, endure Affliction: 2Ti.2:9 4:5, Jas.5:13.†
(AS)

G5591.strong_def: sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from G4152 (πνευματικός), which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from G5446 (φυσικός), which is the lower or bestial nature)

G2152.def:
εὐσεβής, -ές
(εὖ, σέβομαι), [in LXX: Pro.12:12, Isa.24:16 26:7 (צַדִּיק), Mic.7:2 (חָסִיד), Isa.32:8 (נָדִיב), and frequently in Sirach and 4Maccabees ;]
pious, godly, devout: Act.10:2, 7, 2Pe.2:9.†
SYN.: θεοσεβής, θρῆσκος (see Tr., Syn., § xlviii; DB, ii, 221 f.; Cremer, 524 f., 858) (AS)

G2784.def:
κηρύσσω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to be a herald, to proclaim: Mrk.1:45 7:36, Luk.4:18-19" (LXX) (but see Field, Notes, 174) Luk.8:39, Rom.2:21, 1Co.9:27, Gal.5:11, al.; in NT, chiefly of the proclamation of the Gospel, to proclaim, preach: τὸ εὐαγέλιον, Mat.4:23 9:35 24:14 26:13, Mrk.1:14 13:10 14:9 16:15, Gal.2:2, Col.1:23, 1Th.2:9; before εἰς, Mrk.1:39 13:10, Luk.4:44, 1Th.2:9; ἵνα, Mrk.6:12; with inf.. Rom.2:21; κ. Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν, Act.8:5 9:20 19:13, 1Co.1:23 15:12, 2Co.1:19 11:4, Php.1:15; 1Ti.3:16 (cf. προ-κηρύσσω)
(AS)
G2784.strong_def: to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel)

G4420.derivation: from a derivative of G4072 (πέτομαι) (meaning a feather);

G0324.def:
ἀνα-δέχομαι
[in LXX: 2Ma.6:19 2Mac 8:36 * ;]
1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, Heb.11:17.
2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, Act.28:7.†
(AS)

G1937.def:
ἐπιθυμέω, -ῶ
(θυμός), [in LXX chiefly for אָוָה pi., hithp.; also for חָמַד, etc. ;]
to set one's heart upon, desire, lust after, covet: absol., Jas.4:2, Rom.7:7 13:9" (LXX), 1Co.10:6 (of. 4Ma.2:6); before κατά (against, in opposition to), Gal.5:17; prop. (as in cl.) with genitive, Act.20:33, 1Ti.3:1; in late Gk. also with accusative (M, Pr., 65), Mat.5:28 (Rec. αὐτῆς; T omits; cf. Exo.20:17, Mic.2:2, Wis.16:3, al.); with inf., Mat.13:17, Luk.15:16 16:21 17:22, 1Pe.1:12, Rev.9:6; with accusative and inf., Heb.6:11; as in Hebrew, ἐπιθυμία ἐπεθύμησα, Luk.22:15.†
SYN.: ὀρέγω (cf. Field, Notes, 204), θέλω (DCG. i, 453) (AS)
G1937.strong_def: to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise)

G1399.def:
δούλη, ἡ, see: δοῦλος.
δοῦλος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX, ὁ δ. nearly always for עֶבֶד; ὁ δ. chiefly for שִׁפְחָה ,אָמָה ;]
1. in bondage to, subject to: Rom.6:19.
2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ δ., a slave;
(a) fem., ἡ δ., a female slave, bondmaid (Cremer, 702; DB, iii, 215): Luk.1:38, 48 Act.2:18" (LXX) ;
(b) masc., ὁ δ., a slave, bond-man: Mat.8:9 18:23, al.; opposite to ἐλεύθερος, 1Co.7:22 12:13, Gal.3:28, Eph.6:8, Col.3:11, Rev.6:15 13:16 19:18; opposite to κύριος, δεσπότης, οἰκοδεσπότης, Mat.10:24 13:27, 28 Luk.12:46, Jhn.15:15, Eph.6:5, Col.3:22 4:1, al.; metaphorically, δ. Χριστοῦ, τοῦ Χρ., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Rom.1:1, 1Co.7:22, Gal.1:10, Eph.6:6, Php.1:1, Col.4:12, Jas.1:1, 2Pe.1:1, Ju 1; δ. τ. θεοῦ, τ. κυρίου, Act.16:17, 2Ti.2:24, Tit.1:1, 1Pe.2:16, Rev.7:3 15:3; δ. πονηρός, ἀχρεῖος, κακός, Mat.18:32 24:48 25:26, 30, Luk.17:10 19:22; δ. ἁμαρτίας, Jhn.8:34, Rom.6:17, 20; τ. φθορᾶς, 2Pe.2:19.
SYN.: διάκονος (q.V.), θεράπων, ὐπηρέτης (see DB, iii, 377; iv, 461, 469; DCG, i, 221; ii, 613; Cremer, 215, 702). (AS)

G3110.strong_def: a Macedon (Macedonian), i.e. inhabitant of Macedonia

G0015.strong_def: to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty)

G2188.def:
ἐφφαθά (Aram. אֶתְפְּתח, see Abbott, Essays, 142 ff.; DCG, i, 522)
ephphatha, be opened: Mrk.7:34.†
(AS)

G5499.derivation: from G5495 (χείρ) and a derivative of G4160 (ποιέω);

G0843.def:
αὐτο-κατά-κριτος, -ον
(αὐτός, κατακρίνω),
self-condemned: Tit.3:11 (Eccl., Cremer, 377; MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0843.derivation: from G846 (αὐτός) and a derivative or G2632 (κατακρίνω);

G2235.def:
ἤδη
adv.,
in NT, always of time; now, already: Mat.3:10, Mrk.4:37, Luk.7:6, Jhn.4:36, al.; νῦν . . . ἤ., now already, 1Jn.4:3; ἤ. ποτέ, now at length, with fut., Rom.1:10 (cf. ἄρτι)
(AS)
G2235.derivation: apparently from G2228 (ἤ) (or possibly G2229 (ἦ)) and G1211 (δή);

G2793.def:
κινδυνεύω
(κίνδυνος), [in LXX for יָקֹשׁ ni., etc. ;]
1. to be daring, to venture.
2. to be in danger: Luk.8:23, Act.19:27, 40, 1Co.15:30.†
(AS)

G1294.def:
δια-στρέφω
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, עָקַשׁ, etc. ;]
to distort, twist; metaphorically, to distort, pervert: Luk.23:2, Act.13:8, 10; διεστραμμένος, perverse: Mat.17:17, Luk.9:41, Act.20:30, Php.2:15.†
(AS)
G1294.strong_def: to distort, i.e. (figuratively) misinterpret, or (morally) corrupt

G2280.def:
Θαδδαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Aram. תּדִאַי, תַּדַּי),
Thaddæus: Mat.10:3, Mrk.3:18 (WH, mg., Λεββαῖος, which see).†
(AS)

G3611.strong_def: to occupy a house, i.e. reside (figuratively, inhabit, remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit

G2721.def:
κατ-εφ-ίστημι
to rise up against: Act.18:12.†
(AS)
G2721.strong_def: to stand over against, i.e. rush upon (assault)

G1472.def:
ἐγχρίω,
[in LXX: Jer.4:30 (קרע). Tob.2:10 6:8 11:7 * ;]
to rub in, anoint: mid., with dupl. accusative, Rev.3:18.†
(AS)

G0357.def:
ἀνα-λογίζομαι
[in LXX: Wis.17:13 א, 2Ma.12:43 A, 3Ma.7:7 * ;]
to consider: Heb.12:3 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4640.strong_def: to jump, i.e. sympathetically move (as the quickening of a fetus)

G1541.def:
ἑκατονταετής (Rec. έτης), -ές
(ἑκατόν, ἔτης) [in LXX for שָׁנֶה מֵאָה בֵּן, Gen.17:17 * ;]
a hundred years old: Rom.4:19.†
(AS)

G0494.def:
Ἀντιπατρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
Antipatris, bet. Joppa and Caesarea: Act.23:31.†
(AS)

G0272.def:
ἀμελέω, -ῶ
(μέλει), [in LXX: Jer.4:17 (מָרָה) Jer.31:32 (בַּעַל), Wis.3:10, 2Ma.4:14 * ;]
(a) absol., to be careless, not to care: Mat.22:5;
(b) with genitive, to be careless of, to neglect: 1Ti.4:14, Heb.2:3 8:9 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0272.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3199 (μέλω);

G0032.def:
ἄγγελος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for מַלְאָךְ ;]
1. a messenger, one sent: Mat.11:10, Jas.22:25.
2. As in LXX, in the special sense of angel, a spiritual, heavenly being, attendant upon God and employed as his messenger to men, to make known his purposes, as Luk.1:11, or to execute them, as Mat.4:6. The ἄ. in Rev.1:20-2:1, al., is variously understood as
(1) a messenger or delegate,
(2) a bishop or ruler,
(3) a guardian angel,
(4) the prevailing spirit of each church, i.e. the Church itself. (Cf. Swete, Ap)., in l.; DB, iv, 991; Thayer, see word; Cremer, 18; MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0032.strong_def: compare G34 (ἀγέλη)) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor

G1434.def:
δώρημα, -τος, τό
(δωρέω), [in LXX: Sir.31:18 (Sir.34:18)* ;]
a gift, boon: Rom.5:16, Jas.1:17.†
SYN.: see: δόμα (AS)

G3501.strong_def: "new", i.e. (of persons) youthful, or (of things) fresh; figuratively, regenerate
G3501.derivation: including the comparative ; a primary word;

G2257.def:
ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς,
of person(s) pron.
I.
(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in Mat.3:11, Mrk.1:8, Luk.3:16, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as Mat.10:16, Jhn.10:17; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. 1Ki.3:8), Act.9:10; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, Jhn.1:23 (LXX), Act.7:32 (LXX).
(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, Jhn.14:20; μου τ. λόγους, Mat.7:24; ὀπίσω μου, Mat.3:11; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, Rev.5:5; also with the prep. πρός, as Mrk.9:19, al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as Luk.10:16, Jhn.7:23, Mrk.14:7, al.
(with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, Mat.2:6; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, Mrk.9:24.
(d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, Jdg.11:12, al.), i.e. what have we in common: Mat.8:29, Mrk.1:24, 5:7, Luk.8:28, Jhn.2:4; τί γάρ μοι, 1Co.5:2.
(e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).
(f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: Mat.2:8, Luk.2:48, Jhn.6:56, Rom.3:7, 1Co.7:40, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, Jhn.7:28.
(AS)

G1983.def:
ἐπι-σκοπέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּקַד ni., etc. ;]
1. to look upon, observe, examine: before μή, Heb.12:16.
2. As ἐπισκέπτομαι in LXX, NT, to visit, care for: 1Pe.5:2 (R, txt.; WH cm.; Cremer, 527).†
(AS)
G1983.strong_def: to oversee; by implication, to beware

G2752.def:
κέλευσμα, -τος, τό
(κελεύω), [in LXX: Pro.30:27 * ;]
a call, summons, shout of command: 1Th.4:16 (see M, Th., in l).†
(AS)

G3062.gloss: other, which remain, remnant, residue, rest
G3062.derivation: masculine plural of a derivative of G3007 (λείπω);

G0604.def:
ἀπο-κατ-αλλάσσω
(cf. καταλλάσσω: ἀπό here signifies completely, see Lft., Col., l.with; Ellic., Eph., l.with; but also Mey., Eph., l.with),
to reconcile completely: Eph.2:16, Col.1:20-21.†
(AS)

G2236.def:
ἥδιστα, see: ἡδέως.
ἡδέως
adv. (ἡδύς, sweet), [in LXX: Pro.3:24 (עָרַב), etc. ;]
gladly, with pleasure: Mrk.6:20 12:37, 2Co.11:19; superlat., ἥδιστα, very gladly (B1., § 11, 3), 2Co.12:9 12:15.†
(AS)
G2236.derivation: neuter plural of the superlative of the same as G2234 (ἡδέως);

G5275.strong_def: to leave under (behind), i.e. (passively) to remain (survive)

G2513.def:
καθαρός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for טָהוֹר ;]
pure, clean.
1. Physically: Mat.23:26 27:59, Jhn.13:10-11 (fig.), Jhn.15:3 (figuratively, as of a vine cleansed by pruning), Heb.10:22, Rev.15:6 19:8, 14 21:18, 21.
2. Ceremonially: Luk.11:41, Rom.14:20, Tit.1:15.
3. Ethically;
(a) of persons: Jhn.13:16, Act.18:6, Tit.1:15; ό κ. τῇ καρδίᾳ (καθαρὸς χεῖρας, Hdt., i, 35), Mat.5:8; before ἀπό (cl. with genitive simp.; ΒΙ., § 36, 11; Deiss., BS, 196; MM, Exp., xv), Act.20:26;
(b) of things: καρδία, 1Ti.1:6, 2Ti.2:22; συνείδησις, 1Ti.3:9, 2Ti.1:3; θρησκεία, Jas.1:27.†
SYN.: see: ἁγνός. (AS)

G1067.def:
γέεννα (γέενα, Mrk.9:45, Rec.), -ης, ἡ (perh. through Aram. גֵּיהִנָּם, from Heb. גֵּי הִנֹּם, Neh.11:30; גֵּי בֶּן־הִנֹּם, Jhn.18:16; גֵּי בּנֵי־הִנֹּם, 4Ki.23:10; valley of (the son, sons of) lamentation);
[in LXX the nearest approach to γ. is γαίεννα, Jos.18:16 (Γαὶ Ὀννόμ, A), elsewhere φάραγξ Ὀνόμ (Jos.15:8, al.), V. Swete on Mrk.9:43 ;]
Gehenna, a valley W. and S. of Jerusalem, which as the site of fire-worship from the time of Ahaz, was desecrated by Josiah and became a dumping-place for the offal of the city. Later, the name was used as a symbol of the place of future punishment, as in NT: Mat.5:29, ; 10:28, Mrk.9:43, 45 47, Luk.12:5, Jas.3:6; γ. τ. πυρός, Mat.5:22 18:19, prob. with ref. to fires of Moloch (DB, ii, 119b); υἱὸς γεέννης, Mat.23:15; κρίσις γεέννης, 23:33.†
(AS)
G1067.strong_def: valley of (the son of) Hinnom; ge-henna (or Ge-Hinnom), a valley of Jerusalem, used (figuratively) as a name for the place (or state) of everlasting punishment

G1043.def:
Γαβριήλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גַּבְרִיאֵל, hero of God),
the archangel Gabriel: Luk.1:19, 26.†
(AS)

G1264.def:
δια-μάχομαι
[in LXX for לחם ni., Dan LXX 10:20; Sir.8:1, 3 38:28 51:19 * ;]
1. to struggle against.
2. In argument, to contend: Act.23:9.†
(AS)

G1023.def:
βραχίων, -ὀνος, ὁ,
[in LXX, β. Κυρίου, frequently for זְרוֹעַ יהוָֹה ;]
the arm; as in OT, β. Κυρίου, metaphorically, for the Divine power: Luk.1:51, Jhn.12:38" (LXX), Act.13:17.†
(AS)
G1023.derivation: properly, comparative of G1024 (βραχύς), but apparently in the sense of (to wield);

G3617.gloss: goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house

G5228.gloss: (+ exceeding, abundantly) above, in (on) behalf of, beyond, by, + very chiefest, concerning, exceeding (above, -ly), for, + very highly, more (than), of, over, on the part of, for sake of, in stead, than, to(-ward), very
G5228.strong_def: "over", i.e. (with the genitive case) of place, above, beyond, across, or causal, for the sake of, instead, regarding; with the accusative case superior to, more than

G0869.def:
ἄφνω
adv., [in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם ;]
suddenly: Act.2:2 16:26 28:6.†
(AS)

G4337.gloss: (give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard
G4337.strong_def: (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to

G3931.derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and a derivative of G58 (ἀγορά) (meaning to harangue an assembly);

G2748.def:
κέδρος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אֶרֶז, Num.24:6, al.; χειμάρρους τῶν Κέδρων, 2Ki.15:23, 3Ki.15:13 (קִדְרוֹן) ;]
a cedar: χείμαρρος τῶν Κ. (as in 2Sam, 1Ki, ll. with), Jhn.18:1 (Rec. Tr., WH, R, mg.; τοῦ Κέδρου, T, WH, mg., see: Κεδρών, and cf. Westc., in l; WH, App., 89 f.; Abbott, JG, 513 ff).†
Κεδρών
(see: κέδρος), ὁ,
indecl.
(in FlJ, genitive -ῶνος; Heb. קִדְרוֹן), [in LXX: 2Ki.15:23, 4Ki.23:6, al. ;]
Cedron (OT, Kidron): χείμαρρος τοῦ Κ., Jhn.18:1 (L, Tr., mg., R, txt.; cf. Bl., 10, 5; Lft., Essays, 172 ff).†
(AS)
G2748.strong_def: Cedron (i.e. Kidron), a brook near Jerusalem

G3886.gloss: feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy
G3886.strong_def: to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled)

G1878.def:
ἐπ-ανα-μιμνήσκω
to remind again: with accusative of person(s), Rom.15:15.†
(AS)

G2232.def:
ἡγεμών, -όνος, ὁ
(ἡγέομαι) [in LXX for אַלּוּף, שַׂר, etc. ;]
1. a leader, guide.
2. a commander.
3. a governor of a province (pro­consul, proprietor, legate, or procurator; but cf. ἀνθύπατος): Mat.10:18, Mrk.13:9, Luk.21:12, 1Pe.2:14; of the Procurator of Judæa, Mat.27:2, 11 27:14-15, 21 27:27 28:14, Luk.20:20, Act.23:24, 26 23:33 24:1, 10 26:30.
4. For Heb. אַלְפֵי (LXX, χίλιαι) misread אַלֻּפֵי, leaders: Mat.2:6 (OT).†
(AS)
G2232.strong_def: a leader, i.e. chief person (or figuratively, place) of a province

G3120.strong_def: soft, i.e. fine (clothing); figuratively, a catamite

G2465.def:
ἰσάγγελος -ον
(ἴσος, ἄγγελος),
like or equal to angels: Luk.20:36.†
(AS)

G1692.def:
ἐμέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Isa.19:14 (קֵא)* ;]
to vomit: figuratively, Rev.3:16.†
(AS)

G0916.def:
βαρέω, -ῶ (later form of βαρύνω, which see),
[in LXX: Exo.7:14 (כָּבֵד), 2Ma.13:9 * ;]
to depress, weigh down. In NT, in pass. only: Mat.26:43, Luk.9:32 21:34, 2Co.1:8 5:4, 1Ti.5:16.†
(AS)

G3962.strong_def: a "father" (literally or figuratively, near or more remote)

G5005.derivation: from the base of G5007 (τάλαντον) and a derivative of the base of G3984 (πεῖρα);

G0955.def:
Βελίαλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בְּלִיַּעַל, worthlessness, but see DB, i, 268),
Belial, a name of Satan: 2Co.6:15, Rec. See next word.†
Βελιάρ, ὁ, indecl. (another form of previous word, "due to harsh Syriac pronunciation," or else Heb. בֵּל יַעַר, lord of the forest),
Beliar, a name of Satan: 2Co.6:15 (see DB, i, 269).†
(AS)
G0955.strong_def: worthlessness; Belial, as an epithet of Satan

G4979.strong_def: of uncertain derivation); a rushlet, i.e. grass-withe or tie (generally)

G2758.def:
κενόω, -ῶ
(κενός, which see), [in LXX: Jer.14:2 15:9 (עָמָל pu.)* ;]
to empty. Metaphorical, to empty, make empty, vain or of no effect: καύχημα, 1Co.9:15; ἑαυτόν, of Christ, Php.2:7 (v Lft.; ICC, in 1, and esp. Gifford, Incarn., 54 ff.); pass., πίστις, Rom.4:14; ὁ σταυρός, 1Co.1:17; καύχημα, 2Co.9:3†
(AS)
G2758.strong_def: to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify

G0143.def:
αἰσθάνομαι,
[in LXX for בּין, חפז, ידע ;]
to perceive: withaccusative of thing(s) (Bl., §36, 5; MM, VGT, see word), Luk.9:45 (Cremer, 619 f.).†
(AS)

G0007.def:
Ἀβιά (Heb. אֲבִיָּה, אֲבִיָּהוּ), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀβίας, -α),
Abia, Abijah.
1. Son of Rehoboam (3Ki.14:1): Mat.1:7.
2. A priest of the line of Eleazar (1Ch.24:3, 10): Luk.1:5.
† (AS)
G0007.strong_def: Abijah, the name of two Israelites

G5111.strong_def: probably itself from the base of G5056 (τέλος) through the idea of extreme conduct); to venture (objectively or in act; while G2292 (θαῤῥέω) is rather subjective or in feeling); by implication, to be courageous

G0817.def:
ἄτερ
prep., [in LXX: 2Ma.12:15 * ;]
in cl. most frequently in poets; without, apart from: with genitive, Luk.22:6, 35 (for exx. from π., see MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0817.strong_def: aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively)
G0817.derivation: a particle probably akin to G427 (ἄνευ);

G4950.strong_def: a shoal (from the sand drawn thither by the waves), i.e. the Syrtis Major or great bay on the north coast of Africa

G0086.def:
ᾅδης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX ehiefly for שְׁאוֹל, also for דּוּמָה, מָוֶת, etc. ;]
1. in Hom., Hades (Pluto), the god of the underworld.
2. the abode of Hades, the underivorld; in NT, the abode of departed spirits, Hades: ἐν τ. ᾅ., Luk.16:23; εἰς ᾅ., Act.2:27,31; πύλαι ᾅδου, Mat.16:18; κλεῖς τοῦ ᾅ., Rev.1:18; metaphorically, ἕως ᾅ., Mat.11:23, Luk.10:15; personified, Rev.6:8 20:13,14 (Cremer, 67, 610; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0086.strong_def: properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls
G0086.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1492 (εἴδω);

G0315.def:
ἀναγκάζω
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Pro.6:7 (שֹׁטֵר), I Est.3:24, 1Ma.2:25, al. ;]
to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain: with accusative, 2Co.12:11; id. with inf., Mat.14:22, Mrk.6:45, Luk.14:23, Act.26:11 (on the imperfect here, see Field, Notes, 141; M, Pr., 128 f., 247), Gal.2:14 6:12; pass., C. inf., Act.28:19, Gal.2:3 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4518.strong_def: thou hast left me; sabachthani (i.e. shebakthani), a cry of distress
G4518.derivation: of Chaldee or (H07662 with pronominal suffix);

G1469.def:
ἐγ-κρίνω, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-κρίνω (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν),
to reckon among : ἑαυτούς, 2Co.10:12.†
(AS)
G1469.strong_def: to judge in, i.e. count among

G1015.def:
βουνός, -οῦ, ὁ (a Cyrenaїc word, Hdt., iv, 199),
[in LXX chiefly for גִּבְעָה ;]
a hill: Luk.3:5 (LXX) 23:30.†
(AS)

G5127.gloss: here(-by), him, it, + such manner of, that, thence(-forth), thereabout, this, thus
G5127.strong_def: of (from or concerning) this (person or thing)
G5127.derivation: genitive case singular masculine or neuter of G3778 (οὗτος);

G0580.def:
ἀπο-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποβάλλω);
1. a throwing away, rejection: opposite to πρόσλημψις, Rom.11:15.
2. a losing, loss: Act.27:22.†
(AS)

G4889.strong_def: a co-slave, i.e. servitor or ministrant of the same master (human or divine)

G3328.strong_def: to throw over, i.e. (middle voice figuratively) to turn about in opinion

G3709.strong_def: properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment

G0420.def:
ἀνεξί-κακος, -ον
(fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός)
patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, Wis.2:19; and see MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.2:24.†
(AS)

G0101.def:
ἀδυνατέω, -ῶ
(ἀδύνατος), [in LXX: Deu.17:8, Zec.8:6 (פּלא ni.), Job.42:2 (בּצר ni.), al. ;]
1. Abbott-Smith omits this number to be unable (cl., Philo; π., see MM, VGT, see word).
2. In LXX and NT (Kennedy, Sources, 124; Hatch, Essays, 4; Field, Notes, 46 f.), to be impossible: Mat.17:20, Luk.1:37.
† (AS)

G1837.def:
ἐξ-ηχέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jol.3:14 (הָמוֹן), Sir.40:13, 3Ma.3:2 * ;]
to sound forth (as a trumpet, or thunder; see M, Th., l.with): pass., 1Th.1:8.†
(AS)
G1837.strong_def: to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported)
G1837.derivation: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G2278 (ἠχέω);

G3161.strong_def: Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite and a Christian

G2011.def:
ἐπι-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.13:14 * ;]
power to decide, authority: Act.26:12.†
(AS)

G0480.def:
ἀντί-κειμαι
[in LXX for אָיַב, צוּר, שָׂטַן, etc. ;]
1. to lie opposite to.
2. to oppose, withstand, resist: with dative, Luk.13:17 21:15, Gal.5:17, 1Ti.1:10; as participial subst. (ὁ) ἀντικείμενος, 1Co.16:9, Php.1:28, 2Th.2:4, 1Ti.5:14 (Cremer, 746).†
(AS)
G0480.strong_def: to lie opposite, i.e. be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to

G1620.def:
ἐκ-τίθημι
[in LXX for נָתַן ni., etc. ;]
to set out, expose: Act.7:21, Metaphorical, to set forth, expound: Act.11:4 28:23; with accusative of thing(s), Act.18:26.†
(AS)

G1774.def:
ἐν-οικέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly (29/36) for יָשַׁב ;]
to dwell in; metaphorically, before ἐν, with dative of person(s): ὁ θεός, 2Co.6:16; τ. πνεῦμα, Rom.8:11, 2Ti.1:14; ὁ λόγος, Col.3:16; πίστις, 2Ti.1:5; ἁμαρτία, Rom.7:17.†
(AS)

G3609.strong_def: domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent

G0361.def:
ἀναμάρτητος, -ον
(ἁμαρτεῖν), [in LXX: Deu.29:19 (18) 2Ma.8:4 2Mac 12:42 * ;]
1. without missing, unerring (Xen.).
2. In moral sense, faultless (Plat.), without sin: Jhn.8:7 (see Cremer, 102, 634; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0361.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G264 (ἁμαρτάνω);

G2480.def:
ἰσχύω
(ἰσχύς), [in LXX for חָזַק, גִּבּוֹר, עָצַם, etc. ;]
1. to be strong in body: Mat.9:12, Mrk.2:17.
2. to be powerful, have power, prevail: Act.19:20, Rev.12:8; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), Act.19:16; with inf., to be able (MM, Exp., xv): Mat.8:28 26:40, Mrk.5:4 9:18 (inf. understood) Mrk.14:37, Luk.6:48 8:43 13:24 14:6, 29-30 16:3 20:26, Jhn.21:6, Act.6:10 15:10 25:7 27:16; with accusative, Php.4:13, Jas.5:16; of things, to avail, be serviceable (MM, Exp., l.with): Mat.5:13, Gal.5:6, Heb.9:17 (cf. ἐν-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-ισχύω).†
(AS)
G2480.strong_def: to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively)

G3868.strong_def: to beg off, i.e. deprecate, decline, shun
G3868.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G154 (αἰτέω);

G4638.strong_def: an encampment, i.e. (figuratively) the Temple (as God's residence), the body (as a tenement for the soul)

G2766.def:
κεραμος, -ου, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: 2Ki.17:28 (יָצַר כְּלִי)* ;]
1. potter's clay.
2. an earthen vessel.
3. a tile: Luk.5:19.†
(AS)
G2766.strong_def: earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning)
G2766.derivation: probably from the base of G2767 (κεράννυμι) (through the idea of mixing clay and water);

G5221.strong_def: to go opposite (meet) under (quietly), i.e. to encounter, fall in with
G5221.derivation: from G5259 (ὑπό) and a derivative of G473 (ἀντί);

G2354.def:
θρηνέω, -ῶ
(θρῆνος), [in LXX chiefly for יָלַל hi., also for קַיִן pit., etc. ;]
1. intrans., to lament, wail: Mat.11:17, Luk.7:32, Jhn.16:20.
2. Trans., to bewail: with accusative of person(s), Luk.23:27.†
SYN.: κλαίω, κόπτομαι, λυπέομαι, πενθέω (see Tr., Syn., lxv). (AS)

G3054.derivation: from a compound of G3056 (λόγος) and G3164 (μάχομαι);

G4005.strong_def: fiftieth (G2250 (ἡμέρα) being implied) from Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost"
G4005.derivation: feminine of the ordinal of G4004 (πεντήκοντα);

G2980.gloss: preach, say, speak (after), talk, tell, utter
G2980.derivation: a prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb;

G5264.strong_def: to admit under one's roof, i.e. entertain hospitably

G2657.def:
κατα-νοέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc. ;]
to take note of, perceive, consider carefully: Act.7:31-32; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.7:3, Luk.6:41 12:24, 27 20:23, Act.11:6 27:39, Rom.4:19; with accusative of person(s), Heb.3:1 10:24, Jas.1:23-24 (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, Pr., 117).†
(AS)

G0483.def:
ἀντι-λέγω
[in LXX: Hos.4:4 (רִיב hi.), Isa.50:5 (סוּג ni.) Isa.22:22 65:2, Sir.4:25, 3Ma.2:28, 4Ma.4:7 4Mac 8:2 * ;]
cοntradict, oppose, resist (see Field, Notes, 106; MM, VGT, see word); absol.: Act.28:19, Rom.10:21, Tit.1:9 2:9; with dative, Jhn.19:12, Act.13:45; with accusative and inf., Luk.20:27 T; pass., Luk.2:34, Act.28:22.†
(AS)

G2282.def:
θάλπω
[in LXX for סָכַן, etc. ;]
to heat, warm; metaphorically,

ἐχθρός, -ά, -όν

G1174.def:
δεισι-δαίμων, -ον

G1063.def:
γάρ,
co-ordinating particle, contr. of γε ἄρα,
verily then, hence, in truth, indeed, yea, then, why, and when giving a reason or explanation, for, the usage in NT being in general accord with that of cl.;
1. explicative and epexegetic: Mat.4:18 19:12, Mrk.1:16 5:42 16:4, Luk.11:3o, Rom.7:1, 1Co.16:5, al.
2. Conclusive, in questions, answers and exclamations: Mat.9:5 27:23, Luk.9:25 22:27, Jhn.9:30, Act.8:31 16:37 19:35, Rom.15:26, 1Co.9:10, Php.1:18 (Ellic., in l.), 1Th.2:20, al.
3. Causal: Mat.1:21 2:2, 5, 6, 3:23, Mrk.1:22, 9:6, Luk.1:15, 18, Jhn.2:25, Act.2:25, Rom.1:9, 11, 1Co.11:5, Rev.1:3, al.; giving the reason for a command or prohibition, Mat.2:20 3:9, Rom.13:11, Col.3:3, 1Th.4:3, al.; where the cause is contained in an interrog. statement, Luk.22:27, Rom.3:3 4:3, 1Co.10:29; καὶ γάρ, for also, Mrk.10:45, Luk.6:32, 1Co.5:7, al. id. as in cl. = etenim, where the καί loses its connective force (Bl., §78, 6; Kühner 3, ii, 854f.), Mrk.14:70, Luk.1:66 22:37, 2Co.13:4. The proper place of γάρ is after the first word in a clause, but in poets it often comes third or fourth, and so in late prose: 2Co.1:19. Yet "not the number but the nature of the word after which it stands is the point to be noticed" (see Thayer, see word).
(AS)
G1063.strong_def: properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles)

(AS)

G4096.strong_def: perhaps akin to the alternate of G4095 (πίνω) through the idea of repletion); plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness (oiliness)

G4386.derivation: neuter of G4387 (πρότερος) as adverb (with or without the article);

G2590.def:
καρπός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for פְּרִי ;]
fruit: of trees, Mat.12:33 21:19, Mrk.11:14, Luk.6:44 13:6-7; of vines, Mat.21:34, Mrk.12:2, Luk.20:10, 1Co.9:7; of fields, Mrk.4:29, Luk.12:17, 2Ti.2:6, Jas.5:7; βλαστάνειν, Jas.5:18; ποιεῖν (cf. Heb. פְּרִי עָשָׂה), Mat.3:10 7:17-19 13:26, Luk.3:9 6:43 8:8 13:9, Rev.22:2; διδόναι, Mat.13:8, Mrk.4:7-8; φέρειν, Mat.7:18, Jhn.12:24 15:2, 4-5 15:8, 16; ἀποδιδόναι, Mat.21:41, Rev.22:2; ὁ κ. τ. κοιλίας (בֶּטֶן פְּרִי, Deu.28:4), Luk.1:42; τ. ὀσφύος (Gen.30:2, al.), Act.2:30.
Metaphorical,
(a) of works, deeds: Mat.3:8 7:16, 20 21:43, Luk.3:8, Jhn.15:3, 16; τ. πνεύματος, Gal.5:22; τ. φωτός, Eph.5:9; τ. δικαιοσύνης, Php.1:11; σφραγίζεσθαι τὸν κ. (Deiss., BS, 238 f.), Rom.15:28; κ. ἀγαθοί, Jas.3:17;
(b) of advantage, profit: Php.1:22 4:17; ἔχειν, Rom.1:13 6:21-22. συνάγειν, Jhn.4:36; κ. τ. δικαιοσύνης, Heb.12:11, Jas.3:18; of praise, καρπὸν χειλέων (Hos.14:2, al.; cf. Æsch., Eum., 830): Heb.13:15.†
(AS)
G2590.derivation: probably from the base of G726 (ἁρπάζω);

G1105.def:
γνόφος (later form of δν-),
[in LXX for אָפֵל, עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;]
darkness, gloom (including "an element of tempest," Tr., Syn., §with): Heb.12:18.†
SYN.: ἀχλύς, ζόφος, σκότος (Tr., l.with; DB, i, 457a). (AS)

G2179.def:
Ἐφεσῖνος, -η, -ον
Ephesian: Rev.2:1, Rec. (ἐν Ἐφέσῳ, WH, RV).†
(AS)

G3334.strong_def: to stir to a place elsewhere, i.e. remove (figuratively)

G3930.gloss: bring, do, give, keep, minister, offer, shew, + trouble
G3930.strong_def: to hold near, i.e. present, afford, exhibit, furnish occasion

G1378.def:
δόγμα, -τος, τό
(δοκέω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּת, טְעֵם ;]
1. an opinion.
2. A public decree, ordinance: of Roman rulers, Luk.2:1, Act.17:7; of the Jewish law, Eph.2:15, Col.2:14; of the Apostles, Act.16:4 (Cremer, 205).†
(AS)

G4027.strong_def: something cleaned off all around, i.e. refuse (figuratively)
G4027.derivation: from a compound of G4012 (περί) and G2508 (καθαίρω);

G3844.gloss: above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side…by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with
G3844.strong_def: properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of)

G1335.def:
δι-ήγησις, -εως, ἡ
(διηγέομαι), [in LXX: Jdg.7:15 מִסְפָּר Hab.2:6 חִידָה), frequently in (Sir.6:35, al.), 2Ma.2:32 2Mac 6:17 ;]
a narrative: Luk.1:1 (cf. Milligan, NTD, 130).†
(AS)

G2628.def:
κατ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jer.17:16 (רָאָה), 1Ma.6:23, al. ;]
to follow after: Luk.23:55; with dative of person(s), Act.16:17.†
(AS)

G2006.def:
ἐπιτήδειος, -α, -ον
[in LXX: 1Ch.28:2, Wis.4:5, 1Ma.4:46, al. ;]
1. suitable, convenient,
2. useful, necessary: τὰ ἐ., necessaries, Jas.2:16,†
(AS)

G2757.def:
κενοφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(κενός, φωνέω), [cf. κενολογέω (צָפַף), Isa.8:19 * ;]
empty talk, babbling: pl., 1Ti.6:20, 2Ti.2:16.†
(AS)
G2757.derivation: from a presumed compound of G2756 (κενός) and G5456 (φωνή);

G4639.strong_def: "shade" or a shadow (literally or figuratively (darkness of error or an adumbration))

G1157.def:
δανιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(late form of -ειστής, Rec.; see: δανείζω), [in LXX: 4Ki.4:1, Psa.108(109):11 (נשׁה), Pro.29:13 (רָשׁ), Sir.29:28 * ;]
a money-lender: Luk.7:41.†
(AS)

G2716.def:
κατ-εργάζομαι
(emphatic form of ἐργάζομαι), [in LXX for פָּעַל, etc. (9 exx., each for a different Heb. word) ;]
to effect by labour, achieve, work out, bring about: with accusative, Rom.4:15 5:3 7:8, 15-20, 2Co.7:10, Eph.6:13, Jas.1:3; pass., 2Co.12:12; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Rom.7:13, 2Co.4:17 7:11 9:11; id. before διά, with genitive of person(s), Rom.15:18; τ. σωτηρίαν, Php.2:12; with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, 2Co.5:5 (RV, wrought); of evil deeds, Rom.1:27 2:9, 1Co.5:3, 1Pe.4:3.†
(AS)
G2716.strong_def: to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion

G2593.def:
καρπο-φόρος, -ον
(καρπύς, φέρω), [in LXX: Jer.2:21 (זֶרַע), Psa.107:34 148:9 (פְּרִי) * ;]
fruitful: Act.14:17.†
(AS)

G4606.strong_def: a Sidonian, i.e. inhabitant of Sidon

G3953.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G3795 (ὀψάριον);

G1402.def:
δουλόω, -ῶ
(δοῦλος), [in LXX for עָבַד ;]
to enslave, bring into bondage: Act.7:6 (LXX), 2Pe.2:19; metaphorically, 1Co.9:19; pass., before ἐν, 1Co.7:15; τ. θεῷ, Rom.6:22; τ. δικαιοσύνῃ, Rom.6:18; οἴνῳ, Tit.2:3; ὑπὸ τὰ στοιχεῖα τ. κόσμου, Gal.4:3 (Cremer, 217).†
(AS)

G0882.def:
Ἀχαία (T, Ἀχαΐα), -ας, ἡ (Bl., § 46, 11)
Achaia, the Roman province: Act.18:12, 27 19:21 Rom.15:26, 1Co.16:15, 2Co.1:1 9:2 11:10, 1Th.1:7-8.†
(AS)
G0882.strong_def: Achaia (i.e. Greece), a country of Europe

G1819.def:
ἐξάπινα = ἐξαπίνης, ἐξαίφνης (which see),
[in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם, etc. ;]
suddenly: Mrk.9:8.†
(AS)
G1819.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of the same as G160 (αἰφνίδιος);

G2696.def:
κατα-σφραγίζω
[in LXX: Job.9:7 37:7 (חָתַם), Wis.2:5 * ;]
to seal up, secure with a seal: Rev.5:1.†
(AS)

G4151.strong_def: a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit

G4978.strong_def: a split or gap ("schism"), literally or figuratively

G4338.strong_def: to peg to, i.e. spike fast
G4338.derivation: from G4314 (πρός) and a derivative of G2247 (ἧλος);

G2908.derivation: neuter of an alternate form of G2909 (κρείττων);

G2013.def:
ἐπι-τυγχάνω
[in LXX: Gen.39:2 (צָלַח hi.), Pro.12:27 (חָרַךְ)* ;]
1. to light upon.
2. to obtain, attain to: Jas.4:2, with genitive of thing(s) (as in cl.), Heb.6:15 11:33; with accusative (late Gk.), Rom.11:7 (Rec. τούτου).†
(AS)
G2013.strong_def: to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain

G3306.gloss: abide, continue, dwell, endure, be present, remain, stand, tarry (for), X thine own
G3306.strong_def: to stay (in a given place, state, relation or expectancy)

G0568.def:
ἀπ-έχω
[in LXX chiefly for רָחַק ;]
1. trans.,
(a) to hold back, keep off;
(b) to have in full, to have received (on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, Pr., 109, 247): with accusative, Mat.6:2, 5 6:16, Luk.6:24, Php.4:18, Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; LAE, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, Notes, 39), it is enough: Mrk.14:41.
2. Intrans., to be away, distant: absol., Luk.15:20; before ἀπό, Mat.14:24 15:8, Mrk.7:6, Luk.7:6 15:20 24:13. Mid., to abstain: with genitive, Act.15:29, 1Ti.4:3, 1Pe.2:11; before ἀπό, Act.15:20, 1Th.4:3 5:22.†
(AS)
G0568.strong_def: (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively)

G2028.def:
ἐπ-ονομάζω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to name, call by a name, surname: pass., Rom.2:17.†
(AS)

G2853.def:
κολλάω, -ῶ
(κόλλα, glue), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;]
1. to glue or cement together.
2. Generally, to unite, to join firmly. Pass., to cleave to, join (oneself to): with dative of person(s), Mat.19:5(LXX), Luk.10:11 15:15, Act.5:13 (but see Field, Notes, 118) Act.9:26 10:28 (see Field, l.with) Act.17:34; τ. πόρνῃ, 1Co.6:16; τ. Κυρίῳ, 1Co.6:17; with dative of thing(s), ἅρματι, Act.8:29; τ. ἀγαθῴ, Rom.12:9; of sins joining together, ἄχρι τ. οὐρανοῦ, Rev.18:5, of dust, Luk.10:11 (cf. τροσ-κολλάω).†
(AS)
G2853.strong_def: to glue, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively)

G2333.def:
Θευδᾶς
(perh. contr. from Θεόδωρος, but see MM, Exp., xv), -ᾶ, ὁ
Theudas: Act.5:36.†
(AS)

G1847.def:
ἐξ-ουδενέω
(Rec. -όω; T, -θανόω), -ῶ, [in LXX (with vv. ll. -όω, -θενέω, -θενόω) for בּוּז, בָּזָה, מָאַס, בּוּס, etc. ;]
to despise, set at nought: Mrk.9:12 (cf. ἐξουθενέω).†
(AS)
G1847.strong_def: to make utterly nothing of, i.e. despise
G1847.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of the neuter of G3762 (οὐδείς);

G0872.def:
ἀφ-οράω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ma.17:10 (είς θεόν)* ;]
(a) to look away from all else at, fix one's gaze upon: metaphorically (MM, see word), Heb.12:2;
(b) simply, to see: ἀφίδω (see: ἀπεῖδον, and Lft., Phi., in l; MM, see word), Php.2:23 (see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

G4629.strong_def: perhaps akin to the base of G4649 (σκοπός) through the idea of noticeableness); clothing

G0579.def:
ἀπό-βλητος, -ον
(ἀποβάλλω), [in Aq.: Lev.7:18, al.; Sm.: Hos.9:3 (טָמֵא) ;]
to be thrown away, rejected: 1Ti.4:4 (Hom., Plut.).†
(AS)
G0579.strong_def: cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected

G1721.def:
ἔμ-φυτος, -ον
(ἐμφύω, to implant), [in LXX: ἔ. ἡ κακία αὐτῶν, Wis.12:10 * ;]
1. innate (Wis.12:10).
2. rooted, implanted: Jas.1:21 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)
G1721.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of G5453 (φύω);

G0163.def:
αἰχμαλωτίζω
(αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] in late writers = cl. αἰχμάλωτον ποιῶ (ἄγω),
to take or lead captive: before εἰς, Luk.21:24 (cf. Tob.1:10); metaphorically, Rom.7:23, 2Co.10:5, 2Ti.3:6.†
(AS)

G0104.def:
ἀεί, adv.,
[in LXX: Isa.42:14 (מֵעוֹלָם) 51:13 (תָּמִיד), Ps 94(95):10, al. ;]
ever;
1. of continuous time, unceasingly, perpetually: Act.7:51, 2 Co.4.11; 6:10, Tit.1:12, Heb.3:10.
2. Of successive occurrences, on every occasion (MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe.3:15, 2Pe.1:12.
† (AS)
G0104.strong_def: "ever," by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly
G0104.derivation: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration);

G2202.def:
ζευκτήριος, -α -ον
(ζεύγνυμι),
fit for joining. As subst.,
(a) ζευκτήριον, τό = ζυγόν, a yoke;
(b) ζευκτηρία, -ας, ἡ = ζεύγλη, the crossbar of a double rudder: Act.27:40 (found nowhere else).†
(AS)
G2202.derivation: feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as G2218 (ζυγός);

G0761.def:
ἀ-σάλευτος, -ον
(σαλεύω), [in LXX: Exo.13:16, Deu.6:8 11:18 (טוֹפָפָה)* ;]
unmoved, immovable: Act.27:41; metaphorically, Heb.12:28.†
(AS)
G0761.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4531 (σαλεύω);

G4616.strong_def: byssos, i.e. bleached linen (the cloth or a garment of it)

G4868.strong_def: to make up together, i.e. (figuratively) to compute (an account)

G0172.def:
ἄκακος, -ον,
[in LXX for פְּתִי, תָּם, etc. ;]
(a) as in cl. (Æsch., Plat., al.), of persons, simple, guileless: Rom.16:18, Heb.7:26 (cf. Cremer, 327);
(b) of things, undamaged (? MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0172.strong_def: not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting
G0172.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2556 (κακός);

G5082.strong_def: such as this, i.e. (in (figurative) magnitude) so vast
G5082.derivation: from a compound of G3588 (ὁ) with G2245 (ἡλίκος) and G3778 (οὗτος);

G0768.def:
Ἀσήρ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָשֵׁר),
Asher: Luk.2:36, Rev.7:6.†
(AS)

G3927.strong_def: an alien alongside, i.e. a resident foreigner
G3927.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G1927 (ἐπιδημέω);

G1281.def:
δια-πραγματεύομαι , "perfective compound" (see M, Pr., 118);
1. to examine thoroughly (Plat.).
2. In late writers (Dion. Hal.), to gain by trading: Luk.19:15.†
(AS)
G1281.strong_def: to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e. (transitively and by implication) to earn in business

G1653.def:
ἐλεέω
(in Rom.9:16, Ju 22, -άω, which see), -ῶ (ἔλεος), [in LXX (Hex, Pss, Pr) chiefly for חָנַן, also frequently in Proph. for רָחַם, etc. ;]
to have pity or mercy on, to show mercy: absol., Rom.9:16 12:8; with accusative, Mat.9:27 15:22 17:15 18:33 20:30-31, Mrk.5:19 10:47-48, Luk.16:24 17:13 18:38-39 Rom.9:15, 18 11:32, Php.2:27, Ju 22. Pass., to have pity or mercy shown one (EV, obtain mercy): Mat.5:7, Rom.11:30-31, 1Co.7:25, 2Co.4:1, 1Ti.1:13 1:16, 1Pe.2:10.†
(AS)
G1653.strong_def: to compassionate (by word or deed, specially, by divine grace)

G4542.strong_def: a Samaritess, i.e. woman of Samaria

G1507.def:
εἱλίσσω, see: ἑλέσσω Transcriber: Is this word in Abbott-Smith?.
(AS)
G1507.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb (of the same meaning);

G1092.def:
γεωργός, -οῦ, ὁ
(γῆ, ἔργω = ἔρδω, to do), [in LXX for אִכָּר, etc. ;]
1. a husbandman: 2Ti.2:6, Jas.5:7.
2. a vine-dresser (cf. ἀμπελουργός, Luk.13:7): Mat.21:33-35, 38, 40, 41, Mrk.12:1, 2 7, 9, Luk.20:9, 10 14, 16, Jhn.15:1.
† (AS)
G1092.derivation: from G1093 (γῆ) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);

G1739.def:
ἐν-δώμησις (Rec. -δόμησις), -εως, ἡ
(δωμάω, to build),
a build­ing in: ἡ ἐ. τ. τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις, its wall had jasper built into it, Rev.21:18 (see MM, Exp., xiii; Swete, Ap., l.with).†
(AS)
G1739.derivation: from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of the base of G1218 (δῆμος);

G3588.gloss: the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc
G3588.strong_def: the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom)

G1415.def:
δυνατός, -ή, -όν
(δύναμαι), [in LXX for גִּבּוֹר, חַיִל, etc. ;]
1. strong, mighty, powerful: absol., Luk.1:49, 1 Col.1:26; οἱ δ., the chief men, Act.25:5 ; of spiritual strength, Rom.15:1, 2Co.12:10 13:9; before ἐν, Luk.24:19, Act.7:22 18:24; πρός, 2Co.10:4.
2. C. inf., able to do; Luk.14:31, Act.11:17, Rom.4:21 11:23, 2Ti.1:12, Tit.1:9, Heb.11:19, Jas.3:2.
3. Neut., δυνατόν, possible: Mat.19:26, Mrk.9:23 10:27 14:36, Luk.18:27, Act.2:24 20:16; εἰ δ. (ἐστι), Mat.24:24 26:30, Mrk.13:22 14:35, Rom.12:18, Gal.4:15; τὸ δ. (= ἡ δύναμις) αὐτοῦ, Rom.9:22.†
(AS)
G1415.strong_def: powerful or capable (literally or figuratively); neuter possible

G4079.strong_def: from the same as G3976 (πέδη)); a "pedal", i.e. helm
G4079.derivation: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of (the blade of an oar;

G4574.strong_def: something adored, i.e. an object of worship (god, altar, etc)

G2533.def:
Καιάφας (T, Καϊ-), -α ὁ,
Caiaphas (on the name, see Exp. Times, x, 185): Mat.26:3, 57, Luk.3:2, Jhn.11:4 18:13-14, 24 18:28 Act.4:6.†
Καΐφας, for Καιάφας, which see: Luk.3:2 (L)
(AS)
G2533.strong_def: the dell; Caiaphas (i.e. Cajepha), an Israelite

G3335.gloss: eat, have, be partaker, receive, take
G3335.strong_def: to participate; genitive case, to accept (and use)

G2788.def:
κιθάρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for כִּנּוֹר, frequently in Psa.33:2, al.); and in (Dan.3:5, al.) for קִיתָרֹס, itself a transliteration of κίθαρις, the Homeric form of κ. (cf. CB, Dn., lviii) ;]
a lyre, harp: 1Co.14:7, Rev.5:8 14:2 15:2.†
(AS)

G0912.def:
Βαραββᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram. בַּר־אַבָּא, lit., son of a father, i.e. accusative to Jerome, filius magistri),
Barabbas: Mat.27:16, 17 20, 21, 26, Mrk.15:7, 11 15, Luk.23:18, Jhn.18:40. (In Mat.27:16, some MSS. read Ἰησοῦν Β.; see WH, App., 19f.).†
(AS)
G0912.strong_def: son of Abba; Bar-abbas, an Israelite

G5192.strong_def: the "hyacinth" or "jacinth", i.e. some gem of a deep blue color, probably the zirkon

G3841.strong_def: the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign)

G2623.def:
κατα-κλείω
[in LXX: Jer.32:3 (כָּלָא), Wis.17:2, 16, 2Ma.13:21, 3Ma.3:25 * ;]
to shut up:. with accusative of person(s), before ἐν φυλακῇ (-αῖς), Luk.3:20, Act.26:10.†
(AS)
G2623.strong_def: to shut down (in a dungeon), i.e. incarcerate

G1940.def:
ἐπι-καθ-ίζω
[in LXX for רָכַב, etc. ;]
to sit upon: Mat.21:7.†
(AS)

G5388.strong_def: fond of one's children, i.e. maternal

G1315.def:
δια-χειρίζω
(χείρ),
to have in hand, conduct, manage. Mid.
(a) = act.;
(b) in late writers (Polyb., FlJ, al.), to lay hands on, kill: with accusative, Act.5:30 26:21.†
(AS)
G1315.strong_def: to handle thoroughly, i.e. lay violent hands upon
G1315.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and a derivative of G5495 (χείρ);

G5498.strong_def: something hand-written ("chirograph"), i.e. a manuscript (specially, a legal document or bond (figuratively))
G5498.derivation: neuter of a compound of G5495 (χείρ) and G1125 (γράφω);

G0335.def:
ἀναιδία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(αἰδώς), [in LXX: Sir.25:22 * ;]
shamelessness, importunity: Luk.11:8 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0335.derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle (compare G427 (ἄνευ))) and G127 (αἰδώς);

G1512.def:
εἴ-περ, see: εἰ.
εἰ,
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
I. Conditional, if;
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20;
(b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20;
(with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.;
(d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al.
2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, if, whether.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12.
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luk.11:18; but even if, 1Co.4:7, 2Co.4:3 11:16.
3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Mrk.2:21, 22 Jhn.14:2, Rev.2:5, al.
4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Mrk.14:29, Luk.11:8, 1Co.7:21, 2Co.4:16, Php.2:17, al.
5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Mat.24:22, Mrk.2:26 6:5, Jhn.9:33, 1Co.7:17 (only), Gal.1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1Co.14:5 15:2, 1Ti.5:19.
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Heb.6:14.
8. εἴ πως, if haply: Act.27:12, Rom.1:10.
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Rom.12:6-8, 1Co.3:22 13:8, al.

G2075.def:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
I. As substantive verb.
1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.
4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.;
(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult.
2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:7, 2Ti.2:19.
4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): Act.1:8, 9:15, Rom.4:12, 1Co.1:18, 2:14, Rev.21:7, al.
5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mat.10:30, Luk.9:32, Jhn.3:24, Act.21:35, 1Co.15:19, al;
(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Luk.4:31, 14:1, Act.1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rom.12:9, 10, Heb.13:5, al.;
(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Luk.23:9.
6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:8, Heb.8:10, al.
7. C. adv.: Mat.19:20, Mrk.4:26, Luk.18:11, al.
8. Ellipses;
(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mat.8:29, 24:32, Jhn.21:22, 23, Heb.6:4, al.;
(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mat.14:27, Mrk.6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Deu.32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mrk.13:6, Jhn.4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)

G0039.def:
ἅγιος, -α, ον
(τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;]
primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration.
1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence
(a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1;
(b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5.
2. Applied to persons as separated to God's service:
(a) of Christ, Mrk.1:24, Jhn.6:69, Act.4:30;
(b) of Christians, Act.9:13, Rom.1:7, Heb.6:10, Rev.5:8.
3. In the moral sense of sharing God's purity: Mrk.6:20, Jhn.17:11, Act.3:14, Rev.3:7.
4. Of pure, clean sacrifices and offerings: 1Co.7:14, Eph.1:4.
SYN.: ἁγνός, pure, both in ceremonial and spiritual sense; ἱερός (sacer), sacred, that which is inviolable because of its (external) relation to God; ὅσιος (sanctus as opposite to nefas), that which is based on everlasting ordinances of right. (Cf. Tr., Syn., §lxxxviii; DB, ii, 399 f.; Cremer, 34, 594-601; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
