G2468.def:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
I. As substantive verb.
1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.
4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.;
(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult.
2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:7, 2Ti.2:19.
4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): Act.1:8, 9:15, Rom.4:12, 1Co.1:18, 2:14, Rev.21:7, al.
5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mat.10:30, Luk.9:32, Jhn.3:24, Act.21:35, 1Co.15:19, al;
(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Luk.4:31, 14:1, Act.1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rom.12:9, 10, Heb.13:5, al.;
(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Luk.23:9.
6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:8, Heb.8:10, al.
7. C. adv.: Mat.19:20, Mrk.4:26, Luk.18:11, al.
8. Ellipses;
(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mat.8:29, 24:32, Jhn.21:22, 23, Heb.6:4, al.;
(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mat.14:27, Mrk.6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Deu.32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mrk.13:6, Jhn.4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)
G2468.derivation: second person imperative present of G1510 (εἰμί);

G5180.strong_def: to "thump", i.e. cudgel or pummel (properly, with a stick or bastinado), but in any case by repeated blows; thus differing from G3817 (παίω) and G3960 (πατάσσω), which denote a (usually single) blow with the hand or any instrument, or G4141 (πλήσσω) with the fist (or a hammer), or G4474 (ῥαπίζω) with the palm; as well as from G5177 (τυγχάνω), an accidental collision); by implication, to punish; figuratively, to offend (the conscience)
G5180.derivation: a primary verb (in a strengthened form);

G2040.def:
ἐργάτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐργάζομαι, which see), [in LXX: Wis.17:17, Sir.19:1 40:18, 1Ma.3:6 * ;]
1. prop., a field labourer, husbandman: Mat.9:37-38 20:1-2, 8, Luk.10:2, Jas.5:4 (cf. Wis, l.with).
2. Generally, a workman, labourer: Mat.10:10, Luk.10:7, Act.19:25 (opposite to τεχνίτης), 1Ti.5:18; of Christian teachers, 2Co.11:13, Php.3:2, 2Ti.2:15.
3. a worker, doer: τ. ἀδικίας, Luk.13:27 (cf. 1Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G3651.strong_def: complete to the end, i.e. absolutely perfect

G3083.strong_def: something to loosen with, i.e. a redemption price (figuratively, atonement)

G2127.def:
εὐλογέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ pi. ;]
1. to speak well of, praise (cl.; LXX Deu.8:10, al.): τ. θεόν, Luk.1:64 2:28 24:51, 53 (αἰνοῦντες, T, WH, mg.), Jas.3:9; absol., to give praise, Mat.14:19 26:26 (see Swete on Mrk.14:22), Mrk.6:41 14:22 (see Swete, in l), Luk.24:30, 1Co.14:16.
2. As in LXX (= בָּרַךְ pi.);
(a) to bless, invoke blessings on (Gen.24:60, Num.23:20, al.): absol., 1Co.4:12, 1Pe.3:9; with accusative of person(s), Luk.2:34 6:28 24:50-51, Rom.12:14, Heb.7:1, 6-7 11:20-21; εὐλογημένος (= בָּרַךְ; see Lft., Notes, 310; DCG, i, 189), blessed, Mat.21:9 23:39" (LXX), Mrk.11:9-10, Luk.13:35 19:38" (LXX), Jhn.12:13; with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.8:7, Luk.9:16, 1Co.10:16;
(b) with God as subject (Psa.44:3, al.), to bless, prosper, bestow blessings on: with accusative of person(s), Act.3:26, Gal.3:9, Eph.1:3 (Lft., Notes, 311), Heb.6:14; εὐλογημένος, Luk.1:28 (WH, tit., R, tit., omit) Luk.1:42; εὐλογημένοι τ. πατρός (cf. Isa.61:9), Mat.25:34; pass. Act.3:25 (cf. ἐν-, κατ-ευλογέω).†
SYN.: see: αἰνέω, and cf. DCG, i, 189, 211; Cremer, 766 (AS)
G2127.strong_def: to speak well of, i.e. (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper)
G2127.derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G3056 (λόγος);

G0380.def:
ἀνα-πτύσσω
[in LXX for פָּרַשׂ,etc. ;]
to unroll: τ. βιβλίον, Luk.4:17 (WH, R, ἀνοίξας).†
(AS)
G0380.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G4428 (πτύσσω);

G1833.def:
ἐξ-ετάζω
(ἐτάζω (rare), to examine), [in LXX: Deu.13:14-15 Deu.19:18, 1Ch.28:9 A (דָּרַשׁ), דָּרַשׁ), Psa.11:5-6 (בָּחַן), Wis.6:3, Sir.3:21, al. ;]
to examine closely, inquire carefully (of ): before περί (with ἀκριβῶς), Mat.2:8; before τίς, Mat.10:11; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.21:12.†
SYN.: ἀνακρίνω, ἐραυνάω (see DCG, ii, 594b) (AS)
G1833.strong_def: to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate

G4510.strong_def: to soil, i.e. (intransitively) to become dirty (morally)

G1470.def:
ἐγ-κρύπτω,
[in LXX for טמן, etc. ;]
to conceal in: with accusative, before εἰς, Mat.13:33.†
(AS)
G1470.strong_def: to conceal in, i.e. incorporate with

G4474.gloss: smite (with the palm of the hand)
G4474.derivation: from a derivative of a primary (to let fall, "rap");

G3544.strong_def: according (or pertaining) to law, i.e. legal (ceremonially); as noun, an expert in the (Mosaic) law

G5091.strong_def: to prize, i.e. fix a valuation upon; by implication, to revere

G3179.gloss: put out, remove, translate, turn away
G3179.strong_def: to transfer, i.e. carry away, depose or (figuratively) exchange, seduce

G0519.def:
ἀπ-άγχω
(ἄγχω, to press, strangle), [in LXX: 2Ki.17:23 (חָנַק), Tob.3:10 * ;]
to strangle; mid., to hang oneself (or, to choke; see M, Pr., 155): Mat.27:5.†
(AS)
G0519.strong_def: akin to the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death)

G1994.def:
ἐπι-στρέφω
[very frequently in LXX, chiefly for שׁוּב, in its various senses, also for פָּנָה, etc. ;]
1. trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaphorically, to turn, cause to return (to God, virtue, etc.): Luk.1:16-17 (cf. Mal.3:24), Jas.5:19-20.
2. Intrans.,
(a) to turn, turn oneself around: Act.16:18; with inf., Rev.1:12; before πρός, Act.9:40; so also pass. (cl.), Mrk.5:30 8:33, Jhn.21:20; metaphorically, of turning to God (see Field, Notes, 246 ff.), ἐπὶ τ. κύριον (θεόν), Act.9:35 11:21 14:15 15:19 26:20; πρὸς τ. θεόν, 1Th.1:9, 2Co.3:16; ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς, Act.26:18; pass., 1Pe.2:25;
(b) to return (as in MGr.): Luk.8:55, Act.15:36; before ὀπίσω, with inf., Mat.24:18; before εἰς, Mat.12:44, Mrk.13:16, Luk.2:39 17:31; ἐπί, 2Pe.2:22; metaphorically, before ἐπί, Gal.4:9; πρός, Luk.17:4; of moral reform, Mat.13:15, Mrk.4:12, Luk.22:32, Act.3:19 28:27; pass., Mat.10:13 (Cremer, 531, 881).†
(AS)

G1091.def:
γεώργιον, -ου, τό
(γεωργός), [in LXX, frequently in Pr., for שָׂדֶה, etc. ;]
1. a field (Pro.24:5, 30, Strabo).
2. cultivation, husbandry, tillage (Pro.6:7 9:12, Jer.28:23, Sir.27:6): 1Co.3:9.
† (AS)
G1091.derivation: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of G1092 (γεωργός);

G0759.def:
ἄρωμα, -τος, τό
[in LXX for בֶּשֶׂם ;]
spice: Mrk.16:1, Luk.23:56 24:1, Jhn.19:40.†
(AS)
G0759.derivation: from G142 (αἴρω) (in the sense of sending off scent);

G4918.strong_def: to compress, i.e. crowd on all sides

G5514.derivation: feminine of apparently a primary word;

G2369.def:
θυμιατήριον, -ου, τό
(θυμιάω), [in LXX: 2Ch.26:19, Eze.8:11 (קְטֹרֶת), 4Ma.7:11 * ;]
1. as in cl. (Hdt., iv, 162; Thuc., vi, 46) and LXX, a censer: Heb.9:4 (but see infr., and cf. Westc., in l).
2. As in Philo., rer. div., § 46, FlJ, Ant., iv, 2, 4, al., the altar of incense: He, l.with (but see supr. and cf. MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)
G2369.strong_def: a place of fumigation, i.e. the alter of incense (in the Temple)

G4137.gloss: accomplish, X after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply
G4137.strong_def: to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc.

G1908.def:
ἐπηρεάζω
(ἐπήρεια, spiteful abuse),
to revile: with accusative of person(s), Luk.6:28; with accusative of thing(s) (but see ICC, in l), 1Pe.3:16.†
(AS)
G1908.derivation: from a comparative of G1909 (ἐπί) and (probably) (threats);

G0773.strong_def: Asia, i.e. Asia Minor, or (usually) only its western shore

G2430.def:
Ἰκόνιον, -ου, τό
Iconium, a city of the province of Galatia: Act.13:51 14:1, 19 14:21 16:2, 2Ti.3:11.†
(AS)
G2430.strong_def: image-like; Iconium, a place in Asia Minor

G3806.strong_def: properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence)

G0080.def:
ἀδελφός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀ- copul., δελφύς, womb),
in cl., a brother, born of the same parent or parents. [In LXX (Hort, Ja., 102f.), for אָח ;]
1. lit. of a brother (Gen.4:2, al.).
2. Of a neighbour (Lev.19:17).
3. Of a member of the same nation (Exo.2:14, Deu.15:3). In NT in each of these senses (1. Mat.1:2, al.; 2. Mat.7:3; 3. Rom.9:3) and also,
4. of a fellow-Christian: 1Co.1:1, Act.9:30. This usage finds illustration in π., where ἀ. is used of members of a pagan religious community (M, Th., I, 1:4; MM, VGT, see word). The ἀδελφοὶ τ. Κυρίου (Mat.12:46-49 13:55 28:10, Mrk.3:31-34, Luk.8:19-21, Jhn.2:12 7:3, 5 10 20:17, Act.1:14, 1Co.9:5) may have been sons of Joseph and Mary (Mayor, Ja., Intr. viff.; DB, i, 320ff.) or of Joseph by a former marriage (Lft., Gal., 252ff.; DCG, i, 232ff.), but the view of Jerome, which makes ἀ. equivalent to ἀνεψιός, is inconsistent with Greek usage. (Cremer, 66.)
(AS)
G0080.strong_def: a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like G1 (Α))
G0080.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a connective particle) and (the womb);

G2629.def:
κατα-κόπτω
[in LXX for נָכָה hi., כָּתַת pi., etc. ;]
to cut up, cut in pieces (cf. Isa.27:9, Jer.21:7, 2Ch.34:7): ἑαυτὸν λίθοις, Mrk.5:5.†
(AS)

G4912.gloss: constrain, hold, keep in, press, lie sick of, stop, be in a strait, straiten, be taken with, throng
G4912.strong_def: to hold together, i.e. to compress (the ears, with a crowd or siege) or arrest (a prisoner); figuratively, to compel, perplex, afflict, preoccupy

G1059.def:
Γαμαλιήλ, ὁ (Heb. גַּמְלִיאֵל),
Gamaliel the elder, a Pharisee and Doctor of the Law: Act.5:34 22:3.†
(AS)

G1359.def:
Διόσ-κουροι, -ων, οἱ
(Ion. and κοινή form of Att..., Διόσκοροι; Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + κόρος, a son),
the Dioscuri (Castor and Pollux), twin sons of Zeus and Leda (RV, The Twin Brothers): Act.28:11.†
(AS)
G1359.strong_def: sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri
G1359.derivation: from the alternate of G2203 (Ζεύς) and a form of the base of G2877 (κοράσιον);

G1400.def:
servant, slave; in the NT a person owned as a possession for various lengths of times (Hebrew slaves no more than seven years, Gentile slaves without time limit), of lower social status than free persons or masters; slaves could earn or purchase their freedom
a male slave, or servant, of various degrees, Mt. 8:9, and frequently ; a servitor, person of mean condition, Phil. 2:7; feminine δούλη, a female slave; a handmaiden, Lk. 1:38, 48; Acts 2:18; δοῦλος, used figuratively, in a bad sense, one involved in moral or spiritual thraldom, Jn. 8:34; Rom. 6:17, 20; 1Cor. 7:23; 2Pet. 2:19; in a good sense, a devoted servant or minister, Acts 16:17; Rom. 1:1; one pledged or bound to serve, 1Cor. 7:22; 2Cor. 4:5

G0347.def:
ἀνα-κλίνω
[in LXX: 3Ma.5:16 * ;]
to lay upon, lean against, hence,
(a) to lay down: Luk.2:7;
(b) to make to recline: Mrk.6:39, WH, mg., Luk.12:37. Pass., to lie back, recline: Mat.8:11 14:19, Luk.13:29.†
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀναπίπτω (AS)

G5261.strong_def: an underwriting, i.e. copy for imitation (figuratively)
G5261.derivation: from a compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and G1125 (γράφω);

G2331.strong_def: a Thessalonican, i.e. inhabitant of Thessalonice

G5097.strong_def: properly, to protect one's honor, i.e. to avenge (inflict a penalty)
G5097.derivation: from a comparative of G5092 (τιμή) and ouros (a guard);

G2683.def:
κατα-σκιάζω
to overshadow: with accusative, Heb.9:5.†
(AS)
G2683.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G4639 (σκιά);

G0673.def:
ἀπο-χωρίζω
[in LXX: Eze.43:21 (מִפְקָד)* ;]
to separate, part asunder: pass., Rev.6:14; reflexively, to separate oneself: Act.15:39.†
(AS)
G0673.strong_def: to rend apart; reflexively, to separate

G4567.derivation: of Chaldee origin corresponding to H04566 (with the definite affix);

G0868.def:
ἀφ-ίστημι
[in LXX for סוּר, מָעַל, etc. (41 words in all) ;]
1. trans. in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put away, lead away; metaphorically, to move to revolt: Act.5:37.
2. Intrans. in pf., plpf., 2 aor., to stand off, depart from, withdraw from: with genitive, Luk.2:37; before ἀπό, Luk.4:13 13:27, Act.5:38 12:10 15:38 19:9 22:29, 2Co.12:8; metaphorically, ἀπὸ ἀδικίας, 2Ti.2:19; ἀπὸ θεοῦ, (fall away, apostatize), Heb.3:12 Mid. (exc. 1 aor., WH. is trans.), to withdraw oneself from, absent oneself from: Luk.2:37; metaphorically, fall away, apostatize: absol., Luk.8:13; with genitive, 1Ti.4:1 (MM, see word; Cremer, 308).†
(AS)
G0868.strong_def: to remove, i.e. (actively) instigate to revolt; usually (reflexively) to desist, desert, etc.

G2637.def:
κατά-λαλος, -ου, ὁ
a railer, defamer: Rom.1:30.†
SYN.: (ψιθυριστής), a whisperer (see Tr., Syn., § cvii, 15; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)
G2637.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and the base of G2980 (λαλέω);

G0690.strong_def: an Arab or native of Arabia

G2330.def:
θέρος, -ους, τό
(θέρω, to heat), [in LXX chiefly for קַיִץ ;]
summer: Mat.24:32, Mrk.13:28, Luk.21:30.†
(AS)

G0628.def:
ἀπο-λούω
[in LXX: Job.9:30 (רָחַץ)* ;]
to wash off, wash away; mid., metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), to wash off oneself: ἀμαρτίας, Act.22:16; absol., ἀπελούσασθε, ye washed yourselves clean (cf. Cremer, 406), 1Co.6:11.†
(AS)
G0628.strong_def: to wash fully, i.e. (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively)

G1022.def:
1. slowness , (Iliad by Homer), attic
2. of the mind, (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G4840.strong_def: to be at hand together, i.e. now present

G2902.def:
κρατέω, -ῶ
(κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק hi., also for אָחַז, etc. ;]
1. to be strong, mighty, hence, to rule, be master, prevail (so chiefly in cl.; in LXX: Est.1:1, I Est.4:38, Wis.14:19, al.).
2. to get possession of, obtain, take hold of (Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive of thing(s) (M, Pr., 65), Act.27:13; τ. χειρός, Mat.9:25, Mrk.1:31 5:41 9:27, Luk.8:54; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.12:11; with accusative of person(s), Mat.14:3 18:28 21:46 22:6 26:4, 48 ff., Mrk.3:21 6:17 12:12 14:1, 44 ff, Act.3:11 24:6, Rev.20:2 (cf. 2Ki.6:6).
3. to hold, hold fast (Æsch., Polyb., al.): with accusative of thing(s), ἐν τ. δεξιᾷ, Rev.2:1. Metaphorical: with accusative of person(s), pass., Act.2:24; with accusative of thing(s), Rev.2:13, 25 3:11; τ. κεφαλήν (i.e. Christ), Col.2:19; τ. παράδοσιν (-εις), λόγον, διδαχήν, Mrk.7:3-4, 8 9:10, 2Th.2:15, Rev.2:14-15; with genitive of thing(s), Heb.4:14 6:18; of sins, to retain, Jhn.20:23; of re­straint, before ἵνα μή, Rev.7:1; pass., before τοῦ μή, Luk.24:16.†
(AS)
G2902.strong_def: to use strength, i.e. seize or retain (literally or figuratively)

G0234.def:
ἀλίσγημα, -τος, τό
(late ἀλισγέω, to pollute)
pollution: Act.15:20.†
(AS)

G4849.strong_def: a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e. (by extension) a room of guests
G4849.derivation: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of G4844 (συμπίνω);

G2098.def:
εὐαγγέλιον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for בְּשׂוֹרָה, 2Ki.4:10 18:22 18:25 * ;]
1. in cl.,
(a) a reward for good tidings (Hom.; pl., LXX, 2Ki.4:10);
(b) in pl., εὐ. θύειν, to make a thank-offering for good tidings (Xen., al.).
2. Later (Luc., Plut., al.), good tidings, good news; in NT of the good tidings of the kingdom of God and of salvation through Christ, the gospel: Mrk.1:15, Act.15:7, Rom.1:16, Gal.2:2, 1Th.2:4, al.; with genitive obj., τ. βασιλείας, Mat.4:23; τ. Χριστοῦ, Rom.15:19, al.; τ. κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ, 2Th.1:8; τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, Rom.1:9; τ. δόξης τ. μακαρίου θεοῦ, 1Ti.1:11; τ. δόξης τ. Χριστοῦ, 2Co.4:4; of the author, τ. θεοῦ, Rom.15:16, al.; of the teacher, ἡμῶν, Rom.2:16, 2Co.4:3, 1Th.1:5, 2Ti.2:8; of the taught, τ. περιτομῆς, τ. ἀκροβυστίας, Gal.2:7; ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ εὐ., Gal.2:5, 14 Col.1:5; ἡ ἐλπὶς (πίστις) τοῦ εὐ., Col.1:23, Php.1:27 (see Cremer, 31 ff.; and on the later eccl. use of the word„ M, Th., 143 f.)
(AS)
G2098.strong_def: a good message, i.e. the gospel

G4758.strong_def: to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e. enlist in the army
G4758.derivation: from a compound of the base of G4756 (στρατιά) and G3004 (λέγω) (in its original sense);

G5166.derivation: from a derivative of (to dry) meaning ripe fruit (as if dry);

G5103.derivation: of Latin origin but uncertain significance;

G1493.def:
εἰδώλον (Rec. -εῖον), -ου, τό
(εἴδωλον), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:2 (בֵּית אוֹצַר אֱלֹהִים), Bel 9, I Est.2:10, 1Ma.1:47 10:83 * ;]
an idol's temple: 1Co.8:10 (cf. Ἀσταρτεῖον, 1Ki.31:10; see ICC, in I Co, l.with).†
(AS)
G1493.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G1497 (εἴδωλον);

G1572.def:
ἐκ-καίω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּעַר ;]
1. to burn up.
2. to kindle. Pass., to burn: metaphorically, of the passions (cf. Sir.16:6, Job.3:17), Rom.1:27.†
(AS)

G4657.strong_def: what is thrown to the dogs, i.e. refuse (ordure)
G4657.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G1519 (εἰς) and G2965 (κύων) and G906 (βάλλω);

G4594.strong_def: on the (i.e. this) day (or night current or just passed); generally, now (i.e. at present, hitherto)
G4594.derivation: neuter (as adverb) of a presumed compound of the article G3588 (ὁ) (t changed to s) and G2250 (ἡμέρα);

G1076.def:
γενεαλογία, -ας, ἡ (see previous word);
1. the making of a pedigree.
2. a genealogy: pl., 1Ti.1:4, Tit.3:9 (see CGT, in l., and ib. Intr., xlix ff.; DB, ii, p. 141).
† (AS)

G0287.def:
ἀμοιβή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀμείβομαι, to repay); [in Aq., Sm.: Pro.12:14, al. ;]
requital, recompense: 1Ti.5:4 (for illustration from τ.. see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4392.derivation: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G5316 (φαίνω);

G0970.def:
βία, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX for פֶּרֶךְ, etc. ;]
strength, force, violence: Act.5:26 21:35 24:7 27:41.†
(AS)
G0970.derivation: probably akin to G979 (βίος) (through the idea of vital activity);

G1577.strong_def: a calling out, i.e. (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both)
G1577.derivation: from a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G2564 (καλέω);

G5259.gloss: among, by, from, in, of, under, with
G5259.strong_def: under, i.e. (with the genitive case) of place (beneath), or with verbs (the agency or means, through); (with the accusative case) of place (whither (underneath) or where (below) or time (when (at))

G1759.strong_def: properly, within, i.e. (of place) here, hither
G1759.derivation: from a prolonged form of G1722 (ἐν);

G4864.strong_def: an assemblage of persons; specially, a Jewish "synagogue" (the meeting or the place); by analogy, a Christian church

G3357.derivation: adverb from a derivative of G3358 (μέτρον);

G2485.def:
ἰχθύδιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of ἰχθύς),
a little fish: Mat.15:34, Mrk.8:7.†
(AS)

G1302.def:
δια-τί , why, Mat.9:11, 14 Mrk.2:18, Jhn.7:45, al.; δ. τό, with inf., Mrk.5:4, Luk.9:7, Jas.4:2.
3. In composition,
(1) through, as in διαβαίνω;
(2) of separation, asunder, as in διασπάω;
(3) of distribution, abroad, as in διαγγέλλω;
(4) of transition, as διαλλάσσω;
(5) of "perfective" action (M, Pr., 112f., 115f.), as διαφύγω, διακαθαρίζω.
(AS)

G3061.strong_def: a plague (literally, the disease, or figuratively, a pest)

G1809.def:
ἐξ-αιτέω, -ῶ
to ask from; mid., to ask for oneself, demand: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, with accusative (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), Luk.22:31 (see Field, Notes, 76; Cremer, 73).†
(AS)
G1809.derivation: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G154 (αἰτέω);

G5282.strong_def: to think under (privately), i.e. to surmise or conjecture

G1629.def:
ἐκ-φοβέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for חָרֵד hi. ;]
to frighten away, terrify: with accusative of person(s), 2Co.10:9.†
(AS)

G1613.def:
ἐκ-ταράσσω
[in LXX: Psa.18:4 (עֵת pi.), Psa.88:16 (צוּם), צוּם), Wis.17:3-4 18:17 * ;]
to throw into great trouble, agitate: Act.16:20.†
(AS)

G1265.def:
δια-μένω
[in LXX for עמד, etc.;]
to remain, continue: Luk.1:22 22:28, Gal.2:5, Heb.1:11" (LXX), 2Pe.3:4.†
(AS)
G1265.strong_def: to stay constantly (in being or relation)

G4908.strong_def: mentally put (or putting) together, i.e. sagacious

G1381.def:
δοκιμάζω
(δόκιμος), [in LXX chiefly for בָּחַן ;]
1. primarily of metals (Pro.8:10 17:3, Sir.2:5, Wis.3:6), to test, try, prove (in the hope and expectation that the test will prove successful, see reff. s. Syn.): χρυσίον, 1Pe.1:7; other things, Luk.12:56 14:19, 2Co.8:8, Gal.6:4, 1Th.2:4 5:21; τὰ διαφέροντα, Rom.2:18, Php.1:10 (R, mg., but see infr.); πνεύματα, 1Jn.4:1; of men, 1Ti.3:10 (pass.); ἑαυτόν, 1Co.11:28, 2Co.13:5; before subst. clause, Rom.12:2, 1Co.3:13, Eph.5:10
2. As the result of trial, to approve, think fit: Rom.1:28 14:22, 1Co.16:3, 2Co.8:22, 1Th.2:4 (δεδοκιμάσμεθα); τὰ διαφέροντα, Rom.2:18, Php.1:10, R, txt. (but see supr.; cf. διαφέρω).†
(AS)
G1381.strong_def: to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve

G2150.def:
εὐ-σέβεια, -ας, ἡ
(εὐσεβής, which see), [in LXX: Pro.1:7, Isa.33:6 (יִרְאָה), Pro.13:11 (aliter in Heb.), Isa.11:2 (יְהוָֹה יִרְאָה), I Est.1:23, Wis.10:12, Sir.49:3, and very frequently in 4Mac ;]
1. piety, reverence (towards parents and others).
2. piety towards God, godliness: Act.3:12, 1Ti.2:2 4:7-8 6:5-6 6:11, 2Pe.1:3 1:6-7; τὸ τῆς εὐ. μυστήριον, 1Ti.3:16; ἡ κατ᾽ εὐ. διδασκαλία, 1Ti.6:3; ἡ ἀλήθεια ἡ κατ᾽ εὐ., Tit.1:1; μόρφωσις εὐσεβείας, 2Ti.3:5; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6; Mayor on Jas.2:1), 2Pe.3:11 (on the use of εὐ. and cognates in Past. Epp., see CGT, on 1Ti.2:2; cf. also Cremer, 524).†
(AS)

G3785.derivation: first person singular of a past tense of G3784 (ὀφείλω);

G0660.def:
ἀπο-τινάσσω
[in LXX: Jdg.16:20 A (נָעַר ni.), 1Ki.10:2 (נָטַשׁ), La 2:7 (נָאַר pi.) * ;]
to shake of: Luk.9:5, Act.28:5.†
(AS)

G0318.def:
ἀνάγκη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מָצוֹק, צַר ;]
1. necessity: ἔχειν ἀ-, with inf., to be compelled, Luk.14:18 23:17 (Rec., R, mg.), 1Co.7:37, Ju 3, Heb.7:27; ἐξ ἀ., κατ᾽ ἀ., of necessity, 2Co.9:7, Heb.7:12, Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, 1Co.9:16; with inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), Mat.18:7, Rom.13:5, Heb.9:16, 23
2. force, violence, hence pain, distress (Diod., al.; LXX; see M, Th., 41; MM, VGT, see word; cf. θλίψις): Luk.21:23, 1Co.7:26, 1Th.3:7; pl. (see B1., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), ἐν ἀ., 2Co.6:4 12:10.†
(AS)
G0318.strong_def: constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress
G0318.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη);

G0886.def:
ἀ-χειρο-ποίητος, -ον
(χειροποίητος)
not made by hands: Mrk.14:58, 2Co.5:1; metaphorically, περιτομή ἀ. (i.e. spiritual ), Col.2:11 (MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0886.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5499 (χειροποίητος);

G1143.def:
δάκνω
[in LXX for נשׁךְ, Gen.49:17, al., exc. Deu.8:15 (שׂרף) ;]
to bite: metaphorically, Gal.5:15.†
(AS)
G1143.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary root;

G1916.def:
ἐπι-βοάω, -ῶ
to cry out: Act.25:24 (Rec., for βοάω, which see).†
(AS)

G3532.strong_def: victorious over the people; Nicolaus, a heretic

G2911.def:
κρημνός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρεμάννυμι), [in LXX: 2Ch.25:12 (סֶלַע)* ;]
a steep bank: Mat.8:32, Mrk.5:13, Luk.8:33.†
(AS)

G1172.def:
δειπνέω, -ῶ
(δεῖπνον, which see), [in LXX: Pro.23:1 (לחם), Tob.7:8 8:1, Dan LXX 11:27 * ;]
to take the chief meal of the day, to dine, to sup: Luk.17:8 22:20 (WH, br., R, mg. omits), 1Co.11:25; metaphorically, Rev.3:20.†
(AS)
G1172.strong_def: to dine, i.e. take the principle (or evening) meal

G5033.strong_def: most quickly, i.e. (with G5613 (ὡς) prefixed) as soon as possible
G5033.derivation: neuter plural of the superlative of G5036 (ταχύς) (as adverb);

G0386.strong_def: a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth)

G1844.def:
ἐξ-ορκίζω
(later form of ἐξορκόω ), [in LXX: Jdg.17:2 (אָלָה), Gen.24:3, 3Ki.22:16 (שָׁבַע hi.)* ;]
1. to administer an oath to (Dem., Polyb., al.).
2. to adjure: with accusative of person(s), before κατά, with genitive (as frequently in magic π.; MM, Exp., xiv), Mat.26:63.†
(AS)
G1844.strong_def: to exact an oath, i.e. conjure

G1905.def:
ἐπ-ερωτάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל, also for דָּרַשׁ, etc. ;]
1. to in­quire of, consult, question: with accusative of person(s), Mrk.12:34, Luk.2:46, al.; with dupl. accusative, Mrk.7:17 11:29, Luk.20:40, al.; with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, Mat.12:18, Mrk.9:11; εἰ, Mrk.8:23, Luk.23:6, al.; ἐ. θεόν, Rom.10:20 (LXX).
2. In late Gk., to beg of, demand of: with accusative of person(s) and inf., Mat.16:1 (cf. ἐρωτάω; and see Cromer, 716)
(AS)
G1905.strong_def: to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek

G2862.def:
κολωνία (Rec. -ώνια), -ας, ἡ
(Lat. colonic),
a colony: Act.16:12 (see Lft., Phi., 50 f.).†
(AS)

G2703.def:
κατα-φεύγω
[in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;]
to flee for refuge: before εἰς, Act.14:6; metaphorically, with inf., Heb.6:18.†
(AS)

διετής, -ές

(AS)

G3355.strong_def: a measurer, i.e. (specially), a certain standard measure of capacity for liquids

G4046.strong_def: to make around oneself, i.e. acquire (buy)
G4046.derivation: middle voice from G4012 (περί) and G4160 (ποιέω);

G1567.def:
ἐκ-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, also for נָצַר, בָּקַשׁ, etc. ;]
1. to seek out or after, search for: with accusative of person(s) (1Ma.9:26); figuratively, τ. κύριον, θεόν (cf. Psa.14:2, Amo.5:4, al.), Act.15:17, Rom.3:11, Heb.11:6; εὐλογίαν, Heb.12:17; ἐξεζήτησαν κ. ἐξηραύνησαν (as in 1Ma.9:26), sought and searched out: 1Pe.1:10.
2. As in 2Ki.4:11, Eze.3:18, 20 al. (דָּרַשׁ), to demand, require: Luk.11:50-51 †
(AS)
G1567.strong_def: to search out, i.e. (figuratively)investigate, crave, demand, (by Hebraism) worship

G2525.def:
καθ-ίστημι

1.
(a) to set down;
(b) to bring down to a place (Hom., Xen., al.; 2Ch.28:15, 1Ki.5:3): Act.17:15.

(see Mayor, Ja., 115 f.), Rom.5:19, Jas.3:6 4:4; before εἰς with inf., Heb.8:3; τὰ πρὸς τ. θεόν, Heb.5:1 (cf. ἀντι-, ἀπο-καθίστημι).

Gerasene, of Gerasa, not the G. of Decapolis, 30 m. S.E. of the Lake, but a Gerasa or Gergesa (perh. the mod. Kersa) on E. shore; as subst., pl. οἱ Γ., Mrk.5:1, Luk.8:26, 37 (Γεργεσηνῶν, RV, mg. 1; Γαδαρηνῶν, RV, mg. 2).†

G4792.strong_def: to convey together, i.e. collect or bear away in company with others

G1397.def:
δουλεία (T, -λία), -ας, ἡ

slavery, bondage: Rom.8:15, 21 Gal.4:24 5:1, Heb.2:15.†
(AS)

εὐχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(εὔχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for נָדַר ;]
1. a prayer: Jas.5:15.
2. a vow: Act.18:18 21:23.†
SYN.: see: δέησις (AS)
G2171.strong_def: properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation

G5438.strong_def: a guarding or (concretely, guard), the act, the person; figuratively, the place, the condition, or (specially), the time (as a division of day or night), literally or figuratively

G4274.strong_def: a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor)

G1536.def: if any, if everny, if ever

G1404.def:
δράκων, -ο τος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for תַּנִּין ;]
a dragon, a mythical monster: figuratively, of Satan, Rev.12:3-17 13:2, 4 13:11 16:13 20:2.†
(AS)
G1404.strong_def: a fabulous kind of serpent (perhaps as supposed to fascinate)

G1501.def:
εἴκοσι (never -ιν in WH, cf. Bl., §5, 3, and note), indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά,
twenty: Luk.14:31, Jhn.6:19, Act.1:15 27:28, 1Co.10:8, Rev.4:4, 10 5:8 11:16 19:4.†
(AS)

G4988.strong_def: of safe strength; Sosthenes, a Christian
G4988.derivation: from the base of G4982 (σώζω) and that of G4599 (σθενόω);

G0289.def:
ἀμπελουργός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX for כֹּרֵם ;]

(AS)

G0182.def:
ἀ-κατά-στατος, -ον (καθίστημι),
[in LXX: Isa.54:11 (סֹעֲרָה) ;]
unsettled, unstable: Jas.1:8, 3:8.†
(AS)
G0182.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2525 (καθίστημι);

G0012.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a variation of G1037 (βυθός);

G4911.strong_def: to stand up together, i.e. to resist (or assault) jointly

G2246.strong_def: perhaps akin to the alternate of G138 (αἱρέομαι)); the sun; by implication, light

G2993.strong_def: Laodicia, a place in Asia Minor
G2993.derivation: from a compound of G2992 (λαός) and G1349 (δίκη);

G4878.strong_def: to take hold of opposite together, i.e. co-operate (assist)

G4198.gloss: --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk

G4306.strong_def: to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself)

G0474.def:
ἀντι-βάλλω
[in LXX: 2Ma.11:13 * ;]
to throw in turn, exchange: metaphorically, λόγους (cf. Lat. conferre sermons; see Field, Notes, 81), Luk.24:17.†
(AS)

G4128.strong_def: a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace

G1093.strong_def: soil; by extension a region, or the solid part or the whole of the terrene globe (including the occupants in each application)

G0060.def:
ἀγοραῖος, -ον
(ἀγορά),
1. frequenting the ἀγορά , a lounger in the ἀγορά (Xen., al.): Act.17:5.
2. In late writers (Strab., al.), proper to the ἀγορά : ἀγοραῖοι (sc. ἥμεραι) ἀγονται (cf. Lat. conventus agere), court-days are kept, Act.19:38 (for exx. of both usages, see MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0060.strong_def: relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar

G5506.strong_def: the commander of a thousand soldiers ("chiliarch"; i.e. colonel

G1945.def:
ἐπι-κείμαι
[in LXX: Exo.39:31 (נָתַן), Job.19:3 (הָכַר hi.) Job.21:27 (חָמַס), 1Ma.6:57, 2Ma.1:21, 3Ma.1:22 * ;]
to be placed, lie on: Jhn.21:9; before ἐπί, with dative, Jhn.11:38; figuratively, Heb.9:10; ἀνάγκη, 1Co.9:16; χειμῶν, to threaten, come on: Act.27:20; of persons, to press upon: Luk.5:1 23:23.†
(AS)

G0610.def:
ἀπό-κριμα, -τος, τό
(ἀποκρίνω);
1. prop., a judicial sentence: 2Co.1:9, R, mg.
2. an answer (see Thayer, see word): 2Co.1:9, R, txt. (In FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 6, of a rescript of the Senate; in Inscr. of an official decision, Deiss., BS, 257; a reply to a deputation, MM, see word: cf. also Cremer, 3'75).†
(AS)
G0610.derivation: from G611 (ἀποκρίνομαι) (in its original sense of judging);

G2216.def:
Ζοροβάβελ (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל),
Zerubbabel (1Ch.3:19, al.): Mat.1:12-13 Luk.3:27.†
(AS)

G0962.def:
Βηθαβαρά, -ας (Rec. -ρᾶ, indecl.; Heb. בֵּית עֲבָרָה, place of crossing; -αραβᾷ, R, mg.),
Bethabara: Jhn.1:28, Rec. (WH, R, βηθανία).†
(AS)
G0962.strong_def: ferry-house; Bethabara (i.e. Bethabarah), a place on the Jordan

G0131.def:
αἱμορροέω,
(αἷμα, ῥέω), [in LXX: Lev.15:33 (דָּוֶה) * ;]
to lose blood, suffer from a flow of blood (Hipp.): Mat.9:20.†
(AS)
G0131.strong_def: to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage

G4717.strong_def: to impale on the cross; figuratively, to extinguish (subdue) passion or selfishness

G2143.def:
εὐ-πρέπεια, -ας, ἡ
(εὐπρεπής, comely), [in LXX for הָדָר, etc. ;]
goodly appearance, comeliness: Jas.1:11.†
(AS)
G2143.derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G4241 (πρέπω);

G5432.strong_def: to be a watcher in advance, i.e. to mount guard as a sentinel (post spies at gates); figuratively, to hem in, protect
G5432.derivation: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G3708 (ὁράω);

G0065.def:
ἀγρι-έλαιος, -ον
1. of the wild olive (Anth.).
2. As subst., the wild olive: Rom.11:17, 24 (CGT, in 1.; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)

G1537.def:
ἐκ (ἐξ),
prep. with genitive,
from out of, from (see Addendum, p. 492).

prep. with genitive,
of motion outwards, separation from (opposite to εἰς; = Lat. e, ex), from out of, from among, from.
I. Of Place,
1. of motion, out of, forth from, off from: Jhn.6:31, Act.9:3, Gal.1:8, al.; esp. after verbs of motion, Mat.8:28 17:9, Mrk.1:25 7:28, Jhn.1:33 20:1, Act.12:7, 17 27:30, al.; constr. praeg., σώζειν (διας) ἐκ, Ju 5, Act.28:4. Metaphorical, Mat.7:4, 5, 1Pe.2:9; ἐκ τ. χειρός (-ῶν), before genitive of person(s), Luk.1:74, Jhn.10:28, 29, 39, Act.12:4 24:7, Rev.19:2; πίνειν (which see) ἐκ; of the place from which an action proceeds, Luk.5:3 (cf. 12:36, Jhn.13:4, 2Co.2:4).
2. Of change from one place or condition to another: Jhn.8:42, Rom.6:13 13:11, Rev.7:14, al.; with ellips. of verb of motion, 2Ti.2:26, 2Pe.2:21, Rev.2:21, al.
3. Of separation or distinction from a number, before collective or pl. nouns: Mat.13:47, 49, Jhn.12:1, Act.3:15, 1Pe.1:3, al.; after εἷς, Mat.10:29 Luk.17:15, al.; οὐδείς, Jhn.7:19, al.; πολλοί, Jhn.11:19, al.; τις, Luk.11:15, al.; τίς, Mat.6:27, al.; in partitive phrase as subject of sentence, Jhn.16:17; Hebraistically, ἐκ μέσου before genitive, = ἐκ (Heb. מִתּוֹךְ), Mat.13:49, al.
4. Of position or direction (so in cl. = ἔξω): ἐκ δεξιῶν (see: δεξιός); ἐξ ἐναντίας, Mrk.15:39 (metaphorically, Tit.2:8); ἐκ ῥιζῶν (i.e., utterly), Mat.11:20.
II. Of Time,
1. of the point of time from which, from, since: ἐκ γενετῆς, Jhn.9:1, cf. Mrk.10:20, Luk.23:8, Act.24:10, al.
2. Of succession in time: ἐκ δευτέρου, a second time, Mrk.14:72, al., cf. Mat.26:44; ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, from day to day, 2Pe.2:8.
III. Of Origin,
1. of nativity, lineage, race: κοίτην (ἐν γαστρί) ἔχειν, Rom.9:10, Mat.1:18; γεννᾶν ἐκ, Mat.1:3ff.; γεννᾶσθαι (γίνεσθαι) ἐκ, Jhn.3:6 8:41, Gal.4:4; ἐκ πνεύματος (θεοῦ), Jhn.1:13 3:5ff., al. ἔρχεσθαι, εἶναι, etc., ἐκ τ. πολέως, Jhn.1:44; φυλῆς, Luk.2:36, al.; τ. ἐξουσίας Ἡρῴδου, Luk.23:7; ὁ ὢν ἐκ τ. γῆς, Jhn.3:31.
2. Of the author, occasion or source: Mat.5:37, Jhn.2:16, Rom.2:29, 1Co.8:6, Gal.5:8, al.; ἐκ (τ. θεοῦ, 1Co.7:7, 2Co.5:1, 1Jn.4:7; ἐκ τ. πατρός, Jhn.6:65, al.; ἐκ τ. γῆς ἐστιν, λαλεῖ, Jhn.3:31; εκ καρδίας, Rom.6:17, cf. Mrk.12:30, 1Ti.1:5; ἐκ ψυχῆς, Eph.6:6, Col.3:23; ἐκ πίστεως, Rom.14:23; κρίνειν ἐκ, Luk.19:22, Rev.20:12.
3. Of the agent, after passive verbs: Mat.15:5, Mrk.7:11, 2Co.2:2, al.; frequently in Re after αδικεῖσθαι (2:11), etc.
4. Of cause, dependence, source of supply: τ. πόνου (των), Rev.16:10, 11; τ. φωνῶν, Rev.8:13; ἐκ τούτου, Jhn.6:66 19:12 (but see Meyer, in ll.); ἐκ θεοῦ λαλεῖν, 2Co.2:17; ἐκ τ. ἀληθείας, Jhn.18:37, 1Jn.3:19; ὁ ἐκ πίστεως, Rom.3:26 4:16; οἱ (ὄντες) ἐκ περιτομῆς, Act.11:2, Rom.4:12, Gal.2:12, Col.4:11; πίνειν ἐκ, Mat.26:29, Mrk.14:25, Jhn.4:13, al.; θερίζειν, Gal.6:8; μετέχειν ἐκ (= partit. genitive), 1Co.10:13; with inf., ἐκ τοῦ ἔχειν, 2Co.8:11.
5. Of material: Mat.27:29, Jhn.2:15 19:2, Rom.9:21, 1Co.11:12, Rev.18:12, al.; allied to which is its use of price (= cl. genitive): Mat.27:7, cf. ib. 20:2, Act.1:18.
IV. By attraction = ἐν (cl.): τὰ ἐκ τ. οἰκιας, Mat.24:17; τ. ἐξ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν, Mrk.5:30 (see Field, in l.); ὁ πατὴρ ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, Luk.11:13.
V. Adverbial phrases: ἐξ ἀνάγκης, 2Co.9:7, Heb.7:12; ἐξ ἰσότητος, 2Co.8:13; ἐκ μέρους, 1Co.12:27 13:9-12; ἐκ μέτρου, Jhn.3:34; ἐκ συμφώνου, 1Co.7:5.
VI. in composition, ἐκ signifies,
1. procession, removal: ἐκβαίνω, ἐκβάλλω.
2. Opening out, unfolding: ἐκτείνω; metaphorically, ἐξαγγάλλω.
3. Origin: ἔκγονος.
4. Completeness: ἐξαπορέω (see M, Pr., 237), ἐκπληρόω, ἐκτελέω.
(AS)
G1537.strong_def: literal or figurative; direct or remote)
G1537.derivation: a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause;

G0009.def:
Ἀβειληνή (T, Rec. Ἀβι-), -ῆς, ἡ, (sc. χώρα),
Abilene, a district in the Anti-Lebanon: Luk.3:1.†
(AS)

G1861.strong_def: to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself
G1861.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);

G5467.strong_def: difficult, i.e. dangerous, or (by implication) furious
G5467.derivation: perhaps from G5465 (χαλάω) through the idea of reducing the strength;

G2204.def:
ζέω
[in LXX for רוּם, רָתַח, metaphorically, 4Ma.18:20 ;]
to boil, be hot; metaphorically, of anger, love, zeal: ptcp., fervent: τ. πνεύματι, Act.18:25, Rom.12:11.†
(AS)
G2204.strong_def: to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e. (figuratively) be fervid (earnest)

G0446.def:
ἀνθύπατος -ου, ὁ
(ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος),
supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province (cf. ἡγεμών, and see MM, VGT, 44): Act.13:7-8, 12 18:12 19:38.†
(AS)
G0446.strong_def: instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul
G0446.derivation: from G473 (ἀντί) and a superlative of G5228 (ὑπέρ);

G2870.def:
κοπετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόπτω, mid.), [in LXX chiefly for מִסְפֵּד ;]
= cl. κομμός, a beating of the head and breast, lamentation: before ἐπί with dative of person(s), Act.8:2.†
(AS)

G0374.def:
ἀνα-πείθω
[in LXX: Jer.29:8 (נָשָׁא hi.), 1Ma.1:11 * ;]
to per­suade, incite: Act.18:13 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4697.strong_def: to have the bowels yearn, i.e. (figuratively) feel sympathy, to pity

G0509.def:
ἄνωθεν
adv (ἄνω),
(a) from above: ἀπὸ ἄ., Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., Jhn.19:28; meaning, from heaven: Jhn.3:31 19:11, Jas.1:17 3:15, 17 .
(b) from the first, from the beginning: Luk.1:3, Act.26:5; whence
(with) anew, again: Jhn.3:3, 7, (so most, but see Meyer, in l; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., Gal.4:9 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0509.strong_def: from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew

G4882.strong_def: to despatch (on an errand) in company with

G4802.strong_def: to investigate jointly, i.e. discuss, controvert, cavil

G0977.def:
βιβρώσκω, poët, and late prose,
[in LXX for אכל ;]
to eat: Jhn.6:13.†
(AS)
G0977.derivation: a reduplicated and prolonged form of an obsolete primary verb (perhaps causative of G1006 (βόσκω));

G4759.strong_def: a ruler of an army, i.e. (specially), a Prætorian præfect

G5489.strong_def: a sheet ("chart") of writing-material (as to be scribbled over)

G4482.strong_def: for some tenses of which a prolonged form is used to flow ("run"; as water)

G3354.strong_def: to measure (i.e. ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by implication, to admeasure (i.e. allot by rule)

G2559.def:
κακόω, -ῶ
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָעַע hi., עָנָה pi. ;]
1. to ill-treat, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s), Act.7:6, 19 12:1 18:10, 1Pe.3:13.
2. (not in cl.), to embitter (Psa.106:32): Act.14:2,†
(AS)

G3184.strong_def: to drink to intoxication, i.e. get drunk

G5260.strong_def: to throw in stealthily, i.e. introduce by collusion

G2920.def:
κρίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, also for רִיב, etc. ;]
1. a seperating, selection (Arist., al.)
2. a decision, judgment (cl.): Jhn.8:16, 1Ti.5:24, 2Pe.2:11, Ju 9; κ. κρίνειν, Jhn.7:24; in forensic sense, Act.8:33 (LXX) (see Page, in l); esp. of the Divine judgment, Jhn.3:19 5:24, 27 5:29-30 12:31 16:8, 11, 2Th.1:5, Heb.10:27, Jas.2:13 5:12, 2Pe.2:4, Rev.18:10; pl., Rev.16:7 19:2; of the last judgment, Mat.10:15 11:22, 24 12:36, 41-42 Luk.10:14 11:31-32, Heb.9:27, 2Pe.2:9 3:7, 1Jn.4:17, Ju 6 15; τῆς γεέννης, Mat.23:33.
3. By meton. (as in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, Isa.5:7, al.; דִּישׁוֹן, Dan.7:10), of the standard of judgment, right, justice: Mat.12:18, 20 (LXX, Isa 42:43) Isa 23:23, Luk.11:42; of the tribunal (a local court), Mat.5:21-22†
(AS)
G2920.strong_def: decision (subjectively or objectively, for or against); by extension, a tribunal; by implication, justice (especially, divine law)

G2479.def:
ἰσχύς, -ύος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for כֹּחַ, also for חַיִל, עַז, גְּבוּרָה, etc. ;]
strength, might, power, force, ability: Rev.5:12 7:12; ἰ. κ. δύναμις, 2Pe.2:11; τ. κράτος τῆς ἰ. (Isa.40:26), Eph.1:19 6:10; ἡ δόξα τῆς ἰ., 2Th.1:9; ἐξ ἰ., 1Pe.4:11; ἐν ὅλῃ τ. ἰ., Mrk.12:30, 33" (LXX) Luk.10:27 (LXX).†
SYN.: δύναμις (which see, and cf. ICC, Php.4:13); κράτος (cf. M, Th., I, 1:9) (AS)
G2479.strong_def: compare , a form of G2192 (ἔχω)); forcefulness (literally or figuratively)

G0301.def:
Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Isa.1:1; עָמוֹס, Amo.1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B)
1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Mat.1:10.
2. Amos: Luk.3:25.†
(AS)

G2847.def:
κόκκινος, -η, -ον
(κόκκος, as used of the "berry" of the ilex coccifera, see DB, iv, 416), [in LXX for תּוֹלָע, תּוֹלָע, שָׁנִי, Exo.25:4, Gen.38:23, Isa.1:18, al. ;]
scarlet: Mat.27:28, Heb.9:19, Rev.17:3; neut., without substantive, of clothing, Rev.17:4 18:12, 16,†
(AS)
G2847.derivation: from G2848 (κόκκος) (from the kernel-shape of the insect);

G1395.def:
δότης, -ου, ὁ
(δίδωμι), [in LXX: Pro.22:8 * ;]
= δοτήρ,
a giver: 2Co.9:7 (LXX) (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G1633.def:
εκ-χύννω
Hellenistic form of ἐκχέω, which see (E1., § 17): Mat.23:35 26:28, Mrk.14:24, Luk.5:37 11:50 22:20, Act.1:18 10:45 22:20, Rom.5:5, Ju 11.†
ἐκ-χωρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Num.16:45 (רוּם ni.), Jdg.7:3 (צָפַר), Amo.7:12 (בָּרַח), 1Es.4:44 Est.4:57, 1Ma.9:62 * ;]
to depart, withdraw: Luk.21:21.†
(AS)

G2674.def:
κατ-αριθμέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ch.31:19 (יָחַשׂ hith.), al. ;]
to number or count among: before ἐν, Act.1:1.†
(AS)

G1418.def:
δυσ-
inseparable prefix, opposite to εὖ, like un-, mis- (in unrest, mischance), giving the idea of difficulty, opposition, injuriousness, etc.
(AS)
G1418.strong_def: used only in composition as a prefix; hard, i.e. with difficulty
G1418.derivation: a primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation;

G1110.def:
γνωστός, -ή, -όν, later form of γνωστός
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX for various parts of ידע ;]
known: Act.9:42; with dative, Jhn.18:15, 16 (Rec.), Act.1:19 2:14 4:10 13:38 15:18 19:17 28:22, 28; γ. σημεῖον, a notable (EV) sign, one that is matter of knowledge, Act.4:16; γνωστὸν, Act.15:17, 18; τὸ γνωστὸν θεοῦ, Rom.1:19; in pl., as subst., γνωστοί, acquaintances, Luk.2:44 23:49; so in sing., Jhn.18:16 (WH).†
(AS)

G1098.def:
γλεῦκος (-εος), -ους, τό,
[in LXX for יַיִן, Job.32:19 * ;]
must, sweet new wine (Arist.): Act.2:13.†
(AS)
G1098.strong_def: sweet wine, i.e. (properly) must (fresh juice), but used of the more saccharine (and therefore highly inebriating) fermented wine

G1266.def:
δια-μερίζω
[in LXX chiefly for חלק pi. ;]
1. to distribute: with dative of person(s), Act.2:45; before εἰς, Luk.22:17, pass., Act.2:3. Mid. to distribute among themselves: Mat.27:35, Mrk.15:24, Luk.23:34; with redundant ἑαυτοῖς, Jhn.19:24 (LXX) (see M, Pr., 157).
2. to divide, separate: pass., before ἐπί, with accusative, Luk.11:17-18; ἐπί, with dative, Luk.12:52-53.†
(AS)
G1266.strong_def: to partition thoroughly (literally in distribution, figuratively in dissension)

G4254.strong_def: to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous))

G4767.derivation: from a derivative of an obsolete apparently primary (to hate);

G0850.def:
αὐχμηρός, -ά, -όν
(αὐχμός, drought);
1. dry
2. squalid, dismal: 2Pe.1:19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0850.derivation: from (probably from a base akin to that of G109 (ἀήρ)) (dust, as dried by wind);

G4742.strong_def: a mark incised or punched (for recognition of ownership), i.e. (figuratively) scar of service

G4669.strong_def: to tincture with myrrh, i.e. embitter (as a narcotic)

G4298.gloss: increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax
G4298.strong_def: to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along)

G4464.strong_def: a stick or wand (as a cudgel, a cane or a baton of royalty)

G1849.def:
ἐξουσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔξεστι), [in LXX: 4Ki.20:13, Psa.113 (114):2 135 (136)8, 9, Isa.39:2, Jer.28 (51):28 (מֶמְשָׁלָה), frequently in Da for Aram. שָׁלְטָן, etc., Wis.10:14, Sir.9:13, al. ;]
1. prop., liberty or power to act, freedom to exercise the inward force or faculty expressed by δύναμις (which see): 1Co.9:12; ἐ. ἔχειν, 2Th.3:9; id. before inf., Jhn.10:18, 1Co.9:4, 5; with genitive obj., Rom.9:21; before ἐπί, with accusative, Rev.22:14; περί, 1Co.7:37.
2. Later (cf. Milligan, Th., 114; MM, Exp., xiv), of the power of right, authority: Mat.21:33, Mrk.11:28, Luk.20:2; of Messianic authority, Mat.9:6, Mrk.2:10, al.; of apostolic authority, 2Co.10:8 13:10; of the authority of government: Mat.8:9 28:18, Ju 25, Rev.12:10, al.; esp. of judicial authority, Luk.20:20, Jhn.19:10, 11.
3. Meton.,
(a) jurisdiction: Luk.23:7 (cf. 1Ma.6:11, Isa.39:2);
(b) a ruler or magistrate: Rom.13:1-3; pl., Luk.12:11, Rom.13:1, Tit.3:1;
(with) of supramundane powers (syn. with ἀρχή, δύναμις, θρόνος, κυριότης): 1Co.15:24, Eph.1:21 3:10, Col.2:10, 1Pe.3:22, al. (Cremer. 236).
SYN.: see: δύναμις. (AS)
G1849.strong_def: privilege, i.e. (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence
G1849.derivation: from G1832 (ἔξεστι) (in the sense of ability);

G1574.def:
ἐκ-κεντέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּקַר ;]
1. to prick out, put out (Arist.).
2. to pierce (Polyb., LXX): with accusative of person(s), Jhn.19:37 (LXX), Rev.1:7.†
(AS)
G1574.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G2759 (κέντρον);

G1754.def:
ἐνεργέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Num.8:24 B (עֲבֹדָה צָבָא), Isa.41:4, Pro.21:6 (פָּעַל), Pro.31:12 (גָּמַל), I Est.2:20, Wis.15:11 16:17 * ;] (for full lexical treatment, see AR, Eph., 243 ff.);
1. intrans., to be at work or in action, to operate (opposite to ἀργέω): before ἐν, with dative of person(s), Mat.14:2, Mrk.6:14, Eph.2:2; with dative of person(s), before εἰς (Lft., in l), Gal.2:8.
2. Trans., to work, effect, do: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.12:11, Eph.1:11; id, before ἐν, with dative of person(s), 1Co.12:6, Gal.3:5, Php.2:13; ἐ. ἐνέργειαν, Eph.1:19-20 Pass. (taken as mid. by Lft., Ga., 204 f.; but see AR, Eph., l.with; Milligan, Th., 28 f.; Mayor, Ja., 177 ff.), in NT, "always used of some principle or power at work" (Meyer), to be actuated, set in operation: 2Th.2:7; before ἐν, Rom.7:5, 2Co.1:6 4:12, Eph.3:20, Col.1:29, 1Th.2:13; before διά, with genitive of thing(s), Gal.5:6; ἐνεργουμένη (M, Pr., 156), Jas.5:16 (Cremer, 262).†
(AS)

G0894.def:
ἄψινθος, -ου, ἡ
(also ἀψίνθιον, τό; ἀψινθία, ἡ),
wormwood: as a proper name, Rev.8:11.†
(AS)
G0894.strong_def: wormwood (as a type of bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity)

G4431.strong_def: a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively)

G2032.def:
ἐπουράνιος, -ον
(οὐρανός), [in LXX: Psa.68:14 (שַׁדַּי), DA TH Dan.4:23 A (שָׁמַיִם) 2Ma.3:39, 3Ma.6:28 3Mac 7:6, 4Ma.4:11 AR, 4Ma.11:3 א* ;]
in or of heaven, heavenly (in Hom., of the Gods): οἱ ἐ., opposite to ἐπίγειοι and καταχθόνιοι, Php.2:10; to χοϊκός, 1Co.15:48-49; σώματα (see Lft., Col., 376), 1Co.15:40; βασιλεία, 2Ti.4:18; παπρίς, Heb.11:16; Ἱερουσαλήμ, Heb.12:22; κλῆσις (cf. Lft. on Php.3:14), Heb.3:1; τὰ ἐ., Heb.8:5 9:23; opposite to ἐπίγειος, Jhn.3:12; id., of the heavenly regions, Eph.1:3, 20 2:6 3:10 6:12; ἡ δωρεὰ ἡ ἐ., Heb.6:4 (Cremer, 468).†
(AS)

G0227.def:
ἀληθής, -ές
(λήθω = λανθάνω, hence primarily, unconcealed, manifest; hence, actual, real), [in LXX for אֶמֶת, etc. ;]
(a) of things, true, conforming to reality: Jhn.4:18 5:31-32 6:55 (= ἀληθινός, which see) Jhn.8:13-14, 17 10:41 19:35 21:24, Act.12:9, Php.4:8, Tit.1:13, 1Pe.5:12, 2Pe.2:22, 1Jn.2:6, 3Jn.12;
(b) of persons, truthful: Mat.22:16, Mrk.12:14, Jhn.3:33 7:18 8:26, Rom.3:4, 2Co.6:8.†
SYN.: ἀληθινός, real, genuine, ideal, as opposite to spurious or imperfect ἀληθής, true to fact, as opposite to false, lying, denotes the actuality of a thing: ἀληθινός, its relation to the corresponding con­ception. (Cf. Tr., Syn., § viii; Cremer, 84 f., 631 Abbott, JV, 234 f.; DB, iv, 818 f.; MM, VGT, s.vv.) (AS)
G0227.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2990 (λανθάνω);

G0475.def:
ἀντι-δια-τίθημι
in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose: 2Ti.2:25 (EV; but see Field, Notes, 215 f.; cf. MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0475.strong_def: to set oneself opposite, i.e. be disputatious

G0252.def:
ἁλυκός, -ή, -όν
(ἅλς), [in LXX for מְלַח, שִׂדִּים ;]
salt: Jas.3:12.†
(AS)

G1606.def:
ἐκ-πνέω, -ῶ,
to breathe out; sc. βίον, ψυχήν (expressed in cl., Æsch., al.; cf. LS, see word), to breathe one's last, expire: Mrk.15:37, 39 Luk.23:46. For force of aorist, see Swete, Mrk.15:37.†
(AS)

G0764.def:
ἀσεβέω, -ῶ
(ἀσεβής), [in LXX for פָּשַׁע, רָשַׁע ;]
to be ungodly, act profanely: 2Pe.2:6; with cogn. accusative (MM, see word), Ju 15.†
(AS)
G0764.strong_def: to be (by implied act) impious or wicked

G3399.strong_def: Miletus, a city of Asia Minor

G2589.def:
καρδιο-γνώστης, -ου, ὁ
(καρδία, γνώστης),
knower of hearts: Act.1:24 15:8.†
(AS)

G3934.strong_def: a Parthian, i.e. inhabitant of Parthia

G0344.def:
ἀνα-κάμπτω
[in LXX: 1Ch.19:5, Jer.3:1, al. (שׁוּב), Jer.15:5 (סוּר) ;]
1. trans., to bend or turn back.
2. Intrans., to return: Mat.2:12, Act.18:21, Heb.11:15; metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), Luk.10:6.†
(AS)

G1079.def:
γενετή, -ῆς, ἡ = γενεή, Ion. for γενεά,
[in LXX: Lev.25:47 (עֵקֶר מִשְׁפָּחָו), Est.4:17 * ;]
birth: ἐκ γ., Jhn.9:1.†
(AS)
G1079.derivation: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of G1074 (γενεά);

G1694.def:
Ἐμμανουήλ, ὁ (Heb. עִמָּנוּאֵל, Isa.7:14),
Immanuel: Mat.1:23 (LXX).†
(AS)
G1694.strong_def: God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ

G5200.strong_def: wet (as if with rain), i.e. (by implication) sappy (fresh)

G3483.gloss: even so, surely, truth, verily, yea, yes
G3483.derivation: a primary particle of strong affirmation;

G1080.def:
γεννάω, -ῶ
(γέννα, poët. for γένος), [in LXX chiefly for ילד ;]
1. of the father, to beget: with accusative, Mat.1:1-16, Act.7:8, 29; before ἐκ, Mat.1:3, 5, 6.
2. Of the mother, to bring forth, bear: Luk.1:13, 57 23:29, Jhn.16:21; εἰς δουλείαν, Gal.4:24. Pass.
(1) to be begotten: Mat.1:20;
(2) to be born: Mat.2:1, 4 19:12 26:24, Mrk.14:21, Luk.1:35, Jhn.3:4, Act.7:20, Rom.9:11, Heb.11:23; before εἰς, Jhn.16:21 18:37, 2Pe.2:12; ἐν, Act.2:8 22:3, (ἁμαρτίαις), Jhn.9:34; ἀπό, Heb.11:12 (WH, mg., ἐγεν-); ἐκ, Jhn.1:13 3:6 8:41; with adj., τυφλὸς γ., Jhn.9:2; [Ῥωμαῖος ], Act.22:28; κατὰ σάρκα: κ. πνεῦμα: Gal.4:29. Metaphorical; μάχας, 2Ti.2:23; ὑμᾶς ἐγέννησα, 1Co.4:15, (ὅν), Phm 10; in quotation, Psa.2:7 (LXX), Act.13:33, Heb.1:5 5:5; of Christians as begotten of God, born again: Jhn.1:13 3:3, 5-8, 1Jn.2:29 3:9 4:7 5:1, 4, 18 (cf. ἀνα-γεννάω); (Cremer, 146).
(AS)
G1080.strong_def: to procreate (properly, of the father, but by extension of the mother); figuratively, to regenerate

G1464.def:
ἐγκοπή, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-κοπή (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν; T, ἐκκ-), -ῆς, ἡ (ἐγκόπτω) ;
1. an incision, a cutting, break. 2. Metaphorical, an interruption, a hindrance: 1Co.9:12.†
(AS)

G5021.strong_def: to arrange in an orderly manner, i.e. assign or dispose (to a certain position or lot)
G5021.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which latter appears only in certain tenses);

G3721.strong_def: in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break

G0152.def:
αἰσχύνη, -ης, ἡ
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX chiefly for בּשֶׁת ;]
shame (MM, VGT, see word): subjectively, Luk.14:19, 2Co.4:2; objectively, Php.3:19, Heb.12:2; as something to be ashamed of, Rev.3:18; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), shameful deeds, Ju 13.†
SYN.: αἰδώς, which see (AS)

G5118.gloss: as large, so great (long, many, much), these many
G5118.strong_def: apparently from G3588 (ὁ) and G3739 (ὅς)) and G3778 (οὗτος) (including its variations); so vast as this, i.e. such (in quantity, amount, number of space)

G4342.gloss: attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually)
G4342.strong_def: to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor)

G0271.def:
ἀμέθυστος, -ου, ἡ
(accusative to Plut., ἀ- μεθύω, being regarded as an antidote against drunkenness) [in LXX: Exo.28:19 36:19 39:12 Eze.28:13 * ;]
amethyst, a purple quartz: Rev.21:20.†
(AS)
G0271.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3184 (μεθύω);

G0786.def:
ἄσπονδος, -ον
(σπονδή, a libation);
1. without truce (Thuc.).
2. admitting of no truce, implacable (Dem., al.): 2Ti.3:3.†
(AS)
G0786.strong_def: literally, without libation (which usually accompanied a treaty), i.e. (by implication) truceless
G0786.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4689 (σπένδω);

G4723.derivation: a contraction from G4731 (στερεός) (as stiff and unnatural);

G5230.strong_def: beyond the "acme", i.e. figuratively (of a daughter) past the bloom (prime) of youth
G5230.derivation: from G5228 (ὑπέρ) and the base of G188 (ἀκμήν);

G1583.def:
ἐκ-λαλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jdth.11:9 * ;]
to speak out, divulge: Act.23:22.†
(AS)

G4993.gloss: be in right mind, be sober (minded), soberly
G4993.strong_def: to be of sound mind, i.e. sane, (figuratively) moderate

G4771.derivation: the personal pronoun of the second person singular;

G0934.def:
βασίλειος, -ον (also -α, -ον; βασιλεύς),
[in LXX; Exo.19:6, Deu.3:10 (מַמְלָכָה), Exo.23:22, Wis.18:15, 3Ma.3:28, 4Ma.3:8 * ;]
royal: 1Pe.2:9 (LXX) (see Hort, in l.).†
royal, regal, kingly;, metaphorically possessed of high prerogatives and distinction, 1Pet. 2:9; (AS)

G3696.strong_def: an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war)
G3696.derivation: probably from a primary (to be busy about);

G2929.def:
κρυσταλλίζω
(κρύσταλλος),
to shine like crystal, be crystal-clear: Rev.21:11 (ἅπ, λεγ.).†
(AS)

G3667.gloss: made like to, likeness, shape, similitude

G0630.def:
ἀπο-λύω
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;]
1. to set free, release: Luk.13:12, Jhn.19:10, al.; a debtor, Mat.18:27; metaphorically, of forgive­ness, Luk.6:37.
2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): Mat.15:23, Luk.2:29 9:12, Act.19:41, al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: Mat.1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10 Mrk.10:2, 4 10:11, Luk.16:18; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: Mrk.10:12. Mid., to depart: Act.28:25 (MM, see word)
(AS)
G0630.strong_def: to free fully, i.e. (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively, depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon or (specially) divorce

G2936.def:
κτίζω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרָא, Psa.51:10, al.; also for קָנָה, Gen.14:19, Pro.8:22; יָצַר, Isa.22:11 46:11; Wis.2:23, Sir.1:4, 9 (and freq.), I Est.4:53, a1. ;]
1. in cl., to people or found a region or city (1Es, l.with).
2. In LXX and NT, of God, to create: Mrk.13:19, 1Co.11:9, Col.1:16 3:10 Eph.3:9, 1Ti.4:3, Rev.4:11 10:6; ὁ κτίσας, Mat.19:4 (WH, R, mg.), Rom.1:25; of the divine operation on the soul, Eph.2:10, 15 4:24 (cf. Ps., l.with).†
(AS)
G2936.derivation: probably akin to G2932 (κτάομαι) (through the idea of proprietorship of the manufacturer);

G5175.strong_def: Trogyllium, a place in Asia Minor

G0449.def:
ἄνιπτος, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νίπτω),
unwashed: Mat.15:20, Mrk.7:5 (5 Rec).†
(AS)
G0449.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3538 (νίπτω);

G2160.def:
εὐτραπελία, -ας, ἡ
(εὖ, τρέπω),
1. versatility, wit, facetiousness (Hippocr., Plat., al.).
2. = βωμολογία, coarse jesting, ribaldry (Abbott, Essays, 93): Eph.5:4.†
SYN.: μωρολογία, see Tr., Syn., § xxxiv (AS)
G2160.strong_def: witticism, i.e. (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry
G2160.derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of the base of G5157 (τροπή) (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose);

G0216.def:
ἄ-λαλος, -ον
(λάλος, talkative), [in LXX: Psa.31:18 (אָלַם ni.) Psa.38:13 (אִלֵּם)* ;]
dumb, speechless: Mrk.7:37 9:17, 25.†
(AS)
G0216.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2980 (λαλέω);

G0523.def:
ἀπ-αιτέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Deu.15:2-3, al. (נָגַשׂ), Sir.20:15, Wis.15:8, al. ;]
to ask back, demand back: Luk.6:30 12:20 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G4886.strong_def: a joint tie, i.e. ligament, (figuratively) uniting principle, control

G0173.def:
ἄκανθα, -ης, ἡ
(ἀκή, a point), [in LXX chiefly for קוֹץ, also for סִיר, שַׁיִת, etc. ;]
a prickly plant, thorn, brier; in NT always pl.: Mat.7:16 13:7,22 27:29, Mrk.4:7,18, Luk.6:44 8:7,14, Jhn.19:2, Heb.6:8 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0173.derivation: probably from the same as G188 (ἀκμήν);

G1898.def:
ἐπ-εισ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
a bringing in besides or in addition (Hipp., FlJ, al.): Heb.7:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)
G1898.derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G1521 (εἰσάγω);

G3197.strong_def: Melchi (i.e. Malki), the name of two Israelites
G3197.derivation: of Hebrew origin (H04428 with pronominal suffix, my king);

G0460.def:
ἀνόμως,
adv. [in LXX: 2Mac 817* ;]
1. lawlessly (2Mac, l.with).
2. = χωρὶς νόμου, without law: Rom.2:12.†
(AS)
G0460.strong_def: lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law

G1551.def:
ἐκ-δέχομαι
[in LXX for עֶרֶב, קָבַץ, etc. ;]
1. to take or receive from (Hom., Hdt., a1.).
2. (Rare in cl.), to expect, await: with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.5:3, Heb.11:10, Jas.5:7; with accusative of person(s), Act.17:16, 1Co.11:33 16:11; before ἕως, Heb.10:13 (Cremer, 687).†
(AS)
G1551.strong_def: to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication) to await

G1334.def:
δι-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to set out in detail, recount, describe: absol., Heb.11:32; with accusative of thing(s), Act.8:33; with dative of person(s), before πῶς, Mrk.5:16, Act.9:27 12:17; ἅ εἶδον, Mrk.9:9; ὅσα ἐποίησε, -αν, Luk.8:39 9:10.†
(AS)

G4472.strong_def: to render besprinkled, i.e. asperse (ceremonially or figuratively)

G4437.strong_def: clasped (thick), i.e. (figuratively) frequent; neuter plural (as adverb) frequently

G1466.def:
ἐγκράτεια, -ας, ἡ (-ἐγκρατής),
[in LXX: Sir.18:15, 30 4Ma.5:34 * ;]
1. prop., mastery, control.
2. (sc. ἑαθτοῦ) self-control: Act.24:25, Gal.5:23, 2Pe.1:6 (see DB, iv, 558b 695a; Page on Ac, l.with).
† (AS)

G1239.def:
δια-διδωμι
[in LXX for חלק pi., etc. ;]
1. to hand over, deliver: Rev.17:13, Rec.
2. to distribute: Luk.11:22 18:22, Jhn.6:11, Act.4:35†
(AS)
G1239.strong_def: to give throughout a crowd, i.e. deal out; also to deliver over (as to a successor)

G4340.gloss: dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal
G4340.strong_def: for the occasion only, i.e. temporary

G2685.def:
κατά-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רָגַל pi. ;]
a spy: Heb.11:31.†
(AS)
G2685.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) (intensive) and G4649 (σκοπός) (in the sense of a watcher);

G4055.strong_def: more superabundant (in number, degree or character)

G2512.def:
καθαρισμός, -oῦ, τό
(καθαρίζω). [in LXX for טָהֵר, טׇהֳרָה, etc. ;]
cleansing, purification: Jhn.3:25; with genitive subjc., τ. Ἰουδαίων, Jhn.2:6; with genitive obj., of women after childbirth, Luk.2:22; of lepers, Mrk.1:44, Luk.5:14; with genitive of thing(s), τ. ἁμαρτιῶν, Heb.1:3, 2Pe.1:9 (Cremer, 319).†
(AS)
G2512.strong_def: a washing off, i.e. (ceremonially) ablution, (morally) expiation

G4381.strong_def: an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality

G2924.def:
κριτικός, -ή, -όν
(κρίνω),
critical, able to discern or judge: with genitive obj., Heb.4:12.†
(AS)

G4914.derivation: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G2239 (ἦθος);

G4773.strong_def: a relative (by blood); by extension, a fellow countryman

G4927.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of a compound of the base of 3674 and the base of G3725 (ὅριον);

G1308.def:
δια-φέρω
[in LXX for שְׁנָא (שְׁנָא (Dan.7:1-28 only); 1Ki.17:39, Est.3:13, al. ;]
1. trans.,
(a) to carry through: before διά, Mrk.11:16;
(b) to carry about, spread abroad: pass., Act.13:49 27:27.
2. Intrans.,
(a) to differ: τὰ διαφέροντα, Rom.2:18, Php.1:10 (R, mg., but see infr.); impers., διαφέρει, it makes a difference, it matters: Gal.2:6;
(b) to excel: with genitive Mat.6:26 10:31 12:12, Luk.12:7, 24, 1Co.15:41, Gal.4:1; τὰ διαφέροντα, Rom.2:18, Php.1:10 (R, txt.; for discussion and reff. see ICC on Ro, Phi, ll. with).†
(AS)
G1308.strong_def: to bear through, i.e. (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e. (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass

G0847.def:
αὐτοῦ
adv., prop. neut. genitive of αὐτός, [in LXX for פֹּה, בָּזֶה ;]
there: Mat.26:36, Mrk.6:33, WH, mg., Luk.9:27, Act.15:34, WH, mg., R, mg., Act.18:19 21:4 .†
(AS)
G0847.strong_def: properly, belonging to the same spot, i.e. in this (or that) place
G0847.derivation: genitive (i.e. possessive) of G846 (αὐτός), used as an adverb of location;

G2147.def:
εὑρίσκω,
[in LXX chiefly for מצא, also for נשׂג hi., etc. ;]
to find, with or without previous search: absol., opposite to ζητέω, Mat.7:7, 8 Luk.11:9, 10; with accusative, Mat.2:8, Mrk.1:37, Act.13:22, 2Ti.1:17, al.; pass., οὐχ εὑ., of disappearance, Heb.11:5, Rev.16:20, al.; γῆ κ. τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα εὑρεθήσεται (for conjectures as to the meaning of this reading, see Mayor, ICC, in l.), 2Pe.3:10, WH, R, mg. Metaphorical, to find, find out by inquiry, learn, discover: Luk.19:48, Act.4:21; αἰτίαν, Jhn.18:38, Act.13:28, al.; pass., Mat.1:18, Luk.17:18, Rom.7:10, 1Co.4:2, Gal.2:17, 1Pe.1:7, Rev.5:4, al.; of attaining to the knowledge of God, εὑ. θεόν, Act.17:27; pass., Rom.10:20 (LXX). Mid., to find for oneself, gain, procure, obtain: with accusative of thing(s), λύτρωσιν, Heb.9:12; act. in same sense (so cl. poets, but not in Attic prose), Mat.10:39 11:29, Luk.1:30, Act.7:46, 2Ti.1:18, al. (cf. ἀν-ευρίσκω).
(AS)
G2147.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary , which (together with another cognate form) is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect;

G3762.gloss: any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought
G3762.strong_def: not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none, nobody, nothing

G3652.derivation: probably a contraction from (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended);

G0136.def:
αἶνος, ου, ὁ,
[in LXX for הלל pi, עֹז ;]
poët, and Ion.,
1. = μῦθος, a tale (Horn., al.).
2. = Att. ἔπαινος, praise (Horn., al.): Mat.21:16 (LXX), Luk.18:43.
3. In π., a decree (MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0136.strong_def: properly, a story, but used in the sense of G1868 (ἔπαινος); praise (of God)

G0901.def:
βαθύς (genitive -έως, vernac., Lk, l.with; Bl., §8, 5), -εῖα, -ύ,
[in LXX chiefly for עמק ;]
deep; Jhn.4:11; metaphorically, ὄρθρου βαθέως (see supr.), early dawn, Luk.24:1; ὕπνος, Act.20:9; τὰ β. τοῦ Σατανᾶ, Rev.2:24.†
(AS)
G0901.strong_def: profound (as going down), literally or figuratively

G4820.gloss: confer, encounter, help, make, meet with, ponder
G4820.strong_def: to combine, i.e. (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack

G4535.derivation: probably from the base of G4525 (σαίνω);

G5128.strong_def: these (persons, as objective of verb or preposition)
G5128.derivation: accusative case plural masculine of G3778 (οὗτος);

G1777.def:
ἔνοχος, -ον (= ἐνεχόμενος),
(in LXX for רָשַׁע hi., etc. ;]
1. held in, bound by: with genitive (cl. with dative), δουλείας, Heb.2:15.
2. In law-phrases
(a) liable to a charge or action (cl. with dative, of crime): with dative, of the tribunal (MM, Exp., xiii), Mat.5:21-22; before εἰς (Field, Notes, 4 f.), Mat.5:22
(b) with genitive, of the punishment (Gen.26:11): θανάτου, Mat.26:66, Mrk.14:64;
(with) with genitive (cl. with dative„ rarely with prep.; MM, Exp., xiii), of the crime (2Ma.13:6): Mrk.3:29;
(d) with genitive, of the thing injured, guilty (absol., in Cl.): 1Co.11:27, Jas.2:10 (cf. Isa.54:17; DB, ii, 268a).†
(AS)
G1777.strong_def: liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation)

G1166.derivation: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary of the same meaning;

G2397.def:
ἰδέα, -ας, ἡ, see: εἰδέα
εἰδέα (Rec. ἰδ-, as in cl.; see Tdf., Pr., 81), -ας, ἡ (εἶδον), [in LXX (seel. ἰδ-): Gen.5:3 (דְּמוּת), Da TH 1:13, 15 (מַרְאֶה), Ep. Jer.63, 2Ma.3:16 * ;]
appearance, look: Mat.28:3.†
(AS)

G0895.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5590 (ψυχή);

G1805.def:
ἐξ-αγοράζω
[in LXX: καιρόν ὑμεῖς ἐξαγοράζετε (זְבַן), Dan LXX TH Dan.2:8 * ;]
1. to redeem, ransom (esp. of slaves): metaphorically, Gal.3:13 4:5.
2. to buy up; mid., to buy up for oneself: τ. καιρόν, Eph.5:16, Col.4:5 (Cremer, 60).†
(AS)
G1805.strong_def: to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity)

G1440.def:
ἑβδομήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl.
(ἑπτά),
seventy: Luk.10:1, 17 Act.7:14 23:23 27:37.†
(AS)
G1440.derivation: from G1442 (ἕβδομος) and a modified form of G1176 (δέκα);

G1241.def:
δια-ζώννυμι, (also -ννύω)
[in LXX for חֲגוֹר, Eze.23:15 A * ;]
to gird round: ἑαυτόν, Jhn.13:4; pass., ib. 13:5; mid., to gird oneself with: with accusative, Jhn.21:7.†
(AS)

G1949.def:
ἐπι-λαμβάνω
[in LXX for חָזַק hi., אָחַז, etc. ;]
always mid. in LXX and NT (see Cremer, 758), to lap hold of: with genitive of person(s), Mat.14:31, Act.17:19 21:30, 33; with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Luk.9:47 14:4 23:26 (WH, but see Bl., 1015), Act.9:27 16:9 18:17; with genitive of thing(s), Mrk.8:23, Act.23:10, Heb.8:9" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s) and of thing(s), Luk.20:20, 26; τ. αἰωνίου (ὄντως) ζωῆς, 1Ti.6:12 6:19. Metaphorical (as in Sir.4:11), Heb.2:16 (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)
G1949.strong_def: to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively)
G1949.derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);

G2631.def:
κατά-κριμα, -τος, τό
(κατακρίνω),
penalty (RV, condemnation; but cf. Deiss., BS, 264 f.; MM, Exp., xv): Rom.5:16, 18 8:1.†
(AS)

G0269.def:
ἄμαχος, -ον
(μάχη);
1. invincible (frequently in cl.).
2. abstaining from fighting, non-combatant (Xen.). Metaphorical (cf. MM, VGT, see word), not contentious: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.3:2.†
(AS)
G0269.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3163 (μάχη);

G2976.strong_def: Lazarus (i.e. Elazar), the name of two Israelites (one imaginary)

G1365.def:
διστάζω
(δίς),
to doubt, hesitate: Mat.14:31 28:17.†
SYN.: ἀπορέω, διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491) (AS)
G1365.strong_def: properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion)

G2918.def:
κρίνον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּשַׁן ;]
a lily: Mat.6:28, Luk.12:27.†
(AS)

G2753.def:
κελεύω
[in LXX: I Est.9:53, Tob.8:18, al., and frequently in 1-4Mac ;]
to urge on, bid by word of mouth, order, command (mostly of one in authority): with accusative and inf. aor., Mat.14:19, 28 18:25 27:64, Luk.18:40, Act.4:15 5:34 8:38 22:30 23:10 25:6, 17; with ellipse of accusative, Mat.8:18 14:9 27:58, Act.12:19 21:33; with accusative and inf. Pres., Act.21:34 22:24 23:3, 35 25:21 27:43; with ellipse of accusative, Act.16:22; ptcp. aor., Act.25:23.†
SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)
G2753.strong_def: "hail"; to incite by word, i.e. order

G0464.def:
ἀντ-αγωνίζομαι depon.,
[in LXX: 4Ma.17:14 * ;]
to struggle against: before πρός, with accusative, Heb.12:4.†
(AS)

G1674.def:
Ἑλληνίς
[in LXX: 2Ma.6:8 A * ;]
a Greek (i.e. Gentile) woman: Mrk.7:26, Act.17:12.†
(AS)

G0458.def:
ἀνομία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄνομος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, פֶּשַׁע, תּוֹעֵבַה, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
lawlessness, iniquity: Mat.7:23 13:41 23:28 24:12, Rom.6:19, 2Co.6:14, 2Th.2:3 2:7, Tit.2:14, Heb.1:9, 1Jn.3:4; in pl. (as LXX, Psa.31:1, al.; see 131., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), of acts or manifestations of lawlessness: Rom.4:7 (LXX), Heb.10:17.†
SYN.: see: ἁμάρτημα, ἄνομος (AS)
G0458.strong_def: illegality, i.e. violation of law or (genitive case) wickedness

G0393.def:
ἀνα-τέλλω
[in LXX for צָמַח, פָּרַח, זָרַח, etc. ;]
1. trans., to cause to rise: Mat.5:45.
2. Intrans., to rise: φῶς, Mat.4:16 (= Isa.9:1); ὁ ἥλιος, Mat.13:6, Mrk.4:6 16:2, Jas.1:11; νεφέλη, Luk.12:54; φωσφόρος, 2Pe.1:19; ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaphorically of sun or star, Heb.7:14 (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).†
(AS)
G0393.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G5056 (τέλος);

G3358.strong_def: a measure ("metre"), literally or figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree)

G2491.def:
Ἰωάνης (Rec. ννης, which see; cf. Dalman, Gr., 142; Tdf., Pr., 79; WH, App., 159; Bl., §3, 10; 10, 2), -ου, dative, -ῃ (but in Mat.11:4. Luk.7:18, 22 Rev.1:1, ει), accusative, -ην, ὁ (Heb. יוֹחָנָן, LXX: Ἰωανάν, 2Ch.23:1, al.; -ννάν, Je 47 (40):8, al., Aq.), Hellenized form of Ἰωανάν,
John ( I Est.8:38(41)*), viz.,
1. John the Baptist: Mat.3:1, al.
2. John the Apostle, son of Zebedee: Mat.4:21, Mrk.1:19, Luk.5:10, Act.1:13, al.
3. The father of St. Peter: Jhn.1:43 21:15-17.
4. John surnamed Mark: Act.12:12, 25 13:5, 13 15:37.
5. The writer of the Apocalypse, traditionally identified with 2: Rev.1:1, 4 9.
Ἰωάννης (D, Ἰωνάθας; see MM, Exp., XV; Bl., §10, 2), ὁ,
John: Act.4:6 13:5, Tr., WH, Rev.22:8 (cf. Ἰωάνης).†
(AS)
G2491.strong_def: Joannes (i.e. Jochanan), the name of four Israelites

G0513.def:
αξίνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for גַּרְזֶן, קַרְדֹּם ;]
an axe: Mat.3:10, Luk.3:9.†
(AS)

G0785.def:
ἀσπίς, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX for פֶּתֶן, etc. ;]
an asp: Rom.3:13.†
(AS)
G0785.strong_def: a buckler (or round shield); used of a serpent (as coiling itself), probably the "asp"

G0776.def:
ἀσιτία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄσιτος),
fasting, abstinence from food: Act.27:21.†
SYN.: νηστεία (MM, ut infr.) (AS)

G2435.def:
ἱλαστήριος, -α, -ον
(ἱλάσκομαι), [in LXX: 4Ma.17:22; neut., Exo.25:16 (17) ff. Exo.31:7 35:12 37:6 ff., Lev.16:2, 13 ff. Num.7:89 (כַּפֹּרֶת), Eze.43:14, 17 43:20 (עֲזָרָה) Amo.9:1 (on the original here, see Deiss., BS, 127)* ;]
propitiatory (μνῆμα, FlJ, Ant., xvi, 7, 1; θάνατος, 2Mac, l.with): of Christ, Rom.3:25; as subst., το ἱ. (sc. ἐπίθεμα, Exo.25:16-17, where the word first occurs in LXX and where ἱ. ἐ. = כַּפֹּרֶת (which see in BDB, see word), elsewhere rendered simply τὸ ἱ; cf. Deiss., 124 ff.; Westc., He., in l), Heb.9:5.†
(AS)
G2435.strong_def: an expiatory (place or thing), i.e. (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple)
G2435.derivation: neuter of a derivative of G2433 (ἱλάσκομαι);

G1560.def:
ἔκ-δοτος, -ον
(ἐκδίδωμι), [in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:22 * ;]
given up, delivered over: Act.2:23 (for construction, see Field, Notes, 111 f.).†
(AS)
G1560.strong_def: given out or over, i.e. surrendered
G1560.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G1325 (δίδωμι);

G0213.def:
ἀλαζών, -όνος, ὁ, ἡ
(ἄλη, wandering) [in LXX: Job.28:8 (שַׁחַץ) Hab.2:5 (יָהִיר), Pro.21:24 (לוּץ)* ;]
prop, a vagabond, hence, an impostor, a boaster: Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.†
SYN.: ὐβριστής, ὑπερήφανος (see Tr., Syn., § xxix; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)

G1903.def:
ἐπενδύτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπενδύω), [in LXX for מְעִיל Lev.8:7 A (Aq. ἐπένδυμα), 3Ki.18:4 A, 4Ki.13:18 * ;]
an outer tunic (RV, coat): Jhn.21:7 .†
(AS)

G0284.def:
Ἀμιναδάβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb עַמִּינָדָב),
Amminadab: Mat.1:4, Luk.3:33 (WH om.).†
(AS)

G1910.def:
ἐπι-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב ;]
1. to get up on, mount: before ἐπί, with accusative, Mat.21:5 (LXX); to embark in (a boat), go aboard: with dative, Act.27:2; before εἰς, Act.21:6 (Rec.); absol., Act.21:2.
2. to go up to, go on to, enter: before εἰς, Act.20:18 21:4; with dative, Act.25:1.†
(AS)
G1910.strong_def: to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive
G1910.derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G939 (βάσις);

G4893.derivation: from a prolonged form of G4894 (συνείδω);

G0622.strong_def: to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively
G0622.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G3639 (ὄλεθρος);

G2561.def:
κάκωσις, -εως, ἡ
(κακόω) [Ín LXX (for עָנִי, יָדַע, etc.): Exo.3:7, Jer.2:28, Wis.3:2, al. ;]
ill-treatment: Act.7:34 (LXX),†
(AS)

G2319.def:
θεοστυγής, -ές
(θεός, στυγέω),
1. passive, as frequently in cl., hateful to God: Rom.1:30 (R, txt., cf. Lit., Notes, 256).
2. Active, hating God: lb. (R, mg., cf. ICC, in l).†
(AS)
G2319.derivation: from G2316 (θεός) and the base of G4767 (στυγνητός);

G3984.derivation: from the base of G4008 (πέραν) (through the idea of piercing);

G3569.strong_def: the things now, i.e. (adverbially) at present
G3569.derivation: from neuter plural of G3588 (ὁ) and G3568 (νῦν);

G1814.def:
ἐξ-άλλομαι
[in LXX for קָלַל (Hab.1:8), etc. ;]
to leap up: Act.3:8.†
(AS)

G4506.strong_def: compare G4511 (ῥύσις)); to rush or draw (for oneself), i.e. rescue
G4506.derivation: middle voice of an obsolete verb, akin to G4482 (ῥέω) (through the idea of a current;

G4813.strong_def: probably akin to G138 (αἱρέομαι); compare G4661 (σκῦλον)); to despoil

G0928.def:
βασανίζω
(βάσανος), [in LXX: 1Ki.5:3, Sir.4:17, and frequently in Wi, II, 4Mac ;]
1. prop., to rub on the touchstone, put to the test.
2. to examine by torture, hence, generally, to torture, torment, distress: Mat.8:6, 29 14:24, Mrk.5:7 6:48, Luk.8:28, 2Pe.2:8, Rev.9:5 11:10 12:2 14:10 20:10.
† (AS)

G1854.strong_def: out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively

G1522.def:
είσ-ακούω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁמַע, also for עָנָה, etc. ;]
to listen to, in two senses;
(a) to obey: 1Co.14:21 (cf. Deu.1:43, Sir.3:6)
(b) to listen, assent to; pass., to be heard: of persons praying, Mat.6:7, Heb.5:7; of the prayer offered, Luk.1:13, Act.10:31 (cf. Psa.4:2, Sir.34:26); see Cremer, 624).†
(AS)

G2250.def:
ἡμέρα, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly (very freq.) for יוֹם ;]
day;
1. as distinct from night: genitive ἡμέρας, by day (WM, §30, 11), Rev.21:25; ἡ. κ. νυκτός (ν. κ. ̔ἡ.), Act.9:24, 1Th.2:9, 2Th.3:8, Rev.4:8 (BL, §36, 13); ἡμέρας μέσης, at mid-day, Act.26:13; accusative durat., τ. ἡμέρας, Luk.21:37; ὅλην τὴν ἡ., Rom.8:36; ἐν ἡμέρα, Jhn.11:9, Rom.13:13; ἡμέρας ὁδός, a day's journey, Luk.2:44; ἡ. γίνεται, Lk 4:42 22:66; κλίνει, Luk.9:12, al.; metaphorically, Jhn.9:4, Rom.13:12, 1Th.5:4, 5 8, 2Pe.1:19.
2. Of a civil day of 24 hours, incl. night: Mat.6:34, Mrk.6:21, Luk.13:14, al.; τρίτῃ ἡ., Mat.16:21; ἡμέρᾳ κ. ἡ. (cf. יוֹם בְּיוֹם, Est.3:4), 2Co.4:16; ὅλην τ. ἡ., Rom.8:36 10:21; pl., Jhn.2:12, Act.9:19, al.; ἡ. τῶν ἀζύμων, Act.12:3; τ. σαββάτου, Luk.13:14, 16; ἡ κυριάκη ἡ., Rev.1:10.
3. In Messianic sense, of the last day: ἡ ἡ. (ἐκείνη, τ. κυρίου, etc.), Mat.7:22, Luk.6:23, Rom.13:12, 1Co.1:8, 1Th.5:2, 2Th.2:2, 2Pe.3:10, al; by meton., as compared with the divine judgment on that day, ἡ. ἀνθρωπίνη, of a human tribunal, 1Co.4:3 (EV, man's judgment).
4. As in Heb. (also in Gk. writers; Bl, §46, 9; M, Pr., 81), of time in general: Jhn.8:56 14:20, 2Co.6:2, Eph.6:13, 2Pe.3:18; pl. Act.15:7, Eph.5:16, Heb.10:32; πᾶσας τὰς ἡ. (cf. כָּל הַיָּמִים, Deu.4:40, al.; MM, Exp., xv), Mat.28:20; ἐλεύσονται ἡ. ὅταν (ὅτε), Mat.9:15, Mrk.2:20, Luk.5:35 17:22; αἱ ἡ., with genitive of person(s) (Gen.26:1, al.), Mat.2:1, Luk.1:5, Act.7:45, 1Pe.3:20; ἀρχ̀ ἡμερῶν, Heb.7:3.
(AS)
G2250.strong_def: day, i.e. (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context)
G2250.derivation: feminine (with G5610 (ὥρα) implied) of a derivative of (to sit; akin to the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος)) meaning tame, i.e. gentle;

G1650.def:
ἔλεγχος, -ου, ὁ
(ἐλέγχω) [in LXX: frequently in Pr, Jb (יָכַח) יָכַח) Wis.5:1-23, Sir.3:1-31, etc. ;]
a proof, test: Heb.11:1.†
(AS)

G2971.derivation: apparently a derivative of the base of G2759 (κέντρον) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

G5089.derivation: perhaps akin to the alternate of G138 (αἱρέομαι), and thus to G4951 (σύρω);

G2751.def:
κείρω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּזַז, Isa.53:7, al. ;]
to cut short the hair, shear: a sheep, Act.8:32 (Isa, l.with). Mid., to have one's hair cut off, be shorn: absol., 1Co.11:6; τ-. κεφαλήν, Act.18:18.†
(AS)

G4902.derivation: middle voice from G4862 (σύν) and a primary (to follow);

G5359.strong_def: Philadelphia, a place in Asia Minor
G5359.derivation: from (the same as G5361 (φιλάδελφος)), a king of Pergamos;

G2997.derivation: a strengthened form of a primary verb, which only occurs in this and another prolonged form as alternate in certain tenses;

G1846.def:
ἐξ-ορύσσω
[in LXX: Pro.29:22; ὀφθαλμόν (-ούς), Jdg.16:21, 1Ki.11:2 (נָקַר)* ;]
to dig out, dig up: στέγην, Mrk.2:4; metaphorically, ὀφοαλμούς (cf. LXX, ll with; Herod., viii, 116), Gal.4:15.†
(AS)
G1846.strong_def: to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing)

G2974.strong_def: blunted, i.e. (figuratively) of hearing (deaf) or speech (dumb)

G1850.def:
ἐξουσιάζω
(ἐξουσία) [in LXX (frequently in Ec) chiefly for שָׁלַט ;]
1. to exercise authority (Arist.).
2. Trans., to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), Luk.22:25; with genitive of thing(s), 1Co.7:4; pass., to be held under authority (see Lft., Notes, 214): before ὑπό, 1Co.6:12.†
(AS)

G1411.strong_def: force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous power (usually by implication, a miracle itself)

G0703.strong_def: properly, manliness (valor), i.e. excellence (intrinsic or attributed)

G2711.def:
κατα-ψύχω
[in LXX: Gen.18:4 (שָׁעַן ni.)* ;]
to cool: with accusative, Luk.16:24.†
(AS)

G0766.def:
ἀσέλγεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσελγής, licentious; see MM, see word), [in LXX: Wis.14:26, 3Ma.2:26 * ;]
licentiousness, wantonness, excess: Mrk.7:22, Rom.13:13, 2Co.12:21, Gal.5:19 (Lft., in l), Eph.4:19, 1Pe.4:3, 2Pe.2:2 2:7 2:18, Ju 4.†
SYN.: ἀσωτία, profligacy, prodigality (see Tr., Syn., § xvi; DB, iii, 46). (AS)
G0766.derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed (of uncertain derivation, but apparently meaning continent);

G2832.def:
Κλωπᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram.; on the original, see Lft., Gal., 267 f.),
Clopas: Jhn.19:25.†
(AS)

G3387.gloss: any (sometimes unexpressed except by the simple interrogative form of the sentence)

G4851.gloss: be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit(-able for)
G4851.strong_def: to bear together (contribute), i.e. (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage
G4851.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate);

G2233.def:
ἡγέομαι, -οῦμαι depon. mid.,
[in LXX (chiefly Pres. ptcp.) for נָגִיד, רֹאשׁ, שַׂר, etc. ;]
1. to lead;
(a) to guide, go before;
(b) to rule, be leader: present ptcp., ἡγούενος, a ruler, leader (MM, Exp., xiv), Mat.2:6 (LXX), Luk.22:26, Act.7:10 14:12 15:22, Heb.13:7, 17 13:24.
2. to suppose, believe, consider, think (Hdt., Soph., al.; of. Lat. duco): with dupl. accusative, Act.26:2, Php.2:3, 6 3:7, 1Ti.1:12 6:1, Heb.10:29 11:11, 26, 2Pe.1:13 2:13 3:9 3:15; with accusative before ὡς, with accusative, 2Th.3:15; with accusative before adv., 1Th.5:13; ὅταν, Jas.1:2; ἀναγκαῖον, with inf., 2Co.9:5, Php.2:25; δίκαιον, with inf., 2Pe.1:13; with accusative and inf., Php.3:8 (of. δι-, ἐκ-δι-, ἐξ- προ-ηγέομαι).†
SYN.: see: δοκέω (AS)
G2233.strong_def: to lead, i.e. command (with official authority); figuratively, to deem, i.e. consider
G2233.derivation: middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of G71 (ἄγω);

G2080.def:
ἔσω Ion, and old Att.. form of εἴσω
(εἰς),
adv., [in LXX for etc. ;]
1. prop., after verbs of motion (to) within, into: Mat.26:58, Mrk.14:54; with genitive, Mrk.15:16.
2. As frequently in cl. (= cl. ἔνδον), after verbs of rest, within: Jhn.20:26, Act.5:23; οἱ ἔ. (opposite to οἱ ἔξω), 1Co.5:12; ὁ ἔ. ἄνθρωπος, Rom.7:22, 2Co.4:16, Eph.3:16.†
(AS)

G1038.def:
βυρσεύς, -έως, ὁ (βύρσα, a hide), late form for βυρσοδέψης,
a tanner: Act.9:43 10:6, 32.†
(AS)
