G3353.strong_def: participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an associate

G5622.derivation: from a derivative of the base of G5624 (ὠφέλιμος);

G2144.def:
εὐ-πρόσ-δεκτος, -ον
(εὖ, προσδέχομαι)
more usual than δέκτος, which see, acceptable: Rom.15:16, 31, 2Co.6:2 8:12, 1Pe.2:5.†
(AS)
G2144.derivation: from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G4327 (προσδέχομαι);

G3381.gloss: lest (by any means, by some means, haply, perhaps)

G1841.def:
ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ
(ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ, etc. ;]
a going out, departure: Heb.11:22; of death, Luk.9:31, 2Pe.1:15.†
(AS)

G3426.strong_def: a modius, i.e. certain measure for things dry (the quantity or the utensil)

G0731.def:
ἄρρητος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ῥητός, ῥέω), [in Sm.: Lev.18:23 * ;]
1. unspoken (Hom., al.).
2. unspeakable (Hat., al.; frequently in Inscr.; MM, see word): 2Co.12:4.†
(AS)
G0731.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the same as G4490 (ῥητῶς);

G1425.derivation: from G1418 (δυσ-) and a derivative of G3539 (νοιέω);

G1191.def:
Δέρβη, -ης, ἡ,
Derbe, a city of Lycaonia: Act.14:6, 20 16:1.†
(AS)
G1191.strong_def: Derbe, a place in Asia Minor

G1540.def:
ἑκατόν, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
a hundred: Mat.13:8, 23 Luk.15:4, al.; κατὰ ἑ, Mrk.6:40; εἰς, ἐν ἑ., Mrk.4:8, 20
(AS)

G3749.strong_def: earthen-ware, i.e. clayey; by implication, frail

G0233.def:
ἁλίζω
(ἅλς), [in LXX for מָלַח ;]
to salt, season with salt: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:49.†
(AS)

G4613.strong_def: Simon (i.e. Shimon), the name of nine Israelites

G1102.def:
γναφεύς, -έως, ὁ, Ion. and κοινή form of Att. κναφεύς
(κνάπτω, to card wool), [in LXX for כָּבַס, 4Ki.18:17, Isa.7:3 36:2 * ;]
a fuller, cloth-dresser: Mrk.9:3.†
(AS)
G1102.derivation: by variation for a derivative from (to tease cloth);

G1064.def:
γαστήρͅ, -τρός, ἡ,
[in LXX for בֶּטֶן, ἐν γ. ἔχειν for הרה, ἐν γ. λαμβάνειν for חרה ;]
1. the belly: metaphorically, a glutton, Tit.1:12.
2. the womb: ἐν γ. ἔχειν, to be with child, Mat.1:18, 23" (LXX) 24:19, Mrk.13:17, Luk.21:23, 1Th.5:3, Rev.12:2; εν γ. συλλαμβ., to conceive, Luk.1:31.
† (AS)
G1064.strong_def: the stomach; by analogy, the matrix; figuratively, a gourmand

G4316.strong_def: to address, i.e. salute by name
G4316.derivation: from G4314 (πρός) and a derivative of G58 (ἀγορά) (mean to harangue);

G1667.def:
ἑλίσσω
[in LXX: Isa.34:4 (גָּלַל ni.), Psa.102:26 (חָלַף hi.), etc. ;]
to roll, roll up: Heb.1:12 (LXX), Rev.6:14.†
(AS)

G0682.def:
Ἀπφία, -ας, ἡ
Apphia: Phm 2 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G5448.derivation: from G5449 (φύσις) in the primary sense of blowing;

G1000.def:
βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(βάλλω), [in LXX: Gen.21:16 (טחה), 2Ma.5:3, 3Ma.5:26 * ;]
a throw; λίθου β. (Thuc., v, 65, 2), a stone's throw: Luk.22:41.†
(AS)
G1000.strong_def: a throw (as a measure of distance)

G0325.def:
ἀνα-δίδωμι
[in LXX: Sir.1:22, 2Ma.13:15 * ;]
1. to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.).
2. to give up, yield, hand over (MM, VGT, see word): Act.23:33.†
(AS)

G2313.def:
θεομαχέω, -ῶ
(θεομάχος), [in LXX: 2Ma.7:19 * ;]
to fight against God: Act.23:9 (Rec.).†
(AS)

G2221.def:
ζωγρέω, -ῶ
(ζωός, alive, + ἀγρεύω) [in LXX chiefly for חָיָה hi. ;]
to catch alive, take captive: metaphorically, Luk.5:10; pass., 2Ti.2:26 (on the meaning and construction, see Ellic., CGT, in l).†
(AS)
G2221.strong_def: to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare
G2221.derivation: from the same as G2226 (ζῶον) and G64 (ἀγρεύω);

G5223.strong_def: existency or proprietorship, i.e. (concretely) property, wealth

G1990.def:
ἐπιστήμων, -ον, genitive, -ονoς
(ἐπίσταμαι) [in LXX: Deu.1:13 4:6, Isa.5:21 (בִּין ni.), I Est.8:44, Sir.10:25 21:15, etc. ;]
knowing, skilled: Jas.3:13.†
(AS)

G4554.strong_def: Sardis, a place in Asia Minor

G1412.def:
δυναμόω, -ῶ
(δύναμις), [in LXX for עָזַז, Psa.52:7 68:28; גָּבַר pi., hi., Ecc.10:10, Da TH 9:27 * ;]
to make strong, strengthen: Eph.6:10 (WH, mg.; ἐνδυν-, WH, txt., RV), Col.1:11, Heb.11:34.†
(AS)

G1530.def:
εἰσ-πηδάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Amo.5:19 (בּוֹא), Da TH Sus 1:26* ;]
to spring in, rush in: Act.14:14 (Rec.), Act.16:29 (for exx. from π., see MM, Exp., xii).†
(AS)

G0743.def:
ἀρχ-άγγελος, -ου, ὁ
(ἄρχι-, ἄγγελος),
archangel, a chief angel: 1Th.4:16, Ju 9 (Cremer, 24; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G2442.def:
ἱμείρω [in LXX: Job.3:21 B3R (ABא, ὁμ-) ;] 1Th.2:8 (Rec.), see: ὁμείρομαί.
(AS)
G2442.strong_def: of uncertain affinity); to long for

G5537.gloss: be called, be admonished (warned) of God, reveal, speak
G5537.strong_def: to utter an oracle (compare the original sense of G5530 (χράομαι)), i.e. divinely intimate; by implication, (compare the secular sense of G5532 (χρεία)) to constitute a firm for business, i.e. (generally) bear as a title

G1803.def:
ἕξ, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
six: Mat.17:1, Luk.13:14, al.
(AS)

G2511.def:
καθαρίζω
(Hellenistic-FlJ, Inscr.-for Attic καθαίρω, which see, on the vulgar -ερ-, Mat.8:3, Mrk.1:42, see Bl., § 6, 1; Thackeray, Gr., 74) [in LXX chiefly for טָהֵר ;]
to cleanse, make clean.
1. In physical sense: with accusative of thing(s), figuratively, Mat.23:25-26, Luk.11:39; of disease (leprosy), with accusative of person(s), Mat.8:2-3 10:8 11:5, Mrk.1:40-42 Luk.4:27 5:12-13 7:22 17:14, 17; ἡ λέπρα ἐκαθερίσθη (on the spelling see supr.), Mat.8:3.
2. In ethical sense: τ. καρδίας, Act.15:9 (cf. Sir.38:10); τ. χεῖρας, Jas.4:8; λαὸν ἑαυτῷ, Tit.2:14; τ. ἐκκλησίαν, Eph.5:26; with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), before ἀπό (131., § 36, 9; Deiss., BS, 216 f.), 2Co.7:1, Heb.9:14, 1Jn.1:7 Jn 1:9.
3. In ceremonial sense: Mrk.7:19, Act.10:15 11:9, Heb.9:22-23 10:2 (cf. δια-καθαρίζω).†
(AS)

G1562.def:
ἐκ-δύω
[in LXX chiefly for פָּשַׁט ;]
to take of, strip of, strip: with accusative of person(s) (sc. clothing), Mat.27:28; with accusative of person(s) and of thing(s), Mat.27:31, Mrk.15:20, Luk.10:30; mid., to put off: figuratively, of the body, 2Co.5:4.†
(AS)
G1562.strong_def: to cause to sink out of, i.e. (specially as of clothing) to divest
G1562.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G1416 (δύνω);

G2240.def:
ἥκω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
pf. with present meaning (hence imperfect = plpf.), to have come, be present: Mat.24:50, Mrk.8:3 (late pf., ἧκα, see Swete, in l; WH, App., 169), Luk.12:46 15:27, Jhn.8:42, Heb.10:7, 9 10:37, I Jn 5:20, Rev.2:25 3:3, 9 15:4; before ἀπό, with genitive loc., Mat.8:11, Luk.13:29; ἐκ, Rom.11:26; id. before εἰς, Jhn.4:47; μακρόθεν, Mrk.8:3; ἐπί, with accusative, Rev.3:3. Metaphorical, of discipleship: Jhn.6:37; of time and events: absol., Mat.24:14, Jhn.2:4, 2Pe.3:10, Rev.18:8; before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Mat.23:36, Luk.19:43 (cf. ἀν-, καθ-ήκω).†
(AS)
G2240.strong_def: to arrive, i.e. be present (literally or figuratively)

G0520.def:
ἀπ-άγω
[in LXX for נָהַג, הָלַךְ hi., etc. ;]
to lead away: Luk.13:15, Act.23:17 24:7 (R, mg.), 1Co.12:2; esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), prison and death (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.26:57 27:2, 31, Mrk.14:44, 53 15:16, Luk.21:12 22:66 23:26, Act.12:19; of the direction of a way: Mat.7:13-14 (cf. συν-απ-άγω).†
(AS)

G0428.def:
ἀν-εύ-θετος, -ον
(see MM, VGT, see word)
not well placed, not fit: Act.27:12.†
(AS)
G0428.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2111 (εὔθετος);

G4608.strong_def: an intoxicant, i.e. intensely fermented liquor

G2818.def:
κληρο-νόμος, -ου, ὁ
(κλῆρος, νέμομαι, to possess) [in LXX: Jdg.18:7, 2Ki.14:7, Mic.1:15, Jer.8:10 (יָרַשׁ), Sir.23:22 * ;]
1. (as in cl.) an heir: Mat.21:38, Mrk.12:7, Luk.20:14, Gal.4:1; of those who as sons of God inherit the privileges of the Messianic Kingdom; of Christ himself, Heb.1:2; of Abraham, Rom.4:13-14; of Christians, Rom.8:17, Gal.3:29, Tit.3:7, Jas.2:5.
2. (As in LXX: Jg, Mi, Je, ll. with) a possessor: Heb.6:17 11:7 (Cremer, 359 f.).†
(AS)
G2818.strong_def: a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor
G2818.derivation: from G2819 (κλῆρος) and the base of G3551 (νόμος) (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment);

G2905.def:
κραυγάζω (κραυγή)
[in LXX: Est.3:13 (רוּעַ hi.)* ;] = κράζω
1. of animals, to bay, to croak, etc.
2. Of men, to cry out, shout: Mat.12:19, Jhn.12:13 19:15 Act.22:23; before λέγων, Jhn.18:40 19:6, 12; καὶ λέγων, Luk.4:41 (WH, κράζ -); φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Jhn.11:43 (cf. Abbott, JV, 269 f.).†
(AS)

G4327.strong_def: to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience)

G2174.def:
εὐψυχέω, -ῶ
(εὔψυχος, courageous),
to be of good courage: Php.2:19.†
(AS)
G2174.strong_def: to be in good spirits, i.e. feel encouraged
G2174.derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G5590 (ψυχή);

G3632.strong_def: an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness)
G3632.derivation: from G3631 (οἶνος) and a form of the base of G5397 (φλύαρος);

G4015.strong_def: to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light

G2392.def:
ἴασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for מַרְפֵּא ;]
a healing, cure: Act.4:22, 30; pl., Luk.13:32.†
SYN.: see: θεραπεία, 2; ἴαμα, 2 (AS)

G2490.def:
Ἰωανάν (Rec. Ἰωαννᾶς, -ᾶ), ὁ indecl. (Heb. יוֹחָנָן),
Joanan (cf. Ἰωάνης): Luk.3:37.†
(AS)

G4351.strong_def: to roll towards, i.e. block against

G2552.def:
κακοπάθεια (WH, -θία), -ας, ἡ
(κακοπαθής, suffering), [in LXX: Mal.1:13 (תְּלָאָה), תְּלָאָה), 2Ma.2:26-27, 4Ma.9:8 * ;]
distress, affliction: Jas.5:10.†
(AS)
G2552.derivation: from a compound of G2256 (ἡμιώριον) and G3806 (πάθος);

G4623.strong_def: properly, muteness, i.e. involuntary stillness, or inability to speak; and thus differing from G4602 (σιγή), which is rather a voluntary refusal or indisposition to speak, although the terms are often used synonymously); to be dumb (but not deaf also, like 2974 properly); figuratively, to be calm (as quiet water)

G5597.strong_def: to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand)
G5597.derivation: prolongation from the same base as G5567 (ψάλλω);

G0997.def:
βοηθέω, -ῶ
(βοή + θέω, to run), [in LXX chiefly for עזר ;]
to come to aid, to help, succour: absol., Act.21:28; with dative, Mat.15:25, Mrk.9:22, 24 Act.16:9, 2Co.6:2" (LXX), Heb.2:18, Rev.12:16.†
(AS)

G5165.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of uncertain affinity;

G0557.def:
ἀπ-ελεγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπελέγχω, to convict, refute),
refutation, disrepute: ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἀ., Act.19:27 (not elsewhere; see MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0557.derivation: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G1651 (ἐλέγχω);

G4793.strong_def: to judge of one thing in connection with another, i.e. combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance)

G2326.def:
θερισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(θερίζω), [in LXX chiefly for קָצִיר ;]
harvest;
(a) the act: Jhn.4:35;
(b) the time: fig., Mat.13:30, 39, Mrk.4:29
(with) the crop: figuratively, Mat.9:37-38, Luk.10:2, Rev.14:15.†
(AS)

G3156.strong_def: Matthæus (i.e. Matthitjah), an Israelite and a Christian

G0887.def:
ἀχλύς, -ύος, ἡ
[in Aq.: Eze.12:7; Sm.: Job.3:5 * ;]
a mist, esp. a dimness of the eyes: Act.13:11 (see Tr., Syn., § with).†
(AS)
G0887.strong_def: dimness of sight, i.e. (probably) a cataract

G1965.def:
ἐπί-ορκος, -ον
[in LXX: Zec.5:3 (שָׁבַע ni.) * ;]
1. of oaths, sworn falsely.
2. Of persons, perjured; as subst., a perjurer, false swearer: 1Ti.1:10.†
(AS)

G5160.strong_def: nourishment (literally or figuratively); by implication, rations (wages)

G4935.derivation: adverb from a derivative of G4932 (συντέμνω);

G4130.strong_def: to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply)); specially, to fulfil (time)
G4130.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary (which appears only as an alternate in certain tenses and in the reduplicated form pimplemi);

G0542.def:
ἀπ-εῖδον (WH, ἀφ-, ν. Bl., § 4, 3), 2 aor. without present in use (cf. εἶδον), serving as aor. to ἀφοράω, q.v
(AS)
G0542.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the same as G1492 (εἴδω);

G0099.def:
Ἁδρίας (T, Rec. Ἀδρίας), -ου, ὁ,
the Adriatic sea, in later Greek usage extended to take in all the waters between Greece and Italy: Act.27:27.†
(AS)

G4299.derivation: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G2919 (κρίνω);

G2841.def:
κοινωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ch.20:35, Job.34:8, Ecc.9:4 (חָבַר), Pro.1:11, Wis.6:23, Sir.13:1, al. ;]
to have a share of, go shares in (something) with (some one), take part in: with genitive of thing(s) (as usually in cl., so Pr, l.with), Heb.2:14; with dative of thing(s), Rom.12:13 15:27, 1Ti.5:22, 1Pe.4:13, 2Jn.11; with dative of person(s), before εἰς, Php.4:15; ἐν, Gal.6:6 (cf. συν-κοινωνέω).†
(AS)
G2841.strong_def: to share with others (objectively or subjectively)

G1042.def:
Γαββαθα (Rec. -θᾶ), ἡ, indecl.,
Gabbatha, the Greek transliteration of an uncertain Aramaic word (DB, see word; Dalman, Words, 7), used as the equivalent of λιθόστρωτον, stone pavement: Jhn.19:13.†
(AS)
G1042.strong_def: the knoll; gabbatha, a vernacular term for the Roman tribunal in Jerusalem

G3725.strong_def: a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region)
G3725.derivation: neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary (a bound or limit);

G1069.def:
γείτων, -ονος, ὁ, ἡ
(γῆ), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכֵן ;]
a neighbour: Luk.14:12 15:6, 9 Jhn.9:8.†
(AS)
G1069.strong_def: a neighbour (as adjoining one's ground); by implication, a friend

G0125.def:
Αἴγυπτος, ου, ἡ,
Egypt: Mat.2:13-15,19, Act.2:10 7:9-39, Heb.3:16 11:26,27; γῆ Αἴ., Act.7:40 13:17, Heb.8:9, Ju 5 (cf. Exo.5:12, al.); ἡ Αἴ., Act.7:11; figuratively, of Jerusalem as hostile to God, Rev.11:8.†
(AS)
G0125.strong_def: Ægyptus, the land of the Nile

G4312.derivation: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G4098 (πίπτω);

G5158.gloss: (even) as, conversation, (+ like) manner, (+ by any) means, way
G5158.strong_def: a turn, i.e. (by implication) mode or style (especially with preposition or relative prefix as adverb, like); figuratively, deportment or character

G1624.def:
ἐκ-τρέπω
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, Amo.5:8 * ;]
to turn out of the course, turn aside, with accusative Pass., with middle sense, intrans., to turn aside: Heb.12:13 (R, txt., for be put out of joint, R, mg., see Thayer, see word Westc., in l); figuratively, before εἰς, 1Ti.1:6; ἐπί, 2Ti.4:4; ὀπίσω, 1Ti.5:15; with accusative, to shun, avoid: 1Ti.6:20.†
(AS)
G1624.strong_def: to deflect, i.e. turn away (literally or figuratively)
G1624.derivation: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);

G0838.def:
αὔξησις, -εως, ἡ
(αὔξω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:16 * ;]
increase, growth: Eph.4:16, Col.2:19.†
(AS)

G3873.strong_def: to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy)

G2373.def:
θυμόω, -ῶ
(θυμός) [in LXX (chiefly in pass.) for חָרָה, אַף חָרָה hith., etc. ;] (no act. in Attic.);
pass. (and mid.),
to be wroth or very angry: Mat.2:16.†
(AS)
G2373.strong_def: to put in a passion, i.e. enrage

G1783.def:
ἐν-τευξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐντυγχάνω, which see), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:3 * ;]
1. a lighting upon, meeting with.
2. conversation.
3. a petition (in this sense common in π.; cf. Deiss., BS, 121 f., 146; MM, Exp., iii): 1Ti.4:5; p1., 1Ti.2:1.†
SYN.: δέησις (which see) (AS)

G1141.def:
δαιμονιώδης, -ες
(δαιμόνιον, εἶδος), [in Sm.: Ps 90(91):6 * ;]
demon-like: Jas.3:15 (Cremer, 171).†
(AS)

G0846.def:
αὐτός, -ή, -ό,
determinative pron., in late Gk. much more frequently than in cl. (WM, 178f.; Jannaris, HGG, §1399).
1. Emphatic (so always in nom. exc. when preceded by the art., see infr., iii);
(1) self (ipse), expressing opposition, distinction, exclusion, etc., αὐ. ἐκχυθήσεται, Luk.5:37; αὐ. ἐγινώσκεν, Jhn.2:25; αὐ.ὑμεῖς, Jhn.3:28; καὶ αὐ. ἐγώ, Rom.15:14; αὐ. Ἰησοῦς, Jhn.2:24; αὐ. καὶ οἱ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ, Mrk.2:25; ὑμεῖς αὐ., Mrk.6:31; esp. (as freq in cl.) αὐ. ὁ, Mat.3:4, Mrk.6:17, Jhn.16:27, 1Th.3:11, al.; in late Gk., sometimes weakened, ἐν αὐτῇ τ. ὥρᾳ, in that hour, Luk.10:21 (M, Pr., 91; MM, see word);
(2) emphatic, he, she, it (M, Pr., 86; Bl., §48, 1, 2, 7), Mat.1:21, 12:50, Luk.6:35, al.; pointing to some one as master (cl.), Mat.8:24, Mrk.4:38, al.; αὐ., καὶ αὐ. = οὗτος, ὁ δε (BL, §48, 1), Mat.14:2, Mrk.14:15, 44, Luk.1:22, 2:28, al.
2. In oblique cases (cl.), for the simple pron. of 3rd of person(s), he, she, it, Mat.7:9, 10:12, 26:44, al.; with ptcp. in genitive absol., Mat.9:18, Mrk.13:1, al. (for irreg. constructions, V. Bl., §74, 5); pleonastically after the relative (cf. Heb. אֲשֶׁר לוֹ; WM, 184ff.; Bl., §50, 4; MM, see word), Mrk.7:25, Rev.3:8, 7:2, al.; in constr. ad sensum, without proper subject expressly indicated, Mat.4:23, Act.8:5, 2Co.2:13, al.; genitive αὐτοῦ = ἐκείνου, Rom.11:11, 1Th.2:19, Tit.3:5, Heb.2:4.
3. ὁ, ἡ, τὸ αὐ., the same: Heb.1:12, 13:8; τὸ αὐ., ποιεῖν, Mat.5:46, 47, al.; φρονεῖν, Rom.12:16, 15:5, Php.2:2, al.; τὰ αὐ., Act.15:27, Rom.2:1, al.; κατὰ τὸ (τὰ) αὐ. (MM, see word), Act.14:1, Luk.6:23, al.; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐ., together (MM, see word), Mat.22:34, Act.1:15, al.; ἓν κ. τὸ αὐ., 1Co.11:5, 12:11; with dative (cl.), 1Co.11:5; with a noun, λόγος, Mrk.14:39; μέτρος, Php.1:30; πνεῦμα, 1Co.12:4.
(AS)
G0846.strong_def: the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the comparative G1438 (ἑαυτοῦ)) of the third person , and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons
G0846.derivation: from the particle (perhaps akin to the base of G109 (ἀήρ) through the idea of a baffling wind) (backward);

G1291.def:
δια-στελλω
[in LXX for בָּדַל hi. (Deu.10:8, al.), זְהַר hi. (Eze.3:18-19, al.), and 19 other words]
1. to divide, distinguish, define.
2. to command, charge expressly: pass., τὸ διαστελλόμενον, Heb.12:20. Mid., in late Gk. with same sense (so Ez, l.with; and al. in LXX; MM, see word); a. dative of person(s), Mrk.8:15, Act.15:24; before ἵνα, Mat.16:20, Mrk.5:43 7:36 9:9.†
(AS)
G1291.strong_def: to set (oneself) apart (figuratively, distinguish), i.e. (by implication) to enjoin
G1291.derivation: middle voice from G1223 (διά) and G4724 (στέλλω);

G0798.def:
ἄστρον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for כּוֹכָב ;]
(a) mostly in pl. (as in cl.), the stars: Luk.21:25, Act.27:20, Heb.11:12;
(b) in sing. (Xen., al.), only of some noted star; the symbol or image of a star, Act.7:43 (cf. ἀστήρ, and see MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0798.strong_def: properly, a constellation; put for a single star (natural or artificial)

G5422.strong_def: to be a mind-misleader, i.e. delude

G5469.strong_def: a curb or head-stall (as curbing the spirit)

G0317.def:
ἀναγκαστῶς
adv.,
necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, 1Pe.5:2 (rare).†
(AS)
G0317.derivation: adverb from a derivative of G315 (ἀναγκάζω);

G0295.def:
Ἀμφίπολις, -εως, ἡ
Amphipolis, in Macedonia, so called because the river Strymon flowed around it: Act.17:1.†
(AS)
G0295.strong_def: a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia
G0295.derivation: from the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and G4172 (πόλις);

G3081.strong_def: impersonally, it answers the purpose, i.e. is advantageous
G3081.derivation: third person singular present indicative active of a derivative of a compound of G3080 (λύσις) and G5056 (τέλος);

G2024.def:
ἐπι-χορηγία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιχορηγέω),
a supply: Eph.4:16, Php.1:19.†
(AS)

G3689.gloss: certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily
G3689.derivation: adverb of the oblique cases of G5607 (ὤν);

G4253.strong_def: "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to

G3608.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G3607 (ὀθόνη);

G0421.def:
ἀνεξιχνίαστος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; ἴχνος) [in LXX: Job.5:9 9:10 34:24 (חֵקֶר אַיִן)* ;]
that cannot be traced out: Rom.11:33, Eph.3:8 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0421.strong_def: not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable
G0421.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G2487 (ἴχνος);

G1288.def:
δια-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָתַק, as Jdg.16:9 ;]
to break or tear asunder: pass., ἁλύσεις, Mrk.5:4; Παῦλος, Act.23:10.†
(AS)
G1288.strong_def: to draw apart, i.e. sever or dismember

G4352.strong_def: to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore)
G4352.derivation: from G4314 (πρός) and a probable derivative of G2965 (κύων) (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand);

G2086.def:
ἑτερο-ζυγέω, -ῶ
[in LXX cf. ἑτερόζυγος, Lev.19:19 (יְקַמְעָם)* ;]
to be unequally yoked: metaphorically, with dative of person(s), 2Co.6:14.†
(AS)
G2086.strong_def: to yoke up differently, i.e. (figuratively) to associate discordantly
G2086.derivation: from a compound of G2087 (ἕτερος) and G2218 (ζυγός);

G3564.derivation: probably contracted for a compound of G3565 (νύμφη) and G1435 (δῶρον);

G4080.strong_def: how much (as an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity
G4080.derivation: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of G4225 (πού);

G1882.def:
ἐπ-αν-όρθωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπανορθόω, to correct, restore; of. 2Ma.2:22) [in LXX: I Est.8:52, 1Ma.14:34 * ;]
correction: of life, 2Ti.3:16 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)
G1882.strong_def: a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation)
G1882.derivation: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G461 (ἀνορθόω);

G1112.def:
γογγυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX: Isa.58:9 (אָוֶן), Exo.16:7-9, Num.17:5, 10 (תְּלוּנָה), Wis.1:10, 11 Sir.46:7 * ;]
a murmuring, muttering: Jhn.7:12, Act.6:1; ἄνευ γ., 1Pe.4:9; pl., χωρὶς γ., Php.2:14.†
(AS)

G1290.def:
δια-σπορά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(διασπείρω), [in LXX of Israelites dispersed and exiled in foreign lands, as Deu.28:25 (זַעֲוָה) Deu.30:4 (נָדַח ni.), Isa.49:6 (נער); by meton., of the exiles themselves (as Psa.147:2, 2Ma.1:27) ;]
a dispersion: δ. τῶν Ἑλλήνων, Jhn.7:35; metaphorically, of Christians (DB, iii, 782 f.), Jas.1:1, 1Pe.1:1 (see Hort, in ll).†
(AS)
G1290.strong_def: dispersion, i.e. (specially and concretely) the (converted) Israelite resident in Gentile countries

G2279.def:
ἦχος, -ου, ὁ
(also in late and MGr., -εος, τό, Luk.21:25), [in LXX for הָמוֹן, etc. ;]
1. a noise, sound: Act.2:2; ἦ. θαλάσσης, Luk.21:25; σάλπιγγος, Heb.12:19
2. a report: before πεφί, Luk.4:37.†
(AS)
G2279.strong_def: a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e. roar; figuratively, a rumor

G1348.def:
δικαστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(δικάζω), [in LXX for שָׁפַט ;]
a judge: Act.7:27, 35" (LXX) .†
SYN.: κριτής, WH. "gives prominence to the mental process" (Thayer). δ. is the forensic term. In Attic law, the δικασταί were jurors, with a κριτής as presiding officer (LS, see word; Enc. Brit. 11, xii, 504 f.) (AS)

G2510.def:
καθ-άπτω
[in Sm.: Sng.1:6 * ;]
1. to fasten on, put upon, with accusative
2. Act. for mid. (cf. Bl., § 53, 3), to lay hold of, attack: with genitive, χειρός, Act.28:3.†
(AS)

G5520.strong_def: to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric")

G2342.def:
θηρίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of θήρ), [in LXX chiefly for חַי ;]
a wild beast, beast: Mrk.1:13, Act.11:6 28:4-5, Tit.1:12, Heb.12:20, Jas.3:7, Rev.6:8; of Antichrist, Rev.11:7, 13-19.†
(AS)
G2342.derivation: diminutive from the same as G2339 (θήρα);

G3941.strong_def: having a home near, i.e. (as noun) a by-dweller (alien resident)

G3729.strong_def: to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge

G2004.def:
ἐπι-τάσσω
[in LXX for אָמַר, צָוָה, etc. ;]
to command, charge: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.14:22; with dative of person(s), Mrk.1:27 9:25, Luk.4:36 8:25; id. with accusative of thing(s), Phm 8; id. with inf., Mrk.6:39, Luk.8:31, Act.23:2; id. with imperat., Mrk.9:25; with accusative and inf., Mrk.6:27.†
SYN.: κελεύω (AS)

G4932.strong_def: to contract by cutting, i.e. (figuratively) do concisely (speedily)
G4932.derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G5114 (τομώτερος);

G3708.strong_def: by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear
G3708.derivation: properly, to stare at (compare G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally);

G0486.def: to rail at or abuse in turn , (New Testament); Mid., with accusative rei, (Lucian) (ML)

G1634.def:
ἐκ-ψύχω
[in LXX: Jdg.4:21 A (עוּף), Eze.21:7 (כָּהָה pi.)* ;]
to expire, breathe one's last: Act.5:5, 10 12:23 (cf. ἐκπνέω; Cremer, 906).†
(AS)

G0204.def:
ἀκρο-γωνιαῖος, -αία, -αῖον
(ἄκροι, γωνία, an angle) [in LXX: Isa.28:16 (פִּנָּה) * ;] = Attic γωνιαῖος (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word ἀ.),
at the extreme angle: ὁ ἀ., the corner foundation stone, Eph.2:20, 1Pe.2:6.†
(AS)

G0941.def:
βαστάζω,
[in LXX: Jdg.16:30 (נטה), Rut.2:16, 2Ki.23:5, 4Ki.18:14 and Job.21:3 (נשׂא), Sir.6:25, Da TH Bel 36 * ;]
1. to take up with the hands, to lift: λίθους, Jhn.10:31.
2. to bear, to carry, as a burden, and metaphorically, to endure; Mat.3:11 20:12, Mrk.14:13, Luk.7:14 10:7 11:27 14:27 22:10, Jhn.16:12 19:17, Act.3:2 9:15 15:1 21:35, Rom.11:18 15:1, Gal.5:10 6:2, 5 17, Rev.2:2, 3 17:7.
3. In late writers (MM, Exp., ii, iii, x),
(a) to take away; Mat.8:17 (Isa.53:4, Heb.);
(b) to carry off, steal: Jhn.12:6 20:15.
† (AS)
G0941.strong_def: to lift, literally or figuratively (endure, declare, sustain, receive, etc.)
G0941.derivation: perhaps remotely derived from the base of G939 (βάσις) (through the idea of removal);

G2975.gloss: his lot be, cast lots, obtain
G2975.strong_def: to lot, i.e. determine (by implication, receive) especially by lot
G2975.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses;

G2709.def:
κατα-χθόνιος, -ον
(χθών, the earth),
subterranean, under the earth (in cl., of the infernal gods): of the departed in Hades, opposite to ἐπουράνιος, ἐπίγειος, Php.2:10.†
(AS)
G2709.strong_def: subterranean, i.e. infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits)

G1306.def:
δι-αυγάζω
[in Aq.: Job.25:5 * ;]
to shine through, to dawn: 2Pe.1:19 (cf. ἕως οὗ διαπνεύσῃ ἡ ἡμέρα, Gal.2:17).†
(AS)
G1306.strong_def: to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day)

G3559.strong_def: calling attention to, i.e. (by implication) mild rebuke or warning
G3559.derivation: from G3563 (νοῦς) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G0727.def:
ἅρπαξ, -αγος, ὁ, ἡ
(ἁρπάζω), [in LXX: Gen.49:27 (טָרַף) * ;]
rapacious: Mat.7:15, Luk.18:11; as subst., a swindler, an extortioner (MM, see word), 1Co.5:10-11 6:10.†
(AS)

G2610.def:
κατ-αγωνίζομαι depon., "perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116);
1. to struggle against.
2. to conquer, overcome: Heb.11:33.†
(AS)
G2610.strong_def: to struggle against, i.e. (by implication) to overcome

G3159.derivation: apparently a shortened form of G3161 (Ματταθίας);

G5396.strong_def: to be a babbler or trifler, i.e. (by implication) to berate idly or mischievously

G1662.def:
Ἐλιακείμ(Heb. אֶלְיָקִים),
Eliakim, an ancestor of Jesus: Mat.1:13, Luk.3:30.†
(AS)

G0834.def:
αὐλητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(αὐλέω),
a flute-player: Mat.9:23, Rev.18:22 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0976.def:
βίβλος, -ου, ἡ (variant form of βύβλος, the Egyptian papyrus, paper made from its fibrous coat),
[in LXX for סֶפֶר, the form βύβ- being sometimes used ;]
a book, a roll, used much less frequently than βιβλίον, and with a "connotation of sacredness and veneration" (MM, Exp., x), Mat.1:1 Mrk.12:26, Luk.3:4 20:42 Act.1:20 7:42 19:19; β. τ. ζωῆς, Php.4:3, Rev.3:5 20:15.†
(AS)
G0976.derivation: properly, the inner bark of the papyrus plant, i.e. (by implication) a sheet or scroll of writing

G5315.derivation: a primary verb (used as an alternate of G2068 (ἐσθίω) in certain tenses);

G0411.def:
ἀν-εκδιήγητος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐκδιηγέομαι)
inexpressible: 2Co.9:15 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0411.strong_def: not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable
G0411.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1555 (ἐκδιηγέομαι);

G2268.def:
Ἠσαίας (Rec. Ἠσαΐας), -ου, ο (Heb. יְשַׁעְיָה),
Isaiah, the prophet: Mat.3:3 4:14 8:17 12:17 13:14, 35 15:7, Mrk.7:6, Luk.3:4 4:17, Jhn.1:23 12:38-39, 41, Act.8:28 28:25, Rom.9:27, 29 10:16, 20 15:12; ἀνεγίνωςκεν τ. προφήτην Ἠ., Act.8:30; ἐν τ. Ἠ., Mrk.1:2.†
(AS)

G1131.def:
γυμνός, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX chiefly for עָרוֹם ;]
naked, without clothing, and sometimes (as frequently in cl.) scantily or poorly clad (Isa.20:2ff., Tob.1:16, 2Ma.11:12): Mat.25:36, 38 43, 44, Mrk.14:52, Jhn.21:7, Act.19:16, Jas.2:15, Rev.3:17 16:15, 17:16; as subst., to γ., the naked body, Mrk.14:51. Metaphorical, of things exposed, Heb.4:13; of the soul without a body (Plat., Crat., with, 20, and cf. Deiss., LAE, 293), 2Co.5:3; of seed, bare, 1Co.15:37 (Cremer, 168).†
(AS)
G1131.strong_def: nude (absolute or relative, literal or figurative)

G2819.strong_def: a die (for drawing chances); by implication, a portion (as if so secured); by extension, an acquisition (especially a patrimony, figuratively)
G2819.derivation: probably from G2806 (κλάω) (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose;

G4371.strong_def: something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare G3795 (ὀψάριον))
G4371.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4314 (πρός) and G5315 (φάγω);

G0332.def:
ἀνα-θεματίζω
(ἀνίθεμα), [in LXX chiefly for חָרַם hi. (Num.21:2, 1Ki.15:3, al.), 1Ma.5:5 ;]
to devote to destruction, declare or invoke ana­thema: absol., Mrk.14:71; ἐαντόν, to bind oneself under a curse: Act.23:12, 14 23:21 (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., see Deiss., LAE, 92 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0332.strong_def: to declare or vow under penalty of execration

G2294.def:
1. courage, boldness , (Homer), attic; θ. τινός courage to do a thing, (Aeschulus Tragicus)
2. that which gives courage , θάρση grounds of confidence , (Euripides)
3. in bad sense, audacity , (Iliad by Homer): compare θράσος. (ML)

G0108.def:
Ἄζωτος, -ου, ἡ (Heb., אַשְׁדּוֹד),
Azotus, a Philistine city: Act.8:40.†
(AS)
G0108.strong_def: Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine

G0945.strong_def: to stutter, i.e. (by implication) to prate tediously

G3602.derivation: from a derivative of the base of G1416 (δύνω);

G1263.def:
δια-μαρτύρομαι, depon., of Ionic origin, intensive of the simple μαρτύρομαι, which see,
[in LXX chiefly for עוּד hi., usually with dative of person(s), Deu.4:26 8:19, 1Ki.8:9, al. ;]
solemnly to protest: Luk.16:28, Act.2:40 8:25 10:42 18:5 20:21, 23, 24 23:11 28:23, 1Th.4:6, Heb.2:6; in adjuration, before ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, 1Ti.5:21, 2Ti.2:14 4:1 (Cremer, 415).†
(AS)
G1263.strong_def: to attest or protest earnestly, or (by implication) hortatively

G0930.def:
βασανιστής, -οῦ, ὁ (βασανίζω),
prop., a torturer; used of a gaoler, Mat.18:34.†
(AS)

G0992.def:
βλητέος, -α, -ον (gerundive of βάλλω),
(that which) one must put: Luk.5:38.†
(AS)

G5586.strong_def: a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e. (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote

G1107.def:
γνωρίζω
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for ידע hi. ;]
1. as most commonly in cl., to come to know, discover, know: Php.1:22 (but cf. R, mg.).
2. to make known: with accusative, Rom.9:22, 23; with accusative of thing(s) da.t. of person(s), Luk.2:15, Jhn.15:15 17:26, Act.2:28" (LXX), 1Co.15:1, 2Co.8:1, Gal.1:11, Eph.1:9 6:19, 21 Col.4:7, 9 2Pe.1:16; with dative, before ὅτι, 1Co.12:3; before τί, Col.1:27; περί, Luk.2:17. Pass., Act.7:13, Rom.16:26, Eph.3:3, 6 10, Php.4:6 (Cremer, 677; cf. ἀνα-, δια-γνωρίζω).
† (AS)
G1107.strong_def: to make known; subjectively, to know

G2145.def:
εὐ-πρόσ-εδρος, -ον
Rec. for εὐπάρεδρος, which see: 1Co.7:35.†
(AS)
G2145.strong_def: sitting well towards, i.e. (figuratively) assiduous (neuter, diligent service)
G2145.derivation: from G2095 (εὖ) and the same as G4332 (προσεδρεύω);

G4634.strong_def: the Festival of Tabernacles (so called from the custom of erecting booths for temporary homes)

G2398.strong_def: pertaining to self, i.e. one's own; by implication, private or separate

G4992.derivation: neuter of the same as G4991 (σωτηρία) as (properly, concretely) noun;

G4541.strong_def: a Samarite, i.e. inhabitant of Samaria

G4036.strong_def: grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad

G4940.strong_def: to chance together, i.e. meet with (reach)

G4028.strong_def: to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a surface)

G3968.strong_def: a father-land, i.e. native town; (figuratively) heavenly home

G0089.def:
ἀδιαλείπτως (see supr.), adv.,
[in LXX: 1Ma.12:11, II Mac .4, 3Ma.6:33 * ;]
unremittingly, incessantly: Rom.1:9, 1Th.1:3 2:13 5:17.†
(AS)
G0089.strong_def: uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion)

G1936.def:
ἐπί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιτίθημι), [in LXX: 2Ch.25:27 (קֶשֶׁר), Ez 23:11 (עֲגָבָה) 2Ma.4:41 2Mac 5:5 2Mac 14:15 * ;]
1. a laying on: χειρῶν, Act.8:18, 1Ti.4:14, 2Ti.1:6, Heb.6:2 (cf. Westc., He., l.with; CGT on 1Ti, l.with).
2. an attack, assault (2Mac, ll.with).†
(AS)

G0360.def:
ἀνα-λύω
[in LXX: I Est.3:3, Tob.2:9, Jdth.13:1, Sir.3:15, Wis.3:1-19 2:1-24,3 Mac.10 * ;]
1. to unloose.
2. to unloose for departure, depart (MM, VGT, see word): from life, Php.1:23
3. to return, Luk.12:36.†
(AS)
G0360.strong_def: to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively)

G1490.def:
μήγε, see: γε.
γε, enclitic postpositive particle, rarer in κοινή than in cl., giving special prominence to the word to which it is attached, distinguishing it as the least or the most important (Thayer, see word),
indeed, at least, even (but not always translatable into English);
1. used alone: Luk.11:8 18:5 Rom.8:32.
2. More frequently with other particles: αλλά γε, Luk.24:21, 1Co.9:2; ἄρα γε, Mat.7:20 17:26, Act.17:27; ἆρά γε, Act.8:30; εἴ γε (Rec. εἴγε), 2Co.5:3, Gal.3:4, Eph.3:2 4:21, Col.1:23 (see Meyer, Ellic., on Ga, Eph, ll. with; Lft., on Ga, Col, ll. with); εἰ δὲ μήγε, following an affirmation, Mat.6:1, Luk.10:6 13:9; a negation, Mat.9:17, Luk.5:36, 37 14:32, 2Co.11:16; καί γε (Rec. καίγε, cl. καὶ . . . γε), Luk.19:42 (WH om.), Act.2:18 17:27; καίτοιγε (L καίτοι γε, Tr. καί τοι γε), Jhn.4:2; μενοῦνγε (see see word); μήτι γε, see: μήτι; ὄφελόν, 1Co.4:8.
† (AS)
G1490.derivation: from G1487 (εἰ), G1161 (δέ), and G3361 (μή) (sometimes with G1065 (γέ) added);

G4982.gloss: heal, preserve, save (self), do well, be (make) whole
G4982.strong_def: to save, i.e. deliver or protect (literally or figuratively)

G2626.def:
κατα-κλύζω
[in LXX for שָׁטַף, Psa.78:20, al. ;]
to inundate, deluge: pass., 2Pe.3:6.†
(AS)
G2626.strong_def: to dash (wash) down, i.e. (by implication) to deluge
G2626.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and the base of G2830 (κλύδων);

G4172.strong_def: a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size)
G4172.derivation: probably from the same as G4171 (πόλεμος), or perhaps from G4183 (πολύς);

G0892.def:
ἄχυρον, -ον, τό
[in LXX chiefly for תֶּבֶן ;]
chaff: Mat.3:12, Luk.3:17.†
(AS)

G2662.def:
κατα-πατέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for דָּרַךְ, רָמַס, שָׁאַף, etc. ;]
to tread down, trample under foot: Mat.7:6, Luk.12:1; pass., Mat.5:13, Luk.8:5. Metaphorical, τ. υἱὸν τ. θεοῦ, Heb.10:29.†
(AS)
G2662.strong_def: to trample down; figuratively, to reject with disdain

G3693.strong_def: from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)) with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e. at the back (adverb and preposition of place or time)

G0674.def:
ἀπο-ψύχω
[in LXX: 4Ma.15:18 * ;]
1. to breathe out life, expire (Thue.; LXX, l.with).
2. to leave off breathing, faint (Hom., Od., xxiv, 348): before ἀπό, Luk.21:26.†
(AS)

G2940.def:
κυβία (Mt. -εία, and so Rec.), -ας, ἡ
(κύβος, a cube, a die),
dice-playing; metaphorically, trickery, sleight: Eph.4:14.†
(AS)

G1652.def:
ἐλεεινός, -ή, -όν
(ἔλεος in Re, l.with, WH have the Attic poëtic form, ἐλεινός),
pitiable, miserable: Rev.3:17; comparat., 1Co.15:19.†
(AS)

G0463.def:
ἀνοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνέχω, -ομαι), [in LXX: 1Ma.12:25 (RV, respite)* ;]
1. in cl., a holding back, delaying (MM, VGT, see word).
2. forbearance, delay of punishment: Rom.2:4 3:26.†
SYN.: μακροθυμία, ὑπομονή. ἀ., forbearance, is the result and expression of μ., which involves the idea of tolerance, long-suffering, as God with sinners. ὑ. expresses patience with respect to things, as μ. with persons; it is active as well as passive, denotes not merely endurance but perseverance (see Tr., Syn., § liii; Lft., Notes, 259, 273; DB, ii, 47). (AS)

G2370.def:
θυμιάω, -ῶ
(θύω), [in LXX (with -άζω) chiefly for קָטַר pi., hi. ;]
to burn incense: Luk.1:9.†
(AS)
G2370.strong_def: to fumigate, i.e. offer aromatic fumes
G2370.derivation: from a derivative of G2380 (θύω) (in the sense of smoking);

G4721.derivation: strengthened from a primary (a "thatch" or "deck" of a building);

G1960.def:
ἐπιμελῶς
adv., [in LXX for רַק, etc. ;]
carefully: Luk.15:8.†
(AS)
G1960.derivation: adverb from a derivative of G1959 (ἐπιμελέομαι);

G0567.def: refrain, receive/be far, keep away from
G0567.strong_def: to hold oneself off, i.e. refrain

G4961.strong_def: a co-campaigner, i.e. (figuratively) an associate in Christian toil

G2002.def:
ἐπι-σωρεύω
[in Sm.: Job.14:17, Sng.2:4 * ;]
to heap together; metaphorically, διδασκάλους, 2Ti.4:3.†
(AS)
G2002.strong_def: to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally

G3199.strong_def: to be of interest to, i.e. to concern (only third person singular present indicative used impersonally, it matters)

G0620.def:
ἀπο-λείπω
[in LXX for H2308 יָתַר, etc. ;]
1. to leave, leave behind (in π. a term. techn. in wills; see MM, see word): 2Ti.4:13 4:20, Tit.1:5; pass., to be reserved, remain: Heb.4:6, 9 10:26.
2. to desert, abandon: Ju 6.†
(AS)
G0620.strong_def: to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake

G1817.def:
ἐξ-ανίσημι
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1. trans., to raise up: σπέρμα (cf. Gen.38:8), Mrk.12:19, Luk.20:28.
2. In 2 aor. act., intrans., to rise: Act.15:5.†
(AS)
G1817.strong_def: objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object

G5603.strong_def: a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while G5215 (ὕμνος) denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and G5568 (ψαλμός) still more specially, a Hebrew cantillation)

G2954.strong_def: Cyprus, an island in the Mediterranean

G2828.def:
κλισία, -ας, ή
(κλίνω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:31 A* ;]
1. a place for reclining; hence,
(a) a hut;
(b) an easy chair;
(with) a couch.
2. a company reclining: pl., Luk.9:14 (cf. FlJ, Ant., xii, 2, 12)
(AS)
G2828.strong_def: properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal

G4049.strong_def: to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to distract (with care)

G4231.strong_def: to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade

G3325.strong_def: to replenish, i.e. (by implication) to intoxicate

G0472.def:
ἀντ-ὲχω
(ἀντί, ἔχω), [in LXX for חָזַק hi., etc. ;]
1. trans., to hold against.
2. Intrans., to withstand. Mid. 1. in cl., to hold out against.
3. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), to hold firmly to, cleave to: with genitive (see Bl., § 36, 2), Mat.6:24, Luk.16:13, 1Th.5:14 (see M, Th., in l), Tit.1:9.†
(AS)
G0472.strong_def: to hold oneself opposite to, i.e. (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for
G0472.derivation: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G2192 (ἔχω);

G1525.def:
εἰσ-έρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
to go in or into, enter: Mat.9:25, Luk.7:45, al.; before εἰς, Mat.10:12, Mrk.2:1, al.; before διά (πύλης, θύρας, etc.), Mat.7:13, Jhn.10:1, al.; ὑπὸ τ. στέγην, Mat.8:8; with adv.: ὅπου, Mrk.14:14, Heb.6:20; ὧδε, Mat.22:12; ἔσω, Mat.26:58; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mrk.15:43, Luk.1:28, Act.10:3 11:3 16:40 17:2 28:8, Rev.3:20; of demons taking possession, Mrk.9:25, Luk.8:30 22:3, Jhn.13:27; of food, Mat.15:11, Act.11:8. Metaphorical, of thoughts, Luk.9:46; εἰς κόπον, Jhn.4:38; εἰς πειρασμόν, Mat.26:41, Luk.22:40, 46; of hope as an anchor, Heb.6:19; βοαί, Jas.5:4; πνεῦμα ζωῆς, Rev.11:11; εἰς τ. κόσμον (cf. Wis.2:24 14:14, Jhn.18:37), Rom.5:12, Heb.10:5; in counterparts of Jewish Aram. phrases relating to the theocracy (cf. Dalman, Words, 116ff.): εἰς τ. γάμους, Mat.25:10; εἰς τ. χάραν τ. κυρίου, Mat.25:21, 23; εἰς τ. ζωήν, Mat.18:8, 9 19:17, Mrk.9:43, 45; εἰς τ. βασιλ. τ. οὐρανῶν, Mat.5:20 7:21, al. (see: βασιλεία); εἰς τ. κατάπαυσιν, Heb.3:11, 18 4:1ff.; εἰς τ. δόξαν, Luk.24:26; εἰσ. καὶ ἐξερχ., to go in and out (like Heb. בוֹא וְצֵאת, Deu.28:6, etc.), of familiar intercourse, Act.1:21; figuratively, of moral freedom, Jhn.10:9 (cf. ἐπ-, παρ-, συν-εισέρχομαι).
(AS)

G1587.def:
ἐκ-λείπω
[in LXX for כָּלָה, כָּרַת ni., תָּמַם, etc., 47 different words in all ;]
1. trans., to leave out, pass over.
2. Intrans., to leave off, cease, fail: μαμωνᾶς, Luk.16:9; πίστις, Luk.22:32; ἔτη, Heb.1:12 (LXX); of the sun in an eclipse, Luk.23:45.†
(AS)

G4511.derivation: from G4506 (ῥύομαι) in the sense of its congener G4482 (ῥέω);

G3056.gloss: account, cause, communication, X concerning, doctrine, fame, X have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say(-ing), shew, X speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work
G3056.strong_def: something said (including the thought); by implication, a topic (subject of discourse), also reasoning (the mental faculty) or motive; by extension, a computation; specially, (with the article in John) the Divine Expression (i.e. Christ)

G3605.derivation: a primary verb (in a strengthened form);

G4089.derivation: perhaps from G4078 (πήγνυμι) (through the idea of piercing);

G2821.def:
κλῆσις, -εως, ἡ (καλέω)
[in LXX: Jer.31:6 (קָרָא), Jdth.12:10 A, 3Ma.5:14 * ;]
a calling, call; in NT, always of the Divine call to salvation: Rom.11:29, 1Co.1:26 7:20, Eph.1:18 4:1, 4, Php.3:14, 2Th.1:11, 2Ti.1:9, Heb.3:1, 2Pe.1:10 (Cremer, 332).†
(AS)
G2821.derivation: from a shorter form of G2564 (καλέω);

G4053.gloss: exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly)
G4053.strong_def: superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with G1537 (ἐκ)) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence
G4053.derivation: from G4012 (περί) (in the sense of beyond);

G4301.strong_def: to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise

G0589.def:
ἀπο-δημέω, -ῶ
(ἀπόδημος), [in LXX: Eze.19:3 A * ;]
to be or go abroad (M, Pr., 130, 2): Mat.21:33 25:14-15, Mrk.12:1, Luk.15:13 20:9.†
(AS)
G0589.strong_def: to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land

G2427.def:
ἱκανόω, -ῶ
(ἱκανός), [in LXX chiefly for רַב ;]
to make sufficient, render fit: with dupl. accusative, 2Co.3:6; with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, Col.1:12.†
(AS)

G1392.def:
δοξάζω
(δόξα), [in LXX chiefly for כָּבַד ni., pi., also for פָּאַר, etc. ;]
1. to think, suppose, hold an opinion (Æsch., Plat., al.).
2. To bestow δόξα (which see) on, to magnify, extol, praise (Thuc., iii, 45; Plut., al.): with accusative, Mat.5:16, Mrk.2:12, Jhn.8:54, Rom.15:6, 1Pe.2:12, al.; id. before ἐπί Luk.2:20; ἐν, Gal.1:24, 1Pe.4:16.
3. In LXX and NT (see: δόξα, 3), to clothe with splendour, glorify (Exo.34:29-30, Psa.37:20, Isa.44:23, Est.3:1, al): Rom.8:30, 2Co.3:10, 2Th.3:1, 1Pe.1:8, al.; of Christ, Jhn.7:39 8:54, al. (on the Johannine use, see Cremer, 211; Westc., Jo., Intr.); of the Father, Jhn.13:31-32, 1Pe.4:11, al. (cf. ἐν-, συν-δοξάζω).
(AS)
G1392.strong_def: to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide application)

G3705.strong_def: something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially supernatural)

G0613.def:
ἀπο-κρύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;]
to hide, conceal, keep secret: with accusative, Luk.10:21; pass., 1Co.2:7, Eph.3:9, Col.1:26 (MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0613.strong_def: to conceal away (i.e. fully); figuratively, to keep secret

G1327.def:
δι-έ-οδος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for תּוֹצָאָה, as Num.34:4ff, and frequently in Jos;]
in π. of the conclusion of a trial (MM, Exp., xi); a way out through, an outlet; pl., δ. τῶν ὁδῶν, RV, the partings of the highways: Mat.22:9.†
(AS)
G1327.strong_def: an outlet through, i.e. probably an open square (from which roads diverge)

G0712.def:
ἄριστον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: 3Ki.3:1 (לֶחֶם), Tob.2:1, 4, al. ;]
1 1, prop., breakfast.
2. In late Gk. = cl. δεῖτνον, dinner: Mat.22:4, Luk.11:38 14:12.†
(AS)
G0712.strong_def: the best meal (or breakfast; perhaps from ("early")), i.e. luncheon
G0712.derivation: apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as G730 (ἄῤῥην);

G2901.def:
κραταιόω, -ῶ
(late form of κρατύνω; κράτος) [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
to strengthen; pass., to wax strong: Luk.2:40, 1Co.16:13; πνεύματι, Luk.1:80; δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, Eph.3:16.†
(AS)
G2901.strong_def: to empower, i.e. (passively) increase in vigor

G3666.strong_def: to assimilate, i.e. compare; passively, to become similar

G4045.strong_def: to fall into something that is all around, i.e. light among or upon, be surrounded with

G2320.def:
θεότης, -ητος, ἡ
deity, Godhead: Col.2:9†
SYN.: θειότης, q.v (AS)

G1797.def:
ἐνυπνιάζω
(ἐνύπνιον), [in LXX, as in NT, -ομαι, depon., chiefly for חָלַם ;]
to dream: ἐνυπνίοις ἐ., Act.2:17 (LXX); present ptcp., Ju 8.†
(AS)

G1676.def:
Ἑλληνιστί
adv.,
in Greek: Jhn.19:20; Ἑ. (sc. λαλεῖν) γινώσκεις, Act.21:37 (cf. Field, Notes, 135).†
(AS)
G1676.strong_def: Hellenistically, i.e. in the Grecian language
G1676.derivation: adverb from the same as G1675 (Ἑλληνιστής);

G0832.def:
αὐλέω, -ῶ
(αὐλός), [in Al.: 3Ki.1:40 * ;]
to play on a flute, to pipe: mid., Mat.11:17, Luk.7:32, 1Co.14:7.†
(AS)

G3859.derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G1304 (διατρίβω);

G3692.strong_def: a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water)

G5007.strong_def: equivalent to G5342 (φέρω)); a balance (as supporting weights), i.e. (by implication) a certain weight (and thence a coin or rather sum of money) or "talent"
G5007.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of the original form of (to bear;

G0298.def:
ἀ-μώμητος, -ου
(μωμάομαι),
blameless: 2Pe.3:14.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος (which see), ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (AS)
G0298.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3469 (μωμάομαι);

G1784.def:
ἔντιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX for חוֹר, etc. ;]
honoured, prized, precious: of persons, Luk.7:2, Php.2:29; compar., Luk.14:8; of things, metaphorically, λίθος, 1Pe.2:4 2:6" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G1407.def:
δρέπανον, -ου, τό
(later form of Attic δρεπάνη, δρέπω, to pluck), [in LXX for מַזְמֵדָה, חֶרְמֵשׁ, etc. ;]
a sickle, pruning-hook; Mrk.4:29, Rev.14:14-19.†
(AS)

G2767.def:
κεράννυμι
[in LXX for מָסַךְ, Isa.5:22, al. ;]
to mix, mingle, chiefly of the diluting of wine: Rev.18:6; by oxymoron, κεκεράσμενος ἄκρατος, Rev.14:10.†
SYN.: μίγνυμι. κ. implies "a mixing of two things, so that they are blended and forma compound, as in wine and water, whereas μ. implies a mixing without such composition, as in two sorts of grain" (LS, see word κρᾶσις) (AS)
G2767.strong_def: to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking)
G2767.derivation: prolonged form of a more primary (which is used in certain tenses);

G0363.def:
ἀνα-μιμνήσκω
[in LXX for זָכַר hi. ;]
to remind, call to one's remembrance: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.4:17; with inf., 2Ti.1:6. Pass., to remember, call to mind: Mrk.11:21 14:72, 2Co.7:15, Heb.10:32.†
(AS)

G4323.strong_def: to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult

G0431.def:
ἀνεψιός, -οῦ, ὁ
(cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: Num.36:11 ( בֵּן דּוֹד), Tob.7:2 9:6 א * ;]
a cousin: Col.4:10 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0431.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a particle of union) and an obsolete (a brood);

G1311.def:
δια-φθείρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi. ;]
1. to destroy utterly: Luk.12:33, Rev.11:18; pass., to be destroyed, disabled: Rev.8:9, 2Co.4:16.
2. In moral sense, to corrupt, deprave: τ. γῆν, Rev.11:18; pass., διεφθαρμένοι τ. νοῦν, 1Ti.6:5.†
(AS)
G1311.strong_def: to rot thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert)

G4229.strong_def: a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material)

G0158.def:
αἴτιον, -ου, τό, see: αἴτιος.
αἴτιος, -α, ὁ
(αἰτία), [in LXX: 1Ki.22:22 (סבב) Dan LXX Bel 41, TH ib. 42, Su 53, 2Ma.4:47 13:4, 4Ma.1:11 * ;]
1. causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: Heb.5:9; τὸ αἰ., the cause, Act.19:40.
2. blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, Luk.23:4,14,22.
† (AS)

G0035.def:
ἀγενεαλόγητος, -ον
(γενεαλογέω),
without genealogy, i.e. without recorded pedigree (cf. Neh.7:64): Heb.7:3 (Cremer, 152; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0035.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1075 (γενεαλογέω);

G3326.gloss: after(-ward), X that he again, against, among, X and, + follow, hence, hereafter, in, of, (up-)on, + our, X and setting, since, (un-)to, + together, when, with (+ -out)
G3326.strong_def: properly, denoting accompaniment; "amid" (local or causal); modified variously according to the case (genitive association, or accusative succession) with which it is joined; occupying an intermediate position between G575 (ἀπό) or G1537 (ἐκ) and G1519 (εἰς) or G4314 (πρός); less intimate than G1722 (ἐν) and less close than G4862 (σύν))

G4930.strong_def: entire completion, i.e. consummation (of a dispensation)

G0448.def:
ἀν-έλεος, -ον (Attic ἀνηλεής, ἀνελεήμων; MM, VGT, see word),
merciless: Jas.2:13.†
(AS)
G0448.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2436 (ἵλεως);

G5611.strong_def: belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e. (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively))

G1485.def:
ἔθος, -εος (-ους), τό
(ἔθω), [in LXX: Wis.14:16, Da TH Bel 15, 1Ma.10:89, 2Ma.11:25 13:4, 4Ma.18:5 א R* ;]
habit, custom; Luk.22:39, Jhn.19:40, Act.16:21 25:16, Heb.10:25; in Luk.1:9 Act.6:14 15:1 21:21 26:3 28:17, almost in the narrower sense of law (Deiss., BS, 251 f.).†
(AS)
G1485.strong_def: a usage (prescribed by habit or law)

G4971.derivation: adverb from the same as G4970 (σφόδρα);

G0545.def:
ἀπειθής, -ές
(πείθομαι), [in LXX for מַרְאָה, מְרִיא, סָרַר ;]
disobedient: absol., Luk.1:17, Tit.1:16 3:3; with dative, Act.26:19, Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.†
(AS)
G0545.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3982 (πείθω);

G2860.def:
κολυμβάω, -ῶ
[in AI.: Isa.25:11 * ;]
to dive, plunge into the sea: Act.27:43 (cf. ἐκ-κολνμβάω).†
(AS)

G4525.strong_def: to wag (as a dog its tail fawningly), i.e. (generally) to shake (figuratively, disturb)

G0809.def:
ἀσχήμων, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σχῆμα) [in LXX: Gen.34:7 (נְבָלָה), Deu.24:1 (עֶרְוָה), Wis.2:20, Da TH Sus 1:63, 2Ma.9:2 * ;]
1. shapeless.
2. uncomely, unseemly: 1Co.12:23.†
(AS)
G0809.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2192 (ἔχω) (in the sense of its congener G4976 (σχῆμα));

G4138.gloss: which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness
G4138.strong_def: repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period)

G1748.def:
ἐνεδρεύω
(ἐνέδρα), [in LXX chiefly for אָרַב ;]
to lie in wait for: with accusative of person(s), Luk.11:54, Act.23:21.†
(AS)

G3554.strong_def: a malady (rarely figuratively, of moral disability)

G4222.derivation: from a derivative of the alternate of G4095 (πίνω);

G0456.def:
ἀν-οικο-δομέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּנָה, גָּדַר ;]
to build. again, rebuild (MM, VGT, see word): Act.15:16.†
(AS)

G2795.def:
κινέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נוּעַ hi., רָמַשׂ, etc. ;]
1. to set in motion, move: Mat.23:4; τ. κεφαλήν (Psa.22:8, al.), Mat.27:39, Mrk.15:29; pass. (cf. Gen.7:21), Act.17:28.
2. to remove: Rev.2:5 6:14.
3. to excite, stir up: Act.24:5; pass., Act.21:30 (cf. μετα-, συν-κινέω).†
(AS)

G2053.def:
ἔριον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for צֶמֶר, Lev.13:47, Isa.1:18, al. ;]
wool: Heb.9:19, Rev.1:14.†
(AS)

G1931.def:
ἐπι-δύω
[in LXX: Deu.24:15, Jos.8:29, Jer.15:9 (בּוֹא)* ;]
to go down, set (of the sun): Eph.4:26.†
(AS)

G3813.strong_def: a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian

G4370.strong_def: to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join
G4370.derivation: from G4314 (πρός) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);

G1160.def:
δαπάνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Est.6:4, 8 (נִפְקָא), Dan LXX Bel 1:21, al. ;]
expense, cost: Luk.14:28.†
(AS)

G5545.strong_def: an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit

G3543.strong_def: properly, to do by law (usage), i.e. to accustom (passively, be usual); by extension, to deem or regard

G0972.def:
βίαιος, -α, -ον
(βία), [in LXX for אָנַשׁ, עַז, צַר, etc. ;]
violent: Act.2:2.†
(AS)

G5606.strong_def: the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne)
G5606.derivation: perhaps from the alternate of G5342 (φέρω);

G4286.strong_def: a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God

G5409.strong_def: to have a burden, i.e. (by analogy) to wear as clothing or a constant accompaniment

G3695.strong_def: to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively))

G0696.def:
ἄργυρος, -ου, ὁ
(ἀργός, shining), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;]
silver (on its relation to ἀργύριον, see MM, see word): Mat.10:9, Act.17:29, Jas.5:5, Rev.18:12.†
(AS)
G0696.strong_def: silver (the metal, in the articles or coin)

G3728.derivation: from a compound of G3727 (ὅρκος) and a derivative of G3660 (ὀμνύω);

G1866.def:
Ἐπαίνετος (Rec. -τός), -ου, ὁ
Epænetus, a Christian of Borne: Rom.16:5.†
(AS)

G3093.strong_def: the tower; Magdala (i.e. Migdala), a place in Palestine

G4556.strong_def: sardian (3037 being implied), i.e. (as noun) the gem so called
G4556.derivation: properly, an adjective from an uncertain base;

G1158.def:
Δανιήλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. דָּנִיֵּאל, God is my Judge),
Daniel, the prophet: Mat.24:15.†
(AS)

G2428.def:
ἱκετήριος, -α, -ον
(ἱκέτης, a suppliant), [in LXX: Job.40:22, 2Ma.9:18 * ;]
of a suppliant; as subst., ἡ ἱ. (Sc. ῥάβδος),
1. in cl., an olive-branch, carried by a suppliant.
2. In late Gk. = ἱκεσία, supplication: pl., δεήσεις κ. ἱ., Heb.5:7
SYN.: see: δέησις (AS)
G2428.derivation: from a derivative of the base of G2425 (ἱκανός) (through the idea of approaching for a favor);

G2109.def:
εὐεργετέω, -ῶ
(εὐεργέτης), [in LXX: Psa.13:6 (גָּמַל), Wis.3:5, al. ;]
to do good, bestow benefit: Act.10:33.†
(AS)

G0744.def:
ἀρχαῖος, -αία, -αῖον
(ἀρχή), [in LXX chiefly for קֶדֶם ;]
original, ancient: Mat.5:21, 33, Luk.9:8, 19, Act.15:7, 21 21:16, 2Co.5:17, 2Pe.2:5, Rev.12:9 20:2.†
SYN.: παλαιός, old, without the reference to beginning and origin contained in ἀ. The distinction is observed in π. (MM, see word). ἀ. is the antithesis to καινός: παλ. to vέος (see Westc., He., 223; Cremer, 116) (AS)

G4891.strong_def: to rouse (from death) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to revivify (spirtually) in resemblance to

G0967.def:
Βηθφαγή (L, -γῆ), ἡ, indecl. (Aram. בֵּית־פַּגֵּי, house of unripe figs; Dalman, Gr., 191),
Bethphage: Mat.21:1, Mrk.11:1, Luk.19:29.†
(AS)
G0967.strong_def: fig-house; Beth-phage, a place in Palestine
G0967.derivation: of Chaldee origin (compare H01004 and H06291);

G1618.def:
ἐκτενής, -ές
(ἐκτείνω), [in LXX: 3Ma.3:10 3Mac 5:29 * ;]
stretched, strained. Metaphorical, earnest, zealous: 1Pe.4:8 .†
(AS)

G5452.strong_def: to set out in the earth, i.e. implant; figuratively, to instil doctrine

G3456.strong_def: to make mouths at, i.e. ridicule
G3456.derivation: from a derivative of the base of G3455 (μυκάομαι) (meaning snout, as that whence lowing proceeds);

G1838.def:
ἐξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἔχω), [in LXX, cf. Sir, prol.9 ;]
habit, use, experience: Heb.5:14.†
(AS)

G0693.def:
ἀργύρεος (see MM, see word), -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν
(ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;]
of silver: Act.19:24 (WH, br.), 2Ti.2:20, Rev.9:20.†
(AS)

G0586.def:
ἀπο-δεκατοω,
[in LXX for עָשַׂר in both senses foll., e.g. (1) Gen.28:22 (2) 1Ki.8:15 ;]
1. with accusative of thing(s), to tithe, pay a tenth of: Mat.23:23, Luk.11:42.
2. C. accusative of person(s), to exact tithes from: Heb.7:5.
3. to decimate (Socr., HE, 573 A; see Kennedy, Sources, 117).†
(AS)

G0699.def:
ἀρεσκία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ
(ἀρέσκω), [in LXX (-εία): Pro.31:30 (חֵן) * ;]
pleasing, desire to please: Col.1:19 In Gk. writers (Arist., Polyb.), most frequently in bad sense, but in π., Inscr., and in Philo, as above (see Deiss., BS, 224; MM, see word; Cremer, 642).†
(AS)

G5576.strong_def: to be an untrue testifier, i.e. offer falsehood in evidence

G2931.def:
κρυΦῇ
(prop. -ῆ, Rec.; later spelling is due to assimilation to dative; cf. εἰκῆ),
adv., [in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;]
secretly, in secret: Eph.5:12.†
(AS)

G1384.def:
δοκίμιος, -α, -ον
(δοκιμή), [in LXX: ἀργύριον δ. (עֲלִיל), Psa.12:6; and as seel. for δόκιμος (B), ἀργυρίου δ. (זָקַק pual.), 1Ch.29:4 (Bab); εἰ δ .ίστιν (יְקָר), Zec.11:13 א with a vid, Q *)* ;]
= δόκιμος,
tested, approved: τὸ δ. ὑμῶν τ. πίστεως, that which is approved in your faith, 1Pe.1:7 (where Hort suggests the seel. δόκιμος, found in some cursives), Jas.1:3 (but see Mayor, in l For full discussion of this word, not hitherto found in a Gk. Lexicon, and for exx. of its use in π., see Deiss. (to whom is due the credit of its discovery), BS, 259 ff.; MM, Exp., xi; cf. also Milligan, NTD, 76).†
δόκιμος, -ον
(δέκομαι = δέχομαι) [in LXX for זָקַק pual., etc. ;]
primarily of metals, tested, accepted, approved: of persons, Rom.14:18 16:10, 1Co.11:19, 2Co.10:18 13:7, 2Ti.2:15, Jas.1:12 (Cremer, 212, 697).†
(AS)
G1384.strong_def: properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved

G2265.def:
Ἡρῳδιανοί (Rec. Ἡρω-), -ῶν, οἱ,
Herodians, partisans of Herod (cf. τὸυς τὰ Ἡρῴδου φρονοῦνιτας, FlJ, Ant., xiv, 15, 10): Mat.22:16, Mrk.3:6 12:13.†
(AS)
G2265.derivation: plural of a derivative of G2264 (Ἡρώδης);

G0694.def:
ἀργύριον, -ου, τό
(ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף (Gen.13:2, al.), exc. La 4:1 (כֶּתֶם) ;]
prop., a piece of silver (Lft., Notes, 191); in NT,
(a) silver: Act.3:6 7:16 19:19 20:33, 1Co.3:12, 1Pe.1:18;
(b) money: Mat.25:18, 27, Mrk.14:11, Luk.9:3 19:15, 23 22:5, Act.8:20;
(with) a silver coin: p1., Mat.26:15 27:3-6, 9 28:12, 15, where the value is that of a shekel or tetradrachm; ἀργυρίου μυριάδες πέντε (prob. drachmas; MM, see word), Act.19:19.†
(AS)
G0694.strong_def: silvery, i.e. (by implication) cash; specially, a silverling (i.e. drachma or shekel)
G0694.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G696 (ἄργυρος);

G2547.def:
κἀκεῖθεν
(by crasis for καὶ ἐκεῖθεν, and so sometimes written, see: ἐκεῖθεν),
of place, and from thence, and thence: Mrk.9:30, Luk.11:53, Act.7:4 14:26 16:12 20:15 21:1 27:4 28:15.†
(AS)

G1539.derivation: as if from G1538 (ἕκαστος) and G5119 (τότε);

G3316.strong_def: a go-between, i.e. (simply) an internunciator, or (by implication) a reconciler (intercessor)

G5095.strong_def: dear to God; Timotheus, a Christian

G0603.def:
ἀπο-καραδοκία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀποκαραδοκέω, used by Aq. in Psa.37:7 for חוּל; ἀπό, κάρα the head, δοκέω, in Ion., to watch),
to watch with outstretched head, watch anxiously (Polyb., π.; see Deiss., LAE, 374.5, 377 f.), Rom.8:19, Php.1:20 (Lft., in l; Cremer, 177).†
(AS)
G0603.derivation: from a comparative of G575 (ἀπό) and a compound of (the head) and G1380 (δοκέω) (in the sense of watching);

G2520.def:
καθ-ήκω
[in LXX: impers., Lev.5:16, Eze.21:27 (32), al. (מִשְׁפָּט); τὰ κ., Exo.5:13, al. (דָבַר), etc. ;]
1. to come down, come to.
2. to be fit, proper: impers., with accusative and inf., Act.22:22 (on the tense, see Bl., § 63, 4); τὰ μὴ καθήκοντα, Rom.1:28.†
(AS)
G2520.strong_def: to reach to, i.e. (neuter of present active participle, figuratively as adjective) becoming

G5034.strong_def: a brief space (of time), i.e. (with G1722 (ἐν) prefixed) in haste

G1941.def:
ἐπι-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
1. to call, name, surname: with accusative (cl.), Mat.10:25; pass., Act.1:23 4:36 10:5, 18 10:22 11:13 12:12, 25, Heb.11:16; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐπί (denoting possession, as Heb. עַל. . שֻׁם קָרָא), Act.15:17 (LXX), Jas.2:7 (see. CB on Amo.9:12).
2. Mid. (so also act.; cl., LXX), to call upon, invoke, appeal to (θεόν, θεούς, Hdt., Xen., al.; cf. Deiss., LAE, 426): Καίσαρα (Σεβαστόν, Act.25:25), Act.25:11-12, 21 26:32 28:19; sc. τ. Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, Act.7:59; μάρτυρα (cl.) τ. θεόν, 2Co.1:23; πατέρα, 1Pe.1:17; τ. κύριον, Rom.10:12, 2Ti.2:22; τ. ὄνομα κυρίου (μου, σου; like Heb. יְהוָֹה שֻׁם קָרָא), Act.2:21 (LXX) Act.9:14, 21 22:16, Rom.10:13-14" (LXX) 1Co.1:2 (Cremer, 335, 742).†
(AS)
G1941.strong_def: to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.)
G1941.derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2564 (καλέω);

G0559.def:
Ἀπελλῆς, -οῦ, accusative -ῆν (MM, see word), ὁ
Apelles: Rom.16:10.†
(AS)

G3616.strong_def: to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family

G4287.strong_def: fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with G2250 (ἡμέρα) implied) a designated day
G4287.derivation: from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G2596.strong_def: (prepositionally) down (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case (genitive, dative or accusative) with which it is joined)

G0952.def:
βέβηλος, -ον
(βαίνω, whence βηλός, a threshold), [in LXX chiefly for חֹל ;]
1. permitted to be trodden, accessible (see DCG, ii, 422b); hence,
2. (opposite to ἱερός) unhallowed, profane: of things, 1Ti.4:7 6:20, 2Ti.2:16; of men, 1Ti.1:9, Heb.12:16 (cf. κοινός; Cremer, 140).
† (AS)
G0952.strong_def: accessible (as by crossing the door-way), i.e. (by implication, of Jewish notions) heathenish, wicked
G0952.derivation: from the base of G939 (βάσις) and (a threshold);

G3303.gloss: even, indeed, so, some, truly, verily
G3303.strong_def: properly, indicative of affirmation or concession (in fact); usually followed by a contrasted clause with G1161 (δέ) (this one, the former, etc.)

G2858.def:
Κολασσαεύς (Rec. Κολοσ-), -έως, ὁ
a Colossian: pl., Col., tit. (and subscr., Rec., Tr.).†
(AS)

G0576.def:
ἀπο-βαίνω
[in LXX for הָיָה, etc. ;]
to step off, disembark: Luk.5:2, Jhn.21:9; metaphorically, of events, to issue, turn out (Field, Notes, 74): Luk.21:13, Php.1:19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0576.strong_def: literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate
G0576.derivation: from G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G939 (βάσις);

G3957.strong_def: the Passover (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it)

G4440.strong_def: a gate-way, door-way of a building or city; by implication, a portal or vestibule

G0320.def:
ἀνά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Neh.8:8 (מִקְרָא), I Est.9:48, Sir prol. 9, 13 * ;]
1. recognition (Hdt.).
2. reading (Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, NTD, 173, 210 f.): Act.13:15, 2Co.3:14, 1Ti.4:13 (Cremer, 158; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G2857.def:
Κολοσσαί
(so in cl.; -ασσαί, Rec., LTr.), -ῶν, αἰ
Colossæ, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: Col.1:2.†
(AS)
G2857.strong_def: Colossæ, a place in Asia Minor

G4291.strong_def: to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise

G0221.strong_def: an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria

G3853.strong_def: to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin
G3853.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);

G2014.def:
ἐπι-φαίνω
[in LXX for עוּר hi., etc. ;]
1. to show forth.
2. (= pass. in cl.) to appear: Act.27:20; with dative of person(s), Luk.1:79; metaphorically, Tit.3:4; with dative, Tit.2:11 (Cremer, 567).†
(AS)
G2014.strong_def: to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known

G2140.def:
εὐ-ποιία (Rec. -ιΐα), -ας, ἡ
1. beneficence, doing good: Heb.13:16.
2. a benefit (FlJ, Ant., ii, ll, 2, al.).†
(AS)
G2140.derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G4160 (ποιέω);

G0312.def:
ἀν-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi ;]
1. to bring back word, report (Æsch., Thuc., al.): Jhn.5:15 (WH, εἶπεν), Act.14:27 15:4, 2Co.7:7
2. Later, = ἀπαγγέλλω (MM, VGT, see word), to announce, declare (LXX; Cremer, 24): Mat.28:11 (WH, ἀπ-), Jhn.4:25 16:13-15, Act.19:18 20:20, 27 Rom.15:21, 1Pe.1:12, 1Jn.1:5.†
(AS)
G0312.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);

G0702.def:
Ἀρέτας (WH, Ἀρ.; Intr., 313), -α, ὁ,
Aretas, an Arabian king: 2Co.11:32 (Deiss., BS, 183 f., thinks the proper spelling Ἀρέθας was changed, as Schürer suggests, "by desire to Hellenise a barbaric name by assimilation to ἀρετή").†
(AS)

G0323.def:
ἀνά-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Sir.43:6 * ;]
a sheaving forth, announcement: Luk.1:80.†
(AS)

G1495.def:
εἰδωλο-λατρία (-εία, Rec.), -ας, ἡ
(εἴδωλον, λατρεία),
idolatry: 1Co.10:14, Gal.5:20, Col.3:5; pl. (Bl, §32, 6), 1Pe.4:3 (Cremer, 390).†
(AS)

G1048.def:
Γάζα -ης, ἡ (Heb. עַזָּה),
Gaza, in OT, one of the five chief cities of the Philistines: Act.8:26.†
(AS)
G1048.strong_def: Gazah (i.e. Azzah), a place in Palestine

G0239.def:
ἁλληλουιά
(Rec. ἀλληλούϊα; Heb. הָלַל יָהּ, praise the Lord), [in LXX in the titles of certain Psa (104 (105), al.), and at the end of Psa.150:1-6; also Tob.13:18, 3Ma.7:13 ;]
hallelujah, alleluia: Rev.19:1, 3-4 19:6.†
(AS)
G0239.strong_def: praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation
G0239.derivation: of Hebrew origin (imperative of H01984 and H03050);

G0805.def:
ἀσφαλίζω
(ἀσφαλής), [in LXX: Neh.3:15 (חָזַק hi.), Isa.41:10 (תָּמַךְ), Wis.4:17 10:12 13:15 * ;]
to make firm, secure: mid., Mat.27:65-66, Act.16:24; pass., Mat.27:64 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G2675.strong_def: to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust
G2675.derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G739 (ἄρτιος);

G1280.def:
δι-απορέω, -ῶ
[in Sm.: Psa.77:5, Dan.2:1 * ;]
to be quite at a loss, be in great perplexity: absol., Act.2:12; before διὰ τό, with inf., Luk.9:7; περί, Act.5:24; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Act.10:17.†
(AS)

G2912.def:
Κρής, ὁ, pl., Κρῆτες
a Cretan: Act.2:11, Tit.1:12.†
(AS)
G2912.strong_def: a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete

G1097.def:
γινώσκω (= γιγν-: see previous word. So also vulgar Attic, in Inscr., see Thumb, MGV, 207),
[in LXX chiefly for ידע ;]
to be taking in knowledge, come to know, recognize, perceive, understand; in past tenses to know, realize; pass., to become known: with accusative, Mat.22:18, Mrk.5:43, Col.4:8, 1Th.3:5, al. Pass., Mat.10:26, Php.4:5, al.; before ὅτι, Mat.21:45, Jhn.4:1, al.; τί, Mat.6:3; ἀπό, Mrk.15:45; ὅ, Rom.7:15; τ. λεγόμενα, Luk.18:34; τ. θέλημα, Luk.12:47; τ. καρδίας, Luk.16:15; with accusative of person(s), of recognition by God, 1Co.8:3, Gal.4:9; by Christ, neg., Mat.7:23; frequently of the knowledge of divine things, of God and Christ; τ. θεόν, Rom.1:21 Gal.4:9; τ. πατέρα, Jhn.8:55; τ. κύριον, Heb.8:1 (LXX); νοῦν κυρίου, Rom.11:34; Χριστόν, Jhn.17:3, 1Jn.3:6; τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος, 1Co.2:14; τ. πνεύμα, 1Jn.4:6; τ. ἀλήθειαν, Jhn.8:32; of Christ's knowledge of the Father (ἐπιγ.), Mat.11:27 (Dalman, Words, 282ff.). In Hellenistic writers [LXX for Heb. ידע, Gal.4:1, al.], of sexual intercourse, to know carnally: Mat.1:25, Luk.1:34 (Cremer, 153).
SYN.: γ., to know by observation and experience is thus prop. disting. from οἶδα, to know by reflection (a mental process, based on intuition or information); cf. also ἐφίστημι, συνίημι. (Cf. ἀνα-, δια-, ἐπι-, κατα-, προ-γινώσκω.) (AS)
G1097.strong_def: to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed)
G1097.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb;

G4054.gloss: more abundantly, a great deal, far more

G3342.strong_def: betwixt (of place or person); (of time) as adjective, intervening, or (by implication) adjoining
G3342.derivation: from G3326 (μετά) and a form of G4862 (σύν);

G5563.strong_def: to place room between, i.e. part; reflexively, to go away

G3460.strong_def: Myra, a place in Asia Minor

G1914.def:
ἐπι-βλέπω
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה, etc. ;]
to look upon. In NT, as in LXX (1Ki.1:11 9:1, Psa.25:16; Tob.3:3, al.), to look on with favour: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Luk.1:48 9:38, Jas.2:3.†
(AS)
G1914.strong_def: to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality)

G4661.strong_def: something stripped (as a hide), i.e. booty

G0566.def:
to receive (in full); to be distant; (middle) to abstain, avoid
trans. to have in full what is due or is sought, Mt. 6:2, 5, 16; Lk. 6:24; Phil. 4:18; to have altogether, Phlm. 15; hence, it is enough, Mk. 14:41; intransitive to be distant, Lk. 7:6; to be estranged, Mt. 15:8; Mk. 7:6, middle to abstain from, Acts 14:20
G0566.derivation: third person singular present indicative active of G568 (ἀπέχω) used impersonally;

G2466.def:
Ἰσσαχάρ (Rec. Ἰσαχ-, Ἰσασχ- (Elz.), T, -άχαρ), ὁ indecl. (FlJ, Ἰσάχαρις, Ἰσάσχ-) (Heb. יִשָּׂשכָר, Gen.30:18),
Issachar: Rev.7:7.†
(AS)
G2466.strong_def: Isachar (i.e. Jissaskar), a son of Jacob (figuratively, his descendant)

G3911.strong_def: to bear along or aside, i.e. carry off (literally or figuratively); by implication, to avert
G3911.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate forms);

G1180.def:
δεκατέσσαρες, -ων, oἱ, αἱ, -α, τά
[in LXX: Gen.31:41, Tob.8:19, al. ;]
= cl. τεσσαρεσκαίδεκα, more frequently in later Gk. than the older form and in MGr. (for thirteen and upwards) universal, fourteen: Mat.1:17, 2Co.12:2, Gal.2:1 (cf. τεσσαρεσκαιδέκατος).†
(AS)

G2135.def:
εὐνοῦχος, -ου, ὁ
(i.e. ὁ τὴν εὐνὴν(bed) ἔχων), [in LXX for סָרִיס (perhaps not of necessity an actual eunuch; DB, see word), Gen.39:1, al., Wis.3:14, Sir.20:4 30:20 ;]
an emasculated man, a eunuch: Mat.19:12; one such holding, as was common, high office, as of chamberlain, at court, Act.8:27, 34-39; metaphorically, of one naturally incapacitated for or volun­tarily abstaining from wedlock, Mat.19:12.†
(AS)
G2135.strong_def: a castrated person (such being employed in Oriental bed-chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by implication, a chamberlain (state-officer)

G4517.strong_def: probably akin to G4506 (ῥύομαι)); to strengthen, i.e. (impersonal passive) have health (as a parting exclamation, good-bye)

G4195.strong_def: a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor

G3191.strong_def: to take care of, i.e. (by implication) revolve in the mind
G3191.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G3199 (μέλω);

G1864.def:
ἐπ-αγωνίζομαι depon.;
1. to contend with (Plut.).
2. to contend for (C.I., 2335, 19): with dative of thing(s), Ju 3.†
(AS)

G1461.def:
ἐγκεντρίζω, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-κεντρίζω (Rec. ἐγρ-, see: ἐν; κεντρίζω, to graft),
[in LXX: Wis.16:11 *;]
to ingraft, graft in. figuratively, with accusative of person(s), Rom.11:17,19,23,24.†
(AS)
G1461.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of G2759 (κέντρον);

G1030.def:
βρυγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(βρύχω), [in LXX: Pro.19:12 (נַהַם), Sir.51:3 * ;]
a biting, a gnashing of teeth: Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30, Luk.13:28.†
(AS)

G5585.strong_def: to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e. (generally) to compute

G4218.gloss: afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n- )ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when
G4218.strong_def: indefinite adverb, at some time, ever
G4218.derivation: from the base of G4225 (πού) and G5037 (τέ);

G1284.def:
δια-ρήσσω (so WH, exc. Ac, l.with), δια-ρρήσσω
(poetic and late form of διαρρήγνυμι), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to break asunder, burst, rend: δεσμά, Luk.8:29; pass., δίκτυα, Luk.5:6; ἱμάτια, χιτῶνας, in grief or anger (as Gen.37:29, al.), Mat.26:65, Act.14:14, Mrk.14:63.†
(AS)

G3134.strong_def: maranatha, i.e. an exclamation of the approaching divine judgment
G3134.derivation: of Chaldee origin (meaning our Lord has come);

G0048.strong_def: to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally)

G4970.strong_def: of uncertain derivation) as adverb; vehemently, i.e. in a high degree, much

G3004.gloss: ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say(-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter

G1526.def:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
I. As substantive verb.
1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.
4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.;
(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult.
2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:7, 2Ti.2:19.
4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): Act.1:8, 9:15, Rom.4:12, 1Co.1:18, 2:14, Rev.21:7, al.
5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mat.10:30, Luk.9:32, Jhn.3:24, Act.21:35, 1Co.15:19, al;
(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Luk.4:31, 14:1, Act.1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rom.12:9, 10, Heb.13:5, al.;
(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Luk.23:9.
6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:8, Heb.8:10, al.
7. C. adv.: Mat.19:20, Mrk.4:26, Luk.18:11, al.
8. Ellipses;
(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mat.8:29, 24:32, Jhn.21:22, 23, Heb.6:4, al.;
(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mat.14:27, Mrk.6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Deu.32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mrk.13:6, Jhn.4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)
