(a) (so in Hom.), τὰ ἱ., sacrifices, sacred rites, sacred things: 1Co.9:13;
(b) later, τὸ ἱ.,., a consecrated or sacred place, a temple: τ. Ἀρτέμιδος, Act.19:27; of the temple at Jerusalem, i.e. the entire precincts or some part thereof (as distinct from ὁ ναός, which see, the Sanctuary proper): 1Co.9:13, and frequently in Gosp. and esp. in Ac, Mat.12:6, Mrk.13:3, Act.4:1, al. (on the use of ἱ. in Imperial Iuser., see Deiss., LAE, 380 f.)
(AS)

G0096.def:
ἀ-δόκιμος, -ον,
[in LXX: Pro.25:4, Isa.1:22 (סִיג) * ;]
1. of things (prop. of metals: LXX, ll. with), not standing the test, rejected: γῆ, Heb.6:8.
2. Of persons, rejected after testing, reprobate: Rom.1:28, 1Co.9:27, 2Co.13:5-7, 2Ti.3:8, Tit.1:16 (Cremer, 212).
† (AS)
G0096.strong_def: unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally)
G0096.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1384 (δόκιμος);

G4763.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G4764 (στρῆνος);

G4232.strong_def: the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp)

G0942.def:
βάτος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ,
[in LXX (always masc, as in Attic): Exo.3:2-4, Deu.33:16 (סְנֶה), Job.31:40 (בָּאְשָׁה)* ;]
a bramble-bush: Luk.6:44, Act.7:30, 35; ἐπὶ τοῦ (τῆς) β., in the place concerning the bush: Mrk.12:26, Luk.20:37.†
(AS)

G2937.def:
κτίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: Psa.104:24 (קִנְיָן), Pro.1:13 A (הוֹן), Tob.8:5, Wis.2:6, Sir.16:17, 3Ma.2:2, al. ;]
1. a founding, settling, foundation (cl.).
2. In LXX and NT,
(a) the act of creating, creation: Mrk.10:6 (Swete, in l), Mrk.13:19, Rom.1:20, 2Pe.3:4;
(b) that which has been created, creation: Rom.1:25 8:39, Heb.4:13; καινὴ κ., 2Co.5:17, Gal.6:15; πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κ. (Hort., in l), 1Pe.2:13; collectively, of the sum of created things (Wis.19:6, Jdth.16:14), Mrk.16:15, Col.1:15, 23 Heb.9:11, Rev.3:14; of the irrational creation, Rom.8:19-22.†
(AS)
G2937.strong_def: original formation (properly, the act; by implication, the thing, literally or figuratively)

G0829.def:
αὐθάδης, -ες
(αὐτος, ἥδομαι), [in LXX: Gen.49:3, 7 (עַז), Pro.21:24 (יָהִיר)* ;]
self-pleasing, arrogant: Tit.1:7, 2Pe.2:10 (Cremer, 654).†
SYN.: φίλαυτος (see Tr., Syn., § xciii) (AS)
G0829.derivation: from G846 (αὐτός) and the base of G2237 (ἡδονή);

G5052.strong_def: to be a bearer to completion (maturity), i.e. to ripen fruit (figuratively)
G5052.derivation: from a compound of G5056 (τέλος) and G5342 (φέρω);

G0958.def:
Βενιαμίν, (Rec. -μίν), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֶּנְיָמִין),
Benjamin: Act.13:21, Rom.11:1, Php.3:5, Rev.7:8.†
(AS)

G2015.def:
ἐπιφάνεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιφανής), [in LXX: 2Ki.7:23 (יָרֵא), Est.5:1, Amo.5:22, 2Ma.2:21 2Mac 3:24 2Mac 5:4 2Mac 12:22 2Mac 14:16 2Mac 15:27, 3Ma.2:9 3Mac 5:8 3Mac 5:51,* ;] (in late Gk. and Inscr., frequently of deities, see MM, Exp., xiv)
a manifestation, appear­ance: 2Th.2:8, 1Ti.6:14, 2Ti.1:10 4:1 4:8, Tit.2:13 (cf. M, Th., 148 f.).†
(AS)
G2015.strong_def: a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future)

G0741.def:
ἀρτύω
[in Sm.: Sng.8:2 * ;]
1. to arrange, make ready (Hom.).
2. Of food (as in comic writers), to season (MM, see word): Mrk.9:50, Luk.14:34, Col.4:6.†
(AS)
G0741.strong_def: to prepare, i.e. spice (with stimulating condiments)
G0741.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G142 (αἴρω);

G4960.strong_def: to file together (as soldiers in ranks), i.e. (figuratively) to correspond to

G0765.def:
ἀσεβής, -ές
(σέβω, to reverence), [in LXX chiefly for רָשַׁע ;]
un­godly, impious: Rom.4:5 5:6, 1Ti.1:9, 1Pe.4:18, 2Pe.2:5-6 3:7, Ju 4 15.†
(AS)
G0765.strong_def: irreverent, i.e. (by extension) impious or wicked
G0765.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4576 (σέβομαι);

G4441.strong_def: to question, i.e. ascertain by inquiry (as a matter of information merely; and thus differing from G2065 (ἐρωτάω), which properly means a request as a favor; and from G154 (αἰτέω), which is strictly a demand for something due; as well as from G2212 (ζητέω), which implies a search for something hidden; and from G1189 (δέομαι), which involves the idea of urgent need); by implication, to learn (by casual intelligence)
G4441.derivation: middle voice prolonged from a primary (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses);

G2376.def:
θυρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(dim, of θύρα), [in LXX chiefly for חַלּוֹן ;]
a window: Act.20:9, 2Co.11:33.†
(AS)

G0381.def:
ἀν-άπτω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;]
to kindle: Luk.12:49, Jas.3:5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G1372.def:
διψάω,-ῶ
(δίψα, thirst), [in LXX chiefly for צָמֵא ;]
to thirst: absol., Mat.25:35, 37 25:42, 44, Jhn.4:13, 15 19:28, Rom.12:20" (LXX), 1Co.4:11; figuratively, Jhn.4:14 6:35 7:37, Rev.7:16 21:6 22:17; with accusative (= cl. with genitive), τ. δικαιοσύνην, Mat.5:6.†
(AS)

G4445.strong_def: to be on fire, i.e. (specially), to have a fever

G0306.def:
ἀνα-βάλλω
[in LXX: Psa.78:21 89:38 (עָבַר), 1Ki.28:14, Psa.104:2 (עָטָה) ;]
to defer, put off (MM, VGT, see word): mid., Act.24:22.†
(AS)
G0306.derivation: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G906 (βάλλω);

G1383.def:
δοκίμιον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Pro.17:3 27:21 (מִצְרֵף) * ;]
usually regarded as a variant form of δοκιμεῖον, a test, and so perh. Jas.1:3 (see Mayor, in l), but see next word (cf. Cremer, 212, 702).†
(AS)
G1383.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G1382 (δοκιμή);

G4271.strong_def: plain before all men, i.e. obvious

G1018.def:
βραβεύω
(βραβεύς, an umpire), [in LXX: Wis.10:12 * ;]
(a) prop., to act as umpire; hence,
(b) generally, to arbitrate, decide (Isocr., Dem.; Lft., Col., l.with; MM, see word): Col.3:15;
(with) in some late writers, to direct, rule, control (so in Col., l.with, accusative to Thayer, see word, Meyer, in l.), (cf. κατα-βραβεύω).
† (AS)
G1018.strong_def: to arbitrate, i.e. (genitive case) to govern (figuratively, prevail)

G0430.def:
ἀν-έχω
[in LXX chiefly for אָפַק hithp. ;]
to hold up; in NT always mid., to bear with, endure: in cl. most frequently with accusative, but in NT with genitive of person(s), Mat.17:17, Mrk.9:19, Luk.9:41, 2Co.11:1 11:19, Eph.4:2, Col.3:13; before μικρόν τι, with genitive of person(s) and with genitive of thing(s), 2Co.11:1; with dative of thing(s), 2Th.1:4 (v M, Th., in l); before εἴ τις, 2Co.11:20; absol., 1Co.4:12, 2Co.11:4; to bear with = to listen to, with genitive of person(s), Act.18:14; with genitive of thing(s), 2Ti.4:3, Heb.13:22 (cf. προσανέχω and MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0430.strong_def: to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with
G0430.derivation: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G2192 (ἔχω);

G0215.def:
ἀ-λάλητος, -ον
(λαλέω),
inexpressible, not to be uttered: Rom.8:26.†
(AS)
G0215.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2980 (λαλέω);

G0064.def:
ἀγρεύω (ἄγρα),
[in LXX: Job.10:16, Pro.5:22 6:25,26, Hos.5:2 (לקח ni., שׁחט, etc.)* ;]
to catch or take by hunting or fishing; metaphorically, Mrk.12:13.†
(AS)

G0153.def:
αἰσχύνω
(αἶσχος, shame), [in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;]
1. to disfigure (Hom.).
2. to dishonour (Pro.29:15).
3. to make ashamed (Sir.13:7). Pass., to be put to shame, be ashamed: 2Co.10:8; Php.1:20, 1Pe.4:16, 1Jn.2:28; with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Luk.16:3 (cf. ἐπ- (-ομαι), κατ- αἰσχύνω).
† (AS)

G4494.strong_def: to breeze up, i.e. (by analogy) to agitate (into waves)
G4494.derivation: from a derivative of G4496 (ῥίπτω) (meaning a fan or bellows);

G0279.def:
ἀμετανόητος, -ον
(μετανοέω)
1. impenitent: Rom.2:5
2. = ἀμεταμέλητος (π., Philo, al.; see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0279.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3340 (μετανοέω);

G0910.def:
βαπτιστής, -ου, ὁ (βαπτίζω),
a baptizer: of John the Baptist, Mat.3:1 11:11, 12 14:2, 8 16:14 17:13, Mrk.6:25 8:28, Luk.7:20, 33 9:19.†
(AS)
G0910.strong_def: a baptizer, as an epithet of Christ's forerunner

G0352.strong_def: to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated
G0352.derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G2955 (κύπτω);

G5412.strong_def: to load up (properly, as a vessel or animal), i.e. (figuratively) to overburden with ceremony (or spiritual anxiety)

G0370.def:
ἀν-άξιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἄξιος), [in LXX: Jer.15:19 א2 (זָלַל), Est.8:13, Sir.25:8 * ;]
unworthy: with genitive, 1Co.6:2 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0370.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G514 (ἄξιος);

G1084.def:
γεννητός, -ή -όν
(γεννάω), [in LXX: Job.11:2, 12 14:1 15:14 25:4 (ילד)* ;]
begotten, born: pl., γ. γυναικῶν (cf. יְלוּד אִשָּׁה, Job.14:1), periphrasis for mankind, Mat.11:11, Luk.7:28 (Cremer, 147).
(AS)

G5353.strong_def: utterance, i.e. a musical note (vocal or instrumental)

G1731.def:
ἐν-δείκνυμι
[in LXX for לָכַד, גָּמַל, רָאָה hi. ;]
to mark, point out. Mid„
1. to show forth, prove: with accusative of thing(s), Rom.2:15 9:22, Eph.2:7, Tit.2:10 3:2, Heb.6:11; before ἐν, with dative of person(s), Rom.9:17 (LXX), 1Ti.1:16; before εἰς, Heb.6:10 (with cogn. accusative), 2Co.8:24.
2. to manifest (by act): with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), 2Ti.4:14 (cf. Gen.50:15, 17, and see MM, Exp., xiii).†
(AS)

G5070.derivation: from the multiplicative adverb of G5064 (τέσσαρες) and G5507 (χίλιοι);

G0489.def:
ἀντιμισθία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀντίμισθος, for a reward)
a reward, requital: in good sense, 2Co.6:13; in bad sense, Rom.1:27 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0489.derivation: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G3408 (μισθός);

H0001.def:
1) father of an individual
2) of God as father of his people
3) head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan
4) ancestor
4a) grandfather, forefathers - of person
4b) of people
5) originator or patron of a class, profession, or art
6) of producer, generator (fig.)
7) of benevolence and protection (fig.)
8) term of respect and honour
9) ruler or chief (spec.)
Also means: av (אַב "father" H0002)
H0001.strong_def: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application

H0003.def:
freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery
Aramaic equivalent: ev (אֵב "fruit" H0004)

H0004.def:
fruit, fresh, young, greening
Aramaic of ev (אֵב "greenery" H0003)

H0005.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10
§ Abagtha = "God-given"
one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus

H0006.def:
1) perish, vanish, go astray, be destroyed
1a) (Qal)
1a1) perish, die, be exterminated
1a2) perish, vanish (fig.)
1a3) be lost, strayed
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to destroy, kill, cause to perish, to give up (as lost), exterminate
1b2) to blot out, do away with, cause to vanish, (fig.)
1b3) cause to stray, lose
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to destroy, put to death
1c1a) of divine judgment
1c2) object name of kings (fig.)
Aramaic equivalent: a.vad (אֲבַד "to destroy" H0007)
H0006.strong_def: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)

H0007.def:
1) to perish, vanish
1a) (P'al) shall perish
1b) (Aphel) destroy
1c) (Hophal) be destroyed
H0007.strong_def: {properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)}

H0009.strong_def: concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades

H0010.derivation: the same as H9 (אֲבֵדָה), miswritten for H11 (אֲבַדּוֹן);

H0011.def: Abaddon, a place of destruction, destruction, ruin

H0014.def:
1) to be willing, consent
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be willing
1a2) to consent, yield to, accept
1a3) to desire
H0014.strong_def: to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent

H0016.derivation: from H14 (אָבָה) (in the sense of bending toward);

H0017.def: Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain - indicates desire or uneasiness)
H0017.derivation: from H14 (אָבָה) (in the sense of desiring);

H0019.derivation: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn);

H0022.strong_def: Abiel, the name of two Israelites
H0022.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H410 (אֵל); father (i.e. possessor) of God;

H0023.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H622 (אָסַף); father of gathering (i.e. gatherer);

H0024.def:
Month of exodus and passover (March or April)
Also named: ni.san (נִיסָן "Nisan" H5212)
This name means fresh, young barley ears, barley
H0024.strong_def: green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
H0024.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to be tender);

H0025.def:
Abi Gibon = "father of Gibeon"
site of great Bamah, location of the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place
H0025.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H1391 (גִּבְעוֹן); father (i.e. founder) of Gibon;

H0026.def:
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.25.3; married to David (H1732) and Nabal (H5037);
mother of: Chileab (H3609)
§ Abigail = "my father is joy"
1) wife of Nabal, then of David
H0026.strong_def: Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses
H0026.derivation: or shorter אֲבִיגַל; from H1 (אָב) and H1524 (גִּיל); father (i.e. source) of joy;

H0027.def:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.11;
son of: Gideoni (H1441)
§ Abidan = "my father is judge"
a prince (ruler) of Benjamin
H0027.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H1777 (דִּין); father of judgment (i.e. judge);

H0028.strong_def: Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah
H0028.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H3045 (יָדַע); father of knowledge (i.e. knowing);

H0029.strong_def: Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses
H0029.derivation: or prolonged אֲבִיָּהוּ ; from H1 (אָב) and H3050 (יָהּ); father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;

H0030.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H1931 (הוּא); father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God);

H0031.strong_def: Abihud, the name of two Israelites
H0031.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H1935 (הוֹד); father (i.e. possessor) of renown;

H0032.def:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.3.35;
father of: Zuriel (H6700)
§ Abihail = "my father is might"
1) a Levite in Moses's time
2) a Gadite
3) father of Esther
4) wife of Abishur
5) wife of Rehoboam
H0032.strong_def: Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses
H0032.derivation: or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל ; from H1 (אָב) and H2428 (חַיִל); father (i.e. possessor) of might;

H0033.strong_def: an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer
H0033.derivation: from H44 (אֲבִיעֶזֶר) with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite;

H0034.def:
1) in want, needy, chiefly poor, needy person
2) subject to oppression and abuse
3) needing help, deliverance from trouble, especially as delivered by God
4) general reference to lowest class
H0034.derivation: from H14 (אָבָה), in the sense of want (especially in feeling);

H0035.strong_def: provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste)

H0036.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H2898 (טוּב); father of goodness (i.e. good);

H0037.def:
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.4; married to David (H1732);
mother of: Shephatiah (H8203)
§ Abital = "my father is (the) dew"
a wife of David
H0037.strong_def: Abital, a wife of King David
H0037.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H2919 (טַל); father of dew (i.e. fresh);

H0038.strong_def: Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah
H0038.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H3220 (יָם); father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman);

H0039.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe);

H0040.def:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.20.2
§ Abimelech = "Melek is father" or "my father is king"
1) king of Gerar in Abraham's time
2) king of Gath in David's time; maybe title of Philistine kings
3) son of Gideon by a concubine
4) priest, son of Abiathar
H0040.strong_def: Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites
H0040.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); father of (the) king;

H0041.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.7.1;
father of: Eleazar (H0499H), Uzzah (H5798A), Ahio (H0283)
§ Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing"
1) a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark
2) second son of Jesse, David's older brother
3) a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines
H0041.strong_def: Abinadab, the name of four Israelites
H0041.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H5068 (נָדַב); father of generosity (i.e. liberal);

H0042.def:
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.4.6;
father of: Barak (H1301)
§ Abinoam = "my father is delight"
father of Barak, descendant of Naphtali
H0042.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H5278 (נֹעַם); father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious);

H0044.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.27
§ Abiezer = "my father is help"
1) a Manassite, called "son" of Gilead, also son of Gilead's sister
2) a Benjamite, warrior of David
H0044.strong_def: Abiezer, the name of two Israelites
H0044.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H5829 (עֵזֶר); father of help (i.e. helpful);

H0045.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.31
Also named: a.vi.el (אֲבִיאֵל "Abiel" H0022H)
§ Abialbon = "El (God) is my father"
one of David's mighty men (hero)
H0045.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant);

H0046.def:
1) strong, mighty-used only to describe God
2) the Strong-old name for God (poetic)

H0047.def:
1) mighty, valiant
1a) of men
1b) of angels
1c) of animals
1d) (metaph)
1d1) of enemies
1d2) of princes
1d3) of sacrificial objects
1e) obstinate (fig.)

H0048.strong_def: Abiram, the name of two Israelites
H0048.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H7311 (רוּם); father of height (i.e. lofty);

H0049.def:
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.1.3
§ Abishag = "my father is a wanderer"
David's beautiful young nurse
H0049.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H7686 (שָׁגָה); father of error (i.e. blundering);

H0050.strong_def: Abishua, the name of two Israelites
H0050.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H7771 (שׁוֹעַ); father of plenty (i.e. prosperous);

H0051.derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H7791 (שׁוּר); father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason);

H0052.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.26.6 and Zeruiah (H6870);
brother of: Joab (H3097) and Asahel (H6214)
§ Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift"
grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah, brother of Joab

§ Bene-barak = "sons of lightning"
a city in Dan
H1139.strong_def: sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine
H1139.derivation: from the plural construction of H1121 (בֵּן) and H1300 (בָּרָק);

H1141.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.18;
son of: Jehoiada (H3077);
father of: Ammizabad (H5990)
§ Benaiah = "Jehovah has built" or "Yahweh has built up"
1) one of David's mighty warriors, son of Jehoiada the chief priest, a Levite, set by David over his bodyguard, later having remained faithful to Solomon during Adonijah's attempt on the crown, was raised into the place of Joab as commander-in-chief of the army
2) the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite, one of David's thirty mighty warriors, and the captain of the eleventh monthly course
3) a Simeonite, a prince of the families of Simeon
4) a Levite in the time of David who played with a psaltery on Alamoth
5) a priest in the time of David, appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark
6) a Levite of the sons of Asaph
7) a Levite in the time of Hezekiah
8) Four Israelites in the time of Ezra who had taken strange wives
9) the father of Pelatiah
H1141.strong_def: Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites
H1141.derivation: or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has built;

H1142.def:
§ Bene-jaakan = "sons of twisting"
an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as be.e.rot be.ne-ya.a.qan (בְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָן "Beeroth-bene-jaakan" H0885))
H1142.strong_def: Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert
H1142.derivation: from the plural of H1121 (בֵּן) and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); sons of Yaakan;

H1143.def:
1) between, space between two armies
1a) man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton)
H1143.strong_def: a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies

H1144.strong_def: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
H1144.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H3225 (יָמִין); son of (the) right hand;

H1145.strong_def: a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin
H1145.derivation: sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with H376 (אִישׁ) inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy; a Jeminite; (plural) בְּנֵי יְמִינִיxlit Bᵉnîy corrected to Bᵉnêy; patron from H1144 (בִּנְיָמִין);

H1146.def:
structure, building
Aramaic equivalent: bin.yan (בִּנְיָן "building" H1147)

H1147.def:
a building, structure
Aramaic of bin.yan (בִּנְיָן "building" H1146)

H1148.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.13
§ Beninu = "our son"
a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
H1148.derivation: probably from H1121 (בֵּן) with pron. suff.; our son;

H1151.def:
A man of Ammon living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.19.38;
son of: Lot (H3876) and his second daughter (H3876I); half-brother of Moab (H4124H)
§ Ben-ami = "son of my people"
son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites
H1151.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H5971 (עַם) with pronomial suffix; son of my people;

H1152.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.6;
father of: Meshullam (H4918S)
§ Besodeiah = "with the counsel of Jehovah" or "in the secret of the Lord"
father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
H1152.derivation: from H5475 (סוֹד) and H3050 (יָהּ) with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah;

H1153.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.49
§ Besai = "my treading"
a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel

H1154.def:
unripe or sour grapes
Another spelling of bo.ser (בֹּ֫סֶר "unripe grape" H1155)
H1154.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be sour;

H1155.def:
unripe grapes, sour grapes
Also means: be.ser (בֶּסֶר "unripe grape" H1154)

H1156.def:
1) to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition
1a) (P'al)
1a1) to ask, request
1a2) to seek (for favour)

H1157.def:
1) behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about
1a) through (of action)
1b) behind (with verbs of shutting)
1c) about (with verbs of fencing)
1d) on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)
H1157.strong_def: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.

H1158.def:
1) to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to seek, enquire
1a2) to cause to boil up
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be searched out
1b2) to be swelling, bulging, swelling out
H1158.strong_def: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask

H1159.def:
1) petition, request
2) prayer (always in Jewish liturgy)

H1160.def:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.32;
father of: Bela (H1106)
§ Beor = "burning"
1) father of Balaam
2) father of Bela, king of Edom
H1160.strong_def: Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam
H1160.derivation: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of burning); a lamp;

H1162.def:
A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Rut.2.1;
son of: Salmon (H8007) and Rahab (H7343); married to Ruth (H7327);
father of: Obed (H5744)
Also named: Booz (Βοόζ "Boaz" G1003)
§ Boaz = "fleetness"
1) ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi
2) name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple
H1162.strong_def: Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple
H1162.derivation: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

H1163.def:
1) to kick, kick at
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to kick
1a2) to kick at
1a3) to desire (fig.)

H1164.def:
ruin, heap of ruins
Another spelling of i (עִי "ruin" H5856)

H1165.derivation: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of eating);

H1166.def:
This name means to be married
Another name of ye.ru.sha.laim (יְרוּשָׁלִַ֫ם, יְרוּשְׁלֵם "Jerusalem" H3389)
H1166.strong_def: to be master; hence, to marry
H1166.derivation: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל)

H1167.def:
: master/leader
1) owner, husband, lord
1a) owner
1b) a husband
1c) citizens, inhabitants
1d) rulers, lords
1e) (noun of relationship used to characterise-ie, master of dreams)
H1167.strong_def: a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense)

H1169.def:
owner, lord
Aramaic of ba.al (בַּעַל ": master" H1167)

H1170.def:
§ Baal-berith = "lord of the covenant"
a god of the Philistines
H1170.strong_def: Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites
H1170.derivation: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1285 (בְּרִית); Baal of (the) covenant;

H1171.def:
Baal-gad = "lord of fortune"
a city noted for Baal-worship, located at the most northern or northwestern point to which Joshua's victories extended
Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)
H1171.derivation: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1409 (גָּד); Baal of Fortune;

H1172.def:
1) mistress, female owner
2) sorceress, necromancer (noun of relationship)

H1173.strong_def: Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine

H1174.def:
Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance"
the site of Solomon's vineyard
Another spelling of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)
H1174.derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H1995 (הָמוֹן); possessor of a multitude;

H1175.def:
Baalath or Bealoth = "mistresses"
a town in south Judah
Another name of ba.a.lat be.er (בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר "Baalath-beer" H1192)

H1176.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.1.2
§ Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly"
a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron
H1176.strong_def: Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites
H1176.derivation: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H2070 (זְבוּב); Baal of (the) Fly;

H1177.def:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.38;
son of: Achbor (H5907)
§ Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious"
1) an early king of Edom
2) one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations
H1177.strong_def: Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite
H1177.derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2603 (חָנַן); possessor of grace;

H1178.def:
§ Baal-hazor = "lord of the village"
a town on the border between Ephraim and Benjamin, apparent location of a sheep farm of Absalom and location of Amnon's murder
H1178.derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and a modification of H2691 (חָצֵר); possessor of a village;

H1179.def:
Baal-hermon or Baal-chermon = "lord of destruction"
a city near or on Mount Hermon, named as a seat of Baal worship
Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)
H1179.derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); possessor of Hermon;

H1180.def:
Baali = "my lord"
a deity in the northern kingdom, variation of the name 'Baal'
Another name of ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068G)
H1180.strong_def: Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah
H1180.derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) with pron. suff.; my master;

H1181.def:
Baale-bamoth = "the lords of the high places"
the people of Arnon, east of Jordan
H1181.strong_def: Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan
H1181.derivation: from the plural of H1168 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); Baals of (the) heights;

H1182.derivation: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H3045 (יָדַע); Baal has known;

H1183.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.5
§ Bealiah = "Jehovah is master"
a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's mighty warriors
H1183.derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) master;

H1184.def:
Baale-Judah = "the lords of Judah"
a place in Judah named for the Baalim, also known as Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab
Combined with qir.yat ye.a.rim (קִרְיַת יְעָרִים "Kiriath-jearim" H7157)
H1184.derivation: from the plural of H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3063 (יְהוּדָה); masters of Judah;

H1185.def:
A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.14
§ Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy"
king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar
H1185.derivation: probably from a derivative of H5965 (עָלַס) with prepositional prefix; in exultation;

H1186.def:
§ Baal-meon = "lord of the habitation"
a town in Reuben, mentioned in connection with Nebo, and in the time of Ezekiel, Moabite
H1186.strong_def: Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan
H1186.derivation: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן));

H1187.def:
Baal-peor = "lord of the gap"
the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites
Another name of ba.al (בַּעַל "Baal" H1168A)
H1187.derivation: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6465 (פְּעוֹר); Baal of Peor;

H1188.def:
§ Baal-perazim = "lord of the breaks"
the site of a victory of David over the Philistines, and of a great destruction of their images; also called 'Mount Perazim'
H1188.derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H6556 (פֶּרֶץ); possessor of breaches;

H1189.def:
§ Baal Tsphon or Baal-zephon = "lord of the north"
a place in Egypt near the Red Sea where Pharaoh and his army were destroyed during the Exodus
H1189.derivation: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6828 (צָפוֹן) (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter;

H1190.def:
§ Baal-shalisha = "thrice-great lord"
a place in Ephraim near Gilgal
H1190.strong_def: Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine

H1192.def:
§ Baalath-beer = "mistress of the well"
a town in the south part of Judah, given to Simeon, which also bore the name of 'Ramath-negeb'
H1192.derivation: from H1172 (בַּעֲלָה) and H875 (בְּאֵר); mistress of a well;

H1193.def:
§ Baal-tamar = "lord of the palms"
a place near Gibeah in Benjamin
H1193.derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H8558 (תָּמָר); possessor of (the) palm-tree;

H1194.def:
Beon = "in the dwelling: indwelling"
a place or city in Reuben
Another name of ba.al me.on (בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן "Baal-meon" H1186)
H1194.strong_def: Beon, a place East of the Jordan
H1194.derivation: probably a contraction of H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן);

H1195.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.12;
son of: Ahilud (H0286);
brother of: Jehoshaphat (H3092)
§ Baana or Baanah = "in the affliction"
1) the son of Ahilud, Solomon's commissariat officer in Jezreel and the north of the Jordan valley
2) another of Solomon's officers
3) father of Zadok who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah
H1195.strong_def: Banana, the name of four Israelite

H1196.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.4.2;
son of: Rimmon (H7417B);
brother of: Rechab (H7394)
§ Baana or Baanah = "in affliction"
1) a Benjamite, son Rimmon, who with his brother Rechab murdered Ish-bosheth. For this, killed by David, mutilated bodies hung up over the pool at Hebron
2) a Netophathite, father of Heleb or Heled, one of David's mighty warriors
3) the head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
4) a chief of the people
H1196.strong_def: Baanah, the name of four Israelites
H1196.derivation: from a derivative of H6031 (עָנָה) with prepositional prefix; in affliction

H1197.gloss: be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste.
H1197.strong_def: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating);  to be(-come) brutish
H1197.derivation: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1198 (בַּעַר)

H1198.strong_def: properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid

H1199.def:
A womanof the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.8; married to Shaharaim (H7842)
§ Baara = "brutish"
one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite

H1201.derivation: from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness;

H1202.derivation: from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H3050 (יָהּ) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah;

H1203.def:
Beeshterah = "with increase"
a Levitical city in Manasseh, east of the Jordan; probably identical with 'Ashtaroth'
Another name of ash.ta.rot (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת "Ashtaroth" H6252H)
H1203.strong_def: Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan
H1203.derivation: from H6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה) (as singular of H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת)) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth;

H1204.def:
1) to terrify, startle, fall upon, dismay, be overtaken by sudden terror
1a) (Niphal) to be terrified
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to fall upon, overwhelm
1b2) to terrify

H1209.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.17
§ Bezai = "conqueror"
a chief of the returning exiles in the time of Ezra
H1209.strong_def: Betsai, the name of two Israelites

H1211.derivation: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel;

H1212.def:
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.2;
son of: Uri (H0221)
§ Bezaleel = "in the shadow (i.e. protection) of God"
1) son of Uri and grandson of Hur; a skilled Judahite artisan in all works of metal, wood, and stone and one of the architects of the tabernacle
2) an Israelite, one of the sons of Pahath-moab, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
H1212.strong_def: Betsalel, the name of two Israelites
H1212.derivation: probably from H6738 (צֵל) and H410 (אֵל) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God;

H1213.derivation: or בַּצְלִית; from the same as H1211 (בֶּצֶל)xlit bᵉtsel corrected to betsel; a peeling;

H1214.def:
: to cut off
1) to cut off, break off, gain by unrighteous violence, get, finish, be covetous, be greedy
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to cut off
1a2) to stop
1a3) to gain wrongfully or by violence
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to cut off, sever
1b2) to finish, complete, accomplish
1b3) to violently make gain of
H1214.derivation: a primitive root to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder;

H1215.def: profit, unjust gain, gain (profit) acquired by violence

H1216.strong_def: perhaps to swell up, i.e. blister

H1218.def:
§ Bozkath or Boscath = "rocky height"
a city in Judah in the lowlands toward the Philistines, home of Josiah's mother
H1218.derivation: from H1216 (בָּצֵק); a swell of ground;

H1219.def:
1) to gather, restrain, fence, fortify, make inaccessible, enclose
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to cut off
1a2) fortified, cut off, made inaccessible (pass participle)
1a3) secrets, mysteries, inaccessible things (subst)
1b) (Niphal) to be withheld
1c) (Piel) to fortify
H1219.strong_def: to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification)
H1219.derivation: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from H1210 (בָּצִיר))

H1220.strong_def: strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out)

H1221.def:
Bezer = "gold ore" or "remote fortress"
a city of refuge in Reuben in the downs on the east of the Jordan
Also named: bots.rah (בׇּצְרָה "Bozrah" H1224H)
H1221.strong_def: Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite
H1221.derivation: the same as H1220 (בֶּצֶר), an inaccessible spot;

H1224.def:
§ Bozrah = "sheepfold" or "fortress"
a town in Edom

H1227.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.51
§ Bakbuk = "bottle"
a head of a family of temple-slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel
H1227.derivation: the same as H1228 (בַּקְבֻּק)xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq;

H1228.strong_def: a bottle (from the gurgling in emptying)

H1229.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.11.17
§ Bakbukiah = "wasting of Jehovah"
a Levite in the time of Nehemiah
H1229.derivation: from H1228 (בַּקְבֻּק)xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq and H3050 (יָהּ); emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah;

H1230.def:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.15
§ Bakbakkar = "searcher"
a Levite, apparently a descendant of Asaph

H1231.def:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.22;
son of: Jogli (H3020)
§ Bukki = "wasting"
1) son of Abishua and father of Uzzi, fifth from Aaron in the line of the high priests
2) son of Jogli, prince of the tribe of Dan, one of the ten men chosen to apportion the land of Canaan between the tribes
H1231.strong_def: Bukki, the name of two Israelites

H1232.derivation: from H1238 (בָּקַק) and H3050 (יָהּ); wasting of Jah;

H1234.def:
1) to split, cleave, break open, divide, break through, rip up, break up, tear
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to cleave, cleave open
1a2) to break through, break into
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be cleft, be rent open, be split open
1b2) to be broken into
1c) (Piel)
1c1) to cleave, cut to pieces, rend open
1c2) to break through, break down
1d) (Pual)
1d1) to be ripped open, be torn open
1d2) to be rent
1d3) to be broken into
1e) (Hiphil)
1e1) to break into
1e2) to break through
1f) (Hophal) to be broken into
1g) (Hithpael) to burst (themselves) open, cleave asunder
H1234.strong_def: to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open

H1235.def:
1) half, part also called "shekel of the sanctuary" or "holy shekel"
2) half a shekel (meton) There appears to be at least three different shekels, one of silver, gold and copper. See a Bible Dictionary for a complete treatment of the subject.
H1235.strong_def: a section (half) of ashekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin)

H1236.strong_def: {properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains}

H1237.def:
This name means plain, level valley
Another name of kik.kar (כִּכָּר "Plain" H3603G)
H1237.strong_def: properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains

6) son of Shemaah of Gibeah who resorted to David at Ziklag
H3101.strong_def: Joash, the name of six Israelites
H3101.derivation: or יֹאָשׁ; (2 Chronicles 24:1), a form of H3060 (יְהוֹאָשׁ);

H3102.derivation: perhaps a form of H3103 (יוֹבָב), but more probably by erroneous transcription for H3437 (יָשׁוּב);

H3103.def:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.29;
son of: Joktan (H3355);
brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Abimael (H0039), Sheba (H7614H), Ophir (H0211) and Havilah (H2341I)
§ Jobab = "a desert"
1) the last in order of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem
2) one of the kings of Edom
3) the king of Madon, located in northern Canaan, and one of the kings who opposed Joshua during the conquest and who were routed at Meron
4) head of a Benjamite house
5) another Benjamite
H3103.strong_def: Jobab, the name of two Israelites and of three foreigners

H3104.def:
1) ram, ram's horn, trumpet, cornet
1a) ram (only in combination)
1a1) ram's horn, trumpet
1b) jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (meton)
H3104.strong_def: the blast of a horn (from its continuous sound); specifically, the signal of the silver trumpets; hence, the instrument itself and the festival thus introduced

H3107.def:
A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.12.22;
son of: Shimeath (H8100); also called Zabad at 2Ch.24.26;
Another name of yo.za.khar (יוֹזָכָר "Jozacar" H3108)
§ Jozabad or Josabad = "Jehovah has endowed"
1) a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David
2) one of David's mighty warriors
3) another of David's mighty warriors
4) four other priests or Levites
H3107.strong_def: Jozabad, the name of ten Israelites

H3109.strong_def: Jocha, the name of two Israelites
H3109.derivation: probably from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and a variation of H2421 (חָיָה); Jehovah-revived;

H3110.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.23;
son of: Kareah (H7143);
brother of: Jonathan (H3129L)
§ Johanan = "Jehovah has graced"
1) a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel
2) a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem
3) the eldest son of king Josiah
4) a post-exilic prince of the line of David
5) father of Azariah, priest in Solomon's time
6) a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors
7) a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors
8) a returning exile
H3110.strong_def: Jochanan, the name of nine Israelites

H3111.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.6;
son of: Paseah (H6454I)
§ Joiada or Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"
1) son of Paseah, who assisted to repair the old gate of Jerusalem
2) son of the high priest Eliashib in the time of Nehemiah
H3111.strong_def: Jojada, the name of two Israelites

H3114.def:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.10;
father of: Jedaiah (H3048); also called Jehoiarib at 1Ch.9.10;
Also named: ye.ho.ya.riv (יְהוֹיָרִיב "Jehoiarib" H3080H)
§ Joiarib = "Jehovah contends"
1) the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time
2) a teacher in the time of Ezra
3) a Judaite in the time of Nehemiah
H3114.strong_def: Jojarib, the name of four Israelites

H3115.derivation: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) contracted and H3513 (כָּבַד); Jehovah-gloried;

H3117.def:
: day/when/time/period
1) day, time, year
1a) day (as opposed to night)
1b) day (24 hour period)
1b1) as defined by evening and morning in Genesis 1
1b2) as a division of time
1b2a) a working day, a day's journey
1c) days, lifetime (pl.)
1d) time, period (general)
1e) year
1f) temporal references
1f1) today
1f2) yesterday
1f3) tomorrow
H3117.strong_def: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H3117.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be hot;

H3118.def:
1) day
2) day always refers to a twenty-four hour period when the word is modified by a definite or cardinal number

H3119.def:
adv
1) by day, in the daytime
subst
2) daytime

H3120.strong_def: Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia
H3120.derivation: probably from the same as H3196 (יַיִן); effervescing (i.e. hot and active);

H3122.strong_def: Jonadab, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite

H3123.strong_def: a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating)
H3123.derivation: probably from the same as H3196 (יַיִן);

H3124.def:
A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.14.25;
son of: Amittai (H0573)
Also named: Iōnas (Ἰωνᾶς "Jonah" G2495H)
§ Jonah = "dove"
son of Amittai and a native of Gath-hepher; 5th of the minor prophets who prophesied during the reign of Jeroboam II and whom God sent also to prophecy to Nineveh

H3125.strong_def: a Jevanite, or descendant of Javan

H3126.strong_def: a sucker; hence, a twig (of a tree felled and sprouting)

H3128.def:
§ Jonath-elem-recho-kim = "the silent dove of far-off places"
1) meaning uncertain
1a) probably name of melody
1b) only used in title of Ps 56:1
H3128.strong_def: dove of (the) silence (i.e. dumb Israel) of (i.e. among) distances (i.e. strangers); the title of a ditty (used for a name of its melody)
H3128.derivation: from H3123 (יוֹנָה) and H482 (אֵלֶם) and the plural of H7350 (רָחוֹק);

H3129.def:
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.32;
son of: Jada (H3047);
brother of: Jether (H3500I);
father of: Peleth (H6431H) and Zaza (H2117)
§ Jonathan or Jehonathan = "Jehovah has given"
1) a son of king Saul and a friend of David
2) a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear
3) one of David's mighty warriors
4) a Levite and father of Zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall
5) a son of Kareah and a brother of Johanan; a Judaite captain after the fall of Jerusalem
6) another Judaite
7) father of Ebed in the time of Ezra
8) son of Asahel in the time of Ezra
9) a priest of the family of Melicu in the time of Nehemiah
10) son of Joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of Nehemiah
H3129.strong_def: Jonathan, the name of ten Israelites

H3130.strong_def: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
H3130.derivation: future of H3254 (יָסַף); let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding);

H3131.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.8.10;
father of: Shelomith (H8019H)
§ Josiphiah = "Jehovah adds"
father or ancestor of Shelomith who returned with Ezra
H3131.derivation: from active participle of H3254 (יָסַף) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) adding;

H3132.derivation: perhaps feminine active participle of H3276 (יַעַל); furthermore;

H3133.derivation: apparently the active participle of H3259 (יָעַד); appointer;

H3134.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.6
§ Joezer = "Jehovah is help"
a Korhite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag
H3134.derivation: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5828 (עֵזֶר); Jehovah (is his) help;

H3135.strong_def: Joash, the name of two Israelites

H3138.def:
1) early rain, autumn shower
1a) rain which falls in Palestine from late October until early December
H3138.strong_def: sprinkling; hence, a sprinkling (or autumnal showers)

H3139.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.18; also called Hariph at Neh.7.24;
Also named: cha.riph (חָרִיף "Hariph" H2756H)
§ Jorah = "he instructs"
the head or ancestor of a family who returned from Babylon with Ezra

H3141.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.10;
son of: Toi (H8583); also called Hadoram at 1Ch.18.10;
Also named: ha.do.ram (הֲדוֹרָם "Hadoram" H1913)
§ Joram = "Jehovah is exalted"
1) son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal
2) son of king Ahab of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by Jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered Naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of Elijah to the very letter
3) a Levite in the time of David and an ancestor of Shelomith
4) son of Toi, king of Hamath
H3141.strong_def: Joram, the name of three Israelites and one Syrian

H3142.derivation: from H7725 (שׁוּב) and H2617 (חֵסֵד); kindness will be returned;

H3143.derivation: from H3427 (יָשַׁב) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jehovah will cause to dwell;

H3144.def:
A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.34;
son of: Amaziah (H0558H)
§ Joshah = "Jehovah makes equal"
a prince of the house of Simeon

H3146.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.43
§ Joshaphat or Jehoshaphat = "Jehovah judges"
1) one of David's mighty warriors
2) a priest and trumpeter in the time of David

H3147.def:
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.9.5;
son of: Gideon (H1439);
brother of: Jether (H3500) and Abimelech (H0040H)
§ Jotham = "Jehovah is perfect"
1) son of king Uzziah of Judah by Jerushah; king of Judah for 16 years and contemporary with Isaiah and king Pekah of Israel
2) son of Jahdai and a descendant of Caleb and Judah
3) youngest son of Gideon who escaped from the massacre of his brothers
H3147.strong_def: Jotham, the name of three Israelites
H3147.derivation: from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H8535 (תָּם); Jehovah (is) perfect;

H3148.def:
1) superiority, advantage, excess
adv
2) excess, better
conj
3) besides, moreover, more
H3148.strong_def: properly, redundant; hence, over and above, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjunction

H3149.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to sprinkle) and H410 (אֵל); sprinkled of God;

H3150.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.25
§ Jeziah = "Jehovah sprinkles"
a descendant of Parosh who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H3150.derivation: from the same as the first part of H3149 (יְזַוְאֵל) and H3050 (יָהּ); sprinkled of Jah;

H3151.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.31
§ Jaziz = "He makes prominent"
a Hagarite, officer of David in charge of the flocks
H3151.derivation: from the same as H2123 (זִיז); he will make prominent;

H3152.derivation: perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up); he will draw out;

H3154.strong_def: sweat, i.e. (by implication) a sweating dress
H3154.derivation: from an unused root mean to ooze;

H3155.strong_def: a Jizrach (i.e. Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach

H3156.strong_def: Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites
H3156.derivation: from H2224 (זָרַח) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will shine;

H3157.def:
Jezreel = "God sows"
a city in the Nekeb of Judah
Also named: yiz.re.e.li (יִזְרְעֵאלִי "Jezreel" H3158)
H3157.strong_def: Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites
H3157.derivation: from H2232 (זָרַע) and H410 (אֵל); God will sow;

H3158.def:
Jezreelite , of Jezreel "sown of God"
an inhabitant of Jezreel
Another spelling of yiz.re.el (יִזְרְעֶאל "Jezreel" H3157)
H3158.strong_def: a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel

H3159.def:
Jezreelitess , of Jezreel "sown of God"
1) a female inhabitant of Jezreel
1a) used only of Ahinoam, a wife of David

H3161.def:
1) to join, unite, be joined, be united
1a) (Qal) to be united
1b) (Piel) to unite

H3162.gloss: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.

H3163.derivation: from H3162 (יַחַד) with pronominal suffix; his unity, i.e. (adverb) together;

H3164.def:
A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.24
§ Jahdiel = "my unity is God"
a chief of Manasseh on the east of the Jordan
H3164.derivation: from H3162 (יַחַד) and H410 (אֵל); unity of God;

H3165.def:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.20;
son of: Shebuel (H7619)
§ Jehdeiah = "Jehovah is unity"
1) a Levite in the time of David
2) a Meronothite, officer of David in charge of the she-asses
H3165.strong_def: Jechdijah, the name of two Israelites
H3165.derivation: from H3162 (יַחַד) and H3050 (יָהּ); unity of Jah;

H3166.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.4
§ Jahaziel = "beheld of God"
1) a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
2) a priest in the reign of David who helped move the ark
3) a Kohathite Levite, 3rd son of Hebron
4) a Levite, son of Zechariah, of the sons of Asaph, in the reign of Jehoshaphat
5) an ancestor of one of the families who returned from exile with Ezra
H3166.strong_def: Jachaziel, the name of five Israelites
H3166.derivation: from H2372 (חָזָה) and H410 (אֵל); beheld of God;

H3167.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.15;
son of: Tikvah (H8616H)
§ Jahaziah = "Jehovah views"
son of Tikvah, apparently a priest and leader during the time of Ezra
H3167.derivation: from H2372 (חָזָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will behold;

H3168.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.16
§ Ezekiel or Jehezekel = "God strengthens"
1) son of Buzi and a priest and prophet; author of the book by his name; taken captive with Jehoiachin and exiled in Babylon where he prophesied for the next 22 years
2) a priest in charge of the 20th course in the time of David
H3168.strong_def: Jechezkel, the name of two Israelites
H3168.derivation: from H2388 (חָזַק) and H410 (אֵל); God will strengthen;

H3169.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.28.12;
son of: Shallum (H7967N)
§ Hezekiah or Jehizkiah = "Jehovah has made strong"
1) son of king Ahazby Abi or Abijah and the 12th king of Judah; his reign was characterised by his godly conduct; reigned for 29 years
2) head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah
3) an Ephraimite in the time of Ahaz
H3169.strong_def: Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites
H3169.derivation: or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ; from H3388 (יְרוּשָׁא) and H3050 (יָהּ); strengthened of Jah;

H3170.derivation: from the same as H2386 (חֲזִיר); perhaps protection;

H3171.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18
§ Jehiel = "God lives"
1) a Levite and one of the chief musicians in the time of David
2) a Gershonite Levite who had charge of the treasures in the time of David
3) son of Hachmoni and an officer of David and tutor of David's sons
4) a son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah put to death by his brother Jehoram
5) Hemanite who took part in the restoration of king Hezekiah
6) a Levite and overseer in the time of Hezekiah
7) a ruler of the temple during the reforms of Josiah
8) father of Obadiah of the sons of Joab in the time of Ezra
9) father of Shechaniah of the sons of Elam in the time of Ezra
10) a son of Elam who put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra
11) a priest of the sons of Harim who also had to put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H3171.strong_def: Jechiel (or Jechavel), the name of eight Israelites
H3171.derivation: or (2 Chronicles 29:14) יְחַוְאֵל; from H2421 (חָיָה) and H410 (אֵל); God will live;

H3173.def:
adj
1) only, only one, solitary, one
1a) only, unique, one
1b) solitary
1c)(TWOT) only begotten son
subst
2) one
H3173.strong_def: properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced)

H3174.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; also called Jehiah at 1Ch.15.24;
Another name of ye.i.el (יְעִיאֵל "Jeiel" H3273I)
§ Jehiah = "Jehovah lives"
doorkeeper of the ark at the time of its establishment in Jerusalem
H3174.derivation: from H2421 (חָיָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will live;

H3176.def:
: wait[for_time]
1) to wait, hope, expect
1a) (Niphal) to wait
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to wait, await, tarry
1b2) to wait for, hope for
1c) (Hiphil) to wait, tarry, wait for, hope for
Also means: ya.chal (יָחַל ": hope" H3176H)
H3176.strong_def: to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope

H3177.derivation: from H3176 (יָחַל) and H410 (אֵל); expectant of God;

H3178.strong_def: a Jachleelite or descendant of Jachleel

H3179.def:
1) to be hot, conceive
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be hot, become hot
1a2) to mate (of animals)
1a3) to be or become hot (fig. of anger)
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to conceive (sexually)
1b2) to be in heat (of animals)
H3179.strong_def: probably to be hot; figuratively, to conceive

H3180.def:
1) roebuck
1a) a kind of deer, reddish in colour
1b) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown

H3182.derivation: from an unused root meaning to take off the shoes;

H3183.derivation: from H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and H410 (אֵל); God will allot;

H3184.strong_def: a Jachtseelite (collectively) or descendants of Jachtseel

H3185.derivation: from H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and H410 (אֵל); allotted of God;

H3186.def:
(Qal) to delay, tarry, defer

H3187.derivation: a primitive root; to sprout; used only as denominative from H3188 (יַחַשׂ);

H3188.strong_def: a pedigree or family list (as growing spontaneously)

H3189.def:
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.4.2;
son of: Haroeh (H7204);
father of: Ahumai (H0267) and Lahad (H3855)
§ Jahath = "He will snatch up"
1) son of Reaiah and grandson of Shobal of the tribe of Judah
2) a son of Libni and grandson of Gershom and great grandson of Levi
3) a Gershonite Levite; the eldest son of Shimei and the grandson of Laadan; founder of the house of Jahath
4) a Levite and son of Shelomoth
5) a Merarite Levite in the reign of Josiah

H3190.def:
1) to be good, be pleasing, be well, be glad
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be glad, be joyful
1a2) to be well placed
1a3) to be well for, be well with, go well with
1a4) to be pleasing, be pleasing to
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to make glad, rejoice
1b2) to do good to, deal well with
1b3) to do well, do thoroughly

1b5) to do well, do right

Aramaic of ya.tav (יָטַב "be good" H3190)
H3191.strong_def: {to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right)}

H3193.def:

a stopping place in the wilderness
H3193.strong_def: Jotbathah, a place in the Desert

a town in the mountains of Judah, in the neighbourhood of Maon and Carmel; modern 'Yutta'
H3194.strong_def: Juttah (or Jutah), a place in Palestine

H3196.derivation: from an unused root meaning to effervesce;

1) to prove, decide, judge, rebuke, reprove, correct, be right

1a1) to decide, judge
1a2) to adjudge, appoint

father of: Zerahiah (H2228)
§ Uzzi = "strong"
1) a Levite, son of Bukki and father of Zerahiah in the line of the high priest although apparently never high priest himself
2) son of Tola and grandson of Issachar
3) a Benjamite, son of Bela and head of a family of Benjamin

son of: Kohath (H6955);
brother of: Amram (H6019), Izhar (H3324) and Hebron (H2275B);

2) a Simeonite captain, son of Ishi, in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah
3) descendant of Bela, head of a family in the tribe of Benjamin
4) a musician of the sons of Heman in the time of David
5) a Levite of the sons of Jeduthun in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah
6) son of Harhaiah, probably a priest and a goldsmith, who took part in repairing the wall under Nehemiah

father of Paltiel prince of the tribe of Issachar who represented his tribe in the division of the promised land

1b) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown

brother of: Jehozadak (H3087)

1) the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah

H5838.def:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.4.2;
son of: Ahimaaz (H0290H);
father of: Johanan (H3110J)

1) son of king Amaziah of Judah and king of Judah himself for 52 years; also 'Uzziah'
2) the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord
2a) also, 'Abednego' (H5664 or H5665)
3) son of Nathan and an officer of Solomon; perhaps David's grandson and Solomon's nephew
4) a prophet in the days of king Asa of Judah
5) son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and brother to 5
6) another son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and brother to 4
7) a priest, son of Ahimaaz, grandson of Zadok and high priest in the reign of king Solomon
8) the high priest in the reign of king Uzziah of Judah
9) a priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; probably same as 18
10) a Kohathite Levite, father of Joel in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah
11) a Merarite Levite, son of Jehalelel in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah
12) a Kohathite Levite, son of Zephaniah and ancestor of Samuel the prophet
13) a Levite who helped Ezra in instructing the people in the law
14) son of Jeroham and one of the temple captains of Judah in the time of queen Athaliah; probably the same as 21
15) son of Maaseiah who repaired part of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
16) one of the leaders who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel
17) a man who assisted in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; probably the same as 10
18) son of Johanan, one of the captains of Ephraim in the reign of king Ahaz of Judah
19) a Judaite, son of Ethan of the sons of Zerah
20) a Judaite, son of Jehu of the family of the Jerahmeelites and descended from Jarha the Egyptian slave of Sheshan; probably one of the captains of the time of queen Athaliah and the same as 15
21) a priest, son of Hilkiah
22) a priest, son of Johanan
23) son of king Jehoram of Judah; probably clerical error for 'Ahaziah'
24) son of Meraioth
25) son of Hoshaiah and one of the proud men who confronted Jeremiah

a city lying east of Bethel and beside Bethaven near Jericho and the second city taken on the invasion of Canaan

H8562.strong_def: properly, a scouring, i.e. soap or perfumery forthe bath; figuratively, a detergent
H8562.derivation: or תַּמְרֻק; or תַּמְרִיק; from H4838 (מָרַק);

H8566.def:

1b) (Hiphil) to hire (a prostitute), give amorous favours

H8568.def:

H8573.def:
1) swinging, waving, wave offering, offering
1a) a swinging, brandishing
1a1) of God's hand, weapons
1b) waving, wave-offering (technical term of sacrifice)
1c) offering (of gold or brass)
H8573.strong_def: a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings

H8574.def:
Combined with mig.dal (מִגְדָּל "Tower" H4026I)
This name means furnace, oven

H8575.derivation: or תַּנְחֻם; and (feminine) תַּנְחוּמָה; from H5162 (נָחַם);

H8576.def:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.23;
father of: Seraiah (H8304I)

father of Seraiah, a leader who joined Gedaliah after Jerusalem's fall

H8579.def:
the second time, again
Aramaic of she.na.yim (שְׁנַ֫יִם "two" H8147)

H8580.def:
1) an unclean animal of some kind
1a) an unclean bird
1a1) perhaps the ibis, water-hen, species of owl, barn owl
1b) an unclean lizard
1b1) perhaps the chameleon
1c) perhaps an extinct lizard or bird, exact meaning unknown

1a2) in the ethical sense

1b1a) in the ritual sense
1b1b) in the ethical sense
1b2) to cause to be an abomination
1c) (Hiphil) to make abominable, do abominably
1c1) in the ritual sense
1c2) in the ethical sense

H8582.def:
1) to err, wander, go astray, stagger
1a) (Qal) to err
1a1) to wander about (physically)
1a2) of intoxication
1a3) of sin (ethically)
1a4) wandering (of the mind)
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be made to wander about, be made to stagger (drunkard)
1b2) to be led astray (ethically)
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to wander
1c1) to cause to wander about (physically)
1c2) to cause to wander (of intoxication)
1c3) to cause to err, mislead (mentally and morally)

H8584.def:

1b) attestation

H8586.strong_def: caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant

H8587.def: hidden thing, secret, that which is hidden

H8588.def:
1) daintiness, luxury, exquisite delight, pleasantness, delight, comfort

1b) dainty
1c) delight
H8588.derivation: or תַּעֲנֻג; and (feminine) תַּעֲנֻגָה; from H6026 (עָנַג);

1a2) mocker (subst)

1b1) to ridicule
1b2) mocking (participle)

H8593.def:

H8597.def:

1b) glory

1b2) as attribute of God
1c) honour (or nation Israel)
1d) glorying, boasting (of individual)

1b) apples

a place southeast of the Dead Sea and in or near the 'Arabah'
H8603.strong_def: Tophel, a place near the Desert

H8604.def:
1) that which is empty, folly, silly, foolish

H8605.def:
1) prayer
1a) prayer
1b) pray a prayer
1c) house of prayer
1d) hear prayer
1e) in Ps titles (of poetic or liturgical prayer)

H8608.def:
1) to play or sound the timbrel, beat, play upon, drum (on a timbrel or other object)
1a) (Qal) playing (participle)
1b) (Poel) beating (participle)
H8608.strong_def: to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine

H8609.def:
1) to sew together
1a) (Qal) to sew, sew together
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to sew
1b2) sewing (participle)

1a) (Qal)
1a1) to lay hold of, seize, arrest, catch
1a2) to grasp (in order to) wield, wield, use skilfully
1b) (Niphal) to be seized, be arrested, be caught, be taken, captured
1c) (Piel) to catch, grasp (with the hands)

H8613.def:
Tophet = "place of fire"
a place in the southeast end of the valley of the son of Hinnom south of Jerusalem

town founded by Ashur son of Hezron
in the hill country of Judah near Hebron
rebuilt by king Rehoboam of Judah; birthplace of Amos

H8621.def:
Tekoite, of Tekoa "trumpet blast"

H8624.def:
might, strong, mighty
Aramaic of taq.qiph (תַּקִּיף "mighty" H8623)

1a2) to give a blast, give a blow

1b) blast (for march)
1c) shout of joy (with religious impulse)
1d) shout of joy (in general)

daughter of: Zelophehad (H6765);

1a) perhaps a chrysolite, yellow jasper, or other yellow coloured stone

one of the deities of the Avite people of Samaria
according to tradition, worshipped under the form of an ass

noise, clamour

an inhabitant of Tishbe or Tishbi or Tesheb

: salvation

1b) salvation (spiritual in sense)

1c) of beast to devour
